She is a freshman at Shuchiin Private Academy and the Auditor of the Student Council. Miko has a strong sense of justice and will correct others on what's right and wrong. Unfortunately, this led to her being bullied, though she still continues to uphold her idea of "right". She idolizes [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103), listening to anything she says, even if it's for Chika's enjoyment.

name: Yuu Otosaka
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5' 8½")
__Ability:__ Looting: an ability that allows its user to take over another person for 5 seconds. However, it can also be used to take abilities from other ability-wielders if they are possessed.
__Affiliations:__ Hoshinoumi Academy student council

Yuu is a first-year student at Hoshinoumi Academy. He is rude and bad at studying. He usually behaves as if he were smart, but he is actually a chronic cheater. He says things which sound clever, and he is a narcissist. He has the ability to take over another person's body for five seconds.

name: Nao Tomori
description:
__Height:__ 154.5 cm (5’ 1")
__Ability:__ Imperfect Invisibility
__Affiliations:__ Hoshinoumi Academy student council

Nao is a first-year student and also the student council president of Hoshinoumi Academy. She has the ability to make herself invisible to any one person of her choosing at a time. She is a huge fan of the band Zhiend. She hates people who use their power for no good.

name: Joujirou Takajou
description:
A first-year student and member of the student council. He can move at such high speeds that he looks like he's teleporting. However, he's not totally able to control where he stops, so he has to wear protective gear under his school uniform to prevent injury.

Takajou lets his ability be plundered by Yuu for his plan to succeed. He no longer possesses his ability.

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

name: Yusa Kurobane
description:
Yusa is a first-year student and the vocalist for the band How-Low-Hello. She is able to speak to the dead. She uncontrollably channels her dead older sister Misa, who occasionally possesses her. When this occurs, her appearance changes, such as her eye color turning from blue to red.

Misa lets Yuu plunder her abilities after hearing his plan from Nao. Before that she had written a letter to Yusa, after her ability is taken she reads it and starts crying knowing that she was with her and everyone the whole time. She no longer possesses any powers.

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

name: Ayumi Otosaka
description:
A middle-school student and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/88950/Otosaka-Yuu)'s younger sister. She likes stars. She is also a huge fan of the Idol [Yusa Nishimori](https://anilist.co/character/88953/Kurobane-Yusa). 

She awakens the ability to make everything around her collapse, but ultimately, this awakening leads to her death. In episode 6, during a lunch break at school, Ayumi is threatened with a box cutter by a jealous classmate; she begins to run, but is soon cornered. Instinctively, she uses her ability, which collapses both the roof above her and the floor below; killing her.

name: Marin Kitagawa
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'3")

Marin is an extravagant, messy, and while quite mature, she's also clumsy. She isn't very skilled at handiwork. Marin is a cosplayer and a huge otaku, being a fan of magical girl anime and adult video games. 
She is very kind, friendly, cheerful and outgoing. She loves eating but still despite that she manages to maintain her slender figure.

Marin realizes she is in love with [Wakana](https://anilist.co/character/133678), and throughout the series, continually does whatever she can to invite him to places and spend time with him.

name: Wakana Gojou
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Hobbies:__ Hina Dolls

Wakana Gojou is a fifteen-year-old high-schooler who is not very social, and doesn't fit in well with his fellow classmates, leading to him having no friends at the start of the story. Gojou has a strong appreciation for hina dolls and loves making them, although he is not as skilled as he wants to be. This changes when Gojou ends up meeting someone who doesn't find his love for doll making weird, and instead is amazed at his artistic ability and craftsmanship.

name: Akiko Yosano
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'5")
__Ability:__ Thou Shalt Not Die

A modern woman with a bob cut who's a member of the Armed Detective Agency. Although she's an excellent doctor who is indispensable to the Agency, all members of the the Agency are scared to be placed into her care. It's recommended that you don't use outdated misogynistic expressions in front of her.

description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

He came to Yokohama after being driven out of a poor orphanage that was attacked by a man-eating tiger. On the verge of starvation, he meets [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu) and gets a job helping at the detective agency. Because he's never had friends or family and was labeled as "useless," he lacks self-confidence.

name: Osamu Dazai
description:
**Height:** 181 cm (5'11")
**Ability:** No Longer Human

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He's a suicide enthusiast who searches for a place to die. However, he doesn't like pain, and would prefer a lovers' suicide with a beautiful woman. He's aimless, elusive, nonchalant, and jokes around normally, but, when he is serious, it is clear that he is an insightful and intelligent individual. He loves to annoy his fellow Agency member, [Kunikida](https://anilist.co/character/89200).

He was a former Executive of the city's worst underworld organization, the Port Mafia.

name: Doppo Kunikida
description:
__Height:__ 189 cm (6'2")

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He carries a notepad with the word "Ideal" written on the cover, and what is written inside are guides for life. He has a straight-laced personality and hates nothing more than schedules going awry. As a partner to the free-spirited [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu), his troubles never end.

description:
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")
__Ability:__ All Men Are Equal

A member of the notorious "Port Mafia" that operates by the harbor. Akutagawa has a black and white "survival of the fittest" view of the world, claiming that weak people should die and give way to the stronger ones. His ability is called "Rashōmon" (羅生門).

description:
Satsuki Kiryuin is another main heroine of the anime, "Kill La Kill." She is an 18-year-old woman, and is the Student Council President of Honnouji Academy. She rules the school with an iron first, and assesses the students' abilities, holding the position/authority to draw out power surpassing that of humans.

She seems to have information regarding the death of Ryuko's father, putting the two at odds immediately after her arrival.

name: Ryuuko Matoi
description:
She transfers into Honnouji Academy as a second-year student, an Academy ruled by power and authority. She wields a huge single-bladed scissor, and demands to know the owner of the other half. As she remembers, the wielder of the lost half of the scissor blade is the same person who killed her father.

Her body has been fused with life fibers, making her a "life fiber monster"
She is the daughter of Kiryuuin Ragyou, making Kiryuuin Satsuki her older sister

name: Senketsu
description:
A living sailor uniform [Ryuuko](https://anilist.co/character/83797/Matoi-Ryuuko) finds beneath her house. Senketsu is a Kamui (神衣 lit. "God Clothes"), an outfit that provides its wearer with godlike abilities in exchange for their blood. He has the power to transform into an indestructible suit of armor, albeit with a skimpy appearance, much to Ryūko's embarrassment. His name, given to him by Ryūko, literally means 'fresh blood'.

After defeating Kiryuuin Ragyou, while falling through the earth's stratosphere, Senketsu burns up protecting Ryuuko.

description: Mako is a second year student at Honnouji Academy. She is an uber air-head, so her unbelievable actions never cease to shock and awe the people around her. description:
Alciel is one of Satan's Demon Generals and was also transported to modern day Japan with him. Extremely loyal to Maou, he takes care of the domestic duties at home and goes to the library to research ways for Maou and himself to regain their powers.

Back in Ente Isla, Alciel was known widely as the right hand of King Satan and a master strategist, making him both a trusted adviser and top military commander to the ruler of the Demon Realm. description:
Lucifer is a fallen angel and one of the Demon King's generals. After his defeat at the hands of Hero Emilia, he was secretly rescued by Olba Meyer, who promised to return Lucifer to heaven if they became allies in defeating the Demon Lord. After being defeated by the Demon Lord, Urushihara moved in with Sadao Maou and Ashiya.

Lucifer is shown to be cunning and sneaky as well as a childish, preferring to surf the internet and play video games rather than help Ashiya with the housework. Due to his attitude, everyone tends to treat him lightly and pay no mind to many of his protests at being ex

description:

When Naruko asked him if he had a crush on Menma, he said, "Why would I be in love with such an ugly—?" He had plans to apologize to her the next day, but she died later that night in a drowning accident.

Unable to forgive himself, Jinta spent the next years of his life in a constant state of gloominess. He became withdrawn and eventually became a hikikomori, or a shut-in. He currently lives with his father. While he is enrolled at

description:
__Height:__ 147cm

Menma is a ghost girl who suddenly appears several years after her death to Jinta and asks him to reunite their group of friends so her wish can be granted. Yet, she does not seem to remember what is her wish, but she knows she has to reunite her friends in order to remember. Despite being "dead", she is a very positive, energetic and lively person. According to Jinta, she is quite selfless and cries very often for others when they are hurt or upset, but not for herself. Naruko is a childhood friend of Jinta and Menma. While she displays a cold attitude towards Jinta, she is secretly concerned for him. She is perhaps the closest to him at present and is enrolled the same school (although Jinta stopped attending school). Chiriko comments that Naruko has not changed over the years: she is still easily persuaded by everyone around her. Naruko seems to be popular in high school and gets along well with girls that Chiriko deems "sluts."   While they have grown apart, Naruko seems cares deeply about her childhood friends. description:
__Height:__ 181 cm (5' 11")

Atsumu is a childhood friend of Jinta and Menma. In the present, Atsumu holds a condescending attitude towards Jinta. He becomes agitated when Menma is mentioned and is still distraught over her death. He, together with Chiriko, attend the same high school, which Jinta failed the entrance exams to enter. Atsumu and Chiriko were once mistaken as a pair.   Atsumu is still in love with Meiko despite her death and keeps one of her sundresses in his closet. He buys hair scrunchies and other trinkets to place at her grave. He revealed that he is able to see Menma too. Bu

name: Chiriko Tsurumi
description: As a child, Chiriko was a shy girl and a member of the Super Peace Busters. Now, she is enrolled at an elite school with Matsuyuki. Currently, she is ranked fourth in her class. She is serious, stoic, and cocky. Upon meeting with Naruko, Chiriko insults both her and her friends; however, she has since made amends with Naruko. While the other members of the Super Peace Busters have fallen apart, Chiriko and Matsuyuki have remained friends after Menma's death.   Chiriko is shown to have feelings for Matsuyuki; however, he does not reciprocate her affection. Matsuyuki's heart belongs to Menma. He

description: Poppo is the first friend that Jinta reconnects with. As a child, Poppo was uncontrollably energetic and friendly and was always loyal to Jinta recognizing him as the leader of the group. These  traits have not changed. Presently, Jinta reunited with him when he was searching for Menma. He visited their old clubhouse and found that Poppo was living there. Poppo explains that he works part-time jobs to earn money. When he makes enough, he goes on trips around the world. Because of this, Poppo has not attended school in several years.  Poppo seems to have questionable interests: Jinta found seve

name: Black☆Star
description: A shadow weapon meister and the last survivor of the infamous Star Clan, taken into the DWMA and raised by [Sid Barrett](https://anilist.co/character/16582/Sid-Barrett). His weapon partner is [Tsubaki Nakatsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/8443/Tsubaki-Nakatsukasa). He is known as one of the toughest students in the academy, being quite self-centered with a desire to always be in the spotlight.

name: Death the Kid
description: The son of [Death](https://anilist.co/character/8457/Shinigami) himself and the Meister of the Demon Twin Guns, [Liz Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8445/Elizabeth-Thompson) and [Patty Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8444/Patricia-Thompson). Created from a piece of Death's soul, Death the Kid is known to be one of the top 3 students in the DWMA, albeit with a confounding obsession when it comes to symmetry.

name: Maka Albarn
description:
[Soul](https://anilist.co/character/8456/Soul-Eater-Evans)'s partner and the female protagonist of the series.

Known to be cheerful, direct, confident, smart and hardworking, in stark contrast to Soul who is much more laid-back in comparison. Despite this, Maka has been noted by her partner to be stubborn and sometimes prone to making decisions without regarding others' feelings if she feels justified enough. Due to their differences, Maka often bickers with him and they tend to argue with one another, but despite all this they remain loyal partners and close friends.

name: Soul Eater Evans
native: ソウル・イーター・エヴァンス
description: [Maka](https://anilist.co/character/8439/Maka-Albarn)'s partner and the male protagonist of the series. Soul is a demon weapon who was born into a family of famous musicians. After discovering his weapon abilities as a Demon Weapon Soul joined the DWMA, where he partnered up with Maka. They often bicker and don't always see eye-to-eye, but in the end they remain partners and close friends.

name: Tsubaki Nakatsukasa
description:
A demon weapon partnered with [Black Star](https://anilist.co/character/8464/BlackStar) hailing from the Nakatsukasa Clan, a special weapons clan who are direct descendants of demon weapons created by the mother of magic weapons, Arachne Gorgon. Having inherited the unique Multi-Form Ability of her clan, she joined the DWMA to stop her brother from becoming a kishin, becoming fast friends with [Black Star](https://anilist.co/character/8464/BlackStar) in the process.

Tsubaki is known to be very patient and forgiving, with a polite and gentle personality that often leads to her helping or comfo

name: Elizabeth Thompson
native: エリザベス・トンプソン
description: A demon weapon and the older sister of [Patricia Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8444/Patricia-Thompson). Formerly a thuggish ruffian alongside her sister raised in the streets of New York, both her own and sister's life turn for the better when they encountered their future meister, Death the Kid. Eventually becoming Kid's weapon partner alongside her sister, she became a student of Death Weapon Meister Academy enrolled in the E.A.T Class.

name: Patricia Thompson
native: パトリシア・トンプソン
description:
A Demon Weapon and the younger sister of [Elizabeth Thompson](https://anilist.co/character/8445/Elizabeth-Thompson).

Known as one of the "Demon Twin Guns", both her and her sister were known as the "Brooklyn Devils" and were petty thugs until being found by their current Meister, [Death the Kid](https://anilist.co/character/8455). Overtime, she reformed from her thieving and ruffian ways along with Liz and became Kid's weapon, later becoming DWMA students within the E.A.T Class.

name: David Martinez
native: デイビッド・マルティネズ
description:
David is a street kid from Arroyo, Santo Domingo in Night City, who is enrolled into Arasaka's educational system at Arasaka Academy. He lives with his mother Gloria in an apartment of Megabuilding H4.

After experiencing a personal tragedy, David has the powerful Sandevistan speedware installed in his body and becomes one of Night City's edgerunners. He also becomes acquainted with [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/284157/Lucy), who leads him into the city's criminal underworld, and chooses to join the gang of edgerunners she is a part of, led by [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159/

name: Lucy
description:
Lucy is a mysterious netrunner from Night City. She is quite introverted and doesn't like to talk much about her past. Although she looks innocent, she won't hesitate to kill a person in a heartbeat if they tick her off. Lucy also considers Night City a prison and dreams of one day leaving it for the moon.

Lucy is a part of [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159)'s crew of edgerunners. One of its members, a netrunner named [Kiwi](https://anilist.co/character/284161), is her mentor. She also becomes acquainted with [David](https://anilist.co/character/284158) and takes him on a tour throu

description:
**Occupation**: Middle School Student
**Grade**: 3rd year
**Height**: 152 cm (5'0'')

A mysterious, cute and isolated girl in Yomiyama North Middle School's third year's third class. Her left eye is covered by an eye patch. The girl with a mysterious presence and is always sketching alone. She is labelled as the one that "does not exist".   Her left eye is a doll's eye. It can see things that should remain unseen, that's why she keeps it covered.  It can see people close to death or that are dead.

description:
__Occupation__: Middle School Student
__Grade__: 3rd year, 3rd class
__Height__: 167 cm (5'6")

The new transfer student into Yomiyama North Middle School's third year's third class (in May, 1998). He is 15 years old and the only son in the Sakakibara family. His mother supposedly passed away 15 years ago after giving birth to him. He becomes very interested and curious about Mei Misaki and attempts to pursue a friendship with her, but little does he know of the trouble this is going to cause... name: Ken Takakura
description: He is a young male student with a firm belief that UFOs and aliens exist. Upon meeting [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Ayase-Momo) and taking up on her challenge to see if ghosts were real, Okarun became cursed by a yokai known as the [Turbo-Granny](https://anilist.co/character/239956/Turbo-Babaa) and seeks to return to normal.

name: Momo Ayase
description: After making friends with [Ken Takakura](https://anilist.co/character/222593), who she calls "Okarun" (due to refusing to call him by the same name as the actor she idolizes), Momo wishes to help restore his body back to normal after being cursed by a yokai and must overcome other paranormal activities that are involved.

name: Aira Shiratori
description:
__Relatives:__ [Father](https://anilist.co/character/349655/Aira-no-Chichi)

After becoming aware of the existence of the supernatural after collecting a mysterious golden ball, Aira proclaims herself as the "chosen one" that is on a mission to protect the world from evil and directs her attention towards [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Momo-Ayase), believing that she is a demon that has to be stopped after seeing her use her psychic powers. Aira revels in her social status as the popular girl at Kami High and strives to maintain her reputation. Outwardly, she appears sweet, i

description:
Jin Enjouji is [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Momo-Ayase)'s childhood friend and first crush. After his parents were hospitalized as a result of his house being haunted, Enjouji moved in with Momo and [Seiko](https://anilist.co/character/234824/Seiko-Ayase) and transferred over to Momo's school.

name: Hachiman Hikigaya
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Hachiman is an isolated, friendless boy who is pragmatic to a fault. His most prominent feature is his set of "dead fish-eyes." He firmly believes that "youth" is simply an illusion created by hypocrites, for hypocrites, born from the ashes of past failures. In this state of apparent corruption, he is coerced into joining the Service Club by his futures advisor in the hopes that exposing him to the world will change his personality, and ultimately make him a "better person." He is called "Hikki" affectionately by [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069).

description:
Yui is a cheerful, outgoing girl who becomes the Service Club's first "customer", asking them to help her bake cookies for "a certain someone". Her problems lie not with her personality, but with her inability to deal with issues by herself. She believes that talent is inborn, and often aspired to be like others until [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/67067) changed her way of thinking. She has a twisted sense of "noblesse oblige", and believes that it is the duty of the exceptional (in other words, herself) to help the "lost lambs" of the world. Her personality often leads her to be disgusted at the naivete of others, particularly [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069)'s, and she does not hesitate to show it. She is aware of Hachiman's supposed "problems", and takes steps to ensure he is freed from them, her first move being to force him into joining the Service Club. description:
A mage from the Fairy Tail Guild who wields fire dragon slayer magic.

Natsu has a carefree and reckless nature and, despite his constant brawls with the other members of the guild, is a fiercely loyal and protective friend. He has a particularly close and competitive relationship with [Gray Fullbuster](https://anilist.co/character/4839/Fullbuster-Gray) and [Erza Scarlet](https://anilist.co/character/5189/Scarlet-Erza). native: ルーシィ・ハートフィリア
description:
A mage from the Fairy Tail guild who wields Celestial Spirit magic.

Lucy is cheerful, clever, and often gets swept along by her disruptive guildmates when they go overboard. Empathetic, caring, and more likely to write novels than wage battles, Lucy becomes most emboldened to challenge enemies when she needs to fight for her friends. She is said to be a noisy and somewhat fussy person, and there are times when she can be naive and too easily forgiving, greedy for validation as well as overly confident at inopportune moments. However, despite any failings and instances of self-doubt, she doesn

name: Happy
description: Happy is a cat with some magical power, which may be the reason for his ability to speak. He can temporarily grow wings on his back and fly, and is capable of carrying only one person in this form. Happy apparently can fly at incredible speed (As it took Eligor less than a hour to reach Clover when Happy caught up with him in mere seconds with Natsu in tow) This is also the only kind of transportation that does not make Natsu sick. native: グレイ・フルバスター
description:
__Occupation:__ Mage 
__Affiliation:__ Fairy Tail Guild 
__Team:__ Team Natsu 
__Magic:__ Ice-Make, Ice Magic, Ice Devil Slayer Magic

Gray Fullbuster is a member of the Fairy Tail guild. He is an 18 year-old ice mage, practicing ice alchemy, the art of molding ice. Due to his training history, he is most comfortable in little clothing and often forgets to wear clothes or quickly takes it off, thus often being accused of being an exhibitionist. He and [Natsu](https://anilist.co/character/5187) have a friendly rivalry, and can often be seen fighting one another. [Lucy](https://anilist.co/charac

name: Erza Scarlet
native: エルザ・スカーレツト
description:
An S-class mage from the Fairy Tail Guild who uses requip magic, which allows her to summon weapons and equip armor stored in another dimension. She is the strongest active female member.

Erza is a very strict, intimidating, and impatient person with a strong sense of justice. She has been a member of Fairy Tail since she was a kid, and shows great loyalty and dedication to [Makarov](https://anilist.co/character/5333) and the guild.

Erza used to be a nameless child slave where she was forced to help build a tower called the R-system. Over time Erza made friends with other slaves, one of them

name: Charlés
description:
Charlés is an Exceed with the same type of magic as Happy.  Wendy found her as an egg and they have been together ever since. They are very close, and Charlés sees it as her duty to protect Wendy from danger.

Charlés is strict and uptight. She disapproves of fooling around.

Charlés, like all Exceeds, came from the parallel world Edolas. She is the Exceed's princess, daughter of Queen Shagotte. As such, she possesses the same power as her mother: precognition.  

After a year of training, she learns and perfects the ability to use Transformation Magic, making her appear as a young girl around

name: Wendy Marvell
description: Wendy is the sky dragon slayer. She has the ability to heal and manipulate air.

name: Echidna
description: Echidna is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Greed. She has a strong thirst for knowledge along with a curiosity for the unknown, which defines her behavior. Echidna is described as black hearted, being unable to empathize with others and their feelings due to a lack of understanding. She will do anything to gain knowledge, be it deceit or employed sophistry.

native: ガーフィール・ティンゼル
description:
Garfiel Tinsel is the former guardian of the Sanctuary and a member of the Emilia Camp. Introduced during Arc 4, he became one of the main supporting characters of the season. He's a half-beast human and [Frederica Baumann's](https://anilist.co/character/143378/Baumann-Frederica) half-brother. He can transform himself in a giant golden tiger that can deal powerful attacks but with a cost of losing his reason, so he uses this ability when he's pushed to the limit.

Garfiel and Frederica lived together until she left when he was around 4 years old and he hadn't seen her since until their reunion

native: オットー・スーウェン
description:
Otto Suwen is a merchant appearing in  Re:Zero. His remarkable misfortune always takes him to dangerous situations, from which he escapes thanks to his wit.
Otto has gray hair that is mentioned to be as long as a gal game protagonist. He is said to be somewhat handsome if he has a serious expression. However, he is usually either retorting, shouting, or panicking, ruining his looks. He has a medium build, but has trained himself since he used to work as a merchant.

name: Simon
description:
**Height:** 156 cm (5`1")

Simon is the protagonist of the story, a short and un-intimidating fourteen year old boy at the beginning of this tale. He was born in Jiiha Village and was raised by his parents until the age of seven, when his parents were killed in an underground avalanche caused by an earthquake.

name: Youko Littner
description:
**Height:** 160 cm    
**Age:** 14, 23 (second half)

Yoko is a girl from Jeeha's neighboring village Littner, who had been chasing the Gunmen which entered Jeeha village. She wields an extensive range of firearms which include a long range sniper rifle (which she uses most frequently) modeled after the Barrett M82 and hand guns (which can be assumed is used for midrange or close combat) and has previous experience fighting Gunmen. Although she is of the same age group as [Simon](https://anilist.co/character/2257), she is mature and one of the most rational of the group.

Despite always badmou

name: Kamina
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm

Kamina is a young man from Jiiha village who dreams of leaving the village and going to the surface, which he saw as a kid. He's very passionate about his goals, expressing his wishes through energetic speeches, which seems to affect all those who hear him. He convinces [Simon](https://anilist.co/character/2257) to help him with his plan to drill through the roof of the village and get to the world above, but the plan failed and he was put in prison. He left the village shortly thereafter with the help of Simon and a young girl named [Yoko](https://anilist.co/character/2063

name: Nia Teppelin
description:
**Age:** 14-21
**Height:** 158-162 cm

Nia Teppelin is a mysterious young girl found sleeping in a capsule in the middle of a dump site by [Simon](https://anilist.co/character/2257). She had no prior contact with humans, except her father, who is also the sovereign of the Beastmen, the [Spiral King](https://anilist.co/character/5118). She is very curious, pure and innocent, due to growing up sheltered in a peaceful environment, away from all the battles occurring in the outside world. Despite early misgivings, she is quickly accepted by Team Dai-Gurren, much to the (initial) irking of [Yoko](h

name: Hyakkimaru
description: Hyakkimaru is the central character of Tezuka's best-known samurai story, Dororo. A powerful warrior, Hyakkimaru is traveling on a long quest to retrieve 48 parts of his body which were sold to demons by his father at his birth. This is a very dramatic adventure series, with a great variety of unusual mythological creatures and demons, as well as bandits and other fierce foes. Gradually the grim experiences of his travels make Hyakkimaru more and more distant and grim, so as he recovers more and more of his human body he becomes at the same time less and less human.

name: Dororo
description:
__Gender__: Female

After seeing his swordsmanship, Dororo decides to follow Hyakkimaru. Dororo was a thief before meeting Hyakkimaru.

Dororo's bandit father Hibukuro was wounded by a samurai official and later died. Her mother froze to death while fleeing in the snow, but before she died she drew a map on Dororo's back to locate money hidden by her father at Bone Cape.

Hyakkimaru learns that Dororo is female with the latter continuously insisting she is a boy, though this is because her parents raised her as one.

name: Haruki Shiga
description:
A guy who incidentally found a book in the hospital titled "Disease Coexistence Journal" which is owned by his classmate [Sakura Yamauchi](https://anilist.co/character/127118/Yamauchi-Sakura).

It is revealed in the last chapter of the novel that his name is Haruki Shiga (志賀春樹).

I Want to Eat Your Pancreas

name: Sakura Yamauchi
description:
A high school student who suffers a pancreatic disease, having her lifespan cut in half. She has a diary called "Living with Dying" where she writes about her daily experiences, since her illness was first diagnosed. 

Despite her situation, she keeps her smile and even makes jokes about it.

She was later stabbed after being discharged from the hospital and sadly passed away.

description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'5")

Demon Hunter and the Love Pillar of the Demon Killing Corps. Mitsuri is a soft and kind person. She is very emotional and passionate, constantly complimenting people in her head, which probably contributes to her nickname of "the Hashira of Love". Although she is rather shy and is easily flustered, she is always kind to others, most notably towards [Obanai](https://anilist.co/character/137777), whom she appears to share a strong bond with. Besides her rather emotional personality, she can also come off as somewhat childish at times.

description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Genya Is a Demon Hunter of the Demon Killing Corps. He is also the younger brother of the Wind Pillar [Sanemi Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137774).

 Due to his lack of breath forms he is dependent on using his shotgun and demon form. His shotgun pelts are made from sun steel to be effective against demons. name: Howl
description: Wizard Howl is a mysterious, reclusive wizard. He is twenty-seven years old and known for being very flamboyant and wicked. His notorious moving castle has recently been spotted near Market Chipping and rumours have begun to spread that he is searching for beautiful young women whose hearts he may steal. He comes from Wales, a country unknown to most in the book, where his family still remain unaware of his activities in [Sophie](https://anilist.co/character/508)'s world or of its existence.    Despite his reputation, Howl is in reality an endearing, charming man who is intelligent and conside

name: Sophie Hatter
description: She is a plain looking 18-year-old young adult, who passes all of her time working in a hat shop. She has big brown eyes and matching hair, tied with two pink ribbons, in a long braid. She has thick eyebrows, and Howl says that her smile is beautiful. She wears a cerulean dress with a white neck and black buttons. Sophie is a gentle, quiet young woman who doesn't like being in the spotlight. She is mature, and wears clothes meant for women older than her, despite her sister, Lettie's, protests. description:
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")

First-year high school student and contender for the Blue Lock Project. __Height:__ 177cm (5'10")

Hyoma Chigiri is a contender for the Blue Lock Project and member of Team Z.

description:
__Birthplace:__ Chiba
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

name: Reo Mikage

name: Maomao
description:
Maomao works as an apothecary in the red light district, helping her mentor and father [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968) in caring for its residents, with special attention given to the Verdigris Hall brothel, where she was born and was initially raised.

One day, while gathering herbs, she gets kidnapped and sold to be a common servant in the inner court of the imperial palace, where only the Emperor's consorts and their servants reside. Not allowed to leave, her curious personality and skills begin to rope her into mysterious problems that can affect the whole country.

description:

He is a student of the Asahiyama High School. He lives with his father, Isanari Uesugi, and younger sister, Raiha Uesugi, in a small apartment. She is also trusted enough to act as their confidant and leader. Ichika aspires to become an actress. She likes to tease [Fuutarou](https://anilist.co/character/128063).

description:

description:

Among the sisters, Itsuki is the most familiar with [Uesugi](https://anilist.co/character/128063)'s family members and circumstances.

Note: Based on the character file in volume 14, Itsuki’s actual birthday is on May 6th as she was born at midnight. She celebrates her birthday on May 5th and prevents others from looking into it too deeply.

His Zodiac animal is the cat which, in legend, was barred from becoming one of the official twelve animals because of the rat's trickery. Kyo hates the current rat of the family, [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/208), as a result. The two constantly fight and Kyo loses every time.

__Gender:__ Female (Manga); Male (Anime, 2001); Female (Anime, 2019)

He often runs fevers and rarely walks out of the main house other than to greet some of the Zodiac members, such as [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/208) and [Shigure](https://anilist.co/character/206), that live in the outside world. Akito has a definite mean streak, and has physically and emotionally scarred many members of the Souma family, but Akito's rule in the Souma clan is absolute, and none dare oppose him.

A second year student and Banri and Kouko's senior in the Festival Research Society.  Her nickname Linda (りんだ) is an alternate reading of the kanji for Hayashida (林田).

Her hobbies are out of the ordinary, and she rejoices when called a weirdo. She lives with a wealthy family, but she spends much of her money on instruments and always runs out of money. She occasionally eats weeds to get rid of her hunger.

description: Gotou Hitori is a shy, gloomy high-schooler who started learning guitar after seeing rock bands on TV, in the hope that she too could become as popular as them. However, after 2 years she has yet to make a single friend or join a band. She instead sits in her closet at home, recording guitar covers and posting them to her YouTube channel, "guitarhero", on which she has amassed a reasonable following.

Flashbacks throughout the series reveal that Revy may have honed her skills with firearms by shooting at cans, and that her first murder may have involved shooting her father while using a pillow. They continue to write to one another until Takaki discovers he must move to Tanegashima. The two decide to meet one snowy day, perhaps for the last time...   In high school, he belonged to the kyudo club.  (Source: Wikipedia)

description:
Risa Mizuno is a girl Takaki met in Tokyo. They met a couple of times due to their work and started going out after a while.

In the movie, Risa and Takaki were together for a while and Risa started sending text messages to him, inviting him to hang out, but Takaki did not reply back since he still has feelings for Akari.

When Akari moved on and got married, Takaki tried to move on and started dating Risa Mizuno, but eventually broke up.

To Ganta, Shiro's manner of speaking and acting remind him of a small child, even though Shiro is the same age as him. From the beg

Ganta is a seemingly harmless, ordinary middle school boy who is framed for the slaughter of his entire middle school class, perpetrated by the mysterious Red Man. Sentenced to "death," he is sent to Deadman Wonderland, where he is initially confused and frightened by the brutality of the prison.

The next day, Ganta and Senji were slated to be the next two Deadmen to compete in the "Carnival Corpse." A rarity among the prison population, Yoh made himself captured and sent to Deadman Wonderland in hopes to find his sister Minatsuki and buy her freedom with the accumulated Cast Points he got from Tamaki. He is the bespectacled boy in the group. A die-hard fan of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

In a valiant effort to help Kiyoshi escape so he could go on his date and obtain a rare Romance of the Three Kingdoms Figurine, he defecated himself in front of a group of girls in order to obtain the resulting sound in a way that can only be described as camaraderie in its purest, unadulterated form.

His family circumstances have given him maturity beyond his years. He skips the first half of school on rainy days to think up new shoe designs in the garden.  (Source: official site)

He is an ancient magician with both human and fae characteristics. Despite his appearance, he is gentle and polite with humans and shows a great interest in them. He understands why humans feel the emotions they do, but has never experienced them himself. 

One day, he buys [Hatori Chise](https://anilist.co/character/88344/Chise-Hatori) from the black market and makes her his Mage Apprentice.

description:
Cartaphilus is a sorcerer that serves as a recurring antagonist of the series. Later is found out that Cartaphilus is actually an unknown being that has lived for over 2000 years, that was found by and later fused with a man called Joseph.

(Source: The Ancient Magus Bride Wikia)

name: Rishia Ivyred

__Race__: Human

Rishia is the daughter of the House of Ivyred, a noble family. Due to an unfortunate string of events, the family had grown poor and she was forcefully taken as ransom by a neighboring family in exchange for gold. She was rescued by The Bow Hero, whom she would later devote her life to.

To show her gratitude and support for her savior, Rishia would go on to join Itsuki's party. She would then be treated as an errand girl, carrying food and supplies for the Bow Hero's party, leaving her talent in magic unused and untapped.

Ikki Kurogane is an F-rank Apprentice Knight who strives to become a real Mage Knight. He is a young man of average height with dark brown hair and brown eyes.

When it comes dealing women of his age and the whole academy in general Ikki is really clumsy because he has no prior experience with them outside of respect towards a superior or as a knight. name: Shizuku Kurogane
description:
**Ranking:** A-Rank

Ikki Kurogane's younger sister. Unlike her older brother, she was well-respected as a child and was even forgiven due to her talent as a Blazer and was the only person in their family who didn't despise or look down on Ikki for being an F-Rank Blazer and was saddened after he left.

His parents divorced and he now lives with his father (presumably he first lived with his mother after the divorce, but when starting high school he moved in with his father instead, for unknown reasons). One day Kou suddenly moved away without any notice leaving behind a stunned Futaba. They began to hate Futaba and blame her eventually exiling her altogether​. Now in high school, Futaba is determined to

description: Guts is the protagonist of Berserk. Renowned as the "Black Swordsman", he is a former mercenary and branded wanderer who travels the world in a constant internal struggle between pursuing his own ends and protecting those dear to him.

Despite his lack of strength and skill, he utilizes his small size and agility to his advantage, along with various tricks and tools. Her ambivalent relationship to both of them makes her moody and capricious. Casca joins the Band of the Hawk after Griffith saves her from a sexual assault by a nobleman. 

After Griffith is imprisoned, she becomes the leader of the Band of the Hawk and, along with Guts, leads the mission to rescue Griffith.

name: Schierke
description: Schierke is a young witch-in-training, a disciple of the witch Flora. She is accompanied by an elf, Evarella. She aided Guts's group with a troll infestation in the nearby village Enoch, where she showed how powerful magic can be in Berserk.   After a series of events, Schierke was forced to leave her home and Flora behind forever when they faced an attack Griffith ordered. Schierke, having lived a sheltered life, doesn't like the Human world or the Holy See's religion, but she finds life outside bearable due to her companions.   Her magic skills and knowledge of the world are impressive for a

name: Griffith
description:
Griffith was the founder and leader of the mercenary unit known as the Band of the Hawk, named for his helmet which was forged in the shape of a Hawk's head. 

Extraordinarily charismatic, intelligent, and handsome, his skill with his sabre and tactics gives him and his band the reputation of invincibility, making him the favored choice of the Midland King, who was locked in a century long war with the Empire of Chuder. Believing that he is destined for greater things than the average man, Griffith is willing to sacrifice everything for the dream of his own kingdom and only values others so fa

name: Serpico
description: Serpico is Farnese's companion and unbeknownst to her, her paternal half-brother. During his time with the Holy See, Serpico was Herald for the Holy Iron Chain Knights.   When aggressive, Serpico belies his meek appearance and is comparable to a fox due to his shrewd observation and speed with a rapier.   Despite Farnese's childhood abuse and her forcing him to burn his own mother at the stake, he cares deeply for his half-sister. Serpico was her servant since she found him beaten on a snowy street over a decade ago.   Serpico's relationship with Guts has forever been plagued with animosity, d

name: Puck
description:
A wind spirit from Elfhelm, a utopia on the island Skellig in the Western Sea. Elves in Berserk can only be seen by the open-minded; the devoutly religious cannot see Puck at all, though he can play with their face unbeknownst to them.

Puck can secrete a powder from his wings to quickly heal wounds and can emit a bright flash to blind enemies. On occasion, he also resorts to his "Bloody Needle" attack, tossing a spiny object resembling a seed pod at someone. It deals no injury, but is painful enough to prompt most victims to cry out. Puck was the first to join [Guts](https://anilist.co/charac

name: Farnese de Vandimion
native: ファルネーゼ・ド・ヴァンディミオン
description: Farnese is a noblewoman who led the Holy See's ceremonial guard, the Holy Iron Chain Knights. Since this position has been traditionally held by a woman, Farnese was appointed during her stay at the convent she was sent to by her father, Federico Vandimion.   A bit of a pyromaniac (and possibly a pyrophiliac), Farnese's habit of maniacally burning things she didn't like, along with her lack of empathy due to her poor upbringing provoked her to hunt down and burn supposed witches and pagans at the stake. This fueled a secret sadistic pleasure that she constantly tried to deny.   She and Serpico

It is shown later on that the reason he hates Adagaki Aki so much was because she rejected his feelings for her and nicknamed him "Piggy". Later on, in order to get revenge on Aki, Makabe teams up with [Koiwai Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/121008/Koiwai-Yoshino), Aki's maid.

description:
Yoshino is [Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki)'s maid and follower. She seems to be a clumsy girl. However, beneath her clumsy and shy appearance she is actually extremely deceptive and cold, able to deceive and hurt Aki without a second thought. Unlike Aki, Yoshino easily gained weight from sweets.

Later it was revealed that Yoshino had disguised herself as Aki eight years before, rejected Masamune, and gave him the nickname "Piggy" due to jealously towards Aki's affection to him, but soon realized that her actions caused Aki to become estrange towards men. She has been reg

description:
**Height:** 159 cm

She has a frail body, needing to consume many drugs although she often makes jokes about it. Due to her habit of not wearing any panties, [Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki) and [Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/121008/Koiwai-Yoshino) nicknamed her "Pantie-less Woman".

While claiming that she just needs Masamune to pretend that their first en

Inori Yuzuriha is one of the main protagonists of the anime Guilty Crown and a member of the resistance guerrilla group called "Funeral Parlor".  She is also the voice of the internet artist Egoist who sings to release her emotions.  Inori is a very soft, quiet, and sweet girl, who is also very determined to complete her missions successfully and without fail (shown when she was threatened but didn’t show any sign of fear, even when she was about to be killed). She also seem

description:

One of the main protagonists of Guilty Crown, who's right hand holds a special power called "The Power of the King". This ability allows him to extract weapons from his friends known as a "Void" which is a manifestation of a person's personality.  He is an unsociable 17-year-old young man who usually tends to stay out of people's way so as to not cause them any trouble. description: An old friend of Akira Tendou from college and the rugby team. He hasn't seen him in a year before the apocalypse. After he graduated from college he became a salesmen at a major real estate company because of his great communication skills. In reality he seems almost perfect but he too was miserable at his job and wanted to become a comedian.

Her personality is because of her upbringing. Her father was a successful business man. He was very strict and wanted her to be perfect, to succeed.

name: Sakamoto
description:
A black cat who wears a scarf created by the [Professor](https://anilist.co/character/41055), which allows him to speak. Being technically older than both [Nano](https://anilist.co/character/10422) and the Professor, he speaks in a condescending tone towards them, though he occasionally succumbs to his catlike habits.

In the last episode, it is revealed that Sakamoto used to be [Nakamura](https://anilist.co/character/44126)'s cat and was called "Taisho". Sakamoto does not want to return to Nakamura because she did not take good care of him, even though she had good intentions.

name: Yuuko Aioi
description: An energetic high school girl with short brown hair. One of her negative sides is that she is often too lazy to do her own homework and always copies from either [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/40081) or [Mai](https://anilist.co/character/10421).

name: Mai Minakami
description: A rather quiet girl who is very intelligent and often is seen with a book. She is seen to be multi-talented, excelling at using projectiles, arm wrestling, and especially pulling pranks, usually at the expense of [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/10418/Aioi-Yuuko). She also frequently enjoys carving Buddha and Drawing in her spare time.

name: Mio Naganohara
description:
A bright and cheerful girl sporting light blue hair and pigtails held by two small wooden cubes. She has a crush on [Koujirou](https://anilist.co/character/41616). She's usually a calm and collected person who can support her friends whenever they're in a pinch. But she's a lot more sensitive than she lets on, and more often than not needs that support back in return.   

She is a fujoshi mangaka, going under the name Daisuke Naganohara.

name: Nano Shinonome
description:
A robotic schoolgirl that was built by a [Professor](https://anilist.co/character/41055/Shinonome-Hakase). She often worries about keeping her identity as a robot from others, despite the fact that everyone already knows about it due to the noticeable wind-up key exposed on her back. Luckily most don't make a big fuss about it. Her limbs will sometimes fall apart, revealing dubious items that Professor has installed without her noticing, ranging from bean-firing-weapons to Swiss rolls. She is also the Professor's caretaker.

She wishes to live life as a normal girl and therefore real

name: Hakase Shinonome
description:
She is a young scientist, who despite her outstanding intelligence, still reflects her age.

She loves sharks and snacks, and constantly modifies [Nano Shinonome](https://anilist.co/character/10422/Shinonome-Nano), whom she created, to add strange and unusual functions such as a machine gun right hand and a swiss roll dispensing arm. Nano, most of the time, is unaware of these modifications until they are first used. However, Hakase always refuses to remove the obvious wind-up key from Nano's back cause she thinks that it’s cute, despite Nano's requests to do so.

name: Ranpo Edogawa
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

The great detective of the Armed Detective Agency. He possesses sharp observation skills that are acknowledged by his coworkers, and he settles difficult cases at the request of the police. Because of his self-confidence, his speech is brazen and child-like. His motto is "If you'll have me, everything will be ok!" He likes logical thinking and fantastic tales.

name: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
native: フョードル・ドストエフスキー
description:
__Ability:__ Crime and Punishment

Head of the underground organization "Rats in the House of the Dead" and part of the terrorist organization "Decay of Angels". He maintains a calm, confident, and arrogant yet polite personality towards others and has shown to be extremely intelligent, cunning, and sinister. He is highly religious and speaks often of the sin of man, especially ability users. According to him, he is anemic.

name: Hanako
aliases: Crazy Knife (クレイジーナイフ)
description:
__Age of Death:__ 13

Hanako is a ghost haunting the old building of Kamome Academy. He resides on the third floor female bathroom, in the toilet of the third stall. He governs over the Seven Mysteries as School Mystery Number 7.

Hanako's real name is Yugi Amane. He attended Kamome Academy as a student and his goal was to become an astronaut and go to the moon someday. He was to become a science teacher at Kamome Academy as an adult, but his future changed for unknown reasons. He ended up with the fate of killing his own twin brother, of dying as a kid, and of then becoming one of the Seven M

description: Yashiro Nene is a normal student, and one day she listens to a rumor about ''Hanako-san'' who makes wishes for anyone, but the wishes come with a price. She visits him in the hope of getting her crush to fall in love with her. She becomes friends with Hanako-san soon after meeting him then. She is in the gardening club.

name: Kou Minamoto
description: Minamoto Kou is a student at Kamome Academy's Middle School Division, and a member of a renowned family of exorcists, the Minamoto Clan.

name: Akatsuki
description:
__Race:__ Human

__Subclass:__ Tracker

A highly skilled level 90 adventurer who met [Shiroe](https://anilist.co/character/81367) and [Naotsugu](https://anilist.co/character/81371) shortly after the Apocalypse. Shiroe gave her the appearance changing potion (which allowed her character to look more like her real self); before that, she had been playing as a male character. She's very loyal to Shiroe for his generosity, and addresses him as "Master".

Akatsuki is rather insecure about her height, and hates it when people mistake her for a child (despite the fact that she is a

name: Shiroe

__Race:__ Half-Alv
__Class:__ Enchanter

Shiroe, the main protagonist of the series, was an engineering grad student before the Apocalypse. He's one of the most experienced and skillful adventurers in the game, due to having started playing Elder Tale when he was in middle school. He's also infamous for being a brilliant tactician. He is renowned as the strategist of the Debauchery Tea Party, an informal group that managed to tackle some of the game's most difficult raids. He knows [Naotsugu](https://anilist.co/character/81371) from the time both of them spent with t

name: Naotsugu
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Class:__ Guardian
__Subclass:__ Border Patrol

Naotsugu is a friend of Shiroe. He believes that every man is a pervert, either openly or secretly. Thus, he prides himself for being an "open pervert", freely sharing his perverted thoughts about women with everyone.

name: Nyanta
description:
__Race:__ Werecat
__Class:__ Swashbuckler
__Subclass:__ Chef

Nyanta is an old friend of Shiroe, as he also used to be a member of the Debauchery Tea Party. He's the one who protected Serara while she was trapped in the city of Susukino. He considers himself a "gentleman"; his weapon of choice is the rapier which he can double-wield. He can cook meals that have actual taste due to his subclass.

Kichimura Washuu is the primary antagonist of the Tokyo Ghoul series and the former Bureau Director of the CCG. He is involved in numerous organizations and is responsible for several major events of the series.

He was originally the illegitimate son of former CCG Chairman Tsuneyoshi Washuu and an agent of V raised in the Sunlit Garden.

To further his own agenda, he has used various identities to infiltrate organizations or build personal alliances. As a member of the Clowns, he was responsible for the Steel Beam Incident. He also joined the Ghoul Res

name: Reze
description:
Reze is a young girl who met [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) in a phone cabin. She works at a local café and is a kind and gentle girl who seems to have a crush on Denji soon after meeting him. She laughs at his jokes and isn't afraid to get close to and intimate with him.

‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌She is secretly the Bomb Devil hybrid, owned by the Soviet Union and allied to the Gun Devil. Her true personality is manipulative and brutal, as she is shown killing many Devil Hunters without care or mercy. She does, however, not enjoy killing and prefers to avoid it, unless necessary for her mi

name: Kakeru Naruse
description:
The series centers around him, his fate, and the efforts of his friends to fulfill the wishes of a letter from the future.

Kakeru is initially shown to be quiet and reserved, however, once [Hiroto Suwa](https://anilist.co/character/66595/Suwa-Hiroto) and the others invite him to join them on their walk home and hang out with him more, he seems to open up and enjoy himself. He enjoys video games. Though he puts up a happy front around his friends and family, he hides his true feelings often and is incredibly depressed over his mother's death/suicide, in which he blames himself for it happening

description: Suwa is [Naho](https://anilist.co/character/66591/Takamiya-Naho) and [Kakeru](https://anilist.co/character/66593/Naruse-Kakeru)'s classmate and friend. He is very energetic and outgoing and he loves to hang out with his friends. He likes Naho but knows she likes Kakeru, so he supports them both. Suwa will become a very important person to her in her future, but 16-year-old Naho doesnt know yet.

name: Naho Takamiya
description:
Naho Takamiya is the main female protagonist in Orange. When she receives a mysterious letter from the future involving [Kakeru Naruse](https://anilist.co/character/66593/Naruse-Kakeru), she and her friends try their hardest to fulfill the demands of the letter.

Naho is a very loving and shy girl who tends to scream whenever she is nervous or embarrassed. She is shown to have a rather passive personality, as on multiple occasions throughout the series, Naho is unable to speak her own mind and tell people (especially Kakeru Naruse) how she feels, possibly out of fear of hurting or confusing th

description: Hagita is a regular student in Nagano who becomes very good friends with [Kakeru](https://anilist.co/character/66593/Naruse-Kakeru). While he is not outgoing or charismatic, Hagita has a profound determination and intelligence. Hagita is a very big fan of reading manga and watching the television show 'Yuugata Get'. Later in the story, Hagita even goes as far as to buy Kakeru manga for his birthday. Throughout the story, subtle comments and interactions hint at an affection Hagita holds for [Murasaka](https://anilist.co/character/76830/Murasaka-Azusa) and in the future time line Hagita is marr

description:
She is one of [Naho](https://anilist.co/character/66591/Takamiya-Naho)'s best friend who supports her throughout the series. She is often seen arguing with [Hagita](https://anilist.co/character/76832/Hagita-Saku), but has a cheerful personality.

Azusa is shown to be cheerful, playful, bright, and kind to her friends. She accepted many of the nicknames she received in middle school, proving her to be open-minded to most things. Though, she may be mischievous at times.

name: Takako Chino
description: Takako is one of [Naho](https://anilist.co/character/66591/Takamiya-Naho)‘s best friends. She is shown as fairly mature and little boyish who is supportive and unafraid to stand up for her friends, especially Naho Takamiya.

name: Iori Kitahara
description: Iori Kitahara is a first year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. Despite no initial interest, Iori comes to love diving and spending time with the members of the club, whom he becomes friends with and cares about despite their rambunctious behavior and endless crazy schemes.

name: Chisa Kotegawa
description:
Chisa Kotegawa is Iori's cousin and a first-year mechanical engineering student at Izu University. Chisa appears to more level-headed and serious compared to other characters. She has a clear dislike for rowdy behavior and can be quite hostile, especially when it is directed towards her (especially with Iori). She rarely takes part in drinking or crazy antics and is usually seen sitting off the side as an observer. She loves diving and looking at diving equipment. Chisa is one of three female students in her class idolized by her male classmates due to her major's lack of females.

It is later

name: Kouhei Imamura
description: A first-year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. He is [Iori](https://anilist.co/character/123182/Kitahara-Iori)'s best friend and a diehard otaku, perceived to be a lolicon by his acquaintances. He happens to be particularly obsessed with the little sister character trope (hence his obsession with [Shiori Kitahara](https://anilist.co/character/125928/Kitahara-Shiori)). While many are repulsed by his otaku lifestyle, he is indifferent to how he is perceived by others.

name: Aina Yoshiwara
description:
Aina is a first year at Oumi Women's University. She joins Grand Blue Diving Club after getting to know Iori and Kouhei. She is a really shy girl and hates having to expose her skin. She soon becomes good friends with Chisa.

She used to wear strong makeups to appear attractive not realizing her very makeup was a turn-off for men. She was part of the Tinkerbell Tennis Club but she was always looked down upon and made fun of by her seniors. Iori and Kouhei came to her rescue when she had it enough during the Miss Izu Contest as she resorted to getting drunk and broke down in tears in front of t

__Height: __176 cm (5'9")

description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")
__Talent:__ Snowboarding, Skateboarding

At first glance, Langa appears to be a very stoic young man, barely showing any emotions. But on the inside, he’s more complex and appears to be more confident.

Langa is a teenage boy with blue hair that grows past his ears and blue eyes. He is above average height as he’s taller than [Reki](https://anilist.co/character/195120/Reki-Kyan). Throughout the series, Langa wears the average high school uniform of black pants, a yellow jacket, and a white button-down shirt. But when he associates with [Reki](https://anilist.co/chara

description:
__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")
__Talent__: Skateboarding, Talking to cats

Miya Chinen is a character in the SK8 the Infinity anime series who is an elite middle school student and candidate for Japan's national team. Miya is seen as a carefree boy. He is interested in skating, but not portrayed as obsessed like some of his competitors in "S," an underground and dangerous skateboard race at an abandoned mine.

As a child Miya loved skating and had fun with it. As he grew up, he began improving and received awards for it. However, this lead to his friends assuming that he saw them as "sidekicks" and

name: Hiromi Higa
description: In his normal life, as a florist, Shadow looks friendly and kind to his customers. However, entering the middle of the night and S, he changes his attitude to be arrogant, bad, and rude which is thought to be his outlet whenever he experiences unpleasant things during the day.

name: Kaoru Sakurayashiki
aliases: Cherry Blossom (チェリーブロッサム)
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Kaoru is calm intellectual, well-known even outside of "S" as a famous and successful AI calligrapher. He's been shown to treat clients and strangers with polite respect, but is often prickly towards those closest to him, most prominently his fellow "S" member and childhood friend [Kojiro Nanjo](https://anilist.co/character/195123).
Kaoru is also notably competitive when skateboarding - but does truly trust and care for those who he considers his friends.

name: Kojirou Nanjou
description:
__Height:__ 189 cm
__Talent:__ Cooking
__Affiliation:__ Sialaluce (restaurant)

He is a skilled skater and a founding member of "S", he uses his unique build and status to skate in an aggressive, movement-oriented manner. 

Despite his aura of hostility towards [Cherry Blossom](https://anilist.co/character/195118/Sakurayashiki-Kaoru), they are good friends, who have the utmost confidence in each other and their abilities. He is shown to be deeply attached to Kaoru, being the person for whom Kaoru sneaks out of the hospital after his injury, and the one who carried Kaoru when he passed out afte

name: Ainosuke Shindou
description:
__Zodiac:__ Taurus
__Affiliation:__ Diet Member
__Relatives:__ 3 Unnamed Aunts; Aiichirou Shindou (father)
__Talent:__ Skateboarding

He can use an ability called "Love Hug" which allows him to seem like he is riding uphill.

name: Tadashi  Kikuchi
description: He is Ainosuke Shindo's secretary and the person who originally taught him to skate.

name: Muten Roushi
description:
The "Turtle Immortal" is an ancient and wise martial arts master and the first Earthling to wield the Kamehameha. Though he seems frail, he is a mighty warrior. Muten-Rôshi trained [Grandpa Son Gohan](https://anilist.co/character/2104/Son-Gohan), [Ox King](https://anilist.co/character/2094/Gyuumaou), [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu), [Kuririn](https://anilist.co/character/2159/Kuririn), and [Yamcha](https://anilist.co/character/4014/Yamcha). His home, Kame House, a shack on a small isolated island, serves as a gathering place for the Z Fighters and friends.

He is a stock

name: Yamcha
description: __Dragonball:__ Yamcha, the notorious desert bandit, started out as an antagonist of [Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu) but quickly became his friend thanks to [Bulma](https://anilist.co/character/678/Bulma). He lived in the desert, which resulted in him never having much female contact. Whenever he encountered Bulma, he would blush immensely and become petrified right on the spot.  Yamcha's trade mark move was known as the Fist of the Wolf Fang. With this move, he would strike the opponent with his hands in a claw like pose with his middle finger, ring finger and thumb curled.

name: Bulma
description:
__Birth Year:__ 733 Age
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")
__Race:__ Earthling 

Bulma is originally a secondary main character, but her role is quickly downplayed as the series continues, even though she does remain an important support character for most of the series. Bulma is a direct parody of the character Xuanzang from the Chinese novel _Journey to the West_. Even though Bulma's character parodies a monk, her Japanese name "Buruma" is the brand of a popular gym short worn by girls in Japan. Her re-adapted name Bulma is a direct take on the word "bloomers", which was a popular brand of women's un

name: Makoto Naegi
aliases: Super High School Level Good Luck (超高校級の幸運)
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Talent:__ Good Luck

Makoto is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. His talent is Super High School Level Good Luck (超高校級の幸運), meaning he got into Hope's Peak by winning a lottery, rather than being scouted for an extraordinary talent like everyone else. His title is the Ultimate Lucky Student in the English localization.

Makoto is friendly and a lot more down-to-earth than other students. He tends to act passively in conversation. According to him, his most distinguishing feature is his optimism.

He is known as a 'magi', through mediating with his staff, he can gather the magoi of rukhs for attacks. He also has the ability to materialize the djinn Ugo that lies within his flute. In addition, he can also make the magical turban that is wrapped aroun

description: Yuuri began skating at a very young age and aspires to become a great figure skater like his idol, [Victor Nikiforov](https://anilist.co/character/90225/Nikiforov-Victor). As stated by his teacher [Minako](https://anilist.co/character/169094/Okukawa-Minako), Yuuri is not a prodigy at skating, but his skills were honed by rigorous training, which also grants him good stamina. He is Japan's top figure skater; his greatest skating assets being his peculiar sense of rhythm and unique step. However, Yuuri succumbs to pressure easily following the death of his pet dog Victor, causing him to mess up

name: Yuuri Plisetsky
native: ユーリ・プリセツキー
description: A 15-year-old next-generation Russian figure skater who has won three consecutive junior world championships. Because of his looks, he is called the "Russian Fairy," but as soon as he steps off the ice he becomes vulgar and acts more like a delinquent. He is an ambitious person who believes without a doubt he will become the best in the world.

name: Victor Nikiforov
native: ヴィクトル・ニキフォロフ
description: A 27-year-old "living legend" who has garnered the attention of the world. He is a skater who has won five consecutive world championships. He is popular with men and women of all ages, and he has a rock star-like charisma. Yuuri has been chasing after him since he was a child. Victor begins to take an interest in Yuuri for a strange reason.

name: Kei
description:
A young woman whom Kaneda meets on his quest to find Tetsuo. She is a member of an anti-government organization that Ryu and Nezu are also involved in. 

Kei's role in the Resistance is important because she is completely loyal to its cause and to Ryu. She is strong willed and is the one to discover that Lady Miyako is an Esper too. Miyako helps Kei channel her thoughts and discovers she is a conduit for the Espers' telepathy. Kiyoko does this in the movie and Kei communicates with Kaneda and Tetsuo. She works closely with Chiyoko, a physically strong and resilliant resistance fighte

name: Shoutarou Kaneda
description: Kaneda is a carefree gang-leader who boasts a custom-modified motorcycle. He and [Tetsuo](https://anilist.co/character/2589/Shima-Tetsuo) have been best friends since early childhood. He is brash and not above teasing Tetsuo despite feeling affection for him as a younger brother. Upon rescuing [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/9875/Kei), Kaneda becomes involved in the activities of her group of anti-government guerillas in hopes of locating Tetsuo.

name: Tetsuo Shima
description: Kaneda's best friend since preschool and the second principal subject of the story's theme. Tetsuo is shown as a black sheep in the gang he and Kaneda are part of, and quietly suffers from a deeply rooted inferiority complex. He admires his friend yet at the same time strongly resents his own reliance upon him. After his psychokinetic abilities manifest, Tetsuo quickly becomes Kaneda's nemesis; he desires Kaneda's motorcycle (a symbol of status and power), and seeks to prove himself supremely powerful, without need of protection.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Makoto Edamura
description: The self-proclaimed "greatest con artist in Japan" who makes a living swindling innocent seniors and tourists. Used to be an honest, affable guy. Collects capsule toy figures and loves coffee.

name: Laurent Thierry
native: ローラン・ティエリー
description:
An infamous French conman who travels the world. He never loses his cool, and always keeps his eyes on the prize. Likes to dress up and joke around. Becomes the target of one of Edamura's schemes while sightseeing in Asakusa.

Laurent originally wanted to become a diplomat in order to help his mother financially. But she passes away after being decieved by an investor named Hugo, which leaves Laurent at a gambling routine in Paris. One night, he tries to kill Hugo, but Dorothy stops him and ends up recruiting him to her Confidence group, alongside Seiji Osaki, Kudo and Shi-On.

native: アビゲイル・ジョーンズ
description:
An exceptionally athletic conwoman from Iraq with a flexible and toned body. Blunt and belligerent. Hides a secret in her childhood memories.

 In episode 7, she recalls her time as a child soldier after war broke out in her home country. She is heavily affected by the trauma it caused and sometimes even considering suicide.

name: Cynthia Moore
description:
Cynthia is confident in her abilities and takes pride in her sex appeal. She is a confident and outgoing woman. She’s very smart and good at acting. She can speak multiple languages and can stay calm in stressful situations.

Cynthia worked at a café as a young woman. A regular at the café, [Thomas Meyer](https://anilist.co/character/175373/Meyer-Thomas), asked if he could paint her likeness. They hit it off and soon started dating and living together (where they ate many meals of canned beans). Both were trying to hit it big in their careers, Cynthia with acting and Thomas with painting. Thei

Riku was an 18 years old Imanity who lived during the Great War on Disboard. He was one of the main protagonists in Tet's story. He encountered Shuvi while going on an expedition and brought her to his colony after having lost in a game against her (albeit willingly).

He bears many similarities with Sora, being his black hair, slender body, black eyes and his face. Riku is a master strategist and manipulator, much like Sora. One of the colonists in Tet's story and the supposed older sister of Riku. She was also the founder of Elchea after the Great War and is Stephanie Dola's direct ancestor.

Couronna has a very similar appearance to Stephanie Dola; however, her hair is slightly longer and darker. She cares about Riku, going as far as calling herself his sister after he had lost his family. Though she is a mere Imanity, she seems to be sensitive to things, as she was able to figure out that Shuvi was not an Imanity right away.

name: Schwi Dola
description:
Schwi was the first Ex-machina to be introduced in Tet's story. In the story she seeks to understand the human heart and was found by Riku. She looks like a young human but with several differences, being two tails coming out from her back and other machine like features protruding from around her body. She bears many similarities with Shiro.

description:
Yue is a vampire who was imprisoned in the abyss. She was betrayed by her uncle and peers because of her monstrous magic and regeneration that made her nearly immortal.

With a fateful encounter, Yue met [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/132848/Nagumo-Hajime) in a sealed room in the abyss. After being rescued, Yue was the person who suppressed Hajime's madness before he became a monster and she soon became Hajime's "special" person after what transpired in the Abyss.

native: クラウス・V・ラインヘルツ
description:
The leader of Libra and young head of the noble Reinherz family. A large, very powerful man with a distinctive underbite, he is actually very well composed and gentlemanly and honest to a fault, with an unshakable will. Master of the Brain Grid Blood Battle Style, which he can use to create large cross-shaped weaponry and seal away vampires. 

The sealing power he owns is to seal away vampires only under a certain condition: knowing the vampire's real name.

Klaus is also very intelligent, being able to play the game "Prosfair," the complexity of which is known to drive humans mad (Klaus himse

description:
Described as a hotheaded, hyper-sexual juvenile punk, he is easily annoyed, quick to lose his temper, and his juvenile actions often get him and others into trouble.

Despite this, he is supposedly good at looking after new members, and so was assigned as Leo's partner/bodyguard. He is also something of a ladies man, possessing several lovers in town.

For reasons unknown, he continuously tries to fight Klaus, only to be routinely smacked down.

name: Shinpei Ajiro
description:
Shinpei Ajiro is the main protagonist of the Summer Time Rendering series. He returned to his hometown of Hitogashima for the first time in two years to attend the funeral of his childhood friend, Ushio Kofune. Since he lost his parents at an early age and grew up in the Kofune family, he has been close to Ushio and Mio as if they were his family.

name: Hizuru Minakata
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Hizuru Minakata is an author who writes using the pseudonym Ryuunosuke Nagumo.

She has a double personality, the second of which is her dead twin brother, [Ryuunosuke Nagumo](https://anilist.co/character/231699/Nagumo-Ryuunosuke). In actuality, it is [Ryuunosuke](https://anilist.co/character/231699/Nagumo-Ryuunosuke)'s shadow that is within Hizuru. He takes control whenever they must fight, so as not to make Hizuru's hands dirty. name: Ushio Kofune
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

She lives in Hitogashima, she lost her life in a maritime accident while trying to save Shiori from drowning in the sea. Her death acts as the starting point of the story, with Shinpei returning home to attend her funeral.

name: Mio Kofune
description: She is Ushio's younger sister and a first-year high school student. She is good at sports, belongs to the swimming club, and has tanned skin. Despite the death of her older sister, she has a healthy side, such as her cheerful attitude toward Shinpei when he returns home.

name: Laios Thorden
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Laios is the leader of his party and Falin's older brother. He is a tall-man from the Northern Continent.

Laios is a monster fanatic and a strong fighter. His deep knowledge and passion for monsters helps him to excel in combat and dungeon exploration. However, social skills are where he often falters; he struggles to pick up social cues, resulting in a lack of awareness and tact. This has caused him a lot of trouble throughout his life, a shortcoming that he is painfully aware of and insecure about. Despite this, Laios is extremely kindhearted, accepting, and frien

name: Marcille Donato
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Marcille is mage who is part of [Laios'](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios) party. She is an elf from the Northern Continent.

She is actually half-elf and half tall-man. Her mother is an elf, and father was a tall-man who passed away when Marcille was young.

Marcille is kind, intelligent, principled, and loyal to her friends. However, she can also be very high-strung and has a difficult time dealing with things far outside her comfort zone (such as eating monsters). She has a lot of confidence in her magic ability due to her background, and can feel

name: Senshi
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")

Senshi is a member of Laios' party. He is a dwarf from the Eastern Continent.

Having spent 10 years studying monster cuisine and living a self-sufficient life inside the dungeon, Senshi loves cooking and is more than happy to share his knowledge and skills. He is dependable and strong, but can also be rather stubborn and set in his ways. He helps maintain the natural environment and ecology of the dungeon, and considers  himself part of it. He dislikes magic and treats it with a great deal of gravity and caution.

name: Izutsumi
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Izutsumi is a former member of Shuro's party and currently a part of Laios' party. She is a tall-man (beast-man) from the Eastern Archipelago.

Izutsumi is rather stand-offish, but is not a distant person; she's fairly self-centered, but is in the process of learning the value of working with others. She is primarily fueled by a determination to find someone to lift her curse. She has terrible table manners and is a picky eater.

Izutsumi was born to humans, but the nature of her first curse, the curse placed over her which fused her body with that of an animal's is

name: Chilchuck Tims
native: チルチャック・ティムズ
description:
__Height:__ 110 cm (3'7")

Chilchuck is a member of [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)' party. He is a half-foot from the Eastern Continent.

Chilchuck is shrewd, practical, and sharp-tongued. He refuses to take jobs unless he is paid in advance. His specialties are lockpicking and identifying and disarming traps. He's more open to eating monsters than [Marcille](https://anilist.co/character/127292/Donato-Marcille) is, but like her, draws a hard line at humanoids. He generally goes along with whatever the party does, but will speak frankly when they do something that ca

name: Kawaki
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm 
__Affiliation:__ Kara, Konohagakure 

Kawaki is a shinobi raised by [Jigen](https://anilist.co/character/130418/Jigen) and his organization Kara to be the future vessel for [Isshiki Ōtsutsuki.](https://anilist.co/character/189948/Isshiki-Ootsutsuki) After being brought to Konohagakure, he is taken in by [Naruto Uzumaki](https://anilist.co/character/17/Naruto-Uzumaki) and develops a brotherly bond with [Boruto Uzumaki.](https://anilist.co/character/121439/Boruto-Uzumaki)
