name: Boruto Uzumaki
description:
Boruto Uzumaki is a shinobi from Konohagakure's Uzumaki clan and a direct descendant of the Hyūga clan through his [mother.](https://anilist.co/character/1555/Hinata-Hyuuga) While initially resentful of his [father](https://anilist.co/character/17/Naruto-Uzumaki) and his absence since becoming Hokage, Boruto eventually comes to respect his father and duties. Regardless, he vows to instead become a shinobi like his [mentor.](https://anilist.co/character/13/Sasuke-Uchiha)

Boruto is loud, energetic, and stubborn not unlike his father; even possessing a verbal tic, "dattebasa" (だってばさ), similar to

name: Mitsuki
description: Mitsuki was created as a synthetic human by [Orochimaru](https://anilist.co/character/2455/Orochimaru), being cultivated from the same embryo as at least one older "Mitsuki". Orochimaru, as Mitsuki's "parent", wanted Mitsuki to find his independence, having concocted a complex plot for Mitsuki to do so. On Orochimaru's sixth attempt of the plan, each time erasing Mitsuki's memories of the previous, Mitsuki mastered Sage Transformation and decided to rebel against his "parent" and "older brother". He left their company and set out to forge his own destiny himself, now going by the name "Mitsuki

name: Sarada Uchiha
description: Sarada Uchiha is a kunoichi from Konohagakure's Uchiha clan. Because she grew up without having her [father](https://anilist.co/character/13/Sasuke-Uchiha) around, Sarada initially struggles to understand who she is or what she's supposed to be. After meeting him with the help of [Naruto Uzumaki](https://anilist.co/character/17/Naruto-Uzumaki), Sarada comes to believe that she is defined by the connections she has with others, and as a member of [Team Konohamaru](https://anilist.co/character/3889/Konohamaru-Sarutobi), she seeks to someday become Hokage so that she can connect with as many peop

description:
She is a young girl who becomes an apprentice witch under the witch [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) after her initial accidental use of forbidden magic turned her mother to crystal. She hopes to search the Tower of Books for the book containing the magic, in order to reverse its effects on her mother.

She is quite a dork for magic, with a child-like (even for her age) widen eyed look whenever she sees things that are common for every other witch. The very magic that inspired her was simple magic made by Qifrey's watcher that caused glowstone path to light up.

name: Qifrey
description:
Qifrey is a witch and [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco)'s teacher. He runs an atelier and currently has four disciples.

He is a caring teacher who patiently teaches his students magic. This is especially true for Coco, who has no special abilities as a witch at first but he continues to encourage her until she can draw magic skillfully. He is protective of all his disciples, as seen from how he protects them from being taken by Esheath from the Magic Security Council. However, Qifrey is overly obsessed with his goal to locate the Brimmed Hats, with his gentle attitude oftentime

name: Richeh
description:
Richeh is a young witch in training and a disciple of [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/Qifrey). She wants to keep her magic essentially "pure" and unchanged and resents having to do what others tell her to do. 

Richeh specializes in crystal magic, particularly in creating transparent crystal ribbons. She also excels at drawing small, intricate glyphs, and has been shown to be adept at connecting these together to form magical portal holes. She has a seemingly emotionless and childish personality. She avoids showing much emotion, though others can still notice emotions on her. She

name: Tetia
description:
Tetia is a young witch in training at [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) Atelier. She loves clouds and dreams of creating the perfect cloud magic.

She's perpetually energetic and has a habit of thanking people for thanking her. Tetia is an extremely upbeat, loving girl that tries to help everyone she knows and keep the mood high. She is also the one who often gets everyone grounded and keeps the mood up by being loving to her friends.

name: Agott Arkrome
native: アガット・アークロム
description:
Agott is a witch in training and [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/)'s student. She belongs to the famous Arkrome house, who have served as librarians at the Tower of Books for generations.

She has a tendency to focus on how much more she still needs to accomplish, leading her to express dissatisfaction with her current progress. Agott suffers from self-esteem issues over being considered merely average and she takes that out on others who she doesn't think either deserves magic or have the talent to do so, which is usually [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco).

name: Olruggio
description:
He is a witch and serves as the Watchful Eye for [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/Qifrey)'s atelier. He has a gruff way of speaking but his magic is often described as "warm". He has created a lot of magical items, such as the Glowstone Path, the Snugstone and the Searneedle Wand. His specialty is fire-based magic.

He is very caring to the apprentices and gives them things that might be helpful, as well as rushing to Qifrey's aid, but every time someone points out he's acting very nicely, he tries to brush it off as something anyone would do or to his work as watchful eye.

name: Bojji
description:
The firstborn prince of the Bosse Kingdom.
Bojji was born abnormally small, weak, and deaf. He is a powerless prince who has lived his life under the shadow of his father, the legendary [King Bosse](https://anilist.co/character/244198/). He wants to be the world's greatest king, following his father

Bojji is extremely hard-working and sincere, and these traits draw people towards him even if they can't always understand him.

He learns how to wield a sword thanks to [Despa](https://anilist.co/character/244201/). Despa helps him overcome his physical limitations, by making use of his agility a

name: Kage
description: Kage is a literal shadow who becomes [Bojji](https://anilist.co/character/209532/Bojji)’s first friend.

name: Ushio Okazaki
description: Ushio is [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/4606) and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/4604)'s daughter. She is a well-behaved, well-loved girl who is very curious about the world around her. Tomoya notes that she does not act like other girls her age. For example, most girls would want to have dolls; however, when Tomoya goes on a trip with her, he buys her a robot with which she is fascinated. Tomoya, finding it strange that she would prefer this type of toy, learns that Ushio has some interest in robots; thus he also calls her "boyish". Ushio also appears to like baseball. Ushio's i

name: Umetarou Nozaki
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'3")

Umetarou is the high school student that is the object of [Chiyo Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/87271/)'s affection. He is secretly a manga artist named Sakiko Yumeno, the creator of the shoujo manga "Let's Love~". This manga is published in the magazine called Monthly Shoujo Romance. Despite making a romance-oriented manga, he has no personal experience in love, and his story ideas are often ridiculous and farfetched. He appreciates Chiyo's drawing ability but is oblivious to her feelings.

In middle school, he was a captain of the school basketball team. In h

name: Chiyo Sakura
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")

The viewpoint character of the series, Sakura is a high school girl with a crush on [Nozaki](https://anilist.co/character/87269), but when her confession is misinterpreted, she ends up becoming Nozaki's inker assistant. She is in class 2-A and a member of the school's art club. She is petite, and on her head, she wears two large ribbons that have a polka dot pattern, of which it becomes Nozaki's trademark of Chiyo and names a screen tone after her.

name: Mikoto Mikoshiba
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

Mikoto Mikoshiba is one of Nozaki's assistants and Yuu Kashima's best friend and classmate. He has red hair and equally red eyes. Both of his ears appear to be pierced and he usually wears tiny red earrings on them. He attracts the attention of many girls, and is admired by the males as well. However in reality, he has a timid and "tsundere" attitude. While outwardly he flirts with girls shamelessly and confidently, afterwards, he cringes and becomes embarrassed beyond words at his own actions.

name: Masayuki Hori
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

A third year student and the president of the drama club. He is good in acting and used to appear in plays but stopped due to his short height and now in charge of props. Kashima always causes him trouble but he is often like a doting parent to her. 

Nozaki's Assistant who in charge of the background.

name: Yuu Kashima
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

The prince of the school, even though she is female. She is very popular among the female students and flirts with them. She is part of the drama club and is in class 2-G.

Kashima displays a somewhat princely personality, often flirting with the girls and calling them, "hime" (Japanese for "princess"). She has a firm loyalty towards Hori (whom she calls Hori-chan-senpai), and often seeks his attention. She tries to please Hori, but more often than not, misunderstands the situation and ends up getting things very wrong. For example, she mistook Hori's interest in shoujo man

name: Yuzuki Seo
description:
__Height__: 163 cm
__Class__: 2-A

Sakura's classmate. Easily makes people feel offended.
She is a member of the choir club and her singing voice is beautiful enough to be referred to as "Lorelei".

name: Hirotaka Wakamatsu
description:
Freshman who belong to the basketball club and he knows Nozaki since middle school since they were in the same basketball club.

He played against Seo a basketball match and her rough play make him unable to sleep but was able to sleep soundly later thanks to the voice of Lorelei which he doesn't know her true identity.

name: Natsuo Fujii
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Natsuo is introduced as a second-year high school student who loves writing novels, so he frequently heads to the rooftop during his lunch breaks to develop his passion. It is there that he meets the rookie English teacher named [Hina Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana), who becomes his first crush. His current appearance is far different from his junior high days thanks to following the suggestion of [Fumiya Kurimoto](https://anilist.co/character/135349/Fumiya-Kurimoto) (Natsuo's best friend), who forced him to wear contact lenses instead

name: Hina Tachibana
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")
__Occupation:__ Teacher

She is the elder sister of [Rui Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127596/Rui-Tachibana), but soon after [Tsukiko Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/135347/Tsukiko-Tachibana) (Hina's divorced mother) marries a widower named [Akihito Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii), Hina becomes the stepsister of [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii).

 It is also pretty much likely that due to a necessity of a paternal figure added to the kindness of [Shuu](https://anilist.co/character/135346/Shuu-

__Occupations:__ High school student, Apprentice Chef

Rui is the younger sister of [Hina Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/127595/Hina-Tachibana), but soon after [Tsukiko Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/135347/Tsukiko-Tachibana) (Rui's divorced mother) marries a widower named [Akihito Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/135352/Akihito-Fujii), Rui becomes [Natsuo Fujii](https://anilist.co/character/127594/Natsuo-Fujii)'s step-sister.

At first glance, Rui is an aloof and blunt girl who is hard to read emotionally. Her standoffish personality has made it

description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4’7”)

Another researcher at Victor Concordia University's Neuroscience Lab, similar to Kurisu. She attends a lecture at Okabe's university as Professor Leskinen's assistant.

name: Melissa Shield
description: Melissa is a Quirkless girl and the daughter of Scientist [David Shield](https://anilist.co/character/125952/).

name: David Shield
native: デヴィット・シールド
description: David is a scientist who creates support items for heroes, and an old friend of All Might. He is the father of Melissa Shield.

name: Tarou Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm

Tarou Sakamoto is a retired hitman. He was the greatest hitman, feared and revered by bad guys and hitmen everywhere. However, he left the hitman world in order to be with his wife. He currently owns a store, and has one child. He is the jack of all trades of his town, and is very popular and well liked by people in his town.

name: Shin Asakura
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Shin is a ex-hitman turned employee who works for [Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Sakamoto-Tarou). He has the ability to hear the thoughts of those around him.

name: Rachel Gardner
native: レイチェル・ガードナー
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

An amnesiac little girl who finds herself in a mysterious building. Being very calm and collected, she's often described as being extraordinarily dull but painfully honest, with some even remarking that she resembles a porcelain doll due to her difficulty in visibly expressing emotions and always having a strange, blank stare regardless of her mood. She's fixated on the idea of God, often overthinking her relation and worth to him, as well as projecting his will onto various events in her life, even desiring punishment and death once she labels herself a sinner.

She

native: アイザック・フォスター
description:
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")

An illiterate serial killer in charge of floor B6, the lowest in the building. He despises liars and dishonesty above all else and sees himself as a monster. His favourite weapon is a scythe, which was given to him by [Gray](https://anilist.co/character/127275/Gray-Abraham). He seems to have unnaturally strong destructive tendencies, going into a frenzy whenever he's allowed to let loose, as was the case with him destroying [Eddie](https://anilist.co/character/123329/Mason-Edward)'s graveyard on floor B4. Due to his tendency to speak his mind and being brutally hones

name: Yona
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm
__Race:__ Human

The spoiled princess of the Kouka kingdom, who has a crush on her cousin and childhood friend [Soo-won](https://anilist.co/character/88670). Soo-won comforted her when she lost her mother in young age. She hates her crimson red hair. Her bodyguard is the other childhood friend, the general [Son Hak](https://anilist.co/character/43815) who she finds really annoying.

As the princess and the only heir of the Kouka Kingdom, Yona was raised with extreme care and gets whatever she wants, for example, beautiful accessories and clothing. This lead her to being a sp

name: Hak Son
description:
**Height:** 188 cm

He is the former chief and general of the Wind Tribe. He is famously known as Thunder Beast for his fighting skills that were said to be unrivalled by anyone, earning him the title of "strongest soldier in the kingdom".

He is in love with [Yona](https://anilist.co/character/43814/Yona). Even when Yona was unaware of his feelings, every now and then, Hak couldn't help but display his affection towards her.

name: Yun
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm
Race: Human

In Princess Yona's group, he is the healer and genius.

He is an outstanding curious intellectual. He can say mean things, but he's a caring pretty boy. He was born in a poor village of the Fire Tribe.

name: Ki-Ja
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the white dragon of the group. He has dragon claws on his right hand, which is said to have ten times the strength of a normal human's.

In a side chapter focused on Kija, he (when he was a child) had secretly went to see his father (who was on deathbed). However his father was too weak to realise who it was and thought it was the granny. He had asked if it was okay for him to touch that child (Kija) now that his right hand was back to being a normal human hand. Kija, upon hearing this leapt onto the bed and hugged his father. His father died shortly

name: Shin-Ah
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the blue dragon and has dragon eyes that allows him to see great distances. Shin-Ah's dragon eyes are also capable of disrupting the nerves of anyone he glares at until it kills them.

Later in the story, his power was explained in more detail. His victims are subject to fatal hallucinations. In extreme cases he can cause their entire bodies to stop functioning, including their hearts. However, he does not have full control over this power and will lose himself to the blue dragon's murderous willpower. When he finishes using that ability, he himself b

name: Jae-Ha
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the descendant of the Green Dragon and possesses the power of a dragon in his right leg. His power allows him to jump high and long distances that almost make it look like he can fly. It also makes his leg incredibly strong and lethal when used to kick. He's a big flirt, he doesn't care whether it's a man or a girl.

Twenty-five years ago, Jae-ha was born in the Village of Ryokuryuu and Garou, the previous Ryokuryuu, took care of him. During his childhood, he was confined in chains within his room to prevent him from escaping the village and also from

name: Zeno
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the yellow dragon and has a really strong body.

He joins the group immediately after the Awa arc. Later on it's revealed that he was watching Yona ever since she was chased out of Hiryuu castle to see if she was fit to use the power of the four dragons. After the events in Awa he decided that he wanted to follow her, so he showed up at the campfire.

In chapter 100, it is revealed that he is immortal, and that he is the original dragon warrior who received the blood of the Yellow Dragon. His power worked by having certain areas of his body being seri

name: Soo-Won
description:
__Height:__ 185cm
Race: Human

He is the son of the deceased General Yu-Hon, the older cousin of Yona, as well as her and Hak Son's childhood friend, the three were best friends. He kills Yona's father and becomes the 11th King of Kouka and wants to unite the Kingdom to restore its original power after King Il's reign.

He later meets Yona once again in Awa after Kumji's death and hides Yona from General Ju-do and the others, and states that he still has something to do when Yona wanted to kill Su-won.

Nozomi Yamamoto voices him as a child.

name: Miyako Shikimori
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

Shikimori is not only cute but also smart and athletic, however, she isn't very good at cooking! She is very protective of [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/155701/Izumi-Yuuki) because he always puts himself in risky situations, when these situations occur, Shikimori reveals her "cool" appearance. She thinks Izumi is very cool and kind. She owns a pet dog named Kara.

Both cute and cool clothing styles suit her, but she seem to have a preference for a cute look. She became very popular at school with the girls after they saw her cool side during the tournament's v

name: Yuuki Izumi
description: Izumi is a friendly, upbeat kid. He’s had terrible luck his entire life. If something can go wrong... he’ll probably wind up in the hospital. But he still thinks he’s the luckiest guy in the world, because Izumi has a girlfriend who is smart, sporty, and always looking out for him. [Shikimori](https://anilist.co/character/155702/Shikimori-Miyako) is his knight in shining armor.

name: Akari Kawamoto
description:
Akari is the eldest of three Kawamoto sisters.

After her mother and grandmother’s death, she stepped in as the parent figure for her younger sisters. In the mornings she helps her elderly grandfather run a traditional wagashi shop, and in the evenings she works as a hostess at a bar, which her aunt manages.

Hinata Kawamoto, often called Hina, is the middle child of the Kawamoto siblings and a middle school student whose positive attitude inspires [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/21044/) to try to overcome his depression.

description: The youngest of the three sisters. A preschool student, she attends a daycare center. Pure and innocent, she has a bit of a selfish streak at times. Her favorite anime character is Bodoro (modelled on My Neighbour Totoro's [Totoro](https://anilist.co/character/269/Totoro)). She calls [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/21044/Kiriyama-Rei), "Rei-chan".

description:

He is the main protagonist, whose progression is explored through the series. He is a teenage professional shogi player, currently ranked at 5th-dan. He is widely lauded in the shogi community as the fifth shogi player to become a professional in middle school. Using his salary combined with his life savings, he lives in his own apartment while juggling between his official matches and high school. description:
Maru is a boy searching for a place called "Heaven".

name: Kiruko
description: Kiruko is [Maru](https://anilist.co/character/289824/Maru)'s bodyguard, and he is searching for a place known as "Heaven".

Akihiko Kaji is a college student in Given. Also the drummer in Ritsuka's band, he can play not only the drums but also violin, guitar, and bass.

name: Ritsuka Uenoyama
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5′8")

Ritsuka Uenoyama is one of the main protagonists of the Given Series. He is a high school student and has a guitar prowess despite being just a high schooler. He is a considerate and compassionate guy and is also a genuine younger brother of his sister [Yayoi](https://anilist.co/character/167937/Uenoyama-Yayoi). Uenoyama shows little consideration for small talk and can be quick to be irate. He can be smug when showing his high test scores, and says he can understand theory based subjects. Uenoyama can be very attentive to the feelings of others, particularly [Mafuyu

description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

One of the protagonists of the manga-anime. He has a quiet, calm and mysterious personality, he can't express his thoughts and emotions very well, despite being a sincere boy. After all he is a strong person who has endured many bad things in his past. He lives with his mother (who works a lot and is never shown in the manga and anime) and his dog named [Kedama](https://anilist.co/character/230878/Kedama), but he usually calls him Tama (cat name). description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Haruki Nakayama is a film major graduate student, and the bassist in the band Given. He is the oldest in the group and the leader of the band. Haruki “prefers lighter music (compared to other guys) and pop. Drawn to Japanese rock and light, slow tempo dance.”  He is “extremely good natured and kind” and is easily flustered. In the manga it is revealed that Haruki’s “stand” is a kind elderly man. He lives on his own in an apartment and is friends with [Ritsuka Uenoyama](https://anilist.co/character/136843/Uenoyama-Ritsuka), [Mafuyu Satou](https://anilist.co/character/136844/

description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

He is a world-renowned violinist. He is [Akihiko](https://anilist.co/character/136842/Kaji-Akihiko)'s room and classmate, and on-again-off-again boyfriend as well as a University student. He has been classmates with Akihiko since their high school days. Though he is Akihiko's roommate, he sometimes goes abroad and sometimes he stays in Japan.

Ugetsu is very intelligent and a prodigy violinist. He is generally a cheerful and friendly person, he is warm and affectionate towards others, such as welcoming Akihiko home. He is very sharp about other people‘s feelings.

Ugetsu is

name: Chisato Nishikigi
description:
Said to be the strongest Lycoris of all time.
She enjoys solving private-sector problems that the DA would not address.
At Café LycoReco, she works joyfully and cheerfully as the self-proclaimed poster girl.

Chisato has an artificial heart which was developed by Alan Institute, and can be broken by applying high voltages directly to it.

name: Takina Inoue
description:
Previously an exceptional Lycoris, but for some reason, she now works at Café LycoReco.

A realistic person with a distaste for inefficiency, she can be dissatisfied with [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato), who is not a typical Lycoris.

She wants to see good results in her job at LycoReco.

__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")
__Occupation:__ Doctor
__Partner:__ 	Noé Archiviste (now), Dante (former)

Vanitas is an average human being who inherited his name and the Book of Vanitas from the infamous vampire.

He seems to often take nothing seriously and almost always has a broad grin on his face. He acts more on emotions than thought most of the time since his plans are normally reckless. Also carries a mischievous air around him. 

 When he was just a child, his parents were killed by a vampire. He was saved by the chasseurs and taken in. They trained him to become a chasseur

Noé is a gentleman vampire.

His story began when he received a letter from The Teacher, which explained that The Teacher wanted Noé to fly to Paris immediately, as there had been rumors that The Book of Vanitas had been found there. The Teacher then specifically ordered Noé to discern The Book of Vanitas' true nature.

A student at Chidori High. The exceptions to this are his close friends at Chidori High, as well as [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676), a girl from an opposing school known as Kikyo Private Academy. Cliff Grimoire is the Grandson of the Pope, and a friend of Rudeus. 

Cliff has a very high amount of pride, so much so that he will proudly tell people when they ask him for help. Though this trait may irk many people it cannot be said that he is arrogant since he is shown to be constantly studying to improve himself showing that he is very diligent as well. He is also very loyal to his friends, since it is shown that if he is asked for help, then that becomes his main priority

description:

Komatsu came to Tokyo, looking to find her dream. Unlike Osaki, Komatsu came from a large and happy household, though her childish outlook prevented her from living on her own initially. She's the middle child of three sisters.  

Her chance encounter with Osaki began a friendship which changes Komatsu's life forever. She is introduced to Osaki's band, Black Stones, and their members. description:

One of the two titular characters of the series, Oosaki Nana may look like a tough punk rocker, but she has a kind heart and is a devoted friend. Abandoned by her parents and raised by her grandmother, Nana was expelled from high school after she was falsely accused of prostitution. Despite these hardships, Nana "polishes the shards of her dreams" and is determined to be successful as the lead vocalist of Blast. She is now engaged to her first love, [Ren](https://anilist.co/character/1425), although she also has lingering, ambiguous feelings for [Yasu](https://anilis

name: Ayame Kajou
description: Ayame is the Vice-President of the Student Council and daughter of a disgraced former Diet member who unsuccessfully fought against the public morality laws. Ayame secretly acts outside of school as the perverted terrorist Blue Snow (also known as Blue Tundra), wearing panties over her face, spreading semi-pornographic leaflets, and shouting dirty jokes in defiance of the Japanese moral authorities. After kidnapping [Tanukichi](https://anilist.co/character/89004/Okuma-Tanukichi), she decides to form the group SOX with him and expand her activities to include the school.

name: Anna Nishikinomiya
description: Being the president of the Student Council and a daughter to her influential parents, whom are both responsible in enforcing the ever stricter public morality laws, Anna is a soft-spoken and innocent yet strong and determined girl whose role is to get rid any materials that are deemed obscene or lewd not just in the school, but also in the society as a whole.

description: Erotic illustrator for SOX, and double awarded painter who goes to Tokioka Academy with the rest of the main cast.

name: Haruko Haruhara
description:
Haruko Haruhara is Mabase's newest resident, and an extraterrestrial investigator for the Galactic Space Police Brotherhood.

Haruko is an energetic, spontaneous girl with light-pinkish hair. She claims to be 19 years old, but it is impossible to know if that is true. In the first episode, she runs over [Naota](https://anilist.co/character/630/) with her Vespa and hits him in the head with her guitar. Shortly after, she becomes the Nandaba household's house-maid while working to find Atomsk, the most powerful space pirate in the galaxy.

She has a tendency to switch between a variety of differ

name: Naota Nandaba
description: Twelve-year-old Naota Nandaba is the main character. His name is derived from the Japanese word for "honesty" and his father named him Naota because of that (Fooly Cooly). Unbeknownst to him, he has the "right kind of head" to be used as an N.O. channel. He is obsessed with appearing mature and attempts to act nonchalant. This is most expressed in his monologues which open and close each episode where he continues to claims that "nothing amazing ever happens here" despite the show's surreal and often absurd happenings. Naota idolizes his older brother Tasuku,

name: Mamimi Samejima
description: Mamimi Samejima is a truant high school student with a quixotical grip on reality who carries a camera and smokes most of the time, hinted to have been bullied at her school and apparently from a broken family as her parents are mentioned are separated or are out of her life. She was originally Tasuku's girlfriend since he saved her from a elementary school fire, which she apparently caused due to her pyromaniacal tendencies to burn things she hates like her old school. It became a ritualistic practice for her in worshipping her personal deity Cantido whom she considered Canti an incarnation o

description: Takuma Sakamoto (Sakamoto Takuma) a.k.a. Diablo (gamer tag: @Diablo-13) is the male protagonist of the series. He was a Cross Reverie player who controlled the character Diablo, known as the true Demon King. He always defeated players with better equipment and overwhelming skills, always holding back for being too strong. But one day he was invoked in another world, reincarnating in the body of his character, Diablo, finding two girls, a Pantherian and an elf, who claimed to have invoked him and that he should be a slave to one of them but due to his ring the magic back against them becomi

native: シェラ・L・グリーンウッド
description:
Shera L. Greenwood is one of the female protagonists of the series. She is an Elf who is one of the two Summoners who summoned [Diablo](https://anilist.co/character/126793/Diablo). The reason she summoned him was to have the strength to live free.

It was revealed later that she was actually an elven princess.

description:
Rem Galleu is one of the female protagonists of the series. She is a Pantherian who became an invoker and had no choice but to become an adventurer and continue to demonstrate its strength, saying to aim to exterminate the Demon King Krebskulm. 

It is later revealed that the soul of Krebskulm is sealed in her body and in case she dies the soul will be released.

name: Akane Kinoshita
description: Akane is a college student who had just broken up with her ex-boyfriend. Mainly because of him falling in love with another female gamer he met in the game Forest Of Savior (FOS). She is also a player of the said game and is a part of the guild named [Chocolate Rabbit]. Her character's name is Akane and her character's role is a Paladin. She is not tech savvy but she really likes playing the game and getting along with everyone.

My Love Story with Yamada-kun at Lv999

name: Akito Yamada
description: Yamada is a high school student who is an intellectual and a good looking guy. He is not interested in romance but in playing games. He is a famous pro-gamer and receives money from sponsors. He mainly plays FPS (First Person Shooter) games. He is a player of the game Forest Of Savior (FOS) and a part of a guild named [Chocolate Rabbit]. His character's name is Yamada and his character's role is a Wizard.

native: アリサ・ミハイロヴナ・九条
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Alisa Mikhailovna Kujou is a model student who boasts the highest grades in her school year and the student council accountant. Her nickname is Alya and she is the younger biological sister of [Maria Mikhailovna Kujou](https://anilist.co/character/291294/Kujou-Mariya). She is one of the two most beautiful girls in her school year, and is called the "Solitary Princess" because she is perceived as very cold and distant.

Alya is very hardworking to the point she loathes people who don't put in effort. When she was younger, she was disappointed with the lack of motivation from

name: Masachika Kuze
description: Masachika Kuze is an unmotivated underachiever who routinely stays up late indulging in his nerdy hobbies. The girl who sits next to him in class, Alisa, constantly gets after him. While his grade may be on the lower end, he actually understands Russian because of his paternal grandfather, who was a big lover of Russian Culture.

description: The (new) Pure consort, residing in the Garnet Palace within the inner court. She makes a big show of her exorbitant and ever changing clothing, jewellery and make up. Despite that, she doesn't talk any more than she needs to, keeping her distance.

description: The oldest son of the clan of assassins, who is often called a boy genius. He was the world's greatest assassin in his previous life, and he combines that knowledge with the magic of his new world.

She is Lugh's relative.

name: Misaki Nakahara
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm

Misaki is a mysterious girl who decides to help [Tatsuhiro Satou](https://anilist.co/character/1839/Tatsuhiro-Satou) escape his hikikomori lifestyle. She convinces him to sign a contract, involving him in her "big project", with the goal of making him an average person. Though seeing right through his actions, she tries reading him (beginner's) psychology books in an attempt to click with his feelings and "save" him.

Her backstory varies depending on the media. In the anime, it is revealed later on that the only reason she is helping Satou is to save herself from being wor

name: Tatsuhiro Satou
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") 

The story's protagonist is a 22-year-old hikikomori and NEET of nearly four years. He is highly unstable, easily manipulated, obsessive, and often blames the N.H.K. conspiracy, a fabrication of his mind, for his shortcomings. He lives in a rented apartment, but depends on his parents' allowance to live.   At the end of the novel, Satou and Misaki promised each other to get married once they finish school.

name: Kaoru Yamazaki
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'6")

Tatsuhiro's former kouhai (Junior) in high school, who is an otaku. Tatsuhiro once stood up for him when he was still in middle school being beat up by some bullies, since then, he respected him greatly and decided to join the literature club with him when he went into high school. He is currently Tatsuhiro's neighbor and a college student aspiring to be a game creator.

name: Katsuhira Agata
description: The story's protagonist. His sense of pain and his own feelings are dulled. His moods barely fluctuate, and he pays little attention to other people.

name: Noriko Sonozaki
description: A mysterious and beautiful girl who experienced kizuna (connection) with Katsuhira and the others, and assigns them missions. She is even more emotionless than Katsuhira, and feels no human kindness.

name: Chidori Takashiro
description:
Chidori resembles the sin of Envy. Her updated sin is "Goody-Two-Shoes." Her identification when she experiences pain is D-5. 

Chidori was first portrayed as clumsy, emotional, and seemingly nosy at times. She seems to sincerely care about all of the other Kiznaivers, especially [Katsuhira Agata](https://anilist.co/character/89294/Katsuhira-Agata) _(Chidori's childhood friend)_ and tries to cheer them up when they're upset. She got embarrassed rather easily, and had been told by [Tsuguhito Yuta](https://anilist.co/character/89567/Tsuguhito-Yuta) that she was "too heavy" when it comes to her e

name: Hajime Tenga
description:
Of the Seven Deadly Sins of Modern-Day Japan, Tenga's sin is that of the "Musclehead Thug." However, while he is known among his peers as an unpredictable and intimidating delinquent, his true personality holds a deep-seated desire to help others.

In the proper spirit of the "Musclehead," Tenga is an incredibly energetic and physically strong person who many times acts on a whim in order to push through and keep events moving along. In spite of his image, however, he in many situations can display some of the highest practical intelligence and observational skills among the seven Kiznaivers,

name: Nico Niiyama
description:
Nico resembles the sin of Greed. In modern Japan, her sin is 'The Eccentric Headcase' _(Japanese: 不思議メンヘラ, Romanized: Fushigi Menhera, Official English Translation: "Screw Loose")._ Her identification when she experiences pain is D-6. 

Nico appears to be bright and energetic, often being the comic relief of the series. She tends to overreact or be very dramatic when experiencing new things, and acts very feminine.

However, Nico is shown to be rather perceptive in the series, much to her companions' surprise.

Since she came from a wealthy family, it is implied that she has polite and lady-li

name: Tsuguhito Yuta
description: A bit of an opportunist and a lady's man in the classroom, he is revealed to be intensely ashamed of his immense chubbiness back in his grade school years, and goes through great lengths to conceal this fact. He places great emphasis on his own appearance and prefers the company of similarly attractive people, acknowledging these facts even, yet at the same time is shown in several instances to be able to look past people's superficial features; as a result of this, he can be surprisingly intuitive at times. Yuta speaks his mind with a candid tongue (such as when he told [Honoka Maki](https://

name: Honoka Maki
description: Maki is first introduced along with the other main cast after [Noriko Sonozaki](https://anilist.co/character/89295/Noriko-Sonozaki) confronts [Katsuhira Agata](https://anilist.co/character/89294/Katsuhira-Agata) about the Kizna Project. Her sin is revealed to be "Pride". She, along with the other Kiznaivers are then abducted by the Gomorin and has her senses connected together.

name: Setsuko
description: Setsuko completely adores her older brother [Seita](https://anilist.co/character/494/Seita). She is innocent and cheerful, and at times naïve to the terrors of war around her.

name: Seita
description:
Seita is responsible, mature, and tough. Since his dad is away fighting in the war, he is responsible for all the jobs his father would normally take, including caring for his younger sister, [Setsuko](https://anilist.co/character/495/Setsuko). Seita's main fault is his pride, which can cause him to make wrong decisions. 
Seita's mother dies after a bombing raid on their town Seita's father assumed killed after Seita learns the entire Japanese fleet was destroyed, Seita and his sister become orphans Seita's sister dies of malnutrition at the end of the movie, leaving Seita on his own

name: Sekkekkyuu AE3803
description: A newbie red blood cell, who has a bad sense of direction.

name: Hakkekkyuu U-1146
description: He is a White Blood Cell, specifically a Neutrophil, working under the Neutrophil Division. Along with the other neutrophil comrades, he's tasked to patrol around the Blood Vessel and remove any invading Foreign Substances such as Germs and Viruses.

name: Ryuusui Nanami
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'1½")

Ryuusui Nanami is the son of the owner of Nanami Conglomorate. He was revived by [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) for his expertise in sailing. His wisdom about adventuring at sea or air makes him indispensable as one of the Five Wise Generals of the Kingdom of Science.

He was the Heir to the Nanami Conglomerate, and an accomplished sailor. As such, he lived a wealthy and lavish lifestyle. Pre-Stone World, He has been seen as a greedy playboy, rarely seen without the company of beautiful women, exotic sports cars, and excessive partying.

name: Suzume Iwato
description:
A kind and polite - yet headstrong - high-school girl who lives with her aunt in Tonami, Miyazaki Prefecture, Kyushu. She has recurring dreams of her younger self wandering through a field, surrounded by ruins of a city, trying to find her mother.

After accidentally freeing a disastrous force of nature and peering into the mysterious land of Ever-After (常世), she ends up embarking on a journey across Japan in an attempt to seal it, at the same time gradually learning more about the true nature of her strange visions.

She seems to have great admiration for her mother, who was a nurse, studying

name: Souta Munakata
description:
He is a young man who travels around Japan looking for doors that appear all over the country as a "closers" to close doors that bring "disasters".

He meets Suzume on his way to the ruins where the door is located.

He is turned into Suzume's three-legged chair by Daijin.

name: Gilbert Bougainvillea
native: ギルベルト・ブーゲンビリア
description:
Gilbert Bougainvillea is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a major in the Leidenschaftlich army who values Violet more than anything, seeing her as a human being rather than a tool.

Violet was "given" to Gilbert as a gift to commemorate his promotion, having being promoted to a major in light of his wartime achievements and expectations from his bloodline. Dietfried, not wanting to take care of Violet, pushed this task to his younger brother. Gilbert then decided to enlist her on a militant unit that he had been appointed to take overall command of in his promotion to major.

name: Kyon
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") 
__Occupation:__ Student (grade 10-11)  

Kyon is a first-year high school student enrolled in North High, and his real name is unknown; instead being referred to by everyone by the nickname "Kyon". This nickname was created for him by his aunt and then spread by his [little sister](https://anilist.co/character/912/Kyon-no-Imouto). He is quite cynical and doesn't believe in anything interesting like aliens, time travelers, or espers. But his curiosity gets the better of him when he tries to talk to a new student, [Haruhi Suzumiya](https://anilist.co/character/251/Haru

name: Mikuru Asahina
description:
**Height:** 152 cm (5 ft)
**Occupation:** Student (grade 11-12), SOS Deputy Vice Commander, Time Traveler

Mikuru Asahina, a shy and timid girl with a childish naïveté, is the only character other than [Kyon](https://anilist.co/character/252/Kyon) to be brought into the SOS Brigade against her will. Considered one of the most beautiful girls in high school, Mikuru is as kind, caring and thoughtful as she is beautiful. She easily gets scared or flustered, and is apparently prone to daydreaming as she can also be rather clumsy at times. Nevertheless, she can be surprisingly resilient and is capa

name: Itsuki Koizumi
description:
**Height:** 178 cm (5'10")
**Occupation:** Student (grade 11), Vice Commander, Esper

Itsuki is the last member to have joined the SOS Brigade, having been recruited by [Haruhi Suzumiya](https://anilist.co/character/251/Haruhi-Suzumiya) as a "mysterious transfer student". Itsuki is constantly smiling and always speaks in a formal and polite manner. He is also prone to giving long and detailed explanations, usually illustrated by exaggerated hand gestures. Itsuki's fondness for speculation often causes him to produce explanations for situations involving the SOS Brigade, its members and related

name: Yuki Nagato
description:
**Height:** 154 cm (5'0") 
**Occupation:** Student (grade 11), Integrated Data Sentient Entity Humanoid Interface

Yuki Nagato is a quiet high school freshman that is the only member of the SOS Brigade that was not "voluntarily arrested," or coerced into joining, by [Haruhi Suzumiya](https://anilist.co/character/251/Haruhi-Suzumiya). She lives alone in the same apartment complex as [Ryouko Asakura](https://anilist.co/character/255/Ryouko-Asakura). Yuki has a very stoic and introverted personality, preferring simple body language rather than speaking. When prompted to speak, she does so in a ve

name: Haruhi Suzumiya
description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2") 
**Occupation:** Student (grade 10-11), Ultra Director, Ultra Detective, Brigade Chief and Founder

Haruhi Suzumiya is the founding member of the SOS Brigade with the purpose of finding aliens, time travelers and espers. She is incredibly eccentric and usually anti-social, with no interest in "ordinary" humans.

name: Glenn Radars
description: Glenn is lazy, and constantly bored by everything, with his primary focus being sleeping. He becomes the substitute teacher in [Sistine](https://anilist.co/character/121639/Fibel-Sistine)'s class, after the retirement of her favorite teacher. While he may seem incompetent, he is actually very skilled in magic, but not in the traditional sense. Glenn used to be as passionate about magic as Sistine, but became disillusioned by it due to [Sara Silvers](https://anilist.co/character/191611/Silvers-Sara)' death and his past as the infamous military assassin known as "The Fool." He developed his own

appearsIn.title: Akashic Records of Bastard Magic Instructor

name: Sistine Fibel
native: システィーナ フィーベル
description: Sistine admires magic greatly and wishes to discover the secret of the Flying Castle, which no one knows. She maintains a strict, no-nonsense demeanor throughout, and often scolds [Glenn](https://anilist.co/character/121638/Radars-Glenn) for his lackadaisical attitude. She initially hates Glenn, believing him to be as incompetent as he looked due to his lack of enthusiasm. When he actually starts doing his job, however, she begrudgingly begins to respect Glenn as a highly effective teacher. Her personality and appearance resembles [Sara Silvers](https://anilist.co/character/191611/Silvers-Sara

appearsIn.title: Akashic Records of Bastard Magic Instructor

name: Rumia Tingel
native: ルミア ティンジェル
description: Rumia is [Sistine](https://anilist.co/character/121639/Fibel-Sistine)'s best friend who lives with her family. She is close to [Glenn](https://anilist.co/character/121638/Radars-Glenn), who often treats her well, in contrast to the teasing that Sistine faces from him. Rumia's real identity is the Princess Ermiana El Kel Alzano, the "cursed" princess who was supposed to die three years ago. She possesses a high level of spiritual essence, marking her a primary target pose by greedy scientists. She remembered Glenn being the one who saved her life when he was the infamous assassin named "The Foo

description:
The goddess charged with guiding [Seiya](https://anilist.co/character/141625/Ryuguin-Seiya) to defeat the Demon Lord.

Seiyas companion in his life before.

description:
__Hair Color:__ Black

Seiya is a very tall and handsome young man who is portrayed as extremely muscular under his armor with spiky yet still well-kept haircut that is down turned and leans to his right, which is commonly seen covering his right eye, but this is an effect caused by angles and it has never been seen obscuring his vision though as Seiya likely would not allow this (In the manga, his hair is more swept back, unkempt and it seems to move around with his movement more than the anime), black eyes, he is almost always seen with a calm and pensive expression, unless he is annoyed or

description:
__Race:__ Renard
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

Sanjouno Haruhime is a member of the Hestia Familia and a former member of the Ishtar Familia. Haruhime grew up as a dignified young lady of a noble family in the Far East. Living in solitude, her home was like a cage and she had no friends. At some point, children of the Takemikazuchi Familia, with the approval of their God, started taking her outside at night to play with them. Sometime later, someone framed her for eating an offering, which angered her father so much that he disowned her and a Pallum guest offered to take her away. As they were tr

description:

__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")
__Affiliation:__ Xenos • Hestia Familia • Ouranos
__Level:__ 2+ (estimate)

Wiene is a mysterious female Vouivre born in the middle floors of the Dungeon. It is later revealed that she is one of the Xenos. 

Wiene has the ability to speak even though she is a monster due to her being a Xenos. She is kind, helping a young boy even though people regarded monsters as evil. Wiene grew attached to the Hestia Familia, particularly Bell and Haruhime. Wiene doesn't like to wear clothes, as she refused to wear them and she even tried to get rid of the cape sh
