name: Angelo Lagusa
description: A young man who's hell-bent on revenge. His real name is Angelo Lagusa. He has a severe hatred for the Vanetti family, who killed his parents and younger brother. He hid away for seven years, but after receiving a certain letter, he appears in the Lawless district once more.

name: Nero Vanetti
description: The son of the Vanetti family's Don Vanetti. He has a bright and cheerful personality, and he values his family above all else. His sense of duty and empathy are strong, but he does not forgive traitors. He is an object of Avilio's revenge.

name: Kyouka Izumi
description:
__Height:__ 148cm (4'10")

A docile young lady who dresses in a kimono, but also a member of Port Mafia. As she holds a killing ability, she was found by the organization and raised as an assassin.

She later joins the Armed Detective Agency.

name: Chuuya Nakahara
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Chuuya is a Port Mafia member who detests [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198) for betraying the mafia and joining the Armed Detective Agency. He's also constantly teased by Dazai what makes him hate Dazai even more. Chuuya is short but he's quick and uses powerful martial arts. 

His ability, "For The Tainted Sorrow," revolves around gravity manipulation, allowing him to manipulate and alter the gravity of anything he touches, keeping it that way until a certain period of time.

name: Arin Kannazuki
description:
__Archive:__ Ira (wrath)
__Thema:__ ruina, paratum, victoria (temporary)
__Grimoire:__ Laguna Yggdrasil

A mysterious girl who claims Arata to be her husband. She looks like Hijiri, Arata's cousin and childhood friend. Arin rarely shows emotion, and cares little what others think of her. Her first meeting with Arata occurred when she was bathing in the men's bath because she preferred the quiet (very few men attend the academy due to the fact females are usually more attuned to magic) despite being discovered by Arata she acts casual as if nothing had happened. Although she shows little emotio

name: Mira Yamana
description: Mira Yamana is the Head of Grimoire Security and one of the Trinity Seven.

name: Arata Kasuga
description: Kasuga Arata used to live with his cousin and childhood friend [Kasuga Hijiri](https://anilist.co/character/135746/Kasuga-Hijiri), but one day something happened to the city he lives in, and an object was given to him by his cousin. When he finds out she could be alive he tries to become a magician, meeting with the Trinity Sevens in order to become a "Magus" and save Hijiri.

name: Lilith Asami
description:
Lilith is a teacher at the Magic Academy, Lillith possess the ability to manipulate magical energy into her "Thema," a sort of basic will that she uses to create an effect.

She is the one who introduced Arata to the magic world, she becomes one of his earliest allies and friends, watching and supporting him since meeting him.

Her real name is Azazel Lilith, daughter of a demon king who had her memories changed traveling through two worlds.

name: Akio Fudou
description: Akio Fudou is the partner of Mira in operating Grimoire Security as well as a member of the Trinity Seven. Akio won't let anyone get close to her based purely on offensive power.

name: Yui Kurata
description: Yui is a special mage, as she can only communicate with others through dreams. She also lives in the dungeon underneath the academy. After she was rescued by Arata and other Trinity Seven members (except for Lieselotte due to her disappearance) Yui can return to a normal life with other people and Levi as her close friend. She has a little-sister-personality and is extremely close to Arata, calling him "Onii-chan" and exclaims her love for him constantly. Yui is a member of Trinity Seven, too, embodying Greed.

name: Levi Kazama
description: Levi Kazama is a ninja and the Trinity Seven of Invidia, as well as a student at the Royal Biblia Academy. As a user of Shamanic Spells, she is considered to be one of world's top three fighters, becoming one of Arata's earliest allies.

name: Lieselotte Sherlock
native: リーゼロッテ・シャルロック
description: Lieselotte is a beautiful young lady, who has flowing, long blonde hair that is tied up in twin tail. She has purple eyes compared to her sister who has blue eyes. She is also very voluptuous. Her main attire consists of thigh boots, opera gloves, shorts, and a cape-like dress that leaves her midriff open that is held by two strings attached to her choker.

name: Rory Mercury
native: ロゥリィ・マーキュリー
description:
A demigoddess and an apostle of Emroy, the god of darkness, war, violence and death. She is widely known as Rory the Reaper due to her wielding of her halberd as a scythe, slaughtering those who offend Emroy, and those she views are worthy of being punished by death.

Her gothic lolita dress is an outfit for priestesses. In terms of age, she is the third-youngest Apostle of the Twelve Apostles.

(Source: Gate - Thus the JSDF Fought There! Wiki)

name: Lelei la Lelena
native: レレイ・ラ・レレーナ
description:
Lelei is generally an emotionless girl, with her face constantly fixed in an expressionless look. She is usually calm and silent amongst her friends and would always speak in a collected way. She rarely raises her voice, even in dire situations.

However, there are cases where she displays her emotions, such as surprise and awe when she was saved by the JSDF when she was nearly stomped by a horse.

She is a student of Grand Master Cato El Altestan, having moved in with him to the outskirts of Coda village when she was nearly 10 years old.

name: Tuka Luna Marceau
native: テュカ・ルナ・マルソー
description:
This beautiful elf girl is the only survivor from her village, which was destroyed by the dragon. She was very dedicated to her father, who died protecting her. Saved by Japanese soldiers, Tuka Luna lives among the refugees in their military camp.

Unable to cope with the loss of her father, she first acts as though he is staying at the base, insisting on two rooms and extra portions of meals. Her mental stability deteriorates over time and eventually, she latches onto Itami, calling him "father." In an effort to bring her to her senses, Itami brings Tuka along on the hunt for the Flame Dragon

name: Youji Itami
description:
Itami is an otaku who loves to read doujinshi and online novels. Work is nothing more then something that provides an income source for his interest. Itami is a selfless person, he will help anyone who need help no matter if it's friend or enemy. He also cares about other people who he hasn't met before as seen when he immediately saved a japanese woman who was Zorzal's slave. Itami doesn't like the idea of slavery in Special Region. He can become friends with almost anyone no matter what their race is, and he doesn't seem to be bothered by that. Unlike other people in Special Region.

He is d

name: Piña Co Lada
description:
The daughter of the Emperor Molt Sol Augustus and his concubine, Countess Nell. She has two brothers, Zorzal El Caesar and Diabo El Caesar both of whom were candidates for the next Emperor. She is also the leader of Rose-Order of Knights.

Later she becomes a mediator between Japan and her empire, and gets strongly influenced by the otaku culture.

name: Xenovia Quarta
description:
__Rank:__ Low-class 
__Devil Role:__ Knight 
__Species:__ Reincarnated Devil (Former Human) 
__Weapon:__ Excalibur Destruction (Volume 3), The Holy Sword Durandal → Ex-Durandal.  

A Holy Sword user who was sent from the Church along with Irina to destroy or retrieve the stolen Excalibur swords. After she finds out that the God in the Bible has died a long time ago, she decides to join the Occult Research Club as Rias's servant. She tries to seduce Issei whenever she can because she wants to give birth to a strong baby.

name: Gasper Vladi
native: ギャスパー・ヴラディ
description:
__Rank/Role:__ Low-class devil (Former human/vampire)/Bishop 
__Sacred Gear:__ Forbidden Balor View 

A half-vampire male cross-dresser who has the ability to stop the time of those he sees but he is unable to control it. He is sealed by Rias as ordered by the elders till she has grown up enough to control him. He still is unable to have a full command on his powers but can improve a lot by drinking Ise's blood.

name: Ikoma
description:
A headstrong and passionate young Steam Smith and inventor from Hinomoto who makes a living in Aragane Station making iron and steam engines. He and his good friend Takumi developed a weapon called "Tsuranuki Zutsu" in order to defeat the Kabane. Everyone makes light of him now, but he looks forward to a day when he will be triumphant.

His hatred for the Kabane stems from past trauma, with his sister Hatsune dying by his hands folllowing a Kabane attack and Ikoma struggling to cope with his loss ever since.

name: Mumei
description:
A mysterious, arrogant and playful yet exceedingly strong and brave girl who arrives at Aragane Station with unclear intent. She's very proficient with firearms and thrown weaponry, as well as incredibly strong physically, being able to chop off a Kabane's head clean off - using a blade concealed in her sandal - with one swift kick. 
Despite often appearing ruthless and full of bloodlust, she's great with kids.

name: Akaza
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

A member of the Twelve Demon Moons, holding the position of Upper Moon Three.

appearsIn.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle

name: Kaigaku
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")

A member of the Demon Slaying Corps, who was taught the Breath of Thunder by former Thunder Pillar, Jigoro, with fellow disciple Zenitsu.

appearsIn.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle

name: Douma
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'1½")

He is Upper Moon Two, making him the third-strongest demon after Muzan and Upper Moon One. He has a very friendly attitude, and fights with a pair of metal fans. He is the founder of a cult known as the "Eternal Paradise Cult," and eats his followers, allegedly in order to release them from the pain of living.

He is the demon who killed Shinobu Kochou's older sister and Shinobu, as well as Inosuke's mother.

appearsIn.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle

name: Takuro Sugawara
description: In class 2-4 and a member of the soccer club.

name: Haruhiko Takase
description: In class 2-1 and the soccer club.

name: Yuki Minagawa
description: She is a friendly girl from class 2-1 and is both the female class representative and a member of the soft tennis club. She likes teasing people.

name: Kana Ijima
description: She is a tsundere girl who likes football. She is from class 2-4 and is not in any club.

name: Masafumi Akagi
description: He is a straightforward dominant boy and is the student council president. He is in class 3-8.

name: Ayaka Kamine
description: She is a shy timid girl from class 2-4 and is a member of the tea ceremony club.

name: Chiyo Kurihara
description: In class 2-1 and the cooking club.

name: Ryouko Kaji
description: She is delinquent from class 3-8 and often smokes behind the school.

name: Shinichi Katori
description:
He is a spontaneous boy who appears whenever love advice is needed. He is from class 3-5 and is the president of the drama club. Shinichi is a quirky and upbeat teenager. He tends to speak in short English phrases at times; he also tends to be a playboy around girls (though he may not be aware how much it affects their feelings) and even calls himself a "Dating Master" and "Love Master", much to everyone's annoyance and amazement.

In a later chapter, it is revealed that Shinichi has been fighting an illness that causes him to cough up blood. Because of this, he has been repeating years at hig

name: Takeru Gouda
description: A muscular boy with few expressions who is from class 2-4 and is in the volleyball club.

name: Anju Emma
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Anju Emma is a platoon member and later platoon leader of the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package's Spearhead Squadron. She serves as their support fire and artillery provider. Her Personal Name is Snow Witch. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, she is considered one of the most elite Processors alive.

name: Theoto Rikka
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm 

Theoto Rikka is a platoon leader of the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package's Spearhead Squadron and the artist of the squadron member's Personal Marks. His Personal Name is Laughing Fox. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, he is considered one of the most elite Processors alive.

name: Frederica Rosenfort
native: フレデリカ・ローゼンフォルト
description:
__Height:__ 130cm

A girl Shin and his team met at Ernst's residence after being provided shelter by the Federacy. She is assigned as the Mascot to the Spearhead Squadron. She has an intelligence and a manner of speech well beyond her young age of ten.

She is the last empress of the Federal Empire of Giad, having been secretly rescued by Ernst during the coup against the nobility. Her royal bloodline imparts her the gift of seeing the past and present of people she has known.

She was protected by Kiriya Nouzen, a distant relative of Shin from the Nouzen clan and is on the lookout for him aft

name: Koutarou Amon
description:
__Height:__ 191 cm (6'3")

A first class police investigator who investigates Ghouls, also known as a Dove. He comes to the 20th ward with his mentor, [Mado Kureo](https://anilist.co/character/88423), to investigate Ghoul incidents in the area. He has a strong sense of justice, fervently believing it is the right and moral thing to do to exterminate the Ghouls. He hunts the Ghouls in order to prevent more human children from becoming orphaned like himself, and he often works after hours to achieve his goals.

He wields a "Quinque" (a weapon made from the "Kagune" of a Ghoul) that has the appea

name: Taishi Fura
description: Taishi Fura is a First-Class Ghoul Investigator. He is the protagonist of the side story Tokyo Ghoul: Jack, alongside Kishou Arima.

name: Enju Aihara
description: She is one of the "Cursed Children", who are carrying Gastrea virus in their bodies. She is a precocious 10 year old girl, who possesses a hidden superhuman power. Enju is emotionally attached to her partner, Rentaro Satomi, and looks at Kisara Tendo as a rival in love.  (Source: Baka-Tsuki)

name: Rentarou Satomi
description: He is a second-year student at Magata High School. He is also a member of "Tendo Civil Security Company", headed by Kisara Tendo. Together with his partner – Initiator named Enju – he is fighting against parasites Gastrea, the creatures beyond human's imagination.

name: Kisara Tendo
description:
Once a daughter of nobleman, for some reason she ran away from home and now earns her own living. Although, being a student, she manages "Tendo's Civil Security Company" but is forced to live in poverty. She is deeply in love with Rentaro.

(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

name: Reinhard van Astrea
native: ラインハルト・ヴァン・アストレア
description:
__Height__: 184 cm (6'0")

Reinhard van Astrea is the current Sword Saint and a member of the Royal Guard, currently acting as [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt)'s knight. 

As the Sword Saint and the Knight of the Royal Guard, Reinhard embodies chivalry and elegance, treating everyone with exceptional respect. He is fair, brave, and always acts in the name of justice, whether on duty or simply strolling through the Royal Capital.

As a knight, Reinhard only uses his sword when necessary, since, in addition to being a rule, his iron-clad rule is to not inflict pain to others if no

appearsIn.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3

name: Yuuna Shigemura
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Yuuna Shigemura is one of the main characters of the Ordinal Scale arc in Sword Art Online, also known as Yuna. During her childhood, the girl found a passion for singing, especially for the pop genre.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online the Movie: Ordinal Scale

name: Eiji Nochizawa
description: Eiji is a mysterious young swordsman, who is the top ranked player in Ordinal Scale.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online the Movie: Ordinal Scale

name: Seijirou Kikuoka
description: Seijirou Kikuoka is a member of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, Technology, Second Separated Advanced Network Division, or «Virtual Division». He uses the nickname «Chrysheight» in «ALfheim Online»

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online the Movie: Ordinal Scale

name: Gin
description: Gin is a spirit of the forest. He encounters Hotaru first when she was very young and got lost in the forest. After helping her out of the forest, Hotaru stated that she will return to give him a gift. From then on, the two became close friends and met each other every summer.   Gin was once a human, but died from being abandoned in the forest as a young baby. The mountain god cast a spell on Gin, allowing him to live. But since the spell casted upon him was fragile, if he ever touches the skin of a living human, the spell would break and he would disappear.

appearsIn.title: Into the Forest of Fireflies' Light

name: Hotaru Takegawa
description: When she was six year old, Hotaru was lost in the forest of the mountain god. There she met Gin, a spirit of the forest. Since then, every summer thereafter, she has returned to the forest to meet Gin.

appearsIn.title: Into the Forest of Fireflies' Light

name: Ginko
description:
Ginko employs himself as a Mushi master (mushi-shi), traveling from place to place to research Mushi and aid people suffering from problems caused by them. Ginko's unusual white hair and green eye color is the result of an incident involving a mushi that occurred when he was a child.

While designing the character, Mushishi-writer and -artist [Urushibara](https://anilist.co/staff/97394/Urushibara-Yuki) actually planned to have the story take place in a contemporary setting. Ginko's rather modern clothes, which do not seem to match the time period reflected by all other characters, still reflec

name: Hana
description: Hana is a college student that falls deeply in love with a [wolf-man](https://anilist.co/character/60285/Ookami) that she encounters in class one day. They start dating, and even though he tells her one night about his true nature, Hana does not seem to mind, getting married to him and eventually, giving birth to his daughter, [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/60281/Yuki), and one year later, to his son, [Ame](https://anilist.co/character/60283/Ame).  Sadly, the wolf-man dies unexpectedly, leaving Hana and their wolf-children alone. Hana is scared of people finding the truth about her childr

name: Ame
description: Ame is the youngest wolf child. He is shy and quite weak. He looks awfully lot like his father. He is a year younger than his older sister, Yuki    Later in the movie, Ame wants to be a wild wolf instead of a normal human like Yuki.   Ame later goes onto living in the mountains to pursue his dream of living as a wild lone wolf. He would sometimes call out to his mother in the wind of the mountains.

name: Yuki
description: Hana's eldest child. She is very energetic.   Later in the movie, you would notice that Yuki wants to be a normal human girl instead of a wild wolf like Ame.

name: Tadakuni
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Tadakuni is a student in Sanada North Boys High who acts as the straight man of the group. He is usually involved in [Hidenori Tabata](https://anilist.co/character/50691) and [Yoshitake Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/50693)'s wild ideas despite his disapproval. He has a younger sister who proves to be stronger than him and his friends. Gradually, he loses screen time and fades into the background, appearing even less than supporting characters.

appearsIn.title: Daily Lives of High School Boys
The Daily Lives of High School Boys

name: Hidenori Tabata
description:
**Height:** 175 cm (5'9")

A student at Sanada North Boys High. He is the glasses-wearing character of the main trio, of which he usually gets the group involved in his crazy schemes. His older brother used to be the ringleader of the group until he went off to college.  When his friends aren't around and he's alone with a girl, he over-thinks the situation.

appearsIn.title: Daily Lives of High School Boys
The Daily Lives of High School Boys

name: Yoshitake Tanaka
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") 

The dyed blond character of the main trio, he usually goes along with Hidenori's schemes much to Tadakuni's disapproval. He was the masked Rubber Shooter in his childhood and also has a sister who is a year older than him.

appearsIn.title: Daily Lives of High School Boys
The Daily Lives of High School Boys

name: Foo Fighters
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm
__Prisoner Number:__ FE39423
__Manga Debut:__ Chapter 26
__Anime Debut:__ Episode 7

F.F. is a fusion of Stand and Stand User; a colony of plankton that is organized, maintained by, and essentially equivalent to the Stand, Foo Fighters. At first serving [Enrico Pucci](https://anilist.co/character/17676/Pucci-Enrico), they soon ally themself with [Jolyne Cujoh](https://anilist.co/character/11222/Kuujou-Jolyne) out of gratitude.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: STONE OCEAN Part 2
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 6: Stone Ocean

name: Weather Report
description:
__Height:__ 192 cm 
__Nationality:__ Italian-American
__Occupation:__ Delivery Boy (formerly) 
__Stand:__ Weather Report

Weather Report is an amnesiac and fellow inmate who seeks his memory and allies himself with [Jolyne Cujoh](https://anilist.co/character/11222/Kuujou-Jolyne). 

Weather is a Stand User controlling the surrounding atmosphere through his ability, which is also named Weather Report.
He later develops Heavy Weather, after recovers his memory, representing the release of his basic Stand's full power; fostering a particular, bizarre delusion in all within its range.

His real nam

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: STONE OCEAN Part 2
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 6: Stone Ocean

name: Emporio Alnino
native: エンポリオ・アルニーニョ
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm
__Nationality:__ American

Emporio is a young Stand User, born and living secretly in Green Dolphin Street Prison. He sympathizes with Jolyne and becomes one of her primary allies. Emporio's Stand, Burning Down the House, is a room comprising a secret, alternate space within Green Dolphin Street Prison, to which only he may grant entry. The room contains a number of useful, imperishable objects.

Emporio temporarily borrows the Stand "Weather Report" at the end of Stone Ocean.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: STONE OCEAN Part 2
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 6: Stone Ocean

name: Hermes Costello
native: エルメェス・コステロ
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Prisoner 
Number:__ FE40533
__Stand:__ Kiss

Hermes is a woman voluntarily imprisoned in Green Dolphin Street Prison in order to seek revenge for her sister Gloria Costello's killer, Sports Maxx, and soon allies herself with Jolyne Cujoh in the hostile environment that the jail is. Thanks to a certain pendant, Ermes acquires her own Stand, Kiss, which has the ability of duplication stickers.

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: STONE OCEAN Part 2
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 6: Stone Ocean

name: Jolyne Kuujou
description:
__Height:__ 174.5 cm 
__Nationality:__ Japanese-American 
__Stand:__ Stone Free

She is the daughter of [Joutarou Kuujou](https://anilist.co/character/4003) and is the only female "JoJo" to date.  

Quick to anger and snappy with her elders, it seemed like Jolyne was a lost cause. She was irresponsible and flighty, at first only looking to satisfy a cheap thrill. Bitter at Joutarou for leaving the family for so long, she blamed him for her misguided outlook. However, she still had honorable morals and treasured her mother. She would selflessly do everything in her power to help her friends. Jo

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: STONE OCEAN Part 2
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 6: Stone Ocean

name: Enrico Pucci
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm 
__Nationality:__ Italian-American 
__Occupation:__ Priest, Chaplain 
__Stand:__ White Snake, C-Moon, Made in Heaven

A loyal follower and friend of Dio, Pucci aspires to implement a plan long formulated by Dio to "achieve heaven." Working as a chaplain at Green Dolphin Street Prison, he secretly frames Jolyne Cujoh and uses her as bait to lure Jotaro Kujo and his memories of Dio's Diary.

He is the twin brother of Weather Report 

Whitesnake is Pucci's Stand, with which he may steal up to two discs from individuals, one disc contains the Stand of the target while the other

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: STONE OCEAN Part 2
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 6: Stone Ocean

name: Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'10.9")

Sakamoto is the protagonist of the series who is a model student for all in his school. He is the perfect man who can solve any problem with a kind yet calm persona. Because of this, many girls fall for him, and his male classmates resent him. Although he acts strangely sometimes (such as doing weird poses or acting sneakily), it only adds to his coolness. Sakamoto has a range of "secret skills" which allow him to do various things, such as catch bugs or blow bubbles.

name: Taichi Yaegashi
description:
Though Taichi doesn't speak much, he's very sympathetic towards others and wants to help his friends when they're having trouble. He suddenly becomes passionate when he starts talking about his hobby, pro-wrestling, and Inaba stops him when he tries to add wrestling topics to their Cultural Research Club's newspaper. He has a little sister in elementary school, [Rina](https://anilist.co/character/64661/).

He is often described by Inaba as being a martyr who wishes to help people at his own sacrifice.

name: Iori Nagase
description:
Iori is [Taichi's](https://anilist.co/character/40195/) classmate, a bright, friendly, popular girl. She's the president of the Cultural Research Club, but rather than lead everyone, she sets the mood and gets them excited. Occasionally she takes bold actions in front of others, be it due to carelessness or simple naivety.

She is described as the most beautiful girl in her grade, and won the first year Miss Yamaboshi pageant.

name: Himeko Inaba
description: Himeko is vice president of the Cultural Research Club. She excels in gathering information and analysis, possessing private data on each of the club members. She's calm and logical, but she's actually a bit clumsy, so her difficulty with roundabout phrasings causes her to surprise many of those around her with her blunt statements.

name: Yui Kiriyama
description:
Yui is very active and expressive. She's a bit small, but she holds ranks in Karate, and even won tournaments when she was in middle school. She absolutely loves cute things, and her room at home is filled with fancy items. 

She always ends up insulting [Aoki](https://anilist.co/character/40199/Aoki-Yoshifumi) when he tries to approach her.

name: Yoshifumi Aoki
description: Yoshifumi is Yui's classmate. He holds affection for her, and continues his attempts to approach her, but she never gives him a chance. In the Cultural Research Club he's often called out, and his pathetic side stands out more, but he also relaxes them with some of his casual statements.

name: Haruka Sakura
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm

Haruka Sakura is a high school student in his first year. He attends Fuurin, a school known as a delinquent school, with aspirations to reach the top. He admires strong people. Rejected by others for his rough appearance, being alone was natural for him.  Hated by others and sitting at the bottom of the social strata, Sakura believes fighting is his only saving grace and that by winning those fights, he thinks he can feel his worth. He tries to keep an image of a ruthless and tough exterior, but in reality, he is kind-hearted. He easily gets embarrassed by compliments on hi

name: Touma Kamijou
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Classification:__ Esper (technically)
__Esper Power:__ Imagine Breaker
__Power Level:__ 0 (technically)

The main protagonist of Toaru Majutsu no Index and a supporting character in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. He has the lowest psychic rank possible at Level 0—largely because the people testing psychic abilities cannot detect or classify his abilities. His power is Imagine Breaker, a power which negates all magic, psychic, or divine powers but also his own good luck. Due to the nature of his power, the founder of Academy City considers him neither a Psychic nor a Magici

name: Index Librorum Prohibitorum
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm (4'10")
__Classification:__ Magician
__Affiliation:__ Anglican Church
__Ability:__ Spell Intercept

Index, also known by her full name Index Librorum Prohibitorum, is one of the main heroines and the titular character of the series. She is a young nun from Necessarius, a branch of the Church of England. 

Index is small in stature and has a petite build. About 14 or 15 years old, she has thigh-length, silvery-blue hair with very white skin and large green eyes. She also wears a white robe with golden embroidery sewed onto every edge of it, the Walking Church.

name: Risu
description: Risu couldn't produce any magic smoke. Believing himself to be one of the many magically-impaired members of sorcerer society, he joined the CrossEyes organization to make a living. Risu later discovered that he actually possessed a very rare magical ability - the power of Curse. Overjoyed, he told his best friend Aikawa the good news. Little did he know that Aikawa was actually the unwilling alter-ego of the CrossEyes Boss.  As soon as the Boss learned of this ability, he murdered Risu and attempted to claim his Curse power, but it would not be so easy. Risu's Curse power activated upon death

name: Ebisu
description: Ebisu is a young, androgynous and sullen looking woman who first appears in chapter three, donning a skull shaped mask. She is walking through the Hole, unable to summon a door back to the Magic Users' world due to the barrier between worlds currently in effect. She runs in to [Caiman](https://anilist.co/character/9192/Kaiman) and [Nikaido](https://anilist.co/character/16057/Nikaido), who advance on her in their common fashion. Caiman cuts off Ebisu's fingers to prevent her from using magic, and bites down on her head after removing her mask. Before he can withdraw to ask her his "question", a

name: Nikaido
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'6½)

Nikaido is a companion to [Kaiman](https://anilist.co/character/9192), who both hunt Magic Users. She is the owner of a restaurant called the Hungry Bug in the Hole. There she serves primarily gyozas with a few slices of shiso, which Kaiman adores. Nikaido's gyozas are constantly declared as the best in the Hole.

As it progresses, it is revealed that Nikaido is also a magic user, and has some ties in the Magic Users' World. When she trains with the ex-devil, [Kawajiri](https://anilist.co/character/40955), she discoveres that her magic is related to Time and that it

name: Kaiman
description:
__Height:__ 216 cm (7'1)

Kaiman is a human born in the Hole with an immunity towards magic. He has made it explicitly clear that "Kaiman" was not his actual name, but was given to him by [Nikaido](https://anilist.co/character/16057) after he began suffering from amnesia. His lizard head being the result of a Magic User's curse, his main goal is to seek out the one who cursed him in order to change himself back. Because he can't remember who cursed him, due to his amnesia, he instead resorts to clamping his mouth around the head of every magic user he comes across, letting them see the "little

name: Shin
description:
__Height:__ 196 cm (6'5)

Shin is an elite Magic-User, a cleaner for [En](https://anilist.co/character/16060/En), and the partner and long-time friend of [Noi](https://anilist.co/character/16059/Noi). His magic allows him to cut people up without killing them.

Shin is a tall man of muscular build, with short blonde hair, blue eyes, and pale skin. He is often seen in a formal suit while wearing a heart shaped mask backwards. He uses glasses when he isn't wearing his mask. He has stitches running along his arms and hands from his surgery to gain magic powers. He usually uses a hammer to fight,

name: Noi
description:
__Height:__ 209 cm (6'10")

Noi is an elite Magic-User, and the partner and long-time friend of [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/16058). She works with him as a cleaner for [En](https://anilist.co/character/16060), who is her older cousin.

Noi has pink-white hair and red eyes. She is the fourth tallest character in the series and is very muscular. As a result, other characters are often unsure of her sex at first, until she opens her mouth or takes off her mask. Beneath the mask, she is a beautiful woman with long hair that often looks slightly disheveled. Her ears are pierced multiple tim

name: En
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")

Boss of the En family and is an elite Magic User. He is cousins with Noi and Kikurage's partner. He's also good friends with Chidaruma, who is the most powerful Devil. En controls most of if not all business within the Magic-User realm and is regarded as one of the strongest Magic Users in the world. He's shown to be a man who has a large expansive group of lackeys, and is currently Noi and Shin's boss.

Typically seen in loosely worn formal attire and wears his long, red hair spiked upwards. He has a large forehead and menacing eyes further defined by his lack of ey

name: Fujita
description: Fujita is a magic user residing in the Magic user’s domain, working for a company headed by En: a powerful magic user. Fujita isn’t a very good magic user at all, himself-- the only times he manages to produce any magical smoke at all are times when he or someone he cares about are in a bit of a bind. For example, when in the Hole (the domain of non-users,) he and a friend of his are stopped by Caiman, a nonuser who is mysteriously unaffected by magic due to his mutations. His friend is killed by Caiman, and in a scurry to get away with his own life he uses his smoke to open a door

name: Firo Prochainezo
native: フィーロ・プロシェンツォ
description: The youngest executive of Manhattan's Martillo Family Camorra. Firo is surprisingly friendly, humorous and compassionate, but he is a skilled fighter and can be ruthless or even vengeful towards those who bring harm to the people he cares about. He became a complete immortal in November 1930 after accidentally drinking Szilard Quates' immortality elixir. In the same year he falls in love with Ennis, and despite the fact that she initially is unsure of her affection due to her underdeveloped emotional capabilities, they live together as roommates and gradually she reciprocates Firo's feelings.

name: Ennis
description:
Szilard's homunculus, though not his first creation. She was created to unthinkingly execute his every command; recently, however, she has been gaining emotions as well as independent thought, as a result of 'devouring' an alchemist threatening Szilard's life.

She later helps Firo, giving him the necessary knowledge to destroy Szilard, and afterwards moves in with him as his roommate.

Ennis eventually reciprocates Firo's feelings, marrying him in the 1980s and taking his surname 'Prochainezo'; two decades later, the couple honeymoon aboard the cruise ship Entrance in 2002, with Czeslaw taggi

name: Maiza Avaro
native: マイザー・アヴァーロ
description: Bookkeeper of the Martillo family and one of the Advena Avis immortals. His younger brother, Gretto, was one of the first to be "devoured" for knowledge of the elixir's recipe.   In the 1970s, he leaves his post as bookkeeper to Firo and along with Czes begins searching for the rest immortals to inform them of Szilard's death. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Luck Gandor
description: Intelligent executive of the Mafia Gandor Family. The third of the brothers and childhood friend of Firo, having grown up in the same apartment block.  Although he and his brothers lead the Gandor family, Luck's close ties with Firo makes the Gandors allies of the Martillo Family. He is always calm and level-headed, preferring to resort to violence only when necessary. When that time approaches, he does not hesitate to eliminate his opponent while still maintaining his calm demeanor. Sometimes with a faint smile on his face, which according to Firo, is just a pretense to look cool. Luck intent

name: Jacuzzi Splot
native: ジャグジー・スプロット
description: A crybaby who is nonetheless capable of exceptional courage and leadership ability when the situation calls for it. At first, Jacuzzi seems almost cripplingly shy, even with a tendency to stutter in front of strangers. However, when his loved ones are in danger, he will summon the strength to face his problems directly, even though he'll continue to cry. After a member of his gang was killed, Jacuzzi robbed a record number of neighborhood stores, clutching a machine gun as tears stream down his face. Jacuzzi went out and received his "sword tattoo" on his face when Nice, his rom

name: Ladd Russo
description: Ladd is a sadistic hit-man for the Russo family. His love for acts of violence truly shows in the maniacal glee he exhibits while fighting or killing. He is exceptionally skilled in hand-to-hand combat—particularly boxing—and the use of firearms. He is most happy while killing people that think they will never die and by seeing dead people or hearing gunfights. Ladd is deeply in love with his fiancée, Lua, although he expresses it through a passionate promise to kill her someday.

name: Czesław Meyer
native: チェスワフ・メイエル
description: The youngest Advenna Avis immortal. His guardian, Ferment, tortured him to test the limits of immortality. Czeslaw manages to devour Ferment, ending his suffering. Unfortunately, he learns from Fermet's memories that he was simply being tortured for Femet's own self-satisfaction. As a result, Czeslaw becomes paranoid and trusts no one, making it his mission to devour other immortals before they can devour him.  In the 1930's it appears he cares little for the lives of others, even requesting that a large group of people be killed so he could find an immortal among them. However, after meeting

name: Isaac Dian
native: アイザック・ディアン
description:
Issac Dian forms one half of the bumbling thief couple, who seem to cross into everybody's story in one way or another. He's in love with [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/3796/), and they've robbed everything and anything, from doors to the entire Genoard household. He's completely clueless, super eccentric and happy-go-lucky to the point you can't stop laughing from his bold and sometimes completely weird actions.  

He has a cameo appearance in Durarara!!

name: Miria Harvent
native: ミリア・ハーヴェント
description:
Another eccentric thief, she is the partner and lover of [Isaac Dian](https://anilist.co/character/3662). Miria wholeheartedly believes and supports everything Isaac says, often even going so far as to mimic his body language. Together they appear extremely stupid, whimsical and oblivious, but they have great affection for the people they meet, whom they always make a big impression on and always believe the best of them.  

She has a cameo appearance in Durarara!!

name: Claire Stanfield
native: クレア・スタンフィールド
description:
The youngest train conductor for the Flying Pussy Foot, he tells [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/3796/) and [Isaac](https://anilist.co/character/3662/) the story of the dreaded "Rail-Tracer", a story about a brutish beast that causes passengers in a train to disappear one by one. He also seems to be the only one who knows how to stop the Rail Tracer...

It is later revealed he was raised with the Gandor brothers, and is considered part of their family, as well as being the Rail Tracer aforementioned. He works as an assassin under the name of 'Vino' (he is called Vino because he completely

name: Miyabi Itou
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")
__Class:__ 2-C
__Affiliation:__ Supernatural Studies Club

Miyabi Itou is a girl that believes in the supernatural, that's why she also joins the Supernatural club. She later learns the secret of Yamada. Although Miyabi is a considerably attractive and cheerful girl, due to her being a fan of the supernatural phenomenons and alike, she is considered among her peers to be a fraud and liar. Because of this, she didn't have any friends at all.

name: Toranosuke Miyamura
description:
**Affiliation:** Student Council and Supernatural Studies

Council vice president and supernatural club vice president. Knows of [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/57489/Yamada-Ryuu) and [Shiraishi](https://anilist.co/character/57491/Shiraishi-Urara) switching secret.

name: Urara Shiraishi
description:
Class: 2-B
Affiliation: Supernatural Studies Club
Title: President of the Supernatural Studies Club

A beautiful girl who is Suzaku High's brightest student. She is one of the seven (original) witches.

Urara's ability as a witch is Body Swapping. When she kisses a person she will instantly swap bodies with said person. There is a limitation though, if the person she kissed is already under the effects of another witch's power then the body swap won't happen. According to Miyabi Itou, Urara's ability is cataloged into Immediate Reaction. Shiraishi Gained that power by her own dislike of her li

name: Ryuu Yamada
description:
__Class:__ 2-B 
__Affiliation:__ Supernatural Studies Club 
__Ability:__ Copy   

Ryuu Yamada is a second year student at Suzaku High. He is always late for school, naps in class, and gets abysmal grades. His life is a dead bore.    

According to Urara Shiraishi, Yamada has the ability called "Duplication".  When Yamada kisses one of the witches with special powers he replicates their power and uses it when he kissed a normal person.  If Yamada kisses another witch then the abilities he had won't affect the said witch. This can be seen when he kissed Nene Odagiri he didn't swap bodies with he

name: Shinichi Tamaki
description: Class: 2-H Affiliation: Witch Ability: Plunder    Shinichi is able to take away, or "steal", witches powers. He's ability is similar to Yamada's because he can also use the powers that of other witches but instead takes the power away from the witches that he kisses. If he kisses a witch but currently holds another witch's power, the previous one is cancelled and he will only be able to use the new one until he kisses another witch.  His current witch power that he stole makes him invisible after he kisses someone. He calls himself "the invisible man".

name: Rakurou Hizutome
description: Rakurou, better known by his nickname "Sunraku," is an enthusiast of Kusoge (shit games); games that are well-known for buggy states, unfair mechanics and awful AI. He is well known by his friends as a Kusoge fanatic and lunatic. Thanks to the skills Sunraku has built up playing such awful games, he becomes a more motivated and better player the crappier the hand a game deals him.

name: Yoshida
description:
Yoshida is the main male character of the Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou. series. He is an office worker in Tokyo who lives alone in his apartment. One night, after being rejected by his boss, [Airi Gotou](https://anilist.co/character/127927/Gotou-Airi), he had a fateful encounter with a runaway high school girl named [Sayu](https://anilist.co/character/127925/Ogiwara-Sayu).

Living alone most of his life, Yoshida grew to be a highly independent person. He is an exceptional and reliable employee who's always dedicated to his work; pulling off overtime daily and even helps lighten t

appearsIn.title: Higehiro: After Being Rejected, I Shaved and Took in a High School Runaway
Higehiro: After Being Rejected, I Shaved and Took In a High School Runaway

name: Sayu Ogiwara
description:
Sayu Ogiwara is the main female character of the Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou. She is a runaway high school girl from Hokkaido who ended up in Tokyo, in which she had a fateful encounter with a stranger named [Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/127924/Yoshida).

After running away from her hometown and family for unclear reasons, Sayu was forced to adapt and live her new life as a runaway high school girl. With no money to sustain her basic needs like food and shelter, she gathered her resolve and resorted into seducing men, using her body as a bargaining chip in order to surv

appearsIn.title: Higehiro: After Being Rejected, I Shaved and Took in a High School Runaway
Higehiro: After Being Rejected, I Shaved and Took In a High School Runaway

name: Ponyo
description: A goldfish princess who wants to become human after meeting the young boy [Sousuke](https://anilist.co/character/15009/Sosuke).

name: Sousuke
description: Sosuke lives by the sea with his mother, [Lisa](https://anilist.co/character/17231/Lisa). While playing at the shore, he rescues [Ponyo](https://anilist.co/character/14286/Ponyo) in her goldfish form. Their friendship begins from there.

name: Sagiri Izumi
description:
**Height:** 148 cm (4'10 ft)

Sagiri was taught to draw by her mother at a young age, and by the time she was around the age of nine, she became [Masamune](https://anilist.co/character/121470)'s illustrator. A year before the events of the novel, Sagiri met Masamune, though she didn't realize that he was the author she was working with despite the similar names. After her mother died, she temporarily stopped drawing and going outside. After seeing a live video of someone drawing images and getting a response, Sagiri became interested in live video feeds and started drawing images on a camera d

name: Masamune Izumi
description:
__Height:__ 176cm 

Izumi Masamune is the protagonist of the story. He is a novelist that goes by the pen name "Izumi Masamune," his same name. He started out his novels in middle school after winning a light novel writing contest. He hopes to get closer to his younger step-sister.

name: Kiki
description: A thirteen-year-old apprentice witch, leaving her home village to spend a year on her own. She has no visible magical abilities other than communicating with her cat and broom-flying (at which she is still a novice). She is excitable, innocent, and by turns eager and shy. Some of the earlier concept drawings of Kiki closely resembled the original longer hair illustrations by Akiko Hayashi. It was eventually decided to cut her hair short due to the extra difficulty for animators.

name: Deishuu Kaiki
description:
The white swindler who once deceived [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) and the cause of [Nadeko](https://anilist.co/character/22050/Nadeko-Sengoku)'s curse. Kaiki is a capable conman, able to deceive multiple people to get the results he wants, usually being money. On one occassion, he has used the alias 'Suzuki'. Though he appears to be a deceitful man, Kaiki has tried to help others occasionally.

In Nisemonogatari, it is revealed that he was a university student alongside [Yozuru](https://anilist.co/character/57501) and [Meme](https://anilist.co/character/2255

name: Yotsugi Ononoki
description:
**Occupation:** Oddity Specialist

Yotsugi Ononoki is an expressionless human corpse tsukumogami and the shikigami familiar of [Yozuru Kagenui](https://anilist.co/character/57501/).

Despite appearing almost entirely stoic, she still has hinted at feeling genuine emotion. She's mentioned how she considers [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/) her friend on multiple occasions, such as when giving him advice "as a friend" as opposed to as an oddity specialist. She's also expressed how she wouldn't want to have to harm him despite needing to follow orders as a shikigami.

She has an abili

name: Josee
description: A young girl who lives with her grandmother and calls herself "Josee" after her favorite book

appearsIn.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish

name: Tsuneo Suzukawa
description: A fourth year student at a university in Osaka.

appearsIn.title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish

name: Punpun Onodera
description:
Punpun is a socially awkward young boy whose age of innocence ends with his parents' divorce. As he continues to mature and interact with people around him as the average boy would, such as dealing with crushes and getting into mischief with his classmates, he begins to learn how crushing and harsh reality can be and struggles to find his purpose in the world.

As Punpun grows older, his appearance changes drastically based on how he views himself.

name: Aiko Tanaka
description:
An eccentric girl who is the main love interest of Onodera Punpun throughout the manga.

After many years without meeting up with Punpun, they meet at a driving school and start seeing each other more often. Little by little, they open up to each other to eventually reveal different truths about each of their realities. She tells Punpun how she's fed up with the poor lifestyle of hers because of her crippled and cult-obsessed mother. In a rush to leave her house along with Punpun, they decide they should at least let her mother know. While in her house, Aiko's mother becomes enraged with the n

name: Sachi Nanjou
description: Sachi is a young woman pursuing a career as a manga artist. She befriends [Onodera Punpun](https://anilist.co/character/17706/Onodera-Punpun) and serves an important role in his life. She has realistic views on things and isn't afraid to speak out, but most people think she is just a rude person.

name: Alucard
description:
__Height__: 220 cm (7'2")

The secret weapon of the Hellsing organization, Alucard is a vampire specializing in killing other vampires. At first glance, he seems to be nothing but a rather odd gunman, but when he truly unleashes his powers, it becomes quite clear that he is not a mortal. After walking the night for half a millennium, he is constantly seeking a worthy opponent, and with his powers of regeneration, strength, and shape-shifting, not to mention his army of familiars, he lays waste to any of his master's enemies.    

However, beneath his cool and heartless exterior lurks a dark an

name: Integra Fairbrook Wingates Hellsing
native: インテグラル・ファルブルケ・ウィンゲーツ・ヘルシング
description: Sir Integra Hellsing is a noblewoman member of the Protestant Knights who is the head and last member of the Hellsing family, the Bureau Director of the Hellsing Organization, and the current master of Hellsing's vampire, Alucard. Integra is usually a collected individual, rarely allowing her emotions to get in the way of business. However, she is sometimes prone to fits of anger. The Hellsing family is "on a mission from God", and she values her duties to protect the United Kingdom and the Anglican Church above everything else. For her, failure is not tolerated, especially her own. She runs t

name: Seras Victoria
native: セラス・ヴィクトリア
description:
__Affiliations:__ Hellsing Organization, London Metropolitan Police (Former; Firearms Specialist)

A policewoman sent to investigate the troubles at Cheddar Village, her squad is killed and she is nearly raped and killed by the mad vampire priest inhabiting the dead village but is "saved" when [Alucard](https://anilist.co/character/601/Alucard) sends a bullet through her to kill the priest. On the verge of death, she allows Alucard to turn her into a vampire​ and joins Hellsing as Alucard's minion.

She is reluctant to embrace her new powers at first, but gradually comes to terms with what she

name: All For One
native: オール・フォー・ワン
description:
__Quirk:__ All For One
__Occupation:__ Villain
__Fighting Style:__ Close Range and Long Range

All For One is the true leader and benefactor of the League of Villains. Once Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, his true motives are unclear and his true identity unknown. His current goal is to raise Shigaraki to become his eventual successor.

name: Shin  Wolford
native: シン ウォルフォード
description:
He is the main character of Kenja no Mago. After dying in a car accident. He was reincarnated into an unknown world carrying with him a vague memory of his previous life in his previous world.

(Source: Kenja no Mago Wiki)

name: Oliver Schtrom
native: オリバー＝シュトローム

name: August von Earlshide
native: アウグスト＝フォン＝アールスハイド
description: Hes the prince of the kindom of earlhide. His first appearance was at the royal mage academy.  Aug had never had a friend that treated him as a equal until shin said they are like "cousins"

name: Sicily von Claude
native: シシリー フォン クロード
description: Sizilien is the third daughter and fourth child of the House of Claude. [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/138191) encounters Sizilien when she and [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/138195) were being harassed by demon hunters. She was amazed by how quickly he dispatched the bigger and more intimidating men.

name: Satone Shichimiya
description:
[Yuuta Togashi's](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta) friend from middle school with whom she went on delusional adventures. Shichimiya believes to have a magical ring called "Saturn VII" and calls herself "Sophia Ring SP Saturn VII."

During their middle school time, she realized that she fell in love with Yuuta but in the end decided not to change and remain a magical girl. Once reunited in present time, the old feelings eventually come back and she has to make the choice again - this time supporting [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865/Takanashi-Rikka).

appearsIn.title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions - Heart Throb -
Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions: Take on Me

name: Rin Matsuoka
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10"); 179 cm (5'10")
__Swim Style:__ Butterfly (specialty), breaststroke, individual medley

The rival swimmer from Sametsuka Academy.  Rin Matsuoka is [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka)'s rival who is also in 11th grade. He had gone abroad to study swimming, but his personality changed immensely by the time he had returned to Japan and for this reason he often perplexes his former teammates.

Rin goes to all-boys school.

name: Nagisa Hazuki
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5"); 167 cm (5'6")
__Swim Style:__ Breastroke (Specialty)

Breaststroke swimmer of the Iwatobi High School swimming team. [Haruka's](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka) kouhai and a first year. He is a straight-forward person and his actions are faster than his words. He admires Haruka's swimming; it's the reason for him to start swimming. He enters Iwatobi High School because Haruka is there.

name: Haruka Nanase
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9"); 177 cm (5'10")
__Swim Style:__ Freestyle

Freestyle swimmer (crawl) of the Iwatobi High School swimming team. Haruka Nanase is an 11th grader who loves to swim. His strong and quiet swimming style fascinates many, and he holds a strong fixation on freestyle swimming.

His best friends include [Makoto Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/83027/Tachibana-Makoto) & [Nagisa Hazuki](https://anilist.co/character/83021/Hazuki-Nagisa) from Grade School, then he later befriends [Rei Ryuugazaki](https://anilist.co/character/83025/Ryuugazaki-Rei). He used to be best friends

name: Rei Ryuugazaki
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")
__Swimming style:__ Butterfly stroke

A freshman who joins the Iwatobi High School swim team.

Rei Ryuugazaki is a classmate of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/83021/Hazuki-Nagisa)'s in 10th grade. He was originally a member of the track team, but decided to join the swimming club instead. A handsome, intelligent young man who often gets manipulated by [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin) for some reason.

(Source: ANN)

name: Makoto Tachibana
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")  

Backstroke swimmer of the Iwatobi High School swimming team.

Makoto Tachibana is [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka)'s inseparable best friend since 11th grade. He understands Haruka's good points, and is often forced to speak as his spokesman. He is very kind and considerate, but is also very easily scared and weak-hearted.

name: Gou Matsuoka
description: [Rin Matsuoka](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin)’s little sister. She's [Hazuki](https://anilist.co/character/83021/Hazuki-Nagisa)'s classmate and 1st-year in Iwatobi high school. She has a refreshing personality in school but is always worried about her brother, Rin.

name: Haruhiro
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 170 cm, 172 cm (Volume 8)
__Class:__ Thief

The main viewpoint character and Thief of the group. Haruhiro is the most well-rounded character of the series as he is neither arrogant in his nature nor humble. He is generally helpful and always willing to help out his party members.

He is later forced to become the group's leader after [Manato](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato)'s death. Eventually,​ he starts to pay more attention to his teammates' feelings, slowly improving as a leader.

name: Yume
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 159 cm
__Class:__ Hunter

Brave and energetic, Yume is the Hunter of the group. She also has a tendency to try and protect [Shihoru](https://anilist.co/character/89316/Shihoru) because of her shy and timid nature. She has a good friendship with [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro) and they seem to get along well.

name: Mary
description:
__Class:__ Priest

Joining shortly after [Manato](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato)'s death, Mary effectively replaces him as the Priest of the party. Initially, there is a lot of friction between Mary and the rest of the team. She was actually a lot like Manato, but after a tragic incident that led to the death of some of her friends, she became cold and aloof. However, after [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro) tells her about their own situation, she slowly opens to her new party.

name: Ranta
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 168 cm, 170 cm (Volume 11)
__Class:__ Dark Knight

The Dark Knight of the group. He is brash, impulsive, and somewhat perverted, which leads him to constantly arguing with [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro). Ranta is the troublemaker of the group constantly causing problems and making rash decisions for he has a slight hint of arrogance in his character.

name: Shihoru
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ Unknown
__Class:__ Mage

The Mage of the group. She is shy, only opening up to [Yume](https://anilist.co/character/89314/Yume) and [Manato](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato) which led to a one-sided crush on him. Yume is constantly trying to get her to interact more with the group.

Shihoru becomes completely heart broken because of Manato's death

name: Manato
description:
__Class:__ Priest

Manato chose to become a Priest and ultimately assumed the role of the group's initial leader. He saw the positives in people and with that he was able to effectively strategize battle plans when the group began hunting goblins for the first time. As they progressed as a team, they began mapping out abandoned towns while hunting bigger goblin parties. However, while resting the group was ambushed by more goblins than they were accustomed to. Effectively moving his party to retreat, a goblin archer was able to successfully hit Manato square in the back as they ran away succes

name: Moguzo
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 186cm
__Class:__ Knight

Moguzo is the tallest and heaviest member of the group and hence chose to become a member of the Warrior guild. He wears the most ironclad armor and wields a wide blade broadsword that comes up to shoulder height. Although he is the most physically imposing, he challenges Shihoru for being the most soft spoken. On several occasions he will allow his friends to sleep in and will take their turn at cooking breakfast in the morning. He somewhat remembers doing this before and finding joy out of it. He also would carve wooden figurines of notewo

name: Mugi Awaya
description: He falls in love with [Akane Minagawa](https://anilist.co/character/120991/Minagawa-Akane) accepting the fact he has no chance of making her his. He is shown to be emotionless and revealed minimum expression, but as the story goes on, things start to change. He also shows a caring side for the ones close to him. Moka, a childhood friend, has deep feelings for Mugi, but he denies her feelings for him because he knows well he would ruin her.

name: Hanabi Yasuraoka
description:
At the beginning of the story she's in love with [Narumi Kanai](https://anilist.co/character/120993/Kanai-Narumi), her childhood friend who is now her teacher. She immediately realizes that Narumi is in love with [Akane Minagawa](https://anilist.co/character/120991/Minagawa-Akane) and not her. She meets [Mugi Awaya](https://anilist.co/character/120990/Awaya-Mugi), who is in love with Akane, and starts a relationship with him to satisfy each other's loneliness.

She has different attitudes with each character: she's cheerful with [Sanae Ebato](https://anilist.co/character/120992/Ebato-Sanae), h

name: Holo
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'2)

Holo is a wolf harvest deity originally from a land in the north known as Yoitsu. She made a promise with men from a town called Pasloe where she would ensure the town would have good wheat harvests year after year. However, as time went on, the townspeople slowly started to forsake Holo and did not rely on her as they once did. As such, Holo escapes from town in [Lawrence's](https://anilist.co/character/7374/) wagon and started traveling with him to see how much the world has changed since she has been in Pasloe. Holo has chosen the form of a girl younger than Lawren

appearsIn.title: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF

name: Kraft Lawrence
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10'') 

Kraft Lawrence is a twenty-five-year-old traveling peddler who goes from town to town buying and selling various things in order to make a living. When he was twelve, he became an apprentice to a merchant relative, and set out on his own at eighteen. His goal in life is to gather enough money to start his own shop, and he has already been traveling for seven years while gaining experience in the trade. He meets Holo one night and eventually agrees to her traveling with him. She helps him by providing her wisdom which helps to increase his profits and get him out o

appearsIn.title: Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF

name: Kaede Honjou
description: Maple is the main heroine, who has just started playing NewWorld Online. A shielder class. Since she doesn’t want to get hurt, she always puts her skill points into vitality. Due to this, many think of her as useless offensively, but much to their surprise, she manages her own. She's a bit silly, though surprisingly intelligent, and often abuses the game's mechanics in ways the game developers don't expect. Most of her actions in-game are done for the sole purpose of having fun, and though she participates in in-game tournaments often, she's only competitive insofar as it's enjoyable to her.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.
BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: Risa Shiramine
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

[Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/147892)'s gamer gal pal who invited her to the VRMMORPG NewWorld Online. She is a professional gamer, having numerous achievements that certify her capabilities. Being the swashbuckler class, her reflexes are considered abnormal.

Sally is extroverted, cautious, and practical, reflecting on her past experience with other games. She also has a creative and tricky side to her, evidenced by her choice to become a swashbuckler so that her party with Maple "would never take any damage", as opposed to the more conventional choice of bei

BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: Kanade
description:
A boy often mistaken for a girl because of his fair build. He joined Maple Tree when [Maple](https://anilist.co/character/147892) invited him.

Kanade is quiet and clever, showing a fascination with puzzles and mysteries of every kind. He will usually devote an entire day to any task he finds interesting.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.

name: Kasumi

His first appearance is when he tries to frighten [Shirayuki](https://anilist.co/character/18323/Shirayuki) by shooting an arrow to a wall next to her. He tends to hide his face under a mask, which makes many people think of him as a bad guy. He later starts showing to have feelings for Shirayuki, for she is the only person that understands him. Out of all the characters in AnS, he is the only character with unknown motives for following Zen so far

Shirayuki is a bright and resourceful girl, determined, able to speak her mind, and knowledgeable in both botany and medicine. Whenever there is a problem or conflict, she often takes matters into her own hands. She later learns to rely on others, especially Zen.

Due to her rare hair color, Shirayuki gets a proposal to be a concubine of the foolish but famous prince Raji. As she cannot decline it, she escapes to the neighboring country. While traveling, she meets a boy named Zen, who accidentally gets injured, and she boldly cures his wounds. They become friends, an

description:

The 2nd prince of the Kingdom of Clarines. He is in love with Shirayuki and has told his brother, Izana that he wishes to make her his wife.

Zen is an excellent swordsman and has a penchant for exiting out windows instead of doors and jumping down from high places.

As a young child, Zen has built up an immunity against various poisons by exposing himself to poisons in specific controlled doses causing convulsions, fever, and difficulty walking to name a few. These results were carefully documented by his doctors.

(Source: Wikipedia)

description:
**Height:** 156 cm (5'1")
**Character:** Sadistic

Because she usually has an unpleasant look in her eyes, she was worried that she didn't pass the interview, but the shop manager hired her to work at Stile. Her dream is to one day study abroad. She is the "Do S" (extreme sadist) waitress.

name: Mafuyu Hoshikawa
description:
__Height:__ 135 cm (4'9")
__Character:__ Little Sister

She looks young but she is actually a college student. She's usually quite calm but when she starts work she becomes a sparkling "little sister" character. She loves children's anime. She is the "little sister" waitress.

name: Kaho Hinata
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")
__Character:__ Tsundere

A popular blond, twin-tailed high school shop clerk who is so obsessed with games that sometimes leads her to spend too much money on it.

name: Kouyou Akizuki
description: He is in charge of the kitchen at Stile. He loves yuri.

name: Dino
description:
He is Italian, and scouted Maika to work at Stile. He has a bad habit of getting a nosebleed when he gets too excited.
He has a crush on Maika Sakuranomiya.

name: Vivy
description:
Vivy is the first autonomous humanoid AI in history. Her mission as an AI is to make everyone happy with her songs, thus she aims to sing with all her heart. She attaches great importance to promises and feelings, and is an AI "diva" that serves humankind.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

name: Matsumoto
description:
Matsumoto is an AI that came to Vivy from 100 years into the future. Its mission as an AI is "to avoid the war between AI and humankind." To that end, its goal is to destroy AI with Vivy.

It is talkative, overconfident, and has a personality that is not like an AI.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

name: Yunyun
description: Yunyun is a member of the Crimson Magic Clan, and she and [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361) are friends as well as rivals.

name: Shiemi Moriyama
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")    

Slightly allergic to pollen. Shiemi is [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin)'s classmate and friend. Before she met Rin, Shiemi tended her grandmother's garden while her mother ran an Exorcist only shop inside True Cross Academy. During her encounter with Rin and [Yukio](https://anilist.co/character/24734/Okumura-Yukio), they were able to discover that Shiemi was having her life force leached out by a Demon. After Yukio exorcised the demon, Shiemi finally decided to become an Exorcist and started to attend class. It was later revealed that Shiemi

name: Renzou Shima
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

Renzou is a very carefree character, yet he has a fear of many things, mainly bugs. He's very loyal to Bon, his childhood friend. They grew up together along with Konekomaru in Kyoto. He is also has a big obsession with women. Plans to become a Meister in Aria He is the 5th and youngest son of his family, and tells Konekomaru he's glad of this because it means he has less responsibilities. His older brother Juuzou says he's the pervert out of the brothers. Renzou is a carefree character and was the first person to actually befriend Rin since the revealing of the blue flames

name: Konekomaru Miwa
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Konekomaru Miwa hails from Kyoto along with Ryuji Suguro and Renzo Shima and is an Exwire of the True Cross Order, a student of the Exorcist Cram School, and the surviving head of the Miwa family.

name: Tomoya Aki
description:
__Occupation:__ Student / Executive producer / Director / Scenario writer / Manager

Tomoya is described as a 'hardcore geek'. However, he is one of the three most notable students at Toyogasaki Academy, along with [Utaha Kasumigaoka](https://anilist.co/character/88750/Utaha-Kasumigaoka) and [Eriri Spencer Sawamura](https://anilist.co/character/88749/Eriri-Spencer-Sawamura), due to his strong advocating of otaku culture at the school.

Tomoya is an otaku and prefers reading comics and light novels, watching anime, and playing visual novels above anything else. He is an enthusiastic fan of [Uta

name: Megumi Katou
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Occupation:__ Student / Assistant Director / Main Heroine

Megumi Kato is the classmate of [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), who is hardly noticed by others. After Tomoya had met her during the fate summons, she inspired him to make a dating sim game, featuring her as his Main Heroine. However, he is disappointed by her real personality. She is one of the main characters of the [Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata](https://anilist.co/anime/20657/Saenai-Heroine-no-Sodatekata/) series and is essentially the inspiration for the series title.

description:

__Occupation:__ Student / Illustrator / Painter

Eriri Spencer Sawamura is [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s childhood friend. She is a student of class 2G art club. She wears two hats as a student and a doujinshi artist. Eriri is one of the most beautiful girls to attend to Toyogasaki High School. Her family is very affluent. Her father is an English diplomat and she lives in a mansion. She is the secret illustrator for a famous doujinshi circle called ''Egoistic Lily'' under the alias Eri Kashiwagi when she participates in doujin activities.

description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5’6”)
__Occupation:__ Student / Author / Scenario Writer

Utaha Kasumigaoka is an up-and-coming young novelist and a student in class 3C who has a secret identity as a writer.

She is a hardworking girl who easily finishes writing their game's plot in the span of a night. Her usual disinterested expression gives off the impression that she is an unapproachable person. When she is with the people in [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s circle, she reverts to her disdainful self who enjoys making sarcastic remarks. She seems to be calm and quiet, but

Michiru Hyodo is [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s cousin/childhood friend (and by far his longest standing friend). She is a student in class 3, in the second year of Tsubaki Girls' Senior High School.

Michiru would have been a well-rounded student if not for her poor academic performance. She is fickle and naturally good at anything she does. [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) once noted that Michiru had a lot of useless talents. She is not interested in anything but her band and music, and enjoys playing the gui
