name: Shun Aonuma
description: Another one of Saki's childhood friends. Shun is very clever, with a strong intellectual curiosity and mature manners. His marks in magic are excellent at Saint Academy, and many have high hopes for his future. According to Satoru, Shun is the most talented at using the Force in their group.

name: Satoru Asahina
description:
A loud, brash 12-year-old who is part of a childhood friend group consisting of himself, Saki, Shun, Maria and Mamoru that attends Sage Academy in Kamisu 66. Satoru is a quick-witted and observant person who cares a lot about his friends despite poking fun at them. He is shown to be particularly close with Saki, as he teases and argues with her more often than the others. Like the rest of the students at the academy, he has a psychic ability called Cantus.

During summer camp, the group of five go off on a wild adventure that leads to Satoru and Saki being separated from the others and them me

name: Saki Watanabe
description: Saki is the main character and narrator of the story. Saki is a new student at the magic school, “Saint Academy”. Once she joins Saint Academy, she hangs out with [Satoru](https://anilist.co/character/57571/Asahina-Satoru), [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/57573/Akizuki-Maria), and [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/57575/Aonuma-Shun), her friends from Wakien Elementary School, as well as [Mamoru](https://anilist.co/character/57589/Itou-Mamoru), her new classmate. While she's not shy, she is sensitive and delicate.

name: Maria Akizuki
description:
Maria is Saki's best friend and a beautiful girl with pale, white skin and blazing red hair. She's very strong willed, and commands the weak, quiet Mamoru, but in times of need she devotes herself to protecting him. On the other hand, she does show a girlish fear of scary stories too.   

(Source: Crunchyroll)

name: Mamoru Itou
description: After joining Saint Academy and being put in the same class as Saki, he follows them around. He's a very shy boy, and rarely voices his own thoughts and opinions.   As he grows older, he starts to have feelings towards Maria.  He and Maria were killed after their child's birth. (Source: Crunchyroll)

name: Mare Bello Fiore
native: マーレ・ベロ・フィオーレ
description: One of the Guardians of the Sixth floor of Nazarick alongside his twin sister [Aura](https://anilist.co/character/89129). He's rather shy and calm in comparison to his sister, although he can fight and be ruthless when necessary. Like his sister, Mare is a Dark Elf. Mare specializes in Druid magic, capable of twisting the earth to his whims.

name: Keiichi Maebara
description:
Keiichi is the son of a famous and extremely wealthy artist and has recently moved to Hinamizawa after an array of unfortunate events in his hometown. His charismatic, lively attitude and talented tongue allow him to quickly fit in the town and make new friends and also win some club activities. Though he can be somewhat shy and is easily spooked at times. 
 In the first couple arcs, paranoia drives him to murder his friends and others, but in the other arcs, he gains inner strength and faith in his friends, enough to change the fate of Hinamizawa, sometimes by remembering the events of Onikak

name: Rena Ryuuguu
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2'')

Rena is a girl who returned from Ibaraki to Hinamizawa one year ago and now is in the same grade level as [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi). She is very kind and capable and takes care of Keiichi and her friends whenever possible, but is also naive and is usually subject to light teasing by Keiichi. She is distinguished by her obsession with things she perceives as adorable, calling them kāii (かぁいい), a slurred form of kawaii (かわいい) meaning "cute." Those tend to be moekko characters or items she finds while scouring the local dump, which ar

name: Mion Sonozaki
description: Mion is the oldest kid in [Keiichi Maebara](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s class. As the elder, she is the class president and everyone looks up to her as the leader. She acts like a perverted tomboy and calls herself old man, but has a hidden girlish side. Mion is next in line to be the head of the Sonozaki household, one of the Three Families which holds tremendous influence in Hinamizawa. Often when playing games with her fellow club members she is known for her ruthlessness, often coming up with the most embarrassing penalties for the losers.  Mion also serves as the

name: Rika Furude
description: Rika Furude is one of the younger students in [Keiichi's](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi) school, and is in the same grade level as [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Naturally, she is great friends with her, as they live together in the same house. She is revered by the villagers as the heir of the local shrine, and plays the role of a miko in the annual Watanagashi Festival. She has been the head of the Furude house since her parents died, but rarely attends town meetings due to her young age. While she does not speak a lot, she likes to say nonsens

name: Satoko Houjou
description: Satoko is a younger classmate in [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s school. She has a distinctive style of speech, ending all of her sentences with 'wa' which, at times, is grammatically incorrect. In spite of her young age, she is quite clever in setting up traps, and likes to practice on Keiichi.  Despite her extremely energetic and playful disposition she is actually quite the crybaby, which [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion) and Keiichi often tease her about. Satoko is also very close with [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika

name: Shion Sonozaki
description:
Shion is [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion)'s identical twin sister, who currently resides in Okinomiya. In spite of their different personalities, she and Mion often switch places, and it can be difficult to distinguish between them. 

Their first switch took place when they were little. Right before tattooing the symbol of an oni, which is reserved for the older sister, she was mistakenly identified as Shion, the younger sister, which means that she was actually born as Mion Sonozaki, the older sister. Since then, she switched her identity of Mion with Shion, the younger

name: Miyo Takano
description:
Miyo is a nurse at the village clinic who has a keen interest in Hinamizawa's past and culture, recording all her speculation in notebooks. At times, her storytelling can be very mysterious and chilling—she seems to enjoy putting people on edge.

In the first six arcs, she consistently disappears on the night of Watanagashi, and an incinerated body thought to be hers is found in the mountains. Later, however, it turns out that she is the mastermind of the events taking place in Hinamizawa who wants to murder [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) so she can prove her grandfather

name: Irina Shidou
description:
__Rank:__ Angel (Former Human)
__Weapon:__ Excalibur Mimic

She is Xenovia's partner and Issei's childhood friend. After finding out that the God in the Bible is dead, she still follows the teaching and is under the direct command of Michael. She also has a crush on Issei and was shocked to find out he turned into a devil. They are still friends despite that flaw.

name: Vali Lucifer
native: ヴァーリ・ルシファー
description: Vali Lucifer is the leader of the Khaos Brigade's Vali Team. He is a descendant of the original Lucifer and the possessor of the Vanishing Dragon, Albion; wielding the Divine Dividing Sacred Gear. As such, he is the direct rival of Issei Hyoudou and Ddraig.

name: Misaki Kirihara
description: The Section-Chief of the Foreign Affairs Section 4 who is investigating matters that concern Contractors. Misaki has long brown hair and glasses and rarely smiles or laughs. She has a strong sense of justice and a sharp intuition. Kirihara became a policewoman in order to protect the weak, has a distaste for smokers due to their smell, and is sensitive about the exposure of her body. She likes eating greasy food but claims to stay fit due to constantly moving around everyday as part of her job. Her father is Superintendent Supervisor Naoyasu Kirihara of the National Police Agency.   (Source: W

name: Mao
description: His name means "cat" in Chinese. He is a Contractor who has lost his original body and now resides within that of a black cat. His messier code is HM-432. His brain is directly connected to a wireless network which enables him to send and receive information at any time, as well as subduing the natural instincts of the animals he possesses. Mao usually creates diversions for Hei in battle. Mao's ability is to possess the bodies of other animals. While he lost his remuneration along with his body, he must connect periodically with the wireless network or run the risk of having the animal's natu

name: Huang
description: Huang's position can be interpreted as that of field supervisor. He is a human and only possesses strategic abilities. He has a general dislike for contractors and voices it regularly in spite of having to work alongside three of them. Huang passes down orders from the Syndicate to the rest of the team.   Huang was going to run away with a girl he loved who was also a contractor, but she was killed saving Huang from being targeted by the syndicate.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yin
description:
A member of [Hei](https://anilist.co/character/2160/)'s team, an emotionless spirit medium known as a "Doll." Her power lies in tracking and observation through direct contact with water. [Huang](https://anilist.co/character/2164/) mentions that her "program" is a minimal one, incapable of showing emotion or even allowing her to make decisions for herself; however, she later debunks this by making the decision to keep working with Hei and the others when given the choice of leaving, a possible sign of her recovering her humanity.

 Yin is of Finnish origin and her real name is Kirsi. She was o

name: Hei
description: His codename is Hei, which means black in Chinese. Hei is a very talented contractor, his Messier Code is BK-201. Hei lives two lives in the series. In public he is Li Shengshun, a foreign exchange student from China. He is very nice and well mannered. He lives in the Umitsuki apartments and is always working a new part-time job.He has a huge appetite, not unlike most anime characters.  Hei's other life is of a Contractor called BK-201 and also the Black Reaper, mostly by other Contractors. Before becoming a contractor Hei was an assassin which earned him his nickname. Hei is usually seen on t

name: Tomo Aizawa
description:
**Relatives:** Akemi (Mother), Gorou (Father)

Tomo is a high school student with a tomboyish personality, exceptional skills in combat sports, and an earnest desire to win the heart of her childhood friend Junichiro. Despite her athletic abilities, she is self-conscious about her masculine traits and seeks to become more feminine.

name: Junichirou Kubota
description:
Junichirou Kubota is the deuteragonist of Tomo-chan wa Onnanoko!. He is Tomo's neighbor, childhood friend, fellow dojo pupil and high school classmate. He is handsome but unaware of Tomo's affections towards him. He regularly trains with Tomo's father's dojo and feels jealous when she gives attention to other guys.

He does not get along with Misuzu, having briefly dated her in middle school.

name: Misuzu Gundou
description:
**Relatives:** Misaki (Mother)

Misuzu Gundou is the tritagonist of Tomo-chan wa Onnanoko!. She is Tomo and Jun's childhood friend and classmate. She is cunning and sometimes sadistic, often teasing Jun. However, she is also protective of her friend and dislikes the idea of Tomo and Jun progressing their relationship.

Misuzu teases Jun and they briefly dated for 3 days, but broke up because she couldn't keep up with his wild adventures. She has stated that she hates him for breaking up with her before she could break up with him.

name: Carol Olston
native: キャロル・オールストン
description:
**Relatives:** Ferris (Mother), Kousuke (Distant Cousin)

Carol is a classmate and friend of Tomo, Jun and Misuzu. A beautiful, doll-faced student of British origin with no filter between her brain and her mouth.

name: Batou
description:
Batou is nominally the second-in-command of Section 9. 

Little is known about the strange, large foreigner who has been with [Motoko Kusanagi](https://anilist.co/character/1795/Kusanagi-Motoko) for years. He was once American and served in the Special Forces in South America. 

His amount of cyborg-ization is variable according to the storyline, from his limbs only up to most of his body, second only to the Major herself.  Despite the availability of superior eyes, he grew superstitious about his old-style eye replacements, popular with many high-level military operatives. He also retains som

appearsIn.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

name: Togusa
description: Togusa is the newest member of Section 9 and the only one not originally recruited from Kusanagi's team of SpecOps.  Recruited from the regular police forces, Detective Togusa (no first name is yet known) has only the most basic of augmentation and no cyberization outside of his cyberbrain.  The Major wanted him for his perspective as a real policeman and as an outside opinion so as to avoid intellectual incest within Section 9.  Togusa mostly feels inferior to the rest of the team, forgetting to recognize the reason for his inclusion in the group.  He is the only member with a spouse and chil

appearsIn.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

name: Daisuke Aramaki
description: The wise and powerful Head of Section 9, Aramaki relies upon his many international and corporate contacts to supply his team with the information they need to get the job done. Though he commands a great deal of respect, he is occasionally called "Monkey Man" (in the Manga) by his subordinates (perhaps because of his unconventional hairstyle/face). Seldom directly involved in police actions, he is nonetheless constantly working behind the scenes to coordinate the efforts of his agents, making quick and authoritative decisions and maintaining tight control of Kusanagi.

appearsIn.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

name: Motoko Kusanagi
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

Motoko Kusanagi is the mysterious, even enigmatic woman who has led a group of SpecOps for years and was recruited by [Aramaki](https://anilist.co/character/2677/Aramaki-Daisuke) to work for Section 9. Almost nothing is known about her, her origins, birthdate, etc. She could not be older than 60 or so since the widespread use of full cyborgization was not in use until then. She was fully cyborged at a very young age and as she "grew" she went through a series of artificial bodies. This, more than anything, likely contributed to her great ease at controlling cyborg bo

appearsIn.title: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

name: Project 2501
description: Project 2501, also known as The Puppet Master from the film and manga, Ghost in the Shell is an artificial intelligence program secretly developed by Section 6 of Public Security that develops sapience.

name: Ishikawa
description: Ishikawa is the information warfare/technology specialist in Public Security Section 9. It has not been stated in the series thus far as to the degree that he has been cybernetically augmented, though character dialogue suggests that he is one of the least augmented members of Section 9. His appearance is characterized by a large beard and perpetually unkempt hair, and he is the oldest of Section 9's field operatives. He formerly served with Kusanagi and Batou in South America when they were with the Ground Self-Defense Forces in the Japanese UN contingent. He was one of the earliest members r

name: Miyabi Aizawa
description: Anime - Aizawa began not to trust teachers anymore when one of her classmates got involved in a scandal due to an affair of their former instructor. From this, she and her cohorts began their quest of kicking out any teacher who will be assigned to their class. They were successful in making these teachers resign, but Onizuka...  Manga - What drives Miyabi to go bad and lead a rebellion against teachers is an incident which occured when she was in the 7th grade. She had been the favorite student of Mr. Ogi, teacher of Class 2-4 ( the name of her class back in junior high ). Ogi would praise he

name: Azusa Fuyutsuki
description: A beautiful female teacher who is the heroine of the series. Unlike Onizuka, she led a relatively normal life, graduating from Waseda University. Her quiet manner and moderate ideas are misleading as she proves to be very tough on her own sometimes scaring even Onizuka. To prepare him for the test which would determine his teaching career, she prepares a mountain of jelly with eyes of Maguro tuna fish as fruits and imposes an impossibly tough schedule that would have killed anyone or drove them mad. Her field of teaching is Kokugo or Japanese language (English in the Live Action). She, not tha

name: Urumi Kanzaki
description:
The antithesis to the "dumb blonde" stereotype, Urumi Kanzaki is a prodigy with an IQ over 200. She is also a heterochromatic, possessing different colored eyes: one brown and one blue. 

However, she is psychologically disturbed, having her fair share of hate toward teachers. Her genius is displayed repeatedly by such abstract actions as the detonation of time bombs (i.e. firecrackers in disposable boxes) and making a harmless snake look like a cobra using paper cutouts. 

Her intellect is also shown through actions, such as shouting curse words in French and being able to speak fluent Mandar

name: Yoshito Kikuchi
description:
Yoshito Kikuchi is one of Eikichi Onizuka's students. This computer prodigy (scoring the highest without certain "aid" in the country, on a standardized test) serves as class president and is also notorious for making pornographic composite photos, during Onizuka's arrival at the Holy Forest Academy. He tries to blackmail him into resignation with several pictures posted all across the school for everyone to see. Onizuka catches Kikuchi and instead of punishing him, hires him to make composite pictures of Azusa Fuyutsuki and other female teachers, much to his surprise.

Kikuchi eventually befr

name: Kunio Murai
description: The class "jock bully", Kunio Murai is not very bright and loses his temper easily. When Eikichi Onizuka arrives at the Holy Forest Academy, Kunio and his gang (consisting of Kouji Fujiyoshi and Tadaaki Kusano) attempt to kill him several times with seemingly innocent pranks, such as a cockroach planted in his school lunch. The plans backfire (such as Kunio eating the cockroach, instead) and he goes insane, nearly ending up with his face impaled on a pair of razor-sharp scissors. Onizuka then takes advantage of Kunio's 27 year-old mother, Julia Murai, after trouncing Kunio at several arcade ga

name: Tomoko Nomura
description: A student in Eikichi Onizuka's class, Tomoko Nomura has a large chest (her cup size is F), but is not too bright, leading to people calling her Toro-ko (Toro meaning "slow" in Japanese; she is nicknamed Slo-mo-ko in the English version). After initially messing up her role in one of Miyabi Aizawa's plans to get Onizuka fired, she is cut off from Miyabi's group. Seeing her rather slow, clumsy nature, Onizuka enters her into a local beauty contest. He even arranges two porn producer friends to dress her up for the competition. Rather than read the given script for the acting category, Onizuka gi

name: Eikichi Onizuka
description: A hormonal, blonde-haired biker and virgin, Onizuka Eikichi graduated from a bottom-rung university by cheating and, as such, cannot get a decent job. His main way of spending time is peering up girls' skirts in a local mall. He is very athletic, as he can bench press 150 kg (331 lbs), has a second dan black belt in karate, and even claims to perform 500 push-ups, 1000 pull ups and 2000 squats daily.

appearsIn.title: GTO: The Early Years - Shonan Junai Gumi

name: Hiroshi Uchiyamada
description: Yoshiko's father and Vice Principal of Holy Forest Academy. He is a very strict man who readily blindly follows the school rules and places them on top of anything else. Also he doesn't have much patience. He is easily enraged by Onizuka's behavior basically always. He seems to have no respect for school delinquents or any rebels during the series. Hiroshi believes that Onizuka is the evil root of all his misfortunes. He was visibly against Onizuka's hiring, but had to accept Principal Sakurai's decision.  Uchiyamada is always yelling at Onizuka's behavior and argues with him a lot.

name: Noboru Yoshikawa
description: A student at Holy Forest Academy who didn't have a good time before Eikichi Onizuka arrived, as he was the victim of bullying, mostly from Uehara Anko and her group. He is extremely good with video games and somewhat of an otaku, but proves to be quite handy with making things. Anko's bullying is so bad it makes him attempt to commit suicide twice, both times by leaping off the roof of the school, and both times resulting in him being saved by Onizuka, at the cost of Vice-Principal Hiroshi Uchiyamada's car. The two strike a quick friendship, which works for Onizuka, as Noboru has plenty of ite

name: Will Serfort
native: ウィル・セルフォルト
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")
__Race:__ Lyzance

Will Serfort is a sixth year student at the Regarden Magical Academy shunned by most students and faculty due to his lack of magical aptitude. To make up for his lack of magic, Will trains his body and swordsmanship in the dungeon.

name: Xiaoshi Cheng
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Skills:__ Basketball, Photography

Manager of Time Photography Studio. Rough around the edges, but good at heart. Often acts impulsively. In order to save his studio from going out of business, he works together with [Lu Guang](https://anilist.co/character/218267/Lu-Guang), using their powers to enter photos and fulfill client requests.

He can enter the world inside a photo and possess the photographer's body, temporarily controlling their words and actions.

name: Guang Lu
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Skills:__ Intelligence, Strategizing 
__Dislikes:__ Things being messed up after he's tidied them up, Plans being messed up
__Likes:__ Gourmet Food, Basketball, Reading, Sleeping, Sunbathing

Partner at Time Photography Studio. Calm and rational. Works together with [Cheng Xiaoshi](https://anilist.co/character/218266/Cheng-Xiaoshi) to fulfill client requests by acting as his guide and directing his actions.

He can foresee everything that happens inside a photo within 12 hours of it being taken; can share the consciousness of the person going into the photo through a high

name: Ling Qiao
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Current landlord of Time Photography Studio. Grew up with Cheng Xiaoshi. Acts as the middleman and picks up commissions for Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang.

name: Karen Tendou
description:
**Height:** 165 cm (5'5)

She is the most popular girl of the school, but also a huge video game nerd. She's the club president of the Game Club, she invites [Keita](https://anilist.co/character/121826/Amano-Keita) to join but he rejects the invitation each time.

She develops a crush on Keita Amano after she overhears Amano's admiring words about her, as he stood up to [Tasuku Uehara](https://anilist.co/character/121828/Uehara-Tasuku)

name: Chiaki Hoshinomori
description:
She is a classmate of Karen Tendou from class 2-A at Otobuki High School and a member of a non-school recognized gamer appreciation group together with Keita Amano and Tasuku Uehara. Chiaki is a shy girl and very reclusive. She did not seem to care about her looks at first until Keita and Tasuku came into her life. She did not socialize much and mostly preferred to play games on her own.

After she discovered that Keita was both "Tsucchi" and "Yama" was her online gaming friend she develops romantic feelings towards Keita

name: Keita Amano
description:
**Height:** 159 cm

He is the protagonist of the GAMERS! series. He is the older brother of Kōsei Amano, a student from class 2-F and a member of a non-school recognized gamer appreciation group together with [Chiaki Hoshinomori](https://anilist.co/character/121825/Chiaki-Hoshinomori) and [Tasuku Uehara](https://anilist.co/character/121828/Tasuku-Uehara).

(Source: GAMERS! Wikia)

name: Aguri Sakurano
description: Aguri is Tasuku's girlfriend. In the anime, she is a petite girl with pink hair and purple eyes. Aguri is immature and tends to be a clingy girl towards Tasuku though this is because he now spends his time hanging out with others. She also tends to be somewhat of a ditz, she does not play video games nor does she have an interest in them. She fell in love with Tasuku after he gave her a plushie doll in middle school, and she changed her appearance as well in order to get closer to him. She becomes jealous that Tasuku is being friendly with Chiaki, but allies with Keita to help him relate bette

name: Tasuku Uehara
description:
He is a classmate of Keita Amano from class 2-F at Otobuki High School and the boyfriend of Aguri Sakurano.

In middle school, he wore glasses and his hair was in a different style. He was a considered a nerd before he decided to alter his appearance for high school. He is well-known for his looks among the popular boys.

name: Konoha Hoshinomori
description: She is the younger sister of Chiaki Hoshinomori and the Student Council President of Hekiyō High School.

name: Nine
description: A villain and the primary antagonist in My Hero Academia the Movie: Heroes Rising.

name: Kousuke Tsuda
description: A good friend of Makoto.

appearsIn.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

name: Chiaki Mamiya
description: Chiaki is one of Makoto's good friends that joins her and Kousuke in games of baseball after school.     When Makoto attempts to stop Kousuke and his girlfriend from getting hit by a train, she encounters Chiaki, who has turned back time to prevent the accident. This reveals that Chiaki can leap through time as well. Chiaki tells Makoto that in the alternate future, Kousuke and his girlfriend were both killed in the accident. Chiaki then explains that he is from the future, and people in the future can leap through time.    Chiaki reveals that the reason Makoto can leap through time is be

appearsIn.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

name: Makoto Konno
description: Makoto Konno is an ambivalent senior high school student still caught between that devilish question of "Arts or Sciences?" that her teachers require of her immediate academic future. She always sleeps in a few minutes too many, is remarkably clumsy, hates pop quizzes like every other high school student and never really makes an effort to brush her wayward hair.     About as average as can be, she spends the majority of her days after school hitting baseballs and playing catch with her best pals.

appearsIn.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time

name: Ichirou Inuyashiki
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

At first glance, Ichirou is a timid man who rarely likes to speak out, which is evident in the way that his family treats him. He retreats into cowardice and melancholy when behaviors such as hatred, selfishness, rudeness or bullying come into his way. His introversion, however, is in conflict with his need to help and support all those around him.  When he receives his powers he becomes a bit braver than originally perceived at the beginning of the story. 

Ichirou is a middle-aged man who has been diagnosed with stomach cancer the day after moving to his new house. After

name: Hiro Shishigami
description:
This young man cares about his childhood friend [Ando](https://anilist.co/character/123580/Andou-Naoyuki) and his mother more than anyone, but is completely indifferent to anyone else. Just like [Inuyashiki](https://anilist.co/character/123583/Inuyashiki-Ichirou), Shishigami got a mechanical body after being involved in the same UFO accident, but unlike Inuyashiki, he uses his powers to commit crimes in order to feel alive.

 In the end he self destructs himself to change the trajectory of the asteroid that was about to hit the earth and destroy it.

name: Kaname Sudou
description:
__Sigil:__ Flame God's Hammer
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

He was sent a help request by Kyouda Hiroyuki and joined the Darwin's Game. He is only interested in surviving. His sigil allows him to forge any weapon. However, it can't be too complicated.

name: Rein Kashiwagi
description:
__Sigil:__ Worldwide Function
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

A player in Darwin's Game who is an information broker. Her sigil is analogous to Laplace's demon, a hypothetical being that knows the exact location and momentum of every atom in the universe.

name: Shuka  Karino
description:
__Sigil:__ Queen of Thorn
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

She is skilled at Darwin's game and has 49 wins with no losses. Her sigil is a powerful telekinetic type that allows her to freely control any string-like object.

name: Ryuuji Maesaka
description:
__Sigil:__ Lie Detector
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

He is a participant in the Darwin Game and uses a machine gun as a weapon. His sigil enables him to know if people are lying or not. He seems to have a personal grudge against "One", the leader of the clan "Eighth".

name: Souta
description: A player in Darwin Game who has the sigil to control ice. Sui's twin brother, who died in an accident 1 year ago. D-game brought his soul back in Sui's body.

name: Sui
description:
__Sigil:__ Light of Pollux
__Clan:__ Sunset Ravens

A player in Darwin Game who has the sigil to control water. Souta's twin sister.

name: Reisi Munakata
description: __Age:__ 24  __Height:__ 185 cm  __Birthday:__ October 1  __Horoscope:__ Libra   (RH-)  The head of SCEPTER4 and the Blue King. Reishi is a sophisticated, observant and composed individual who is cautious in the battlefield. Though he is willing to use physical action in a fight, Reishi does attempt to win with victory through negotiation instead. He is a natural leader and generally puts the concern of innocent lives over his own. Though he possesses a general loathing towards Mikoto Suoh, Reishi still accepts him as a human being. He takes immediate notice when his vice-commander Awashima's

name: Kuroh Yatogami
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm 

A young man with an unyielding personality. He is also a skilled swordsman, martial artist, and housekeeper. Kuroh is a quiet, serious and composed individual that appears tough and completely no-nonsense on the surface. He is very determined to accomplish his goals, whatever they may be, but despite so Kuroh is willing to set them aside for the finer things in life, such as genuine companionship. Kuroh says that he follows a policy where, rather than judging a man by his appearance or words, their actions are what matters more.  In his younger years, Kuroh was trained by

name: Neko
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Neko has a very joyful, carefree, and energetic personality. She is very playful, often participating or even starting chases with people. In addition, Neko seems to have no qualms or worries about being nude, especially in front of men, showing some immodesty. She even stated that she does not like wearing clothes, the reason being that "Clothes are too restricting". She is also a mysterious girl, who is also a cat. Neko also likes Shiro and even calls him "My Shiro".

Neko is a female Strain. By projecting her powers within a perimeter with herself at the center, she can

name: Yashiro Isana
description:
**Height**: 169 cm

A joker who goes around asking for his schoolmates to share their lunch with him. Yashiro is soft-spoken but very charismatic. He is very friendly and well-liked. In addition, he is quite respectful towards anyone he meets, even robots.  He is also somewhat laid-back and happy-go-lucky. Yashiro carries also a red, Japanese-style parasol with him at all times.

His real name is Adolf K. Weissman and he's the Silver King. The Colorless King was once in control of "Yashiro's" body, but once he took control of Weissman's original body, their spirits switch. He had amnesia from

name: Mikoto Suoh
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm  

Third King, known as the Red King. Has an ability to control fire. Feared by people as the leader of the Red Clan, HOMRA. Mikoto is a quiet man who says very little, even to his own subordinates. He is very calm, rarely being irritated or annoyed, and even when his mood changes Mikoto still maintains his composure. Mikoto is an avid smoker, often holding a cigarette and a lighter in each hand.

name: Fubuki
aliases: Jigoku no Fubuki (地獄のフブキ)
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Superhero
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'5¾")
__Level:__ B-Class Rank 1
__Affiliation:__ Hero Association
__Family:__ Tatsumaki (sister)
__Abilities:__ Psychokinesis


Fubuki, also known by her hero alias Blizzard of Hell, is the B-Class Rank 1 professional hero of the Hero Association. She is an esper, the younger sister of Tatsumaki, and the leader of the Blizzard Group, a B-Class hero faction. She and her sister are known as the Psychic Sisters. Fubuki is currently trying to recruit [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935/Saitama) into her group. She's also a sel

name: Mahiru Shiina
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

A classmate who lives next door to [Amane](https://anilist.co/character/195601/Fujimiya-Amane). She is the most beautiful girl in school. She's well-behaved, gets great grades, always wears a smile, and is called an angel by her peers. Because of her beauty, she is very popular for the male student population at school. Due to this, Mahiru tended to avoid her male classmates in the beginning of the story.

A first-year high school student who began living alone at the start of the semester. He is poor at every type of housework and leads a self-indulgent life. He has few friends and tends to put himself down.

name: Miroku
description:
A Buddhist 'houshi,' or low-ranking, itinerant monk, Miroku traveled the countryside performing services such as exorcisms and youkai exterminations to earn his living.

He suffers from a hereditary curse originally inflicted upon his grandfather Miyatsu (also a Buddhist monk) by [Naraku](https://anilist.co/character/1367/Naraku), who exploited Miyatsu's weakness for attractive women by taking the shape of one, and reflected one of Miyatsu's ofuda back to pierce the palm of his right hand (it appears to be his left hand in the English language manga where right and left are reversed). The hole

name: Shippo
description:
An orphaned young youkai-fox (kitsune) whose father was killed by the Thunder Brothers, [Hiten](https://anilist.co/character/17073/Raijou-Hiten) and [Manten](https://anilist.co/character/17074/Raijou-Manten). He wanted to avenge his father so he helped [Kagome](https://anilist.co/character/1354/Higurashi-Kagome) and [Inuyasha](https://anilist.co/character/1353/Inuyasha). He was the first character in the story to join InuYasha and Kagome in their travels as a group.

Shippo can shape shift, but his forms are temporary, often incomplete and ineffective, and he is usually given away by his tellt

name: Inuyasha
description:
__Birthday:__ Unconfirmed 
__Birthplace:__ Western Japan, equal to Toyama  
__Height:__ 167 cm  
__Weapons:__ claws, sword-Tessaiga  
__Attacks:__ Claws-Sankountessou, Hijinkessou. Tessaiga- Kaze no Kizu, Bakuryuuha, Kongousoha, and Meido Zangetsuha.   
__Family:__ [Izayoi](https://anilist.co/character/21685) (mom), [InuTaisho](https://anilist.co/character/3167) (dad), and [Sesshoumaru](https://anilist.co/character/1358) (half-brother).  

The male protagonist, a hybrid of a youkai-dog and a human, a half-demon ("han'yo" in Japanese). He wields the Tessaiga (pronounced "Tetsaiga" in the Americ

name: Sango
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Sango is a youkai slayer who hails from a village of professional yōkai slayers. The only member of Inuyasha's group to have no supernatural powers, Sango instead wields the Hiraikotsu, a massive boomerang made of yōkai bones, in addition to a broad repertoire of tools and tricks for battling yōkai.

Sango is also a victim of [Naraku](https://anilist.co/character/1367/Naraku)'s evil schemes; her family was killed and her entire village destroyed by Naraku's yōkai so that Naraku could then blame [Inuyasha](https://anilist.co/character/1353/Inuyasha) and manipulate Sango into

name: Kagome Higurashi
description:
__Height:__ 157.5 cm (5'1")   

The female protagonist and a third year middle school student. In the tradition of many [Rumiko Takahashi](https://anilist.co/staff/96891) heroines ([Lum](https://anilist.co/character/4835), [Akane Tendo](https://anilist.co/character/669), [Kyoko Otonashi](https://anilist.co/character/4745)), Kagome can be extremely sweet, but can also become very dangerous when provoked. 

[InuYasha](https://anilist.co/character/1353) wears a special bead necklace (known as the Beads of Subjugation) which only responds to Kagome's command: when she yells "Sit!" ("Osuwari!") (Of

name: Tomoe
description:
Tomoe is one of the Greater Dragons, existing in the World of the Goddess. She is presently in servitude of [Makoto Misumi](https://anilist.co/character/138137/Misumi-Makoto).

She tends to have an easy-going personality, likes taking on new challenges and learning interesting things related to the Edo period of Japan. Different from her previously lazy and disˈinterested outlook of the world.

She's not serious at times to a dangerous degree.

She finds great enjoyment in seeing what changes would come from Makoto and especially learning things from his memories.

name: Mio
description: She is previously referred to​ as the Black Spider of Calamity and is a unique existence in the Goddess' World. She is presently in servitude of [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/138137/Misumi-Makoto). She can be single-minded and straightforward in her loyalty to Makoto to the point that it reaches a dangerous level. She has no qualms about destroying anyone who intends to do harm to Makoto.

name: Makoto Misumi
description:
Makoto Misumi is the Main Protagonist of this series. He is a one of the three World Traveler's who got sent to the [Goddess](https://anilist.co/character/221535/Megami)' World.

Originally meant to be the only person to be sent to the other world as per the contract between his parents and the Goddess, but because of her own preferences in beauty standards, she abandons and throws Makoto to the edge of her world into the Wasteland, while secretly kidnapping two other people from Earth and sending them to her world as Heroes. [Tsukuyomi](https://anilist.co/character/195917/Tsukuyomi), the Moon

name: Umaru Doma
description: A high school girl who is beautiful and intelligent, but at home she is lazy, and surrounds herself in games, anime, and manga. Nobody knows what she's like at home except her brother [Taihei](https://anilist.co/character/89020/Doma-Taihei).

name: Taihei Doma
description: A company employee who lives together with his younger sister Umaru. With his kind and methodical personality, he easily handles his job as well as taking care of all the housework for the two of them. He warmly watches over his carefree sister and scolds her as she spends her time lazying around.

name: Miia
description:
__Species:__ Lamia 

She is the first to arrive in [Kimihito](https://anilist.co/character/60225/Kurusu-Kimihito)'s ward when the cultural exchange began. She is sweet, naive, and a carefree individual. She has a habit of being clingy when she sleeps. She's very ticklish when one holds the very tip of her tail, which is why Kimihito exploit that weakness in order to get out of her grip.

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Kimihito Kurusu
description: Ever since the cultural exchange between humans and sub-species begun, he found himself suddenly forced to volunteer in such program where he has to be the custodian of 3 sub-species; namely Miia a lamia, Papi a harpy and Centorea Shianus a centaur, where everyday living with them is an accident waiting to happen.

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Papi
description:
__Species:__ Harpy

Papi is the second girl to move in with Kimihito after she abducts him and almost dropped him while flying. She has difficulty with words which makes it difficult for Kimihito to understand what she is saying. She's childish, both physically and mentally, despite being as old as Miia.

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Centorea Shianus
native: セントレア・シアヌス
description:
__Species:__ Centaur

Centorea, also known as "Cerea", is the third resident of Kimihito Kurusu's home. She is very prim and proper, referring to herself as a self-proclaimed knight.
As one of the noble creatures, Cerea is incredibly honorable and chivalrous, while being unerringly loyal to Kimihito. Also, she is somewhat archaic in speech and behavior. Centaurs have strict rules about only letting one's master ride on their backs. She has been shown to be just as possessive of Kimihito as Miia, the difference is that Cerea hides it much better and can seemingly be ashamed of it.
Due to her ho

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Suu
description:
__Species:__ Slime

A humanoid-like monster who tends to cling onto [Kimihito](https://anilist.co/character/60225/Kurusu-Kimihito) and loves to copy [Papi](https://anilist.co/character/63267/Papi). She can also copy speech word-for-word in the same pitch and tone as others. Can shape-shift to become like other humanoid beings but leaves her distinct traits to distinguish her from the person she copied.

In chapter 13, Suu apparently learns how to speak and confesses her love to Kimihito (Master) in front of the others surprising everyone especially [Miia](https://anilist.co/character/60223/Mii

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Meroune Lorelei
native: マーラウン・ロリライ
description:
__Species:__ Mermaid

Meroune Lorelei, or Mero for short, is a mermaid bound to a wheelchair. While she is the the fourth girl to officially move in with Kimihito, she is technically the fifth girl to move in with him because Suu is supposed to be the fourth, but she lives there illegally so she doesn't count. Mero has a very warm personality. According to Centaurea, she gets a vibe of royalty from her. As a young girl she had a fascination with the "tragic love" story of Hans Andersen's "The Little Mermaid", and wants to experience it in real life, even to the point of turning into sea foam (

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Rachnera Arachnera
native: ラチネラ・アラチネラ
description:
__Species:__ Arachne

Arriving to her first host family, the host family did not expect Rachnera to be a Arachne, which caused them to take a disliking to her. When a man offered them money for the rights as her host, they accepted. Being used as a way to make money by producing spider web the man could sell, she ran away from the man. While on the run she kidnapped Kurusu Kimihito, causing the police to search for him and her.

appearsIn.title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls

name: Nishikata
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Nishikata is a middle school student in class 1-2. He sits in the back of the classroom next to [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800). He can't handle bitter things like black coffee, secretly watches/reads a romance titled "100% Unrequited Love", and gets frightened very easily. He does average academically.

name: Takagi
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

A middle schooler​ at an unnamed school. She sits at the back of class 1-2 next to [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799). Academically talented and physically capable, she claims her only weaknesses are her ticklish armpits and her inability to stop teasing Nishikata.

name: Meryl Stryfe
description:
Meryl Stryfe and her junior co-worker [Milly](https://anilist.co/character/714/Thompson-Milly) were sent by the Bernardelli Insurance Society to evaluate claims regarding [Vash the Stampede](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash-the-Stampede). Despite her serious attitude and short temper, she is a good person.

Although she doesn't often fight alongside Vash, she hides many derringer-style "throwaway" pistols under her coat. She once referred to herself as "Derringer Meryl".

Initially, she finds Vash to be a nuisance and dismisses the idea that he is the legendary Humanoid Typhoon. As time p

name: Vash the Stampede
native: ヴァッシュ・ザ・スタンピード
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") 

Vash is an outlaw, commonly referred to as "The Humanoid Typhoon" due to the carnage and destruction left in his wake. Feared as a ruthless desperado, Vash is actually a man who hates violence and would much rather spread his message of "LOVE AND PEACE!"

name: Milly Thompson
description:
Milly Thompson is a fellow Bernardelli agent and friend and assistant to [Meryl](https://anilist.co/character/713/Stryfe-Meryl). Despite physically towering over Meryl, Milly looks up to her and always refers to her as "senpai," or "Ma'am" in the English Version, as a term of respect for a senior.

Although physically very strong, she appears rather simple and ditzy, but has an extremely kind heart and also reveals a strength of character and genuine optimism. However, Milly can be just as hotheaded as Meryl if someone is disrespectful towards their family (or wasting food, especially pudding)

name: Nicholas D. Wolfwood
native: ニコラス・D・ウルフウッド
description: He is a priest who wields a large cross-shaped gun named the Punisher, which he and his former colleagues use either in saving people or for complete destruction. After showing potential in the orphanage in which he was raised, Chapel trained and modified him, giving him enhanced abilities and the ability to regenerate from heavy injuries using special vials. He was given a special large cross-shaped gun called the Punisher, which contains two machine guns and a rocket launcher. Wolfwood is found nearly dead in the desert by protagonist [Vash the Stampede](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash

name: Tomoe
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6’3”)

Tomoe is a familiar to the last land god, [Mikage](https://anilist.co/character/37871/Mikage). Currently he is the familiar of [Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) and sealed their contract with a kiss. He shows a wonderful talent for cooking and is shown to be highly dedicated to the shrine. Tomoe worries a great deal about Nanami and is very aware of how delicate she is as a human, threatening anyone who harms her or speaks ill of her. It is often implied that he loves Nanami, such as doing random acts of kindness for her and refusing to kil

name: Nanami Momozono
description:
__Species:__ Human / God
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

A teenage girl whose father ran out on her because of his gambling debts, she was often mocked for her poverty by her classmates.

She becomes the local land god after former god [Mikage](https://anilist.co/character/37871/Mikage) transfers his position as master of the shrine over to Nanami. She begins with very little spiritual power, but works hard at balancing her godly duties with her schoolwork. Nanami is often upset when [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/18344/Tomoe) flirts with other women. Tomoe always puts Shiitake mushrooms in N

name: Unmei
aliases: Cosette Schneider (コゼット・シュナイダー)
description:
L.V. Beethoven "Symphony No. 5 in C minor Op.67"

She is a Musicart who carries "Destiny" in her body. Despite her ladylike appearance, her facial expressions rarely change and her tone of voice is always calm and polite. At first glance, she looks pretty, but she has an unconventional personality, with a sharp tongue and a sweet tooth. She and her partner, the conductor [Takt](https://anilist.co/character/234535), have a deep and long past together.

Cosette used to take care of Takt in his childhood. One day during Symphonica Party, Cosette suggests Takt to play the piano to make his debut a

name: Takt Asahina
description:
A conductor who made a contract with the Musicart "Unmei." He has the idea that "music is prioritized in everything."

(Source: Official Site, translated)

His father was Kenji Asahina, a famous conductor killed in the Boston tragedy incident.

name: Anna Schneider
native: アンナ・シュナイダー
description:
A girl who is a childhood friend of Takt and a fateful "sister". She has a cheerful and caring personality.

(Source: Official site, translated)

name: Iruma Suzuki
description:
__Rank:__ As of now in the Manga, Iruma achieved Rank [5] *He*.
__Familiars:__ His very first and only familiar is a demon named [Callego Naberius](https://anilist.co/character/135021/Callego--Naberius), whom he managed to summon in the form of a flying owl in episode 2 of the series.

A human boy whose parents sold him to a demon named [Sullivan](https://anilist.co/character/135023), who subsequently transports him to the Demon World and adopts him as his grandson. He starts his new life by being enrolled into Babyls Demon School, where he constantly has to hide the fact that he is a human in

Clara is one of the stranger students at the school, acting very much like an excited child. She has abundant energy that most students can't keep up with. Other students find her weird and hard to deal with, but are drawn to her because her
