name: Karen Kohiruimaki
description:
__Height:__ 183cm (6'0")

Karen is a female college student who has a complex about her tall figure and has a poor social disposition because of it. In Gun Gale Online, she obtains a dream "chibi" avatar less than 150 centimeters in height that dons a full-body pink uniform.

She has excellent agility and specializes in close-range combat that utilizes her speed. She loves cute things, and all of her equipment is pink. Her main arm is P90 and she calls it "P-Chan".

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online

name: Goushi Asougi
description:
A male player who is Pitohui's acquaintance and longtime friend. Asougi Goushi, known as M in Gun Gale Online, is one of the main characters of the Sword Art Online Alternative "Gun Gale Online" spin-off series.

He is a giant man, over 190 centimeters tall, and is good at medium to long-range combat, and is especially good at sniping. He is calm, has excellent strategy planning skills, and serves as the team's staff officer.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online

name: Miyu Shinohara
description:
Shinohara Miyu, known as Fukaziroh in ALfheim Online and Gun Gale Online, is one of the main characters in the Gun Gale Online spin-off series. She is a long-time friend of Kohiruimaki Karen from her hometown Hokkaido in the real world. She plays ALfheim Online as a Sylph but occasionally converts her account to Gun Gale Online to participate in Squad Jam tournaments.

Taking advantage of her high strength, she fights with two six-barreled grenade launchers in GGO.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online

name: Pitohui
description:
A tall beautiful woman with a tattoo on her cheek, Pitohui is a player in Gun Gale Online and LLENN's first friend in the game. She is a veteran GGO player and is a mysterious person whose only secret is that she is a gun enthusiast who uses a different gun every time she plays.

It is later revealed that her real name is Kanzaki Erza.

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online

name: Sucy Manbavaran
native: スーシィ・マンババラン
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__School:__ Luna Nova Magical Academy
__Occupation:__ Witch Student

Sucy is an aloof, calm, sarcastic, and somewhat sadistic person. She also surprisingly remains indifferent in various situations and things that drive the other girls crazy, which shows that she is calmer than her roommates.

name: Lotte Jansson
description:
**Height:** 156 cm

Lotte is shy, calm and timid, rarely ever getting angry. She is a kind-hearted girl who earnestly looks after [Akko](https://anilist.co/character/81645/Kagari-Atsuko). Lotte is often concerned about Akko, given that her determination to become a witch like [Shiny Chariot](https://anilist.co/character/81717/du-Nord-Chariot) sometimes makes her go too far, and that she would forget the well-being of friends and people who wish to help her.

name: Atsuko Kagari
description:
__School::__ Luna Nova Magical Academy
__Occupation:__ Witch Student

The main protagonist, an energetic and optimistic girl who attends Luna Nova after being inspired by the witch [Shiny Chariot](https://anilist.co/character/81717/du-Nord-Chariot). Having come from a non-magical background, she struggles using magic much of the time, and is disappointed by the mundanity of her classes as opposed to Chariot's more spectacular performances. However, her strong sense of self-confidence enables her to wield Chariot's Shiny Rod, which accepts her as its new master.

name: Yuuichi Katagiri
description:
Yuuichi Katagiri is a hardworking lad who believes friends are more important than money. In reality, he is a dead broke student with multiple part-time jobs. In secret, he is "the mind" of the team, and often, even when things seem dire, Yuuichi manages to swing the odds to his favor with every ounce of his might. His past is heavy--and often, for it, he is called a "devil" and considered dangerous.

 In Chapter 99, it is revealed that Katagiri Yuuichi is the one who created the prototype for the "Tomodachi Game".

name: Yutori Kokorogi
description:
A shy girl who used to get bullied in primary school that participated in Tomodachi Game alongside her friends. She is considered to be weak and helpless so she is oftenly used by Yuuichi Katagiri in order for his plans to succeed.

Is one of the traitors of group C

She has a second personality that she keeps deeply hidden from her friends is dark and twisted. Yutori has no qualms about hitting her own mother and is actually very rich, though it is unknown where she gets most of her money from. Yutori is an unstable person as she is insanely obsessed with Yuuichi, even using her own money and

name: Makoto Shibe
description: A somewhat idiotic guy who comes from a rich family and has an obvious crush on Shiho Sawaragi. He participated in the Tomodachi Game alongside his friends.

name: Shiho Sawaragi
description: A solemn female student that is respected by her classmates for her hard working and serious nature. She participated in Tomodachi Game alongside her friends.

name: Tenji Mikasa
description: A strategist/genius with grades at the top of his class who participated in Tomodachi Game alongside his friends.

name: Mari Tamaki
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1)

A second-year high school student a sunny disposition. Although she has a great attitude and is admired by her friends, she is not good at finding a place in their midst or being a leader. In spite of being filled with curiosity, she is also rather cowardly and timid. She is troubled by the dilemma that although part of her wants to do things, another part of her just ends up not doing them.

(Source: Anime News Network)

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Shirase Kobuchizawa
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'5)

A second-year high school student who attends the same school as [Kimari](https://anilist.co/character/124545/Tamaki-Mari). She is a black-haired beauty that turns heads, but she is shy and not good at conversation. When she actually does speak, she can't help but say rather nasty things, which leads to misunderstandings. She has few friends and is treated as an oddball at school. At school, she is secretly called "Antarctica."

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Hinata Miyake
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9)

A girl brimming with curiosity and always looking for fun things to do. She is very friendly and can get along well with everyone. 

Since childhood, she has been a leader who has always willingly taken on roles of responsibility, such as class committee and club leader. However, she quit high school because of something that happened and is now working part-time at a convenience store.

(Source: Anime News Network)

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Yuzuki Shiraishi
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0)

A girl who is one grade lower than [Kimari](https://anilist.co/character/124545/Tamaki-Mari) and the others. She lives in Hokkaido. She has been an actress since childhood, and she now works as an entertainer while attending high school. She shows maturity and is a good speaker with polite manners. She is concerned that because of always working, she is unable to make close friends.

appearsIn.title: A Place Further Than the Universe

name: Nadeshiko Kagamihara
description: A member of the outdoor crew at high school, she’s drawn into camping when she meets [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/124586/Shima-Rin) at a lake shore. She’s always cheerful and positive and loves anything fun.

name: Aoi Inuyama
description:
A gentle girl who speaks with a Kansai accent. Of the reckless outdoor crew members, Aoi is like the secret leader who looks out for everyone during important times. She’s called 'Inuko' by [Chiaki](https://anilist.co/character/124578).

(Source: Honey's Anime)

name: Chiaki Oogaki
description:
A bright and active person, in charge of choosing the camping spots and gear. She’s lively and cheerful, but is also full of emotion and easily brought to tears. Wanting to camp, she forms the outdoor crew with [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/124577).

(Source: Honey's Anime)

name: Ena Saitou
description: Rin’s friend, a free spirited person who goes at her own pace. She’s not a member of the outdoor crew, but she occasionally shows interest in their activities. She also gives casual advice to Rin, who is bad at dealing with people. She has a dog called 'Chikuwa.'

name: Rin Shima
description: A solo camper who started camping due to her grandfather’s influence. She experiences camping with another person for the first time when she meets [Nadeshiko](https://anilist.co/character/124576/Kagamihara-Nadeshiko). She’s not a member of the outdoor crew, but she worries about Nadeshiko a bit.

name: Sena Kashiwazaki
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5")

Sena Kashiwazaki is the female tritagonist of the Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai series. She is the first recruited member of the Neighbor's Club and the daughter of Tenma Kashiwazaki, headmaster of St. Chronica's Academy. Her wealth, beauty, and outstanding academic and athletic performance have made her popular among male students, and likewise, have made her an outcast among girls. Starting from high school, Sena continuously took first place in all tests, exams, and competitions. A year prior to the start of the story, Sena in her freshman year of high school, won

name: Yozora Mikazuki
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

Yozora Mikazuki is the founder, first member, and club president of the Neighbor's Club. Prideful and easily provoked by nature, Yozora detests "normals" and that is the reason why Yozora doesn't have any friends along with the fact that she's a natural loner. She also preferred to have an "air friend", whom she calls "Tomo-chan" but decided to make a club to make friends. She is a cruel and selfish black-haired girl who says she understands and respects bullying but resents being called a bully herself. Yozora's difficult personality drives away anyone who might wis

name: Kodaka Hasegawa
description: Kodaka is a transfer student who has not been able to make friends in his first month at St, Chronica's. Of all of the members of the club, he is the most gentle, balanced and socially competent in personality; but his unusual hair color, inherited from his late English mother, leads classmates to assume he is a violent and abusive delinquent and spread defamatory rumors about him. Because of his long experience of antagonism, Kodaka has become accustomed to fighting and can defend himself quite well. His father is working in the United States, and so he takes care of his younger sister alone

name: Ilulu
description:
Ilulu is a female dragon who belongs to the Chaos Faction. Originally, she came to [Kobayashi's](https://anilist.co/character/120969) world to destroy [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) and then tries to drive Kobayashi away from Tohru. After a change of heart, she begins to live with Kobayashi as her third dragon resident.

She has a caring personality and loves children. Later on, her personality leads her to taking over the running of a candy store from an old lady, who's looking for her replacement.

name: Akari Watanabe
description: Akari Watanabe is a Gyaru who was assigned to be [Jirou Yakuin's](https://anilist.co/character/191673) partner during the marriage practical, a special course to train students how to function in a real romantic relationship, despite her wanting to be partnered with [Minami Tenjin](https://anilist.co/character/273110/Minami-Tenjin), her true fool love. She hopes by training by acting as a perfect newlywed with Jirou, she can earn the two of them enough points to swap each other out for who they truly want to pursue. However, after spending more time with Jirou, she begins to second guess herse

appearsIn.title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.

name: Jirou Yakuin
description:
__Relatives:__ Himari and Leo (Younger Cousins).

Jirou Yakuin is the main protagonist, being an antisocial, pessimistic high school boy. He ends up forced to pair with [Akari Watanabe](https://anilist.co/character/191672) in their school's "Couple Practical" course, despite harboring feelings for his childhood friend [Shiori Sakurazaka](https://anilist.co/character/273105). Because of his crush, he makes it his goal to find a way to pair up with Shiori instead, being willing to do anything to reach his goal even if it means acting as a newlywed with Akari. However, the more time he spends wit

appearsIn.title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.

name: Shiori Sakurazaka
description:
Shiori is [Jirou Yakuin's](https://anilist.co/character/191673/Jirou-Yakuin) classmate and childhood friend (and crush). She was paired with [Minami Tenjin](https://anilist.co/character/273110/Minami-Tenjin) in their school's couples training.

She is a kind and gentle girl, but she isn't very confident in herself and has a shy demeanor. Shiori is academically intelligent and regularly scores high marks on her exams, although she is known to struggle athletically. She is especially bad at talking to boys she doesn't know due to past experiences she had in middle school, but is known to be very

appearsIn.title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.

name: Sadaharu Kamo
description:
__Relatives:__ Keiichiro Kamo (Older Brother).

Sadaharu is a close friend of [Jirou Yakuin](https://anilist.co/character/191673/Jirou-Yakuin), being one of the few people Jirou is comfortable being open around. He is paired with Satsuki Kaneyama in their school's Marriage Practical.

Sadaharu is portrayed as being a mild mannered and eccentric otaku who enjoys reading manga, watching anime, and playing video games. Like Jirou, Sadaharu also has lousy luck with women, preferring the women to be "2D" instead of real so they can't end up hurting his feelings. However, it appears that he and his

appearsIn.title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.

name: Minami Tenjin
description:
Considered to be the most popular student at Seishun Academy, Minami Tenjin is [Shiori Sakurazaka's](https://anilist.co/character/273105) partner in the Marriage Practical and [Akari Watanabe's](https://anilist.co/character/191672) crush. He works at a café together with [Shuu Terafune](https://anilist.co/character/286620) and Keiichiro Kamo.

What makes Minami so admirable are the numerous amounts of traits and skills that he has that would make other boys jealous. He is a star athlete who is proficient in multiple sports including basketball, volleyball, and track-and-field, on top of him be

appearsIn.title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
More Than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.

name: Isuzu Sento
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

A royal guard who carries a magical muzzle-loader infused into her body, named Steinberger, who forces [Seiya Kanie](https://anilist.co/character/87971/Kanie-Seiya) to go on a "date" with her to Amagi Brilliant Park.

She has a stoic personality and rarely shows emotion, finding it difficult to smile or understand the jokes of others. Her upbringing as a royal guard resulted in a tendency to quickly resort to violence by threatening others or inflicting non-lethal damage to them with Steinberger. Behind her mask of stoicism and violence, she is actually quite sensiti

name: Seiya Kanie
description:
Seiya is a perfectionist high school student who is mentally sharp, intelligent, has excellent reflexes, and acts like a prince to the point of being a narcissist, much to the annoyance of others. 

He was involved with the entertainment industry as a child, bearing the stage name Seiya Kodama. According to [Isuzu](https://anilist.co/character/87970/Sento-Isuzu), he was a child who would have made every adult/parent proud.

name: Latifa Fleuranza
native: ラティファ・フルーランザ
description:
The princess and ruler of Amagi Brilliant Park. She is a very cheerful and positive girl often seen with a smile on her face. She cares deeply about the amusement park as she is seen being concerned about the future of the amusement park and willing to do anything in order to preserve it. 

Years ago, she was saved by a wizard who had been promised her in marriage. However, the King (Latifa's father) refused to keep his end of the bargain and tried to have the wizard executed. In revenge the wizard cursed Latifa with a spell that gradually removes her animus; a magical substance that all creat

name: Moffle
description: A fairy of candies with the form of a mouse with a hat and Amagi Brilliant Park's main mascot who takes a mutual disliking towards Seiya. He is Latifah's uncle. His appearance resembles Bonta-kun, the fictional mascot from Full Metal Panic? Fumoffu.

name: Himiko
description:
She has a crush on [Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/49657/Sakamoto-Ryouta) and cooperates with him in the Btooom! game. 

Himiko always carried a stun gun where ever she goes because she is afraid of being touched by men. Yoshioka-senpai and [Mitsuo](https://anilist.co/character/84457/Akechi-Mitsuo) Akechi have both tried to rape her, eventually resulting in her fear for men, and she said that every man on the island is her enemy. However, she slightly changed her opinion, as she realized that Sakamoto is the only one on the island whom she could trust.

name: Ryouta Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm  
__Players Data:__ No.1  
__Works:__ None 
 __Home:__ Tokyo  
__Bim Type:__ Timer type  

Ryōta Sakamoto (坂本・竜太 Sakamoto Ryōta) is the protagonist of the manga Btooom!. He is one of the top ranking players of the Btooom! game and is the best player on Japan. He is ranked #10 worldwide. He has been nominated to participate in the real life Btooom! game.  He is a regular guy in his twenties. He is of average height and weight. He has light brown hair and brown eyes. He wears a dark gray, buttoned shirt and regular black pants. He also wears a black belt. As any other Btooom!

name: Ippanjin
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

She was just a regular girl, born in a regular family, worked like everyone else, and was leading a simple life. One misfortune after another got her involved in the crimes of Akudama. She’s a kind of person who doesn't get depressed, and she deals with problems optimistically.

name: Hakobiya
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 745 years

Courier grew up being forced to transport things by adults. He has confidence in his work and is somewhat of a workaholic. He doesn't speak often, but when he does, he has the right words for the situation. He has a habit of clicking his tongue, and his favorite food is takoyaki.

name: Kenkaya
description:
__Height:__ 200 cm
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 348 years

The Brawler is pure and straightforward. He believes that power is everything and doesn't care if he dies as long as he can fight strong enemies. He often fist bumps people and his favorite food is meat.

name: Hacker
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Weight:__ 47 kg
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 589 years 

The Hacker is more excited the more difficult something is, but is completely apathetic to things he's uninterested in. He likes healthy jelly drinks.

name: Isha
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 432 years

The Doctor is a mad scientist who toys with people's lives for fun. She has a calm demeanor and speaks philosophically. She has a habit of messing with her nails, and her favorite foods are wine and cheese.

name: Chinpira
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Estimated Prison Sentence:__ 4 years

Chinpira is greedy and is involved with crimes for money. He tries to act bold, but ultimately, he's a coward who believes that "if you can't beat them, join them." However, thanks to his weakness, he can show consideration to his comrades. He's a pathological liar and likes ramen.

name: Satsujinki
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

An Akudama. His estimated prison sentence is 967 years.

Cutthroat's hobby is murder. Paradoxically, his usual behavior is innocent and almost childlike. He becomes unable to control his murderous impulses under certain conditions, especially when he sees the color red. Just simply seeing the color red makes him excited to the point of childlike giddiness. His favorite food is marshmallows and he has an extreme infatuation with [Swindler](https://anilist.co/character/163011/Ippanjin).

name: Kuroneko
description:
The mysterious employer of the Akudama who speaks through a robotic black cat. They enlist the Akudama to rescue [Cutthroat](https://anilist.co/character/163013/Satsujinki) and later hijack the Shinkansen.

They are later revealed to be an immortal boy attempting to—alongside his [sister](https://anilist.co/character/196158/Imouto)—escape their fates as vessels to maintain the Kanto supercomputer.

name: Imouto
description: A mysterious girl. She is quiet, with little self-assertion. She tends to hide behind her [brother](https://anilist.co/character/188625/Kuroneko).

name: Haru Katou
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Haru is a member of the Modern Crime Prevention Task Force's Metropolitan Police Department. He is a hot-blooded humanistic detective who hates dishonesty and bending. Originally, he belonged to Investigation Division 1 as a promising rookie, but after a siege incident where he misfired and the target was seriously injured, he was dropped from the division and moved to the current headquarters he's in at the start of the series.

name: Daisuke Kanbe
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

Daisuke is a scion of the millionaire Kambe family. Utilizing abundant financial resources and the latest technology, he solves various cases in a semi-aggressive manner. He becomes a member of the Metropolitan Police Department's Modern Crime Prevention Task Force, and forms buddies with [Haru Kato](https://anilist.co/character/158385/Katou-Haru). However, he seems to have no ear to hear what Kato says.

name: Prushka
description:
__Species__: Human

Prushka is the adoptive daughter of the White Whistle Delver [Bondrewd](https://anilist.co/character/122463/Bondrewd). She lives with him at the Forward Operation Base.

Prushka is a cheerful and amiable girl who loves her adoptive father very much. She is incredibly devoted to him and would do anything to help him, holding him in higher regard than anyone else. Having lived the majority of her life in the 5th layer, she developed a strong curiosity for exploring and was fascinated by tales of others' travels through the Abyss. She is adventurous and quite brave, going on h

appearsIn.title: Made in Abyss: Dawn of the Deep Soul
Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun

name: Ryouta Kise
description:
**Height:** 189 cm (6'2")
**School:** Teiko, Kaijou High
**Number:** #8 (Teiko), #7 (Kaijou)
**Position:** Small Forward
**Talent:** Copy

Now a freshman at Kaijou High, Kise was the rookie of the "Generation of Miracles". Since he only started playing basketball in his second year of middle school, Kise was his team's least experienced member, and notes himself the weakest of the five.

Kise's unique skill is his ability to mimic the moves and plays of other players. The only moves he cannot copy are the special skills of truly exceptional players, like the other members of the "Generation of

name: Miko Yotsuya
description:
__Height:__ 160cm
__Family:__ [Mamoru Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/250703/Mamoru-Yotsuya) (Father), [Touko Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/199025/Touko-Yotsuya) (Mother), [Kyousuke Yotsuya](https://anilist.co/character/199026/Kyousuke-Yotsuya) (Younger Brother)

Miko has the ability to see frightening supernatural things that most people can't, but she pretends that she can't see them to avoid conflict. Her Spiritual-Awareness power overpowers her sight, like the reflection in glass is overpowering and you're unable to see what lies beyond it.

She tries to have a stoic exterior

name: Hana Yurikawa
description:
__Height:__ 156cm

[Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) close friend. She is clueless of the supernatural terrors that afflict her friend, but she does unknowingly attract a lot of them due to her unusual amount of life energy.

name: Yulia Niguredou
description:
__Height:__ 140cm

An aspiring spirit medium who believes she's somewhat special because she has the power to see spirits. However, she doesn't know that she can only see lesser spirits, and misinterprets [Miko's](https://anilist.co/character/139631) attempts to protect her from the greater dangers she cannot see as acts of malice.

name: Matahachi Honiden
description: Hedonist and childhood friend of Musashi. Assumes Sasaki Kojiro's identity after a dying Tenki entrusts Kojiro's swordsmanship certificates to him. Later, after coming into contact with the genuine Kojiro, begins to identify himself as Sasaki Koujiro, an interpreter for Kojiro, the real Kojiro being deaf. He later becomes estranged from Musashi after a tense reunion, Matahachi displaying an intense jealousy to Musashi. He was an illegitimate son of a mistress and the previous head of the Hon'iden bloodline, he was born shortly before his father died. The wife of the former head Osugi Honiden a

name: Musashi Miyamoto
description: Miyamoto Musashi or Shinmen Takezo (his real name), only at a very young age, embarked on a journey to become the strongest samurai only after being exiled from his own village. Musashi is the son of a samurai family, whose father is one of the most renowned samurai across the nation. One of the foremost reasons that drive Musashi to excel in sword-fighting, is his desire to overcome his father for all the harsh treatment given during his childhood and Musashi's incapability to rebel. Musashi is unique in terms of his sword skill for the unfamiliar movements and lack of style he uses. This is

name: Kojirou Sasaki
description:
The legendary archrival of [Musashi Miyamoto](https://anilist.co/character/6194/Miyamoto-Musashi).

Raised by [Kanemaki Jisai](https://anilist.co/character/25810/Kanemaki-Jisai), after he is found as a baby in casket, floating on the ocean. He develops an intense attachment to swords and fencing at an early age, possessing an almost preternatural ability to react to his opponents' moves. Kojirou is deaf and mute, though still literate. His personality is very playful, almost child-like. [Ittousai](https://anilist.co/character/24309/Itou-Ittousai) has also commented on the possibility that Koji

name: Kotoko Iwanaga
description:
Kotoko is the main female protagonist in Kyokou Suiri and the current girlfriend of [Kuro Sakuragawa](https://anilist.co/character/125947/Kurou-Sakuragawa).

She has a very outgoing personality and always makes an effort to find the root of any problem, especially when she has the help of yokai. She is oblivious to danger and she tends to be very clingy when it comes to Kuro. Kotoko is a self-centered, unrepentant prankster, who enjoys poking fun at others expense, and is also a bit of a pervert. She is also shown to have a rather childish demeanor whenever she feels she is not given enough at

name: Kurou Sakuragawa
description:
Kuro is the main male protagonist of Kyokou Suiri (In/Spectre) and the current boyfriend of [Kotoko Iwanaga](https://anilist.co/character/125946). He has supernatural powers of immortality and precognition.

Kuro is quiet and tends to be very nonconfrontational, barely even taking notice of his own injuries. He is uncaring about his own safety due to his healing abilities.

name: Basara Toujou
description: Toujou Basara is an ex-member of the Hero-clan. He lives with his two step sisters who are both Demons. Basara is determined no matter what to protect [Naruse](https://anilist.co/character/89158/Naruse-Mio) from anyone wanting to cause harm to her.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Mio Naruse
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Mio is a beautiful young girl of average height, with long waist-length red hair and violet eyes. She is noted for having a distinctly voluptuous body for someone her age. Mio has been seen wearing a number of outfits throughout the series, with several casual attires at home that are usually form-fitting or revealing, as well as a uniform for attending school. After forming a contract with [Basara](https://anilist.co/character/89157/Toujou-Basara), Mio gains a choker-like tattoo around her throat which takes the appearance of a love heart with two prongs extending around e

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Yuki Nonaka
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

Yuki is a member of the Hero Clan who watches over Mio Naruse. She is also Basara's childhood friend.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Maria Naruse
description:
Maria is Mio's sister and guardian.

She is a rather childish person and likes teasing people no matter how serious the situation is. Despite this, she can be dead serious as seen when she revealed her real identity to Basara.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Kurumi Nonaka
description:
A Hero and the sister of [Yuki Nonaka](https://anilist.co/character/89159/Nonaka-Yuki). She is also an Element Master.

Kurumi is a petite, young girl who is surprisingly developed for her age. She has blue violet hair held up in a ponytail by a white scrunchy and yellow eyes like her sister. Her battle outfit tightly wraps around her slim figure and is the typical attire for female Heroes which is a navy blue leotard with a black collar and a white skirt. Kurumi chooses to wear short tights underneath and her limbs are covered by her Spirit Armor with her Spirit Gauntlet on her left hand.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Zest
description: Zest is a Demon who originally served her creator, the Demon marquis Zolgear, as his aide.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Chisato Hasegawa
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Chisato Hasegawa is the school nurse of Hijirigasaka Academy and a magic user. Originally she is one of the Ten Gods from the divine realm. At first, she acts as Basara's mentor often providing him with advice. Eventually, they develop a romantic relationship.

appearsIn.title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
The Testament of Sister New Devil BURST

name: Anna Yamada
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'8")
__Occupation:__ Middle School Student (Second Year)

Yamada Anna is the main heroine of the story and is the classmate and love interest of [Ichikawa Kyoutarou](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa). She is also an airhead who is pretty and very immature besides her looks.

She is a magazine model and actress. She is very popular with both boys and girls but has a clumsy side to her. Anna frequently snacks in the library, much to Kyoutarou's dismay. She is also shown to be very jealous to the point of obsession whenever Kyoutarou interacts with other

appearsIn.title: The Dangers in My Heart Season 2

name: Kyoutarou Ichikawa
description:
__Height:__ 156.5 cm (5'2")
__Occupation:__ Middle School Student (Second Year)
__Twitter:__ https://twitter.com/thanatos_moros

Ichikawa is the protagonist of the story Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu and a classmate of  [Yamada Anna](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada). He at the beginning of the manga is a gloomy, antisocial, sadistic boy and eager to kill his classmates, but in reality he is a kind boy with an incredibly low self-esteem, reaching the point where he believes that the people feel disgusted with the simple fact of being by his side, but the only person who does not

appearsIn.title: The Dangers in My Heart Season 2

name: Xylo Forbartz
native: ザイロ・フォルバーツ
description: The former captain of the Federated Kingdom's Fifth Order of the Holy Knights and the now de facto leader of Penal Hero Unit 9004. He was sentenced to be a hero for the crime of killing the goddess [Senerva](https://anilist.co/character/387992/Senerva). He would later meet and reluctantly make a contract with [Teoritta](https://anilist.co/character/355726), the "Goddess of Swords".

name: Teoritta
description: The Sword Goddess who made a contract with [Xylo](https://anilist.co/character/355722/Xylo-Forbartz). She summons numerous swords, including holy swords and demon swords. While possessing a high sense of self-worth and a fondness for being praised, she also exhibits a characteristic goddess-like trait of engaging in self-sacrificing actions.

name: Phosphophyllite
native: フォスフォフィライト
description:
**Hardness**: 3.5 (legs: 7; head: 5)

The main protagonist and the youngest gem when the story began. They're weak, brittle - not suited for battle - and their clumsiness makes them difficult to maintain any roles, even though they've always wanted to be useful. Phos' initial job was to make a natural history encyclopedia which they progressed very little on. They promised to help [Cinnabar](https://anilist.co/character/123384/Cinnabar) find a job suited for them as well.

Phos is a young, overconfident, clumsy, and naive gem, who is the only one capable of getting away with talking back to [K

name: Tatsu
description: An ex-yakuza who now lives peacefully as a househusband.

name: Akane Mizuno
description:
Student of class 3-1 who belongs to the track and field club. She's an easy going character, but can be self-conscious and timid at times. When feeling nervous, she would squeeze her potato mascot plushie. Akane moved to Kawagoe, Saitama when she was a fifth grader in Primary school. She secretly starts dating Kotarō, but later reveals this to Chinatsu and Takumi, who inform the class about that.

When she is forced to move to Chiba due to her father's work, she becomes anxious over her future relationship with Kotarō, but cheers him on as he tries to get into the same school as her. When Kota

name: Kotarou Azumi
description: Student of class 3-1 who belongs to the literature club. He's aiming to become a novelist and is inspired by Osamu Dazai & Natsume Soseki who are both Japanese novelists. He generally has a calm and composed attitude. He initially is too embarrassed to show his novels to other people, but upon learning Akane's love for running and openness to use embarrassment as a method of improving oneself, he begins to open up to that prospect. From early childhood, Kotarou has received instruction in the performance of traditional dance and festival music accompaniment, Hayashi, at a local Shinto shrine.

name: Kurama
description:
Kurama is first encountered in the series at the same time as Hiei. His ability is in manipulating plants, and he generally wields a whip created from a rose vine, complete with thorns. He is one of the wiser characters in the series and the smartest and calmest of the four main characters.

Kurama is generally regarded as the most calm and level-headed member of the group. His analytical nature is present in battle where he prefers to study the strengths and weaknesses of his opponents before devising a strategy of his own.  He is protective of those he cares about and is often merciless to a

name: Hiei
description:
Hiei is a main character in Yu Yu Hakusho, a demon who prefers to keep his distance from others. Because of this he often comes across as aloof and elusive. He has a rather cynical and even misanthropic view of the world around him, often belittling and mocking humans and their emotions and the significance they place on friendship and life.

Hiei is the shortest of the four main characters at only 147 cm (4'10) during the Dark Tournament as stated by [Juri](https://anilist.co/character/8717/). Despite his short size, he has a lean, muscular build to him. He wears a white headband that conceal

name: Kazuma Kuwabara
description: Kuwabara, as most people call him, is the second-toughest kid in Sarayashiki Junior High School and is always trying to usurp [Yusuke Urameshi](https://anilist.co/character/729/Urameshi-Yuusuke)'s position as the toughest. In the manga(chp.1) he says he never lost a fight until he met Yusuke. He leads a gang consisting of himself, [Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/9591/Kirishima), [Okubo](https://anilist.co/character/8641/Okubo), and [Sawamura](https://anilist.co/character/8640/Sawamura) (In the English dub, Komada). He has a soft spot for kittens (including his own, Eikichi) and an iro

name: Yuusuke Urameshi
description:
The main protagonist of the manga and anime series YuYu Hakusho.

He is a Spirit Detective who is tasked with protecting the Human World from various supernatural threats over the course of the series and his closest friends, as well as greatest allies, include [Kuwabara](https://anilist.co/character/730/Kuwabara-Kazuma), [Kurama](https://anilist.co/character/731/Kurama), [Hiei](https://anilist.co/character/732/Hiei), [Keiko](https://anilist.co/character/733/Yukimura-Keiko), [Genkai](https://anilist.co/character/735/Genkai), [Koenma](https://anilist.co/character/2305/Koenma) and [Botan](https:

name: Alas Ramus
description:
Alas Ramus is the appointed daughter of Sadao Maou and Emi Yusa. 

She is a fragment of Yesod, one of the elements of Sephiroth.

appearsIn.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer! Season 2

name: Vincent Law
description:
An immigrant from Mosko working for Romdo's AutoReiv Control Division within the Temporary Immigrant Sector FG set up to hunt and dispose infected AutoReivs. Vincent appears driven to become a Model Citizen, but ultimately fails to suppress the burden of his traumatic past and flees from Romdo. He has a romantic interest in [Re-l Mayer](https://anilist.co/character/643/Mayer-Rel).

Vincent is a personality created after Ergo Proxy gave his memories to the Memory Guardian, [Amnesia](https://anilist.co/character/10624/Amnesia).

name: Re-l Mayer
description:
Embodiment of the no-nonsense personality, Inspector Re-l Mayer of the Citizen Intelligence Bureau is in charge of investigating a series of brutal murders apparently committed by AutoReivs infected with the Cogito virus. She is also the granddaughter of Donov Mayer, the Regent of Romdo. Given her privileged status, she expects respect from people around her, and speaks as such (she addresses Vincent as "o-mae"). 

Re-l accompanies Vincent on his journey in order to learn more about the mysterious Proxies, but having been living in comfortable conditions and being spoilt by Iggy all her life,

name: Pino
description: An infected Companion AutoReiv with a bubbly personality, she was owned by Raul Creed and Samantha Ross, Pino served as a surrogate child to the couple (in fact, in episode 19, everyone in the smile land gets so shocked that she is able to smile so "naturally", which is reasonable since she is "infected" with a soul. With the humanity within her, she then proceeds, under the request of all the friends she made in Smile Land, to save Smile Land from impending destruction upon Vincent's arrival). She was scheduled for decommissioning after the Creeds were granted a real baby son by the governmen

name: Takeo Gouda
description: The protagonist of the story and a first-year student at Shuei High School. He is very tall and muscular, with a face that easily scares those around him. He scares many women but is very popular with many men, but Takeo is actually extremely kind and selfless, quickly helping others without a second thought throughout the story.

name: Rinko Yamato
description: A girl whom [Takeo](https://anilist.co/character/80757/Gouda-Takeo) saves from a molester on a train. After Takeo saves her, she immediately falls in love with him. She attends Koizumi Girls’ Academy and is very skilled in making sweets.

name: Makoto Sunakawa
description: Next door neighbor and childhood friend of Takeo, as well as his classmate. Because Makoto is so handsome, all of the girls Takeo liked ended up falling in love with Makoto instead. Makoto is always watching out for Takeo and is willing to sacrifice his own happiness for his friend.

name: William Moriarty
native: ウィリアム・ジェームズ・モリアーティ
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Hometown:__ East End

A noble, a mathematics professor and the antiheroic protagonist of the manga. He is a genius who attempts to overthrow evil nobles and destroy the class system that has caused misery and pain to the poor everywhere.

He and his brother were orphans who were adopted by [Albert Moriarty](https://anilist.co/character/151489/Moriarty-James-Albert) after noticing his capabilities and his ideals of overthrowing the evil nobility. At Albert's request, he concocts a plan to kill the remaining members of the family and make it look like an accident. Aft

name: Sherlock Holmes
native: シャーロック・ホームズ
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Hometown:__ North Riding, Yorkshire

He is the antagonist to Moriarty and also the figure around which Moriarty's plan revolves. He enjoys puzzles, is a violin player, has a prodigious observational skill, well-versed in hand-to-hand combat and has a machiavellian attitude when it comes to something he wants. He is a detective consultant and can be considered an intellectual match and rival to Moriarty himself.

name: Louis Moriarty
native: ルイス・ジェームズ・モリアーティ
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6')
__Hometown:__ East End

William's younger brother. When young, he was often very ill, but was later treated after moving in with the Moriarty family. Louis often serves as the family butler, despite being a nobleman.

name: Albert Moriarty
native: アルバート・ジェームズ・モリアーティ
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")
__Hometown:__ London

The eldest son of the Moriarty family.

name: Claudia Enfield
native: クローディア・エンフィールド
description: Claudia is the second highest ranking student of Seidoukan Academy and its Student Council President. She recommended [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/89058)'s transfer to the academy. She has held the position of President since junior high.

name: Saya Sasamiya
description: Saya is Ayato's childhood friend. She moved abroad six years ago due to her father's career. She seems to be an air-headed stoic who has trouble waking up in the morning and is directionally-challenged. She uses a 38th generation Lux grenade launcher Helnekrom but later switches to a type 41 Gleaming Form - twin particle guns Waidenholt and Type 34 wave Motion heavy artillery Ark Van Ders for the Phoenix. Like Kirin, she enters the Phoenix for her father's sake.

name: Kirin Toudou
description: Kirin is the top-ranking student of Seidoukan Academy. She is a shy and quiet girl who becomes the academy's top student as a 13 year-old and has not lost to anyone until Ayato challenges her a second time. She does not have a personal lux but rather carries a katana (Senbakiri) around as a weapon which often makes her greatly marveled by others as she tops the former No. 1 spot just by using a katana.

name: Ayato Amagiri
description:
He transfers to Seidoukan Academy to investigate his sister's disappearance and to figure out what he is supposed to do (he later says that it is to protect Julis). 
Ayato sports a friendly, polite, and helpful personality with a penchant for ending up in awkward situations. He is indiscriminate as to who he is being friendly to and is helpful to a fault, as well as being a bit naive. However, underneath the soft facade lies a person with an indomitable will who always tries to do the right thing, regardless of the potential trouble that he will get himself into.

name: Julis Alexia von Riessfeld
native: ユリス＝アレクシア・フォン・リースフェルト
description:
Julis is the fifth ranking student of Seidoukan Academy and is Lieseltania's First Princess. Her full name is Julis-Alexia Marie Florentia Renate von Riessfelt. She wields a rapier-type lux called Aspera Spina which she uses during the Phoenix tournament and bears the image of a flower for her power - control over flames.

She warms to [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/89058/Amagiri-Ayato), unlike the other students with whom she is distant. She starts to like Ayato and often find herself arguing with [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/89060/Sasamiya-Saya) and [Kirin](https://anilist.co/ch

name: Touya Mochizuki
description:
Touya is a young boy who has come to this other world. For the most part, he is very well-mannered, but when he feels that those close to him could be harmed, he also has a side that will not hesitate.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Elze Silhoueska
description:
Elze is an adventurer equipped with gauntlets on both hands. She is the type who acts rather than talks and often pitches in before thinking. She is the older of the twins.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Linze Silhoueska
description:
Linze was in the city with her sister and right before they were tricked into something, Touya saved them. She is reserved, but there are times where she shows her inner strength. She is the younger of the twins.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Yae Kokonoe
description: Born in the far eastern country of Eashen to a samurai family, Yae left her home to travel and hone her skills elsewhere. Touya's group crosses paths with her during their travels, helping to fend off a group of ruffians attacking her. Thereafter, she decides to accompany Touya on his travels.

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Yumina Urnea Belfast
native: ユミナ・エルネア・ベルファスト
description: A Princess of Belfast, and daughter of King Tristwin and Queen Yuel. Yumina met Touya when he heals her father from an attempted poisoning. Yumina possess the Null magic "Mystic Eyes", an ability that comes from her Heterochromic Eyes which give her the ability to see a person's true nature. Due to this power, upon seeing the selfless and kind aura surrounding Touya after he saves her father, she asks to be engaged to him, believing that she will never find a better candidate to be her husband. She is also proficient with bows and arrows, often choosing to fight alongside a pack of hunting wol

appearsIn.title: In Another World With My Smartphone

name: Louise Françoise Le Blanc de La Vallière
native: ルイズ・フランソワーズ・ル・ブラン・ド・ラ・ヴァリエール
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm
__Familiar:__ A Knight (newly appointed), [Saito Hiraga](https://anilist.co/character/137/Hiraga-Saito)

Louise Françoise Le Blanc de La Vallière is the main female character. She is a second-year student at the Tristain Academy of Magic and a terrible mage who is often scorned by her fellow classmates. Because every spell she casts fails, she is nicknamed "Louise the Zero" after her zero success rate and zero attributes. The third daughter of the noble family La Vallière who owns the northeastern territory of Tristain. 

The Familiar of Zero F, the final episode, she gets m

appearsIn.title: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons
The Familiar of Zero: "Rondo" of Princesses

name: Derflinger
description:
Saito's talking sword. Seems to have the power to warp people, as seen in the beginning of the third ZNT series: Princesses no Rondo.  

He shatters after taking a powerful breath of fire from the Ancient Dragon in episode 10 of Zero no Tsukaima F  On the episode 12 it's revealed that he's not the "sword", he's a spirit that lives within Gandalfr

appearsIn.title: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons

name: Saito Hiraga
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'8") 

Saito is a student from Tokyo, Japan. One day, his laptop got broken and he decided to repair it; however, learning of the expensive fee for repair, he does not continue the repair, thinking of applying for a part-time job. As he walks down the streets, a mysterious portal appears before him, which can be only seen by him. He touches it out of curiosity, but it sucks him up despite his attempts to break free from it. Upon getting sucked, he arrives in Halkeginia as summoned by Louise de la Vallière as her familiar.

appearsIn.title: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons
The Familiar of Zero: "Rondo" of Princesses

name: Henrietta de Tristain
native: アンリエッタ・ド・トリステイン
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") 

The Princess of Tristain. She is loved by her nationals and is also an old friend of Louise. Later, she becomes the queen of Tristain and decides to defend Tristain from the Albion invasion after the assassination of the Albion prince.  She is named after Henrietta Anne, the youngest daughter of Charles I of England and sister of Charles II of England.  

She has a crush on Saito.

appearsIn.title: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons
The Familiar of Zero: "Rondo" of Princesses

name: Paprika
description: Paprika is a playful girl that guides others through their dreams in the experimental psychotherapy treatment. She never means any harm. She is Atsuko's alter ego.

name: Atsuko Chiba
description:
Chiba Atsuko is the head of the DC Mini development team. She also uses the DC Mini to treat patients by entering their dreams as her alter ego Paprika. She does this in secret since the system is still under development, and such unauthorized treatments are illegal.

She is in love with Tokita.

name: Toshimi Konakawa
description: A curious detective who is immersed in a dream with Paprika in the beginning of the movie. Throughout the movie, he is trying to understand what is the cause of a reoccuring anxiety dream that he is having.  He eventually figures out that it is a product of his disappointment of never finishing a movie that he was making with a deceased friend.

name: Kousaku Tokita
description: The inventor of the DC Mini. He's childish and doesn't know much about responsibility or the eventual consequences that the DC Mini comes with.

name: Faputa
description:
**Race**: Narehate
**Relatives**:[Irumyuui](https://anilist.co/character/183025/Irumyuui) (mother)

Faputa is referred to as "Princess of the Narehate" by the inhabitants of the Narehate Village Ilblu within the inviolable 6th layer of the Abyss. She is described by Majikaja as "the embodiment of value", and is incredibly highly regarded by all the Narehate in the village.

Faputa appears to be unstable and unreasonable, displaying a wild behavior that makes her comparable to a beast. She speaks in a simplistic and primitive manner, referring to herself in third person, and communicating only

appearsIn.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun

name: Yamato Kurosawa
description: One of the most popular boys in his school. He is quite protective of [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/24201) as he protects her of anyone who does anything rude to her or insults her. [Asami](https://anilist.co/character/38441) describes Yamato as someone who thinks of others more than anyone else, protects what should be protected, and cares for others despite having his own problems to deal with.

name: Mei Tachibana
description: Mei was a social person before, but ever since her friends turned against her, she decided never to befriend anyone again. At first, she is described as "freakishly gloomy" and "doesn't speak". She is anti-social, clumsy, observant as well as honest, and funny. Her dad passed away from cancer and her mom is alive.  By episode 3, she enters a relationship with Yamato at his demand. She loves Yamato very much but she finds it difficult to express her feelings as she is new to interacting with people. She receives a blue bracelet as well as a pair ring from Yamato as a symbol of their relationshi

name: Yatora Yaguchi
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

He is a second-year high school student with remarkably high grades despite his delinquent lifestyle. Yatora feels like his life is dull and predictable, that is, until he comes across his senpai, [Maru Mori](https://anilist.co/character/157117/Mori-Maru), painting in the school's art club. He discovers his passion for painting and dedicates his remaining school years to it, aiming to pass the Tokyo University of the Arts entrance exam.

Although Yatora is very hardworking and looks composed, there is an underlying insecure part of him that is further exposed when he

name: Ryuuji Ayukawa
description:
__Height:__ 5'9 (175cm)

[Official Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ryuji_ayukawa/)

Yatora's classmate and fellow art club member, they are responsible for inviting Yatora to the art club. Yuka has a talent for modern street fashion.

They are closest to their grandmother, who is the reason why they decided to pursue Japanese Art. Yuka will often put on a bright demeanor in front of themselves, and when placed in stressful situations they are often brash and impulsive. Yuka's mother and father both disapprove of their identity and lifestyle. It's shown that they don't have a very happy ho

name: Sakura Minamoto
description:
__Year of death:__ April 7, 2008
__Cause of death:__ Collision with a pickup truck on her way to an idol audition

Before becoming a zombie, Sakura was an ordinary girl with nothing special going on in her life. She is shown to be an energetic girl and becomes very passionate whenever she is singing as an idol. 

When she regains her memories of her life but loses her memories of her Zombification, Sakura becomes very defeatist and detached due to the failures she kept facing in life no matter how hard she tried. After she regained all of her memories with the encouragement of her friends she

name: Saki Nikaidou
description:
__Death:__ August 30, 1997

Formerly a biker who conquered the entire Kyushu with her biker gang Dorami. Saki has a tough and rebellious attitude, calling [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/127540) a goody-two-shoes, and outright stating that she has no respect for those who don't have guts. However, after a successful performance, Saki takes being an idol very seriously and becomes leader of Franchouchou. Saki also occasionally shows a soft side, as seen in episode 6 where she comforts [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/127539). When she was alive, she was fond of her Tamagotchi and enjoys

name: Ai Mizuno
description:
__Death:__ August 4, 2008

She was a popular idol in the early 2000s from the idol group called Iron Frill.

 __Cause of death:__ struck by lightning during a concert. Because of how she died, she is afraid of lighting. 

When alive, Ai demonstrated a cheerful and determined personality, but after becoming a zombie she became rather skeptical and suspicious. As she gradually begins to warm up to her group, she begins to act like herself. She has shown a supportive side when aiding the other members with her idol experience.

name: Junko Konno
aliases: Densetsu no Shouwa Idol (伝説の昭和アイドル)
description:
__Death:__ December 9, 1983
__Height:__ 155cm (5'1")

Konno Junko was an idol from the 80s whose popularity caused the idol boom of said decade. She died in 1983 on a plane crash. She is titled as the Legendary Showa Idol.

Junko seems to be calm, collected, little shy, but also a little serious if not daring. This serious side is shown when she tries to escape the mansion, collaborates with [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/127538) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/127540) in going in the Hot Springs, and when it comes to idols. She seems prone to panic whenever something disturbing

name: Koutarou Tatsumi
description:
He is the energetic producer of the idol group Franchouchou. He's the one who resurrected the girls from different eras as zombies to be part of his idol group.

He seems to have known Sakura in high school

name: Tae Yamada
description: A mysterious girl with an unknown past, titled only as the Legendary Tae Yamada. She is the only one of the girls who has not fully regained consciousness, and so has remained a mindless zombie. As such, Tae is unpredictable and driven by pure instinct, doing things such as biting at the other members and launching herself at the crowd. However, she does seem to have some semblance of awareness, being able to at least understand the members to some degree and be cooperative enough to participate in the practices and performances.

name: Yuugiri
description:
__Death:__ December 28, 1882

Yuugiri was a high-ranking courtesan from the Meiji era. After being resurrected from the dead, she becomes a member of the zombie idol group, Franchouchou.

Yuugiri remains very calm and traditional in various situations, probably due to the period in which she lived and where she worked. Despite this, she seems to calmly accept and adapt to the changes in modern Japanese society. Every time she sees someone depressed, she physically hits people to get them out of their mood. The problem is that most of the time, they have already recovered when Yuugiri slaps the

name: Lily Hoshikawa
description:
__Death:__ November 30, 2011
__Cause of death:__ mental shock from growing a facial hair


Lily is often seen with a smile, and due to her young age, is shown to be quite playful as well. She has also demonstrated a professional aspect from her experiences before her death.

description:
__Height:__ 161 cm (5'3")
__Classification:__ Esper

__Power Level:__ 5

One of the main heroines in the Toaru Majutsu no Index series and the protagonist of her side story, Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. An Esper of Academy City, her powers are ranked Level 5, the highest rank for the most powerful Espers. She ranks as third-strongest out of the seven people who hold this rank in Academy City.

She is a little shameless as she sometimes flips Uiharu's skirt in public.  She first appears in the Toaru Kagaku no Railgun manga and its anime series and makes a cameo appearance in the Toaru Majutsu no Index light novel series and the opening of the anime. Kuroko is [Mikoto](/character/13701/)'s kouhai in Tokiwadai Middle School and a protagonist in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun, as well as a supporting character in Toaru Majutsu no Index. A Level 4 Esper, she is a member of Judgment, a special public committee group whose duty is to maintain peace and order in Academy City. She has an unhealthy obsession with Mikoto, whom she calls "Onee-sama" (big sister), and is on the constant lookout for a

Shirai's friend and colleague in Judgment and another protagonist in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. Shy and humble, she goes to Sakugawa Junior High, different from Shirai's, and is known for wearing a headband made of flowers on her head, and sometimes a surgical mask as she constantly suffers the flu. She has a sweet tooth but is often called for Judgment duties before she can enjoy her sweets. She displays various skills with the use of the co

name: Tomoko Kuroki
description:
Socially inept and often desperate, the series chronicles her various attempts to try to be more popular at her school, Makuhari Shuuei High School. She is 15 years old at the time of the series' debut and was born towards the end of February of either 1994, 1997, or 1998.

Tomoko started off very excited about high school. After all, she had had over 50 years of dating experience with over 100 boys in otome games, and she could not have been more enthralled with the years of popularity her secondary education was bound to bring! However, after going two months without speaking to anyone in he

appearsIn.title: WataMote: No Matter How I Look At It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!

name: Kumoko
description:
A high school girl of self-professed low standing who has reincarnated as a spider. 

In her former life, she lived as a shut-in and immersed herself in video games, but now she uses her remarkable mental strength to fight for survival. She uses battle tactics that make up for her low stats with her mastery of agility, spider thread, and poison fangs.

Kumoko later takes on the name of Shiraori after deification, becomes the Tenth Demon Army commander and the transcended protagonist of the series. After the events of the battle with the G-Fleet, Kumoko was forced to transcend the limits of the

name: Ariel
description:
The current Demon Lord. She is the Origin Taratect, Ancient Divine Beast, and Ruler of Gluttony. She is the origin of all Taratects in the System, and thus all spiders can be considered her kin. The Queen Taratects and Puppet Taratects are her closest kin, having wills and personalities of their own, and are not dominated by Kin Control, even though she has this skill.

(Source: Kumo Desu ga, Nani ka? Wiki)

description:
Sophia Keren, formerly known as Negishi Shouko in her previous life, is one of the reincarnated students. She was reincarnated as a True Vampire in a noble human family, the Kerens. Her relatives are normal humans, so she hides the fact that she is a Vampire.

Sophia works for the demons as a soldier of the 10th Demon Army under direct orders of [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/122124/Kumoko) to hunt the various clones of [Potimas](https://anilist.co/character/130480/Harrifenas-Potimas).

description:
The fourth prince of the Kingdom of Analeit.

His name in his previous life was Yamada Shunsuke. He was a textbook example of the average high school student and retains that quality after reincarnating. However, he has a deep admiration for his older brother [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/196477/Julius-Zagan-Analeit), the hero, and spends every day working hard to catch up to him.

description:

A 23-year-old calligrapher. He goes to the Goto Islands in Nagasaki to focus more on his calligraphy and to take time to understand himself and find his passion.

name: Naru Kotoishi
description: She is an energetic and cheerful kid who likes to play around. She keeps coming to Seishuu's house and doesn't seem to understand personal space. She also has a lot of friends. Even though she can sometimes be seen as annoying by Seishuu, she properly apologizes if he gets really mad. She may have a possible crush on him since she was worried when she considered the possibility he might have a girlfriend. She also likes to collect strange things such as bugs and shells from the beach (with slugs and other creatures still living inside them). She is also rather adventurous as shown in the first

name: Isabel Magnolia
native: イザベル・マグノリア
description:
Isabel Magnolia is one of [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) two old companions from his time in the capitol's Underground District, the other being [Furlan Church](https://anilist.co/character/87928/Furlan-Church). She met the two of them after she was discovered trying to sneak past a checkpoint to the surface without paying and was forced to flee until she arrived at their doorstep and was saved by them. Impressed by her saviors, she asked to join their gang, and they agreed on the condition that she be trained to use ODM gear 

Isabel is an energetic, outspoken young woman w

name: Furlan Church
native: ファーラン・チャーチ
description:
Furlan Church is a delinquent who roamed the capital's Underground District and one of [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) two old companions from his time living in the underground, the other being [Isabel Magnolia](https://anilist.co/character/87929/Isabel-Magnolia). He's a very talented ODM user, having learned to use it and teach his fellow delinquents how to use it. The way he managed to acquire and learn how to use ODM gear is unknown.

Furlan, in contrast to Isabel, is very focused and able to make the distinction between when to have fun and when to be serious. He is usua

name: Elaina
description:
On her broom, she flies from country to country with her long, black robes adorning the lengths of her arms and trailing behind her with every weave and turn. Her purple-blue eyes peer out from beneath a black tricorn hat to reveal beautiful and silky ashen hair that flows down her back like clouds flowing through summer skies. On her chest is pinned a star-shaped brooch — signifying her status as a witch.

Prior to the main story, she was a sheltered child who was greatly proficient in magic, innocent, and "not knowing what failure is."

appearsIn.title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina

name: Shuichi Kagaya
description:
Shuichi is a third-year high school student and wants to be a normal person and wants things to stay the same forever. but he is scared of himself as he has the ability to turn into a monster.

His abilities allow​ him to transform into a mascot character which gives him enhanced physical strength and sense of smell. It also has a zipper which can be unzipped so that someone can go inside of him. This will allow that person to control Shuichi's body. 

If he and the person inside of him have the same goals, he can collaborate with them and join forces and fuse together to become one being and

name: Clair Aoki
description:
A female freshman from Shuichi's highschool that in the beginning of the series attempts to commit suicide by immolation due to the death of her parents to the hands of a "monster." She is saved from this situation by Shuichi. Whilst being saved, she discovers Shuichi's other form and with this information she later convinces him into doing what she wants him to do.

She is a rather smart girl that takes advantage of any opportunity to gain the upper hand in any given situation be it by using her female attributes (mostly against Shuichi) or by using the enemies' secrets and goals against them

name: Elena Aoki
description:
She is Claire Aoki's Older Sister. A 3rd year high school student in a far-off private school. She is bad at talking to people.

She told Claire that she killed their parents for her because they were bad people. They were very strict people and their dad was on the diet but he was doing all sorts of bad things in secret and her mom was cheating on him with all the younger men at her company.

It is hinted that Shuichi and her met in the past even though Shuichi doesn't seem to have any memories of her as she seems to know about Shuichi Kagaya and it was also stated that she was the reason Shu

name: Isamu
description:
__Height:__ 135cm (4'5")
__Race:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Superhero
__Level:__ S-Class; Rank: 5
__Affiliation:__ Heroes Association

Child Emperor is a young boy with large eyes. He wears a plain T-shirt with two buttons both of which are buttoned, along with a black school bag on his back.

As a genius, the Child Emperor values education, which can be seen when he mentions about going to cram school even after hearing about the Earth being in danger. He easily becomes infuriated when being labeled as childish by others. He is very analytical, observing the situation and formulating plans in a

name: Kumiko Oumae
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm  
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

Kumiko enrolled in Kitauji High School after long hoping to wear the uniform. She wasn't particularly dead set on it but decided to join the wind ensemble and continue playing the euphonium. She has a habit of immediately saying what she's thinking and changes her mind easily. She is very preoccupied with something she said to [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina) at a contest in junior high school.

name: Reina Kousaka
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__Instrument:__ Trumpet

A girl who graduated from the same junior high school as [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko). Influenced by her dad, who is a pro, she has been playing the trumpet since she was little, so she continues at the wind ensemble in high school. She is stoic and cool, and tends to keep herself distanced from other people.

name: Hazuki Katou
description:
**Instrument:** Tuba

Kumiko's classmate. She was in the tennis club in junior high school, and is a beginner in music. She admired the trumpet and joined the wind ensemble, but ends up playing the tuba. She's a bright and perky mood-maker.

name: Sapphire Kawashima
description:
**Instrument:** Contrabass

Kumiko's classmate. At an elite junior high school for young ladies, she learned to play the contrabass. She joined the wind ensemble to continue to happily play music. She has a positive personality, but worries about her name.

(Source: Anime News Network)

name: Asuka Tanaka
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

A third-year high school student. She is the vice president of the brass band club, and also leads the bass section. Like Kumiko, she plays the euphonium. Her standoffish nature has brushed people off time and again. Her red-rimmed glasses are her trademark.

name: Shinichi Sakurai
description:
Shinichi Sakurai is a tall, introverted college student with short brown hair. Shinichi enjoys peace and quiet and likes playing video games. He prefers to be left alone, but despite his objections, he often ends up hanging out with [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki). Shinichi works at a college café run by [Mr. Asai](https://anilist.co/character/169505/Akihiko-Asai).

After learning his feelings for Hana, he quickly confesses resulting in the two going out.

name: Hana Uzaki
description: Hana Uzaki is a short, silver-haired college student with an energetic personality. Her antics often annoy her senpai, [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/).

name: Hiroshi Odokawa
description:
__Occupation:__ Taxi Driver

Odokawa is an eccentric and quiet person who does not open up to others. He has a serious and compassionate side. His hobbies include listening to rakugo before going to bed and listening to the radio while working.
 
Due to brain damage suffered from a drowning accident in his childhood, Odokawa cannot perceive human beings and instead views them as animals. His condition is solved when he gets in an accident again.

name: Yuuya Tenjou
description: Yuuya Tenjou is the main protagonist of the series. Located in his grandfather's secret room, Yuuya came across a door leading to another world, Argena, where he gained his powers. Being able to go back and forth between Earth and Argena, Yuuya became extrodinary in both worlds.

name: Hina
description: A strange girl with supernatural powers that suddenly comes into [Nitta](https://anilist.co/character/89229/Nitta-Yoshifumi)'s house in a strange box. She usually has a problem communicating properly with other people and rarely shows emotion.

name: Yoshifumi Nitta
description: The main character, a yakuza member. His life changes dramatically after he met [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/89228/Hina).

name: Watashi
description: An unnamed (his name translates to "me" or "I") college student in Kyoto who is recollecting his past two years of college life. He entered college dreaming of the "rosy campus life" that must surely be his. He wants to meet the raven-haired girl of his dreams, which is why he joins a new social circle in each episode. He is quite shy, and easily manipulated by the other characters. Even though he is the central character, he seems to be the most powerless and normal person in the roster.

name: Akashi
description:
Akashi has a very icy personality and is hard to approach. She appears to be slightly less harsh to the main character.

A freshman student who is commonly (but not always) the center of the protagonist's affections. She acts rationally and even coldly towards most people, but often shows hints of affection (or helpfulness) to the protagonist. Her fear of moths also contrasts with her normally calm demeanor.
She often appears in the same club that the protagonist joins, she is a student of the engineering department and a member of Birdman circle.

name: Ozu
description: The main character's mischievous friend, tied to him by "the black thread of fate." Ozu also appears as a child in The Night is Short, Walk on Girl. His ghastly appearance is due to his refusal to eat vegetables or anything of that nature, rather, he subsists off of instant foods and ramen.

name: Kasumi Nomura
description:
A girl who appears to be a goody-two-shoes who reads book in the classroom after school, but she's actually extremely unskilled at English. She asks [Olivia](https://anilist.co/character/126451/) to teach her English.
(Source: ANN)

name: Hanako Honda
description:
An energetic and bright girl who can both play sports and hit the books. However, that doesn't mean she's the sharpest knife in the drawer. She admires popular girls with fulfilling lives, and she's currently part of her middle school's soft tennis team in order to become one herself. However, there seems to be no hope of her becoming popular anytime in the near future.

(Source: ANN)

name: Olivia
description:
A blonde-haired, blue-eyed girl who transferred into [Hanako](https://anilist.co/character/126452/)'s midde school. Both of her parents are non-Japanese, and her appearance might make you think she knows English, but she's actually really bad at it because she was born and raised in Japan. In fact, she can barely speak a word of English.

(Source: ANN)

name: Chinatsu Kano
description:
__Sports Team:__ Basketball
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ High School Second-Year / Third-Year

A first-year high school student and the rising star of Elmei Junior and Senior High's girls' basketball team. Her personality and skills have made her incredibly popular both inside and outside of her school, to the point where she's been featured in various magazines. Chinatsu can be quite competitive, as she always arrives to Elmei's gymnasium in the morning for open practice even earlier than [Taiki Inomata](https://anilist.co/character/191242/Taiki-Inomata), whom she freque

name: Taiki Inomata
description:
__Sports Team:__ Badminton, Volleyball (one-shot)
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ Junior High Third-Year

A third-year middle school student and a member of Eimei Junior and Senior High's boys' badminton team. While not the most-talented player, Taiki is nonetheless extremely hardworking. He very routinely goes to Eimei's gymnasium for morning open practice, sharing the floor with his crush, [Chinatsu Kano](https://anilist.co/character/191241/Chinatsu-Kano). Taiki's strong work ethic is complemented by his optimistic view of things and his headstrong demeanor. His two friend

name: Hina Chouno
description:
__Sports Team:__ Rhythmic Gymnastics
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ Junior High Third-Year

A third-year middle school student and a member of Eimei Junior and Senior High's girls' rhythmic gymnastics team. The youngest daughter of a former representative of the Japanese gymnastics team, Hina is considered a prodigy in the sport among her peers, having ranked fourth among all junior high school students in the country. While she doesn't consider herself to be a hard worker, Hina is willing to put in considerable amounts of effort if it results in her being able to achieve h

name: Kyou Kasahara
description:
__Sports Team:__ Badminton
__School:__ Eimei Junior and Senior High
__Year:__ Junior High Third-Year

A third-year middle school student and a member of Elmei Junior and Senior High's boys' badminton team. He is friends with both [Taiki Inomata](https://anilist.co/character/191242) and [Hina Chono](https://anilist.co/character/218648/Hina-Chono).

In the _Ao no Hako_ oneshot, Kyo is instead a member of his school's shogi club.

Yamai was originally one spirit, but for unknown reasons or causes that may be related with her coming and going between the dimensions sometime in the past; she was split into two bodies and mind. The original personality of Yamai is no more, as well as what type of personality she used to have is unknown to the split Yamais. The Yamai Sisters have been well known to the people who know about the existence of spirit because they often cause major storm in

name: Miku Izayoi
description:
Miku is a Spirit who is an idol and lady. She hates men to the point that [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257) even has to crossdress in order to interact with her.

Just like [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263), Miku was a normal human before she became a Spirit. Her angel is Gabriel, and she has the power to manipulate and brainwash people.

Ever since she was little, Miku loved singing. She wasn't good at studying or sports, but she could sing better than anyone else around her. As an aspiring singer, she had always dreamed of performing on the big stage. That dream came tr

name: Yukana Yame
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

A high school gyaru who is very soft and has a very close friend who's also a gyaru.
