name: Kenji
description: While Brock was at Professor Ivy's lab, Ash and Misty land on Tangelo Island and meet this young man, Tracey. He is a Pokemon Watcher and is also a very big fan of Professor Oak. Knowing that Ash and Misty are close to Professor Oak, Tracey decides to tag along with Ash as the crew travels the Orange Islands. Only after the Orange Islands adventure, Tracey decided to stay in Pallet Town and be Professor Oak's assistant.

name: Matadogas
description: Matadogas is a purple Pokémon consisting of two spherical heads connected by a thin tube with another sphere in the center. The heads have differing sizes and features. The left head is larger and has prominent eyebrows, pointed teeth protruding from its lower jaw, and two flat teeth in its upper jaw. The smaller, right head simply has two pointed teeth, one at each corner of its mouth. The larger head has a cream-colored skull-and-crossbones marking below its face, while the smaller head has a ring marking instead. It is covered with many geyser-like protrusions, which usually expel mustard-c

name: Arbok
description:
Arbok is a serpentine Pokémon that resembles a cobra. It has narrow eyes and several sharp teeth. Just below its head is a large hood with a face-like pattern. This pattern has over 20 possible variations. The pattern typically has two red and yellow eyespots outlined in black, a wide black streak resembling an upturned mouth, and a black V-shaped stripe above the eyespots.

Arbok is capable of crushing opponents by coiling its body around them and squeezing them tightly. It can even flatten steel oil drums. If it encounters an enemy, it raises its head, mimics, and stuns the opponent using th

name: Kojirou
description: Kojirou is a member of the Rocket Gang, more specifically part of a trio with [Musashi](https://anilist.co/character/3935/Musashi) and [Nyarth](https://anilist.co/character/3937/Nyarth), that follows [Satoshi](https://anilist.co/character/2473/Satoshi) and his friends around in the Pocket Monsters anime, usually trying to steal Satoshi's [Pikachu](https://anilist.co/character/3891/Pikachu).

name: Pikachu
description: Pikachu is the signature Pokémon of the Pocket Monsters anime, and the first Pokémon that Satoshi obtained on his journey as a Pokémon Trainer, given to him by Professor Okido.

name: Sonans
description:
Sonans is a tall, cyan Pokémon with a soft body. Its eyes usually appear scrunched, and it has a jagged upper lip. Female Sonans have a red marking on their mouth that resembles lipstick, while males do not. It has flat arms that are wider towards the tip and four stubby legs at the base of its body. There are two eyespots on its black tail. Sonans is very protective of its tail, to the point where it will suddenly turn uncharacteristically aggressive if the tail is attacked.

(Source: Bulbapedia)

Musashi's Sonans originally belonged to a different trainer until she accidentally traded her Be

name: Musashi
description: Musashi is a member of the Rocket Gang, more specifically part of a trio with [Kojirou](https://anilist.co/character/3936) and [Nyarth](https://anilist.co/character/3937), that follows [Satoshi](https://anilist.co/character/2473) and his friends around in the Pocket Monsters anime, usually trying to steal Satoshi's [Pikachu](https://anilist.co/character/3891).

name: Togepy
description:
Togepy is a small, light yellow Pokémon with a round body that is still encased in its eggshell. Togepy does not shed its shell. The Egg has red and blue shapes on it. Togepy has stubby hands and round feet with two toes each. Togepy has black eyes and five spikes on its head that seem to form a crown. It also has semi-oval, brown pads on the soles of its feet.

Togepy is able to release poison from the spikes on its head. The anime has shown that it can retract into its shell, which it usually does to sleep. It is able to siphon the positive energy of others, and then release it to those in n

name: Kasumi
description:
Kasumi is a Gym Leader of Hanada City's Gym, known officially as the Hanada Gym. She gives the Cascade Badge to Trainers who defeat her in battle. She specializes in Water-type Pokémon.

Kasumi is a friend and former traveling partner of the anime's main character, Satoshi. After he stole her bike and proceeded to accidentally destroy it, Kasumi followed him around the Kanto region, the Orange Islands, and the Johto region, using the time she spent with him to further her goal of becoming the greatest Water Pokémon Master.

name: Gerald Stuart
native: ジオルド・スティアート
description:
__Magic Type:__ Fire

Gerald is the third prince of the country, and the capture target that is Katarina's fiance. Even though he looks like an orthodox blonde-haired, blue-eyed prince, Katarina thought otherwise that on the inside he’s actually an evil sadistic prince.

However, even though Gerald in the game was supposed to be “not interested in Katarina at all, and almost never visited her, before she noticed, he would come over to her house once every three days. And, he even helps Katarina harvest the fruits and vegetables from the field, and would always bring her sweets as presents, and

name: Maria Campbell
description:
__Magic Type:__ Light

Maria Campbell was the main character of the game Fortune Lover.

Maria worked hard and actively participated in household chores, never complained or said anything selfish, and desperately studied. When she entered magic school, her long years of hopes for magic school were immediately shattered when she learned she was the only commoner. What’s more, she was also bullied for the audacity of having magic powers despite only being a commoner.

name: Katarina Claes
description:
__Magic Type:__ Earth

The main villain of the Fortune Lover game, however, after she recalls her previous life as a Japanese student, her personality underwent a massive change and she became much nicer and more humble.

As far as future plans, he intends to attend the same local university as his childhood friend, Manami. Kuroneko is a fan of teenage fantasy anime and is sickened by cute anime, like [Meruru](ht

description:
__Height:__ 165 cm 

Kirino is Kyosuke's younger sister. She is mature for her age with a cold, tsundere-like personality. She has a strong "little sister" fetish and owns many adult games with older brother/little sister themes, relying on a modeling job to pay for them. Despite this, she states she does not know why she started liking it, though it is suggested that she has a brother complex and is using the games as a surrogate to this. description:

The protagonist of Grisaia. Ace number 9029, Yuuji is the “janitor” for the underworld. Tired of the life, he wanted to live a normal school life. Cool, philosophical, and minimalist, Yuuji is a realist…but also tsundere. Being very cowardly, he always plans and scouts before action. Other than his occasional orthodontic military methods, he’s just a fit young man.

A second-year at Mihama Academy, and the daughter of the East Beach Railway Express Group tycoon. She was the first student to enroll at Mihama Academy. She has waist-length black hair. Because of her bluntness and hard-to-please personality, she has difficulty talking to others. Always trying to be alone, she hardly spends time with the others. She always carries a box cutter with her and use it to threaten others when she’s angry. She is a bookworm, and mystery novels are her favorite genre. Although she gives off the aura of a spoiled princess, she loves junk foods, an

name: Amane Suou
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm

Third-year student at Mihama Academy, she is the big sister type who always takes care of others. Because of unknown circumstances, she skipped one school year at her previous school, so she is actually two years older than [Yuuji](https://anilist.co/character/80891). She is tall and has a good figure. Her family manages a long-established restaurant in Ginza, so she is good at cooking. Because her mother comes from Kyoto, when excited or panicking, she talks in a Kansai dialect. She has a deep interest in cars and has acquired an automatic two-wheeled vehicle license. She

name: Michiru Matsushima
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Second-year student at Mihama Academy, a fake tsundere with bleached blonde twintails. She has a deep interest in tsundere characters and tries to act like one. Her silly and energetic personality makes her becomes the mood maker of the class. Her grades are bad. She always carries a shark-shaped pouch which contains lemonade sweets. Despite having difficulty with sour foods, she still tries to drink 100% pure Vitamin C in order to “improve her intelligence”. She has encountered many instances of bad luck since her birth but always manages to get through them in one way or

name: Makina Irisu
description:
__Height:__ 144 cm

First-year student at Mihama Academy, an innocent and carefree girl. For some inexplicable reasons, it’s hard to understand her personality. In general, she can be explained in one word, “fool”, but sometime her speeches and behaviors make people shed cold sweat. For that uniqueness, most of people who talk with her for five minutes will say, “This girl is awful”. She adores Yuuji like a brother and Amane like a sister. She calls Yuuji “onii-chan”. Although she has her own room in the dormitory, she always stays in Amane’s room. She always wears knee-socks with 2 different

name: Sachi Komine
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm

First-year student at Mihama Academy and the maid of Mihama Academy. Except when going to school, taking a bath, or swimming, she always wears her maid uniform. The students at Mihama told her to wear maid uniform as much as possible as a joke, but she took it seriously. Polite and having strong sense of responsibility, she never fails to accomplish any request from others. In her action dictionary, there are only 3 words “receive” – “confirm” – “execute”. Because of that reason, sometimes she takes a joke too seriously and causes a lot of trouble. Her favorite animal is th

name: Kazuki Kazami
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm

Kazuki is [Yuuji](https://anilist.co/character/80891)'s elder sister as well as the one who taught him throughout the earlier periods of his life.

Despite her delicate and diminutive body, she has brilliant intellect and excels in quick-witted judgement to the point that she has been labelled as a genius. She is the same age as [Amane](https://anilist.co/character/80899), both of which attended the same school "Takizono Private" and was also an active member of the basketball team for the aforementioned academy.
She unfortunately dies in an accident which has a great impac

description:
Isabella York is the daughter of the York family that is closely related to the Drossel Royal Family. She had trouble fitting in with the nobility as she can't follow etiquette and mannerism of the nobles in her school, making her some sort of outcast.

She is an illegitimate daughter of the York family, she used to live in poverty with her adopted sister, Taylor Bartlett. Before becoming Isabella York, she goes by the name of Amy Bartlett. When Amy was taken as the York's daughter, Taylor was sent to an orphanage where she spent years apart from her sister, Amy. It's not until Benedict delivered Amy's letters to her that she start to reminiscence the day she spent with her sister, Amy.

appearsIn.title: Violet Evergarden: Eternity and the Auto Memory Doll

description:
__Height:__ 142 cm (4'8")

Konata Izumi is, more by default than anything else, the "leader" of the main characters. Nicknamed "Kona-chan" by her friends, she is an eccentric but friendly and outgoing girl, with a mischievous but good-natured sense of humor. She can be smart, but she hates studying, thus her grades are a bit uneasy. However, she is an expert in pulling an "all-nighter." In contrast to her studying habits, she loves video games, to the extent that she can compete against [Kagami Hiiragi](https://anilist.co/character/2171/Hiiragi-Kagami) on trivia games (by remembering the quest

description:

Miyuki is a "young lady" from a wealthy family whom is also beautiful, smart, and well-mannered. She was the president for her grade level in her first year when she became great friends with Kagami. She was even the class president of her class in her first year. She is in a different class than [Konata](https://anilist.co/character/2169/Izumi-Konata) and Tsukasa, but she frequently comes to their class during lunch time to eat with them. Additionally, Kagami chose the humanities course in her second year so that she could be with Konata, but she was the only one separated into a different cla

name: Hideki Nishimura
description: Hideki is a first-year high school student who plays Legendary Age (LA), under the name Rusian, a male knight. He distrusts girls online after having been rejected by a girl who told him that she was actually a guy in real life. He is Ako's in-game husband in Legendary Age after reluctantly accepting her many repeated in-game proposals. Over the course of the series, Hideki begins to develop real feelings for Ako and attempts to help her differentiate reality from the gaming world. Outside of LA, he is an otaku.

description:

name: Masaru Aoki
description: Aoki was a punk from his childhood up through high school, at which point he encountered, fought and got beat down by Takamura Mamoru (who was then a middleweight with two wins under his belt). This loss motivated him to quit school along with his close friend Kimura Tetsuya to become boxers at Kamogawa gym.  Although their initial goal was to land a clean hit on Takamura, they grew to love boxing and develop their own skills. Aoki became a clownish boxer whose signature techniques, the Frog Punch and Look-Away, eventually led him to a draw in a Japanese title match with then-champion Imae Kat

name: Genji Kamogawa
description:
Head coach and founder of the Kamogawa gym. He fought as a prizefighter in Japan shortly after the end of World War II. Along with his friends, [Ginpachi Nekota](https://anilist.co/character/34715/Nekota-Ginpachi) and [Dankichi Hama](https://anilist.co/character/83533/Hama-Dankichi), Kamogawa developed a style of fighting that both presumably became the forerunner of boxing in Japan and emphasized scientific theory in its techniques.

As a coach, Kamogawa's wealth of knowledge and experience has been tapped into on multiple occasions during training as well as in matches. Although he rarely ad

name: Tatsuya Kimura
description: Ippo's senpai and Aoki's best friend. He is the smooth, collected type and a romantic at heart, but trains as hard as anyone. His style incorporates a fast left and faster footwork. In the past, he and Aoki were the toughest high-school thugs around, but now Tatsuya's real job is at his family's flower shop. His current record stands at 13–5–3, with 8 KOs.  After losing to Ryo Mashiba, he announced his retirement from boxing.Shortly after, unable to stay away from boxing, he returned saying he would spell his name in katakana (タツヤ) instead of kanji (達也).

name: Ippo Makunouchi
description:
__Nationality:__ Japanese 
__Boxing style:__ Infighter, Peek-a-Boo 
__Height:__ 5'5" (164.0 cm)  
__Reach:__ 65" (165.0 cm) 
__Weight Class:__ Featherweight 
__Specialty:__ Liver Blow, Gazelle Punch, Dempsey Roll  

Ippo Makunouchi is the main protagonist of the series. He lives with his mother, [Hiroko Makunouchi](https://anilist.co/character/36881/Makunouchi-Hiroko), and helps with the family charter boat fishing business. description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Takamura is very hearty, rude and often behaves vulgarly. He is a loud arrogant boaster who tends to refer to himself as Ore-sama (a Japanese name suffix intended for people of great importance) and he rarely ever shows a shred of consideration towards other fighters after a loss.  Takamura was discovered on the streets by Coach Kamogawa Genji, and his speed, power, and technique are all high-level to the point that he is capable of handling both In Fighters and Out Boxers without too much trouble. Unlike most characters in Hajime no Ippo, he has no special finishing

name: Ichirou Miyata
description:
Ever since he was little, Miyata has always wanted to be like his dad. His dad, Suzuki Miyata, used to be a boxer, until a career-ending jaw bone injury forced him to retire. Miyata takes  his training dead seriously, and has always believed in his father's old beliefs, that skill can beat strength. You hardly ever see the guy smile because he thinks  that he doesn't have the privilege to smile unless he wins a boxing match. 
He had worked his way up to almost the top of the feather weight championship, until Ryo Mashiba beat him in a match. Miyata ended up in the hospital with a broken foot,

name: Mei Aihara
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Mei Aihara is an honor student, the chairman's granddaughter, and the stern and cold student council president. She is often calm and composed but she can be rather sensitive and mature to some extent. At first, there is little to know about her and a bad impression of Mei washes over Yuzu, which causes Yuzu to take interest for Mei later on. Though Mei seems to be hard to approach, she is rather sensitive and lonely which makes Yuzu want to care for Mei more.

description:

The self-proclaimed Gyaru and only child, Yuzu transfers to an all-girls school after her mother is remarried. Yuzu is outspoken, daring, and shameless to some extent. She is often seen wearing her uniform that runs against the rules thus far. Unfortunately for her, she is bothered by the Student Council President's dress code enforcement. Yuzu eventually comes home to hear that she is now the older sister of the Student Council President, [Mei Aihara](https://anilist.co/character/83209/Aihara-Mei).

Despite showing irritation towards Mei, she becomes concerned for her in w

name: Kiyoka Kudou
description: Head of the Kudou family. Kiyoka is looked upon as cold or standoffish by others, including his many past prospective fiancés. This is due to his understanding of others' motives.

name: Miyo Saimori
description:
Eldest daughter of the Saimori family. Her mother died when she was young. She is ungifted
Later it was revealed that she is actually gifted, her gift was sealed away by her mother before her death. She has the gift of Dream-Sight

name: Sai
description:
__Height:__ 172.1 cm  

Sai is the replacement of Sasuke Uchiha in Team 7. The name "Sai" is given to him for the purposes of joining the team. He was recruited at a young age by Root, which trained him to have no emotions so as to make it easier for him to accomplish missions. This lack of personality causes Sai to meet with hardship upon joining Team 7, as he makes the mistake of insulting the other members in an attempt to seem sociable. He tries to seem more caring by smiling, though his teammates come to dislike it due to his obvious insincerity. 

Sai is a talented artist, and claims to

name: Toneri Ootsutsuki
description: Toneri Ōtsutsuki is a descendant of [Hamura Ōtsutsuki](https://anilist.co/character/165868/Hamura-Ootsutsuki) and the sole survivor of the Ōtsutsuki clan's branch family on the Moon.

name: Shikamaru Nara
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Rank:__ Genin (I); Chuunin (II); Hokage (III)

Shikamaru is an extremely unenthusiastic person, and as such lives his life avoiding work. This is partly due to him seeking paths of least resistance, as he often chooses to do things he would otherwise not do if people nag him enough. In his free time he typically takes naps, watches clouds, and plays strategy games such as Shogi and Go. When put into a situation where he potentially needs to put effort into something, he attempts to try to find a way to avoid it such as forfeiting a battle or by pretending to be preoccupied

name: Aoi Hinami
description: Aoi is [Tomozaki](https://anilist.co/character/136978)'s classmate, and the number two ranked player at the fighting game 'Tackfam'. She excels at everything she tries due to her hard-working attitude, so much so that many regard her as being outright perfect. To most people, she seems like a happy-go-lucky, carefree student. However, Tomozaki soon learns that she's a very serious, accommodating, supportive, yet somewhat harsh and rude person.

name: Fumiya Tomozaki
description:
Fumiya Tomozaki is a high school student who is a friendless loner and an outcast in school. To escape from his lonely existence, he dedicated himself to a fighting game called Attack Family, or 'Tackfam' for short, so much so that he's the number one ranked player in Japan, his username being nanashi. 

Tomozaki sees himself as a "bottom-tier character" in life: someone born unlucky and destined for loneliness. However, after meeting his online rival, [Aoi Hinami](https://anilist.co/character/136977/Aoi-Hinami), he agrees to learn from her how to socialize and improve himself, treating life a

name: Yoshiki Tsujinaka
description:
The best friend of [Hikaru](https://anilist.co/character/281110/Hikaru-Indou), he is a quiet teenage boy. He has a fondness for animals and insects. 

The first to realize that "Hikaru" isn't Hikaru. He struggles with accepting the fact that his childhood friend has been replaced by something else, yet continues to go about his daily life with it.

name: Hikaru Indou
description:
An easy going teenage boy who went missing in the forbidden mountains for a week about half a year ago.

A shapeshifter who took the form of Hikaru after his death. This new "Hikaru" has become greatly attached to Hikaru's best friend, [Yoshiki](https://anilist.co/character/281109/Tsujinaka-Yoshiki). It seems innocent and full of curiosity.

name: Ling Wang
description:
Wang Ling is a cultivation genius who reaches a new realm every two years since he was one year old, Wang Ling has an almost invincible existence with strength far beyond his control.

Wang Ling is a non-talkative individual who‘s obsessed with being average and not standing out. He tries to avoid troublesome matters yet he still manages to get involved and has also secretly saved the world on numerous accounts. He also lives for and loves his crispy noodles. 

He's a genius who has a vast amount of knowledge ranging from simple things to complex concepts such as multiple cultivation systems,

appearsIn.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King
The Daily Life of Immortal King

The Daily Life of Immortal King

description: A young girl whom [Takopi](https://anilist.co/character/266372/Takopi) befriends upon its arrival on Earth. She is the subject of bullying in her school due to her mother's work as a hostess and only finds solace at home with her pet dog [Chappy](https://anilist.co/character/269156/Chappy).

name: Takopi
description: A Happian alien from the Happy Planet who resembles an octopus. Takopi's goal is to spread happiness to others through its various gadgets, though its innocent and simplistic worldview is challenged as they confront the complex morality and nature of human beings.

name: Marina Kirarazaka
description: [Shizuka Kuze's](https://anilist.co/character/266369/Kuze-Shizuka) classmate who is her bully, often mocking her family situation.

name: Naoki Azuma
description: He is the class representative and has an older brother named Junya.

name: Lala Deviluke
native: ララ・サタリン・デビルーク
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Princess of Deviluke. Ran away from home so she doesn't have to get married. Uses many self-made inventions. At first she was pretending to love [Rito](https://anilist.co/character/5510) to keep from getting married, but eventually she fell in love with him. She has physical abilities far beyond that of a human and also has a distinctive tail coming from her back (which is very sensitive).

Being an alien, Lala has far more strength, power and speed than the average human. Her physical strength (without any inventions or powers) surpasses any human on Earth, and maybe even

Haruna Sairenji is the second female protagonist of To Love Ru and one of Rito's classmates and the girl of his affections. Haruna has similar feelings for him, having been attracted to his kind, gentle nature since junior high. Despite her growing love for Rito, which she believes to be unrequited, she usually suppresses her feelings and cannot confess to him because of her friendship with Lala who also loves Rito. However, with some encouragement, she tells Lala of her ordeal, to which Lala accepts, claiming Haruna as her rival for Rito's heart, while remaining friends. S

name: Rito Yuuki
description:

He is a normal 16 year old student of Sainan High, and he has a big crush on Haruna Sairenji. He attempted numerous times to confess to her but has met with failure each time. Rito used to be on the soccer team in junior high and was quite good, but quit because he was constantly helping his father with his mangaka duties, thus did not want to leave his little sister Mikan Yuuki alone in the house. Mikan comments he is very good at the most "useless little things", like crane and festival games (e.g. hoops, catching fish, squirt guns). Along with the numerous useless litt

name: Licht Bach
description:
He was presented at Nana's restaurant as a degenerate lower number, beyond that, fortunately for Hina, he is one of the Legendary Red Barons possessing a powerful force for justicing his path.

His "Count" is, initially, -999.

Even though Nana stated that his Count stands for how many girls have turned him down, his count becomes -1000 after Hina calls him a liar and says that she hates him.

His "Ballot" count is 5700 and stands for how many heads he had cut off. In chapter 10, it states that he is actually hiding his true power. During his battle, his count increases by 10 times, reaching t

name: Hina
description:
She is a solitary girl who lived before with her mom on the mountains. Now she had been traveled around this world looking for The Legendary Red Baron.

Her "Count" is, initially, 441.

Her Count stays for how many hundreds of kilometers her mother walked. 44100 km, accordingly.

In chapter 2, her Count is increased to 760 after Licht wins the game of "The Startheft Bout" for her.

He is a part of the Althea Royal Guard army, having the rank of squad leader with the title of Lieutenant. 

His "Count" is 900.

Jail maintains his true count hidden so as not to be promoted to a higher rank, so that he can continue with field missions. His original count is 12500, later decreasing to 12498, due to the events of the series. Later, the possession of his second glove is revealed, containing the count of 45,000, thus showing how great his conviction is.

description:
Lyne Mei is the secondary female character of Plunderer. She is a sergeant, who protects Hoemmh which is located at the side of a hill. 

Amiable to a fault, Lyne is always eager to help others, and boosting her count is not the sole motivator. She is genuinely a good person, if not a little daft because of her sweet nature. She is easily misled because of how quick she is to want to do good. Lyne is also short-tempered when anyone called her weight to be too heavy.

She is unafraid to use physical force to protect others and fulfill her duties as a soldier.

name: Pele Poporo
description:
Pele is friends with Lyne.

It was later revealed that Pele Poporo isn't his real name, his real name and true identity was Gespenst Zerlegen the Pierce Baron, and the founder of Special Service faction.

name: Staz Blood
native: ブラッド・チャーリー・スタズ
description:
The vampire, Staz C. Blood, is one of the most powerful district bosses in the demon world, fending off everyone who dares challenge him. But secretly, Staz is also quite obsessed with human culture, especially video games, manga, and everything that comes from Japan.

When Staz makes a decision that he wants something, he's known for always accomplishing his goal and getting or doing whatever it is that he set out for. So, when the young Japanese girl, [Fuyumi](https://anilist.co/character/36361/Yanagi-Fuyumi), wanders into the demon world by accident and dies, Staz declares that he'll help b

name: Fuyumi Yanagi
description: The human high-school-aged girl who becomes lost in the Demon World through unknown methods and for unknown reasons. She becomes a ghost after being eaten by a carnivorous plant. The triangle headband she dawns is a symbol of this. Yanagi is from Japan, and because of this, [Staz](https://anilist.co/character/36362/Blood-Charlie-Staz) is even more interested in her, often asking about anime and manga from the human world. She wishes to be resurrected as a human, and to help Staz achieve that goal.

name: Wolf
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm
__Abilities:__ Werewolf, Strength
__Weapons:__ Magic, Iron rod

An experienced and talented street fighter, Wolf is a long time friend and rival of [Staz](https://anilist.co/character/36362/Blood-Charlie-Staz). 

Wolf was abandoned by his parents for not being a pure werewolf. When Wolf gets over-hyped, he grows claws and he grows a snout. Wolf is a mildly short-tempered young man, but with great ambition. He is very powerful and strong-willed, and thinks very highly of his strength. However, he knows he is not stronger than Staz, but still continues to challenge him to batt

name: Bell Hydra
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

A sorceress of the highest quality, she meets up with [Yanagi](https://anilist.co/character/36361/Yanagi-Fuyumi) and [Staz](https://anilist.co/character/36362/Blood-Charlie-Staz) after they use her gateway connecting Hell and Earth after it was stolen from her. She has expressed interest both in unsealing Staz's powers and it is hinted that she has a crush on him. A naturally outgoing and goofy person, she is rarely seen without her giant backpack.

name: Braz D. Blood
native: ブラッド・D・ブラッズ
description: Braz Daniel Blood (ブラッド・D・ブラッズ) is the oldest sibling of the Blood Family. He lives in the Blood Estate in the Demon World Acropolis, and is also a noble, pure-blood vampire like Staz.

name: Amatsuyu Kisaragi
description: Amatsuyu Kisaragi, nicknamed Joro (如雨露 Jōro )is a second year High School student and the Student Council secretary (being replaced during the Confession Arc) who is the object of affection of [Sumireko Sanshokuin](https://anilist.co/character/138897), [Sakura Akino](https://anilist.co/character/138899), [Aoi Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/138898), [Asaka Mayama](https://anilist.co/character/152047) and [Hina Hanetachi](https://anilist.co/character/149583).

appearsIn.title: ORESUKI: Are you the only one who loves me?

name: Sumireko Sanshokuin
description: Sumireko Sanshokuin is one of the three initial heroines introduced in the series. Her nickname, Pansy, is a wordplay from her full name 三色院菫子. When the 院 and 子 removed, the remaining character (三色菫) form the Japanese name for Viola tricolor or Wild Pansy flower. She is usually called by her nickname to those who are close to her. Initially introduced as a librarian committee member with a petite build and plain face, she spends her time observing people who come to the library and somehow took interest in [Kisaragi Amatsuyu](https://anilist.co/character/138900). She is known to be gloomy by t

appearsIn.title: ORESUKI: Are you the only one who loves me?

name: Aoi Hinata
description: Aoi Hinata is a second year high school student and is also the ace of the school's Tennis Club.

appearsIn.title: ORESUKI: Are you the only one who loves me?

name: Sakura Akino
description: Sakura Akino is a third-year high school student and the Student Council President who is in love with [Taiyo Oga](https://anilist.co/character/138901).

appearsIn.title: ORESUKI: Are you the only one who loves me?

name: Yuki Itose
description: A deaf college student who seeks to learn about the outside world through [Itsuomi](https://anilist.co/character/179810/Nagi-Itsuomi).

name: Itsuomi Nagi
description:
Yuki's university senior and a member of the International Club/Circle. 
He knows 3 languages: German, English and Japanese. He also likes journeys around the world and communicating with children.
In the future he wants to be a teacher that teaches about countries and cultures.

name: Celia Claire
description: A teacher who finds Rio in the slums.

name: Rio
description: Rio is a boy living in the slums who wants revenge for his mother who was murdered in front of him when he was five years old. He has inherited the memories of his last life as Haruto Amakawa, a college student who died in an unfortunate bus accident in Japan.

name: Latifa
description: Latifa is a young fox beastkin girl born in the Beltram Kingdom of the Strahl region.  She also has the past memories and personality of an elementary school student Japanese girl named Endo Suzune.

name: Liscia Elfrieden
native: リーシア・エルフリーデン
description:
__Race:__ Human

Liscia Elfrieden is the main female protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She was the princess of Elfrieden, the daughter of the previous king, [Albert Elfrieden](https://anilist.co/character/237299/Elfrieden-Albert), and the first primary queen of Freidonia as the tentative fiancée of [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/133333/Souma-Kazuya).

appearsIn.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom
How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom Part 2
How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom

name: Kazuya Souma
description:
Kazuya Souma is the main male protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. He is an earthling who was summoned to another world as a hero, but with the accurate announcement of the previous king, Albert Elfrieden, he became the King of Elfrieden Kingdom and to avoid rebellions of people thinking Kazuya has usurped the throne, the king gives his daughter's hand in marriage to Kazuya.

Because Kazuya introduced himself to others using the Japanese form of family-name/surname first, most people in the Kingdom think that "Souma" is his given name, thus referring to him as "King

appearsIn.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom
How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom Part 2
How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom

name: Aisha Udgard
native: アイーシャ・ウドガルド
description:
Daughter of the Chief of the Dark Elves of the God Protected Forest. One of the 5 people discovered during the gathering of Gifted People after winning the Martial Competition. Serves as Souma's bodyguard after he teaches the Dark Elves how to save their forest and gradually falls deeply in love with him. She is often compared to an animal as she's very food motivated and loyal.


Becomes Souma's second fiancée in recognition for her actions in the war against the hostile Principality of Amidonia. In volume 6 she fights alongside Naden and Souma to save the dragons from a mysterious futuristic

appearsIn.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom
How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom

name: Azusa Aizawa
description: Commonly known as "The Witch of the Highlands." A girl who was reincarnated as an immortal witch with the appearance of a seventeen-year-old. Before she knew what was happening, she'd become the strongest being in the world. Although she's had some rough times, it has ultimately given her a family, and she's delighted about it.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Laika
description: A dragon girl and [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa)'s apprentice. She's fastidious and cares a lot about what others think, but she's a good, earnest, and hardworking girl. Gothic Lolita clothes, maid outfits, and other frilly things suit her very well (which embarrasses her).

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Halkara
description: A young elf woman and [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa)'s apprentice. She is an upstanding CEO who runs a company using her knowledge of mushrooms, but in the house in the highlands, she's known for her knack for screwing up.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Beelzebub
description: A high-ranking demon known as the Lord of the Flies and the demons' minister of agriculture. She frequently shuttles between the demon realm and the house in the highlands. She's [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa)'s reliable "big sister" surrogate.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Falfa
description: Oldest of the slime spirit sisters. Loves books and math.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Shalsha
description: Youngest of the slime spirit sisters. Loves books and history.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Rosalie
description: A ghost girl and resident of the house in the highlands. She's devoted to Azusa, who didn't shy away from her as a ghost and instead reached out to her. She can go through walls but can't touch people. She can also possess others.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Flatorte
description: Flatorte is a cheerful, energetic blue dragon girl who obeys what [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/135592/Aizawa-Azusa) says. Since she's a dragon like [Laika](https://anilist.co/character/135593/Laika), there is somewhat of a rivalry between them, but she's an optimistic and energetic girl. Unlike Laika, she has a tail in human form.

appearsIn.title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level

name: Baki Hanma
description:
Baki is the son of Yujiro Hanma and Emi Akezawa. Baki is also the half-brother of Jack Hanma.

The main character, and son of Yujiro Hanma. He has been training in martial arts since the age of three, and has trained under various teachers and coaches throughout his life. At the age of thirteen, he decided to take his training into his own hands and left the coaches to perform more intense training in his father's footsteps. He later meets with his father and becomes disillusioned as to his father's true character, and afterwards, aims to defeat and kill him. His fighting style is called "Tota

appearsIn.title: Baki: The Search of our Strongest Hero

name: Yoshitake Shiraishi
description:
One of the Abashiri Convicts who travels with Sugimoto's Group. 

Shiraishi is carefree and goofy, and prefers to sneak his way out of trouble. He is also rather immature. Most of the time, Shiraishi lacks seriousness and prefers to spend time on frivolous pursuits like gambling or eating rather than looking for the gold. He also likes pretty women; his backstory involves him searching for a woman he fell in love with through a sloppy drawing.

Shiraishi has a roguish personality. Because he lacks strength, he prefers to flee danger but is confident in his ability to escape any bond. He tends

name: Asirpa
description:
Asirpa is an Ainu girl who finds [Sugimoto](https://anilist.co/character/124704/Sugimoto-Saichi) when he is attacked by a bear. Her father was one of the Ainu killed by the Japanese who stole the Ainu gold. Her Japanese name is Asuko Kochoube (小蝶辺明日子).

From a young age, Asirpa was trained by her father to become a hunter. As such, she possesses many skills that are necessary for a successful hunter: trapping, poison brewing, knowledge of traditional medicine, archery, deep knowledge of Hokkaido's flora and fauna, harsh winter survival. Asirpa is also a great cook and can prepare many traditio

name: Saichi Sugimoto
aliases: Sugimoto the Immortal (不死身の杉元)
description: A demobilized soldier who survived the Russo-Japanese War in 1904. He served in the 1st Division of the Imperial Japanese Army and fought in the battle of 203 Hill. He was feared for his savage fighting style and amazing toughness on the battle field, and was known as "Immortal Sugimoto". He decides to make money to save his dead comrade [Toraji](https://anilist.co/character/131880)'s wife, [Umeko](https://anilist.co/character/131882).

name: Joe
description: An underground Megaloboxer from the outskirts of town whose real name is unknown, Junk Dog is forced to throw fights to earn money for his crooked manager, [Gansaku Nanbu](https://anilist.co/character/130056/Gansaku-Nanbu). He had something that most boxers lack however: ''A True Fighting Spirit''. He fights not just for the sake of earning a dime or two, but to prove himself as a Megaloboxer. So, he gets challenged by [Yuri](https://anilist.co/character/127574/Yuuri) to join the Megalonia Tournament and fight him in order to prove he's a real fighter, he immediately jumps at the opportunity a

name: Yuuri
description: Yuuri is [Yukiko Shirato's](https://anilist.co/character/130053/Yukiko-Shirato) bodyguard and the current champion of Megalolania, a massive megaloboxing tournament headed by the Shirato Group. He seeks out the underground fighter [Junk Dog (Joe)](https://anilist.co/character/125369/Joe) after he had insulted both him and Yukiko, meeting him in the underground ring where he easily defeats him and challenges him to work his way up to Megalonia if he wants to fight him again. Yuuri is equipped with a unique prototype state-of-the-art "integrated" Gear, which is surgically grafted directly to his

name: Sakuya Togane
description:
Togane has narrow gray eyes and long black hair whose bangs curl. His attire consists of a black suit with a gray and green vest worn over a white shirt and black tie. His collar points seem to be tucked under the vest. He is an Enforcer in Division 1 of the Public Safety Bureau.

(Source: PSYCHO-PASS Wiki)

name: Mika Shimotsuki
description:
She is a student of Oso Girl's Academy who seems to be aware of what's going on around campus. She is [Kagami](https://anilist.co/character/74009/)'s friend and classmate.

She becomes an inspector, working with Akane Tsunemori as the new junior inspector, with a first day on the job mirroring Tsunemori's own first day.

name: Kirito Kamui
description:
Kirito Kamui is a person who cannot be detected by any scanners or by the Dominators themselves. He aids and abets criminals, including Akira Kitazawa, with his ability to clarify their Hues.
The reason why a dominator or a scanner could not detect him was because after a plane crash he was reconstructed in surgery with the remains of the other victims

name: Haruhiko Ichijou
description:
A first-year high school student, he has the power to summon or seal Phantoms by drawing them in a sketchbook.

Haruhiko keeps a massive library in his house, and is knowledgeable on all kinds of subjects. This often comes in useful when dealing with Phantoms, but his teammates do not always enjoy listening to his trivia.

name: Mai Kawakami
description:
Mai is a second-year high school student at Hosea Academy and the leader of her Phantom-hunting team. Her ability is called "Spirit of the Five Elements", which requires her to  channel a specific element from parts of her body into her fists, using the classic Chinese elemental system.

She specializes in close combat and fights on the frontline, with Haruhiko backing her up.

name: Reina Izumi
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Affiliations:__ Hosea Academy, Team E
__Occupation:__ First year High School Student. Ability Wielder, Phantom Hunter

Reina Izumi is a first-year high school student who transferred to Hosea Academy in April. She has a special ability, and because of this she later joins the Phantom-Hunter club with [Haruhiko Ichijou](https://anilist.co/character/89033/Haruhiko-Ichijou) as a member of Team E. She does not get along well with her parents until some events that happen later.

Reina has a special ability to consume and seal away phantoms, hence why she was given the n

name: Koito Minase
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Affiliations:__ Hosea Academy, Team E
__Occupation:__ 1st-year High School Student, Ability Wielder, Phantom Hunter

Koito Minase is a 1st-year high school student who transferred to Hosea Academy in April. Initially, instead of joining a club or fighting the phantoms together with the others, she chose to fight them alone. This is due to the fact that she has shut herself off from other people because of an incident that happened during her childhood. After Team E helped her on various occasions, despite wishing to work on her own, she decides to join them as an of

name: Ruru
aliases: Rururaruri Rurararirararururirirari Rirararururararururararirari (ルルラルリー・ルララリララルルリリラリー・リララルルララルルララリラリー)
description:
Ruru is a Phantom who accompanies Haruhiko. She is not the type of Phantom that is hunted, and is a self-proclaimed 'good girl'.

Her full name is Rururaruri Rurararirararururirirari Rirararururararururararirari.

She is a Phantom born from Haruhiko's mind

name: Manaka Mukaido
description: The heroine, a middle school girl who is indecisive and prone to crying. She is best friends with [Hikari Sakishima](https://anilist.co/character/73067).

name: Chisaki Hiradaira
description: A calm and compassionate 14-year-old middle school student from Shioshishio, a village located in the sea. Chisaki is the childhood friend of [Manaka](https://anilist.co/character/73065/Mukaido-Manaka), [Hikari](https://anilist.co/character/73067/Sakishima-Hikari), and [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/86313/Isaki-Kaname), and together they attend Mihama Junior High School, which is located in the surface town of Oshiooshi. She attempts to act mature in most situations, putting her friends' feelings before her own, but her temper can flare up whenever she gets especially frustrated - in pa

name: Kaname Isaki
description: One of four childhood friends from Shioshishio. He is [Hikari](https://anilist.co/character/73067/Sakishima-Hikari)'s best friend and is quiet and mature for his age. He is interested in [Chisaki](https://anilist.co/character/86227/Hiradaira-Chisaki) and cares deeply for her.

name: Hikari Sakishima
description: One of four childhood friends from Shioshishio. He has a short temper and usually scolds Manaka for her mistakes, though he has deep feelings for her. He is the son of Shioshishio's Chief Priest, who serves the Sea God.

name: Tsumugu Kihara
description: A boy from the surface whose grandfather is a fisherman. One day, he meets [Manaka](https://anilist.co/character/73065/Mukaido-Manaka) when she is caught in his net. He is quiet, stoic, and very interested in the underwater world.

name: Miuna Shiodome
description: A third grade elementary school girl whose mother, Miori (originally from Shioshishio), died when she was young. She met Akari a couple of times and played with her when Akari came to visit Miuna's mom and the family.

name: Sayu Hisanuma
description:
A third grade elementary school girl with brown haired pigtails and eyes. She is Miuna's best friend who often instigates confrontations with sea people. She appears to have a crush on Kaname.

 
After the timeskip, she entered the same middle school as Hikari and the others. She also decided to be more serious at studying and becoming independent.

name: Yuu Koito
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

A first year high school student who has never experienced romantic feelings. She joins the student council, where she meets [Touko Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/123529). She lives above the family bookstore, where she occasionally works.

 She later falls in love with Touko.

name: Touko Nanami
description:
**Height:** 163 cm (5’4”)

A second year high school student, and the busiest member of the student council. She consistently ranks number one with her test scores and grades, and excels in sports as well. Due to this, and her beauty, admirers frequently confess to her - only to be turned down, as the confessions never make her feel anything.

name: Rossweisse
description:
__Rank:__ Low-class 
__Devil Role:__ Rook 
__Species:__ Reincarnated Devil (Former Valkyrie) 
__Power:__ Norse Magic 

Originally Odin's bodyguard. After the battle with Loki and Fenrir, Odin leaves her in Issei's town. She then gets persuaded by Rias to become her servant. She remains in Kuou Academy as a teacher.  Rossweisse is known to be a very serious person. She has a tendency to buy things at sales when they're cheap, allowing Issei to coin for her the nickname "The 100-Yen Shop Valkyrie".  Rossweisse makes her first appearance in Volume 5 as Odin's bodyguard, reminding him of his statu

name: Chito
description: She travels with [Yuuri](https://anilist.co/character/120890) on their Kettenkrad. She can read and write in the current language, but not in kanji or Latin alphabets, because they became old languages in this world. She loves reading and collecting books she finds during traveling.

name: Yuuri
description: Yuuri is a care-free, fun-loving girl. She is the direct foil and companion of [Chito](https://anilist.co/character/120889). She carries an Arisaka type 38 rifle and loves food more than anything else in the world.

name: Risa Koizumi
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm 

Risa Koizumi is not your average Japanese high school student. Risa's height is well above that of most Japanese girls her age (the average height for a female is 160 cm (5 ft 3 in) Ironically, her surname means 'little spring'.

She and other characters compare her to a giraffe. Risa can be impulsive and strong-willed at times, and is rarely willing to display her softer side. She had a crush on [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/3026/Suzuki-Ryouji) before he started dating [Chiharu](https://anilist.co/character/3024/Tanaka-Chiharu).

name: Atsushi Ootani
description:
__Residence:__ Osaka
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'2")

Atsushi Ootani is one of the main characters. He is very short for a boy, standing 156 centimeters. Like [Koizumi](https://anilist.co/character/2379/Koizumi-Risa), Ootani's surname (roughly, "big valley") is a pun on his diminutive stature, and he can be thoughtless and rude; at heart, however, he is kind and a little silly. Ootani is also the star player of the school basketball team. Some say he wears padded shoes so he can reach 162 cm.

name: Worick Arcangelo
native: ウォリック・アルカンジェロ
description: One half of Benriya, Worick is the more personable and communicative partner. He presents himself as fairly happy-go-lucky, but can be serious when a job is on the line. Worick works as both a freelance gangster and gigolo in order to pay the rent. In chapter seven it is revealed that he has exceptional recall abilities. He is the second son and only surviving member of the influential Arcangelo family.

name: Alex Benedetto
native: アレックス・ベネデット
description: A prostitute who is assisted by [Worick](https://anilist.co/character/41198/Arcangelo-Worick) and [Nicolas](https://anilist.co/character/41197/Brown-Nicolas) during one of their jobs. Although ordered to eliminate her, Benriya decides instead to claim her as "loot" - effectively saving her life. With nowhere else to go, Alex begins working as Benriya's secretary. She is currently learning sign language so that she can better communicate with Nicolas.

name: Nicolas Brown
description:
__Height:__ 5'5"

One half of Benriya, Nicolas is highly skilled with a sword, imposing and somewhat aloof. He is deaf and communicates primarily through sign language, though he can speak in a limited capacity. Along with [Worick](https://anilist.co/character/41198/Arcangelo-Worick), Nick works as a gangster-for-hire. He is an A/O level Twilight or "tagged" (in reference to his dog tags), making him both feared and reviled on the streets. Despite his rough exterior, Nicolas has a soft spot for [Nina](https://anilist.co/character/43900/Nina) and is beginning to accept [Alex's](https://anilist.

name: Ichirou Suzuki
description: Suzuki, or Satuu, is an adult programmer who had been transported into a game-like world after falling asleep. This game-like world is strangely related to the video games he was working on. In this world of levels and skills, Suzuki has a special ability to immediately learn a skill related to the actions he takes.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Pochi
description:
Originally a nameless slave known simply as "Dog" belonging to a man named [Urs](https://anilist.co/character/188389/Urs), but became master-less after his death. She was given the name "Pochi" by [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/124921/Ichiro-Suzuki) during the events of the labyrinth and became his slave after leaving the labyrinth.

Pochi would later take up Liza's family name "Kishreshigarza" after being conferred the Honorary Chevalier title and rank.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Lulu
description: [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/124921/Suzuki-Ichirou) purchased her along with her younger sister, [Arisa](https://anilist.co/character/124917/Arisa). Her great-grandfather was Japanese. She is seen as ugly due to the different beauty standards in the world of Death March even though she is extremely beautiful in the eyes of the Japanese. She was born in Kubooku Kingdom.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Liza
description: Originally known as Lizaryu in her youth. Liza was a slave belonging to a man named [Urs](https://anilist.co/character/188389/Urs), she became master-less after his death. Being initially low-leveled, weak, and trapped in the labyrinth, she pleaded [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/124921/Ichiro-Suzuki) to take her with him, going as far as to offer herself as his literal shield. She officially became Satou's slave together with [Pochi](https://anilist.co/character/124912/Pochi) and [Tama](https://anilist.co/character/124914/Tama) after leaving the labyrinth. Her forename is derived from he

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Arisa
description:
First seen in a carriage carrying 10 female slaves.[ Satou ](https://anilist.co/character/124921/Ichiro-Suzuki)purchased her from a Slave Trader, Nidoren, along with her older half-sister, [Lulu](https://anilist.co/character/124918/Lulu). She hid her skills before she was bought in order to prevent being purchased. She took a liking to Satou when she first saw him due to him being a young teenage male. She subsequently used her mind magic to brainwash Satou to buy her.
Her violet hair and irises are considered a bad omen, and it might be the reason she was unsold as a slave.

appearsIn.title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody

name: Tama
description:
Originally a nameless slave known simply as "Cat" belonging to a man named [Urs](https://anilist.co/character/188389/Urs), but became master-less after his death. She was given the name "Tama" by [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/124921/Ichiro-Suzuki) during the events of the labyrinth and became his slave after leaving the labyrinth.
Tama considers [Pochi](https://anilist.co/character/124912/Pochi) as her younger sister despite the fact that she is a Cat demi-human and Pochi is a Dog demi-human.

 Nozomi has developed a "compass" that allows her to see a light that indicates a point anywhere.

Mizuho's power was thought to be "Nyamazon", which allows cats to bring her whatever she wants. It was later revealed that this was just the power of her cats.

Her Creator, the planner of "Avalken of Reminisce," is already deceased.

She claims to do this in order to overthrow their creators and force them to improve the living conditions of their worlds. However, she is actually aiming for the destruction of the real world.

She is capable of flying and manipulating dozens of swords through telekinesis at once for both attack and defense.

He is not interested in making his creator alter his world, being fine with the way he is.


Though he remains independent at first, he came to the aid of Souta's group against Altair's faction several times and eventually joins them.

A child soldier in his world, Rui was constantly thrust into battle, having never had the chance to enjoy life or even go out on a date. He is thus relieved that the real world is much more peaceful. He is attracted to girls younger than him.

The siblings were abandoned by their parents at a young age and Ichika was raised by his sister thereafter. Ichika has a habit of personally assessing the situation with interior monologues as well as being easily out-guessed about his tactics. As the first (and thus far only) male IS pilot, his new reputation has made him somewhat famous. He pilots the Byakushiki IS. He is also considered to be fairly dense as he doesn't realize the feelings of those around hi

A genetically engineered super soldier, Laura is a member of the German military and holds the rank of second lieutenant. She has one red eye, long silver hair, and a black eye patch over her left eye. Laura was under Chifuyu's guidance when the latter was working with the German army's IS divison and holds Chifuyu in high regard. Of all of the cast members, she is perhaps the most open to physical interaction with him (although this mostly platonic physical interaction). During her stay in Japan, Ichika would visit her family's restaurant as his sister was out at work most of the time and she is a n

**Age**: 13

Pazu is an orphan who lives alone in a small hut atop a hill in Slag Ravine. While no mention is made of his mother, his father was an avid aviator who, though no one had believed him, had previously discovered and photographed the floating kingdom of Laputa. After his death, Pazu swore that he would find Laputa and prove his father right.

Pazu has brown hair and brown eyes. He wears a white shirt and orange vest, blue pants that are patched at the knee, a yellow cap, and brown laced boots.

Pazu is an energetic, amicable young boy with a heart of gold, always willing to help out

Muska has light brown hair and hazel eyes. He wears tinted glasses, a brown suit, a white shirt, and a pale yellow cravat. He is armed with what seems to be a Webley Mk VI revolver.

Muska is cold, calculating and duplicitous, and will turn on his allies once he has used them to attain his goals.

Muska is biologically related to Sheeta and a descendant of the royal line of Laputa. He believes that he is entitle

Sheeta is a 13-year-old orphan farm girl. After falling from the sky, she is saved by an orphan named [Pazu](https://anilist.co/character/8524/Pazu).

She at first insists on being on her own due to the danger her very company presents and out of fear of causing damage to Pazu or his hometown. Despite her taciturn and shy personality, Sheeta is polite, kind, and intelligent.

Sheeta is the rightful princess of Laputa. She possesses an Aetherium crystal, which can save her in

name: Mitsumi Iwakura
description: First-year high school student who moved to Tokyo from the outskirts of Ishikawa Prefecture near Suzu. Raised a child prodigy, she entered high school at the top of her class; however, she has no athletic ability. Her pure personality unintentionally influences the people around her. She has a younger sister and brother.

name: Sousuke Shima
description: [Mitsumi](https://anilist.co/character/138851/Iwakura-Mitsumi)'s classmate who is popular with girls. He is known for sabotaging the entrance ceremony and skipping classes. Though he planned to skip the entrance ceremony, he meets Mitsumi and they run to school together.

name: Mika Egashira
description: Mitsumi's classmate who approached her after Mitsumi became friends with Sousuke. Mitsumi's pure nature inspired her to face her complexes. She develops a caring relationship with Mitsumi.

name: Yuzuki Murashige
description: [Mitsumi](https://anilist.co/character/138851/Iwakura-Mitsumi)'s classmate and her first friend in Tokyo. Her popularity among boys made her develop a complex about being shunned by other girls. She studied abroad in her childhood and has blonde hair, so people assume she is good at English, but according to herself she is not that good at it.

name: Makoto Kurume
description: Mitsumi's classmate. She is introverted and worries about becoming isolated; she meets Mitsumi when she joined the student council to join some kind of community. Despite not liking flirtatious people, she meets Yuzuki through Mitsumi and they become close friends.

name: Shizuku Yaegashi
description:
Kaori's best friend. She's the childhood friend of Kouki and her family runs a dojo.

Shizuku is a hardworking, kind and caring girl who passes her time on practicing her swordsmanship. She is regarded as a cool and stoic beauty, but actually has a girlish side that likes cute things, such as the color pink, as well as cute animals like cats and bunnies. She has often hid her true feelings and would put up a brave face, as a front so other people did not worry about her.

name: Haruyuki Arita
description:
He is a middle school student and is overweight. He has been bullied for many years and because of that likes to go to places where no one is like the squash game on the local network at school. 

One day he had an encounter with the school's most beautiful, refined girl, "[Kuroyukihime](https://anilist.co/character/46305/Kuroyukihime)", which changed his life abruptly. Introduced to the software she transmitted, Haruyuki learned about "Accel World", a program that enhances one's mind capabilities, with certain side-effects of him becoming Silver Crow and seriously changing his life. description:

__Height__: 159 cm (5'3")

The main female protagonist and leader of the Nega Nebulus legion, her real name is unknown. Her pseudonym is Japanese word play with Snow White. Beautiful and popular, she is also the Student Council Vice-President at Umesato Junior High School. She has been a Burst Linker since she was eight years old.

description:

 __Height__: 156 cm (5'1")

[Haru](https://anilist.co/character/49637/Arita-Haruyuki)'s and [Taku](https://anilist.co/character/49631/Mayuzumi-Takumu)'s childhood friend. Although she is dating Takumu, she also cares a lot for Haru. Her non-accelerated avatar is a catgirl.

In volume 3 of the light novel, she decides to become a Burst Linker with Taku being her 'parent'. Her Duel Avatar's name is Lime Bell. It is a unique avatar because it has the special ability to restore HP, an ability only shared by 2 other Burst Linkers, one

name: Naoya Mukai
description:
**Height:** 170 cm (5'7")

Naoya is considered to be a very straightforward and outgoing person. His straightforward personality is very explicit and knows no bounds; Naoya is straightforward regardless of his situation, be it in front of the mass crowd or in private with his girlfriends. Additionally, Naoya can be considered slightly selfish for he openly asks his first girlfriend, [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki), whether he can two-time her and go out with [Minase Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/162885/Minase-Nagisa).

description:
**Height:** 161 cm (5'3")

Saki Saki is [Mukai Naoya](https://anilist.co/character/162887/Mukai-Naoya)'s girlfriend. She is one of the female protagonist of Kanojo mo Kanojo series, along with Naoya's other girlfriend [Minase Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/162885/Minase-Nagisa).

Saki is stated to be a cheerful and energetic girl. She is also an emotional, naive and forgetful girl. She excels in sports and can be openly aggressive against anyone, mostly Mukai Naoya, whose actions are a bit too much.

name: Nagisa Minase
description:
**Height:** 155 cm (5'1")

Minase Nagisa is [Mukai Naoya](https://anilist.co/character/162887)'s girlfriend. She is one of the female protagonist of Kanojo mo Kanojo series, along with Naoya's other girlfriend [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886)

Nagisa is shown to be a collected, considerate and humble girl. She seems to have no talent, often working hard to stay on her classmates average. Despite her considerate personality, she would resort to underhanded tactics, even to the point of cheating, to preserve her relationship with Mukai Naoya. Nagisa has been shown to have a lack

name: Rika Hoshizaki
description: Hoshizaki Rika, also known as her alternate name Mirika, is a popular virtual content creator on MeTube, and is persistently pursuing over [Naoya's](https://anilist.co/character/162887/Mukai-Naoya) affection for her. She is a first year high school student who attends the same school as [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki) and Naoya.

name: Shino Kiryuu
description:
Shino is a close friend of [Saki Saki](https://anilist.co/character/162886/Saki-Saki). They are in the same class and the same after school club. Shino is serious and considerate, and also academically talented, being the top scoring student at school.

After learning [Naoya](https://anilist.co/character/162887/Mukai-Naoya) and Saki Saki were both on a two-time relationship with [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/162885/Minase-Nagisa), she decided to expose their relationship, and attempt to end it, in order to help Saki, believing it was hurting her feelings. However she also has feelings

name: Eita Kidou
description: The main character and a first year high school student. He aims to attend medical school after graduating from high school. Eita is very smart and always places at the top of the class during term exams. He doesn't like romance and love, as he calls himself "anti-romance." However, there is a reason for this: his parents divorced to search for 'the real one' and left him alone, never appearing before him again. This is why he lives with his aunt, Saeko-san.

name: Masuzu Natsukawa
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm 
 __Weight:__ 52 kg  
__Likes:__ Jojo's Bizarre Adventure  

Masuzu is [Eita](https://anilist.co/character/48997/Kidou-Eita)'s classmate and his girlfriend. A first year high school student, who spent nine years overseas. She is considered to be the school beauty and is constantly confessed to by male students before she forms a fake relationship. She is bold and acts more evil out of school and she is very devious. Like [Chiwa](https://anilist.co/character/48999/Harusaki-Chiwa), she is a terrible cook.  Like Eita, she actually hates romance and only blackmails him to be her

name: Chiwa Harusaki
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4' 9")

Eita's childhood friend and neighbour who is in love with him, and a 1st year Highschool student. Her friends often call her 'chihuahua' (Chiwawa), due to her petite appearance and two ponytails that resemble puppy's ears. She used to be in Kendo Club until the last year of junior highschool due to a critical injury. She is tomboy, who loves eating and meat, as she thinks about food from dawn till dusk. She want's to be popular with males, and constantly fights Masuzu for Eita's efforts. She is also a terrible cook.

name: Ai Fuyuumi
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5' 2")  
__Relatives:__ Yuki Fuyuumi (Younger Brother), Daigoro Fuyuumi (Father)

She is an uptight and by the book member of the Student Council's Hallway Monitoring Committee, it is hinted that she often reprimands [Chiwa](https://anilist.co/character/48999/Harusaki-Chiwa) due to her rowdy behavior along the hallways. Ai is talented at cooking. She and [Eita](https://anilist.co/character/48997/Kidou-Eita)'s friend, [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/75772/Asoi-Kaoru), were classmates in elementary school.

Ai is Eita's fiancée. She is also actually his childhood friend,

description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5')  
__Weight:__ 46 kg (101 lbs)  
__Likes:__ Video games  

A mysterious, black-haired girl who is actually a chuunibyo. She sent Eita letters and messages so she could finally see him. Himeka calls herself "Himekashizuka Heaven's Rain" while being in chuuni mode, and tells that her name from past life was "Burning Princess Saint Dragon Lady of Dawn".  She has a one-sided crush for Eita, and says that she is his former girlfriend.
