name: Astolfo
description:
**Height:** 164 cm

Rider of Black is the Rider-class Servant of [Selenik Icecol Yggdmillennia](https://anilist.co/character/122393/Icecolle-Yggdmillennia-Celenike) as part of the Black Faction in the Turifas Holy Grail War of Fate/Apocrypha.  Black Rider's identity is Astolfo, the Twelfth Paladin of Charlemagne.

In the Charlemagne Legend, he is the son of an English king, and one of [Charlemagne](https://anilist.co/character/259823/Charlemagne)'s twelve faithful Paladins. He is beautiful beyond all compare, but he is also a frightfully unparalleled blabbermouth, prone to speaking on and on u

name: Jeanne  d'Arc
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3)

Ruler's True Name is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War.

A Ruler Class Servant is the Standard-Bearer who Correctly Guides the Holy Grail War. Jeanne is a special Heroic Spirit summoned by the Holy Grail itself to act as the administrator of the Holy Grail War instead of the Church. Being summoned in the Ruler class also allows her to retain the memories of each repeating "game" unlike other Servants.

Jeanne d'Arc was a common farmer's daughter. She c

name: Sieg
description:
Sieg was created by Yggdmillennia as one of their many homunculi suited to various purposes. Initially kept in a prana supply tank devised by Gordes Musik Yggdmillennia to grant energy for Servants, he was one of many allowed to be used by Caster of Black for usage as harvesting materials for his golems. Due to his unexpectedly high quality Magic Circuits, he was thought to be a good choice for Caster's Golem Keter Malkuth.

Sieg comes into consciousness without anything to form a personality. He is scared of everything but himself, believing to be nothing. He calls himself transparent and col

name: Andy
description:
Andy is member no. 9 of the Round Table. He is a Negator with the alias Undead. His original personality is that of Victor.

Andy is a deuteragonist along with Fuuko Izumo.

Andy is insanely reckless, he enjoys attempting to die and is always looking for new methods of death. He also has a soft spot for Fuuko, who he is very protective of and gets very angry when she is hurt, to the point where he will willingly remove the card in his head to release Victor. 

Andy is a tall and muscular man, with white combed back hair. He has a card in his forehead above his left eye which causes his eye to

name: Fuuko Izumo
description: __Age:__ 190+ in the 101st Loop

name: Kazuhiko Nukumizu
description: Kazuhiko is a student in Class 1-C at Tsuwabuki High School and the president of the Literature Club. He is fairly intelligent and quite experienced in handling girls' issues due to taking care of his little sister. He also has a terrible sense of style, much to the chagrin of his more popular and fashionable friend, [Anna Yanami](https://anilist.co/character/230873/Anna-Yanami).

name: Anna Yanami
description: A first-year student at Tsuwabuki High School and one of the loser heroines. She is a popular girl in [Kazuhiko](https://anilist.co/character/230874)'s class with a bright and charming personality as well as a big appetite, often bickering with Kazuhiko when he says anything to her about gaining weight.

name: Lemon Yakishio
description: A first-year student of Tsuwabuki High School. She's the ace of the Female Track and Field Team and also a member of the Literature Club. She has romantic feelings for her long-time friend [Mitsuki Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/341640/) and is currently friends with Ayano's girlfriend [Chihaya Asagumo](https://anilist.co/character/341637/).

name: Chika Komari
description: A first-year student at Tsuwabuki High and a member of the Literature Club, she is an avid web/light novel reader and writer. Behind her timid and awkward exterior lies a hardworking girl who deeply cares for her siblings and treasures her closest relationships.

name: Dok-Ja Kim
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

He is the sole reader of the webnovel Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World (AKA 'Ways of Survival'), an apocalyptic fantasy story written by tls123.

name: Jung-Hyeok Yu
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm

Yoo Joonghyuk is the main character of tls123's novel Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World.

Throughout Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint, he is seen in his 1863rd, 1864th (believed to be his 3rd), and 1865th regressions.

name: Su-Yeong Han
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

Han Su-Yeong is first shown to have a selfish personality, prioritizing her own interests over anything else. However, throughout the story she grows closer to the members of , gradually coming to  value each of them. Han Su-Yeong is a very confident, intelligent, and witty person, constantly insulting and joking around with her companions, but she gets angry very easily when others do stupid things. Similar to [Yu Jung-Hyeok](https://anilist.co/character/180892/), she will berate the people she cares about even as she tries her hardest to keep them safe. When [Kim Dok-Ja](

name: Shounen Bat
description: The enigmatic figure the series revolves around. He appears as a grinning, baseball cap-wearing juvenile who travels on golden inline skates and attacks people with a gold-colored metal baseball bat that is curiously bent.

name: Tsukiko Sagi
description: One of the central characters of the series, she is a famous, but timid, character designer best known for a cartoonish dog named Maromi. She carries a plush toy copy of Maromi everywhere. She is Shounen Bat's first apparent victim in the series, and the catalyst who jump-starts the plot.

name: Keiichi Ikari
description:
Keiichi Ikari is a detective in charge of the Shounen Bat case alongside [Mitsuhiro Maniwa](https://anilist.co/character/5131/). In comparison to his coworker, Maniwa, Keiichi is very old fashioned and prefers to do things simplistically. He's extremely uptight and easily frustrated. He is impatient and doesn't try to work with the witnesses and victims of his case and gets upset at Mitsuhiro's attempts to be understanding.

Husband of [Misae Ikari](https://anilist.co/character/12387/).

name: Mitsuhiro Maniwa
description:
Mitsuhiro works with [Keiichi Ikari](https://anilist.co/character/5130/) in the Metal Bat case, and is often the more understanding of the two. He has a very gentle personality and questions Keiichi's hastiness in his mind. It is thanks to Mitsuhiro that they've been able to get through to many of the witnesses and victims of Metal Bat's attacks.

He is the first to see the pattern among the victims, and to realize that the Bat can appear in two places at once.

name: Göll
description:
__Species:__ Demigod

Göll is the youngest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the deuteragonist of the series. During the Ragnarok matches, she is usually seen with Brunhilde anxiously watching each match.

She's usually anxious and worried about many things to the point that it gets on Brunhilde's and Hrist's nerves. Whenever humanity's warriors die, she cries and mourns each of her sisters as they die with them.
As an apprentice valkyrie, she doesn't seem all that interested in saving humanity compared to worrying about her sisters.

name: Brunhilde
description:
__Species__: Demigod

Brunhilde is the eldest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the main protagonist of the series.

She is the one who chose humanity's finest and strongest warriors in Ragnarok to stand up against the strongest gods in combat and slay them in an attempt to save Humanity.

name: Adam
description:
Adam was a very calm, collected, and carefree individual; speaking to Zeus in a very casual manner, much to the chagrin of the other gods present.
We later find out that Adam holds no grudge against heaven, despite the fact the Serpent assaulted Eve and then framed her when he was elsewhere, resulting in humanity's banishment from Eden. However, at the same time, he did not hesitate to kill the Serpent the moment he attacked them.

Adam loved Eve, so much so that he abandoned the paradise of Eden without a second thought when his wife was banished.

Adam displayed selflessness to the highest d

name: Thor
description:
__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Similar to Lü Bu, Thor is a battle maniac and takes great interest in fighting; especially with strong and/or worthy opponents. Furthermore, he only shows happiness and joy in combat, displaying his finest smile in the first round of Ragnarok. Thor is also a man of few words, not speaking unless absolutely necessary or when in combat. He often does not show this and has a more stoic and aloof expression on his face most of the time, making him seem unapproachable to others.

Thor is the Gods' representative in the first round of Ragnarok.

name: Zeus
description:
__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Zeus is a prominent deity and the Supreme God in the Greek Pantheon. He is also the chairman of the Gods' Council and often referred to as the "God Father of Cosmos"

When addressing his fellow gods, Zeus is extremely calm and authoritative while possessing a very formal and wise disposition. Like most gods, Zeus holds his own kind to a superior and extremely high standard, always expecting them to win no matter the odds, and seething with anger when they lose to humans. Zeus is also an eccentric individual, having random exaggerated emotional outbursts,

name: Bu Lü
description: Lü Bu, the Flying General was the strongest warrior of The Three Kingdoms. Humanity's vanguard and representative in the first round of Ragnarok.

name: Kojirou Sasaki
description: Kojiro Sasaki's a famous swordsman from Japan, known as "History's Greatest Loser". Kojiro Sasaki is Humanity's representative in the third round of Ragnarok.

name: Poseidon
description:
Poseidon is a prominent deity in the Greek Pantheon as the God of the Seas.

Poseidon is the Gods' representative in the third round of Ragnarok.

name: Ilse Langnar
description:
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Soldier. 

Ilse Langnar was a member of the Scout Regiment. She was a participant of the 34th expedition beyond the Walls and was in charge of the left wing of the second brigade who went MIA. In a notebook, she documented information regarding an [Abnormal Titan](https://anilist.co/character/133213/Abnormal-Titan) she encountered, which later was discovered and aided in [Hange Zoë's](https://anilist.co/character/71121/Hange-Zoe) research. 

Ilse appeared to be quite emotional, yet brave, attempting to stand firm in moments of despair. She seemed to be a very dev

name: Nariyuki Yuiga
description: Yuiga has been appointed by the principal as [Rizu](https://anilist.co/character/121776) and [Fumino](https://anilist.co/character/121775)'s tutor to get them into their desired universities. Later is also asked to tutor [Uruka](https://anilist.co/character/121778).

name: Fumino Furuhashi
description:
**Height:** 165cm

Fumino is a genius with liberal arts but terrible with math. Left-handed. She is a blue-haired girl whose dream is to be able to reach for the stars just as how her mother dreamt of studying the stars. Her father is a professor and teaches Math, but she genetically relates to her mother where they both can't do math. Along with being one of the main heroines of the series, she teaches [Yuiga](https://anilist.co/character/121777) about the feelings of a woman, not knowing that she would later fall for him in the series. She is quite insecure with her chest size, and tends to

name: Rizu Ogata
description:
**Height:** 143cm

Rizu is a genius with math and science but terrible with liberal arts.

Rizu is one of the four students that is being tutored by Yuiga in Liberal Arts. She is smart when it comes to Science and Math, but is terrible with liberal arts. She is also terrible at understanding people's feelings and reading the mood of the conversation. She tends to see everything in a logical manner whenever something related to emotions such love and awkwardness arise.

name: Uruka Takemoto
description: Uruka is a genius when it comes to sports, having earned several titles in freestyle swimming, but her lazy nature and hatred for studying has made her terrible with her other academics.

name: Mafuyu Kirisu
description:
Student Counselor at [Yuiga](https://anilist.co/character/121777)'s school and one of [Rizu](https://anilist.co/character/121776) and [Fumino](https://anilist.co/character/121775)'s ex-tutors.

She is a pink-haired individual whose clumsiness (ie. misplacing her keys and a messy house) and being reckless (ie. Can drive at "normal levels" in which it frightens Yuiga) is part of her overall personality. Being a person who isn't close to her parents, she was once a professional skater until she abruptedly stopped due to the fact that her parents had the expectation of being a skater when she only

name: Asumi Kominami
description: Part-time worker at a maid café called High Stage and classmates with [Yuiga](https://anilist.co/character/121777) at a summer cram school.

name: Natsuno Yuuki
description:
Natsuno lives and attends school in Sotoba. He hates living in the village and prefers to be in the city. Originally a city dweller, Natsuno reluctantly moves to Sotoba with his parents when they wanted a change of environment. He often exhibits a cold exterior, especially disliking Megumi Shimizu's presence, who has a crush on him and is obsessed(to the point where she stalks him). He is kind and friendly toward those whom he considers his friends (Tooru, Kaori, Akira and Tooru's younger siblings)  Natsuno is one of the two main protagonists in the series.   

His best friend Tooru is forced

name: Toshio Ozaki
description: The dean of the hospital in Sotoba, Toshio resigned from university hospital, returning to take up his father's position when he passed away. He is fondly given a nickname, "Waka-sensei", by his colleagues as well as the residents. Toshio has a dislike to both his mother and his late father, as both of them often put reputation of the Ozaki family before anything else. He is childhood friends with Seishin Muroi and Mikiyasu Yasumori. Toshio is a chain smoker and is married to Kyouko who manages an antique shop. He is baffled by the mysterious deaths and swears to solve the case and protect his

name: Seishin Muroi
description:
Seishin is the local priest in Sotoba, as well as an author in writing novels. His latest work is called Shiki, which translated in English is called Corpse Demon. He has a sense of the supernatural and detects the presence of the real "shiki." He is childhood friends with Toshio Ozaki and Mikiyasu Yasumori. He is single and once attempted to commit suicide in a drunken state during his university days.     

He befriends Sunako during her nightly visits to his place. Although he eventually comes to discover the nature of the deaths in the village like Ozaki Toshio, unlike Toshio, Se

name: Sunako Kirishiki
description: A young girl who moves into the Kanemasa mansion atop the hill with her family. She has a rare genetic disorder known as SLE, which leads her to stay inside her home during the day and only come out at night. She and her family are fans of the essays and novels written by Seishin Muroi, and is the reason they moved to Sotoba. Sunako dislikes people calling her name with the honorific "chan".    Sunako was originally a beloved daughter of a well-off family. She was bitten by a vampire Western noble, who was a guest of her family, and died. When she revived as a Shiki, her family kept her confin

name: Gabriel Tenma White
native: 天真・ガヴリール・ホワイト
description:
__Height:__ 144 cm

Gabriel is the main protagonist of the story and an angel who was the top of her class but turned into a 'Faillen Angel' after her newfound addiction to video games.

name: Satanichia Kurumizawa McDowell
native: 胡桃沢・サタニキア・マクドウェル
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

The self proclaimed "Future Queen of Hell". Satanichia is a dimwitted demon who often thinks of petty ways to cause mischief which usually end in failure. She is often pestered by both [Raphiel](https://anilist.co/character/120938) and [a dog](https://anilist.co/character/133465).

name: Vignette Tsukinose April
native: 月乃瀬・ヴィネット・エイプリル
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

The complete opposite of [Gabriel](https://anilist.co/character/120937/Tenma-White-Gabriel), Vignette is very responsible and often has to look after Gabriel, who lives in the same building as her, contrary to her actual role as a demon.

name: Raphiel Shiraha Ainsworth
native: 白羽・ラフィエル・エインズワース
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Raphiel is the second-ranked angel in Gabriel's class, who has since become a sadistic stalker who takes delight in teasing Satanichia and causing chaos for entertainment.

(Source: Gabriel DropOut Wiki)

name: Ougi Oshino
description:
Ougi appears to be a girl with short black hair, black pupils, and pale white skin. She is a junior of [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) at Naoetsu Private High School. Ougi often talks to Koyomi about oddities, and helping him remember what he knows. Her catchphrase is, "I don't know anything, Araragi-senpai. It's you who knows."

Ougi is mysterious and can come off as spooky/creepy. She also speaks in a condescending tone towards Koyomi and [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Furthermore, Ougi is capable of pulling off many thing

name: Sodachi Oikura
description:
[Koyomi Araragi's](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Araragi-Koyomi) childhood friend. She is a student with a strong sense of competitiveness which led to her popular nickname, much to her chagrin.

Sodachi was the president of a first-year class where both [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Senjougahara-Hitagi) and Koyomi also belonged to. At school, she wanted to be called as "Euler", but ends up getting the nickname "How Much", a pun on her surname and a reference to her personality.

When she tried to figure out the culprit who stole the answers for the mathematics test, everyon

name: Michiru Kagemori
description:
A tanuki-human high school student who secretly escaped to Anima City. She is communicative and has a bright and cheerful personality.

(Source: Official Website)

name: Nazuna  Hiwatashi
description: A close friend of the main character, Michiru Kagemori.

name: Shirou Oogami
description: A social worker Wolf Beastman. He despises humans and fights for the rights of Beastmen.

name: Mirai Kakehashi
description: He was raised by his abusive uncle and aunt after his family were killed in a car crash. The abuse he endured resulted in him trying to commit suicide by throwing himself from a tower block, but he was saved by [Nasse](https://anilist.co/character/89232).

name: Nasse
description:
Nasse is [Mirai](https://anilist.co/character/89231/Kakehashi-Mirai)'s life saving's angel, and as such, knows everything Mirai has been through, everything which is related to him, notably his being being mentally abused by his aunt and uncle since they have been fostering him.

After that, they found out that the radar intergraded into his software. description:
Dera Mochimazzi is a bird that speaks in Japanese, with a little bossy tone. It seems that he is a noble bird that came from a tropical place. He later stays at Tamako's house.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kanna Makino
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0") 

Kanna is a high school student in the same year as her friends, [Tamako](https://anilist.co/character/74850/Kitashirakawa-Tamako) and [Midori](https://anilist.co/character/75080/Tokiwa-Midori), and is a member of the baton club. She is the daughter of a carpenter who works in the same shopping district as Tamako and her family. A relaxed and laid back girl, Kanna does not care what anyone else thinks and is not easily swayed, however she does have a fear of heights.

description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") 

Tamako is a first-year in high school whose family runs a mochi shop in their town's shopping district called Tama-ya. She enjoys her high school life and the baton club with her friends Kanna and Midori. She helps her family run the shop and invent new kinds of mochi.

description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") 

Midori is Tamako's classmate, childhood friend, and baton club member. Her grandparents, whom she lives with, own and run a toy shop in the town's shopping district. Midori feels the need to "take care" of Tamako, so much that she feels she may be in love with her.

name: Mochizou Ooji
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Mochizou is Tamako's childhood friend whose family runs Ouji-ya, a mochi shop located across from Tama-ya. Though their fathers are not on good terms due to business competition, he and Tamako are good friends. He is in love with Tamako.

name: Ryuu  Lion
description:
__Race:__ Elf
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Ryuu Lion is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility.

Ryuu was a member of a family that cared for the sacred tree in their home forest of Ryumilua. As time passed, she began to think that beautiful Elves were the ugliest of all people, due to seeing her fellow Elves' behavior toward those of other races. No matter how much she tried to forget it, once she began thinking about it, the thought firmly planted itself in her mind. Eventually, the thought became enough to make her decide to leave the forest.

Ryuu is calm and stoic but also cares deeply for

He lost his job but became an adventurer and wants to pass the exam to enter the Hero Academy. He gained a lot of new skills and abilities from [Olivia Servant](https://anilist.co/character/187862/Servant-Olivia), his master trapped in the Unending Dungeon. A Cleric of the church, Luna is seen as a saint for using her healing skills on people while listening to their problems, but she fears that using her skills will lead to a premature death like her mother's. Luna is Lola's best friend and a solo adventurer. Luna is convinced that it is her mission to save people and make them smile. She is usually a very dignified person but reveals a strange expression when Luna passes out and murmurs what she really feels.

description: An ordinary high school student who just dreams of something special. description: Leader of the Lingle Kingdom Lifesaving Team. She is a healing magician, but her combat abilities are very high, and she once served as a battalion commander of the Knights. She forces Usato, her healing magician, to join the lifesaving group and trains him as her right-hand man.

Kojou was a normal high school student 3 months ago, until the original 4th primogenitor had released her spirit into him because of a wish she had granted him. It's possible they made a deal.

description:
A mysterious feline spirit. 

Madara was sealed in a shrine until he was accidentally released by Natsume. Because Madara was trapped in a material form for so long, Madara ordinary takes on the shape of a maneki neko (lucky cat), leading Natsume to nickname him Nyanko-sensei. In this form, other people can see him, leading for Natsume having to ask his guardians if he could keep him as a pet.   

Madara is a powerful spirit, who protects Natsume from others and teaches him spells on occasion, in return for Natsume's promise to give him the Book of Friends when he dies. They often fight each o

description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")

Natsume Takashi is the main protagonist of the series who, like his deceased grandmother [Natsume Reiko](https://anilist.co/character/13886/Natsume-Reiko), has the ability to see ayakashi (spirits). He inherited the Book of Friends from her, a book of contracts binding ayakashi to servitude when they were defeated by Reiko. To rid himself of these troubles, Natsume resolved to end the book by returning all t

She eventually confesses her love to Raidou.

name: Kazuki Kurusu
description:
[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/fantastic_sweeper0516/)

Kazuki lives with his colleague and buddy [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/289969/Suwa-Rei), who also looks after his personal needs. Contracting, gathering information in advance, and making execution plans are the main areas of work with Rei. He likes women and gambling and he has good communication skills. He is skilled at cooking and cleaning, and he occasionally chastises Rei for his indulgent lifestyle. 

He was previously married and had a wife who was pregnant with his child, but he lost her due to his shady work.

name: Rei Suwa
description:
Rei is a man of few words who doesn't mind that [Kazuki](https://anilist.co/character/289968/Kurusu-Kazuki) has already moved into his house. He is physically strong, and his fighting abilities and marksmanship are among the best in the industry. He has a clear separation between his professional and personal lives and spends most of his time at home playing video games. His family is a large underworld family, and his parents have been training him as a gifted assassin since he was a child. 

He has not been able to escape the family feud and has no comprehension of normal parent-child relati

description: Miri is an innocent girl who is just as energetic and fearless. Her father is a mafia boss and a major broker for a human trafficking organization. Her mother is the mistress of the boss. When she arrives at the hotel in search of her father, she becomes involved in a gunfight and is rescued by Kazuki. She is friendly and refers to Kazuki as "Papa Kazuki" and Rei as "Papa Rei".

description:
**Height:** 167.5 cm (5’6”)

Makoto Ito is the protagonist of the series. Though he is initially casual, gregarious and understanding, his addiction to sex over time corrupts his personality and he instead becomes more apathetic, rash and egotistical towards others, regardless of interpersonal harm or later consequence. However, once he truly knows he has done wrong, he is quick in his

She then helps him get close to Kotonoha despite harboring strong feelings for him.

Due to her striking appearance, she's always been somewhat frightened of boys. She is disliked by the girls in her class, and distanced from the boys, who restrain each other from approaching her. Having taken an interest in Makoto as he watches her from afar, she decides to accept when he confesses with the help of Sekai's mediation.

Ruby Tojo is a witch from the human world who was part of a plot to destroy mankind as a response to a large garbage dump polluting her mistress' sanctuary. Her hate for humans stems from a car accident caused by a human drunk driver that took her parents' lives while the family was vacationing in the human world. Upon remembering the kind of love her parents had given her, she attempts to persuade her mistress to call off her plan but to no avail, as her mistress was bent on destroying the human world. description: Ginei Morioka nicknamed "Gin" for short, is a werewolf and the president of the Newspaper Club who speaks in an Osakan dialect. He is a second (later third)-year student at Yokai Academy and a shameless peeping tom who initially began as an antagonist to Tsukune, but becomes somewhat of an older brother/guardian to him and his friends. He ceases his schemes so other students will stop calling him a pervert, but remains unchanged in the anime. description:
**Height:** 168 cm (5'6")

The main character of the story. As the youngest son of a soldier, Kazuya has spent most of his life struggling with living in his highly successful siblings' shadows. Jealous of all the attention his brothers got, he worked hard to compete, but everything changed when he understood that adults, who think that the youngest child is always spoiled and useless, will never acknowledge his efforts. name: Yutaka Hoshino
description:
Peco is a member of the Katase High table tennis club, along with his best friend [Smile](https://anilist.co/character/20325/Tsukimoto-Makoto). Unlike his friend, Peco is very charismatic and has a real passion towards Ping Pong. Peco dreams of becoming the Ping Pong world champion, and claims that he'll move to Europe to start playing professionally after he graduates.

 In the epilogue, it is revealed that Peco loves playing ping pong again and competes in competitions regularly.

name: Makoto Tsukimoto
description:
Smile is a member of the Katase High table tennis club, along with his best friend [Peco](https://anilist.co/character/20326/Hoshino-Yutaka). Unlike the other members of the club, Smile thinks of the sport as a job or a way to pass time. He does not try to enjoy it for fun and often lets less able players beat him out of consideration for their feelings. The other members of the club nicknamed him Smile because he never does.

In the epilogue, he becomes a ping pong coach for kids and new players.

She is unaware of how impressive her life is compared to the average person, as it is completely normal to her.

Obsessed with disassembling objects, Annasui grew up a bit awkward during his childhood days. He painstakingly dissected a pocket watch, his neighbor's car, and whatever else that struck his fancy. One day while returning from work, he found his girlfriend cheating on him with another man. In response, he methodically tore both of them apart. He often attempts to become someone big in various areas like: soccer, acting, etc. but he lacks all kind of talent and fails at everything, including simple things as map reading.

description:
Benio first comes off as a cold, quiet person, who dislikes talking and is easily irritated. However, regarding exorcism she is very passionate and can be very talkative. Since she comes from an important family, honor and pride are both very important to her. She is also very competitive, especially around [Rokuro](https://anilist.co/character/89537/Enmadou-Rokuro), and since she was taught to never back out from her words, she can be pretty stubborn and will use any argument to win.

Later on, Benio seems to be able to show her feelings comfortably compared to when she first met Rokuro, and

name: Ayumu Fujino
description: Fujino is a fourth grader who draws 4-panel manga strips for the elementary school's newspaper. Her talent as well as her funny stories are praised by her classmates. But one day, she is challenged by the skilled drawings of a truant student from next-door class, and becomes determined to improve her art.

name: Kyomoto
description: Kyomoto is a truant student in fourth grade. Because she doesn't show up to school, she practices drawing at home relentlessly. One day, her art gets published alongside [Fujino](https://anilist.co/character/286677)'s in the elementary school's newspaper, which began a one-sided rivalry.

name: Yuki Takeya
description:
Yuki Takeya is the main protagonist of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a former senior student at Megurigaoka Private High School and a member of the School Life Club, where she, as the most cheerful and optimistic person, comes up with club activities and brings comfort among the club despite their surroundings.

Yuki is oblivious to the fact that she is in the midst of a zombie apocalypse and the "activities" of the club are survival missions. Not wanting to disturb her already fragile mental state, the other girls go along with her ideas.

name: Kurumi Ebisuzawa
description: Kurumi Ebisuzawa is a former student at Megurigaoka Private High School and the primary "zombie killer"/strategist of the School Life Club, where her abilities prove invaluable.

name: Yuuri Wakasa
description:
Yuuri Wakasa is one of the main characters of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a former student at Megurigaoka Private High School. As the big-sister figure, Yuuri is the president of the School Life Club, where she is more commonly referred to as "Rii (-san)".
She keeps a detailed record of food, electricity, lessons, and other resources and activities. Yuuri is usually very calm and mature, and acts in a collected and proper manner. She also is quite serious, always looks after her comrades, and is not afraid to scold someone when they put themselves in danger pointlessly.

name: Miki Naoki
description:
Miki Naoki is one of the main characters of the Gakkou Gurashi! series. She is a second year student of Megurigaoka High School. She eventually joins the School Life Club as the youngest member after being rescued during the members' outing to the mall. 
Miki is very polite and kind, as she uses the honorifics and calls her seniors "senpai". Though she is usually quiet, Miki is very caring and supportive, as she comforts her friends when they feel down, and gives them words of encouragement when they need it.

Miki has had many appearances with "The Stand," a book by Stephen King, which is a p

name: Sentouin Roku-gou
description:
The man known as "Combat Agent Six" joined the Kisaragi Corporation in his first year of high school, roughly three to four years before the beginning of the story. He began working there part-time at age nineteen.

Six is a senior in the organization being the oldest member of the organization left except for the generals. That is why, when the company was on the verge of the global conquest, Six was one of the candidates to explore an alternate world similar to Earth in order to conquer it.

Six was eventually chosen, being sent to a alternate world in order to spy on it and prepare him for

name: Alice Kisaragi
description: A high-spec android developed with the latest technology the Kisaragi Corporation has to offer. Her internal reactor will melt down and self-destruct if exposed to excessive levels of violence.

name: Snow
description: A diligent woman who rose up from the slums to become captain of the Royal Guard. She's very ambitious and zealously seeks credit for accomplishments.

name: Grimm
description: She's an archbishop. She rides in a wheelchair due to a curse accidentally placed on her by herself that does not allow her to wear shoes.

name: Rose
description: A Chimera who can copy the abilities of any monster she eats, just like K*rby. She treats the dying words of her elderly creator as gospel, resulting in....rather tacky lines.

She claims to know everything, to the degree where she can predict the future; as a result, she likes to brag about this with her catchphrase, "There is nothing I don't know, I know everything." Izuko is also the younger sister of [Tooe Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/137496/Gaen-Tooe).

When others get help from her, she wishes for something in return; usually ending up with them doing her a favour.

She was the senpai of [Oshino](https://anili

While she is beautiful, she is considered too weird; her classmates refer to her as a "waste of a beauty". She has been described as a "tomboy trapped in a supermodel's body".

description:

Smart, good looking, and mature, he excells at nearly everything he does which makes him the voice of reason in the Misusawa Karuta Club. He had difficulty fitting in at Chihaya's elementary school because of his Fukui dialect and his family's poverty. His passion for karuta is inspired by his grandfather, a Meijin (master). Kaworu Nagisa is both the 17th Angel and the Fifth Child. Although classified as an Angel, Kaworu is similar to Rei Ayanami in being a Seed of Life that inhabits a human body. Despite his human form, Kaworu does not consider himself to be human, since he refers to humans as "the Lilin".

description:
Rouka Numachi is the former basketball rival and supposed arch-nemesis of Suruga Kanbaru. Though she once shared an affinity for basketball akin to Suruga, albeit as a defensive player, she would go on to sustain a leg injury that would end her endeavor in sports. The two had a falling out in middle school due to Rouka's injuries causing a rift between the two.

Her gift is called "Genome Arbor - Non Priorum". She came to Little Garden mostly due wanting more friends. In addition, she only gets angry when her friends are threatened, and is a big eater despite her appearance.

description: A rich young lady who has the ability, her Gift "Authority", to command others with her words. It also has the ability to control other gifts and strengthen its power.

description: A rabbit-eared girl who resides in Little Garden and is the one who summoned the problem children. She often tries to be serious but easily gets flustered. When using her power, her blue hair turns pink as she gains increased power.

appearsIn.title: Problem Children Are Coming From Another World, Aren't They?

name: Izayoi Sakamaki
description:
Izayoi Sakamaki is a young boy with strong psychic powers (Esper). He is always bored since no one can challenge him until he is summoned to the world of Little Garden.

Years ago, Sakamaki started a game called "Try to find me" where he would pay someone if they found him. He would go on a rampage as the world was too boring for him.  Canaria, Sakamaki's adoptive mother, discovered him 3 minutes before the time limit. She made him admit defeat then proposed that she was going to host a game with him. If she won, she would gain a son, if Sakamaki won, she would play with him for the rest of he

name: Nana Hiiragi
description:
A main character of Talentless Nana. Her talent is mind-reading. Her mind-reading ability is a lie and she's talentless. She uses logical deductions and improvisation to fake her ability.

A cute and observant, though somewhat pushy girl. Despite her mind-reading talent, she admits she's not good at reading the room. Nana Hiiragi is actually the protagonist of Talentless Nana. Cruel and calculating, she is an antiheroine who has been sent to the island by the government to stop the Talented from fostering their abilities by assassinating them one by one. Has had a personal vendetta against the

name: Kyouya Onodera
description:
Kyouya's immortality allow's him to take attacks that would usually kill someone, and it is shown when he is attacked that he can somewhat regenerate. Although he has immortality he can still feel pain to an extent.
The price of his immortality is that he can only remember the last 2 years. He writes about his experiences in notebooks, so he can read them and remember past events.

name: Nanao Nakajima
description: Can neutralize other people’s powers. After his ability mutates, he is able to neutralize the human body functions too. This can mean neutralizing their bodily functions (breathing, heartbeat, etc.). In addition, the extent of neutralizing human body functions allows him to neutralize people's moral capacity, turning them into temporary killing machines. He is essentially able to mind-control them into the killing.

name: Michiru Inukai
description:
She has a Healing ability. Although unlike normal healing, she is giving up her lifespan to heal another. Often times after she heals a major injury, she feels lightheaded and sick. Her healing was shown to be of Type Heavy Injuries as she was able to completely heal Nana having received a fatal injury.
She can do Resurrection, though it is at the cost of her life.
Her body is revealed to still be cared for. While her heart has stopped, her body is still warm even after events of the island.

name: Shinya Yukimura
description:
**Height:** 177 cm

He is a 1st-year post-graduate science and technology researcher at Saitama University who works closely with [Ayame](https://anilist.co/character/141945). After finding out that she loves him, he realizes that he knows nothing about love nor about his feelings for her, so he embarks on a series of mathematical and logical experiments with her to see if they truly love each other. He is somewhat easily embarrassed, but otherwise completely serious and logical like Ayane, keeping him stuck to her mathematical quest as well.

appearsIn.title: Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It

name: Ayame Himuro
description:
**Height:** 170 cm

She is a 1st-year post-graduate science and technology researcher at Saitama University. Having fallen in love with her academic rival [Shinya Yukimura](https://anilist.co/character/141948), she embarks on a mathematical and logical journey with him to prove this love when he demands such proof. She can be snarky, but is usually serious and logical above all else, making her stick to her quest above all else.

appearsIn.title: Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It

name: Kotonoha Kanade
description:
**Height:** 162 cm

She plays the role of a storyteller, who is close to the reader's point of view. She is constantly pushed around by [Ayame](https://anilist.co/character/141945) and [Shinya](https://anilist.co/character/141948), who are conducting insane experiments, and she goes along with them, saying what they are up to and mercilessly criticizing them in her head.

(Source: Official Site, translated, edited)

name: Ena Ibarada
description: Ena loves playing video games and doesn't really have any other motivation for work or ambitions. She also likes to mess with [Shinya](https://anilist.co/character/141948/Yukimura-Shinya) or make fun of [Kosuke](https://anilist.co/character/141947/Inukai-Kosuke), just to entertain her or bring chaos. Ena is quite smart and whimsical and sometimes acts like a cat.

appearsIn.title: Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It

name: Satou
description:
Satou is an Ajin. He is referred to by officials such as [Yuu Tosaki](https://anilist.co/character/122294/Tosaki-Yuu) as Hat (帽子, Boshi). His real name is Samuel T. Owen.

While Satou's father is British and his mother is Chinese, he himself is from the United States of America. He was part of the United States Marine Corps in the past. Before dying for the first time he had a large x-shaped scar on the left side of his face and was missing his right leg.

He is passionate about video games and gaming in general.

name: Yuu Tosaki
description:
Yuu Tosaki is a high-ranked member of the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare.

Generally, Tosaki has a commanding air about him and wears a serious expression. His answers are always short and to the point. He is also quite blunt and lacks patience.

He's quick to anger with certain triggers, such as multiple instances in which he snaps at the mispronunciation of his name - "Tozaki" as opposed to what he claims is correct, "Tosaki".

From the very start, Tosaki is shown to be morally ambiguous. It isn't above him to resort to violence through either his own force or those beneath him to get

name: Izumi Shimomura
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Izumi Shimomura is an Ajin. Her name is taken from her birth father's last name (Shimomura) and her mother's maiden name (Izumi). Her former name was Yoko Tainaka. 

Izumi is a rather quiet and reserved individual, talking mainly when informing Tosaki about something. Her answers are usually short and to the point. Even though she is an Ajin, she chose to live between humans in secret and doesn't seem to be consumed completely by resentment towards humans despite her background. She seems to be quite intelligent and understanding, both towards Tosaki and when interrogating

name: Kouji Tanaka
description:
Kouji Tanaka is the second Ajin discovered in Japan. He is a partner to Satou.

Tanaka shows a rather large resentment towards humanity after the daily torture and experiments he was subjected to during his capture. Other than this, he is rather impassive; not really getting frustrated or angry in many situations, and is completely unresponsive to bloodshed and gore.

(Source: Ajin Wiki)

name: Kei Nagai
description:
Kei Nagai is an Ajin and the main protagonist of the series.

Kei was first shown with an academic, serious personality. He is very intelligent and hardworking with ambitions to be a doctor who cures illnesses that don't yet have a cure; specifically to cure his sister [Eriko](https://anilist.co/character/290487/Nagai-Eriko).

Despite Kei's lack of emotional investment in others, he seems to have strong personal values that he tries to live by. He demonstrates gratitude for [Kaito](https://anilist.co/character/120727/Kaito)'s help and cares about his welfare. He also doesn't begrudge [Satou](h

name: Moritaka Mashiro
description:
__Horoscope:__ Aquarius
__Height:__ 171 cm 

Mashiro is a 14-year-old boy who doesn't know what to do with his life. One day his classmate Takagi finds out about his amazing drawing skills and asks him to help create a manga. He initially declines but changes his mind when Takagi helps him to ​get engaged with his crush, Azuki Miho.  He and Takagi create manga for Shonen Jump under the pen-name Ashirogi Muto. Mashiro is very talented in drawing although he is very dissatisfied with his style. He specializes in drawing fairly dark characters. His favorite manga is Ashita no Joe.

name: Akito Takagi
description:
__Height:__ 175cm (5'8.9")

Akito is a young 14-year-old who gets some of the best grades in the country and is an award-winning writer. With these brains and writing skills,​ you would think he would have a stable and bright future, but no, this boy has dreams of becoming a mangaka and he is determined to make his dream come true at any cost.   Takagi persuades Mashiro into creating a manga with him after he finds out about his amazing drawing abilities. The two work under the pen-name Ashirogi Muto. Takagi specializes in serious and realistic story lines. His favorite manga is Dragon Ball.

name: Tooru Kokonoe
description:
__Blaze:__ Shield

The male protagonist, a kind boy with an irregular Blaze. His Duo is Julie Sigtuna.

name: Julie Sigtuna
native: ユリエ・シグトゥーナ
description:
__Blaze:__ Twin Blades

A quiet girl from a foreign country in Europe, as well as a princess. The reason she came to Japan and Kouryou Academy is because she wants to get stronger to avenge her father's death, and so she seeks out Tooru for help and to teach her his Final Move.

Julie says "Yes" and "No" in Swedish: "Ja/Nej". Her Surname is also a name of a Swedish town.

name: Lilith Bristol
native: リーリス・ブリストル
description:
__Blaze:__ Rifle

A rich girl from Great Britain. She is an "Exception" that came to make Tooru, the "Irregular", her Duo partner. Lilith's hobbies include hunting and DNL (Deathnewland).

name: Miyabi Hotaka
description:
__Blaze:__ Lance

A shy, kind, and caring girl who is often panicking. Because she came from an all-girls school, she is very bad with the opposite sex (except for old men with a gentle atmosphere). Tomoe is the one who keeps supporting her when she wants to get stronger.

name: Tomoe Tachibana
description:
__Blaze:__ Kusarigama 

A smart, mature, and talented student who knows a lot about martial arts. She has a dignified atmosphere about her, and cannot tolerate laziness.

Tomoe always cares for Miyabi who's bad at interacting with men. She also often advises her friends to eat vegetables for a balanced diet and to regain stamina and power.

Her blaze is a modified kusarigama with one end a sickle and the other end having a sharp dagger like point. The chain is made up of individual shards that are not connected, but acts as if they are.

name: YoRHa 2-gou B-gata
description:
__Type:__ YoRHa B-Type (Battle model)
__Affiliation:__ YoRHa Soldiers
__Height:__ 168 cm (heels incl.)

An all-purpose battle android deployed as a member of the YoRHa Soldiers and dispatched to the surface for the 243rd Descent Operation. She specializes in close-quarters combat. She tries to follow YoRHa's regulations that emotions are prohibited, and even amongst androids of the same type, 2B is comparatively cool, calm, and collected.

name: YoRHa 9-gou S-gata
description:
__Type:__ YoRHa S-Type (Scanner model)
__Affiliation:__ YoRHa Soldiers
__Height:__ 160 cm

Of the YoRHa Aircraft Soldiers, he specializes in exploration and research. His main role is collecting information, but by making full use of his hacking, he also supports combat models like [2B](https://anilist.co/character/132494). Due to his role and characteristics, he is full of curiosity. Amongst androids of the same type, 9S is comparatively varied in his emotional expressions.

name: Clare
description:
Clare is the series' protagonist. In the beginning of the series she is number 47 of the organization's 78th generation, making her the lowest ranked claymore. She also holds the distinction of becoming the first individual to willingly become a claymore.  Her goal is revenge against the awakened being [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla).

She saves [Raki](https://anilist.co/character/2208/Raki) from a youma and takes him under her care because he reminds her of herself when she was younger.

Clare bears a striking physical resemblance to [Ikuno](https://anilist.co/charact

name: Miria
description:
__Name:__ Miria
__Alias:__ Phantom Miria
__Rank Number:__ No.6 of 78th Generation
__Type:__ Offensive
__Special attack:__ Phantom Mirage

Miria is Claymore No. 6 of the 78th generation. Her great speed leaves after-images of herself in battle, confusing the opponent, thus earning herself the nickname, "Phantom Miria." She is also skilled at teamwork and tactics. Miria has long, pale blonde hair, styled in a razor-shag cut. She has silver eyes. After the Northern Campaign, she sometimes ties it in a ponytail. Miria has superior leadership qualities. But contrary to Organization aims,

name: Raki
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Hometown:__ Doga (Lautrec)  
__Occupation:__ Swordman  
__Afiliations:__ Claymore (Ally) ∕ Seven Ghost (Ally) 
__Generation:__ [Clare](https://anilist.co/character/2188/Clare) ~ [Clarice](https://anilist.co/character/3336/Clarice) 
__Know relatives:__ [Zaki](https://anilist.co/character/35614/Zaki) (brother), Clare, [Priscilla](https://anilist.co/character/2624/Priscilla), [Isley](https://anilist.co/character/3339/Isley)

Living in his peaceful village like any ordinary boy, Raki's life is changed forever when most of his family is killed by a Yoma. When the "Claymore" Clare

name: Aoba Suzukaze
description:
__Birth Place:__ Tokyo, Japan
__Height:__ 149 cm

A high school graduate who joins the Eagle Jump game company as a character designer, as they made her favorite game, Fairies Story. Due to her small stature, she is often mistaken for a middle school student.

name: Kou Yagami
description:
__Birth Place:__ Tokyo
__Height:__ 164 cm

The lead character designer of Eagle Jump. She spends a lot of time at the office, often sleeping there overnight in her underwear, and has a laid-back but stern attitude. She was the character designer for the game that inspired [Aoba](https://anilist.co/character/89641/Suzukaze-Aoba) to become one herself.

name: Hifumi Takimoto
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Takimoto Hifumi is a character designer (currently character team leader) for Eagle Jump, a gaming studio located in Tokyo.

Hifumi is especially shy to the point of avoiding talking to people or looking at them directly. As a result, in order to not make her feel uncomfortable, the other employees interact with her through the company's computer messenger system. Although, in later seasons she becomes more lively and goes out of her way to try to improve talking to people. 

Contrary to her normal personality, she becomes very lively, outgoing, and cheerful while texting o

name: Shizuku Hazuki
description:
__Birth Place:__ Tokyo, Japan
__Height:__ 161 cm

A game director with a strong interest in cute girls, hence why her department is entirely female. She owns a cat named [Mozuku](https://anilist.co/character/127138/Mozuku).

name: Rin Tooyama
description:
__Birth Place:__ Aichi prefecture, Japan
__Height:__ 158 cm

An art director and head of the background department. She joined the company at the same time as Kou whom she is very close friends with.

name: Hajime Shinoda
description:
__Birth Place:__ Tokushima Prefecture, Japan
__Height:__ 167 cm

A motion designer who works in the character design department as there are no open seats in the animation department. She enjoys sentai shows and owns various prop weapons.

name: Yun Iijima
description:
__Birth Place:__ Mie Prefecture, Japan
__Height:__ 151 cm

A character designer who designs monsters and often dresses in gothic clothing. She has two younger siblings.

name: Nene Sakura
description:
**Birthplace:** Tokyo
**Height:** 144 cm

Aoba's friend from high school who is currently in university. She took an interest in programming and eventually became an intern at Eagle Jump after beta testing Fairies Story 3.

Nene is described as childish, selfish, and goofy by Aoba, who can't stay focused on the task given to her, which is why she's often seen leaving her post. She is also an otaku and a fan of Faries Story Series.

name: Umiko Ahagon
description:
__Birth Place:__ Okinawa Prefecture, Japan
__Height:__ 162 cm

A programmer who often gets annoyed when she has to fix errors and is embarrassed by her surname. She is a military fan and has several airsoft weapons in her workspace.

name: Arc
description: A Japanese gamer who, after falling asleep playing an online game, finds himself trapped in his game avatar, seemingly transported to a different world. In the game, the only paid avatar was a full-body skeleton, which he chose despite wearing full-body armor. When arriving in this world he still is in the body of a skeleton, which he figures out to be a curse. So he thinks up his own background story to be "a knight that is trying to find a cure for his curse".

name: Ponta
aliases: ベントゥヴォルピーズ
description: Arc's traveling companion. Ponta is of the species Bentou Volpies, a spirit beast also known as Fluffy Fox. Arc encounters it caged and hurt when defeating some bandits. He frees and heals it. Which makes it decide to follow Arc, so Arc gives it the name Ponta. The species is known for being very rarely tame.

name: Ariane Glenys Maple
native: アリアン・グレニス・メープル
aliases: Ariane Glenys Lalatoya (アリアン・グレニス・ララトイア)
description:
A dark elf female warrior with lilac skin, long white hair, and golden eyes. Excellent in magic and swordsmanship. She encountered [Arc](https://anilist.co/character/161637/Arc) when he assisted her in trying to rescue kidnapped elves. Ever since they have been working together.

Elven names don't follow the same custom as human names do. First, you have an elf their first name, followed by the name of their parent with the same sex's name and as last the name of the place they belong too.

name: Komari Koshigaya
description:
__Height:__ <140cm (4'7'')

A second-year middle school student and Natsumi's older sister. She is quite short, which she has a complex about.

name: Natsumi Koshigaya
description: A first-year middle school student and Komari's little sister. An airheaded tomboy who has bad grades.

name: Hotaru Ichijou
description: A fifth grade elementary school student who transfers into Asahigaoka Branch School from Tokyo. She is quite tall and mature for her age, but she is also shy and has a crush on [Komari](https://anilist.co/character/54149/Koshigaya-Komari).

name: Renge Miyauchi
description: A first-grade​ elementary school student. Renge is always attached to her recorder and likes to make up nicknames for all the characters in the show. She is quite attached to [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/87829/Kaede-Kagayama), to whom she likes to call "Candy store" and is very fond of her since she was a baby.

name: Osamu Mikumo
description:
Osamu Mikumo is one of the main protagonists of World Trigger and is a member of the Border with low Trion level. He joined the Border after [Jin](https://anilist.co/character/89014/Jin-Yuuichi) saved him. He is usually referred as simply "Four Eyes" by people outside the Mikumo unit. 

He is later promoted into B-Class Border and later became a Shooter and the leader of the Mikumo Unit.

name: Yuuma Kuga
description:
__Height:__ 141 cm (4'6")

Yuuma has a laid back personality and is not very knowledgeable about Japanese customs, due to being from another world (despite having a Japanese father), leading to some run-ins with rough people. 

He is logical, advising [Mikumo](https://anilist.co/character/81237/Mikumo-Osamu) to stay away from the Trion Battle Soldier rather than save the students as Mikumo could die. He seems to be aligned with Border's cause, fighting against Neighbor forces.

name: Yuuichi Jin
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10.5")

Yuuichi Jin is an S-Rank agent and also a member of Tamakoma Branch. He is one of the strongest members in Border. He also has a Black Trigger named Fujin. Jin's Side Effect is Foresight, allowing him to predict future events. His mentor Soichi Mogami lost his life making Jin's Fujin. 

With the help of engineers at Border, Jin was able to create a new type of trigger, Scorpion, which was adopted by many Border agents.

 Jin is demoted to A-Rank after he offers his Black Trigger in exchange for Yuma's safety and guaranteed enlistment

name: Chika Amatori
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'5")

Chika Amatori is one of the main protagonists of World Trigger. Chika is very shy, and rarely says much. She has very few friends, because she voluntarily distances herself from others. She believes that she'll just get hurt when those she gets close to get kidnapped by the Neighbors. She is really patient and serious and can concentrate very well, but she has low confidence and can't see her own potential. After meeting Yuuma and joining Tamakoma Branch, however, she starts warming up to others and becoming more sociable and confident on herself. She is a kind-heart

name: Shiki
description:
Shiki is a Lich and presently in servitude to [Makoto Misumi](https://anilist.co/character/138137/Misumi-Makoto). 

His origins and original name are unknown. What is easily ascertained is that he was a brilliant researcher in magic knowledge. Before his death he possibly came back as a lich or possibly, he turned himself into a lich; when and where is unknown. All that is known is that he’s been a lich for a very long time and with quite the reputation.

name: Sui
description:
Sui is a slime that Mukoda took as his second familiar. At the time when he got as a familiar, Sui was just a baby slime but evolved on the third day.

Thanks to Hephaestos' blessing, Sui gained the ability to do blacksmithing.

appearsIn.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill
Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

name: Tsuyoshi  Mukouda
description:
A salaryman summoned from modern Japan. He possesses the unique skill, "Online Supermarket", which allows him to buy goods from modern Japan any time, any place. The food he buys with his skill has buffing effects, making anyone who eats it become much stronger than before. He is very good at cooking, but is a coward by nature.

Mukouda was first seen wearing a suit and tie, a huge difference from his co-summoned heroes which were wearing school uniforms. After selling his former clothes, he now wears a dark green shirt with long sleeves that he usually kept folded when he cooks.

appearsIn.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill
Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

name: Fel
description:
__Level:__ 906
__Race:__ Fenrir

Fel is a Fenrir who is considered a legendary magical beast, one of the descendants of the Goddess of the Wind, Ninrir.

Formed a contract with Mukouda and became his first familiar due to his great interest in his cooking. Fel absolutely hates vegetables and prefers to eat meat.

appearsIn.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill
Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

name: Sinbad
description:
__Height:__ 183cm 

He is the king of Sindria and the leader of the Alliance of the Seven Seas. He was 14 years old when he first captured a dungeon, the first dungeon "Bael". Since then, he had sailed the seven seas and captured seven dungeons. He is known as the "Legendary Dungeon Capturer" being the master of seven djinn. He is also commonly known as "High King of Seven Seas". His nickname is Sin. His name is based on "Sinbad the Sailor".  He met Aladdin and his friends when he was in Balbadd, trying to reopen trade.

name: Hinahoho
description:
Height: 240cm  
Likes: taking care of children  
Weakness: heat (because of where he was born)   

Hinahoho is one of the eight generals.

name: Ja'far
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm  
__Likes:__ Working  
__Weakness:__ Easily angered 
__Birthplace:__ Unknown 
__Special skill__: Assassination   

One of the eight generals, he uses the weapon household's vessel "Balalark Sei." His loyalty towards [Sinbad](https://anilist.co/character/42528/Sinbad) is so high that he'll approach anyone who insults him with murderous intent. When Sinbad does things as he pleases, Ja'far worries endlessly and sometimes even feels faint.

Ja'far usually only wears official clothing as he only has one set of normal clothing he received from Sinbad when he was 14 years old.

Hi

name: Chtholly Nota Seniorious
native: クトリ・ノタ・セニオリス
description:
She describes herself as "responsible and mature." Chtholly is a Leprechaun Fairy Soldier who lives at the Fairy Warehouse on Sky Island 68. She is the oldest fairy of her generation and she is also the wielder of the strongest sword of the Emnetwiht race, Seniorious. As the oldest fairy of the warehouse, she tries to be a good example for the little ones, she even avoids eating sweets in front of the little ones because she thought it was childish to do so.

She's not very honest with herself.

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

name: Ithea Myse Valgulious
native: アイセア・マイゼ・ヴァルガリス
description:
Ithea is a Leprechaun that has her hair styled like cat ears. She has a happy-go-lucky personalty, and often jokes that Willem only likes girls of her age. She is one of the main characters in Suka Suka and is a supporting character in Suka Moka. 

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

name: Willem Kmetsch
description:
Originally an orphan, he started training with a weapon at 11 in order to become a Brave. A jack of all trades, he exceeded in a myriad of techniques - earning him the title of  "strongest" Quasi Brave. After an hard fight, several curses caused by his techniques hit back, resulting in his 16 year old body being petrified in a frozen lake for 525 years.

When the events take place, he has been freed from the ice for two years with a deeply broken body caused by the petrification.

By the help of his boggard friend [Grick](https://anilist.co/character/163065/Graycrack-Grick), he becomes the car

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

name: Nopht Keh Desperatio
native: ノフト・ケー・デスペラティオ
description:
Nopht Keh Desperatio is one of the fairies who live at the Fairy Warehouse. She is one of the main characters in Suka Suka and is a supporting character in Suka Moka. After losing Desperatio, she gets a new name along with a new weapon and is now called "Nopht Caro Oracion" in Suka Moka. 

She was 14 during the events of Suka Suka and was originally assigned to the Surface Artifacts Recovery Team along with Rhantolk Ytri Historia.This lasted until the Battle of Gomag, where she lost her Dug Weapon, 'Desperatio,' after Chtholly Nota Seniorious took it for her final stand-off against the Timere.

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

name: Nephren Ruq Insania
native: ネフレン・ルク・インサニア
description:
Nephren is a quiet Leprechaun, who almost never shows her emotions. Despite this, she cares a lot about her friends, and tries to support them as best as she can, especially Willem. Nephren cares a lot for Willem because she thinks he is the same as her. While she was having a conversation with Nygglatho, she described her feeling for Willem as: "I don’t want him to break down. So I’ll try my best to stay by his side and support him."

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

name: Rhantolk   Ytri Historia
native: ラーントルク・イツリ・ヒストリア
description:
__Age__: 14

She is one of five full-grown fairy weapons stationed in the Fairy Warehouse. Alongside Ctholly, Nephren, and Ithea, she is classified as Grade A Fairy Weapon. She wields the Dug Weapon Historia. 

She later returned the ownership of Historia when she left the military

appearsIn.title: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?

name: Nagisa Momoe
description:
A magical girl who wished for a cheesecake that her mother would think was the best. Nagisa is usually rather childish, serving as the plucky and cheerful comic relief of the group, though she's shown to be more perceptive than she seems. She tends to speak rather eloquently. She fights with a trumpet horn that can shoot bubbles powerful enough to put cracks in a witch's barrier.

She is the magical girl form of [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/40842/Charlotte).

Nagisa is considered a secretary to the Law of Cycles following Madoka's wish. She assisted Madoka, along with Sayaka, in th

appearsIn.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Rebellion-

name: Sasaki
description:
__Occupation:__ Office Worker

A tired middle-aged corporate slave. His daily relaxation comes from cigarettes and Yamada's cheerful hospitality.

He doesn't recognize that his favorite employee, Yamada, is the same person as his new smoking friend, Tayama.

appearsIn.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You

name: Yamada
description:
Yamada is an employee of the supermarket known as Super S. She initially started in a part-time position 8 years ago as a teenager.

As Yamada, she is a cheerful, flawless customer handler. Her real self, which she introduces to [Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/281763/Sasaki) as "Tayama", is much more frank and less outwardly polite. She invites Sasaki to come to the smoking area behind the store, which he then does regularly.

appearsIn.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You

name: Hideyoshi Kinoshita
description:
Hideyoshi Kinoshita is a class 2-F student in Fumizuki Academy. A classmate of [Akihisa](https://anilist.co/character/27362/Yoshii-Akihisa) since 1st grade. Hideyoshi is the fraternal twin of [Yuuko Kinoshita](https://anilist.co/character/29562/Kinoshita-Yuuko), class ambassador for Class 2-A. He is also a member of the Drama Club. He is one of the most famous characters in the series and in the manga, particularly due to his gender neutrality.

Unlike the rest of Class F, Hideyoshi is relatively calm and normal. Hideyoshi remains stoic at most times, but there are times when Hideyoshi loses h

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Akihisa Yoshii
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm

Although Akihisa denies it, he is a rarely found 'fool' who even his own parents call him as "the fool over all the world." Not only are his grades the lowest, but he's really so stupid that he is titled the "Kansatsu Shobunsha (under observation)" from the school. For him his own safety is the most important thing and does not hesitate to use the most cowardly ways if needed, in circumstances where his harm is unnecessary.   However he also has a righteous heart that can stand up against for other friends (except [Yuuji](https://anilist.co/character/29607/Sakamoto-Yuuji)).

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Mizuki Himeji
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm  

2nd Grade highschool student in Fumizuki Gakuen. 

She's in the same F-class along with [Akihisa](https://anilist.co/character/27362/Yoshii-Akihisa) and friends, but actually she is ranked 2nd from the whole school in academics. She came to the F-class because she exited the room midway during the class division examinations- resulting in a zero score. 

She was Akihisa's first love since long ago when they were in elementary school, but never noticed until recently when he pleaded for her during the class division examinations. But why she likes Akihisa is the greatest m

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Minami Shimada
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm  

2nd year highschool student in Fumizuki Gakuen. In Class F. Classmates with Akihisa from 1st grade. Born in Germany, she returned to Japan. She is strong and wild; according to herself, her hobby is "beating up Akihisa" and really does hit him all the time for whatever reason, but it's just a reverse way of displaying her special feelings to him. The so-called 'tsundere'. Whenever Akihisa's up to do anything useless, she restricts him with excessive violence; and for this reason, Akihisa takes her as his natural enemy.  She is taking the rumor of Akihisa liking a boy quit

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Kouta Tsuchiya
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

2nd Grade highschool student in Fumizuki Gakuen. In Class F. Friends with Akihisa since grade 1.   Because of his silent and serene nature he is not often noticed, but for his perverted heart and how he is always trying to hide it, he was nicknamed "Muttsurini (parody of Mussolini, also said to be the shortened form of Muttsuri Sukebe (Reticent Pervert)".  His grades are as low as Akihisa (but just a bit higher than him), but his knowledge of sex is unusually broad. However in reality he lacks boldness so much that spouts out nosebleed just by imagining in his head. And in

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Yuuji Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Yuuji Sakamoto is the class representative of class F. In the series, the class rep position is assigned to the smartest student of that class. He is cool, collected, and exhibit surprisingly high intelligence and foresight unexpected of a student from class F. In volume 1, his strategies and tactics had helped class F to attain victory after victory, until the duels with class A in which he overestimated his ability in elementary school level Japanese history. Yuuji was once known as a child prodigy in his childhood. The only reason why he ended up in class F was b

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Shouko Kirishima
description:
Shouko Kirishima is the childhood friend of [Yuuji Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/29607/Sakamoto-Yuuji). She is the top student in her level and the class representative for class A.

In the story, she is portrayed as a soft-spoken, but highly assertive and intelligent girl. In the novel, her dialog always starts with ellipses. She is described as elegantly beautiful and very popular like a typical Yamato Nadeshiko, but yet has no boyfriend, which initially created the impression to others that she is a lesbian. Later, it was revealed that the reason for this is because she is crazily

appearsIn.title: Baka and Test - Summon the Beasts

name: Myne
description:
__Family structure__
　Father: [Gunther](https://anilist.co/character/126528)
　 Mother: [Effa](https://anilist.co/character/126527)
　 Older sister: [Tuuli](https://anilist.co/character/126526)
　 Younger brother: [Kamil](https://anilist.co/character/157140)

__Status__
　 Class: commoner
　 Occupation: soldier's child

Youngest daughter of a poor commoner family. She has navy blue hair and golden eyes. She has a feeble body which gets a high fever if she forces it too much, it is also smaller than the average for her age. Urano Motosu died at the age of 22 and reincarnated into Myne's body by the

name: Lutz
description:
__Family structure__
　Father: [Deid](https://anilist.co/character/140074)
　 Mother: [Karla](https://anilist.co/character/126535)
　 Older brother: [Zasha](https://anilist.co/character/126533)

description:

A girl from the city whose father owns a world famous sweets company. Since she will one day inherit the company, she desires to make it the best sweets company in the world. name: Kokonotsu Shikada
description: He is an aspiring mangaka, who also happens to be the son of a once famous confectionery maker who now runs a lowly candy shop which was also been owned by his family for generations. He is always being pestered by his father to take over the business, much to his annoyance. During his spare time he would hang-out at Edo Cafe and chat with his childhood friends, [Tou](https://anilist.co/character/89171/Endou-Tou) or [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/89170/Endou-Saya).

name: Saya Endou
description:
[Kokonotsu](https://anilist.co/character/89168/Shikada-Kokonotsu)'s classmate who runs a nearby cafe. She has a crush on Kokonotsu. At first alarmed by [Hotaru](https://anilist.co/character/89119/Shidare-Hotaru)'s presence, she quickly befriends her for their goals are aligned: Hotaru wishes Kokonotsu to run the store while she wants him to keep staying in town.

Saya has a hidden talent of toy mastery. At one point she defeats well prepared Hotaru at a Menko game, an event that leads Hotaru to start addressing her with suffix shi, an antiquated designation used by disciples to their masters.

name: Tou Endou
description: Older twin brother of [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/89170/Endou-Saya) and a good friend of [Kokonotsu](https://anilist.co/character/89168/Shikada-Kokonotsu). A laid back person who usually wears Hawaiian shirt and sunglasses. He and Saya run a cafe named "Cafe Endō".

description: [Kokonotsu](https://anilist.co/character/89168/Shikada-Kokonotsu)'s father as well as the current owner of Shikada store. He is desperate to make his son 9th head of the shop so that his legacy will continue. He agrees to [Hotaru](https://anilist.co/character/89119/Shidare-Hotaru)'s bargain that if she can convince his son to be the next head of his shop, he would become part of Hotaru's company.

name: Ichika Amasawa

He once made a sarcastic joke about leaving them to die. It is his opinion that exorcists are not saviors. [Komui's](https://anilist.co/character/142) younger sister, and assistant Head Officer. 

Her parents were killed by an Akuma when she was very young. Because she is an Accommodator, the Black Order took her away from her only remaining family member (Komui) to Headquarters against her will. For three years she was never allowed to leave the place, which felt like a prison to her. Because she attempted suicide, she had to be restrained and tied to her bed. However, once Komui joined the Black Order, Lenalee became more at ease in the Black Order.

description:

Takumi has been manipulated subtly by Bunta

Before Ryousuke got Keisuke involved in street racing he was the leader of a Bosozoku gang. He joins his brother's new team and has a rivalry with Takumi.

native: ジュリエット・ペルシア
description:
The leader of the 1st Year High School division of the "White Cats". She is the only daughter of the Persia household, a high ranking noble family from the West. Since only males can inherit the rank of nobility, the household is at risk of losing its noble status. This motivates Juliet to become stronger so that her strength and intelligence are no less than that of a man. She initially mistakes [Romio](https://anilist.co/character/128066/Inuzuka-Romio)'s protection of her as pity for being a woman and has been harboring animosity towards him until he confessed his love.

description:

Whilst physically strong, he struggles with his studies and is unable to swim.

name: Midori Asakusa
description:
Asakusa is a freshman at Shibahama Highschool who likes anime. She is full of curiosity and imagination, yet not that sociable. Her policy is “Anime is all about its setting” and she has kept various settings inspired by her daily life in her sketchbook. 

[Sayaka Kanamori](https://anilist.co/character/149677/Kanamori-Sayaka), Asakusa’s classmate, used to be the only person who knows about Asakusa’s passion, but when they visited Anime Club together they got along with [Tsubame Mizusaki](https://anilist.co/character/149678/Mizusaki-Tsubame), which led them to start up Eizouken. Her goal is to

name: Tsubame Mizusaki
description:
Asakusa’s classmate who is a charismatic amateur model and is famous in the school. She is expected to be an actress in the future as both of her parents are actors, but she actually wants to be an animator and is especially good at capturing motion of characters. 

As Mizusaki has been banned from joining Anime Club by her parents, she joins Eizoken instead and starts to create anime together with Asakusa and Kanamori. She has different sense of money from two of them as she comes from a rich family.

description: A spirited 18-year-old high school student and a close friend of [Kenji Koiso](https://anilist.co/character/22808/). She invites Kenji to meet her large extended family for her great-grandmother Sakae Jinnouchi's 90th birthday.

name: Sakae Jinnouchi
description: The great-grandmother of [Natsuki](https://anilist.co/character/22809/Shinohara-Natsuki) and indomitable head of the family. Despite her advanced age, she holds the family together. She also has connections in the highest ranks of political and financial circles.

name: Kenji Koiso
description: A math-savvy 17-year-old high school student and a moderator of the interactive computer world OZ along with his close friend Takashi Sakuma. Kenji is less skilled in dealing with people. Kenji is invited by his friend Natsuki Shinohara for Sakae Jinnouchi's 90th birthday. After receiving a cryptic code on his cell phone and cracking it, he becomes a primary suspect for hacking into OZ.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Wabisuke Jinnouchi
description: A handsome and sardonic 41-year-old computer expert and the "first love" of Natsuki.     He is the illegitimate son of Natsuki's grandfather but was adopted by Sakae, whom Wabisuke cares for deeply. Wabisuke had long been estranged from their family and returned after selling off his program to the U.S military. The U.S. military had chosen to test the efficacy of the Love Machine on Oz. When the rest of the family learns of this, they are understandably upset and angry at Wabisuke.

name: Kazuma Ikezawa
description: A 13 year old Oz user and one of Natsuki's cousins.  On Oz, he is known as King Kazma. He is famous on there for being an excellent fighter in the Martial Arts Championship. He refers to Oz's fighting games as not being a game, but a sport. He says that he 'likes the fighting and winning, but not the gaming part.'   He assists in helping Kenji with the fight against Love Machine. When he lost the first battle against Love Machine, many people sent him hate messages for not winning.  His Oz avatar is a white rabbit wearing a red vest, jeans, goggles around the neck, and white and red gloves. Ka

Yukari however, is forced to be engaged with [Sanada Ririna](https://anilist.co/character/121847) by the government marriage policy after confessing to [Misaki Takazaki](https://anilist.co/character/121845).

__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

She is mostly very blunt and speaks what's on her mind which earned her the nickname Snooty Sanada. She claims to have no special feelings for Yukari and acts as a love cupid for Yukari and [Misaki](https://anilist.co/character/121845). She is very interested in romantic stories and encounters.

name: Yuusuke Nisaka
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

It is hinted that he has a special relationship with [Misaki](https://anilist.co/character/121845) which caused Yukari to think that Yuusuke might also like her. However, Yuusuke is still shrouded in mystery and whether he likes Misaki or not is unclear.

description:
