Takeda is a large well build man with short black hair. Takeda is a nice man who gladly helps out his coworkers. He is in charge of Igarashi and will always try his best to support and help her, and will even apologize to their boss for her mistakes. He cares for her.

Master is the main protagonist of the Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita series and the main weapon of Fran.

His personality is that of a father/guardian of sorts towards Fran, he takes care and protects her while also assisting her by providing his abilities and bonuses to Fran. Towards other people Master acts in a kind and well mannered way, except if that people disrespect or try to hurt Fran in any way or shape.

In sword form, Master looks like a white longsword with three blue lines on it. Beneath the pale gold hilt there is the sculpture of a courageous wolf a

name: Ragna
description: A dragon hunter who teamed up with [Crimson](https://anilist.co/character/168967/Crimson) to kill all dragons.

name: Crimson
description: Crimson is the previous Winged Monarch who betrayed the dragons and tried to kill the Dragon God. Crimson teamed up with [Ragna](https://anilist.co/character/204860/Ragna) to slay all dragons, himself included.

name: Nagi Umino
description:
Nagi is a second-year student at Megurogawa Gakuen. He is the biological son of a hotel tycoon, but due to a mix-up after his birth is raised by a different family.

Nagi seems to be obsessed with studying to the point that he studies day and night in order to achieve top marks. He is quite capable in pretty much everything, whether it is housework or schoolwork, proving his culinary skills multiple times by preparing delicious dishes everyday. He is a free-willed and determined person with a stubborn attitude to never give up. He is also naïve when it comes to the girls around him. Yet his ki

name: Erika Amano
description:
**Height:** 160 cm

Erika Amano is a second-year student at Orpheus Jogakuin but transfers to Megurokawa Gakuen. She is a popular social media celebrity and the biological daughter of the family that raised Nagi.

name: Hiro Segawa
description: Hiro Segawa is the love interest of Nagi Umino.

name: Sachi Umino
description: Sachi Umino is the sister of [Nagi Umino](https://anilist.co/character/166730/Nagi-Umino).

name: Axel Gilberto
description: Parkour specialist originally from Brazil. He has outstanding physical abilities and is a quick thinker, who can fly through the city like a bird. He is famous for his numerous jailbreaks.

name: Doug Hadine
description: Originally from Nigeria. He's an intelligent man who creates strategies as the brains of the team, and hides his warm heart behind a calm and collected demeanor. As a student, he studied physics and had a great respect for [Dr. Skinner.](https://anilist.co/character/347658/Skinner) He has a high-strung and prideful personality.

name: Christine Blake
description:
Originally from Russia. She has a lively and frank personality, allowing her to get along with anyone. She acts as a gun specialist, who can use any type of gun. She is also a heavy drinker and optimist.

Christine is not her real name, she changed her face and identity after defecting from Russian intelligence.

name: Leland Astor
description: Originally from Canada. His special skill is piloting drones. He seems like a normal dumb middle school student, but has a complicated family situation which is kept secret. He is skilled at reading the room but never says his real intentions. His hobby is ego surfing.

name: Eleina
aliases: Mad Screamer (マッド・スクリーマー)
description: Originally from Hong Kong. Although she seems unsociable and is bad at listening to what others say, she is actually a famous hacker under the name "Mad Screamer."

name: Kintarou Ooe
description: Kintaro "The Golden Boy" Oe is the 25-year-old protagonist of the anime, manga, and OVA series "Golden Boy." As a "Tokyo University Department of Law" dropout, he is studying the way of life by traveling with his bike through Japan. Although he dropped out, he mastered the entire curriculum. This fact combined with his knowledge of the human behavior and psyche lets one assume that he is indeed quite intelligent. He goes from place to place, applying for whatever job he can, instead of sticking to one occupation.

name: Onna Shachou
description: She is the owner of a software company in episode one. She is a strong, independent and intelligent woman. Moreover she is really hot and wears expensive, sexy clothes. She does not believe in showing sincerity to men because of their true intentions, that's why she never employs men. Kintaro is the first man to work in her office.

name: Naoko Katsuda
description:
__Relatives:__ Juzo Katsuda (father), Noriko Katsuda (mother)

Naoko is the daughter of a powerful local politician and Noriko Katsuda and the friend of Yuka Kanzaki who has employed Kintaro Oe as part of his campaign team to run for a third term as mayor.

name: Noriko
description: Golden girl No.3. Dreams about arranging flowers for her beloved one. Her parents run a noodle restaurant. She is looking for true love and is very shy and sensitive. She contends with marrying a rich businessman from yakuza. Kintaro helps her with making the right decision.

name: Ayuko Hayamizu
description: Golden girl No.4. An olympic gold medalist and swimming instructor that runs her own swimming school. Ayuko is very dominant and disciplined, she requires a lot of involvment in work from her staff. Furthermore her methods of learning need some changes, because they're not suitable for students. Kintaro is about to influence her attitude.

name: Reiko Terayama
description: Reiko Terayama is the daughter of Daitaku Terayama; one of the richest men in Kyoto. In public Reiko is beautiful, elegant and well mannered. However, secretly she has an obsession with her motorbike she calls her "bimo". She has a distaste for men and prefers her "bimo" over them. But as soon as she met Kintaro Oe her views change...

name: Chie
description: Chie is a cel-painter at the animation studio where Kintarou works as an errand-boy.

name: Umi Sonoda
description:
__Height: __159cm

Umi is normally a shy girl, but she has a strong will and some qualities of a leader. Despite this, she is content to stay reserved and always thinks logically. Umi is uncomfortable with wearing short skirts but gets used to it after their first live. Although Umi tends to be hard on others, she is especially hard on herself. She doesn't do anything criminal and despises laziness.

name: Rin Hoshizora
description:
__Height:__ 155cm

Rin appears to be a bit of a tomboy, though with a girly streak. She likes sports and is arguably the most athletic member of μ's, on par with Eli. Like Honoka, Rin is very energetic, hard-working and active. One key difference between her and Honoka, however, is that Rin is known for being very mindful of other people's opinions, as she puts their feelings first before taking action into something.

name: Nico Yazawa
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm 

Nico has been observing [Honoka's](https://anilist.co/character/46171/Kousaka-Honoka) new Idol group for a while but eventually joins them. She has past experiences as an amateur school idol. At first, she was secretly the President of the school's unknown Idol Research Club, but after an incident, the club was later joined together with Honoka's Idol Club. She likes bossing people around and acting superior, but she also has an energetic and cheeky personality.

name: Hanayo Koizumi
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm  

A shy girl who dreamed of being an idol since she was very young; Rin and Maki finally convince her to join µ's.

name: Maki Nishikino
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Maki Nishikino is a first-year​ high school student in Otonokizaka High School. She has a beautiful voice and loves jazz music more than anyone else in the group. At first, she didn't want to join µ's because she had decided to inherit their family's hospital and take up medicine in college, but after joining forces with Rin to push Hanayo to join, she decides to follow the same path and join along with her two fellow first years.

name: Nozomi Toujou
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm 

Nozomi is the vice-president of Otonokizaka High School. She is the best friend of [Eli](https://anilist.co/character/46173/Ayase-Eli). She is also a Shrine Maiden in a temple because she believes that a shrine is the source of people's faith. Eventually she will join the school idol club with Eli and will be one of the most successful school idols.

(Source: Character Book)

name: Eli Ayase
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Eli Ayase is the student council president of the Otonokizaka High School. Along with her best friend, [Nozomi](https://anilist.co/character/46169/Toujou-Nozomi), they do plans so the closure of the school could be prevented. She is partly Russian because her grandmother is a Russian. Alongside Nozomi, they join the school idol group for the prevention of their schools closure.

name: Kotori Minami
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

Kotori is known for having her head in the clouds. Despite this, she is μ's designer along with [Nico Yazawa](https://anilist.co/character/46163/Yazawa-Nico). Kotori has a very huge aptitude for fashion and is very good at drawing costumes for the group. Kotori is shown to be very kind and supportive to her friends and genuinely cares about them, especially their feelings. However, this can go too far as Kotori usually backs [Honoka](https://anilist.co/character/46171/Kousaka-Honoka) up when she is scolded by [Umi](https://anilist.co/character/46167/Sonoda-Umi).

Kotori is

name: Honoka Kousaka
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

Honoka is the main character, who is a second-year student at Otonokizaka Academy. Her family works in a japanese sweet shop named Homura. When Otonokizaka Academy is planned to be shut down due to lack of applicants, Honoka becomes determined to save it by starting up a school idol group. Honoka also has a knack for finding loose change on the ground. Since she was young, she has been friends with [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/46013/Minami-Kotori), and she befriended [Umi](https://anilist.co/character/46167/Sonoda-Umi) after inviting her to play hide and seek.

In

name: Ard Meteor
description:
**Race:** Human

Socially awkward Demon Lord whose goal is to make friends.

appearsIn.title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody

name: Ireena Olhyde
native: イリーナ・リッツ・ド・オールハイド
description:
**Race:** Elf

Ireena Litz de Olhyde is the childhood friend of the Ard Meteor.

She is from the Olhyde family, but it was just an alias as her family comes from the true and real bloodline of the nation's royal family, making her the real princess of the Laville.

She is also a descendant of Lydia which explains why she reminds Ard of her.

appearsIn.title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody

name: Ginny de Salvan
native: ジニー・フィン・ド・サルヴァン
description:
**Race:** Succubus

A young succubus who got bullied a lot by Elrado and his gang even through their childhood. She began to worship Ard after he came to her rescue.

appearsIn.title: The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody

name: Irma Fellicha
native: イルマ・フェリーチェ
description: Irma Fellicha is an opera singer from Leidenshaftlich who entrusts Violet to write her a letter that will be used in her new opera. Her lover, Hugo, was killed during the war.

name: Sonoshee McLaren
native: ソノシー・マクラーレン
description: Sonoshee is the winner of the Yellow Race which qualified her to enter the Redline race. She's commonly known as the Cherry Boy Hunter even though it was never completely described why.     Through JP's flashbacks, we learn that they knew each other from awhile back. Her father was a racer and she got the urge to race from him.

name: JP
description: "Sweet JP"—a nickname earned for JP's personality and retro style, though most likely from a refusal to mount any form of weapons or upgrades on his race car. Seemingly, the only advantages of JP's car, the Trans Am 20000 WR, are Frisbee's modifications and the Old man's mechanical skills.  One of two human racers to qualify for REDLINE, though through unusual circumstances (default and popular demand). An ambitious and talented racer, JP pushes his driving skill and soul to their limits when he feels the time is right, throwing an extravagant show whilst putting his body and vehicle on the li

name: Panty Anarchy
native: アナーキー・パンティ
description:
__Height:__ 164cm (5'4")   

Panty is Stocking's sister. She is an angel forced to kill evil spirits in order to earn her way back into Heaven. She is obsessed with sex and as such, spends a lot of her free time in love hotels with random men. She speaks with a traditional Tokyo dialect and bad girl's dialect. Her name is also the source of her power as she is able to transform her panties into a diamond handgun named Back Lace, that has amazingly destructive power against spirits but can't even bruise humans.

name: Briefers Rock
native: ブリーファス・ロック
description:
A self-proclaimed ghost hunter who has a crush on Panty. 

His real name is Briefers Rock, and he happens to be quite handsome under his hair.

name: Garterbelt
description:
The priest of the Cemetery Hills Church on the outskirts of Daten City. He serves as the overseer of the angel sisters, but beneath his calm demeanor, he occasionally acts suspiciously and engages in dubious activities, making him a mysterious character. 

(Source: Official Site)

name: Stocking Anarchy
native: ストッキング・アナーキー
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (4'11")

The younger angel sister, banished to Earth along with her sister [Panty](https://anilist.co/character/32800/Panty-Anarchy). A goth girl with straight bangs and ultra-long hair. She fights by transforming her stockings into two katana-shaped heavenly weapons, Stripe I & II. Stocking enjoys eating various desserts and sugary food, but doesn't seem to gain weight. However, she acts quite enraged and sensitive whenever someone calls her fat. She is usually a level-headed and intelligent girl, though she can be rude if provoked, especially towards her older sister Panty

name: Natsumi
description:
__Angel:__ Haniel
__Height:__ 144 cm (normal), 170 cm (adult form)
__Rank:__ B-Class spirit 

Natsumi is the seventh Spirit to appear in the series. She first appears as a slender woman whose age should be slightly past 20 years old.

 However, it is later revealed that her true form is a little girl with the appearance of a child with unkempt hair and clothing.

name: Aoi Miyamori
description:
**Occupation:** Production assistant for Musashino Animation

Aoi is cheerful and positive and has an interest in animation and was a member of the animation club in high school. However, she does not know what specific job she wants to do in the anime industry.

name: Ema Yasuhara
description: Animator at Musashino Animation. Was a member of the animation club in high school.

name: Shizuka Sakaki
description:
__Occupation:__ Voice actress at Akaoni Production.

Shizuka also works part-time as a waitress and is a former member of her high school animation club.

name: Misa Toudou
description:
Aspiring 3D computer graphics operator.

Misa once worked at the computer graphics studio Super Media Creations and was a former member of her high school animation club.

name: Midori Imai
description:
Aspiring scriptwriter and university student.

The highly enthusiastic Midori is a former member of her high school animation club.

name: Kyouya Hashiba
description:
Main protagonist of the series. He travels back ten years ago by an unknown event. Kyouya shows a very calm personality. He is inspired by a group of talented people known as "The Platinum Generation".

Kyouya had been deeply inspired by paintings of a famous female illustrator which made him feel alive when he was working as a game developer, later Kyouya found out that Aki Shino was indeed that famous illustrator named Shino Akishima.

In the world of 2018 he married Aki Shino (which makes her Aki Hashiba) and he was the father of a child with a daughter, Maki Hashiba.

name: Tsurayuki Rokuonji
description: A close friend of Kyouya Hashiba. Although displaying a lazy nature, he is a genius in writing scripts.

name: Nanako Kogure
description: She is a resident of Share House Kitayama, and a very talented singer. Despite her appearance, she's innocent and caring.

name: Aki Shino
description:
Aki has an unfussy and motherly temper while also known to have a caring nature too. She's also a very talented artist. She is a second-year student in [Kyouya Hashiba](https://anilist.co/character/197117/Hashiba-Kyouya)'s Department of Film who is commonly known as "Shinoaki".

As of 2016, she was working as a famous illustrator under the name Shino Akishima, whom Kyouya adored.

In the world of 2018, she married Kyouya (which makes her Aki Hashiba) and become a mother of one child named [Maki Hashiba](https://anilist.co/character/239482/Hashiba-Maki), but had to quit to being a painter as sh

name: Eiko Kawasegawa
description:
Eiko is a competitive, stubborn, and mature young woman whose enthusiasm and talent for film-making have no bounds. She is also somewhat prickly and looks up to her older sister and professor Misaki Kanou. 

At the same time, she is able to empathize with others and holds herself to the same high standards she expects of her colleagues.

Later it is revealed that she also had romantic feelings towards Kyouya.

name: Puck
description:
__Height:__ 7 cm

Puck is an Artificial Spirit that [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) was formerly contracted with. He is the current Great Spirit of Fire.

He is currently known as the Beast of The End.

Around 400 years ago, Puck was created by Echidna, though he had apparently left her by the time she moved into the Sanctuary. Seven years before the start of the election, Puck unfroze Emilia and began to act as her friend and mentor, and later on started to live at Roswaal's mansion where he was reunited with Beatrice.

Puck can be described as cute or adorable, thus his s

appearsIn.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- OVAs

name: Loo
aliases: Loo Lulucy (ルールーシー＝ルー)
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Affiliation:__ Taiju Village, Kingdom of Galbart (Formerly)

Loo is a Female Vampire, who stumbles into Hiraku's farm during his early days of living in the formidable forest of death. On the run, with no where to turn, she falls in love with Hiraku who by this time has not seen another person since coming to the world. She can change her body/age to suit her needs to survive. She is a skilled magician as well as a farmer who works at Hiraku's farm. At first she viewed Hiraku's farm (now a village) as a place she can hide from the nobles and now she views it as home. 
She a

name: Ria
description:
**Race:** High Elf

Ria is the leader of a group of high-elf girls who wandered in the forest after their village was destroyed by humans in a war. They were homeless for 200 years until Tier brought them to Hiraku's farm. Ria is a reliable construction enthusiast and contributes to the farm by establishing a smithy and bringing other technologies such as building construction and baking. After meeting Hiraku and his friends, Ria decides to live with them.

name: Hiraku Machio
description:
**Race:** Human

Hiraku Machio is the main protagonist of Isekai Nonbiri Nouka series. He was resurrected with a healthy body, the ability to speak the common tongue, and the All-Purpose Farming Tool (AFT) by God. Despite being unable to use magic, he cultivates the forest to create farmland and a village, with the help of the wolves Kuro and Yuki, the demon spider Zabuton, and even humanoid species.

name: Tier
description:
**Race:** Angel

Tier is one of the main characters of Isekai Nonbiri Nouka series. She is an angel with celestial magical powers and bird-like wings that allow her to fly. She is part of the Angel of Annihilation tribe, specializing in golem magic. Tier visits the forest in search of Loo, her frenemy, and ends up living there with Hiraku and Loo.

name: Iska
description:
Iska is the main protagonist of the series. He is the current wielder of the Astral Swords and is determined to end what he considers a pointless war. 

He was the youngest Saint Disciple to ever receive the title; but after releasing a "witch" from captivity, he was stripped of his rank and imprisoned for life. Circumstances around the war against the Nebulis Sovereignty have led to his release, but his goals haven't changed. 

Iska has a moral code that doesn’t discriminate, even if a supposed enemy is at hand. He shows kindness and bravery, despite putting himself at risk, and even willing

appearsIn.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World

name: Aliceliese Lou Nebulis IX
native: アリスリーゼ・ルゥ・ネビュリス9世
description:
Aliceliese is a calm person and a kind heart to which she uses mostly to protect her family legacy. While she comes off as a cold fighter when she's on the battlefield, Aliceliese isn't much different from a normal girl her age. She enjoys going to the opera (having cried during one play), and is a fan of art and can be very talkative at times.

Being a teenage girl, Alice has some interest in the opposite sex. Not having many males her age around her, she expresses most of this interest in [Iska](https://anilist.co/character/170215/Iska) when they're not on the battlefield. She even treats th

appearsIn.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World

name: Akira Takizawa
description:
Height: 166cm  

He lost his memory during a brain washing program. At first he thinks he is a terrorist. He met Saki in Washington D.C., being naked and only carrying a gun and a cellphone. When he helps her out, because she threw a coin in the grounds of the White House and is questioned by policemen, she gives him her coat, scarf and her hat. He has a very modern cell phone with the phrase "noblesse oblige" printed on it and 8.2 billion yen in digital money credit. When he makes his first call, a female voice claiming to be Juiz answers. After she sent him a map with the place where he was

name: Saki Morimi
description: Saki is in her last year in university. She is 22 years old, born on January 6, 1989. After her parents died she lived with her elder married sister, brother-in-law and niece. She visits New York City as part of her graduation trip with her friends and after visiting Washington D.C. alone, she meets Takizawa Akira who helps her out when is questioned by the police for suspicious behaviour. She gives the completely nude Akira her coat, scarf and hat. After noticing that she left her passport in the coat, she chases after Akira and then they decide to go back together to Tokyo, Japan.   She plan

name: Alto Goldfield
native: アルト・ゴールドフィルド
description: Alto is the male protagonist of the Kinsou no Vermeil series. He is the one who summoned the most powerful devil of all time, [Vermeil](https://anilist.co/character/171759).

name: Vermeil
description: She is the devil summoned by [Alto Goldfield](https://anilist.co/character/171760) from a book that she was imprisoned in centuries ago.

name: Lilia Kudelfate
native: リリア・クーデルフェイト
description: [Alto](https://anilist.co/character/171760)'s childhood friend, who is in love with him and becomes jealous when [Vermeil](https://anilist.co/character/171759) appears and other girls surrounds Alto. She made a contract with a high-class wind spirit, named [Sylphid](https://anilist.co/character/319902).

name: Kufa Vampir
native: クーファ=ヴァンピール
description:
Kufa is dispatched to Melida as her tutor (and her possible assassin), but continues to train Melida in defiance of his orders.

(Source: ANN)

name: Melida Angel
description:
Melida is a girl born in a family of Holy Knights but with no talent with mana.

(Source: ANN)

name: Elise Angel
description:
Elise is Melida's cousin and a Holy Knight who can use mana unlike Melida. She boasts the most talent in her class despite her stoic, silent nature.

(Source: ANN)

name: Rosetti Pricket
native: ロゼッティ=プリケット
description: Rosetti is an elite member of the holy city guards. She is currently Elise's tutor.

name: Kagura
description: __Height:__ 156 cm   Her name comes from Shinto ritual: the kanji for Kagura (神楽) meaning "entertainment of the gods". It was used to describe the traditional music played at shrines and the Imperial Court. Kagura also makes a cameo appearance as an anthropologist in Classroom of Thesis; From the Report to the Graduation Thesis by Kazuhisa Todayama which refers to several other Azumanga Daioh characters.  While she makes appearances earlier on as one of Nyamo's students, Kagura doesn't become a true acquaintance of the group until sometime later, joining Yukari's class in the 2nd year (Yukari

name: Ayumu Kasuga
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Ayumu Kasuga is a transfer student from Osaka. [Tomo](https://anilist.co/character/181), expecting her to act like the stereotypical Osakan—loud, exuberant and fond of jokes—chose for her the nickname "Osaka", although Ayumu's behavior could not be more different. Ayumu considers the name "slow" and "spacey", but she lacks the energy or motivation to dispute it. The nickname sticks so well that she is called Osaka by teachers and even in the class roster, to the point that no one remembers her real name. In the manga, Osaka mentions that she lived in Kobe when she was in el

name: Minamo Kurosawa
description: A gym teacher at the girls' school. In the girls' first year of high school, she is the homeroom teacher of Class 5. During their last two years, she is the homeroom teacher of Class 2. An old high school friend and rival of Yukari, they have a juvenile, exasperating, but funny relationship with each other; Yukari relentlessly insults and freeloads from Nyamo, but Nyamo gets her digs in, too. "Nyamo" is a nickname from her student days, but Yukari calls her that, and so does Tomo. Other students call her Kurosawa-sensei. Whereas Yukari appears to be an older version of Tomo, Nyamo resembles Yo

name: Chiyo Mihama
description: Chiyo Mihama , usually called Chiyo-chan, is a child prodigy, having skipped five grades to 10th grade (first year in Japanese high school) at the start of the series yet is still top of the class. Such grade-skipping would be unthinkable in Japan, and the series humorously explores its potential consequences. The other characters find Chiyo amazingly cute, but sometimes take advantage of both her youthfulness and her scholastic abilities. Her diminutive stature leads to her having a lack of confidence, particularly in sports where she fears she is a burden to others. Chiyo is frequently viewe

name: Koyomi Mizuhara
description: Koyomi Mizuhara, commonly known as Yomi, is a grade-school friend and general antithesis of Tomo. She is the voice of reason of the series, carrying herself as the most mature and serious of the group. Though smart and athletic, she is constantly dissatisfied with herself due to her weight and is always trying various diets in an effort to become thinner. She can never seem to stick to these diets however, as she finds herself constantly tempted by her favorite foods. Another weakness of Yomi's character is that while she is above average in everything else, Yomi is an awful singer, but karaok

name: Sakaki
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm

Sakaki is a quiet, stylish girl. Looking cool and distant, she's often seem staring out of the window. Being tall and well-endowed in both athletics and body, she's often admired by many girls in the school where Azumanga Daioh takes place. Despite being tall, cool and aloof or distant, deep in her heart she wishes to be small, soft, and cute, like [Chiyo-chan](https://anilist.co/character/247/Mihama-Chiyo), but she perceives that she can't - because of her height. She loves cats and always attempts to be friendly with them, but often gets scratched and bitten in response.

name: Tomo Takino
description: Tomo Takino is extremely energetic and competitive, despite being nonathletic and a slacker at the same time. She tends to irritate everyone around her, especially [Yomi](https://anilist.co/character/182/Mizuhara-Koyomi), who has been her classmate since elementary school. Tomo's character is extremely impulsive and never considers nor cares about the consequences of anything she says or does. However, on the occasions when Tomo has actually been inspired to concentrate on something, she has demonstrated that she is quite capable. She succeeded in gaining the grades needed to qualify for the s

name: Yukari Tanizaki
description: Tanizaki Yukari is the girls' English and homeroom teacher (class 3), but a teacher with very unconventional methods and a close relationship with the class. Her students are casual enough to call her by her first name: Yukari-sensei, and even use the very informal and intimate name and title of Yukari-chan. She can be moody and, like Tomo, is incredibly impulsive and has a tendency not to think things through. Yukari has a rivalry/friendship with Minamo and attempts to prove that she is the superior teacher.

name: Niina Sugawara
description: Kazusa's friend, a melancholic girl who the guys call a "crane" because of her fragile beauty. Initially, Niina ignores the boys because of a harassment experience in her childhood but gradually begins to develop feelings for Izumi because of his caring and kindness. Thus, her loyalty to her friend and their common love of one boy quickly becomes one of the main conflicts of the story.

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Kazusa Onodera
description:
Kazusa is the series main lead. 
Since childhood, she has been in love with Izumi, but all this time she was afraid to take a step forward, while the mockery of more popular classmates did not motivate her to be more active in an attempt to attract his attention. However, as the story progresses, she notices that Izumi is clearly sexually attracted to Sugawara’s outstanding beauty and tenderness. She is Sugawara's friend and is childhood friends with Izumi and Momoko.

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Momoko Sudou
description: A shy girl and Kazusa’s best friend. At first, like the other girls, she becomes interested in relationships with boys. However, as the story progresses, she gradually realizes her true feelings and growing attraction toward other girls. At first, she dismisses it as a misunderstanding about why girls like boys, but eventually she develops a one-sided crush on Sugawara.

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Rika Sonezaki
description: The president of a literary club, a tall, prudish girl who is ashamed of her interest in the opposite sex because of her strict upbringing and serious nature. Nevertheless, in spite of her purism, she gets the most healthy relationship with guys compared to other girls. Over time she comes to realize that romantic affection and sexual attraction are not the same thing, thus she begins to lower her guard and starts a relationship with [Shun Amagi](https://anilist.co/character/141291/).

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Hitoha Hongou
description: A blunt girl aspiring to publish erotica novels. Being a virgin, she relies on online adult chatrooms to get inspiration and feedback on her sexual writing. When her editor describes her first draft as if it was written by a virgin 40 year old man, she decides that she needs to go further on her journey for sexual knowledge.

appearsIn.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season

name: Kumatetsu
description:
Kumatetsu is a potential successor to the throne of the Beast Kingdom. He has to choose someone to be his apprentice and he ends up choosing a human boy named [Ren](https://anilist.co/character/122894) (and later names him Kyuuta).

Near the end of the movie, Kumatetsu battles Iozen to see who will become the new lord. Kumatetsu wins but is badly injured right after his victory. Later on, Kyuuta ends up getting in big danger. Since Kumatetsu couldn't help due to him being injured, he decides to reincarnate as a sword and he becomes a part of Kyuuta's soul.

name: Ren
description: A young boy who runs away from home and ends up accidentally going to the beast world. He meets a beast named [Kumatetsu](https://anilist.co/character/122871), who is a potential candidate to become lord of the beast world. Kumatetsu ends up making Ren his apprentice and later names him Kyuuta.

name: Kaede
description:
Kaede is a kind girl who meets [Ren](https://anilist.co/character/122894) in the human world. Humbled by his kindness, yet baffled by his horrible Japanese, she offered to tutor him for free and they became good friends.

At the climax of the show, she is protected by Ren from Ichirouhiko, and later shows up in the beast world to support Ren in the end

name: Mikiya Kokutou
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

[Shiki](https://anilist.co/character/3105/Ryougi-Shiki)'s friend who, two years ago, made a promise with Shiki to attend college.

He discovers a doll at an exhibition his friend asked him to and falls in love with its flawless craftsmanship. He is so charmed by it that he seeks out the maker, [Touko Aozaki](https://anilist.co/character/5266/Aozaki-Touko), and then finds her residence. With his hopes of attending college with Shiki crushed because of her coma, he drops out of college to work under Touko as an assistant investigator. Touko holds his investigative skills with

appearsIn.title: the Garden of sinners Chapter 1: Thanatos. (Overlooking View)

name: Touko Aozaki
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") 

Appearing as a puppet maker, Touko is actually an extremely powerful magus.

appearsIn.title: the Garden of sinners Chapter 1: Thanatos. (Overlooking View)

name: Kirie Fujyou
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

A girl who was sick in a hospital bed. She has long hair, wearing all white. She could barely move and she was starting to lose her eye sight as well. Her parents and younger brother died soon after she got sick and she didn't get any visitors. She wouldn't last long and has always been looking out of the window. She must have been so lonely. Although she was scared of dying, that feeling of death was the only thing she was able to make her realize that she was alive.

appearsIn.title: the Garden of sinners Chapter 1: Thanatos. (Overlooking View)

name: Shiki Ryougi
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

A teenage girl who possesses the "Mystic Eyes of Death Perception," a supernatural ability that allows her to view the death of any given object and destroy its origin. She recently recovered from a two-year coma caused by a traffic accident.

appearsIn.title: the Garden of sinners Chapter 1: Thanatos. (Overlooking View)

name: Kaoru Touno
description: A high school sophomore in a secluded side of town and [Karen](https://anilist.co/character/278440/Touno-Karen)'s older brother.

appearsIn.title: The Tunnel to Summer, the Exit of Goodbyes

name: Anzu Hanashiro
description:
A mysterious girl who just transferred in from Tokyo. 

By law she is 30 years old, but her body is still 22 years old because she entered the Urashima Tunnel in order to find [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/272295/Touno-Kaoru).

appearsIn.title: The Tunnel to Summer, the Exit of Goodbyes

name: Maou
description: The main female protagonist and the supreme ruler of the Demon Realm. Soon after Demon Queen and the Hero join forces, she sets for the Human Realm, disguising herself as a human noblewoman known as the Crimson Scholar (紅の学士 Kurenai no Gakushi), and sharing a part of her vast knowledge with the Human society to help improve their civilization.  Becoming famous in the Human World not only by her feats, but also by her beauty, the Crimson Scholar is viewed with distrust by the church who brands her as a heretic in spite of her growing influence, fearing it would loosen its grasp over the countri

name: Yuusha
description:
The main male protagonist and the greatest warrior of the Human realm. He gives up on his task of slaying the Demon Queen after he is convinced to join her in her efforts to ensure a truly peaceful solution to the war between Humans and Demons by first addressing the issues of both societies that could put them into greater turmoil once the conflict ends. 

He is an unequaled swordsman capable of standing against the strongest Human or Demon, along with being capable of powerful magic ranging from healing to creating familiar spirits, and able to instantly teleport to any location he previousl

name: Chikage Rokujo
description: Rokujo Chikage is a biker gang leader whose members were attacked  by Dollars (actually Blue Square that claimed to be Dollars).     He is a strong fighter, who fought Shizuo in the 5th novel. He and Kadota were fighting at the end of 6th novel.    Chikage is a ladies man who has a throng of girls follow him around. However, like a gentleman, Chikage refuses to harm any female, enemy or not.

name: Aoba Kuronuma
description:
Aoba is 1st year student in Raira Academy. He has a bright personality and is always seen smiling, but has also a darker side to him. He's described as being akin to "a younger version of [Izaya Orihara](https://anilist.co/character/24596/Orihara-Izaya)".     

When he was in elementary school his older brother [Ran Izumii](https://anilist.co/character/33014/Izumii-Ran) physically abused him, so Aoba in revenge set out fire in Ran's bedroom and Ran took the blame, as the adults thought the fire started from  his cigarette. After their parents' divorce, Aoba went to live with his mother and cha

name: Kana Kojima
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

A Japanese-language teacher.

appearsIn.title: Why the hell are you here, Teacher!?

description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'6")

He's an 'average' high school student who somehow seems to get into ridiculous situations with his teacher, [Kana Kojima](https://anilist.co/character/135226/Kojima-Kana). He also has zero luck with girls.

appearsIn.title: Why the hell are you here, Teacher!?

description:
__Height:__ 146 cm

A kind teacher revered as a saint by the students of the school. She's small, but has a big bust.

A high school student feared by his giant stature and scary face, but at heart he is a kind person.

Later he marries his teacher and they live together

appearsIn.title: Why the hell are you here, Teacher!?

description:

Taka-kun's neighbor and childhood friend. Despite her constant teasing, they're always stuck together.

appearsIn.title: Why the hell are you here, Teacher!?

Takashi is a first year at Kawanuma-higashi High School and the student council treasurer.
