description: Chizuru Tachibana is the 24 year old school nurse at Kawanuma East who is known as "Absolute Zero Tachibana" for her cold and expressionless attitude towards the students.

appearsIn.title: Why the hell are you here, Teacher!?

name: Kou Tanaka
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'7")

Kou is a 3rd year at Kawanuma-higashi High School.

appearsIn.title: Why the hell are you here, Teacher!?

name: Wein Arbalest
native: ウェイン・サレマ・アルバレスト
description:
Wein is the crown prince of Natra. He will take over the future of the country on behalf of his sick father. Although the retainers trust him due do his superior position, he is actually lazy. He wants to sell the deadlocked kingdom of Natra and lead a comfortable retired life.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

appearsIn.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

name: Ninym Ralei
description: Ninym is a beautiful white-haired, red-eyed Flahm girl who is [Wein](https://anilist.co/character/206359/Arbalest-Salema-Wein)'s childhood friend. As his top aide, she assists him in everything from affairs of the state to combat. She is among the few who know what he is really like, as well as the kingdom's current dire straits.

appearsIn.title: The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt

name: Kazuyoshi Usui
aliases: Mr. Wild Pitch (ミスターワイルドピッチ)
description:
__School:__ Kaimei High School
__Class:__ 2-C (chapters 1-209); 3-C (chapters 210-288)
__Affiliation:__ Sket Dan

Switch is the brains and secretary of the Sket Dan. As a result of the events that happened in his life, he opts to speak through a voice synthesizer on his computer. 

He has a deadpan sense of humor and seems to enjoy teasing others. Because he always communicates through speech synthesis software and has a tendency to joke with a straight face, it is difficult to tell what he is really thinking. While he usually "speaks" without much emotion, he would sometimes purposely raise h

name: Aria Shichijou
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm 

Aria Shichijou is a second-year student (later a third-year student) who serves as the Student Council as Secretary and Shino Amakusa's best friend. She is the most mature character in appearance and comes from an affluent family. However, her mind tends to follow the same paths as Shino, seemingly more so and seems especially interested in bondage

name: Shino Amakusa
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

The student council president and a second-year student. She is serious, diligent, and talented in most subjects. However, she is almost always thinking of perverted things, even suggesting that one of her main reasons to be interested in [Tsuda](https://anilist.co/character/32770/Tsuda-Takatoshi) is curiosity about information not covered in health classes. She is also a very popular girl with a lot of female fans in school, and has a complex about her chest, which is exacerbated by the fact that [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/32798/Shichijou-Aria) happens to be more

name: Takatoshi Tsuda
description:
The main character of the story, he chooses to attend a former all-girl school simply because it is close to his home. The first day at the school, he is forced to join the student council as its vice president and sole male representative.

Tsuda plays the role of the straight man, and is often worn out by his friends' antics.

name: Suzu Hagimura
description:
__Height:__ 140.6 cm

A first-year, sixteen-year-old genius return student. She's really the most mature of the characters, but she is very sensitive about her body, which still appears to be that of an elementary school student. She is the smartest student at Ousai Academy and boasts an IQ of 180. She can also perform 10-digit calculations in her head.

name: Lio Fotia
description: The leader of Mad Burnish. Lio seems like someone who keeps his cool, but it's actually the opposite. Lio aims to burn everything with the power of a special flame called "Burnish Flare".

name: Galo Thymos
description:
Galo Thymos is the Burning Rescue's newest recruit. Set with a burning passion to extinguish all that is wrong, you can expect Galo to rush in first to the scene of an emergency. His 'Burning Soul' is his strongest characteristic.

Galo isn't one for planning ahead of time and often speaks his mind. He is willful and often relies on that to get through battles. While Galo appears to be all brawn and no brain at first, he is actually deeply compassionate and hates to see others hurt. Furthermore, his plans, while odd, have been shown to work. Said plans consistently use the likes of hikeshi and

name: Ganta Nakami
description:
A high school student of Kuyo High School who suffers from insomnia. He comes off as grumpy and unfriendly due to his condition. Ganta is determined to protect the observatory and the revived Astronomy Club, of which he becomes the president.

After meeting Isaki, he opens up to the people around him and reveals to Isaki that the cause of his insomnia is due to separation anxiety caused by his mother leaving him and his father.

He becomes Isaki's boyfriend at the end of the club trip during the summer holiday of their first year. He aims to get into a university with a nursing program in Kana

name: Isaki Magari
description:
A cheerful high school girl who also suffers from insomnia like Ganta. She first discovered the abandoned observatory and made it her sleeping haven, until Ganta came along. 

As she and Ganta became closer, she shared to him that she has congenital heart disease which requires monthly examinations, frequent hospitalization, and even surgeries. She was the only other member of the Astronomy Club in her first year, and became the vice-president later in the winter of the same year.

She started dating Ganta after his confession at the end of their club trip. Initially, she aimed for a universit

name: Seiji Amasawa
description: A boy who first appeared reading a book that Shizuku had left behind. In the book, Shizuku left her song lyrics inside, and Seiji read them. He, in reality, liked them, but when Shizuku returned to retrieve her book, he called the lyrics corny, which caused her to call him a jerk. He's frequently seen riding his bicycle during the movie. Like once when Shizuku forgot her lunch in his grandfather's shop, he returned the lunch to her, with his bicycle. He playfully comments on the enormous amounts of food inside the lunch, asking her if she eats that much. Shizuku again yells at him. Their first

name: Shizuku Tsukishima
description: Shizuku is a junior high student living in the Tokyo Suburb of Tama New Town. She loves to write, or at least has the potential for she writes the translation of the song "Country Road" from English to Japanese for graduation (she also creates her own version for Tokyo, which shows that potential as well). At the beginning of the film, it's summer and all the students are awaiting the arrival of the new school year. Shizuku is determined to read at least twenty books before that happens. Her local library does not have one that she wants to read the most, so she goes to school to find it and i

name: Humbert von Gikkingen Danshaku
native: フンベルト・フォン・ジッキンゲン男爵
description: As the owner of the strange "Cat Bureau", he is known as a helper to all. He is an artisan's statue that somehow has been brought to life.

name: Leo Demonheart
description:
**Abilities:**
-Crimson Comet: A High level attack magic
-Twelve Layers Of Barrier (Statis)': A High level magic which can nullify or seal any type of magic regardlessly.
-Voice Changer: A magic that allows to change your voice to anybody's.
-Metamorphisis: A magic for disguise.
-Clearance: A magic which can heals diseases or curses.
-Mirage Eye: A magic technique that can send the information that was seen as it is in its eyes to its caster.

Leo Demonheart is the strongest of all of the Twelve Demonheart Series. He is the main protagonist of the Yuusha, Yamemasu series.

name: Echidna
description: Echidna is the demon queen leading the latest invasion on mankind in search of the Philosopher's Stone. After being defeated by Leo Demonheart, she was driven into retreat, but seeks to rebuild her army.

name: Nozomi Kaminashi
description:
Nozomi Kaminashi is the main protagonist of Keijo!!!!!!!!. She was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class.

Upon graduating from Setouchi, Nozomi officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Hyougo Branch. After her winless start in the professional world of Keijo, Nozomi tries to seek a mentor to guide her. After meeting [Sumire Sakuragi](https://anilist.co/character/271330/Sakuragi-Sumire), Nozomi asks Sumire to become her mentor. Although Sumire initially refused, Sumire is later will

name: Sayaka Miyata
description:
Kaminashi's first friend and rival. 

Before Keijo used to be a judo's athlete, she was the Japan's hope for a golden medal in the Olympics but threw it all away in the qualifications. She has a complex about her bust size and Kaminashi usually makes fun about it.

She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class. Upon graduating from Setouchi, Sayaka officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kansai's Hyougo Branch.

name: Kazane Aoba
description:
She is a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School, a former resident of Room 309 and currently a member of the Elite Class.

Upon graduating from Setouchi, Kazane officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Chugoku's Hiroshima Branch. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

name: Non Toyoguchi
description:
Non Toyoguchi was a student at Setouchi Keijo Training School. She previously resided in Room 309 before being promoted to the Elite Class.

Upon graduating from Setouchi, Non officially becomes a B-Rank Keijo player, affiliated with the Kyushu's Kagoshima Branch. Sometime later, she is able to advance to the A-Rank.

name: Senko
description:
__Race:__ Kitsune+
__Height:__ 135 cm (4'5")

Her name is Senko, and she’s a divine messenger fox of 800 years! Her mission is to ease the anxiety and darkness plaguing humanity, and thus she has come to pamper and take care of [Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/130431/Nakano-Kuroto) by cooking, cleaning, and more!

name: Kuroto Nakano
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Nakano is a depressed salaryman working for an exploitative company, until [Senko](https://anilist.co/character/130429/Senko) intrudes into his life!

name: Yasuko Kouenji
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

She is a student and mangaka. She is the next door neighbor of [Kuroto Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/130431/Nakano-Kuroto) and [Senko-san](https://anilist.co/character/130429/Senko).

Spoiler: Later, Shiro comes to her place and begins pampering her similar to how Senko-San pampers Nakano.

name: Shiro
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm

Another fox goddess, who appears at [Nakano](https://anilist.co/character/130431/Nakano-Kuroto)’s house after [Senko](https://anilist.co/character/130429/Senko). Her pure white tail is a proof of her pure blood! She has special abilities like reading people’s hearts and seeing visions.

name: Albedo
description: The overseer of the Floor Guardians and one of the most powerful NPC in Nazarick. She takes the form of a beautiful woman with fallen angel wings and horns. Because [Ainz](https://anilist.co/character/89103) modified her settings on a whim, she ends up madly in love with him. Albedo's romantic obsessions are so strong that if Ainz were to even glance at her body, she would immediately become excited. Albedo's obsession with Ainz has led him to greatly regret his actions. While she tries to act calm, as befitting of her role, any perceived insult against Ainz or Nazarick, real or imagined, send

name: Shou
description: Shou is a young boy who befriends Arrietty. In the beginning of the film he moves in with his great aunt because he suffers from a heart condition and needs lots of rest and quiet.

name: Arrietty
description: A 14-year old borrower who lives with her parents under the floorboards of Shou's house.

name: Yupa
description:
Nausicaä's teacher and legendary swordsman. He's been traveling the world in search of the secret of the Sea of Corruption.  

(Source: nausicaa.net)

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Kushana
description: Princess of Torumekia, youngest daughter of the Vai Emperor.      In the anime, she lost one of her arms as a child during an Ohmu attack, and is driven by a desire for revenge against the giant insects.  She intends to wipe the Sea of Corruption off the face of the earth, by any means necessary.  While she is not presented as completely evil, she is definitely an antagonist.    In the manga, she has a much more complicated role, more of an antihero/ally than an antagonist.  She is mostly driven by a desire for revenge against her father and three older half-brothers, whom she hates and blames

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Asbel
description:
Rastel's twin brother. He is the sole survivor of Pejite, and deeply hates Kushana and Torumekians. He is a very good pilot, mechanic, and swordsman. He was rescued by Nausicaä at the bottom of the Sea of Corruption, and witnessed the secret of the Sea of Corruption with Nausicaä. He sometimes accompanies Nausicaä, and sometimes travels alone or with others.

(Source: nausicca.net)

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Nausicaä
description:
The Princess of the Valley of Wind. She is clever, resourceful, and a skilled swordswoman. She is a windrider, who can read and utilize the wind well, and flies a "Mehve", a glider with an engine. She has an empathetic ability and can even communicate with insects from the Sea of Corruption.

As a next chieftain of the Valley, she joins [Kushana](https://anilist.co/character/541/Kushana)'s army, but the gruesome reality of the war devastates her. She desperately tries to stop mass killing and suffering, and her quest for the truth leads her to the most unimaginable places, and to the biggest s

appearsIn.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

name: Yume Irido
description: Yume moves in with her ex-boyfriend Mizuto Irido when their parents remarry. Loves reading, especially mystery novels. Used to be quite introverted and shy but put in the effort to socialize and become popular after entering high school.

appearsIn.title: My Stepmom's Daughter is My Ex

name: Mizuto Irido
description: Mizuto is a relatively introverted high-school boy with high intelligence and an interest in books of all kind. Moved in with his ex-girlfriend after their parents remarried.

appearsIn.title: My Stepmom's Daughter is My Ex

name: Anzu Hoshino
description: Anzu Hoshino is the protagonist who bears the "anti-heroine" attribute. She is a high school first year who claims her 3 great desires are video games, cat, and chocolate. She has no interest in real life romance and has been counter-measuring all the shojo manga-like situations conspired by [Riri](https://anilist.co/character/285561/Riri). She is logical and a very caring person who can't leave her troubled friends. Her biggest fear are cockroaches.

name: Riri
description: Riri is a wizard who can do romantic magic with their star shaped magic wand.

name: Tsukasa Kazuki
description:
A cold and reserved boy who is Anzu's first romance candidate. He is popular among women due to his good looks but tends to avoid them, rejecting any romantic proposals outright. He meets Anzu in a meet cute where she accidentally bumps into him and breaks his phone. Due to Riri's meddling, his house is flooded and he has to live with Anzu early in the story. 

It is later revealed that before transferring schools he was a warm and caring person who could "befriend anyone", indicating that his cold appearance is a façade.  In an effort to distance himself from women's attention, he often wears

name: Hijiri Koganei
description: A wealthy boy who is not in touch with the lives of "peasants", also set up by Riri for Anzu. He meets Anzu in a twist on a classic anime meet cute, where she is running late to school and is hit by his car. He takes her on a date for compensation, assuming she got hit on purpose, and is shocked when she rejects him. He is not used to having girls reject him so he tries to woo Anzu by buying her off. After being called out and further by Anzu, he tries to navigate common life by getting a job at the convenience store that Anzu works at and getting his own money. Knowing how much Hijiri was use

name: Junta Hayami
description:
The "childhood friend" that Riri set up for Anzu. Anzu originally believed him to be a random hot guy brainwashed by Riri, but it is later revealed that he is in fact a childhood friend of Anzu.

He had picked up baseball and changed himself after overhearing Anzu say that she would like to date an "athletic guy who can beat the boss."

Anzu is aware of his feelings for her, and acts oblivious to hide it from him.

name: William Maryblood
native: ウィリアム・G・マリーブラッド
description:
He is a lone human from the City of the Dead, born with vague memories of a past life and raised by a group of undead until the age of adulthood, he swore an oath to [Gracefeel](https://anilist.co/character/129753/Gracefeel) and leaves the city in search for adventure and civilisation while he restores the faith of his guardian deity.

He was brought to the City of the Dead as an infant by demons with the intention to be used as a sacrifice to break the seal placed upon the High King, however, he was found and taken in by a group of undead, these three undead were [Blood](https://anilist.co/ch

name: Noko Shikanoko
description:
__Grade:__ 3rd Year
__Positions:__ Founder, Mascot, and Official Deer of the Deer Club, Part-Time Deer at Hino Zoo.

Noko Shikanoko is a unique human-deer hybrid and the founder and mascot of the Deer Club at Hino Minami High School.

She is a transfer student who becomes the best friend, classmate, and clubmate of [Torako Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi).

name: Torako Koshi
description:
__Grade:__ 3rd Year (Formerly 2nd Year).
__Positions:__ President of the Deer Club, Head of the Student Council, Delinquent Gang Member (Formerly).
__Relatives:__ [Anko Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330138/Anko-Koshi) (Younger Sister).

Torako Koshi is a student at Hino Minami High School, and a highly respected one at that; being considered by many to be a "perfect girl". She is the classmate, best friend, and clubmate of [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko).

Wanting to change for the better after her past of being a delinquent, Koshi vowed to renew her

name: Tomodachi
description:
The main antagonist of the series. An enigmatic cult leader who, in 1997, began using the symbol [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Endou-Kenji) and his friends put together in the 1970s. His followers have filled venues such as the Budokan.One of his goals is to take over the world. His face is hidden in shadow throughout the series; he even confronts Kenji by wearing a mask. His true identity is one of the driving mysteries of the series. As of 2000, the Friendship Democratic Party (FDP) is established as a political group with government representatives such as Manjome Inshu.   

Ove

name: Kenji Endou
description: Endo Kenji grew up in late-1960s/early-1970s Japan, at a time when American phenomena, notably the space race and the era of Woodstock, were resounding around the world.  An avid reader of manga who often saw apocalyptic scenarios playing out, he always responded with the cry of "I would fight".  During this time, he and his friends made up a scenario for world conquest in order to play heroes.  Flash forward to 1997, when Kenji has taken charge of his family liquor shop, and turned it into a convenience store.  He is now raising the daughter of his sister, [Kiriko](https://anilist.co/characte

name: Kanna Endou
description: [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Endou-Kenji)'s niece, she serves as the protagonist for the events in the aftermath of the "Bloody New Year's Eve". She is shown to have ESP at an advanced level, and is capable of predicting the future (To a small extent), bend spoons with her mind, and even once strangled a woman without touching her (in a fit of emotional rage). She loves rock&roll, due to Kenji's obsession with it. She idolizes Kenji despite what the rest of the world thinks of him, and is also quite skilled at the guitar. She lives by herself in a low-rent apartment and works

name: Chouji Ochiai
description: A childhood friend of Kenji's who created the "Friend" symbol and became a salaryman. Later traveled to Tibet and Thailand after his son died, at which point he gets involved in the dealings of the "Friend" group.  長治 is sometimes misread as "Nagaharu" but his first name is Chouji.

name: Yami Sukehiro
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Yami Sukehiro is a foreigner from the Land of the Sun and the first captain of the Clover Kingdom's Black Bulls squad of the Magic Knights. He is also a former member of the Grey Deer squad.

appearsIn.title: Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King

name: Rumiko Manbagi
description:
**Height:** 158.3 cm

Rumiko Manbagi is a gyaru girl who enters the second year of school with no friends. She becomes friends with [Shouko Komi](https://anilist.co/character/121956/Komi-Shouko) and [Hitohito Tadano](https://anilist.co/character/78093/Tadano-Hitohito), her being the first Komi was able to befriend alone.

Manbagi is a manba-styled gyaru girl with tanned skin, bleached light hair, and a very girly fashion sense. She's introduced in ridiculous, heavy makeup, but once that's removed she is revealed to have a naturally beautiful face. She has shoulder-length, wavy blonde hair, a d

name: Kakushi Gotou
description: He writes vulgar manga and tries to hide it from his young daughter, Hime. He tends to be overprotective, which often leads to misunderstandings, but all he wants is for Hime to grow up well.

name: Hime Gotou
description:
[Kakushi](https://anilist.co/character/120482)'s kind daughter who loves her dad very much. As far as she knows, her dad works as a normal salaryman.

It is revealed that she has a step-brother, [Nantokaemon Ishikawa](https://anilist.co/character/175254).

name: Hildegard
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'3")

Hilda, is a Demon that serves as both the adoptive mother and wet nurse to [Beelzebub IV](https://anilist.co/character/21154/Beelzebub-IV-Kaiser-de-Emperana). 

She is an attractive young woman with blonde hair that covers one side of her face and is tied in a bun, green eyes and a well-endowed chest. Her clothes are mostly elegant and black with frills and white quillings, thus resembling Lolita Fashion.

name: Kaiser de Emperana Beelzebub IV
native: カイゼル・デ・エンペラーナ・ベルゼバブ4世
description:
The son of the Devil King. He is very attached to [Oga](https://anilist.co/character/20766/Oga-Tatsumi), clinging with a vice-like grip to Oga's back. When he is agitated or sees blood, he will spontaneously electrocute anyone within his vicinity. Beelzebub's characteristic cry is "Daabuu!" and he is always naked with a pacifier in his mouth.

Baby Be'el is very easily impressed, especially by strong people since he himself is still weak and loses to other babies as well as to cats. On the other hand he is not the smartest one out there and tries to force his way through the most simple proble

name: Alaindelon Bathin de Emuna
native: バティム・ド・エムナ・アランドロン
description:
Alaindelon surprisingly resembles Queen lead singer Freddy Mercury. They share hairstyles, moustache and even attitude. However, Alaindelon is better built being quite muscular. He often wears sweatshirts along with boxer shorts.  Alaindelon is a very comical person. Even though he tries to remain serious, his uselessness usually puts him down. 

He is a dimensional demon capable of going in between dimensions. He also has the ability to open himself up in order for people to enter him and be able to travel alongside him. He also lacks physical strength, but seems to make up for it with incred

name: Takayuki Furuichi
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") 
__Likes:__ cute women, beautiful women, simply women

Furuichi is one of the main protagonists of Beelzebub.  Furuichi is Oga's best friend and along with him is a 1st year at Ishiyama High. After finding out about Oga's baby he joins him up in his search for a new parent. He is actually the most normal person in the anime/manga because he tries to add common sense to everything. He also has no powers.  Although Furuichi does retain a rational, passive and calm demeanor, he usually reacts in an insane (but often comical) fashion whenever a character does something ou

name: Aoi Kunieda
description:
__Name meaning:__ State Branch's Sunflower 
__Height:__ 162 cm (5' 4'') 
__Occupation:__ High school student, Shrine maiden 
__Affiliation:__ Touhoushinki, Red Tails 

Aoi is a second-year student and the third leader of the "strongest ladies of Kantou", the Red Tails. She is first introduced in disguise at the park taking care of her baby brother, Kouta, who is constantly mistaken as being Aoi's own child by the mothers at the park. She is the daughter of a local temple keeper. Her nickname is Queen because she is the protector of all the girls at Ishiyama High from the men's "grubby hands".

name: Tatsumi Oga
description:
**Height:** 179 cm (5'11'')
**Occupation:** High school student, adolescent delinquent
**Debut:** Ep. 1/Ch. 1

Tatsumi Oga is the main protagonist in the Beelzebub series, first introduced as a strong fighter, beating up some fellow class mates and then making them bow down to him because they had attacked him in his sleep. He was picked to become Beelzebub's parent as he possessed the qualities of the ideal parent for the future Demon Lord: strong, arrogant, and thinks-nothing-of-fellow-man. In addition to the aforementioned attributes, Oga also seems to take pleasure in tormenting others.As

name: Jurai Andou
description:
Jurai is the main protagonist of Ino Battle wa Nichijo-kei no Naka de. He is also part of the school Literature Club on his right hand he has a superpower called, "Dark and Dark."

Jurai is a goofy boy. Due to his Chunin Syndrome, he often falls into a world of his own, causing annoyance to those around him. Because of this he has developed a very care free personality that can often accept other peoples' faults without much trouble. When he gained his superpower, he was excited, saying that even though it didn't do much, he still loved it all the same, because every guy wants one.

(Source: I

name: Chifuyu Himeki
description:
She is a shy elementary school girl, she was accepted as an unofficial member of the Literature Club mainly because she is the club advisers's relative. Her special powers allows her to create anything out of thin air, she can also create portals, dimensions and she can also manipulate any materials down to its sub atomic level. 

Just like the rest of the girls in her club, she too has feelings for Andou.

(Source: Zinc View)

name: Tomoyo Kanzaki
description:
Tomoyo Kanzaki is one of the main characters of Ino Battle wa Nichijou-kei no Naka de. She has the superpower to manipulate time, "Closed Clock," and she is also part of the Literature Club.

A red-haired girl who is constantly bemused by Jurai's antics. Her power allow her to speed up, slow down, or stop time, though she cannot rewind it.

name: Hatoko Kushikawa
description:
Hatoko Kushikawa is one of the main characters of Ino Battle wa Nichijo-kei no Naka de. She is also a part of the Literature Club.

She is a polite air-headed girl who often takes Jurai's chunibyo antics seriously. Her power is "Over Element," which gives her the ability to manipulate five main elements of the natural world: earth, water, fire, wind, and light.

She is also Jurai's childhood friend and next door neighbor, who sometimes drops by to his house to cook for him and his big sister, since both of them admit to being bad at cooking. She has a tendency to be jealous towards Jurai when

name: Sayumi Takanashi
description:
She is a senior student and the president of the Literature Club. She is normally seen reading books, and there are hints that she has feelings for Andou. Her power is "Root of Origins" in which anyone she touches returns to his or her original state, although the exact nature of this remains vague. She a very refine girl, whose other hobbies, besides reading, includes ikebana, origami, and martial arts.

For some reason, she dislikes being called "cute."

(Source: Zince-View, edited)

name: Keita Suminoe
description: Keita is a third-year junior-high school student studying for his high school entrance exams and although he is the younger brother, it is obvious he is the most mature of the three siblings. He wants to enter the same high school as his older twin step-sisters [Ako](https://anilist.co/character/8040) and [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/8041), and to do so must study hard while getting help from his sisters as well as he was originally planning on relying on his track running scholarship for another school. While at first he initially dislikes himself for becoming attracted to Ako and Riko

name: Ako Suminoe
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (OVA 7)  

Ako is the elder twin sister. A way to tell her apart from [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/8041/Suminoe-Riko) is that she wears a hair clip to keep the hair off her forehead. She has a reliable, level-headed personality, but can be sullen, moody, even a bit childish and is quickly embarrassed. She carries herself differently than her sister, is more skilled in cooking which she learned to help her mom out with the housework, and is strong with alcohol which she sometimes uses to her advantage to knock out Riko to have the livelier [Keita](https://anilist.co/ch

name: Riko Suminoe
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm

Riko is the younger twin sister. A way to tell her apart from Ako is that she wears her hair in a ponytail, and it is longer than her sister's hair. Also, she has a bandage below her left eye. She has a habit of answering truthfully but very bluntly, causing everyone else to jump to conclusions, even at one time about to honestly state that she and her sister wanted a computer solely for porn, however was quickly stopped by Ako. She is much shyer in person than her sister, as she could not kiss Keita in front of others. At school, she is on the disciplinary committee, where

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Scarlet Bond

name: Hiiro
description: A survivor of the Ogre Village. He is given his name by  [Towa](https://anilist.co/character/285168), the queen of the kingdom of Raja.

appearsIn.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Scarlet Bond

name: Kae Serinuma
description: A nerdy and chubby girl in second year of high school. She's a fujoshi obsessed with BL and otome games. After spending a week without eating due to sadness after the death of her favourite character, she loses weight and becomes stunning, earning four suitors.

name: Asuma Mutsumi
description:
__Affiliation:__ History Club

He is a high school student in his third year and head of the history club. He is also one of the four boys and one girl who are trying to win Kae Serinuma's affection.

Mutsumi is depicted having straight shaggy brown hair that is styled on either side, slanted light brown eyes, a calm expression and he is often seen with a soft, genuine smile.

In the manga, Kae Serinuma made her choice and asked Asuma to become her boyfriend. Seven years after Mutsumi graduated, they get married and have a son named Shion Mutsumi.

(Source: Watashi Ga Motete Dousunda Wikia)

name: Shima Nishina
description: Shima Nishina is a first-year high school student, fujoshi, mangaka and cosplayer. She's in class 1-4, and is known to be quite popular and crafty. She's a smooth talker and can easily appear likeable to her peers.

name: Minako Aino
description: Minako is the fourth member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the leader of the Guardian Senshi who protect her. She uses love-related powers. In the manga and anime series she dreams of becoming a famous idol, whereas in the live-action series her character is refactored to already be a celebrity. Silly or serious, Minako consistently displays great confidence, enthusiasm, and leadership skill. She is the "owner" of [Artemis](https://anilist.co/character/5408/Artemis), the white guardian cat who introduced her

name: Mamoru Chiba
description:
Mamoru Chiba is the major romantic interest of [Usagi Tsukino](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi). He is often portrayed as stoic, steady and introverted. This may be because when he was young his parents died in a car crash. This blocked his childhood memories of his current lifetime and opened up the memories of his previous life as Prince Endymion. Tuxedo Mask is a disguise Mamoru created for himself in order to hunt for the Silver Crystal incognito and, later, assist the Sailor Senshi in battle.

He is always addressed as Mamo-chan by Usagi throughout the series (Chibiusa als

name: Rei Hino
description: An elegant miko (shrine maiden), called Raye in the English version and Raya in the French version. Because of her work as a Shintô priestess, Rei can sense and dispel evil even in civilian form. When she transforms into Sailor Mars, she can also manipulate fire. She is very serious and focused, but although easily annoyed by [Usagi's](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi) flightiness, cares about her very much. Rei is portrayed as boy-crazy in the early anime, but is uninterested in romance in both the manga and live-action series. She attends a private Catholic school, separate fr

name: Usagi Tsukino
description:
__Family Members:__ [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/18345/Tsukino-Kenji) (Father), [Ikuko](https://anilist.co/character/17937/Tsukino-Ikuko) (Mother), [Shingo](https://anilist.co/character/18346/Tsukino-Shingo) (Younger Brother) 

The main character of the series, called Serena in the English dub (nicknamed Bunny in the manga). Usagi is a carefree schoolgirl with an enormous capacity for love, and transforms into the heroine called Sailor Moon. At the beginning of the series she is portrayed as an immature crybaby who hates having to fight, but over the course of the series you come to kn

name: Makoto Kino
description: Makoto is the third member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by [Sailor Moon](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi), and serves as the "muscles" of the group. In addition to being physically tough, she is able to manipulate electricity and uses some plant-based powers. Her friends rarely use her full given name, normally shortening it to Mako-chan.

name: Artemis
description: Artemis is the companion to the leader of the Guardian Senshi—he trained [Minako Aino](https://anilist.co/character/2826/Minako-Aino) as Sailor V, and remains by her side when she takes on her proper role as Sailor Venus. His memory of the Silver Millennium seems to be more intact than Luna's—in fact, before appearing in the Sailor Moon series he guides her through the Sailor V video game at the arcade. Later, he fills in the details of her true mission. Artemis is more easy going than [Luna,](https://anilist.co/character/5407/Luna) and has a "big brother" relationship with Minako, although hi

name: Luna
description:
Luna was a talking cat and advisor to [Usagi Tsukino.](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Usagi-Tsukino) It was she who first detected Usagi's power, but at the time did not realize that she was the Moon Princess. Luna and her partner [Artemis](https://anilist.co/character/5408/Artemis) were advisors to [Queen Serenity](https://anilist.co/character/17010/Queen-Serenity) in the Silver Millennium, and when the kingdom was ruined Serenity used the power of her Silver Crystal to send the two cats to Earth's future in order to awaken the Sailor Senshi. 

She and Artemis one day married and had a dau

name: Ami Mizuno
description: A quiet bookworm in Usagi's class called Amy in the English adaptations of the series. She is hugely intelligent, with an IQ of 300, and can transform into Sailor Mercury, acquiring power over water. Ami's shy exterior masks a passion for knowledge and for taking care of the people around her. She hopes to be a doctor one day, like her mother and tends to be the practical one in the group. Secretly, she is also a fan of pop culture and romance novels and becomes embarrassed whenever this is pointed out.

name: Yuuta Hibiki
description:
Yuuta has amnesia at the beginning to the extent of not even remembering where he lives. He fuses with Junk to become Gridman.

It is later revealed that the Yuuta we have seen throughout the show has been Gridman inside of Yuuta's body the entire time, except he had forgotten who he was (explaining the amnesia).

name: Rikka Takarada
description: The sole female member of Gridman Alliance and Yūta's classmate, who found the amnesiac boy in front of her house. Out of her teammates, she desires a normal life but wishes Yūta to keep fighting as Gridman to save her friends. Once discovering Akane's double life as the creator of the monsters, Rikka becomes committed to reason with her friend despite the former's insistence that their friendship was not genuine. Before Akane leaves for her world, Rikka gives her a purse case as a departure gift.

name: Akane Shinjou
description: Akane is noted to be a kind and popular girl, liked by all her classmates, and especially admired by Utsumi. However, behind that facade lies a mentally troubled individual with sociopathic tendencies, easily harboring petty grudges against anyone who wrongs her, even if it was an accident. She is also shown to be extremely manipulative and violent. Alongside Alexis Kerib, she serves as a central antagonist in SSSS.Gridman.

name: Gridman
description:
Gridman (グリッドマン, Guriddoman) is a Hyper Agent from the Hyper World and the titular hero of SSSS.GRIDMAN and GRIDMAN UNIVERSE. 

In SSSS.GRIDMAN, he chose Yuuta Hibiki as his host to stop Alexis Kerib in order to save Akane Shinjou. However, the injuries he sustained from the fight against Alexis resulted Gridman split into six fragments. Whereas Gridman's master fragment resided within an old computer aptly named "Junk", Four of the fragments spawned new Hyper Agents that became both hosts of said fragments and new assist weapons at the simulated city while the last one ended up possessing his

name: Gesicht
description:
He attempts to capture a powerful killer in Germany who is attacking both humans and robots with no apparent motives.

In the original manga, Gesicht's name was Gerhart, and in the 1980's anime his name was Zeron. In Pluto, he along with his wife and the other robots in the story are given a human appearance - contradictory to his prior robot appearances in both the manga and 1980 series.

name: Atom
description: Loosely based off of Osamu Tezuka's classic character, "Astro Boy," Atom of the "Pluto" series is a highly developed robot. He is constantly classified as one of the worlds top seven robotic technological advances in science, to the point that even Gesicht's sensors have trouble distinguishing him as a robot or human.  He works with Gesicht in order to help discover the truth behind the recent chain of murders. He has a sister, Uran.

name: Chika Kudou
description:
**Height:** 178 cm (5'10")

The first member to join Kurata in the club. Kudou brings with him a reputation for fighting and delinquency, which initially makes others distrustful of him. However, underneath his rough exterior is a kind heart who wants to honor his deceased grandfather by playing the koto.

Prior to the start of the series, Chika was neglected by his father and was caused to live with his grandfather, [Gen Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/134571/Kudou-Gen), instead. During these days, Chika would always get into fights and is infamous because of this. Despite this, [Tetsuki T

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Kouta Mizuhara
description: Kota Mizuhara is a second year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Satowa Houzuki
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Satowa is a first year student and the daughter of a famous koto family, Houzuki. She has been learning to play koto since she was little and has won many contests. Although she is a koto prodigy, Satowa was debarred from Houzukikai. She claims that she joined the koto music club because she wants to become known as "young virtuoso koto player that led a no-name school club to become number 1 in nation" when she makes professional debut. She loves koto.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Michitaka Sakai
description: Michitaka Sakai is a second year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Hiro Kurusu
description: She is Takezou's classmate and joins the koto music club after hearing their first performance. She has knowledge of koto due to the influence of her grandmother. She becomes the koto music club's vice-president.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Takezou Kurata
description: President of koto music club. He's shy and weak in difficult situations. After his failure at the exam, depressed, Takezou saw his senpai's performance, where she was giving her all even though no one listened and koto's string had been broken. He was deeply moved by her performance, so he joined the club. After senpai's graduation, he became an only member of koto music club and had to find strength to protect it.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Suzuka Takinami
description:
A math teacher at Tokise High and the Koto Club's advisor.

Initially he feigned ignorance of his musical background, though it's later revealed that his parents are world renowned musicians. As a child, he had no interest in playing music whatsoever other than listening to it. When he was seven, his father discovered his talent for writing musical scores and quickly took upon him to brand his son as a child prodigy. Because of this, Suzuka began to disdain music but his interest is later revitalized after becoming the advisor for the Koto club. He often writes pieces for the club as well as g

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Saneyasu Adachi
description: Saneyasu is a second-year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

appearsIn.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

name: Diego Brando
native: ディエゴ・ブランドー
description:
Diego Brando (usually called "Dio" for short) is a famous professional jockey from England. He is one of the participants in the Steel Ball Run race. Although unrelated to his DIO counterpart directly (parts 1-6 and 7-9 take place in two distinct, separate universes), he appears to be very similar to the original Dio in both looks and personality. 

He was raised among a group of homeless people after his mother saved him from drowning in a river when he was still a baby. He was later adopted into nobility when his talent as a jockey was discovered. Although he was raised with much love, he ac

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run
STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: Johnny Joestar
native: ジョニィ・ジョースター
description:
Johnny Joestar is an American former jockey turned paraplegic, and is the main protagonist of Part 7. He is a depressive man with a bleak outlook on life, but he is also very stubborn and capable of extreme, unwavering determination to the point of disregarding any risks or consequences, putting his goal above all else. He joins the Steel Ball Run race to find out the secret behind [Gyro Zeppeli's](https://anilist.co/character/11772) steel balls, as Johnny believes they're capable of healing his legs.

Johnny was once a horse racing prodigy. However, when waiting in line for a play, the girl h

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run
STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: Lucy Steel
native: ルーシー・スティール
description:
Lucy Steel is the wife of Steven Steel, the organizer of the Steel Ball Run race. Lucy is a kind, intelligent, and gentle girl who is extremely loyal to her husband. Although she appears nervous and meek, Lucy is incredibly courageous, resourceful, and determined.

Lucy's involvement with the story truly begins when Funny Valentine is introduced. Lucy finds out that Funny Valentine plans to gather the bones of "The Saint" for his own needs and also kill Steven Steel. Lucy goes to great lengths to prevent this from happening.

Later on, Lucy teams up with Hot Pants to steal back the heart of Je

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run
STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: Funny Valentine
native: ファニー・ヴァレンタイン
description:
Funny Valentine is the 23rd President of the United States, and the main antagonist of Steel Ball Run. He is the true mastermind behind the Steel Ball Run race. He watches the competition from behind the curtains and hopes to gather the Saint's Corpse to use the Holy Relic to further the United States of America's interests and power, and explains that his way to do that is by "taking the first napkin".

Valentine has a lot of importance for patriotism and seems to care about his country. Most of his bad deeds are not selfishly centered, but instead are done in order to achieve what he thinks

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run

name: Gyro Zeppeli
native: ユリウス・カエサル・ツェペリ
description:
Gyro has a cocky and flamboyant personality, appearing to have a high opinion of himself. However, he can be driven by emotions for other people and become realistic and serious when a problem presents itself.

Like most Manga archetypes, Gyro is incredibly intelligent when he needs to be. His most distinguishable body features are his long hair, western hat and his gold teeth which have "GO! GO! ZEPPELI" displayed on them, revealed whenever he smiles at someone. His signature laugh/chuckle is "Nyo ho ho ho~".

Note that the "Caesar" in his name is pronounced in the traditional Greek way, more

STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 1st STAGE

name: Rika Shiguma
description: Rika Shiguma is a main supporting character from the Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai series, a freshman and scientific genius whose presence at St. Chronica's Academy was designed to increase its prestige. She was saved by Kodaka when she fell unconscious during a disastrous lab experiment (she invented and released sleeping gas that works in just a few seconds), and begs to repay his kindness with sex. She joined the Neighbor's Club just to get closer to him. She is the fifth member of the club. Rika was a shut-in before joining, being isolated from the outside world her personal room in the sch

name: Agni
description:
Agni is the titular protagonist of Fire Punch. He is a large, muscular young man with black hair and his entire body is on fire except for his mouth and the left side of his face. Agni possesses the blessing of Regeneration. His regeneration is extremely powerful, as he is able to regrow lost limbs instantly and even regenerate from being beheaded.

On his way home one day, he sees a plane flying towards the village. Investigating, he sees a large group of men rounding up the older members of the village at gunpoint. He intervenes, telling the men to leave the elders alone. Agni is approached

name: Judah
description: Judah (ユダ, Yuda) is one of the main characters of Fire Punch. She had an overwhelmingly powerful blessing of regeneration.

name: Kanata Hoshijima
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm (5'11")
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District

Kanata is naturally athletic and a steadfast person that wants to become a space explorer. He is also a very selfless person who would willingly help anyone in distress and would take any risks necessary to save them. He acts like a leader and wishes to be acknowledged as one by his comrades. 

Later in the story it's revealed that  the reason why he wants to become a space explorer was the influence of one of his middle school teacher's that passed away in a fatal accident that happened during a school trip. That accident was also t

name: Luca Esposito
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District

Luca is deft with their hands and has a strong artistic sense.

Luca is an intersex person and possesses both male and female sexual and reproductive organs. He currently identifies as male, but he explains how being male or female can feel fluid to him and can fluctuate by the day.

He was adopted and raised by [Senator Marco Esposito](https://anilist.co/character/157841/Esposito-Marco).

name: Quitterie Raffaeli
native: キトリー・ラファエリ
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District

She likes being fashionable and doesn't feel comfortable around strange animals. Although she's not good at socialising, [Zack](https://anilist.co/character/139432/Walker-Zack) and her have been friends since they were little due to their parents being coworkers.

Quitterie's mother is the head doctor at a hospital and she wishes to become a doctor like her in the future, so she's studying medicine. She never knew her father.

Later in the story it is revealed that she was actually raised solely by her family's servants. Because of th

name: Aries Spring
native: アリエス・スプリング
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Hometown:__ Rosapop District

Aries is a very cheerful, optimistic, and spacey girl. According to her friends, she is also careless and can't take a hint. She is also a very grateful person that would repeatedly thank someone who helps her.

Although she is a bit spacey, she actually has photographic memory.

In the end, she marries Kanata.

name: Zack Walker
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Weight:__ 76 kg (168 lbs.)
__Eye color:__ Blue
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District

Zack is a genius with an IQ of 200 whose field of expertise is space science. He even has a spaceship pilot's license. He and [Quitterie](https://anilist.co/character/122754/Raffaeli-Quitterie) have been friends since they were little due to their parents being coworkers.

He ends up marrying Quitterie.

name: Ulgar Zweig
native: ウルガー・ツヴァイク
description:
__Hometown:__ Mousanish District
__Height__: 165 cm (5'5")

Ulgar is a snarky person and extremely reserved, he is a lone wolf and tries to stay away from the group. His favourite piece of clothing is his knit cap from the popular fashion brand Rocket Rollance. name: Itsuki Hashima
description:
__Occupation:__ Novelist

Itsuki is the protagonist of the series who has an obsession towards younger sisters. He is a novelist who debuted when he was in high school; all of his novels feature younger sisters as the heroine. In the span of five years, he has published 20 books, some of which have ranked in the top 10 weekly rankings for light novels on Oricon. Despite his success, his irrational personality and writing style has led to mediocre success compared to his fellow writers.

name: Nayuta Kani
description: Nayuta is a genius novelist who is in love with [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/123942/Hashima-Itsuki). She debuted as a novelist after she won a newcomer prize. Nayuta Kani is her pseudonym and even Itsuki does not know her real name. She cannot write if she is not naked. Starting in junior high school, she refused to go to school after getting bullied.

name: Miyako Shirakawa
description: Itsuki's former college classmate. Although she is not attempting to be a professional author like Itsuki is, she enjoys reading his works. She supports him, and Kani's work.

name: Haruto Fuwa
description: Haruto is another novelist who debuted around the same time as Itsuki. He is 22 years old and often drinks alcohol with Itsuki. Despite his cool appearance, he loves maid characters and owns a lot of adult games and figurines. Haruto has a "persona" in his social media to gain fans for his novel series' popularity. He has a younger sister whom puts on a tsundere persona around him.

name: Chihiro Hashima
description: Chihiro appears as Itsuki's younger step-sibling. Chihiro is a dependable person who looks after everyone and attends high school.It is later revealed that Chihiro is a girl.

name: Tetsuo Takahashi
description:
The main protagonist. A biology teacher who is fascinated by demis and wants to learn more about them. He is occasionally referred to as "Iron Man" by his students, a pun on his bulky physique and his name. As he learns about demis, he starts to understand the problems they face, both as teenagers and demis, and strives to help them in any way he can.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hikari Takanashi
description: A highly energetic vampire. She usually avoids biting other people's necks, instead drinking blood packs sent by the government and using blood substitutes like tomato juice. Contrary to myths, she loves eating garlic and merely dislikes bright lights. She occasionally has the urge to nibble on someone, usually her sister. Despite her lackadaisical nature, she often strives to help others in need.

name: Yuki Kusakabe
description:
A timid snow woman whose body is always cold. She will sometimes spread cold air while experiencing negative emotions and is susceptible to heat. She initially dislikes her demi nature, fearing that she could harm others, though Tetsuo manages to show her that the only things she can actually freeze are her tears and sweat. She's also secretly a manga enthusiast and has a taste for multiple genres.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sakie Satou
description:
A succubus who works as a math teacher. Due to the aphrodisiac her body produces, she constantly has to take precautions to avoid inadvertently seducing her male students, such as wearing a tracksuit and taking early trains. While her nature as a succubus leads several males to become attracted to her, she herself develops a crush on Tetsuo.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kyouko Machi
description: A shy dullahan whose head is always detached from her body, which has a blue flame coming from where the neck should be. Since she can't move her head by herself, she is always longing for contact with others. She develops a crush on Tetsuo, due to his kind and caring nature. She initially found it hard to make friends as people found it awkward to talk to her without bringing up her detached head in some way, despite her own acceptance of the concept and desire to joke about it. Incidentally, she does possess a neck, which allegedly exists in another space and serves as a wormhole between her

Before his death, Clow appointed Kero as the one to select the potential candidate to be the next master of the cards, Cerberus himself, and his "brother" and fellow guardian, Yue. After Sakura accidentally releases the cards, Cerberus chooses her to be the candidate and teaches her the basics of capturing the cards. Throughout the series, he displays an extensive knowledge of mysticism.

A rare Gohou-type shikigami, she possesses independent thought and actions and is fiercely loyal to her master, and even gets jealous when Harutora associates with other girls.

Shortly before Harutora's awakening as Yakou, Kon reveals her true identity as Hishamaru, one of

name: Keith Kazama  Flick
native: キース・風間・フリック
description: Keith Kazama Flick is a character in B: The Beginning. On a winter eight years ago, his sister, Erika Flick, was murdered by someone, causing him to go into depression and eventually retire from the police force. During present day, he is called out of retirement by his old friend, Eric Toga, to help the R.I.S. criminal investigation force to track down the serial murderer known as "Killer B".

name: Koku
description:
Koku is one of the main characters in B: The Beginning. He works as a Violin Craftsman under Lily's father and has the ability to transform into a black-winged, heteromorphic being. He is also the true identity of Killer B, a name derived by his unusual way of writing the number "13" at his murder sites.

Since the attack on Jaula Blana orchestrated by Gilbert Ross that took the lives of several of his classmates including Dr. Heath Flick, Koku has spent the last seven years in search of his love, Yuna, in hopes of reuniting with her.

name: Lily  Hoshina
description: Lily Hoshina is one of the main characters in B: The Beginning. She comes from a family of violin repairers and is a detective that works for the Royal Investigative Services.

name: Satou Matsuzaka
description:
Satou Matsuzaka learns to love for the first time after meeting [Shio Koube](https://anilist.co/character/126755) and lives with her in a shared apartment. Publically, she tells people that she resides with her aunt in her apartment, and keeps the fact that she lives with Shio a secret.

Satou is a freshman at Makikou High School and primarily works at Cure á Cute, maintaining a kind nature and getting along well with other people in order to sustain her lifestyle with Shio. While she wishes she could spend her time with Shio forever in their apartment, she is aware of the fact that they canno

description:
Shio Kobe is a young, innocent girl who lives with Satou Matsuzaka in their apartment. She loves and cares for Satou deeply, but often remains blissfully unaware of Satou's endeavors aside from Satou's necessary attendance in school and work, as she is not allowed outside of the apartment.

Shio is a kind and innocent girl who tries her best to work hard and watch over the house while Satou is away at school and work. She routinely greets Satou whenever she returns home and is always genuinely happy to spend time together with Satou. Shio believes that both she and Satou need to stay together,

description:
Emilico is the main protagonist of the Shadows House series and narrates some of the chapters. She is a Living Doll working as a maid in the Shadows House and as a "face" of [Kate Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/127319/Kate).

Emilico is cheerful and hard-working. Her top priority is taking care of her master Kate Shadow, whom she is friends with. She likes making friends and spending time with them. Although she is inexperienced and sometimes clumsy, she is also dependable. She keeps a positive attitude and stands up for others. Emilico is curious and eager to learn new things. She enjoy

name: Kate
description:
Kate is a young girl in the Shadow family, a noble family. Her "Living Doll" is [Emilico](https://anilist.co/character/127318/Emilico). Like the rest of the Shadow family, Kate is a shadow. Her whole body including her hair is black. She wears a red dress with a white frill underneath. She is a very calm and intelligent young girl.


__Season One Spoiler__
At the beginning of the story she is very distant with Emilico although she cares about her. She apparently suffers a lot because of a shadow and her emotions are not easy to understand. But with the help of Emilico, she opens up more social

Shaun is one of the side protagonists in the Shadows House series. He is a Living Doll working as a servant in the Shadows House and as a "face" of [John Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/197307/John).
He completes his work flawlessly and secretly has poor vision.

name: John
description:
John is one of the side protagonists in the Shadows House series and the shadow living under the care of the "Living Face", [Shaun](https://anilist.co/character/197306/Shaun).

John is known to be quite friendly with everyone and very open-minded. Unlike many shadows, he treats Shaun with respect and even offers to wear glasses so that Shaun can be seen while wearing his. Like Kate and Emilico, John and Shaun are polar opposites. John is a muscle-headed extrovert while Shaun is a thoughtful introvert. Despite this, the two are very good friends and John cares for his "face" immensely.

He expresses himself through Haiku, as talking to other people is hard for him.
