She is shown to be wrapped in a green hagoromo like sash with four feathered wings sprouting from and wing like accessories in her hair and three diamond markings on both of her legs. She generally takes on the form of a young female fairy.

Aerial is shown to be a very loving and caring spirit with a strong sense of duty and loyalty, despite the fa

name: Myura
description: An Elf swordswoman and a former apprentice of Lemia, she is a Dual Magician capable of using the magical elements Fire and Earth. She is known under the title "Golden SwordsWoman" for her skill with the blade. Impressed with Rin's abilities, the two girls become fast friends.

name: Rin Azuma
description: After being summoned to Altia alongside her childhood friend Taichi Nishimura, she decides to become an adventurer with him in the hopes of finding a way back home.

name: Taichi Nishimura
description: He is a 16-year-old high school student and role-playing game fan blessed with good reflexes but lacking ambition.

name: Remia
description: A Master Triple Magician whom everyone in the kingdom knows who she is due to her magical prowess, thus her nickname as the Magician of Fallen Leaves. She taught Muller magic before teaching Taichi and Rin.

name: Fenrys
description: She is the younger sister of Fengaril, a Garo tribe member who was one of the Four Heavenly Kings in the Demon King's army. She meets Flio and begins her tentative married life with him. As a Garo tribe member, she can be quick to pick a fight. Above all, she loves [Flio](https://anilist.co/character/207817/Flio).

appearsIn.title: Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers
Chillin’ in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers

name: Flio
description: A kind-hearted young man who loves peace. He is suddenly summoned to another world as a "candidate for hero." He is banished because his abilities at level 1 were mediocre, but when he reaches level 2, his status changes to "∞." He obtains powers that ordinary people cannot handle.

appearsIn.title: Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers
Chillin’ in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers

name: Akuto Sai
description: Akuto Sai was left on the door steps of a church by a strange woman. He grows up and transfers into the Constant Academy for Magical Arts, wanting to be a high priest. He meets Junko Hattori on the train to the school, and forms a pact with her to make the world a better place. The predicting spirit Yata Garasu predicts that he will be a Demon Lord upon graduation. Yata's predictions have never been wrong, and everyone becomes afraid of him as a result. Even so, he still tries to do the right thing when situations happen around him and he is shown to have an incredible amount of power wit

name: Keena Soga
description: A weird girl who seems to have some kind of relationship with Akuto, who she calls Aa-chan. She is astonishingly optimistic. Her special abilities are disappearing, flying and eating amazing amounts of rice, to the point that, when she has to grow a plant using her mana, the plant takes the form of a rice plant. Her hair has two sprouts on the top that wag depending on how she feels.

name: Korone
description: Korone is a Liladan (リラダン Riradan?), a race of androids, sent by the government to observe Akuto 24/7. She is usually emotionless and stolid, but occasionally curious when it comes to certain things. However, she does display human characteristics on occasion; particularly, she enjoys teasing Akuto, often doing ecchi things in front of him. She sleeps in a small storage closet in Akuto's dorm and has numerous firearms and other items stored inside her handbag, a sort of hammerspace. Korone has the ability to read other people's emotions and can detect an individual's mana levels

name: Junko Hattori
description: Junko is introduced in episode one of the anime. She's very skilled with a short blade and wooden sword, both of which she carries or summons. She also has a tsundere nature, often becoming embarrassed and misunderstanding situations because of that. She comes from a Suharaist family that protects the Empire and is very strict about upholding the values that were taught to her.   She wants to marry Sai Akuto and even temporarily removed herself from her family to aid Sai when he was in trouble, trying to destroy the Gods and save Keena. As Sai was about to leave on  Peterhausen, he told her th

name: Fujiko Etou
description: Fujiko Etou is the current head of the Etou family, the head of the girl's dorms at Constant Academy, and the only person who understands Akuto's current situation. Her older brother, the Etou's previous head, was killed after failing a mission, causing Fujiko to become the new head of the family, though for unexplained reasons, she kept her brother's (revived) head, which is kept in a jar-like container filled with fluid. She is the leader of an underground movement that uses black magick (magic) for evil purposes and plans to use Akuto's demon powers once he becomes Demon Lord for her own pu

name: Diana Cavendish
native: ダイアナ・キャベンディッシュ
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Diana is serious, composed, and erudite. Being descended from a prestigious line of witches back to ancient times, she is exceptionally devoted to her magical studies and to the tradition and history of magic. Her status as Luna Nova's best student cannot be solely attributed to heredity — she has self-discipline and maturity far surpassing the average teenage girl.

She quickly becomes [Akko](https://anilist.co/character/81645/Kagari-Atsuko)'s rival, though she doesn't see herself as her rival.

name: Natsume
description:
A girl who lost her father and her right arm due to a Gadoll attack when she was a child. She dreams of joining the Kanochikara and fight the Gadoll as a warrior, but reality bites, and ends up working under [Kaburagi](https://anilist.co/character/170192/) as an armor repairer.

Cheerful, energetic, and reckless.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Kaburagi
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'2 ft)
__Race:__ Cyborg

__Human Avatar__
Kaburagi is a middle aged man sporting greying black hair, which he slicks back, and facial hair on his chin. He wears a tucked-in wide necked short-sleeved shirt (with the sleeves tucked up and buttoned) with two buttons on the front. He wears olive wide pants and are tucked into brown boots. He has a black belt tied and a leather bracelet on his wrist.

__Cyborg Form__
In his cyborg form, Kaburagi is very short and cylindrical. He has a rectangular faceplate, and a brown and mint-green color scheme. He wears a red jet pack on his

name: Kyouya Sata
description: At the begining, when Erika suggested her idea of faking lovers, Kyouya agrees to it with a "Prince Charming" attitude. However,shortly after, he blackmails her, torments her and makes her his "dog." Gradually he starts to care for her and becomes jealous whenever she gets close to other guys. He also develops a protective attitude towards her.

name: Misumi Tozawa
description:
Tozawa Misumi was a student at the Aeterna Girls' Academy, where she befriended her classmate [Yuuki Asuna](https://anilist.co/character/36828/Asuna-Yuuki). Being one of the 1,000 beta testers for Sword Art Online, Misumi encouraged Asuna to play the game with her in the official release. 

On November 6, 2022, Misumi became one of the 10,000 players trapped in the public release version Sword Art Online and temporarily formed a party with Asuna, until an accident in the field led her to believe that the latter had been killed by monsters. Since then, Misumi became one of the Clearers to help

appearsIn.title: Sword Art Online the Movie -Progressive- Aria of a Starless Night

name: Yuuki Cross
description:
__Height__: 156 cm  

The adoptive daughter of the headmaster of Cross Academy, Yuuki is a member of the school's disciplinary committee (public morals committee in Japanese), which is the 'front' for the Guardians. Ten years prior to the events of "Vampire Knight," Yuuki was attacked by a vampire, but was rescued by Kaname. She has lost all memory of her life before the attack, and Headmaster Cross took her in as his own daughter. Yuuki loves Kaname, and even though she has witnessed his vampiric nature when he bit Ruka, she still couldn't stop loving him. However, she has also started to let

name: Zero Kiryuu
description:
__Height__: 178 cm - 183 cm 

Yuuki's childhood friend, Zero is also a Guardian and likewise on the disciplinary committee. Yuuki has been taking care of him as her little brother since he was brought into their home (the Headmaster's). His family, a line of vampire hunters, was murdered by the pure blood vampire Shizuka Hio when he was young. He harbors a deep hatred for vampires and claims to have taken on the role of Guardian to learn to hunt them better. In truth, Zero was bitten during the attack on his family, and have kept the secret that he was a vampire from Yuuki until he was no long

name: Kaname Kuran
description:
**Height:** 184 cm  

A pureblood vampire. He saved Yuuki from an attack by another vampire when she was little. Kaname is the class president of the Night Class, much feared and respected by the other Night Class students. While he is cold and authoritative towards his fellows in the Night Class, he is always kind and sweet to Yuuki. He has shown that he cares deeply for Yuuki ever since he saved her, and loves her in a romantic sense.   As a Pureblood, Kaname is capable of controlling lesser vampires, but he chooses not to exercise his powers, thus earning the respect of the Noble vampires.

name: Fate  Graphite
native: フェイト・グラファイト
description:
Fate is a young man that has black hair and brown eyes. However, when the glutton skill is activated, the color of his eyes become red.

After his father passed away, the villagers kicked him out from the village. The villagers think of him as a useless guy after his father had passed away. Fate then looked for a job to live.

name: Saya Kisaragi
description:
A miko and a chiropteran slayer. She is known to her friends to be very dense with no common sense especially when it comes to love. 

Saya is portrayed as a kind, clumsy and helpful person, acting very cheerful and singing songs in the morning. She loved her friends, her family, and her normal life as well as being dutiful in her family's fighting against the Elder Bairn.

name: Rakka
description: Rakka is the newest addition to Old Home and the main character of Haibane Renmei. The series largely focuses on Rakka's adjustment to the strange new world of Glie. Although happy to have several new friends, Rakka cannot help but wonder who she was before she became a Haibane and if her family is somewhere in this world. She feels a connection with the birds of Glie, especially since her dream involved falling with only a crow as company. She is very amiable and quickly becomes attached to her new family.

name: Reki
description: Reki is the unofficial leader of Old Home. She's tough when she needs to be but is also caring and compassionate. Her role at Old Home is to care for the young Haibane as well as take care of New Feathers like [Rakka](https://anilist.co/character/1995/Rakka). Reki is a major part of Rakka's life in Glie as she was the one who discovered her cocoon and stayed by her side during the painful process of growing wings. Reki is most always cheerful, at least on the surface. We receive hints of a darker past throughout the series. Despite whatever these problems from her past may be, Reki is a strong

appearsIn.title: I'm Standing on a Million Lives
I'm Standing on a Million Lives
I'm Standing on a Million Lives
I'm Standing on a Million Lives

name: Keiki Kiryuu
description:
Keiki is a kind-hearted, friendly and considerate guy. He cares for his close friends and family, and is, in turn, cared for and liked just as much by them. His kindness is pointed out, by [Shouma](https://anilist.co/character/138711/Shoma-Akiyama), as his good trait and as to why girls would have a reason to like or love him.

Keiki also wants a girlfriend and is annoyed by the many couples he sees and is quite envious of them.

He cares very much for his sister [Mizuha](https://anilist.co/character/138709/Mizuha-Kiryuu) and spoils her with affection, to the point of being described as a sis-

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Sayuki Tokihara
description:
She is a third year student and the Calligraphy Club's President. On the outside, she is a mature upperclassman, with a playful attitude and a kind spirit. She enjoys calligraphy and tends to make a huge mess whenever she is writing. She always seems to be at odds with [Yuika](https://anilist.co/character/135803/Yuika-Koga) and teases/picks on her, the same goes both ways.

 However deep down Sayuki is actually a huge masochistic pervert. She has a fetish for being dominated and wants [Keiki](https://anilist.co/character/135801/Keiki-Kiryuu) (whom she likely holds feelings towards) to make her

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Yuika Koga
description:
On the outside, she is a cute and outgoing girl who is playful with her friends, especially [Keiki](https://anilist.co/character/135801/Keiki-Kiryuu). She can sometimes be childish and jealous when Keiki is around other girls, especially [Sayuki](https://anilist.co/character/135802/Sayuki-Tokihara). She does not get along with Sayuki and is always picking on her and the same goes both ways.
 However, on the inside, Yuika is actually a huge Sadist/Femdom. She wants to dominate Keiki and wishes for him to become her slave, the polar opposite of Sayuki.

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Mizuha Kiryuu
description:
Mizuha is a kind and cheerful girl and acts somewhat air headed and cute at times. She is good at giving different types of advice to her brother [Keiki](https://anilist.co/character/135801/Keiki-Kiryuu) and cares for him dearly. She enjoys being pampered by him.

She appears to be a normal girl who gets along well with her brother, but is later shown to be a pervert as she is an exhibitionist who not only strips in her brother's room, but also does not wear her panties to school on a regular basis. 

She is revealed to be the 'Cinderella' that Keiki was looking for and after this is also show

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Mao Nanjou
description:
She is somewhat of an introvert, she's quiet, passive and is a bit of a loner. The only person she is seen talking to in class is [Keiki](https://anilist.co/character/135801/Keiki-Kiryuu) whom she most likely has romantic feelings towards. She is shown to be quite open with Keiki however and gives him advice as well as acting like a tsundere towards him at times.
 She turns out to be a fujoshi who wants to create a yaoi manga/doujin involving Keiki and his friend [Shouma](https://anilist.co/character/138711/Shoma-Akiyama).

appearsIn.title: Hensuki: Are you willing to fall in love with a pervert, as long as she’s a cutie?

name: Ushikai Musume
description:
Cow Girl is the childhood friend of [Goblin Slayer](https://anilist.co/character/126458) and a farm hand on her uncle's farm. 
Her uncle took her in on his farm after her family was massacred by goblins during her childhood.

appearsIn.title: Goblin Slayer Side Story: Year One

name: Morihito Otogi
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm  (5'11")

An ogre. Strong and level-headed, he's had his hands full ever since his childhood friend [Nico](https://anilist.co/character/207345/) returned. Nico's nickname for him is "Moi."

name: Nico Wakatsuki
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'3")

A witch. Clumsy and goofy, she has a tendency to let compliments go straight to her head. Her dream is to be a great witch who helps others.

Due to being the Witch of Thousand, a type of witch that is born every 1000 years that is able to use various spells unlike normal witches, she is targeted by a group of Black Witches. Her childhood friend and first love, [Morihito](https://anilist.co/character/207344/), is assigned the task of being her familiar and protecting her from harm.

name: Kanshi Kazamatsuri
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm  (5'5")

A tengu. Due to clan differences, he didn't like [Morihito](https://anilist.co/character/207344/) at first. He's highly sociable and makes friends easily. He joins the Otogi household as [Nico's](https://anilist.co/character/207345/) familiar.

name: Keigo Magami
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm  (5'9")

Nico's classmate and self-proclaimed hipster. He was a figure skater until an accident forced him to retire.

He's actually a werewolf, and seeing any crescent shape brings out his other [personality](https://anilist.co/character/301197/).

name: Miharu Kiryuu
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm  (5'2")

He is a very polite and elegant vampire with absolutely no filter. He will say whatever is on his mind, no matter how rude it is. He doesn't drink blood but uses his soul-stealing ability to absorb vital energy of others. He joins the Otogi household as Nico's fourth familiar.

name: Nemu Miyao
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm  (5'0")

A witch from a venerable household who specializes in shape-shifting magic and can turn into a cat. Falling asleep turns her back. She wants to make [Morihito](https://anilist.co/character/207344/) her familiar.

name: Conrad Leto
description: The 27th Wizard King of the Clover Kingdom's Magic Knights.

appearsIn.title: Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King

name: Maki Maehara
description: A boy who doesn't know how to make friends because he kept changing schools.

appearsIn.title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class

name: Umi Asanagi
description: She is smart, friendly, and is considered "the second cutest girl in the class" by the boys.

appearsIn.title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class

name: Hitomi Tsukishiro
description: Hitomi is a reserved girl who hesitates to interact with people. She cannot see the colours around her and sees everything in monochrome. Hitomi is sent back 60 years in the past by her grandmother and tells Hitomi to meet her younger self from when she was in high school.

name: Kohaku Tsukishiro
description: She is the grandmother of [Hitomi Tsukishiro](https://anilist.co/character/128075/Hitomi-Tsukishiro) who sends her back to 2018 to explore the past, make friends and regain her sense of color.

name: Yuito Aoi
description: Yuito Aoi is one of the main characters of Iroduku Sekai no Ashita kara. He is a member of the photography club whose hobby is drawing and Hitomi Tsukishiro is able to see his drawings in color for some reason.

name: Seika Lamprogue
native: セイカ・ランプローグ
description: He is the reincarnation of Haruyoshi Kuga. He is very kind and will do anything to protect people dearest to him.

appearsIn.title: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World

name: Yifa
description:
A young girl who served as a slave in Seika's birthplace, the House of Count Lambrogue. Although she hides it from her surroundings, she has the power to see "spirits" that even Seika cannot see, and the talent to follow them. Ever since she was young, she has taken a liking to Seika, who has treated her well.
She is a half elf.

appearsIn.title: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World

name: Amyu
description:
A commoner girl who, like Seika, came to take the entrance exam for Rodnaire Academy of Magic. She has magical aptitude for all attributes, and she has an amazing talent for swords and magic, topping the entrance exam. Because of her ability, it is rumored that she is a "hero" who can defeat the Demon King.
She is also the hero who is destined to be protected by the Demon king
She also looks like Haruyosh's disciple who killed him

appearsIn.title: The Reincarnation of the Strongest Exorcist in Another World

name: Kobeni Yonomori
description:
__Race:__ Half-Human/Half-Inugami

The main heroine, a responsible sixteen-year-old who handles cooking and chores well. 

On her 16th birthday, a young man named [Hakuya](https://anilist.co/character/87583) and [Mashiro](https://anilist.co/character/87582) suddenly appear in front of her, in which it turns out that Hakuya is her fiancé and Mashiro is her future sister-in-law.

When she was younger, she fell down a cliff but she was saved by Hakuya Mitsumine. The incident left her with a scar and little memory of the event, as she does not remember Hakuya when they meet again. Over time she re

name: Hakuya Mitsumine
description: Hakuya is Kobeni Yonomori's fiancé who suddenly appears on her 16th birthday with his little sister Mashiro Mitsumine. He and his sister start living in the same house as Kobeni and her own sister, Benio Yonomori.

name: Mashiro Mitsumine
description: Hakuya's younger sister, who somehow manages to enroll in Kobeni's class. She often tries to vocalize that she isn't a child, but her honest feelings over her likes and dislikes are often read easily by the others. She is quite fearful of Benio but is easily swayed by sweet things.

name: Benio Yonomori
description: Benio Yonomori is Kobeni's elder sister who has two personas: an immature and a carefree loving sister at home and the student council president at school, where she maintains her respectable popular image as a demure, well-mannered and an elegant top-performing student in front of her legion of fans. She has taken a liking to Mashiro to the extent that she would do all sorts of advances to her at home.

name: Mary Kozakura
description:
First appeared in Imagination Forest. A 1/4-Medusa, 3/4-human girl. 

Her parents told her “We’re medusae, so if we make eye contact with a human they’ll be turned to stone.” While growing up, she always stuck to their words and hid herself away from the world in the forest. Even after they died she continued to live alone. By chance, a boy named [Seto](https://anilist.co/character/67945/Seto-Kousuke) visited the forest and found her. He has since brought her to the outside world. 

After coming to the Mekakushi Dan’s hideout, and joining the group, she leads a sideline life making fake flower

name: Hibiya Amamiya
description: First appeared in Heat-Haze Days. A boy that visits the city to take summer courses with Hiyori. He is known to be very mature for his age, yet has a cheeky personality. His quarrels with Momo are endless. On August 15, he becomes involved in a certain incident with Hiyori, but is the only one saved, and obtains the “eye focusing” ability under these circumstances.   (Source: Vocaloid Wikia)

name: Kousuke Seto
description: First appeared in Imagination Forest. A young man who belongs to the Mekakushi Dan and is from the same orphanage as Kido and Kano. He works as a florist at the shopping center as well as various other fields of work such as traffic control and newspaper delivery. He is also the person that invited Mary into the Mekakushi Dan. With his "eye-stealing" ability, he can read information from any target. However, he dislikes it because, "it's a power where you steal with glances, without needing communication," so he rarely uses it. He has a pet hamster named "Hanao." He also has a habit of wanderi

name: Takane Enomoto
description:
__Species:__ Human

A strange program taking the shape of a young girl which has taken up residence inside [Shintaro](https://anilist.co/character/67167/Kisaragi-Shintarou)'s computer. She calls him "Master", and yet adores bothering him.  First appeared in Artifical Enemy. A naive cyber girl who lives in Shintaro's computer. She can possibly invade anything that uses electricity and gives her all in doing things that Shintaro hates. Was once a human, but lost her body in a certain experiment. She now possesses the power of immortality from her "opening eyes" ability.

name: Shuuya Kano
description: Kano is a young man who is part of the Mekakushi Dan. He outwardly has an unfocused, aloof personality and always has a smile on his face. Because he teases [Marry](https://anilist.co/character/67947/Kozakura-Mary), [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/67949/Kisaragi-Momo), and [Kido](https://anilist.co/character/67171/Kido-Tsubomi) a lot, he's often considered to be a flirt, but when it counts, he's worth relying on. His actual personality, which he hides behind his ability the majority of the time, is quite subdued and mature. He seems to be mistrustful of others and carries around self-loath

name: Tsubomi Kido
description: A mysterious girl who has appeared before [Shintaro](https://anilist.co/character/67167/Kisaragi-Shintarou) in a shopping center. She's seemingly the leader of the Mekakushi Dan. First appeared in Blindfold Code. A girl that plays the role of the leader of the Mekakushi Dan. She's essentially good-natured, but struggles to keep the individual members, like [Kano](https://anilist.co/character/67943/Kano-Shuuya) and [Seto](https://anilist.co/character/67945/Seto-Kousuke), in line. Using her "eye concealing" ability, she can erase the perception towards objects within a certain distance of hersel

name: Shintarou Kisaragi
description: The main protagonist of the manga and brother of Momo Kisaragi, Shintaro is a hikikomori and as such, he has a hard time dealing with people. He seems to be constantly bothered by Ene.  First appeared in Transparent Answer. A hikikomori (recluse/shut-in) young man with an IQ of 168. In middle school and high school, he performed at the top of his class in National Mock Examinations, but due to the suicide of a close friend (Ayano), he dropped out of his first year of high school. Subsequently, a mysterious software enters into his computer named "Ene," and, being unable to control her actions,

name: Momo Kisaragi
description: First appeared in Kisaragi Attention. A very popular idol in her first year of high school. Ever since a childhood marine accident at the beach with her father, she has the "eye-captivating" power that can draw peoples' attention regardless of their preferences in tastes or interests. Because of her power she was often alienated from people and had no friends, but since her meeting with the Mekakushi Dan, she regains her original, bright character. She has peculiar sense in taste and fashion, and as such, it is common for her opinions to disagree with other people's. She is also the younger si

name: Haruka Kokonose
description:
A mysterious albino with supposed amnesia that appeared at Hiyori's relative's house one day during the summer. He was once a human called Haruka Kokonose but somewhere before the current timeline, he was turned into a cyber-being. He is currently living at Hiyori's sister's house as a foster child. Not knowing about the normal world, he's rather my-pace (air-headed, lost, confused). He is known to possess a strong curiosity for the unknown.

Haruka Kokonose was a boy in high school with a severe illness. He would often get tired easily, collapse, and not be able to do much. Caring greatly for

name: Me wo Samasu Hebi
description: One of Azami's many snakes that is now connected to Kokonose's eye ability, Awakening Eyes. The snake controls Haruka Kokonose's remade body, "Konoha", with its empty shell of a personality and fragmented memories. It acts on Kokonose's final wish to make friends, as Konoha. When separated from Konoha in the Kagerou Daze, the snake is more condescending and direct towards Kokonose.

name: Shinako Morinome
description:
[Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/69339/Rikuo-Uozumi)'s former classmate and close friend. She taught at the same high school [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/11766/Haru-Nonaka) attended. She only wishes to be friends with [Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/69339/Rikuo-Uozumi). She feels at fault for [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/11766/Haru-Nonaka) dropping out.

She loved [Rou](https://anilist.co/character/127393/Rou-Hayakawa)'s brother a long while ago, but when he passed away, she found it hard to love again. She loved him because of how hard he tried to be unpleasant, knowing

name: Haru Nonaka
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm

A high school dropout because her school didn't approve of her working at Milk Hall, a cafe and bar, since they serve alcohol in the evening. She has feelings for [Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/69339/Uozumi-Rikuo) and frequently visits him at his part time job at the convenience store.

Often seen with her pet crow, [Kansuke](https://anilist.co/character/180177/Kansuke).

name: Rikuo Uozumi
description:
Rikuo is a university graduate who has a passion for photography, but lacks motivation to find a career in life. He works part time at a convenience store to pay for his rent and living utilities. Rikuo has feelings for [Shinako](https://anilist.co/character/68127/Shinako-Morinome) ever since their university days.

He works at Nico2 Mart four days a week. [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/11766/Haru-Nonaka) claims that she knew him for a long time, but he has no recollection of her. He has a past that he doesn't want to remember. He consistently treats Haru coldly, saying he doesn't know he

name: Rou Hayakawa
description: Rou is a childhood friend of Shinako's and considers her family. Even though he treats her like an older sister, he has feelings for her.

name: Krulcifer Einfolk
native: クルルシファー・エインフォルク
description:
One of the main female characters. She is a transfer student from the Ymir Theocracy, a powerful nation from the north. She is the user of the Divine Drag-Ride "Fafnir" ファフニール Fafunīru).

(Source: Saijaku Muhai no Bahamut Wiki)

name: Philphie Aingram
native: フィルフィ・アインクラム
description:
Lux's childhood friend who is frail, has a notably large bust, and has a sleepy expression on her face. She wields the Divine Drag-Ride "Typhon". She comes from the powerful and influential Aingram merchant house and took Lux and Airi in after their mother's death.

It is revealed that Philuffy was a victim of human experimentation using poisons and weapons by military authorities by the old Arcadia Empire who ignored her sister Relie's pleas for her release. It was this incident that made Lux decide to join Fugil's coup d'etat and pilot the "Bahamut" though he has since forgotten the incident

name: Celistia Ralgris
native: セリスティア・ラルグリス
description:
Celistia Ralgris is the Third Year knight leader of the “Knight Squadron”. She was said to be the strongest of the Academy. She's a young woman of the Duke House, one of the four Great Nobles, and she's famous for being a man-hater.

She is user of the Divine Drag-Ride "Lindworm."

(Source: Saijaku Muhai no Bahamut Wikia)

name: Lisesharte Atismata
native: リーズシャルテ・アティスマータ
description:
Lisesharte Atismata is a princess of the New Kingdom of Atismata. At first, Lisha acts like a tsundere, but as series goes on she opens up to Lux little by little.

She is user of the Divine Drag-Ride "Tiamat."

(Source: Saijaku Muhai no Bahamut Wiki)

name: Lux Arcadia
native: ルクス・アーカディア
description: He was a prince from the Empire that was destroyed five years ago due to the coup d'état. He is a Drag-Knight who is called the “Weakest Undefeated” and also the "Black Hero". He is also the user of the Divine Drag-Ride "Bahamut". (Source: saijakumuhainobahamut.wikia.com)

name: Yoruka Kirihime
description: She was the princess of the fallen nation of Koto, later becoming an assassin for the Old Arcadia Empire and then a student of the New Kingdom's Royal Officer Academy.

name: Fudou Nomura
description:
Nomura is a pacifist by nature, but his freedom-loving ideals as well as his cheeky attitude often finds himself rebelling against figures of power and authority. Ultimately, though, he’s a relatively laid-back guy with a cheerful demeanor.

Nomura was originally a talented user of the Jigen-ryū school of Japanese swordsmanship; however, due to extremely harsh and rushed training enforced by his former master, his body was broken beyond repair, which made him incapable of picking up a sword ever again. Instead, he developed his capabilities in hand-to-hand combat, and eventually crafted a powe

name: Rin Onigawara
description:
Leader of the Tenka Goken. Onigawara is known for being merciless and a prominent hater of men, causing many to quit the academy. However, she softens significantly after meeting Nomura, showing many signs of affection.

When her father abandoned their family after having an affair, Onigawara had to deal with the mental backlash of her distraught mother. Because she resembled her father, her mother would call her “ugly” or “ the child of a demon” and would demand her to wear a demon’s mask whenever she was around. This would cement the thought that Onigawara was hiding her “shameful self” by w

name: Satori Tamaba
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

A member of the Tenka Goken. Satori is said to be reminiscent of a creature of sorts attempting to imitate human-like behavior. Since she primarily lacks the ability to empathize, she tends to act in various extreme ways as a means to compare and explore herself and others. As a result, she can be incredibly unpredictable as said actions are often irrational.

Her real name is Misogi. The name “Satori” originally belonged to her twin sister currently known as “Misogi”. The original Satori, fueled by hatred and jealousy towards Misogi, attempted to push her sister off the to

name: Warabi Hanasaka
description: While Hanasaka fronts a blatantly evil persona, she only acts that way for the sake of her beloved pet bear, Kyoubou. Many have attempted to get rid of Kyoubou from the premises of the academy, so Hanasaka rose to the position of one of the Tenka Goken so that no one would oppose her. Hanasaka is a user of the Taisha-ryū.

name: Kirukiru Amou
description:
A deranged psychopath carrying an unhealthy obsession with [Fudou Nomura](https://anilist.co/character/121446/Nomura-Fudou), seemingly stemming from a twisted sense of love where she demands his total submission before her and is willing to kill him otherwise. She earns the title of “Empress” after defeating two members of the Tenka Goken simultaneously.

Amou specializes in Uechi-ryuu, a traditional style of Okinawan Karate that emphasizes toughness of the body by being attacked and pained while practicing nukite based counter-attacks to a point of being able to respond reflexively. This is t

name: Mary Kikakujou
description: Mary is a prim and proper French-Japanese student and is a member of the Tenka Goken. She is an expert in western-styled fencing in combination with techniques of the Jigen-ryū style. She is also into executing the buriburi style of torture.

name: Tsukuyo Inaba
description:
Tsukuyo is a child prodigy that skipped several grades, making her the youngest member of the Tenka Goken. Despite being so young, however, she is unquestionably the strongest member. 

While blind, she has excellent hearing, to the point that she is capable of hearing most things going on in the academy. Even though she carries a calm and collected demeanor, she can still act childishly, much like the many instances where she likes to show off her knowledge resulting in long rambles.

Tsukuyo is a skilled user of the Yakumaru Jigen-ryū, the descendant style of the Jigen-ryū that Nomura practi

name: Kabane Shinden
description: The Corpse God, later known as Polka Shinoyama, is the main protagonist of Dead Mount Death Play. As a human born with the Evil Eye, the Corpse God (not yet known as such) was sold to the necromancer Easlies Swordfrail at the age of ten and studied Necromancy under her tutelage, eventually becoming an Undead himself. Though he wanted nothing more then to live a peaceful life, the Geldwood church spent a century wanting nothing more than to see him dead. To achieve the peaceful life he so desired, the Corpse God pursues the secret art of reincarnation with the intention of reincarnating as one

name: Misaki Sakimiya
description: Misaki Sakimiya, known professionally as Zaki, is the former heiress to Sakimiya Steel and the assassin hired to kill the original Polka Shinoyama. In the aftermath of her own premature murder and subsequent resurrection as a Zombie—respectfully the accidental and purposeful doing of the Corpse God—she moves in with the Corpse God and assists him with his fortune-telling endeavors. Misaki has since evolved to become a Vampire Larva per the Corpse God's magic, her newfound powers allowing her to better assist him as an offensive agent. At the start of the series, those with the Evil Eye would h

name: Takumi Kuruya
description: Takumi Kuruya is an informant based in Tokyo's Shinjuku Ward who uses illegal drones to collect data alongside other methods; occasionally, he also helps contract killers conceal their victims' corpses. Per Lisa Kuraki's instructions, he has become companion to the Corpse God and assists his fortunetelling business by collection information on clients during their sessions.

name: Kaiji Itou
description: The main character of the story. Kaiji is poor, downtrodden and lazy - he lives by himself in a slum and is constantly in debt. He bides his time by playing cheap gambling games with neighbors, though he always loses. In spite of this, when his life is in danger, he displays a remarkable hidden capacity for gambling, which allows him to endure the hardships he faces. He is shouldered with a 3,850,000 yen debt at the beginning of the story by a coworker who convinced him into consigning a loan, leaving Kaiji with the full weight of the debt compounded over a year. Though he started off as somew

name: Jun Naruse
description:
A girl whose words were sealed away.

(Source: Official website)

name: Takumi Sakagami
description: A boy who avoids talking about his true feelings.

name: Daiki Tasaki
description:
An ex-baseball club ace who spends his days sulking.

(Source: Official website)

name: Natsuki Nitou
description:
An honors student in the cheerleading club who is concerned about love.

(Source: Offical website)

name: Somali
description: A young human girl who is found by [Golem](https://anilist.co/character/140697/Golem) in his forest. She has endless curiosity, which usually gets her in trouble. She wears a hood on her head with minotaur horns to hide her human features since humans are a delicacy in the monster world.

name: Golem
description:
An ancient automaton protector of the forest who stumbles upon [Somali](https://anilist.co/character/140696/Somali) while patrolling the woods. He exhibits no emotions, but instinctively protects Somali from any potential threat. He acts like Somali's father and is referred by her as "Dad".

It is soon revealed that every Golem only lives 1000 years, and this Golem is approaching it's 1000th year. It feels a responsibility to deliver Somali to humans before that happens

name: Jirou Jou
description: Jirō Jō is a 1st-year economics student at Kansei University. He is the younger twin brother of Tarō Jō. He is a resident of room 201 at Chikuseisou. Joji has a yellow spiky hair. He is often seen wearing a necklace and a long sleeve shirt underneath a yellow shirt and shorts. He and his brother played soccer for three years in high school. The only two things he knows how to cook is pasta and a simple ochazuke. Originally intending to run for the sake of becoming popular with girls, he realize that running was something enjoyable in itself.

name: Yukihiko Iwakura
description:
Height: 170 cm (5'7)

Yukihiko Iwakura is one of the Aotake runners. He is a 4th-year law student at Kansei University and the resident of room 102 at Chikuseisou. Yuki is a rather slim yet lean young man. His skin is a pale peach color. He has side-swept black hair and an undercut. He also wears glasses and piercings on his ears. He is often seen wearing a blue sweatshirt and black pants. He is short-tempered and gets easily annoyed by his teammate's actions. However, he does care about his teammates and often jokes with them. He is very detail-oriented as seen when he points out Shindo's low

name: Musa Kamala
description:
Height: 176 cm (5'9)

Musa is a native to Tanzania. He moved to Japan to study Space and Engineering as a sponsored international student at Kansei University. His Japanese still has flaws leading to some misunderstandings and written mistakes. Kind and earnest, Musa is always supportive of his other team members and is well known by the residents of the local shopping district. He is the resident of room 203 at Chikuseisou. Musa is a young man with tall build. He has a dark-toned skin and has black colored shaved hair. He enjoys meditating in the dark in the Aotake bathtub from time to time.

name: Akihiro Hirata
description:
Height: 178 cm (5'10)

Akihiro Hirata is a 3rd-year science and engineering student at Kansei University. Hirata is resident of room 104 at Chikuseiso. Nico is the tallest among the Aotake runners with a muscular statue. He also has a light beard and chin-length brown hair, which he wears in a low ponytail. He is often seen in sweats. His nickname, Nico-chan-senpai, comes from the abbreviation of the word nicotine due to his past cigarette addiction. It is also seen that the residents of Aotake will just draw a cigarette doodle in place of his name on the chore chart. In an effort to stop smok

name: Kakeru Kurahara
description:
Height: 172 cm (5'8)

Kakeru has short, straight black hair and slate-colored eyes. When he runs, the wind pushes his hair to the back. He has a lean and athletic build that was developed over the years of competitive running. He often maintains a serious expression and he is usually seen wearing his sky blue sports jacket and gray sweatpants.

Kakeru is a first-year sociology student at Kansei University and the current resident of Room 103 of Chikuseisou. A prodigious athlete since high school who became disillusioned due to an incident in his old Track and Field team. He first joined the Ch

name: Akane Kashiwazaki
description:
Height: 167 cm (5'6")

Nicknamed "Prince" because of his good looks, Prince is a 2nd year literature student at Kansei University. He is most notably known for having copious amounts of manga in his room and being the slowest runner in the group with the most unique running style. Prince currently stays in room 204 in Chikuseisou. Prince is rather inactive and occasionally speaks in dramatized speech. It is noted by Musa that he speaks in a more proper Japanese than the rest of the team. He began as one of the most reluctant and slowest members due to his lack of physical stamina and indoor te

name: Haiji Kiyose
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7)

Haiji Kiyose is the deuteragonist in the series Run with the Wind. He is a 4th year literature student in Kansei University Student and a long time resident of Chikuseisou. He is the resident of room 101 of Chikuseisou. He has a friendly and outgoing personality, but underneath has a bit of a manipulative side. He's never willing to compromise on his dreams, even if it means reasonably threatening his housemates in the process. Despite this, he is very caring towards his teammates. He has shown concern towards them throughout the show. 

 He is the cook of the Chikuse

name: Takashi Sugiyama
description:
Height: 167 cm (5'6)

Takashi Sugiyama is a third-year business student at Kansei University. He is the resident of room 205 at Chikuseisou. Generally considered an honor student by the other residents of Chikuseisou, Takashi is an earnest student from the Yamagata Prefecture- a mountainy region. He used to walk ten kilometers through the mountains to get to school and back every day. He was the first convinced by Haiji to give running a chance and has been a significant driving force behind the others. His dedication towards training originally stemmed from wanting to inspire and impress his

name: Youhei Sakaguchi
description:
Height: 165 cm (5'5)

Yōhei Sakaguchi is one of the Aotake runners. Known as 'King' due to his love of trivia, Yohei is a 4th year Sociology student at Kansei University. He is the resident of room 205 at Chikuseisou. He has a buzz cut, a large nose, and black eyes. Yohei can usually be seen wearing a yellow tracksuit or an orange sweatshirt with grey sweats. He is a joker and is very desperate to get a job, even going as far as joining in Haiji's dream because of the idea of the experience in the Hakone Ekiden could help him land a job. He seems to be shy around people and has trouble opening

name: Tarou Jou
description:
Height: 172 cm (5'8)

Tarō Jō is a 1st-year economics student at Kansei Univeristy. He is the older twin brother of Jirō Jō. He is a resident of room 201 at Chikuseisou. He and his brother played soccer for three years in high school. He goes by Jota and is nearly indistinguishable from his younger brother. The two think and act in tandem. Though he was originally driven by the intention to attract girls through running, Jota came to appreciate the sport. He wears green and purple accent running shoes.

name: Lurie Abendroth
native: ルリイ＝アーベントロート
description: A daughter of the Abendroth House. She has a crush on Matthias since the first day they met and bears the "First Crest" just like Matthias's previous reincarnation.

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Matthias Hildesheimer
native: マティアス＝ヒルデスハイマー
description: Known as "Gaius" in his previous life around 5000+ years ago, he reincarnated himself as Matthias in order to obtain a new Crest by his Reincarnation magic, which would be better than his "First Crest". He was able to successfully achieve his goal upon reincarnation in the form of "Fourth Crest". His main goal in life is to gain power so that he could challenge and fight against the powerful Monsters in the Outer Space.

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Alma Lepucius
description: The 3rd Daughter of the Lepucius House. She is a best friend of Lurie and bears the "Second Crest". Although her magic power is lower than Matthias and Lurie, she has been good with her archery skills.

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Iris
description: Also known as the "Black Dragon Iris", she is one of the oldest and strongest Dragons still alive. She is the only one who knows Matthias's true identity after reunited thousand years later and decided to keep it a secret upon his request.

appearsIn.title: The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest
The Strongest Sage with the Weakest Crest

name: Iroha Igarashi
description:
A beautiful and flashy high school student dating [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari). She is a very honest and easy-going person often fooling around with her close friends. 

Iroha is a very honest girl who is a little bit shy, but not all that much and she is also quite easy-going and can get jealous rather easily. She doesn't like it when others say rude things about her friends.

name: Hikari Tsutsui
description: An awkward otaku who has bad luck with relationships but is ironically dating [Igarashi Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/83237/Iroha-Igarashi). He has a very timid personality which often leads others to push him around.

name: Pecorine
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 156 cm

Possessing a voracious appetite and boundless energy, Pecorine lives a seemingly carefree life from meal to meal. She is ever optimistic and is proactive in making friends, regardless of their attitude in return. Pecorine also loves to travel in search of exotic delicacies, and pays respect to all life by not letting any food that is prepared go to waste. She is the Guild Master of the guild 'Gourmet Edifice'.

name: Karyl
description:
**Race:** Beast
**Height:** 152 cm

Karyl can be described as a 'Tsundere' as she is often complaining about her friend, but always follows along regardless. She has a sharp tongue and often gets annoyed and/or flustered. She tries to act tough and harsh on the outside but in fact she is quite soft-hearted. She is a member of the guild 'Gourmet Edifice'. She also likes to play with cats.

name: Kokkoro
description:
**Race:** Elf
**Height:** 140 cm

A member of the guild Gourmet Edifice.

name: Yuuki
description: An amnesiac with good intentions but often clueless.

name: Frankenstein
aliases: フランケンシュタイン
description: Frankenstein (Kor. 프랑켄슈타인) (commonly referred to as chairman by the children) is Rai's devoted servant. He supports Rai whole-heartedly and calls him "Master". He had tried searching for his master after Rai's apparent "disappearance."  Frankenstein is the principal/director of Ye Ran High School. He was stunned to find Rai in his school office after Rai had woken up and dressed in his school's uniform.  Frankenstein is a very cheerful and loyal person, especially toward his master, but can become quite serious and calculative when the situation calls for it. Although Frankenstein has shown so

name: Cadis Etrama di Raizel
aliases: カディス・エトラマ・デ・ライジェル
description: Rai is a very elegant and mysterious Noble. He has no knowledge whatsoever of the 21st century, and will often become lost and confused especially with regards to modern day technology (such as using a cell phone). He is often used as the manhwa's comic relief with his love of ramen and the errors he makes with technology. He has fallen into a deep slumber for 820 years, and had woken up in an abandoned building in South Korea. After seeing what most of the humans on the streets were wearing, Rai took on the uniform of a student from Ye Ran High School, which is under the administration of Fra

name: Ruri Ichigyou
description: She is a silent person that usually looks unapproachable because she prefers to read and be alone instead of spending time with her classmates. She is very confident and serious about her decisions which is another reason she stands out most of the time. Gradually as the story progresses, she slowly opens up to some people around her because the main protagonist [Katagaki Naomi](https://anilist.co/character/142129/Katagaki-Naomi) was the first person to ever reach out and trying understand her. She is also very old fashioned and uncomfortable using electronic devices like her phone.

name: Naomi Katagaki
description:
Katagaki Naomi is an ordinary high school student and especially doesn't have any social skills. He is usually seen reading novel books, but he gets to a point where he wanted some friends. His shy type of personality had eventually made him a loner. Naomi's failed attempts garnered him no friends even in his class, except Ichigyou Ruri.
He eventually ends up dating Ichigyou Ruri.

name: Akira Tachibana
description:
A beautiful 17-year-old high school sophomore who attends Kazamizawa High School. She is an odd and reserved person. Because of it she has problems expressing her emotions, and as a result, people around tend to misunderstand her.

She was once the top athlete in the women’s track and field club at her school, but due a severe foot injury during a race she was forced to give it up. She harbors vague regret and bitterness about leaving the track and field club, therefore she consciously tries to avoid anything related to it, even contact with former teammates.

She started to work as a part-tim

name: Masami Kondou
description:
__Occupation:__ Garden Manager

He is a kind and easygoing person who gets along amicably with almost everyone, though he strives to be friends with his subordinates at work. However, his soft nature makes him "weak" in the eyes of [Kubo](https://anilist.co/character/130559/Kubo-Kayoko), the assistant manager, owing to his lack of assertiveness. He puts in an adequate amount of effort at work, with his mind seemingly fixated on his other passion – literature. He appreciates belles-lettres or "fine writing" immensely, and is a man of the arts. Easily lost in the book he is reading, he does not

name: Sousuke Sagara
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'7")
__Rank:__ Sergeant

Sousuke Sagara is a skilled mecha pilot and protagonist of Full Metal Panic!  Of Afghan and Japanese heritage, he grew up in Helmajistan, experiencing the harsh realities of guerrilla warfare. Before the events of the series, he joins the private military organization Mithril and raised to the rank of sergeant. After being assigned to protect [Kaname Chidori](https://anilist.co/character/272/Chidori-Kaname), he joins a Japanese highschool in order to more effectively guard and monitor her. Sousuke struggles to adapt to civilian life while balancing

name: Kaname Chidori
description:
__Height__: 166 cm
__Place of Birth__: Japan

Kaname is the female protagonist of the series. She is often described as, 'The kind of girl everyone looks up to, but not even a boy wants as their girlfriend', as a male, fellow student put it. She's very much the loud mouth, speak your mind kind of girl; a trait she picked up when she studied abroad in the United States. Until then, she feels like she must protect Sousuke from the harsh, cruel world of high school - a place where he doesn't quite fit.

Sousuke is assigned to guard her as she is one of the "Whispered". People that have in their s

name: AL
description: AL is the artificial intelligence support system which was originally part of the ARX-7 Arbalest.  AL becomes permanently locked to Sousuke after his initial use of AL during the hijacking incident.  Also, because the original programmer is dead it is impossible to reprogram AL to work with anyone other than Sousuke.  At the beginning of the series AL is nothing more than your average arm slave operating system, but as the series progresses AL starts to develop a personality much to Sousuke's dismay.  AL begins tuning into AM/FM band radio stations in an effort to expand its vocabulary, cultur

name: Gauron
description: While little is known about Gauron at the present, he is Sousuke’s strongest and most formidable enemy throughout the TV series. He’s a terrorist of the highest caliber sponsored by a mysterious organization, but little is known about Gauron’s benefactors other than the fact that they appear to be more formidable and possess greater resources than even the notorious Soviet KGB. Believed to be Japanese, or at least of Asian ethnicity, Gauron and Sousuke have a long and bloodstained history together. He was once a captain in MITHRIL although he left before all the major charact

name: Kurz Weber
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Place of Birth:__ Japan
__Rank:__ Sergeant
__ID Number:__ B-3127

Kurz is a member of Mithril. Part of the SRT (Special Response Team) of the Tuatha de Danaan's (TDD-1) Pacific Battle Group. His call sign is Urzu-6. He is an SRT AS (Arm Slave) pilot and designated marksman, equally proficient with sniper rifles and AS long range precision cannons. It is said that he can visualize the exact trajectory of a bullet, resulting in an almost inhuman accuracy. He most often forms a three-man cell with squadmate Sousuke Sagara and squad leader Melissa Mao. He is regarded as a fini

name: Teletha Testarossa
native: テレサ・テスタロッサ
description:
__Background Information:__    Teletha "Tessa" Testarossa is the clumsy but charming Captain of the revered TDD-1 'Tuatha de Danaan' submarine of the anti-terrorist organization 'Mithril'. She is American by birth but has lived on submarines and military bases for the majority of her life time. She is a child prodigy who rose to such a high rank at the age of only 16, has silver hair and grey eyes.

Later revealed as being a Whispered, her high level of mathematical and scientific adeptness is dwarfed only by her brother's, which seems to have given her a sense of inferiority.

She is also  no

name: Lambo
description:
__Nationality:__ Japanese/Italian  
__Mafia:__ Vongola/Bovino  
__Occupation:__ Assassin  
__Vongola Ring:__ Ring of Thunder  
__Box Weapon:__ Gyuudon (Vongola Lightning Bull aka Beef Bowl) 

Lambo is a hitman assassin from Italy's Bovino family. He is also the self proclaimed rival of [Reborn](https://anilist.co/character/671/Reborn). His main choice of weapons are hand grenades and horns, and his future dream is to rule the world. Lambo dresses in a cow suit complete with a tail, and has a huge afro with horns on the sides of his head which gives him the appearance of a bison. He's a pretty

name: Takeshi Yamamoto
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (present), 185 cm (future self)     
__Relatives:__ Tsuyoshi Yamamoto (father)   
__School:__ Namimori Junior High   
__Grade:__ 1st year, 2nd year (later in the series)   
__Vongola Ring:__ Ring of Rain   

Takeshi is cheerful boy from Tsuna's class whose dream is to become professional baseball player. He spends most of his time either practicing or helping out in his father's sushi restaurant. Introduced as playful and happy guy, Yamamoto is not hard to become friend with. He succeeded in making some of the series's angriest characters his friends or comrad

name: Reborn
description:
__Height:__ 40 cm  
__Title:__ Sun Arcobaleno, Home Tutor Hitman
__Weapon:__ Leon; the shapeshifting Lizard  
__Flame:__ Sun  

Reborn is the baby Home Tutor of Tsunayoshi Sawada, and whenever he greets someone, he says "Ciaossu", a casual male greeting that combines Ciao and Ossu. He wears a black fedora with an orange stripe running across the sides of the cone. He has black eyes and wears an all-black suit with black boots and a purple dress shirt underneath. He is always seen with his pet chameleon Leon on the brim of his hat, along with his yellow Arcobaleno pacifier. Out of all Arcobalen

name: Chrome Dokuro
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm
__Weapon:__ Trident, Daemon Spade's Devil Lens
__Flame:__ Mist
__Box Animal:__ Vongola Mist Owl

Chrome Dokuro is a 13-year-old girl who was first introduced as Tsuna's mysterious Mist Guardian and one of Mukuro's subordinates. From what her parents talked about, she was once known as Nagi, and lived an isolated and non-social life. After trying to rescue a cat, she was badly injured in a car accident, which led to the loss of her right eye and some of her internal organs. The only way to save her life would be to have someone with the same  their organs to her. She did not

name: Hayato Gokudera
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Nationality:__ Japanese/Italian  
__Known relatives:__ [Bianchi](https://anilist.co/character/1860/Bianchi) (Half-Sister), mother (deceased), father  
__School:__ Namimori Junior High  
__Grade:__ 1st year, 2nd year (later in the series)  

Gokudera was born in Italy and is 3/4 Italian and 1/4 Japanese (from his mother). His future dream is to become Tsuna's right-hand man. He has an ability to play the piano. He dislikes people that are older than him, like Bianchi and Lambo. Gokudera is also a chain smoker, but they remove this in the anime adaptation.   

At school, Hay

name: Kyouya Hibari
description:
__Nationality:__ Japanese  
__Height:__ 169 cm  
__School:__ Namimori Junior High  
__Grade:__ 3rd year   
__Affiliation:__ Disciplinary Committee, The Foundation (10 years later)  
__Vongola Ring:__ Ring of Cloud

Momoe also becomes close friends with [Kirie](https://anilist.co/character/39417/Kanoe-Kirie) by the time of the school festival. Officially, Momoe is a member of the school's Third Newspaper Club, but she is able to participate in the activities of

name: Yuzu Kichougasaki
description:
She is in love with her sister [Akane Hiyama](https://anilist.co/character/122435/Hiyama-Akane).

She latter falls in love also with [Seiji Aino](https://anilist.co/character/122437/Aino-Seiji). Marrying him at the end of the story together with her sister and [Guri](https://anilist.co/character/122436/Guri).

name: Akane Hiyama
description: The school's idol who [Seiji](https://anilist.co/character/122437/Aino-Seiji) is in love with, she turns out to be a yandere. Although they have different surnames, she's also the older sister of [Yuzu Kichougasaki](https://anilist.co/character/122433/Kichougasaki-Yuzu).

name: Guri
description:
An Angel/Cupid. She often treats her duty as a Cupid like a joke, forming almost exclusively gay couples due to her love for male romance.

She is the daughter of [God](https://anilist.co/character/155539/Kamisama) and is set to take his place soon, and her mom is a demon, thus why she has a hard time understanding love.

name: Seiji Aino
description: Seiji is a more-or-less level headed individual, trying to please all the women around him without hurting them. He is a high school student and older brother of [Akua Aino](https://anilist.co/character/122432/Aino-Akua).

name: Kusuriuri
description:
A mysterious wandering man with a vast knowledge of the supernatural and is mystical in appearance. He carries around a large wooden box filled with medicine and holy tools. Among them is an enchanted sword that is used to slay the mononoke. To use the sword, the Medicine Seller must find the "Katachi" (shape), "Makoto" (truth), and "Kotowari" (reasoning) of the mononoke he wishes to exorcise. Once the sword has been unsheathed, he transforms into a demon-like creature.

While his origins are unknown, it is clear that the Medicine Seller is not human or at least not entirely human; he has elf-

name: Souta Takanashi
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Souta is a high school student recruited by [Popura](https://anilist.co/character/24417/Taneshima-Popura) to become a new employee at the family restaurant Wagnaria.

He is enamored by cute things and thus favors Poplar over the other employees due to her cute appearance. He voices his thoughts out loud and occasionally offends his co-workers, often resulting in him getting punished by them. He usually finds his co-workers and the rules of the restaurant to be strange, but he still has an attachment to his job. He can adapt quickly to his job at the restaurant.

He has thre

name: Aoi Yamada
description:
Aoi is a mysterious, self-proclaimed 16-year-old girl who [Otoo](https://anilist.co/character/32294/Otoo-Hyougo) meets on his travels to find his missing wife. He brings her back to Wagnaria where she starts working as a waitress and living in Wagnaria’s attic.

While she has great confidence in herself, during work she is an unhelpful troublemaker who gets yelled at by other staff members, especially [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta). Since she is in training, her position among the staff is low, which she complains about. She is bad with dealing with Souta’s constan

name: Yachiyo Todoroki
description:
Yachiyo is another employee at the restaurant. She usually carries around a katana which, according to her, was made by her parents who used to be blacksmiths. Yachiyo is unaware that some of the customers, and even [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta), are intimidated by her blade.

She admires [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/24420/Shirafuji-Kyouko) considerably. She gets angry if anyone offers Kyouko food or tries to take her away, although is willing to allow Satou to feed her because she considers him trustworthy, much to his chagrin.

name: Hiroomi Souma
description:
A chef who works in the kitchen, he is a young man with an easygoing attitude.

He often blackmails other workers to do his job for him and pass it off as a form of modesty from the other employees. He can blackmail anyone except [Inami](https://anilist.co/character/24419/Inami-Mahiru), who punches him even before he manages to talk to her. He is terrified of Inami's urges and is thankful for [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s existence in the restaurant since Inami is taking out her urges all on Souta and not him.

name: Mahiru Inami
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm

Inami is a timid girl who joins the rest of the employees at Wagnaria.

She has androphobia and is thus terrified of men; she punches any male that comes near her. This violent behavior arises from her belief that every man is ready to attack her, but instead, she is prone to violently attacking men at a moment's notice. This androphobia was caused by her father who did not want her to eventually wed due to jealousy and thus told her that males would attack her, which ended in her fearing men since then.

As she and [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta

name: Jun Satou
description:
A chef who works in the kitchen, Satou is a helpful but intimidating individual.

He is in love with [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/30905/Todoroki-Yachiyo), but has problems expressing it. Of course, because she is so devoted to [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/24420/Shirafuji-Kyouko), she fails to recognize any hints he attempts to make.

He likes to take out his anger on [Popura](https://anilist.co/character/24417/Taneshima-Popura) by messing with her or bending the truth, to which Popura naively believes. When [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/30686/Souma-Hiroomi) tries to h

name: Popura Taneshima
description: Popura is a short 17-year-old high school student who works at Wagnaria. Ironically, she was named after the poplar tree so that she would grow tall. She is a hard worker, but she sometimes makes clumsy mistakes in her job. She is very sensitive about her small appearance; many customers usually mistake her to be younger than she really is. She often fails to gain respect from [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta), who is one year younger than her, as he usually regards her as an elementary school student. She is also unable to properly call him by his surname, saying "Ka

name: Kyouko Shirafuji
description:
Kyouko is the manager of Wagnaria.

She usually maintains a rather apathetic attitude about how the restaurant is run and almost never bothers to do any work herself. She is not beyond using violence to deal with unruly customers and firmly believes that employees come before the customers, as the employees are the ones doing all the work. She is 28 years old, but she becomes despondent whenever her age is mentioned.

Kyouko saved [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/30905/Todoroki-Yachiyo) as a little girl from bullies, which is how they met.

name: Shuu Ogata
description:
**Height:** 179 cm

The protagonist who runs a small private military company. He is usually broke as he cannot handle finances well. He is an orphan, as the rest of his family is presumed to be dead after an incident prior to the events of the series.

name: Kisara
description:
**Height:** 158 cm

A young girl who goes to a high school in Bayron City. She is actually a demon girl who is hundreds of years old. She has the ability to eat the memories of people, including [Shuu](https://anilist.co/character/268522/Ogata-Shuu).

name: Ayano Yuugiri
description:
**Height:** 165 cm

[Shuu Ogata](https://anilist.co/character/268522/Ogata-Shuu)'s first ex-girlfriend. Although she and Shuu have broken up, she still has feelings for him. She is also [Akino](https://anilist.co/character/278138/Yuugiri-Akino)'s daughter.

name: Hibiki
description: __Height:__ 5'7"

name: Uta
description: __Height:__ 5'2"

name: Favaro Leone
description:
Favaro makes his living as a bounty hunter. He can't live without women, money and wine. His life takes a turn when he meets [Amira](https://anilist.co/character/88554/Amira).

Favaro is a young man with an orange hair styled into an afro, and green eyes. He has a large X-shaped scar on his face. His armor consists of a left pauldron, plate on his left elbow, plates on both of his knees and plated boots.

Speaks with a carefree attitude and is somewhat of a self-proclaimed ladies' man. He doesn't like to be responsible for others and claims that he only watches out for himself.

name: Kaisar Lidfard
native: カイザル・リドファルド
description:
Kaisar used to be a knight from a prestigious family, but has since become a bounty hunter. He chases Favaro, blaming him for his current status.

Kaisar is a very tall man, with white pants, a green shirt with white stripes and golden buttons, and a dark green vest hung over it, with green arm covers and golden stripes on the wrists. He has his knight's sword sheathed in a navy blue scabbard on his left side at all times. At times he's seen in gray knight's armor; even when he takes the armor off he keeps the leggins of the armor on his legs. Can be often seen holding a knight's pose and usua

name: Amira
description:
A mysterious woman who fell from the sky. She, by all means, wants to reach the northern land called Helheim.

Amira is a very tall young woman with pale skin, violet eyes, and long, flowing, pink hair she ties in two ponytails. Her attire is somewhat unusual, consisting of a white blouse with a black vest above it, and a knee-length tan-colored shirt which acts as a coat, with a maroon and red vest covering her shoulders. She wears white and beige shorts, held up with a black belt, and two long, cowboy-looking boots with folded top edge, patched black in color.

name: Rita
description:
Rita is a young child who lives in Nebelville, and is the daughter of the village doctor. She has short black hair and bangs, and usually wears a lopsided hat. She has somewhat of a quiet and timid personality.

She is actually a young necromancer. One day a monster invaded the village and killed everyone, leaving her as the only survivor of the massacre. Alone and scared, Rita used the Black Bible to revive her parents and the dead villagers, and concealed all of them behind an magical mist that made the zombies look as if they were alive. For two hundred years she lived with the zombified re

name: Akatsuki Ousawa
description: Akatsuki came back to the real world after defeating the demon king in a world of sword and magic called Alayzard.  A fine young man who is confident of his strength, perverted yet serious.  He has a nasty habit of irritating girls by taking off their lingerie in a stealthy manner.  For some reason, Miu is the frequent victim of his perversion.

name: Chikage Izumi
description: A classmate of Akatsuki's and Miu's. She is a friendly, tomboyish girl with short brown hair and amber eyes. She becomes friends with Miu immediately. She is also a lesbian, and admits this fact with no shame. Her element is water, and her weapon is a crossbow.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Haruka Nanase
description: The Vice President of Student Council, who has long, green hair and green eyes. She seems to dislike Akatsuki a lot, especially after he steals both her bra and her panties during the middle of a school day, though she attacked him out of nowhere. Her weapons are two big blades.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kuzuha Doumoto
description: A classmate of Akatsuki's and Miu's, also the Class Rep of their class. She is a really small girl, who is also really young, about the age of an elementary schooler. However, because of her being really smart and clever, she gets to be in high school. Doumoto has usually an emotionless expression most of time, and rarely smiles. Her element is earth, and her weapon is a gigantic, wooden hammer.

name: Miu Ousawa
description: She is the daughter of the Demon King Akatsuki. For some unfortunate reason she would always finds herself being a victim of Akatsuki's perversion be it accidental or intentional however she is pretty much capable of fending him off.... some of the time that is. Though Akatsuki treats her like his sister, it is suggested that he may have deeper feelings for her.

name: Chii
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

Chii is a Persocom who is found by [Hideki Motosuwa](https://anilist.co/character/225) in a garbage dump. At first, she is only able to say "Chii", thus earning her that name. Later on, she is taught various things, and is eventually able to communicate with other people.

She is a Chobit, a legendary Persocom that is capable of thinking independently and feeling human emotions. Her real name is Elda. She was created to be a "little sister" to Freya, the first Chobit, after Chitose Hibiya noticed Freya becoming increasingly sad. After Freya eventually breaks down, El

name: Hideki Motosuwa
description:
**Height:** 178 cm (5'10'')

Hideki Motosuwa is a student who is attempting to qualify for university by studying at the Seki cram school in Tokyo. He's an honest and kind teenager who was raised on a farm, and unfortunately for him, has no experience with women. He has a very active imagination, which tends to result in him talking to himself in public. Hideki is interested in finding a girlfriend and has a great desire to have a Persocom—a computer shaped in the form of a human who can do all sorts of things. Although he cannot afford one, his luck holds out when he finds one lying in a garb

name: Minami Fuyuki
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3'')

[Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/142802/Shiki-Tsubasa)'s 16-year-old classmate at Kitami Hokuryo High School, who is popular and talkative. She follows the gal subculture; dyeing her hair blonde, wearing short skirts in winter, and refusing to wear gloves in the winter so that she can still use her phone. She seems to have a crush on Tsubasa and enjoys flirting with him to make him embarrassed and flustered.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Tsubasa Shiki
description:
__Height:__ 179cm (5'10'')

He is a city boy who is quite a fool. He speaks his mind at times when he'd rather not let those thoughts slip out. He is very weak to the cold.

name: Sayuri Akino
description:
__Height:__ 157cm (5'1")

Tsubasa and Minami's classmate who, with her raven-hair, reserved personality and choice not to use the Hokkaido dialect, is the exact opposite of Minami. She is very into video games, but pays attention to her appearance; reading fashion and make-up magazines in order to fit in. Because she sweats a lot, Sayuri avoided all forms of exercise, which eventually found her avoiding people in general. Because she has no friends, Sayuri felt a kinship with Tsubasa, and she becomes friends with him and Minami.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Rena Natsukawa
description:
__Height:__ 150cm (4'11")

[Tsubasa Shiki's](https://anilist.co/character/142802/Shiki-Tsubasa) senpai or upperclassman one grade above him. 

She is a gal like [Fuyuki](https://anilist.co/character/142801/Fuyuki-Minami), who respects her a lot. She is really timid and insecure, even though she's considered really talented, especially at studying.

name: Special Week
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream.

Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

name: Silence Suzuka
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier.

An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated. She is roommates with Special Week and many find themselves attracted to her authentic personality.

name: Kyousuke Munakata
aliases: Super High School-Level Student Council President
description:
__Height:__ 186cm (6'1")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Student Council President

A character featured in _Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School_. During his time in Class 74th at Hope's Peak Academy, his title was the Ultimate Student Council President. He is later the vice-chairman of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 2 Director. His responsibility as the director is the management of the Future Foundation, including construction of new facilities, expansion of the organization, etc. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final K

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Future Arc

name: Ashito  Aoi
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__ Jersey Number:__ 33
__Position:__ FW DF

Ashito is a brash and naïve kid from a remote prefecture called Ehime who has dreams of becoming the world's greatest forward. He currently lives in Tokyo as a first year high school student and member of Tokyo City Esperion FC.

name: Tokiyuki Houjou
description:
__Skill:__ Elusiveness: combined techniques in running away, evasion, and stealth 
__Emblem:__ Mitsuuroko (Three Scales)

A boy in the Houjou clan who was expected to inherit the rule of the Kamakura shogunate. He excels at fleeing and is now gathering strength at Suwa Grand Shrine so he can use that skill in his efforts to reclaim the throne.

name: Yorishige Suwa
description:
__Skill:__ Future Sight

Worshiped as the God of Suwa by having the spirit of Suwa Myojin within him. He's the person who offers safety to Tokiyuki after the fall of his clan in 1333. He is one of the 3 most outstanding arahitogami in Japan.

name: Shizuku
description: The priestess of Suwa Shrine under the orders of [Yorishige](https://anilist.co/character/300898/Suwa-Yorishige). She's a member of Elusive Warriors.

name: Kojirou Nezu
description: Tokiyuki's ally and a member of Elusive Warriors. He belongs to the Nezu clan.

name: Ayako Mochizuki
description: A member of Elusive Warriors.

name: Genba Kazama
description: A thief that belongs to the Kazama clan, a branch of the Suwa clan. He is a member of the Elusive Warriors.

name: Chocolat
description: A carefree and upbeat girl who claims to have come to Kanade to help free him of his "Absolute Choice" curse. However, ends up having amnesia on arrival and becomes very little help at all. Enjoys sweets and particularly chocolate.

appearsIn.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy

name: Kanade Amakusa
description:
He is a regular high school student who has a curse that he calls "Absolute Choice". This curse will at random times cause a voice in his head to give him two or more choices to make. If he doesn't choose one of them soon after, he will start getting a severe headache, forcing him to choose one.

Ouka affectionately calls him "Amachi."

appearsIn.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy

name: Furano Yukihira
description: Kanade's classmate who is quiet but a little weird. She likes verbally abusing Kanade.

appearsIn.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy

name: Ouka Yuuouji
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")

One of the Reject 5 members. She is a very cheerful and happy girl. She also likes Kanade and doesn't mind being a 5th wheel.

appearsIn.title: My Mental Choices Are Completely Interfering With My School Romantic Comedy

name: Guo Chen
description: Owner of Happy Internet Cafe and the boss of Team Happy. She plays under the account Chasing Haze, a Launcher class.

name: Rou Tang
description: Plays a Battle Mage by the name of Soft Mist in the game of Glory.

name: Xiu Ye
description:
He is well-known by players as a textbook expert and the God of Fighting. Ye Xiu is one of the first batch of players and a first-generation Glory player.
