He is also known to be skilled at all professions, having developed combo guides, created techniques like 'Delivery Gun' and various other popular types of playstyles in Glory.

Former captain of team "Excellent Era" who obtained 3 consecutive championships during the first 3 season of the Glory Pro League.

name: Mucheng Su
description: Su Mucheng is an eSports player of Glory. She plays the launcher class under the users "Dancing Rain" and "Cleansing Mist".

name: Hanyuu Furude
description:
Hanyuu is the mysterious "transfer student" in Matsuribayashi-hen. She has a pair of dark colored horns on her head, one of which is chipped slightly (however, no one seems to notice or mention them, with the exception of [Takano](https://anilist.co/character/4934/Takano-Miyo), who calls her a "monster").

In fact, she has appeared to [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) all her life, but only in Matsuribayashi-hen and Miotsukushi-hen did she gain the power to interact with others, posing as a distant relative of Rika's and given the name "Hanyuu Furude." Like many of the char

name: Miyuki
description:
Miyuki's backstory deals with her fear of returning home. She is a runaway girl who leaves home because she hated her father's over-controlling ways. In the past, Miyuki was slightly overweight, but after 6 months on the streets, she has lost a substantial amount of weight.

Miyuki considers herself to be a very independent young woman, however at her young age, she greatly relies on the support and safety that Hana and Gin provide for her in order to survive on the streets.

name: Kiyoko
description: The little baby that Hana, Gin and Miyuki want to protect.

name: Hana
description: A homeless trans woman. She never knew her actual parents, and thus feels the most sympathy for "Kiyoko", the baby she finds and names. Because of her upbringing, she is the kindest out of the three main characters, but is also the sickliest, which she hides from the others.

name: Gin
description: An alcoholic that once made money by racing bicycles. When his daughter became ill, he threw a race to get the money for her medicine, but because of that got banned from the sport.   ... or so he says , in reality he owned a bike shop with his wife , he ran up a gambling debt and ran away from home leaving his wife with the shop and the baby who became a nurse   After that he started living on the streets with Hana and Miyuki.

name: Tomoe Inui
description:
__Race:__ Mystic Wolf

Tomoe Inui is a recurring character of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series.

(Source: Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki Wiki)

appearsIn.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom Part 2
How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom

name: Juna Doma
description: Juna Doma is one of the female protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She is the granddaughter of [Excel Walter](https://anilist.co/character/214660/Walter-Excel).

appearsIn.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom Part 2
How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom

name: Asako Kusakabe
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm

Asako was Yuuji's former master. She took charge of raising Yuuji when his parents passed away. She was both harsh and sweet, capable and incompetent and drilled many of her own values into Yuuji. Thanks to her job of bringing him up, he can at least act normal, but now possesses a strong wariness for the horrors of large women. She also completely and utterly incompetent at cooking as she couldn't even make fried rice.

Asako wasn't particularly different from Yuuji; she loved to read. She was content to pass time with a book, a pack of cigarettes, and a pot of coffee espe

name: Hikaru Gero
description:
__Specialist Type:__ Poison User

Hikaru Gero is part of the Gero Family, one of the top five families of specialists. He is the current heir to the Poison clan. A poison-using hitman from the clan of assassins. In order to keep his sister from being forced into having a child to continue the lineage of the clan, Gero decides to try and get married and have a child of his own.

name: Mei Kinosaki
description:
__Gender:__ Male__Occupation:__ Swindler

Mei Kinosaki is a marriage swindler who charms both men and women in order to get money from them to help keep their sick brother alive. Mei was saved by [Gero](https://anilist.co/character/297787/Gero-Hikaru) after being captured by a crime syndicate that they had wronged. Mei agreed to help Gero find a wife in exchange for Gero's protection, and help with keeping their sick brother alive.

name: Kenshin Himura
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm  

Kenshin Himura, also known throughout the anime as Hitokiri Battousai (Battousai the Manslayer) or Himura the Battousai, is the main character of the series Rurouni Kenshin. His original name was Shinta (心太). 

His parents died of cholera when he was very young and as a result, was adopted by three slave women in a traveling slave wagon. Soon after meeting them, bandits had raided the convoy and killed his three new guardians and where about to kill him when [Seijuro Hiko](https://anilist.co/character/2406/Hiko-Seijuurou) killed the bandits. Hiko soon adopted the child an

name: Kaoru Kamiya
description:
__Height:__ 155cm 
__Affiliations:__ Kamiya dojo

The primary instructor of the Kamiya Kasshin-Ryū fighting style developed by her late father, Kamiya Koshijirō, Kaoru inherited a small dojo from her father after he was killed during the Seinan War and operates it by herself. Naturally, she is independent, possessive, compassionate, courageous, feisty, strong-willed, and a great fighter to boot- with only the occasional mood swing. Kaoru is also known for her cooking disliked by her friends and family and her ability to see the good in others.

name: Yahiko Myojin
description: Yahiko is a samurai descendant. Yahiko's father died during the Battle of Ueno during the Boshin War, slain at the Keneiji Temple. His mother died of syphilis in a brothel to put food on their table not long after giving birth to her son. Yahiko was originally forced to live as a thief for the local Yakuza, who tricked him into believing that he still had to pay off the money the gangsters gave to his mother to buy medicine. With the help of Himura Kenshin and Kamiya Kaoru, he becomes an apprentice of the Kamiya Kasshin-Ryu style. Yahiko has a friend/rival, Tsukayama Yutaro and a sweetheart, S

name: Sanosuke Sagara
description: Sagara Sanosuke left home at an early age to join the Sekihou Army (Sekihou-tai), leaving behind his father ([Kamishimoemon](https://anilist.co/character/49245/Higashidani-Kamishimoemon)), his mother (Naname), and his younger sister ([Uki](https://anilist.co/character/49541/Higashidani-Uki)) who adored him.

name: Noor
description:
Though he aspired to become an adventurer, at the age of twelve he was deemed to possess "absolutely no talent whatsoever in anything." Yet, refusing to abandon his dream, he secluded himself in the mountains to hone his "Parry" skill—a dedication that eventually allowed him to grow capable of deflecting a thousand blades. 

In truth, he possesses truly extraordinary abilities, though he remains the only one completely oblivious to them.

He is currently registered with the guild at the lowest possible rank, he spends his days simply performing menial chores around the town.

name: Lynne
aliases: Linneburg Clays (リンネブルグ・クレイス)
description:
The First Princess of the Kingdom of Clays, her full name is Linneburg Clays. She excels in every conceivable ability, having graduated from the Royal Capital Training Academy with the highest scores in its history across all disciplines. She has comprehensively mastered skills spanning all six elemental systems. 

She was once attacked by a monster and saved from a perilous situation by [Noor](https://anilist.co/character/213554/Noor); ever since, she has looked up to him and affectionately addresses him as Sensei.

name: Anisphia Wynn Palettia
native: アニスフィア・ウィン・パレッティア
description:
Anisphia is the first Princess of the Kingdom of Palettia. 

Possessing memories of her past life, she longs to be able to fly in the sky with the power of magic. However, as she's unable to use magic herself, she spends her days conducting questionable research in hopes of fulfilling her dream. Her eccentric behavior earned her the nickname "Princess Peculiar".

appearsIn.title: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady

name: Euphyllia Magenta
native: ユフィリア・マゼンタ
description:
The daughter of [Duke Magenta](https://anilist.co/character/261968/Ruomen). A genius beauty who not only excels at magic, but also well-versed in academics, politics and combat.

As the fiancé of [Prince Algard](https://anilist.co/character/287676/Von-Palettia-Algard), she showed promise as the kingdom's next queen. But one fateful night would change the course of her life forever...

appearsIn.title: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady

name: Ilia Coral
description:
[Anisphia](https://anilist.co/character/203119/Wynn-Palettia-Anisphia)'s personal maid. Although a servant, she watches over Anisphia like an older sister. She was saved by Anisphia in the past and is deeply loyal to her.

Ilia was born into a low-ranking noble family. To improve their status, her parents intended to marry her off to an influential husband, basically treating their daughter as a political tool. All of this caused Ilia to grow up to become a fairly weak-willed person who did whatever she was told. However, before marrying her off, her family had her work at the royal palace as

appearsIn.title: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady

name: Lainie Cyan
description:
The daughter of a commoner elevated to the rank of Baron. Despite her humble origins, she has succeeded in attracting the attention of the sons of several influential nobles at the aristocratic academy.

It is eventually revealed that Lainie is actually a vampire who constantly gives off a charm that makes people infatuated with her, which she herself was unaware of. Following this, she is taken in by Anisphia so she may learn to control her abilities, which she repays by working for her as a maid.

appearsIn.title: The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady
The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady

name: Rebecca Bluegarden
native: レベッカ・ブルーガーデン
description:
Rebecca Bluegarden, the female protagonist, is a kind and energetic girl from the planet Blue Garden who travels to different planets to record videos of and upload to her channel on Aoneko, a video-sharing website, with the goal of obtaining one million subscribers. She pilots a spaceship called the Aqua Wing, which also functions as a seaboat.

Rebecca's power, Leaper, is an Ether Gear that enhances her jumping ability, giving her great speed and agility.

name: Shiki Granbell
description: Shiki, the main protagonist of the story, is a friendly yet socially awkward boy who's the sole human denizen of the Granbell Kingdom, a fantasy theme park on the planet Granbell inhabited by robots. He possesses an ability called Ether Gear, which is inherited from the park's animatronic Demon King, granting its user powers akin to those of a machine; Shiki uses a variation known as "Satan Gravity" that allows him to alter and redirect his own personal gravity. Encouraged by his artificial family to go out and make some real friends, he gets swept up on a journey with Rebecca to see new world

name: Witch  Regret
native: ウィッチ・リグレット
description:
Witch Regret is a machine part of the Four Shining Stars. She is responsible for defending Edens Zero. Her power, Shield Ether, allows her to produce barriers made of Ether. 

Witch is very dutiful and holds a deep respect to Ziggy and his adoptive grandson Shiki. Although she is usually emotionless, Witch is capable of showing emotions. She finds it embarrassing to show her face to other people.

name: Happy
description:
Happy is a machine cat from the planet Excede, Rebecca Bluegarden's companion, and a member of the Edens Zero's crew. His ability "Happy Blasters" allows him to transform into a pair of guns that fire Ether bullets. These bullets are powerful enough to incapacitate their targets, but won't kill them.

Happy was a cat found by Rebecca when he was young. He instantly became friends with her due to them sharing common life events. He received his name "Happy" from Rebecca for making her happy by becoming her friend. Sometime later, an accident occurred where a drunk driver ran over Happy, which e

name: Homura Kougetsu
description: Homura Kougetsu is a member of the Demon King's crew on Edens Zero, and a self-described knight from Planet Blue Garden. Her power, Soul Blade, is a type of Ether Gear that allows her to create bladed weapons made of Ether.

name: Hermit Mio
description: Hermit Mio is an android who's the member of the Four Shining Stars. Her power, Master Code, is a type of Program Hacking. Hermit likes clothes and video games, and used to dislike humans, but not anymore.

name: Sister  Ivry
description:
Sister Ivry is a machine part of the Four Shining Stars. Her power, Heal Atomizer, is a Healing Ether ability that allows her to mend wounds, undo negative status effects, and repair living machines. Sister is short tempered, enjoys teasing, and has a laid-back attitude, but she is also dutiful and can be friendly to her allies. She has a sadistic side and enjoys torture. She dislikes things that can't be healed.

Sister is shown to be someone who cannot accept death as a finality for machines, going as far to believe machines can be brought back by using the cloud's stored data.

name: Weisz Steiner
native: ワイズ・シュタイナー
description:
Weisz is a member of Edens Zero and a former thief from the Planet Norma. His power is Machina Maker, an Ether Gear that manipulates machines.

Weisz is a selfish, stubborn, and vain man with a perverted side. However, he does care for his friends, and shows concern for others in his own way. Weisz likes money and bunny girls, and dislikes studying. 

He is also the younger version of Professor Weisz from the year X442.

name: E.M. Pino
description:
Pino is a miniature anti-bot machine who joins the crew of Edens Zero. She can emit bursts of electromagnetic pulses, also known as EMP, that short out electronics for a few seconds and cancel out Ether Gear when it's in use.

Her digital avatar resembles a young human girl with rabbit-like ears. She wears a necktie that is decorated with a single large heart.

name: Noboru Maeda
description: Maeda Noboru, nicknamed Suppon (Turtle). He has been detained for theft, con, dine-and-ditch, and many other crimes which could not be fully investigated during his detention.    Maeda is one of the seven protagonists in RAINBOW. He is the smallest guy in the group and the most cunning in the team. Other than An-chan, he seems to get along with Jou best,  most probably because of them being same aged and both being orphans.

name: Mansaku Matsuura
description: Matsu'ura Mansaku is seventeen and is one of the seven protagonists in RAINBOW. He is nicknamed Cabbage. He has been detained for violence and underage drinking. He performed an act of violence while drunk, leaving the victim with grave injuries.    Despite his huge figure, Mansaku is quite gentle in nature and probably the most calm amongst the seven cell mates. He showed his caring nature by wiping away the blood clots from Sakuragi's body after he was heavily beaten and left senseless for being in a fight with new cell mates by the inspector in charge.

name: Mario Minakami
description:
Minakami Mario is one of the seven main protagonists in RAINBOW. Nicknamed Mario has been detained to two years of confinement in the Shonan Special Disciplinary School. He was found guilty of inflicting grave injuries on one of his teachers who attempted an act of violence towards a female student.

Mario is strong willed and hates being looked down upon. He was the first one to start a fight in day one soon after being confined in a cell with [Sakuragi](https://anilist.co/character/31741/Sakuragi-Rokurouta)

name: Ryuuji Nomoto
description:
Nomoto Ryuji, nickname Baremoto, which means "Uncovered" has been detained for con, usurpation, and theft. He frequently committed crimes in shopping centers.

Nomoto is one of the seven protagonists of RAINBOW. He wears glasses and have a character of being an observer. [Sakuragi](https://anilist.co/character/31741/Sakuragi-Rokurouta) used his glasses to refract sunbeam to light the cigarette which [Joe](https://anilist.co/character/31748/Yokosuka-Jou) gave to him.

name: Rokurouta Sakuragi
description:
Sakuragi Rokurouta, referred as 'An-chan' by his cell mates, is the oldest of the seven protagonists in Rainbow. He is strong and has great boxing technique which he used to take on all the six new comers when [Mario](https://anilist.co/character/31742/Minakami-Mario) instigated a fight.

Although it seemed he looked down upon the six new cell mates in the beginning, which lead to a fight he won with ease, the six new cell mates found out later that Sakuragi is in reality a guy worthy to look upon and soon start to refer him as An-chan, which can be translated as an 'intimate bro'.

The reason

name: Tadayoshi Tooyama
description: One of the seven main protagonists of RAINBOW. Nicknamed Heitai (Army Corps/ Soldier), he has been detained for acts of violence and false imprisonments. He ruthlessly struck his mother's boyfriend, seriously injuring the man.

name: Jou Yokosuka
description:
Yokosuka Jou, nicknamed Joe is one of the seven protagonist of RAINBOW. He has been detained for 2 years for violence after being forced to have intergender relationships. He inflicted injuries requiring three months of recovery on the person who attempted to violate him.

Joe is weak by nature. He offered [Sakuragi](https://anilist.co/character/31741/Sakuragi-Rokurouta) a cigarette in the first day to beg for mercy as Sakuragi took all six of them on in a fight started by [Mario](https://anilist.co/character/31742/Minakami-Mario).

He has a younger sister named [Megumi](https://anilist.co/cha

name: Solada
description: Solada is a member of the Winged People Clan

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins the Movie: Prisoners of the Sky

name: Erlatte
description: Erlatte is a member of the Winged People Clan.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins the Movie: Prisoners of the Sky

name: Charlotte Soller
native: シャルロット・ソレル
description: Charlotte is a maid at the de Médicis house and Pharma's childhood friend. Later on, she joins her master as a pharmacy clerk.

name: Farma de Médicis
native: ファルマ・ド・メディシス
description: Pharma is the otherworldly reincarnation of Kanji Yakutani, a world-famous medical researcher at T University who created countless medical advances and medicines to counter any sickness.

name: Eléonore Bonnefoi
native: エレオノール・ボヌフォワ
description: Pharma's personal tutor and a talented pharmacist who passed her first-grade exam at the age of fifteen. Has so many glasses to replace those she lost. She joins her student in building his dreams.

name: Lehm Brick
description:
The oldest member of Koko's crew and the second in command. A former Delta Force operator who used to be active in Somalia during the 1990s, he is a veteran mercenary with strong leadership skills. He acted as Floyd Hekmatyar's bodyguard together with Chiquita, his ex-wife, before joining Koko's squad. Lehm also does sniper work either alone or together with Lutz.  His surname "Brick" was reveled in ep7 of season 2.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sofia Velmer
native: ソフィア・ヴェルマー
description: An ex-mechanized jäger major of the Finnish Rapid Deployment Force who is skilled with knives. She is in love with [Koko](https://anilist.co/character/33451/Hekmatyar-Koko), but it is unknown whether Koko returns her feelings. Her real name is Sofia Velmer. Valmet comes from a military family and served as a UN peacekeeping officer in Africa. Her entire Finnish-led UN squad was annihilated by [Chen Guoming](https://anilist.co/character/65311/Guoming-Chen) and she herself lost an eye in that attack. Since then Valmet feels uneasy and even frightened whenever she sets foot on African soil.

name: Koko Hekmatyar
native: ココ・ヘクマティアル
description:
The series' protagonist. A young arms dealer and the daughter of Floyd Hekmatyar, a global shipping magnate. Belongs to HCLI's European and African Logistics Division.

She is physically attractive, with long silver-white hair, pale alabaster skin, striking blue eyes and her trademark smile, which is present even under dire circumstances. She is extremely charismatic and bold, which earned her great success in her business as well as the fierce loyalty of her subordinates. While generally behaving in a bubbly and slightly childish manner, Koko is actually rather ruthless and has been called a

name: Jonathan Mar
description:
A child soldier. His parents were killed by an airstrike by a F-22 Raptor. Picked up as a child soldier soon after this traumatic event. Despite his intense hatred of weapons, Jonah decides to work under the enigmatic arms dealer, [Koko Hekmatyar](https://anilist.co/character/33451/Hekmatyar-Koko). Though he is young, his skills on the battlefield are extraordinary and is frequently shown besting men much older than himself. Also, infrequently displays a childish nature. Is shown to dislike mathematics and science and excels at languages.

His primary weapon in season 1 is an FN FNC and in sea

name: Sae Nakata
description:
__Class:__ 1-B
__Height:__ 151 cm


A friend of Miya's. Having studied at an all-girl's school for most of her life, Sae is incredibly shy around men.   She is the main female character on the third arc in the anime   Her ending in the game: Best End: She feels badly about making Tachibana be her boyfriend. Tachibana runs after her, telling her how much she means to him. They spend their Christmas watching a movie in a private room. They share a deep, passionate kiss. Sex is strongly implied. Many years later, she walks out of a hospital towards Tachibana... pregnant with his child.   Good End

name: Junichi Tachibana
description:
**Height:** 172 cm
**Class:** 2-A

Junichi Tachibana is the lead male protagonist of the story. He has a hard time opening up to others due to trauma two years ago when his date stood him up on Christmas Eve, leaving him heartbroken. In the anime, he has acrophobia, which is referenced several times.

name: Tsukasa Ayatsuji
description:
**Class**: 2-A 
**Height**: 165 cm 

Tsukasa is the classmate of Junichi and is also the class representative of Class 2-A. She is very hard-working, and often takes the jobs that her classmates do not want. Her study habits, looks, and personality are perfect. She is popular with the students, and is also seen as a reliable student by the faculty. Her hobbies include reading in a quiet place, as such she often appears to be in the library after school.  Her arc is the 6th arc to be shown in the Anime.

name: Kaoru Tanamachi
description:
**Height:** 168 cm
**Class:** 2-A

One of Junichi's childhood friends, and is often seen with his other friend Masayoshi. She is unpredictable as she would punch Junichi anytime. She works part-time at a Family Restaurant to support her single mother.  She is the main female character on the second arc in the anime.  Kaoru is the second heroine of Amagami - Precious Diary.

name: Haruka Morishima
description:
**Height:** 169 cm 

A very popular girl in her final year, who has many fans at school. She can be described as picky, innocently insensitive, insecure, forgetful and eccentric. She also has a liking for cute things, especially puppies. Her best friend is Hibiki Tsukahara, a captain of the girls swimming team. She has one older brother and two younger brothers. She is a quarter British from her mother's side of the family. Her middle name is "Lovely" which was given by her British grandfather.  Her arc is the first in the anime.    Her ending in the game: Best End: Morishima reserves a hotel

name: Rihoko Sakurai
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

She is Junichi's childhood friend who, despite having a big appetite, avidly reads the dieting books in their school library. She is a member of the Tea-Making Society.   Riihoko's arc is the 5th in the Anime.

name: Ai Nanasaki
description:
__Class:__ 1-B 
__Club:__ Swimming Team 
__Height:__ 160 cm 

A classmate of Miya's. She is part of their school's girl swimming team. She has a younger brother named Ikuo and is very calm in nature, and humble.   Her story is the fourth arc of the anime.   Her ending in the game: Best End: They spend their Christmas in a hot spring in the mountains. Tachibana realizes how much she means to him and confesses. She accepts and hugs him while they're both in the spring. She's naked. Many years later, they watch fireworks from their room. Sex is certainly implied somewhere.[ending they used in the

name: Ai Mie
description:
An absentminded and innocent middle-school girl who sits next to Komura-kun. She has poor eyesight and must wear glasses, but she tends to forget them quite often. 
Whenever Mie forgets her glasses her depth perception in particular suffers and thus she tends to lean in close to Komura-kun.

appearsIn.title: The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses
The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses

name: Kaede Komura
description: Komura is a shy, good-natured middle-school boy. He has had a crush on Mie since the first days of school, but because of his fear of being rejected, it is difficult for him to confess his love to her. He loves playing games, especially those at the arcade.

appearsIn.title: The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses
The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses

name: Miniskirt Santa
description:
__Height:__ 161cm

A miniskirt-wearing Santa calling herself "Touko Kirishima". She claims she's been handing out presents—Adolescence Syndrome.

appearsIn.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus

name: Ikumi Akagi
description: Sakuta's classmate from middle school who seems to share a troubled past with him. She currently attends the same college as [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta). She's highly intelligent, and appears to have a number of secrets.

appearsIn.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus
Rascal Does Not Dream of a Knapsack Kid

name: Sara Himeji
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm

A first-year student at Minegahara High with excellent grades, and one of Sakuta's students at cram school.

appearsIn.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus

name: Junko Enoshima
aliases: Super High School Level Gyaru (超高校級のギャル)
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")
__Talent:__ Gyaru

Junko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant in the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Gyaru (超高校級のギャル), or Ultimate Fashionista in the English localization.

Junko is talkative, charismatic, and can be hotheaded at times.

It is discovered that the girl who introduced herself as Junko wasn't really Junko at all, but actually Mukuro Ikusaba, her twin sister, the Ultimate Soldier. She was the "victim" of the fifth murder, her body having been used to create a fake crime scene. The real Junko, the youn

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Hajime Hinata
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")
__Talent:__ Ultimate ???

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. He doesn't remember his talent at the beginning of the Killing Game, so his title is the Ultimate ???.

Hajime seems cynical at first glance, but it would be better to describe him as a realist. He is quite skeptical and tends to worry more than the other students, but his worries are usually understandable. He is logical and smart; often annoyed by the idea of not being able to understand someone or somethi

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Chisa Yukizome
aliases: Super High School-Level Housekeeper (超高校級の家政婦)
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm (5'3")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Housekeeper

She was later Class 77-B's homeroom teacher, and then the Future Foundation's Branch 5 Office Director responsible for the inquiry and secret intelligence regarding Despair. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Mukuro Ikusaba
aliases: Super High School Level Soldier (超高校級の軍人)
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")
__Talent:__ Soldier

Mukuro is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Soldier (超高校級の軍人), or Ultimate Soldier in the English localization.

During the Killing School Life, Mukuro disguised as her younger twin sister, Junko Enoshima, and joined the remaining fifteen students to carry out Junko's plan. However, Mukuro ended up being killed by her: shortly after the first murder, Mukuro was supposed to follow a plan she had agreed on with her sister, but on a whim, Junko decided to ki

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Chiaki Nanami
aliases: Super High School Level Gamer (超高校級のゲーマー)
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'2")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Gamer

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. 

Chiaki normally has a quiet and sleepy disposition, but she becomes a lot more lively when discussing games and concentrates hard when playing. She has a number of unusual habits, such as dozing off while playing games and taking long pauses during her conversations to think about everything she wants to say. She sometimes even sleeps while standing and forgets to breathe when she's playing games. She also quite often uses gaming terms and referen

appearsIn.title: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope’s Peak High School - Despair Arc

name: Kenji Miyazawa
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Ability:__ Undefeated by the Rain

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. Before he was scouted, he lived in a rural area without electricity. He knows no suspicion, and will be understanding and considerate no matter who he is talking to. He has a lot of friends who call him "Ken-chan." He likes music, tempura soba, and Mitsuya cider.

name: Sakunosuke Oda
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1)
__Ability:__ Flawless

Was a member of the Port Mafia. Oda was a man described as kind, despite working for the mafia, by [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu). He had an incredibly perceptive side to him that allowed him to come the closest to understanding Dazai, whom he referred to as "his dear friend, who had grown tired of the world and is simply waiting to die."

It is his understanding of Dazai's loneliness, as well as his regret of not being able to do anything about it, that prompted him to leave behind the last words that became the trigger

name: Tatsuhiko  Shibusawa
description:
__Ability:__ Draconia

He is the main antagonist in DEAD APPLE. Six years ago, he pulled the strings behind the Dragon's Head Conflict.

His ability, Draconia, has several forms and variations.

He can create a mist that separates abilities from their users, causing them to attack them. If the ability succeeds in killing its user, they transform into a gem and become part of his collection.
The abilities themselves also have a red gem on their bodies, which is their weak point. Destroying it will 'kill' them. If the user then accepts their ability, it is regained. If they reject it, it will in

name: Shintarou Midorima
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5")
__School:__ Shuutoku High School 
__Position:__ Shooting Guard  
__Special Ability:__ Shooting from anywhere on the court (Far-Distance Shooter)  

Midorima often acts reserved, mean, and brusque with others, coming off as arrogant—although [Takao](https://anilist.co/character/53563/Takao-Kazunari) claims Midorima is just "tsundere." He has a hard time acting kind to his opponents and generally hates "fooling around" (although Takao often pursues him into it). He can be seen, at all times, with a lucky item due to his strong belief and passion for horoscope. He is lef

name: Seijuurou Akashi
description:
**Height:** 173 cm
**School:** Rakuzan 
**High Position:** Point Guard 

The final member of the Generation of Miracles, he stood at their head as captain, leading their team to uncontested victory during the three years he played for Teikou Middle School. He is uninterested in winning, simply because victory in his eyes is an absolute given, requisite to his own life as much as breathing. But he has grown tired of victory in the absence of a chance of defeat;    Thus when it became clear that Aomine would not be able to participate in the final rounds of the inter-high school championship, he

name: Daiki Aomine
description:
__Height:__ 192 cm (6'3'')
__Number:__ #6 (Teikou), #5 (Touou) 
__Position:__ Power Forward 
__Talent:__ Skill and Agility, Unusual Speed, Zone Play 

Aomine was the ace of Teikou's team, embracing an aggressive and liquid style, made even more powerful by Kuroko's misdirection. In fact, Aomine was once Kuroko's "Light", before Kagami. Incredibly fast and versatile, Aomine's strength lies in his unpredictability, as well as an uncanny ability to shoot from virtually any position.  

In his second year in middle school, Aomine inspired Kise to play basketball and he became his training partner.

name: Kyouko Toshinou
description: Toshinou Kyouko is the founder of the amusement club. Goes so wild that no one can keep up with her, but it's not as if anyone even tries in the first place, so it's ultimately no big deal. She is actually an otaku who creates her own doujinshi of Mirakurun, an anime character in Yuru Yuri. Her favorite ice cream is rum raisin.

name: Akari Akaza
description:
Akari is a polite red-haired girl who is supposedly the main protagonist of the series. However, due to her rather small presence and plain personality, she is often forgotten about or pushed into the background. 

She is often thought of as having the ability to fire her hair dumplings and turn invisible whilst shouting "Akkari~n!". [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) and [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/35874) are her childhood friends, while [Chinatsu](https://anilist.co/character/35875), [Sakurako](https://anilist.co/character/35878) and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/3

name: Yui Funami
description: A cool-headed girl who often acts as the voice of reason, usually when it comes to keeping [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) in check. She is a reliable friend and usually lives alone in an apartment complex, but actually feels lonely without anyone else around. Although generally quiet, she will sometimes burst into laughter upon hearing [Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/35876)'s puns. She likes playing video games.

name: Chinatsu Yoshikawa
description: Akari's pink haired classmate who originally wanted to join the Tea Ceremony Club, but ended up joining the Amusement Club as the Tea Ceremony Club was already abolished. She is often chased after by Kyōko due to her resemblance to Mirakurun, though she herself has a passionate crush on Yui. She generally acts cute, especially in the presence of Yui, but she occasionally shows dark thoughts and a terrifying lack of artistic skills.

name: Rishe Weitzner
native: リーシェ・イルムガルド・ヴェルツナー
description: Rishe is a noble who dies at the age of 20 and returns to the moment of her broken engagement five years earlier. As a result of her various lives, she has acquired numerous skills and resilience; in this life, her seventh loop, she is engaged to Crown Prince [Arnold](https://anilist.co/character/312404/Arnold-Hein).

appearsIn.title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!

name: Arnold Hein
description: The crown prince of Galkhein.

appearsIn.title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!

name: Yui
description: Along with her twin [May](https://anilist.co/character/155752), they are recruited to Maple Tree while still on the first layer.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: Chrome
description:
Introduced [Maple](https://anilist.co/character/147892) to [Iz](https://anilist.co/character/155754). He is invited to join Maple tree after the guild system was introduced.
He is a caring and honest person who is open-minded and serious. Outside of combat, he gives off a strong parental vibe. Like Maple he is part of the Shield class as well as a sword he still tries to master.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: May
description: Along with her twin [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/155753), they are recruited to Maple Tree while still on the first layer.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: Iz
description: She plays the production-specialized crafter class, being one of the top crafters in NWO. She joins Maple Tree upon [Maple](https://anilist.co/character/147892)'s invitation.

appearsIn.title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. Season 2

name: Ena Komiya
description:
Ena is a second-year student, and a member of the photography club that is close to being disbanded. In order to save the club, she plans to enter a photography competition. In search of a good photo, she witnesses the reunion between Eita and Haruto.

(Source: ANN)

name: Hazuki Morikawa
description:
Hazuki is a member of the school concert band who has already decided on her preferred college. Her family has tended to a farm since her grandfather's time. She does not stand out in class, and seems uninterested in romantic relationships.

(Source: ANN)

name: Haruto Souma
description:
Haruto is a baseball team member who has already secured a job after graduation. He plans to hit the home run that he couldn't hit during the summer competition, and confess to someone he likes.

(Source: ANN)

name: Mio Natsume
description:
Mio was Eita and Haruto's classmate during middle school. She plans to enroll in college and is studying hard to make that happen. Her unrequited feelings for a middle school crush still influence her.

(Source: ANN)

name: Eita Izumi
description: Eita is a transfer student who has lived away from the town where Mio and the others lived for four years, but has now returned. He had been close friends with Haruto since middle school, and his transfer into their high school is a reunion for them.

name: Aikawa
description: Aikawa is one of Ai's several alter-egos. He's an easy going guy who loves good food and always stands up for his friends. However, because he shares a body with the psychopathic Kai, another one of Ai's alter-egos, anyone Aikawa gets close to tends to meet an untimely death. This is because anything Aikawa overhears Kai learns too. Even Aikawa's best friend, Risu, fell victim to Kai after he told Aikawa of his newly-discovered magical abilities. Aikawa hates Kai and tries to sabotage him any way he can, even attempting to kill himself to take Kai down with him. Alas, their body isn't that eas

name: Kai
description:
Kai is the Boss of the CrossEyes organization, whose symbol and namesake comes from the cross marks around Kai's eyes. Kai's only two interests are food and power. He is a ruthless killer who targets powerful sorcerers and butchers them to appropriate their magical abilities. But he has his own ability, as well: an aura which has the same effect as Hole's rain, crippling any sorcerers in its range. Though Kai's murderous exploits started as relatively low-key, they later escalated to genocidal proportions, amassing mountains of corpses to fuel his scientific experiments.

He is one of Ai's sev

name: Renton Thurston
native: レントン・サーストン
description: Renton Thurston is the son of the late military hero Adroc Thurston and co-pilot of the Nirvash typeZERO. He has been in love with Eureka the other pilot of the Nirvash ever since he first saw her. He is a very outgoing and emotional person possessing strong ideals and compassion yet is naive and tends to jump into matters before understanding what's going on. Before joining Gekkostate, he lived with his grandfather Axel Thurston in Bellforest, attending school and learning to be a mechanic in Axel's shop. He was heavily influenced by his sister Diane Thurston and believes that he will see her

name: Holland Novak
description:
**Affiliation**: Gekkostate
**Relatives**: Azmodeus Novak (father), Cicily Kane (mother),  [Dewey Novak](https://anilist.co/character/4005/Dewey-Novak) (older brother), [Talho Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/1530/Talho-Yuuki) (wife, implied), unnamed child (may be female) 

Holland Novak is the leader of Gekkostate, captain of the Gekko, and pilot of the LFO Terminus typeR909 (and later the Terminus B303).

name: Eureka
description:
**Age**: 14 - 16 ([Eureka Seven](https://anilist.co/anime/237/Eureka-Seven/)), 30 - 32 ([Eureka Seven AO](https://anilist.co/anime/12471/Eureka-Seven-AO/))
**Relatives**: [Maurice](https://anilist.co/character/4049/Maurice) (adoptive son), [Maeter](https://anilist.co/character/17776/Maeter) (adoptive daughter), [Linck](https://anilist.co/character/17777/Linck) (adoptive son)

Eureka is a member of Gekkostate and the pilot of the Nirvash type ZERO, alongside her co-pilot [Renton Thurston](https://anilist.co/character/477/Renton-Thurston). 
A bit of an enigma, Eureka is a young girl who has trou

name: Talho Yuuki
description: Talho Yūki is the head pilot of the Gekko. She is also best friends with Hilda. She and Holland are romantically involved throughout the series, with context suggesting that the relationship goes back at least to Holland's military service. During the early episodes she feels insecure in Holland's commitment to her, constantly reacting jealously to Eureka, as well as to the memory of Renton's sister whom Holland had dated.

name: Aika Natsukawa
description: The prettiest girl in class. Various things happened between her and Wataru, leading to her being Tsundere only around him.

appearsIn.title: The Dreaming Boy is a Realist

name: Wataru Sajou
description: Wataru is in love with Aika. However one day suddenly things start to change...?

appearsIn.title: The Dreaming Boy is a Realist

name: Nico
description:
__Nationality:__ American
__Height:__ 168cm (5'6")
__Occupation:__ Inmate
__ID Number:__ 1325
__Building:__ 13
__Cell:__ 13

He is one of the main protagonists of the anime and web manga series. He is in Nanba Prison for unknowingly buying and selling drugs in the slums.

Born in the slums of America, he was born with an unusual condition that gave him strange allergies and illnesses. He was arrested for carrying and selling drugs. However, when the doctors checked his body they discovered he did not digest any drugs and was more than likely used as an unwitting courier. He was sent to juvenil

name: Juugo
description:
He is the main protagonist of the anime and web manga series. He is in Nanba Prison on larceny charges. He is a skilled escape artist, that specializes in locks.

While his background has not been fully explored, it is shown in a flashback that as a baby he was born in a prison and he even states he feels most at home in prisons. He is also stated to have been arrested for larceny charges, but escaped the same day and has been arrested and escaped prisons the most out of his friends and is described by Hajime Sugoroku as the type of person who deserves to be in Nanba Prison in contrast to his

name: Hajime Sugoroku
description:
__Height:__ 199 cm / 6.5 ft

The head supervisor of Nanba Prison's Building 13.

name: Uno
description:
__Ethnicity:__ English
__Height:__ 177cm (5'10")
__Occupation:__ Inmate
__ID Number:__ 1311
__Building:__ 13
__Cell:__ 13

He is one of the main protagonists of the anime and web manga series. He is in Nanba Prison for frequenting underground casinos and is a compulsive gambler.

He was arrested for illegal gambling in underground casinos and sent to juvy. However, he would escape every time he had a date, but lately has not had a date and thus lost his motivation to escape. At some point while being arrested, he became close friends with Jyugo and the two even traveled together to Las Vegas,

name: Rock
description:
__Nationality:__ American
__Height:__ 186cm (6'1")
__Occupation:__ Inmate
__ID Number:__ 1369
__Building:__ 13
__Cell:__ 13

He is one of the main protagonists of the anime and web manga series. He is in Nanba Prison for starting a gang riot in a city.

Born to a wealthy family, Rock rejected his dad as his dad wanted Rock to be like him. Running away from home, Rock was arrested and sent to juvenile hall for starting a gang riot, but escaped because the food was terrible. Rock was then arrested once again and was sent to prison, only to again escape due to the terrible food.

At an unknown po

name: Alicia
description: One of the thirteen heroes who set out to slay the lord of Dark Beasts, [Clevatess](https://anilist.co/character/339319/Clen). She was bestowed the sacred treasure "Rock Swallow" by [King Haiden](https://anilist.co/character/359337/Haiden-Ou). She is the daughter of the hero [Margo](https://anilist.co/character/366646/Margo-Glenfall), who was once granted the title of "Sword Saint."

name: Clen
description:
One of the Four Great Demon Beast Kings, he dwells upon the Moon Mountain of the South. He is also known as "Clevatess of the Moonlight." He possesses a massive, jet-black body resembling that of a wolf, with a single long horn protruding from his forehead and seven sharp tails.

Deeming that he could not walk the human world while retaining his colossal form, Clevatess assumed a human guise. It is modeled after the appearance of the pageboy who entrusted him [Luna](https://anilist.co/character/355949/Luna).

name: Luna
description: A newborn infant entrusted to [Clevatess](https://anilist.co/character/339319/Clen), who had attacked Hiderat, the capital of the steel nation of Hiden, by a dying page. He is a pure-blooded Hidenean and holds the right to the Hiden throne.

name: Roberto De Niro
description: A middle-ranking reporter for Bernardelli News Agency. Travels with Meryl as her educator. He is a drunkard who loves sake and is aloof, but he is a veteran who has overcome many battles.

name: Takao
description: President of the "real" Game Creation Club with no known first name. Friends with Roka, even though she left and started her own Game Creation Club on negative terms. Others in the school refer to Takao as a "Boobs" elemental in later chapters due to their large size and amount of times they affect other people. She has feelings for Kazama. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Chitose Karasuyama
description: A second-year and the Student Council President. Her authority is so great even the teachers fear her. Her element is "Earth", and her main combat method includes punching her opponent, throwing dirt at them, or digging traps. She also has a habit of burying her victims up to the neck. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kenji Kazama
description: An 'infamous' delinquent at Fujou High. Unlike the members of his gang, he possesses no special or remarkable traits other than his hard spiky hair and his straight man ability. He is also a member of the Game Production Club (Temp), after he was coerced into it by the other 4 original members.   He has a desire to be the strongest at the school, but constantly wonders why the girls are much more stronger; and why the guys are usually freaks.

name: Sakura Mizukami
description: A first-year and a pink-haired tomboy. Her element is "Water", and she carries around a water bottle at all times. Her combat method includes pouring water on her hands, or forcing water down an opponent's throat. She later starts referring Kenji as her big brother, while Noe as her little sister, despite the denial from both. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Roka Shibasaki
description: The president of the Game Creation Club (Provisional). She refers her element as "Fire", but later states that her true element is actually "Darkness." Her main combat method is putting a bag over her opponents' head, rendering them blind, hence the darkness element. She carries a lot of spare bags so she can use them anytime. Despite having a small profile, she is referred as "Strongest Darkness" and is the strongest in school. She refers Kenji as her "important person", and shows jealousy when other girls approach him. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Anna Sasaki
description: Anna Sasaki is the introverted core protagonist of the Japanese animated film, When Marnie Was There by Hiromasa Yonebayashi. Anna has short brown hair and blue eyes. She typically dresses in tan shorts, blue sneakers, and a two-shades of blue t-shirt. At the Tanabata festival, she wears a pink kimono.

name: Marnie
description:
Marnie was raised in the Marsh House when she was growing up. 

She was often mistreated by the maids while her parents were out. Eventually she met a man named Kazuhiko. Kazuhiko and Marnie spent a lot of time together, often sneaking out. One day, Kazuhiko and Marnie went to the silo that Marnie was deeply afraid of, due to the maids' usage of the location to secretly abuse her. She nearly died while in the silo, before Kazuhiko saved her.

name: Sousuke Yamazaki
description: He is the butterfly and freestyle swimmer on Samezuka Academy's swim team and a 3rd year high school student at Samezuka Academy. Sosuke is a close elementary school friend of Rin Matsuoka, and the person who understands him the most.

name: Dr. Xeno
aliases: Xeno Houston Wingfield (ゼノ・ヒウストン・ウィングフィールド)
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Scientist and leader of the American Colony. Similar to Senku, Xeno is brilliant when it comes to science. He is very observant, somewhat eccentric, and has a penchant for stating the word "Elegant."

name: Stanley Snyder
native: スタンリー・スナイダー
description: Stanley is a tall, well-built man with very feminine facial features.

name: Mitsuyoshi Tada
description: He is in his second year at the Ginga University Affiliated Koinohoshi High School. He wants to become a photographer just like his late father, and is working at Tada Coffee Shop, which is run by his grandfather. He is a part of the photography club at school, and his specialty is atmospheric pictures. He doesn't talk much, but he is a kind boy who works very hard and cares for his friends. Those around him sometimes envy him, because he is always himself and very attentive to his surroundings. He lives with his grandfather, his sister [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/125339/Tada-Yui), and

name: Teresa Wagner
description:
A student from the European country of Luxembourg. She is a beautiful girl with blonde hair and bright, jade-like green eyes. She has a bubbly and honest personality, and always has a bright smile on her face. She loves a Japanese historical drama called "Rainbow Shogun" and even though she is really good with Japanese, she sometimes ends up using samurai language. She is living together with [Alexandra](https://anilist.co/character/125337/Magritte-Alexandra), who is also a fellow exchange student and they also like to spend a lot of time together.

She is the princess of Luxembourg.

name: Kirie Goshima
description: Kirie Goshima, a schoolgirl in the town of Kurouzucho, becomes concerned with her boyfriend Shuichi Saito’s father who has become obsessed with collecting and staring at spiral patterns to the ignorance of all else. After Shuichi’s father kills himself inside a washing machine, his cremated remains hang over the town in a giant cloud. The obsessive behaviour starts to spread to Kirie’s father and others, while all around the town people start bodily mutating into spiral creatures.

name: Shuuichi Saitou
description: Shuichi is Kirie's boyfriend. He is the only one who feels and understands the fact that the town is cursed by the spiral.

name: Afro Samurai
description: The holder of the title "Number Two," Afro is out to hunt down Justice, the man who killed his father for the rank of "Number One." From the time he was a child, Afro honed his skills as a swordsman; his style typically consists of wielding his sword with only his right hand while his left continues to hold on to his sheath, although during his fight with Jinno, he held his sword with both hands to compensate for Jinno's dual wielding speed. He is a very quiet individual, likely because the life of the "Number Two" does not allow him to have any close relationships with anyone, so when approac

name: Sueharu Maru
description: Sueharu Maru was originally a very famous child actor, and his mother was also one. However, his mother couldn't express emotions well, so she couldn't become very famous. She supported her son so he could become a fantastic actor for both her and his sake. He likes Shirokusa Kachi and he's a fan of her. Kuroha Shida is Sueharu's childhood friend.

appearsIn.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose

name: Kuroha Shida
description:
Sueharu's childhood friend. She also lives next door to Sueharu and is the eldest of the 4 sisters in her family.
She likes Sueharu and has a crush on him.

appearsIn.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose

name: Shirokusa Kachi
description: A child novelist who has received well-known awards at a very young age for her astounding works. She is Sueharu's first love interest.

appearsIn.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose

name: Maria Momosaka
description: A famous child actor who worked with Sueharu in the past.

appearsIn.title: Osamake: Romcom Where The Childhood Friend Won't Lose

name: Uramichi Omota
description:
**Height:** 175 cm (5'9)

He works as an exercise instructor (or gymnastics teacher) for the educational TV program "Together with Mama". The characters of his name implies that he is two-faced.

He was among one of the elites in Nippon Sport Science University, which is known for its many famous athletes.

When he has some free time after work, he enjoys taking some time to relax his muscles because it makes him forget about his problems, otherwise he "drops dead".

name: Iketeru Daga
description:
**Height:** 184 cm (6")
**Smoker:** His body can't handle it
**Alcohol:** Incredibly weak

One of the song instructors along with Tadano Utano. His name is a pun meaning "But I'm handsome".
Former musical actor with a beautiful voice and a face that girls can't resist.
He loves low level puns, he can't read between the lines or take a hint. He can't even read a clock.
He has an obsession over food, making him think about food constantly.

name: Utano Tadano
description:
**Height**: 162 cm (5'3")

One of the song instructors along with Daga Iketeru. Her name is a pun meaning "Just a singer".

Former washed up pop idol, then cover singer, then Jazz singer at a nightclub. She graduated from an elite music school, but because of bad luck or poor timing, her career got unstable.

She's been living together with her comedian boyfriend for 6 years and constantly talks about marriage.

name: Tobikichi Usahara
description:
**Height:** 182 cm (6')

He wears the costume of a rabbit while on stage. He is the target of Uramichi's stress, and as such, Usahara fears him. Because of his fear of Uramichi, Usahara makes sure to avoid eye contact with him by not removing his mask often. Usahara gossips about Uramichi behind his back and once he notices Uramichi around him, he freezes in fear. His partner, Mitsuo Kumatani, often tells Uramichi what Usahara thinks of him and this frustrates Usahara of how easily Mitsuo can betray him. Regardless, he still drinks out with Uramichi and Kumatani and often visits Uramichi's hom

name: Mitsuo Kumatani
description:
**Height:** 176 cm (5'8")
**Smoker**: Quit
**Drinker:** Yes (High tolerance)

He wears the costume of a bear while on stage.

name: Chinatsu Hiyama
description:
Chinatsu Hiyama is one of the main characters in the series.

Chinatsu has long orange-red hair that reaches mid-torso, and pink eyes. She is slender and tall, once mentioning that if she wore high heels she would probably be taller than Tatara.

name: Tatara Fujita
description: A third year middle school student living a quiet boring life and getting bullied by the upperclassmen. He then meets Kaname Sengoku and gets dragged into trying ballroom dancing. He soon fall in love with ballroom dancing after watching a video of Kaname Sengoku at a tournament and winning it. He aspires to become a professional ballroom dancer.

name: Shizuku Hanaoka
description: A third year student who is studying ballroom dancing at Ogasawara Dance Studio. She aims to be a professional dancer. She is good enough to beat most cheap professional dancers.

name: Kiyoharu Hyoudou
description: He is a third year junior high student and is studying dancing at Ogasawara Dance Studio. He won the JDSF Grand Prix and ranked first in the 'latin' and 'standard' division.

name: Yukari Akiyama
description:
**Height:** 157 cm (5'2")
**Home Town:** Tsuchiura, Ibaraki Prefecture

A member of Anko Team, and the loader of the Team. She gets overly excited when she sees or hears anything about tanks - to put it, she is a tank otaku. Yukari has had a deep love for all things tanking and WW2 since a young age. She collects tank models and frequently utilizes WW2-era equipment whenever possible. She uses her knowledge of tanks to help the team.  She has a deep respect and admiration of overall tank commander [Miho](https://anilist.co/character/62939/Miho-Nishizumi), going as far to refer to her as "Nishi

name: Mako Reizei
description:
**Height:** 145 cm (4'9")
**Home Town:** Ooarai, Ibaraki Prefecture

A member of Anko Team and is the team's driver. She is a quiet and gloomy girl who falls easily asleep, and hates mornings. She is also weak to certain conditions.

She is late to school everyday but is top of the class and can learn things almost instantly just by reading. She is a genius with a high level grade performance. But, due to her habitual tardiness in the morning she has insufficient credits, and so in exchange for credits, she is pursuing Sensha-do. She is childhood friends with [Saori Takebe](https://anilist.co/

name: Miho Nishizumi
description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")
**Home Town:** Kumamoto City, Kunamoto Prefecture

She was born into the distinguished family of the Nishizumi Style of Sensha-do, but she changed schools to Ooarai Girls Academy intending to run away from Sensha-do.   However, perplexingly enough, she was extorted into joining Sensha-do by the student council. She's a second-year and considers her friend's feelings more than anyone else. She has traumatic memory of tanks because of an incident that happened during her past with a tank. She's Ankou Team's Commander and is Ooarai's De Facto captain.   

Miho has a poli

name: Saori Takebe
description:
**Height:** 157 cm (5'2")
**Home Town:** Ooarai, Ibaraki Prefecture

Hana's friend and the other girl who befriended Miho during the first day of school. She is a social butterfly and is incredibly talkative. She yearns for a love that will love everything in the world, despite never being in a relationship before. She thought she would be popular among boys if she took Sensha-do. She is a member of the Ankou Team and serves as the Radio Operator and machine gunner. She also acts as a big sister for the Rabbit team comprised of the freshman. She sometimes calls [Miho](https://anilist.co/charac

name: Hana Isuzu
description:
**Height:** 163 cm (5'4")
**Home Town:** Mito, Ibaraki Prefecture

A member of Anko Team and the Team's gunner. A beautiful girl who has a gentle and composed demeanor, and is the other girl alongside Saori who befriended Miho during the first day. She was born into a home that had mastered the art of flower arrangement, but having felt dissatisfaction with this way of life, as a genuine Ojou-sama she chose Shensha-do instead.   
 She is disowned by her mother because of her decision to pursue Sensha-do instead of flower arrangement, but eventually, her mother reconciles with her after seeing

name: Lisara Restall
description:
__Race:__ Shinigami  

The heroine of the story and a beautiful Goddess of Death, who has came to the human world to find the ''Singular Man''. Ryosuke first encounters her when he sees her drenched in the rain.  She later makes a contract with Ryosuke, and tries to take away his perverted spirit.

name: Quele Sellier
description: Lisara's distant cousin and another Grim Reaper. She calls Lisara "Onee-sama" despite not being her sister. She made a contract with Mina as her energy source to both Ryosuke's and Lisara's dismay. Wields a gladius called "Carnun Solace".  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Iria Fukumune
description:
Lisara's rival Grim Reaper during her school years at Grimwald who is also a famous pop idol in the human world. Despite being 2nd in the school (1st being Lisara), she has the biggest bust size of the main cast (92.5cm). However, her large breasts are revealed to be a result of infusing breast pads with magic, and her actual bust size is smaller than Lisara's. Her weapon, "Froddy," is a falchion.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ryosuke Kaga
description: The main protagonist of the story who lost his perverted spirit to Lisara, and now struggles to regain that spirit back. Ryosuke cannot enjoy himself while living with the Death Goddess Lisara under a contract, because he gave up his erotic spirit under the deal. He cannot get excitement from watching girls and wonders if his adolescent days are over. Also, he learns from Lisara, that he will die in three months and in return of his help, she will try to change his fate.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mina Okura
description: She is Ryosuke's childhood friend, who lives next door from him. She rather a good cook and she would often drop by Ryosuke's place to either fetch him or prepare his meal. She also has a large bust size which the latter would look at, from time to time.

name: Chaika Trabant
native: チャイカ・トラバント
description: Chaika is usually an optimistic girl that longs to help everyone, regardless of who they are. Her speech pattern differs from the rest of the characters and speaks in the "Laake" language fluently but to avoid confusion Chaika speaks the common tongue (the official language of the continent). However, because it is not her native tongue, Chaika's language fragmented and broken. Chaika is scared easily, as seen when Akari was telling them a scary rumor. Chaika can be very clumsy sometimes too.

name: Toru Acura
description:
The protagonist is a Saboteur from the village of Acura. He has dark hair and eyes, but in the anime he has dark blue hair. After the downfall of the Gaz Empire and the return of peace, he has lost his way of life. When introduced, he is jobless and poor, and initially mistaken by Chaika to be a bandit attempting to rob her. However they inadvertently encounter a man-eating Unicorn and they work together to defeat it.

He has the power of the mysterious Iron-Blood Form (also Iron-Blood Transformation) that when activated turn his hair red and cause crimson markings to appear on his body. He wi

name: Yuka Mochida
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7") 

Despite being a teenager, Yuka acts in a much younger manner than her age due to her being pampered by her parents. She tries to act like an adult in order to be taken more seriously by her peers, but her constant failures at doing so cause her to come across as even more immature. Her naivety makes her childlike innocence more apparent than most others trapped in Heavenly Host Elementary School, but it also makes her susceptible to being manipulated by the school's more ill-intentioned residents (humans and ghosts alike). It also makes her more psychologically vuln

name: Yui Shishido
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") 

Yui an English teacher and the homeroom teacher of Kisaragi Academy's high school class 2-9, and a victim trapped inside Heavenly Host Elementary School. She's very close to the students and everyone loves her.

name: Yoshiki Kishinuma
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5' 8")  

Giving off the aura of a delinquent, Yoshiki faced difficulty in school due to issues at home. At one point, Yoshiki considered getting himself expelled from Kisaragi Academy since he could not find a reason to continue attending if he had no interest. However, Ayumi changed Yoshiki's mind on the matter after standing up for him against their PE teacher Mikio Tsubota. Carrying over from his attitude at school, Yoshiki is prone to outbursts of frustration when faced with difficult situations. Though he often means well, his actions can appear cold or even selfish t

name: Seiko Shinohara
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")  

Seiko is an extremely cheerful and energetic girl who enjoys playing around with her friends. She often comes across as immature and crass, and makes over-the-top outbursts that surprise everyone around her, but her friends are able to put up with it.

name: Ayumi Shinozaki
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm (4'11") 

Ayumi is the representative of Class 2-9. She is a tough girl with a creepy personality when it comes to occult topics.

name: Sachiko Shinozaki
description:
Sachiko Shinozaki is a former student of Heavenly Host Elementary School, and one of the recorded victims of the 1973 serial kidnappings and murders at the school. Her ghost rules the multidimensional nexus where Heavenly Host exists, making her the main antagonist of the Corpse Party series.    

Sachiko was a student of Heavenly Host Elementary School in 1953. She witnessed the death of her mother Yoshie, a nurse at the school, after the school principal chased Yoshie into a stairwell where she slipped and fell to silence her over his attempts to rape her. Sachiko was subsequently murdered b

name: Naomi Nakashima
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")  

Naomi is generally a bright and cheerful, if stubborn, teenage girl. A tomboy, she often feels the need to take charge of everything she is involved with, which usually causes her to butt heads with Satoshi Mochida. This behavior hides a more "girlish" side to her that enjoys shopping and grooming herself like other average girls her age, which shows itself whenever she plays with her friend Seiko Shinohara. She also tends to let her emotions control her actions: when stressed, she is prone to acting like a spoiled child who whines, complains, and lashes out at eve

name: Satoshi Mochida
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5' 6")

A student from Kisaragi Academy's high school class 2-9. Satoshi is kindhearted by nature, often willing to go the extra mile for those he cares for. Ironically, Satoshi is also a bit of a coward, and was highly reluctant to take part in the ritual that placed him and his peers at Heavenly Host Elementary School. A bit of a blockhead, Satoshi is blissfully unaware of the crushes multiple girls in his group of peers have for him, which never sees further development as everyone becomes more preoccupied with surviving the horrors of Heavenly Host. Despite the grotesqu

name: Mayu Suzumoto
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'0")

Mayu is a member of drama club. Even though she seems much smaller than she is, Mayu have a great heart, in fact, thanks to her energetic nature, she is very popular between the students and she earned the nickname "Suzume". She is also the only one who can call Sakutaro with a nickname (namely Shige-nii).

name: Runa Shirakawa
description: Considered one of the school's most beautiful girls, Shirakawa is easygoing and friendly with most people, earning her even more popularity. Since she is so popular, bad rumors tend to go about her, like how she dates guys for two or three months at best, and how easily she switches from guy to guy at the drop of a hat. All those rumors are false though. Despite her gal appearance, Shirakawa is sincerely devoted to whoever she is dating (to the point of being called "Heavy" or "Annoying"). She reaches the point of putting her boyfriend's happiness first or enduring a lot to keep the relationsh

appearsIn.title: Our Dating Story: The Experienced You and The Inexperienced Me

name: Ryuuto Kashima
description: Kashima has admired Shirakawa since the first year and got the lucky break of moving to the same class as her during the second year, turning simple admiration into a one-sided crush. Kashima never hoped to get more than that and was happy with keeping the status quo.

appearsIn.title: Our Dating Story: The Experienced You and The Inexperienced Me

name: Lyrule
description: She is Winona's adoptive daughter. Tsukasa suspects Lyrule might hold the reason for their presence in the world.

appearsIn.title: High School Prodigies Have It Easy Even In Another World

name: Tsukasa Mikogami
description: Genius serving as the prime minister.

appearsIn.title: High School Prodigies Have It Easy Even In Another World

name: Tooru Kirishima
description: First lieutenant of the Sakuragi Family. Infamously known as "The Demon of Sakuragi".

name: Yaeka Sakuragi
description: The sole daughter of the Sakuragi family boss. A timid girl who struggles at expressing her emotions.

name: Remon Yamano
description:
__Height__: 139 cm (4'7")  
__Class__: 3rd Year  

A short, third year high school student with a petite appearance and a distinctive voice. She is generally cold towards people, but befriends Ichika when they first meet. She is good at picking locks and can be quite mischievous, such as when she makes the rest of the group drink an alcoholic drink, then records them sleeping. She seems devious, as though everything she does has an ulterior motive. Since she claims to have written a script for Lucas in Hollywood (implying George Lucas), she ends up being the writer for the group's movie. She t

name: Tetsurou Ishigaki
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'9")
__Class:__ 1st Year

A close, easygoing friend of Kaito and Tanigawa. He knows of her feelings for Kaito and encourages a relationship between the two. He seems to be an all-around savvy guy with females and is easily able to smooth-talk a female teacher into giving out Ichika's body measurements. He is known to be quite handsome in his class, even in the eyes of the teachers.

name: Kanna Tanigawa
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5')
__Class:__ 1st Year

[Kaito](https://anilist.co/character/47299/Kaito-Kirishima)'s classmate. She seems to have a crush on him, and gets jealous when he talks about other girls.

name: Mio Kitahara
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Class:__ 1st Year

A beautiful girl who is quite shy, but has pretty lewd thoughts sometimes. A good friend of Tanigawa. She has feelings for Tetsuro and her thoughts seem to innocently go in a sexual direction.

name: Kaito Kirishima
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Class:__ 1st Year

The main protagonist is a student in his first year of high school. He is an avid videographer, and is constantly out recording things. Others sometimes refer to him as "The Director". He's seemingly aware of Tanigawa's feelings for him, nonetheless he seems to have a genuine interest for Ichika. He has day dreams of conversing with Ichika and talks out loud sometimes during them. This may even lead to misunderstandings in a comical sense.

name: Ichika Takatsuki
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'3")
__Class:__ 3rd Year

A 3rd year student who stands out due to her red hair. The main female protagonist is an alien come to Earth who acts to save [Kaito](https://anilist.co/character/47299/Kirishima-Kaito) from the injuries he sustains when her ship crash-lands. Being an alien unaccustomed to life on Earth, her actions may seem weird in the eyes of others, but she is quick to correct herself, if only to hide the fact that she's an alien. She is kind, polite, friendly and a good cook. Like her "best friend" [Remon Yamano](https://anilist.co/character/47297/Yamano-Remo

name: Fudou Aikawa
description: Fudo Aikawa is the main character of the manga Love After World Domination. He is the Red Gelato and leader of the hero squad Gelato 5. He is also the strongest member among them.

name: Desumi Magahara
description: Desumi Magahara is the deuteragonist of the manga Love After World Domination. She is a beautiful high school student, with blond hair and green eyes, her Gekko Battle Gear is a kind of erotic black demon-style outfit with bunny-like ears. Ever since young, her strength has been remarkable. It is so incomprehensible that she managed to close down a dojo unintentionally after defeating a dojo master there. Her family have some past and connections with Gekko, hence getting her involved with them despite not wanting to.

name: Yuuji
description: A former office worker who was forcefully summoned to another world and gained the Class of "Tamer" and "Sage".

appearsIn.title: My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World!
My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World!
KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World
KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World

name: Yami Yuugi
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5')

Yami no Yuugi is the spirit residing in the Milennium Puzzle. After a historic battle against Zorc Necrophadius, he had sealed his soul along with Zorc in order to save Egypt. However, he had lost his memory as a result.

3,000 (5,000 in the dub) years later, [Yuugi Mutou](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi), after trying to solve the puzzle for eight years, awakens Yami no Yuugi from his slumber, although Yugi does not realize this until much later in the story, more specifically, Duelist Kingdom.

At the end of Duelist Kingdom, he asks Yugi to help him rec

name: Yami Bakura
description: The strange dark spirit that lies inside the Millennium Ring. He searches for all the other Millennium items. Although the purpose is unknown, it's obvious that the intent is pure evil. When in full possession of Bakura's body, he is capable of invoking many magical powers of the Shadow Realm into this world. The spirit has linked itself through the Millennium Ring to Bakura and is able to return itself to Bakura even if discarded or lost.    He's the main arch enemy of Yami Yugi. He holds a 5,000 year old grudge with Yami Yugi which he never reveals.    Yami Bakura uses an occu

name: Hiroto Honda
description: Another one of Yugi's friends. Honda used to bully Yugi with Jounouchi. He never understood Yugi's fashination with games but he was able to understand the feelings of others. Honda always helps Jounouchi or Yugi when they are in need. He's a friend to the end.

name: Katsuya Jonouchi
description: Jonouchi is [Yugi](https://anilist.co/character/1374)'s best friend. At the beginning Jonouchi used to bully Yugi but after being saved by Yugi from an even more of a dangerous thug, Jonouchi has been pals with Yugi ever since. Jonouchi likes to hang around with Yugi and learns a lot of new games. He's not always confident that he'll win his games but he always tries his best. He enters the Duelist Kingdom Tournament to get money for his sister, [Shizuka](https://anilist.co/character/5989), who is losing her eyesight. He wants to use the money for her surgery.

name: Seto Kaiba
description:
__Height:__ 186 cm

Seto Kaiba is the majority shareholder and President of his own multi-national company, KaibaCorp, who aims to become the world's greatest player of the Duel Monsters card game. To accomplish this goal, he must defeat his arch-rival, [Yugi Muto](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi).

He is largely considered an anti-hero, as his motives are usually ego-centric, but in several cases towards a good cause. Among one of the recurring plots in Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters is Seto Kaiba being forced to deal with either people adversely affected by Gozaburo Kaiba's actions wa

name: Anzu Mazaki
description:
Anzu is the childhood friend of [Yugi Mutou](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi). She becomes a good friend to [Katsuya Jonouchi](https://anilist.co/character/1377/Jonouchi-Katsuya) and [Hiroto Honda](https://anilist.co/character/1380/Honda-Hiroto), though she is not fond of them at first. 

In the first series anime, Miho Nosaka is also one of Anzu's friends. Anzu does not usually play games with Yugi and his friends, though she is once shown beating Jonouchi. In the manga, especially in the beginning, Anzu has a spunky, tomboyish personality, and in the first chapter, frightens Ho

name: Yuugi Mutou
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

Yugi Mutou is the main protagonist of Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters. At the start of the series, he is a shy boy who is really short for his age, something he always gets teased about in school. For this reason, he was always alone. However, his grandfather gives him the Millennium Puzzle prior to the story's time line and Yugi is told that if he solved it, one wish of his could be granted. He manages to solve the Millennium Puzzle and he asks for friends and his wish is immediately granted. He also awakens the spirit residing in the Puzzle, but Yugi is not aware of this u

name: Ryou Bakura
description: Bakura Ryou is a classmate and friend of [Yugi Muto](https://anilist.co/character/1374/Mutou-Yuugi). [Yami Bakura](https://anilist.co/character/1489/Yami-Bakura) is his other self, released from the power of the Millennium Ring. The two rarely directly converse. Unlike the close, cooperative relationship between Yugi Muto and [Yami Yugi](https://anilist.co/character/1375/Yami-Yuugi), Yami Bakura is a malignant entity that completely suppresses Bakura's spirit when he takes him over.

name: Mamako Oosuki
description: Mamako is a beta tester in the MMORPG alongside her son, [Masato Oosuki](https://anilist.co/character/141135/Oosuki-Masato) who she is overprotective of. She is a very powerful adventurer, to the point that Masato often questions his role as the hero.

appearsIn.title: Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks?
Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks?

name: Ran
description:
Ran is this generation's Prophet in Gabe and, therefore, she has the ability to see into the future. She goes every now and then into Lux to sell flowers, but recently she seems to just follow people around. She takes special interest in Ichise and helps him escape from the sewers when Isshii's men throw him down there.    

She acts as a kind of restraint for Ichise while he learned how to use his Texhnolyze better.

name: Ichise
description: One of our protagonists. When he was younger, his father, Ikuse, was killed for what Ichise believes was betraying his friends. A short time after, his mother also died.
