All he was left with was a vial that contained some of his mother's cells. Soon after, he began his life as a fighter in an underground arena, and proved to be quite formidable.  Ichise is very quiet and rarely speaks. He has an odd tendency to go berserk at very inopportune times. Whenever something has angered him, he channels nearly all his energy in an effort to destroy whatever it is that has crossed him. Throughout the c

name: Shinji
description: Shinji is Lakan's leader. He believes in the free will of people and that is what his group is based on. He is rather carefree, but believes very strongly in his ideals. He's basically a younger, rasher Oonishi, and could probably be considered the third protagonist of the series.    His best friend is Haru and his girlfriend is Yoko. However, Yoko and Haru are also intimate with each other; Shinji explains that since their group is based on free will, it's up to Yoko to decide what she wants to do.  He first takes Yoshii in near the start of the series when some of his guys get their asses ki

name: Keigo Oonishi
description: Oonishi is the leader of Organ and one of our protagonists.     When he was younger, he was somewhat tricked into selling his legs to Kanno. His legs were replaced with Texhnolyze legs that allow him to hear the 'voice of the city', which are visions the Mothers send to him about things that will happen in Lux.    Most of the main council of Organ had some kind of qualm with Oonishi, first and foremost being his passive nature. Even on the battlefield, he prefers to not kill his opponents. In the office, he believes in talking things over first before starting an unnecessary war. Thi

name: Kotori Iida
description: A lonely high schooler and student of [Kohei](https://anilist.co/character/89273/Inuzuka-Kohei) who gives Kohei the address to her mother's restaurant and ends up asking him to make meals and eat them with her (along with [Tsumugi](https://anilist.co/character/89272/Inuzuka-Tsumugi)). She is a shy, lonely girl whose mother is a good cook but is so busy she rarely has time for her daughter. Her parents divorced when she was in third grade. She is kind and gets along well with Tsumugi. She is a bad cook, partially because of having a large fear of knives. She has a large appetite.

name: Tsumugi Inuzuka
description: Kohei's adorable daughter who attends kindergarten. Though energetic, she is well-behaved and loves her father dearly. She always thinks of him and begins to truly enjoy eating when her father and Kotori start making meals together. She has large fluffy hair and is a fan of magical girls. She likes meat, particularly hamburger steak, and doesn't like green peppers.

name: Kohei Inuzuka
description: The single father of Tsumugi. His wife died of unknown illness and he is currently doing his best to take care of his daughter. He is a math teacher at Kotori's school. He currently works hard with Kotori to become a good cook to make his daughter happy. The three often hang out at Kotori's place and eat meals together. He is a bit plain and wears glasses, but is a very kind hearted and hard working person whose daughter is his life.

name: Petralka Anne Eldant III
native: ペトラルカ・アン・エルダント三世
description:
Emperess of the Holy Eldant Empire. She's proactive and brimming with curiosity, so she's curious about importing Otaku culture and proactive in supporting Shinichi. 

(Source: ANN)

name: Myucel Foaran
native: ミュセル・フォアラン
description:
A Half-Elf in the Holy Eldant Empire, currently serving as Shinichi's maid. She is naturally adept at learning and is able to quickly pick up on the written language of Japanese through Shinichi's tuition. 

She is also said to be proficient at offensive magic during her time at the military camp as stated by Bluk.

name: Shinichi Kanou
description:
The protagonist of this story. He decides to look for a job in order to escape the hikkikomori lifestyle he'd fallen into after entering high-school, but as a result he ends up employed in spreading Otaku culture for the “Holy Eldant Empire”, a fantasy world that's mysteriously connected to Japan. He's a hardcore otaku who's true and honest to his interests.

(Source: ANN)

name: Bocchan
description:
He is the firstborn of his noble family, and was considered to be the next head of his family until he was ostracized and cast out of his family for being cursed.

As the single possessor of a curse that allows him to unintentionally kill any living thing with a single touch, he lives alone in a decrepit mansion located deep within a forest with his servants, [Alice](https://anilist.co/character/132921/Lendrott-Alice) and [Rob](https://anilist.co/character/132924/Rob).

appearsIn.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid
The Duke of Death and His Maid

name: Alice Lendrott
native: アリス・レンドロット
description: Alice is a maid who assists the protagonist of the story, [Duke](https://anilist.co/character/132920/Bocchan), with his daily life. She is responsible for maintaining Duke's mansion and helping him with his day-to-day functions along with the family butler, [Rob](https://anilist.co/character/132924/Rob).

appearsIn.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid
The Duke of Death and His Maid

name: Jahy
description: Jahy was originally the Dark Realm's second-in-command. After the destruction of the Mana Crystals, however, she becomes a small and adorable girl! She works as a part-time waitress.

appearsIn.title: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!

name: Eri
description:
She is the girl that [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/270546/Itou-Yuuta) meets on the hospital roof where he was about to commit suicide.

She likes movies and chooses to exploit her passion to help Yuuta create a movie himself.

name: Yuuta Itou
description: A boy tasked to film his mother's disease battle.

name: Paul von Oberstein
native: パウル・フォン・オーベルシュタイン
description: Paul von Oberstein is a captain serving as chief of staff in fortress Iserlohn of the Galactic Empire. He was born blind and has to wear artificial eyes to see. He has nothing but contempt for his incompetent commander and despises the high nobles, realizing fully well the decadence of the Goldenbaum dynasty and how ignorant they are of the common people’s plight. If he himself had been born a few years earlier, when the “inferior genes exclusion law” was still in effect, he would have been discarded as dangerous to the species. Because of that and realizing Reinhard’s abilities, he wants to j

name: Wolfgang Mittermeyer
native: ウォルフガング・ミッターマイヤー
description: Wolfgang Mittermeyer is a rear admiral serving in Reinhard’s fleet and, along with Oskar von Reuenthal, Reinhard’s ablest field commander.   Mittermeyer is a commoner, born to a middle-class family. He first met Reuenthal while stationed in fortress Iserlohn, early in his career, and the two became close friends. Kind and caring, Mittermeyer has been a stabilizing factor for Reuenthal’s self-destructive tendencies ever since. A family man at heart Mittermeyer soon married his childhood sweetheart Evangeline and became a dedicated husband, but their efforts to have children have been fruitless

name: Dusty Attenborough
native: ダスティ・アッテンボロー
description:
**Rank:** Commander, later Commodore 
**Occupation:** Advisor, later Squadron Commander Group Affiliation: Free Planets Alliance 	 
**Base of Operations:** Flagship Patoroklos (2nd Fleet); Battleship Triglav (13th Fleet) Marital Status: Divorced 	 
**Known Relatives:** Patrick (father), unnamed ex-wife 	 
**First Appearance:** MOVIE "My Conquest is the Sea of Stars" (as Commander), Book 2: "Ambition" (Novels) 	 
**Hair:** Blue/Black (Golden Wings OAV: Blond) 	 

Dusty first met Yang Wen-Li at the military academy in 785UC, and they have been friends ever since.  First Lieutenant Dusty Attenbor

name: Julian Mintz
description: Julian Mintz is the son of a soldier who served in the Alliance’s army, he lost his mother at a very young age and, some years later, his father was killed in battle leaving him a war-orphan. As such Julian was admitted in the wartime welfare program and, through the mediation of vice admiral Alex Cazellnu, he was made Yang Wenli’s ward.  Julian is a very intelligent and responsible boy with a knack for house chores and is the one who takes care of the domestically incompetent Yang, so much so that their friends often wonder who amongst the two is the real guardian and who the ward

name: Hildegard von Mariendorf
native: ヒルデガルド・フォン・マリーンドルフ
description: Birthdate: 468 R.C. (777 U.C.)  Hildegard von Mariendorf is one of the principal characters in the series. She served as the New Galactic Fleet's Chief Advisor  She later reigned with Reinhard von Lohengramm when she became his wife and Empress in U.C. 801.  Hildegard, usually referred to by the nickname Hilda, was born in Galactic year 777 into an distinguished noble family of the Goldenbaum dynasty, the sole daughter of the benevolent and just Count Franz von Mariendorf. From an early age, she was distinguished from the other girls of the aristocrat society by her independent ideas. Complete

name: Wenli Yang
description:
Yang Wenli is a commodore, currently serving in the 2nd fleet of the Free Planets Alliance.

The son of a merchant and a pacifist at heart, Yang never wanted to be a soldier, his dream was to become a historian, but he didn’t have the money to pay for his tuition and joined the army to get a scholarship. He barely made it through the officer’s academy due to his lack of interest, though he did make a number of friends there including [Dusty Attenborough](https://anilist.co/character/3869) and [Jean Robert Lap](https://anilist.co/character/24155). He also met music student [Jessica Edwards](htt

name: Siegfried Kircheis
native: ジークフリード・キルヒアイス
description: Siegfried Kircheis was an Imperial high admiral who was most notable for his role as the best friend and personal confidant of [Reinhard von Lohengramm](https://anilist.co/character/3066/Reinhard-von-Lohengramm) since childhood, who later became his top admiral. Often referred to as Reinhard's "shadow," Lohengramm viewed Kircheis as a part of himself. Kircheis was frequently present with Reinhard throughout their military career while rising through the ranks of the Imperial Fleet, following him from assignment to assignment, before reaching the admiral ranks himself in 796 UC. Although some r

name: Oskar von Reuenthal
native: オスカー・フォン・ロイエンタール
description: Oskar von Reuenthal is a rear admiral serving in Reinhard’s fleet and, along with Wolfgang Mittermeyer, Reinhard’s ablest field commander. He was born to a lowly, but rich noble father and a mother from a distinguished but impoverished line that only married his father for his material affluence. Reuenthal was born with a rare condition called heterochromia, one of his eyes is blue, while the other is brown. Since both his parents had blue eyes, this was seen as proof of his mother’s adultery. His mother committed suicide after trying to pluck out his brown eye while he was still an infant. Re

name: Frederica Greenhill
native: フレデリカ・グリーンヒル
description: Frederica Greenhill first met Yang during the evacuation of El Facil. She joined the military to find him again and was assigned as his adjutant.

name: Reinhard von Lohengramm
native: ラインハルト・フォン・ローエングラム
description:
Count Reinhard von Lohengramm is a young admiral in the Galactic Empire.

He was born Reinhard von Müsel to an impoverished aristocratic family. His mother died when he was very young and he only has faint memories of her. His father's will was shattered at about the same time and the only person left to care for young Reinhard was his beloved older sister [Annerose](https://anilist.co/character/13100/von-Grnewald-Annerose). When Reinhard was about ten years old, his family had to move into a middle class suburban neighborhood. There he met [Siegfried Kircheis](https://anilist.co/character/125

name: Cain von Silford
native: カイン・フォン・シルフォード
description: An average Japanese teenager with very little going on in his life in the past, and the third son of a noble family with a strong fixation with fantasy and high talents in magic and swordsmanship in the present - Cain is a carefree individual who likes taking things at his own pace. Despite being an aristocrat, he doesn't evaluate people by their status and often hates when others start abusing their titles, showing his cheeky side when necessary. While he knows it's better to hide his true powers, his ardent temperament often takes better of him, resulting into all kinds of troubles and funny

Chronicles of an Aristocrat Reborn in Another World

name: Honoka Takamiya
description:
Honoka Takamiya (多華宮　仄 Takamiya Honoka?) is the male protagonist of the story. He is a second year student and the new student council president of Tougetsu Academy.

(Source: Witchcraft Works Fandom)

name: Ayaka Kagari
description: The female protagonist of the series. She is known as "Princess" by many female students due to her intelligence and high grades, which makes her the most popular girl at Tougetsu Academy. Ayaka is Kazane Kagari’s foster daughter, the chairwoman of the school who also happens to be head of "Workshop Witches."

name: Kogarashi Fuyuzora
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'9")

The main protagonist of Yuragi-sou no Yuuna-san. A skillful psychic who banishes spirits through his punches. He is poor and used to be homeless before arriving at Yuragi Inn.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Chisaki Miyazaki
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

A girl who befriends [Kogarashi](https://anilist.co/character/126834/Fuyuzora-Kogarashi) after meeting him during the first day of high school. She is also a popular girl at school, known for her beauty.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Chitose Nakai
description:
__Height:__ 135 cm (4'5")

A zashiki-warashi who is the caretaker of the Yuragi Inn. She has the power to manipulate the fortune of others, but she rarely uses it because of its potential consequences.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Yuuna Yunohana
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

Yuuna is a ghost who is bound to the Yuragi Inn. She has no recollection of her life when she was alive and asks for Kogarashi's assistance in helping her discover who she was, developing an attachment to him in the process.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Sagiri Ameno
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

A ninja from the Chuuma Village. She hails from the Ameno house, a clan specializing in the art of demon slaying. She is dedicated to her duty as a ninja, spending time going on missions to destroy harmful supernatural creatures. 

As a result of her upbringing, she has a stern personality and is often flustered when someone compliments her appearance.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Oboro Shintou
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm (4'11")

The chief retainer and the older half-sister of Genshiro Ryuga, the Black Dragon God. She is a stoic woman who moves into the Yuragi Inn after being impressed by Kogarashi's strong physical and spiritual prowess. Her motivation to moving in is to preserve her family's bloodline by attempting to seduce Kogarashi. As she continues on this plan and interacting with the fellow tenants, she begins to display emotion and genuine romantic feelings. She and her brother have the ability to manipulate their arms into blades.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Yaya Fushiguro
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

A timid girl who acts as a vessel for a cat god. She exhibits catlike behavior as well as having cat ears and a tail when she is possessed by it. Through their bond, she is able to call on its power whenever it is needed, and she can also warp in more cat gods through her body.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Nonko Arahabaki
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'8")

An oni who works as a manga author. She loves to drink alcohol, and as she becomes more intoxicated, her power as an oni grows. She is formerly a member of the Yoinozaka (宵ノ坂 Yoinozaka) family, one of the three great families in Japan, but left the clan and pursued her passion.

appearsIn.title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs
Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs

name: Koyuzu Shigaraki
description:
__Height:__ 125 cm (4'1")

As he accompanies Ringo in her stalking activities, the two of them develop a strange closeness.

After being discharged from the hospital, she loses consciousness and dies at a trip to the aquarium. She is revived by a penguin hat bought at the aquarium's souvenir shop. When she wears the penguin hat, her appearance and personality changes to that of a dominatrix, donning a skintight costume and ordering the brothers to obtain the Penguindrum in order to extend her life.

The more serious and colder of the twins. He takes his duty to obtain the Penguin Drum seriously, willing to resort to any method to obtain it, whether legal or not.

He has red hair and is more popular with girls than his brother. He has a past history as a playboy, dating girls only to dump them later on, causing some heartbroken girls to join forces to take revenge on him. Kanba seems to actually harbor feelings for [Himari](https://anilist.co/character/43009/Takakura-Himari). She started to believe that by turning herself into Momoka she could bring her family back together, often going to extreme lengths to have what is written there fulfilled.

She is unaware of this until Vincent sets free the Nanomachines on the Monorail and she survives. She meets Spike by chance when he infiltrates a bio weapon lab fronting as a pharmaceutical company where she works. After a few more chance meetings, and witnessing his being shot and thrown from a monorail by Vincent, she teams up with the crew of the Bebop to put an end to Vincent's intent to destroy the population of Mars. He was the only survivor in a field of test subjects, ergo, the vaccine only he carried was successful. He was abandoned to die on Titan by the government, but somehow survived and returned to civilization. He has also loved Electra very deeply, but has suffered amnesia from his ordeal and does not remember.  His plan is to release the virus throughout the world, leaving only a handful of survivors. Miyagi is a store clerk at a special store. She's the observer of [Kusunoki](https://anilist.co/character/132152/Kusunoki).

In the end, Miyagi sells her remaining lifespan so she and Kusunoki can have 3 days of life left. This releases her of her observer duty, making her visible to everyone.

Freya made her a challenge, telling her that she would help her if she won. He is easily recognisable through his bandaged left eye, his colorful  kimono, his eerie smile, and the pipe he is often seen smoking.

He now leads a radical Joui faction called the Kiheitai and is known amongst the Shinsengumi as 'the most dangerous man in both the Joui faction and amongst the radicals'.

He, Gintoki, and Katsura studied in the same temple elementary school when they were children, and he f

name: Rentt Faina
description: Rentt is a bronze-class adventurer who never managed to climb higher in the ranks in over 10 years. One day, he has an unfortunate run-in with a dragon and ends up being turned into a skeleton.

native: ロレーヌ・ヴィヴィエ
description: Lorraine Vivie is a genius scholar who studies monsters and magics.

name: Rina Rupaage
description: Rina Rupaage is a beginner adventurer from the capital city of Kingdom of Yaaran. She moved to Maalt Town for progressing her career as an adventurer and escaping from her personal issues.

name: Hikaru Kusakabe
description: A second year high school student. He's an average student but a talented musician. Very comfortable around people and usually speaks his mind.

name: Rihito Sajou
description: Rihito Sajou is an excellent student and he seems to have a high IQ although he works very hard to maintain his top grades. He doesn't actually reach out to people, so he doesn't have any friends until he meets Kusakabe.

name: Milo Nekoyanagi
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

A young doctor with outstanding medical skills who runs the Panda Clinic. He has pale blue hair and a panda-like birthmark around his left eye which causes him to be referred to as Panda.

name: Bisco Akaboshi
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Occupation:__ Mushroom Keeper

A mushroom protector with the nickname of "Man-Eating Mushroom" who is regarded as a terrorist and has a price on his head. He commands a giant crab named Actagawa that is also used as for transport.

name: Ao Horie
description: A quiet girl who has always kept to herself and studied, that is, until she gets dragged into Kijima's life. Between her perverted ero-artist father and her expectations built up from his publications, she often embarasses herself in front of Kijima. Her life is changing and she doesn't know how to cope in many ways, but she isn't exactly against it happening.

name: Takumi Kijima
description: A male student who confesses his feelings for Ao. Ao calls him “The Normie King.” Takumi is athletic and handsome. Ao thinks he’s a sexually experienced stud just trying to get in her panties, but he genuinely likes her. Because of this, he’s often nervous when they see each other. He is unaware that Ao’s father is a famous erotic author.

name: Akira Oda
description: Akira Oda is an ordinary high schooler. He lives with his sickly mother and sister. Each time the school ends, he goes to do part time odd jobs to fulfill his family's expenditure. One day, a king of Retice Kingdom from the world called Morigan has Akira and the classmates Summoned to the kingdom to defeat the demon king and protect them from the threat.

description:
Mash Kyrielight is a clerk at Chaldea and a Shielder-class Demi-Servant contracted with [Ritsuka Fujimaru](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka) in Fate/Grand Order. The title Demi-Servant indicates that she's a human bonded with a Heroic Spirit's Soul.


In the year 2000, Mash was created through artificial fertilization and genetic editing. She is actually a Designer Baby, a magus genetically engineered under the orders of Chaldea's late director, ‎[Marisbury Animusphere](https://anilist.co/character/147492/Animusphere-Marisbury), to be a prime vessel for a Heroic Spirit's so

name: Ritsuka Fujimaru
description:
Ritsuka Fujimaru is the protagonist of Fate/Grand Order, acting as the Master of many Servants for the purpose of solving the Grand Order conflicts. He has absolutely no background details or connections to other people or events. He is simply "someone who just happened to see a recruitment flyer at a station, applied and got accepted into the job, and somehow ended up getting taken into the Chaldea Security Organization.'' 

He is a rather mediocre magus with skills comparable to Lord El-Melloi II.
 
After the events of First Order, Ritsuka is the only magus available to tackle the Singularit

appearsIn.title: Fate/Grand Order Absolute Demonic Front: Babylonia

name: Hayato Kisaragi
description:
Hayato Kisaragi is the main protagonist of Hundred. He is the older brother of Karen Kisaragi originating from Yamato prior to the Second Attack, but later moved to Gudenburg due to their father's job where he befriended Emilia Hermit until his parents' death, then moved to an insitutute in Yamato. 

Hayato was later scouted to enroll in Little Garden with both his tuition waived and under a scholarship under the condition his little sister would receive the treatment she needed due to his high aptitude for a Hundred, as a result of him being a variant and become a first-year student in Bugeik

name: Emile Crossfode
native: エミール・クロスフォード
description:
Emilia Gudenburg is the main female protagonist in Hundred.

She is the third princess of the Gudenburg Empire.

Having snuck outside of the royal palace several times, Emilia befriended, Hayato Kisaragi under the alias of Emilia Hermit. During the Second Attack, she was turned into a variant after being attacked by a savage and was separated from Hayato.

She soon enrolled in Little Garden under the guise of a male student named Emile Crossfode where she had become the roommate of Hayato but was later removed after Claire found out she was a female.

name: Claire Harvey
description: Claire Harvey is one of the three main female protagonists of Hundred. She is the first daughter and second child of Bill and Linis Harvey, thus making her the little sister of Judal Harvey and older sister of Liza Harvey. After being admitted into Little Garden, she became the highest-ranked Slayer known as the Perfect Queen and Rose Guardian.

name: Akira Tsubaki
description: This story's main character.  Since he tasted Urabe's drool, the two have entered into a strange love relationship.  He's reached the age where he's just acquired some interest in the opposite sex, but every time he tries seizing the initiative in romancing the beautiful Urabe, he can never seem to make any progress in their relationship.

name: Mikoto Urabe
description:
**Class:** 2nd year of high school
**Height:** 162 cm (5'3")

Urabe Mikoto is a girl who enjoys cutting things with her "panty scissors", sleeping during class, and not associating with anyone other than her boyfriend and friend [Oka](https://anilist.co/character/14886/Oka-Ayuko). While quirky, Urabe is incredibly genuine and sincere to her beloved [Tsubaki](https://anilist.co/character/7088/Tsubaki-Akira).

name: Reona Kisaragi
description: Reona is the manager of the desolate game store Kisaragi. She is a beautiful woman with clear silver hair and a great sense of style, but she forcefully sells Hiroshi Yuuki the VRMMORPG game "Kiwame Quest".

appearsIn.title: Full Dive: This Ultimate Next-Gen Full Dive RPG Is Even Shittier than Real Life!

name: Hiroshi Yuuki
description: Hiroshi Yuuki, with the player name of Hiro, is a high school boy who loves to play virtual reality MMORPGs. When a game store manager named Reona Kisaragi forces him to buy the game Kiwame Quest, he soon discovers that it is not what it seems. Unlike regular games, it is a game that tries to pursue realism to a fanatical point. As such, Hiroshi struggles to eke out a niche. Along the way, he meets many girls who all want something from him.

appearsIn.title: Full Dive: This Ultimate Next-Gen Full Dive RPG Is Even Shittier than Real Life!

name: Charlotte Zenfis
native: シャルロッテ・ゼンフィス
description:
____Age____ 7 (Debut) 11 (Time Skip)
____Affiliation____ Camelot
____Aliases____ Weiss Owl

____Personality____
Charlotte is a curious individual, which led her to investigate [Haruto ](https://anilist.co/character/303772/Hart-Zenfis) and she noticed his odd behavior. While initially hesitant around Haruto, she grew to have immense faith in him and his abilities. Haruto introducing her to anime at a young age led to her becoming a chuunibiyo, a big fan of the magical girl genre, and imagining the capita was home to a massive conspiracy (which coincidentally turned out to be true).

name: Wendelin von Benno Baumeister
native: ヴェンデリン・フォン・ベンノ・バウマイスター
description: Poor son of a nobleman who lives in a remote area far from the royal capital. Formerly, Shingo Ichimiya, a salaryman who works for a food-related trading company, woke up after taking a nap and became a small child in a different world. Since he could not succeed to the territory, he was aiming for independence with one point that he was blessed with magical talent in the situation of being stuck.

name: Yuuki Anzai
description:
Anzai is the male protagonist of the Devils' Line series. He is a half-devil, half-human hybrid and a police officer who is a member of F Squad in the MPD Public Safety Division 5, responsible for combatting devil crimes. His occupation as a police officer utilizes his abilities as a hybrid.

Anzai was raised at ONLO orphanage in Hokkaido. He was a member of the 15th ONLO hybrid birth project along with [Johannes Kleeman](https://anilist.co/character/125057/Kleeman-Johannes), but was excluded from experimentation due to his weakened healing abilities. Despite spending his childhood believing h

name: Tsukasa Taira
description: Tsukasa is the female protagonist of the Devils' Line series. She is a first-year graduate student at Keio University where she originally studied Humanities and Geography. She is a kind-hearted human girl who falls in love with Yuuki Anzai at almost first sight. Despite the difficulties of being in a devil/human relationship, she stays positive and is always trying to make it work. She cares about Yuuki and his suffering as a devil very much and is constantly looking for something she can do.

name: Siluca Meletes
description: Siluca Meletes is the main female protagonist throughout the series. She is a young mage that has a great amount of potential and talent, and wishes to stop the feuding of lords. She forms a contract with Theo, and possesses a cat familiar, who can travel through shadows and is the king of the cat kingdom.

name: Theo Cornaro
description: Theo Cornaro (テオ・コルネーロ) is the main protagonist of the series. A wandering knight who obtained a Crest from a Chaos Core. He comes from Sistina, a village ravaged by Chaos and oppressed by their Lord, Viscount Phederico Rossini. After rescuing Siluca from soldiers and telling her his goal to free his hometown, he forms a contract with her and together they fight to stop the feuding lords and end the Chaos era.

name: Adonis
description: Adonis is a human raised by a witch named Chloe.

name: Doroka
description: A young girl who was imprisoned in a prisoner's camp in the Lydia Empire. She is kind and has a noble spirit.

name: Tsunemi Chiba
description: Main vocalist for BECK, he is the key member that [Ryusuke](https://anilist.co/character/4170/Minami-Ryuusuke) needed to bring [Taira](https://anilist.co/character/308/Taira-Yoshiyuki) into the band. His attitude, style, and appearance was based on Zack De La Rocha from Rage Against The Machine and compared to [Koyuki](https://anilist.co/character/676/Tanaka-Yukio), his voice is more punk and rock oriented, like the majority of the band's songs. He also named the band Beck after staring at [Ryusuke's dog](https://anilist.co/character/141894/Beck) for a few moments. He also tends to pick his no

name: Maho Minami
description: Ryusuke's sister who is a talented singer with a strange relationship with Koyuki. At times she seems attracted to him, at others she brushes him off with little regard to his often ignored feelings.

name: Ryuusuke Minami
description: A Japanese character with a long history in America, he speaks fluent English, and frequently uses both Japanese and English in his conversations. He lives alone in a shack by the fishing pond. His skills and taste in music inspire Koyuki to take up the guitar. The band's creator, Ryusuke is BECK's lead guitarist. A once-younger Ryusuke and Eddie Lee stole the Lucille from the trunk of Syke's vehicle.

name: Yuuji Sakurai
description: The fourth member to join, he was also Koyuki's first good friend, sticking with him even when the school bully and his gang beat him up for breaking the silent treatment on Koyuki. He is the drummer, inspired by his brother, and replaces the original drummer of BECK who followed Ryûsuke from his original band, Serial Mama.

name: Yoshiyuki Taira
description: The first recruited member of BECK, Taira is the bassist, and the most talented band member next to [Ryusuke](https://anilist.co/character/4170/Minami-Ryuusuke). He plays Music Man StingRay bass. His attitude may sometimes come off as uncaring. He has been seen working as a traffic officer. As the story progresses, we learn that his father was a jazz musician that left him and his mother when he was young.

name: Yukio Tanaka
description: The main character, the series follows his rapid development from living an average life to becoming an outstanding guitarist. Being a weak individual lacking an authoritative presence , he cannot help but let others push him around, a possible metaphoric stereotype on the very proper and manner conscious Japanese society. Recruited as the last member of BECK, he serves as the second guitarist and vocalist, and has a very beautiful voice that is mostly used for Beck's slower songs. He owns a Fender Telecaster.

name: Kamui
description:
Kamui is a member of the Yato Tribe, the son of [Umibouzu](https://anilist.co/character/9876/Umibouzu) and older brother of [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674/Kagura). His excellent fighting skills helped him become Captain of the 7th Division of Harusame's Thunder Guns, the most powerful combat unit within the Harusame group and Overlord of Yoshiwara. Since defecting from the Harusame, he no longer holds these positions.

Kamui firmly believes that the Yato are to remain on the battlefield and shows his disapproval of [Housen](https://anilist.co/character/25666/Housen) staying locked u

name: Kotarou Katsura
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'8")

Katsura is [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672)'s former comrade during the Joi war. Even after the Amanto take-over of Japan, Katsura continues to resist the Amanto, and has amassed a band of followers.

He is a wanted man due to his involvement in terrorist activities against the Bakufu, and is constantly on the run from the Shinsengumi. Although his initial methods were originally more violent in nature (for instance, sending a bomb to an Amanto embassy), Katsura has gradually grown to believe that there are people important to him in Edo, and decides that

name: Tatsuma Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

Sakamoto is a former member of the Joi. He is a good-natured man and optimistic to the point of being ridiculous, even in the most dangerous situations. His favorite phrase is "AHAHA! It must be _____". He also has a tendency to misspell names; he calls Gintoki "Kintoki". Gintoki often corrects him, citing that if he were named Kintoki, they would be in some kind of hentai anime (because 'Kin' from 'Kintoki' instead of 'Gin' would make the title 'Kintama', which means 'testicles' instead of 'Gintama', which means 'silver soul').  

Despite his goofy nature, Sakamoto is actu

name: Umibouzu
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Occupation:__ Alien Hunter

Umibouzu is Kagura and Kamui's father and one of the last members of the Yato clan. 

Like Kagura, he fights using an umbrella but is also shown to be strong in his own right.

name: Mahiro Yasaka
description: The male protagonist of the story. Usually avoids close contact with Nyaruko and often stabs her with a fork. Since this is a parody anime, Mahiro is a tsundere. It is shown that Mahiro has feelings for Nyaruko, but doesn't like her aggressiveness.

name: Nyaruko
description: A Nyarlotephian, who has come to Earth on a mission to protect Mahiro. Nyaruko has a bright personality, as she is always shown to be happy and rarely down. She likes anime, manga, games, and superhero shows. She has perverted thoughts that usually revolve around Mahiro, whom she says to love.

name: Cthuko
description: A Cthuko (another alien species), who is Nyaruko's childhood friend from kindergarten and elementary school. Instead of thinking of Nyaruko as her enemy (because they're different species, and both Cthuko and Nyarlotephian are enemies), she loves her deeply. Kuko is usually quiet and blushes a lot. She has really perverted thoughts. Nyaruko calls her 'NEET', due to the fact that she loves games.

name: Yakumo Yuurakutei
description:
A legendary rakugo performer who is haunted by his past. He refused to take in any apprentices until he met [Yotarou](https://anilist.co/character/89343/Yotarou).

As a child, Bon had originally trained as a dancer until damage to his leg left him unable to dance. Bon's mother, a geisha, sent him to train as a rakugo performer under the Seventh Generation [Yakumo Yuurakutei](https://anilist.co/character/369125/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) alongside [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/89346/Yuurakutei-Sukeroku), a boy who shows up unexpectedly and is accepted on a whim. While he proved to be adept at the

name: Sukeroku Yuurakutei
description: Shin was the [Eighth Generation Yakumo's](https://anilist.co/character/89345/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) lifelong friend and partner growing up, and [Konatsu's](https://anilist.co/character/89707/Konatsu) father. Apprenticed under [Yakumo Yuurakutei](https://anilist.co/character/369125/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) alongside Bon, he was originally given the name "Hatsutarou," but rejected it to instead perform under the name "Sukeroku." As a shin'uchi, his unique and passionate style of performing quickly earns him a name and reputation in the rakugo community, but also strikes a nerve with the traditionalist mem

name: Kafuka Fuura
description: A somewhat strange and exceedingly optimistic student who always sees everything in the single most positive light possible: the polar opposite of [Nozomu](https://anilist.co/character/3169/Itoshiki-Nozomu), who sees only the dark side of things and is constantly in despair. She often has bizarre, childishly optimistic explanations for grim situations, calling suicide by hanging "becoming taller" and the act of stalking "deep love." She enjoys giving whimsical nicknames to people (much to their annoyance), and has a strange obsession with aliens. Once she turned in a briefcase full o

name: Nozomu Itoshiki
description:
A high school teacher and the youngest son of the Itoshiki family. He always wears a hakama and kimono abroad, preferring flippant casual western clothing in his hometown. When his name is written horizontally it resembles zetsubou ("beyond hope" or "despair"), befitting his extremely negative, paranoid and pessimistic attitude.

He often shouts "I'm in despair!" and attempts suicide several times, though rarely with serious intent. Most of the main girls seem to have feelings for him, but only because they misunderstand what he said to each of them (during the episodes introducing them). 

Hi

name: Nia Honjou
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Angel:__ Rasiel

She is the ninth Spirit to appear in the series.

Nia, also known as the Second Spirit, is a Spirit that appeared on Earth some time after the First Spirit appeared and is claimed to be the only one who knows any information about the First Spirit and her whereabouts. At some point, the D.E.M. captured her by unknown means and she fell into a comatose state.

name: Mukuro Hoshimiya
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm
__Angel:__ Michael

She is the tenth spirit to appear in the series. Mukuro speaks in an overly archaic style. She often speaks in a third person perspective by referring to herself as "Muku" (むく).

After having her emotions unlocked, Mukuro regained her true personality, which in contrast to her sealed one, is very emotional. Due to growing up as an orphan, Mukuro fears to be alone again and desperately wants to remain attached to those who she believes loves her. Even after going as far as to seal the other Spirits' memories of him, [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65

name: Patema
description: The main character of Patema Inverted. She is a resident of a village that lives deep underground, and often challenges the rule that forbids leaving the village's limits. Throughout the movie, Patema is shown to have an inverted gravity in comparison to those who dwell on the surface, meaning she could fall upwards through the sky should nothing bound her to land.

name: Ayaka Sajyou
description:
Ayaka Sajyou is a magus living in Fuyuki City attending school at Homurahara Academy. She is also a former student of the El-Melloi Classroom, having attended classes for about a month.

__In Fate/Prototype:__

She’s the Master of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497) in the Second Tokyo Holy Grail War.

__In Fate/strange Fake:__

She's the "True" Master of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/127453) in the True and False Holy Grail Wars. Ayaka is recognized by [Thia Escardos](https://anilist.co/character/270568) as a non-human being.

name: Richard I
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Saber-class Servant summoned in the "True and False Holy Grail Wars" of Fate/strange Fake. His true name is Richard I, also known as Richard the Lionheart.


He is the "True" Saber-class Servant summoned by [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223/), after usurping the contract from [Cashura](https://anilist.co/character/239478), in the True and False Holy Grail Wars of Fate/strange Fake. He is the Saber of the True Holy Grail War, but there is no "False Saber" due to the abnormal nature of the False Holy Grail War.

name: Tatenashi Sarashiki
description: Tatenashi Sarashiki is a 2nd year student at the IS Academy, Student Council President of the IS Academy, and the IS Representative of Russia. This is due her combat skills, which exceed the Cadet stage. She appears in Volume 5. She is also current Roommate of Orimura Ichika. She pilots the IS "Mysterious Lady a 3rd Generation type".

name: Saki Ayase
description:
[Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/200292/Yuuta-Asamura)'s step-sister and a second-year high school student. 

She became Yuuta's step-sister after her parents remarried. Because of her flamboyant outfit, she is considered a delinquent student and is not well-liked in class.

name: Yuuta Asamura
description: [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/200291)'s step-brother and a second-year high school student. He became Saki's step-brother after his parents remarried. He is a normal high school student but is somewhat distant from others. He loves books to the level of a print addict.

name: Yoshikazu Miyano
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

He's really sensitive about his girlish features, and he's a hardcore fudanshi.

name: Shuumei Sasaki
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm
__Likes:__ Sweets

Sasaki is [Miyano](https://anilist.co/character/164752/Miyano-Yoshikazu)'s senior in high school. He's a 'bad-boy' who doesn't cause much trouble. He got introduced to BL manga through Miyano.

name: Mio Chibana
description: Mio is a 20-year-old freeter. After his mother's death, he briefly moves to Okinawa, where he meets Shun. Initially offended at Shun's attitude, he soon falls in love and pursues him romantically when he returns to Okinawa. Mio attempts to get better understanding of Shun's concerns, despite Shun constantly dismissing his advances.

name: Shun Hashimoto
description:
Hashimoto Shun, a gay novelist in the making, lived on the island Okinawa with his family. On Okinawa, he met a boy named Chibana Mio, who later left to pursue his studies for three years. When he returned, he confessed his attraction to Shun and developed a relationship with him.

Originally from Hokkaido, he moved to Okinawa to live with his grandmother after his parents discovered his sexual orientation.

name: Oochi Fukuchi
description:
Oochi Fukuchi is the commander of the Hunting Dogs special units and has the ability Mirror Lion. 

However, in reality, he is the leader of the terrorist organization, the Decay of Angels, acting under the alias of Kamui.

name: Utena Tenjou
description:
Utena is a tomboyish, courageous and naïve character who lives to emulate the idealized prince figure from her childhood. She is forthright, honest, and friendly, and nearly all the girls in school adore her.

__Anime TV Series:__

Utena’s parents died when she was six years old. On that day she was wandering around, lost, and she fell through a hole in a fence that enclosed a river area. Utena nearly drowned but was saved by a mysterious Prince who kissed away her tears and told her that if she did not lose her noble heart, they would meet again. He left with her a rose signet ring (the Rose

name: Anthy Himemiya
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

A mysterious and shy dark-skinned girl whose sometimes vapid expression and superficial politeness seem to mask something deeper. Many people project their wants or desires onto her, and she's often the target of their eventual rage or hate. Her "doormat" behavior belies a far more complex personality.

Anthy appears to house the Sword of Dios within her own body. At the beginning of a duel, she slips into a trance and the Sword manifests, protruding from her chest so that her champion may draw it from her. This Sword is said to be a key to reaching the goal of Revolution,

name: Rick Gladiatol
native: リック・グラディアートル
description: At the age of 30, he left his job as a guild clerk to pursue his dream of becoming an adventurer. After undergoing two years of "terrifying beyond hellish training" from his seniors from the Orichalcum Fist party, the strongest on the continent, he showed remarkable growth. The days of continuous death and resurrection during training have left him deeply traumatized.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Reanette Elfelt
native: リーネット・エルフェルト
description: Reanette is a dark elf and Rick's assistant and companion who once achieved the legendary 9999 consecutive victories in an underground arena. She now wears a maid outfit and takes care of all the housework for "Orichalcum Fist". She meets Rick through a certain incident and invites him to join her party.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Broughston Ashorc
native: ブロストン・アッシュオーク
description: Broughston is a warrior-monk orc who became an adventurer, and is known as "The Sage Beast" because of his monstrous physique and intelligence. He currently leads "Orichalcum Fist," and Rick looks up to him as his mentor. Despite his gigantic size, he is skilled in support magic, including healing magic, and can even resurrect the dead if they have died shortly after.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Mizett Eldwarf
native: ミゼット・エルドワーフ
description: The young-looking half-elf, half-dwarf, (but over 50 years of age). He continues to develop weapons that cannot be made with the scientific technology of this world, and people say that he has access to technology from 1000 years into the future, earning him the nickname "The Thousand-year Workshopper". He is an invincible womanizer.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Alicerette Draqul
native: アリスレート・ドラクル
description: A pure-blooded vampire girl. Nicknamed the "The Demon Child of Devastation", she is the continent's strongest super-genius offensive magician. Rick has been killed numerous times during training while she innocently toys around, unleashing tremendous offensive magic that carves into mountains and the earth. She is a glutton, which is difficult to believe given her appearance.

appearsIn.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible

name: Momoko Koigakubo
description: Momoko is a 6th grader and Satsuki's best friend. She seems to fear nothing, even in very dangerous situations, and is very brave when it comes to helping Satsuki and the gang confront the ghosts. She also seems to have a psychic connection with Satsuki's mother. In the Spanish Dub, she was named as "Nicole"

name: Reo Kakinoki
description: Reo is Hajime's friend and has a big obsession with paranormal themes, and proclaims himself as a respected paranormal researcher. However, whenever Reo finds a clue pertaining to the existence of supernatural entities, it seems that the clue turns against him. Like Hajime, he tries to be brave but is actually just a coward.

name: Hajime Aoyama
description: Hajime is Satsuki's neighbor. He is always strong and courageous to help defeat the ghosts, but though he says that this is very brave, he is actually a coward. Despite this, he is one of the most reliable of Satsuki's friends and has saved her on more than one occasion. Hajime also has a naughty habit of flipping girls' skirts, and his constant victim is no other than Satsuki. This results in frequent comic moments. Throughout the anime, it seems that Hajime and Satsuki develop mutual crushes on each other (not that they'd admit it).    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Amanojaku
description: Amanojaku is a powerful entity that, long ago, was sealed by Satsuki's mother in a tree in the mountains, but was finally released from his magic prison due to urbanization. However, he did not have his freedom long, as Satsuki sealed him (by accident) in the body of her pet cat, Kaya. At first, Amanojaku is hostile toward the kids and takes great pleasure in seeing them in trouble, but throughout the series he develops somewhat of a care for them, especially for Satsuki and Keiichirou.

name: Satsuki Miyanoshita
description:
Satsuki is the main character of the show. She moves with her father and her young brother Keichirou to the hometown of her deceased mother, where she finds that her mother confronted several evil entities that haunted the town, which included Amanojaku, and wrote all her supernatural experiences in a diary, which is entitled "The Ghost Journal."

Satsuki is very strong, brave, and determined, but sometimes bit moody, mostly because of Hajime trying to see her underpants. In the Spanish Dub, she was named "Claire". Her nickname in the Animax dub is Suki.

name: Keiichirou Miyanoshita
description: Keiichirou is Satsuki's young brother. He is easily frightened by many things and is seen crying sometimes, but he shows courage where it counts to help in defeating the ghosts. He creates a special friendship with the ghost Amanojaku.

name: Senpai
description: Senpai is a high school girl who is a skilled magician when no one is watching. However, she easily gets stage fright, is very embarrassed and clumsy, and often blunders her magic tricks when even one person watches her perform.

name: Joshu
description: He is an underclassmen and a member of the Magic Club.

name: Subaru Uchimaki
description: A second year middle school student, and a member of the art club.  He's the main character of this series, and has a few small problems. He is mostly dense with girls but has a very close relationship with Usami.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!
This Art Club Has a Problem!

name: Mizuki Usami
description:
A second year middle school student, and a member of the art club.  She's the heroine of the story, and has relatively fewer problems.
She tends to display a calm and outgoing expression but may turn violent at times.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!
This Art Club Has a Problem!

name: Buchou
description: The president of the Art Club that the above two are members of. He's taller than the other two, but also has more problems.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!
This Art Club Has a Problem!

name: Colette
description: An underclassman who is also a member of the art club. She moved to Japan with her parents for their careers and has been there for around 7 years. She got so used to living in Japan that she decided to continue living there even after her parents returned home.

appearsIn.title: This Art Club Has a Problem!
This Art Club Has a Problem!

name: Kazunari Usa
description:
Usa Kazunari is a high school freshman whose parents had to move away for work. He agrees to stay anywhere, as long as he could live on his own in peace and quiet.
Having grown up surrounded by his parents' eccentric friends, Usa feels that unique individuals tend to gravitate to him resulting in what he considers a disastrous three years in middle school where he gained a reputation for handling odd people. Although he initially balks at the idea of rooming with dysfunctional people, he decides to stay at the Kawai Complex and quickly adjusts to its residents' behaviors.

His favorite dish is

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior
The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Ritsu Kawai
description: Ritsu is a 2nd year high school student who lives in the same dorm with Usa. She is a seemingly shy girl who likes to read books. Her grandfather is brother to landlady of their dorm who views Ritsu as her relative. She is trusted with looking after the dorm when landlady takes a leave. She keeps multiple weapons around the house and doesn't hesitate to use them if one of the guys crosses into girls side of the house.

appearsIn.title: The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior
The Kawai Complex Guide to Manors and Hostel Behavior

name: Conan Edogawa
description:
**Height:** 174 cm (as Shinichi)
 **Relatives:** [Yusaku Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/9177) (father) & [Yukiko Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/20372) (mother)

At the beginning of the series, Shinichi is a 17-year old student at Teitan High School. He is already well-known as a brilliant young detective, the "Savior of the police force", for solving many difficult cases that the professionals could not. However, while investigating 2 mysterious men, he is spotted and forced to swallow an experimental poison known as APTX 4869. This results in his body shrinking to that of a 6 year old

name: Kogorou Mouri
description: Kogoro is a private investigator, but he prefers to laze around his office all day unless his client is a beautiful woman. Kogoro attended Teitan High School, the same high school as his daughter [Ran Mouri](https://anilist.co/character/1748/Ran-Mouri) and [Shinichi Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/1742/Conan-Edogawa) , along with [Eri Kisaki](https://anilist.co/character/1744/Eri-Kisaki) _(his future wife)_, [Yukiko Fujimine](https://anilist.co/character/20372/Yukiko-Kudo), and through kindergarten to middle school attended the same schools as the actress Ruri Ujo and Eri. He then graduated

name: Ran Mouri
description:
A childhood friend of [Shinichi Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/1742); daughter of [Kogoro Mouri](https://anilist.co/character/1746), a private detective, and [Eri Kisaki](https://anilist.co/character/1744), a lawyer. Her parents got separated when she was seven, and one of her biggest goals is to get them back together. Her best friend next to Shinichi is her classmate [Suzuki Sonoko](https://anilist.co/character/1749), who constantly teases her about her relationship with Shinichi.

After Shinichi's disappearance, Ran met [Edogawa Conan](https://anilist.co/character/1742), who was introdu

name: Eliaria Jamil
native: エリアリア・ジャミール
description:
Heir to the Jamil dukedom, Eliaria is an 11-year-old girl who becomes Ryoma's close friend. Like Ryoma, she is a monster tamer and her body is gifted with large magic potential, but has difficulty controlling it, until Ryoma teaches her how to train herself properly.

(Source: Wikipedia)

appearsIn.title: By the Grace of the Gods
By the Grace of the Gods

name: Ryouma Takebayashi
native: リョウマ・タケバヤシ
description: The main protagonist who lived an uneventful life as an office worker in Japan before dying in his sleep. Due to his diligent and kind behavior, he earns the grace of the gods who send him to another world as an 8-year-old boy where he lives in a forest for three years while polishing his skills and taming hundreds of slimes, making use of their multiple abilities in various tasks from combat and hunting to cleaning and crafting, until meeting the Jamil family who warmly welcomes him among them. Determined to live independently, he refuses to overindulge on their hospitality and looks for ways

appearsIn.title: By the Grace of the Gods
By the Grace of the Gods

name: Touma Shinjou
description: Captain of the soft tennis club, he was the only one on the team who earnestly tried to play in matches until he recruited Maki to be his partner.

name: Maki Katsuragi
description:
A transfer student, as well as a part-time worker, and the son of Aya Katsuragi and the latter’s ex-husband, Kenji Kyobate. Despite having no past experience in soft tennis, he joins the Shijo Minami Junior High boys’ soft tennis club and is quickly discovered to have a natural talent for the sport. He plays as the front player with Toma Shinjo as his partner. 

(Source: Stars Align Wiki)

name: Ray White
aliases: Lily White (リリィー ホワイト)

appearsIn.title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World

name: Haru Yoshioka
description: A quiet, shy, and unassuming high school student who has a long-suppressed ability to talk to cats. [From Wikipedia]

name: Aurora Suya Rhys Kaymin
native: オーロラ・栖夜・リース・カイミーン
description: The princess of the human kingdom. Kidnapped by the [Demon King](https://anilist.co/character/181143/Maou-Tasogare), she spends her days waiting for the heroes to rescue her. At least, that's how it was supposed to be...

appearsIn.title: Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle
Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle

name: Albert Hawke
description:
He is the commander of the Knights of the Third Order. He is nicknamed the "Ice Knight" for his frigid demeanor. He became an ally of Sei Takanashi after she saved him from a mortal wound.

He proposed to Sei and is currently engaged to her.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Johan Valdec
native: ヨハン・ヴァルデック
description: He is the director of a medicinal plants institute and the second son of Count Valdec.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Yuri Drewes
description: He is the grand magus of the Royal Magi Assembly. His only interest is in research related to magic and magical powers. He looks cheerful and passionate on the outside, but on the inside, he is a completely different man.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Sei Takanashi
description:
Sei Takanashi is an office lady in her twenties who was summoned by the Saint Summoning Ritual. Her saintly powers enhance her abilities by fifty percent, due to her appearance she was not crowned as Saint. Accidentally making scenes with her research, she is on the verge of being found out as the saint. But after seeing her abilities she was finally been recognized as the Saint. She Likes to cook and make cosmetics in her spare time.

On Volume 8, she got engaged to Albert Hawke.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Jude
description: He is a researcher at the same institute for medicinal plants as Johan Valdec and is responsible for teaching Sei Takanashi.

appearsIn.title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent

name: Nephelia
description: A beautiful elf [Zagan](https://anilist.co/character/181709/Zagan) bought for one million gold coins. She is wary of him at first but later on feels comfortable by his side, and is able to understand him despite when he cant properly express his feelings.

appearsIn.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride

name: Zagan
description: A young but powerful mage who is one of the candidates to be a "demon lord." He is a handsome eighteen-year-old, that later on buys an elf slave due to falling in love with her at first sight.

appearsIn.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride

name: Tenshu
description:
The owner of Western Restaurant Nekoya, a historic restaurant in the basement of a multi-tenant building in one corner of a shopping district. He inherited the restaurant from his father ten years ago. He is skilled at cooking not only Western cuisine, but Japanese, Chinese, and even desserts, among many other dishes.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Aletta
description:
A young demon girl who found Western Restaurant Nekoya while jobless and down on her luck, and ended up being hired there. Through the people she’s met at Nekoya, she’s found some job leads back in her own world, as well. She always looks forward to eating the master’s cooking on meal breaks.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Kuro
description:
The avatar of a black dragon who, like Aletta, works at Western Restaurant Nekoya. When she comes to the restaurant, she takes the form of an elf girl and uses her power of telepathy to speak to others. She has a bit of an obsession with chicken curry.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Nako Oshimizu
description:
**Height:** 168 cm (5'6") 

Nako is a cleaning maid and waitress working part-time at Kissuisō. She has a shy and timid personality, with a tendency to avoid unwanted social interaction. She is, however, confident about her swimming ability, having been swimming since she was three, she was nick named the "Kappa Girl". She attends the same high school as [Ohana](), [Minko](https://anilist.co/character/37212/Minko-Tsurugi) and [Yuina](https://anilist.co/character/39194/Yuina-Wakura).

name: Ohana Matsumae
description:
**Height:** 160 cm

She is an energetic and mostly optimistic school girl. She was born in Tokyo, but is sent to live at her grandmother's inn, Kissuisō, when her mother elopes with her boyfriend to avoid debt. At her grandmother's request, she works at the inn as compensation for her residency. Before she leaves, her best friend, [Kouichi Tanemura](https://anilist.co/character/39195/Kouichi-Tanemura), confesses to her. However, he runs off before she can answer him. Ohana now feels awkward whenever she thinks about him. Her desire to help others usually backfires or goes unappreciated. As a r

name: Minko Tsurugi
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Minko is an apprentice chef and resident at Kissuisō. She has a very cold demeanor, often telling [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae) to 'die' following their first encounter, though when this is considered too harsh by [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae), she settles for calling her a balut instead. Though she is hard working, she becomes passive when being scolded for her mistakes and is usually victim to [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae)'s mishaps. She displays great jealousy when [Ohana](https

name: Yumeko Suzukiri
description: She is a Ranger and a member of Yellow Battalion, with the rank of Junior First Class.

name: Hiyori Moritani
description: One of Haruka and Manabe's classmates. Unlike Haruka, Hiyori is a social girl. She's set to inherit her family's dojo, but she's not very enthusiastic about the idea. She has a crush on Manabe, so she tends to lash out at Haruka for getting his attention. She's also a bit of a tsundere.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Haruka Kotoura
description: A girl with the power to read minds. Her power has caused her harsh experiences since she was a child, so she's closed off her heart to others. But the truth is that she's still just a normal, weak girl who longs to be with someone. Her heart begins to open after her encounter with [Manabe](https://anilist.co/character/73021/Manabe-Yoshihisa) and the others. Even though she can read minds, she's not used to experiencing sexual thoughts, so she's always getting flustered by Manabe.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Yuriko Mifune
description: The president of the ESP Research Club. Her mother was a clairvoyant similar to Haruka, who would often assist in police investigations. However, she was accused of being a fake and hung herself, bringing shame to her family and horrifying Yuriko who believed in her. Ever since, Yuriko has been keen to prove the existence of psychics, finally having the answer in Haruka. At first she plans to use Haruka  for her fortune telling schemes, until Haruka got bullied and blame herself for Haruka's demise.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Yoshihisa Manabe
description: A healthy young, high school boy who always has sex on the brain. Despite his loose appearance, he's a handsome man who hates twisted things. He's also generous, and doesn't mind Haruka's power at all. Though he does tease Haruka with his sexual fantasies, his love for her is clear and true, and he treasures her more than anyone.  (Source: ANN)

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Daichi Muroto
description: Daichi is the childhood friend of [Yuriko](https://anilist.co/character/73023/Mifune-Yuriko). When around the club members of ESP Research Club, he has a laid-back appearance and is usually seen reading a book. When he is alone with Yuriko, he tends to be more serious, and his eyes are visible.

appearsIn.title: The Troubled Life of Miss Kotoura

name: Iku Sutou
description:
__Type:__ Masochist
__Occupations:__ First-Year High School Student, Baseball Club Member
__Debut:__ Chapter 33

**Girlfriend No. 009**

Iku loves baseball, to the point of spending hours recruiting for her team when it's on the verge of being disbanded. She is determined to do her best no matter what; because of this she's described as the embodiment of "stoicism" by Rentarou. Iku is also wildly masochistic, going so far as to train for hours until her body is in agony so she can enjoy the pain.

appearsIn.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You Season 2
The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You

name: Mimimi Utsukushisugi
description:
__Type:__ Narcissist
__Occupation:__ Second-Year High School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 39  

**Girlfriend No. 010**

Mimimi is very haughty and narcissistic, constantly complimenting herself and talking about her beauty. Despite her appearance of a naturally-beautiful rich girl, Mimimi actually works incredibly hard to provide for herself and keep herself beautiful. She works for herself to earn money, is frugal where appropriate so she can afford expensive, gorgeous clothing, and puts significant effort into her appearance. Though she puts a lot of value on outward appearances, Mimimi also r

appearsIn.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You Season 2

name: Meme Kakure
description:
**Type:** Self-Conscious 
**Occupation:** First-Year High School Student
**Debut:** Chapter 45

**Girlfriend No. 011**

Meme is extremely shy, to the point of wearing masks to hide her face in order to avoid drawing attention to herself. She strives to keep her face hidden no matter what. Meme also enjoys knitting, and spends time knitting a lot of little stuffed animals. She uses these stuffed animals for "misdirection", in which she runs away quickly and leaves a stuffed animal as a distraction so no one sees where she went. Meme wears a modest turtleneck beneath her school blazer, and dark

appearsIn.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You Season 2

name: Amidamaru
description: Samurai that died during the Muromachi period 600 years ago - now is Yoh's ghost companion. He is very powerful and wise but quite taciturn and extremely devoted to "Lord Yoh" ("Yō-dono" in Japanese). He was greatly known around the town of Funbari, where he had died 600 years prior after killing several hundred other samurai soldiers during a battle. He is the original handler of the legendary sword named "Harusame", meaning "Spring Rain", a sword forged by his best friend, Mosuke, who also appeared in the anime/manga as a spirit. This very same sword w

name: Lyserg Diethel
description:
__Race:__ Human / Shaman

A British Shaman and a traditional "dowser", whose parents were killed by [Hao](https://anilist.co/character/172/Hao-Asakura). Lyserg has dramatic interactions with all of the main characters at some point, and though he travels with them for a long time, he fights against [Yoh's](https://anilist.co/character/167/Yoh-Asakura) team more than once during the series.  

Lyserg is an intelectualy genius but he is blinded by the prospet of revenge for his family's murder. He has a generally kind heart, although he becomes a bit of an anti-hero.

At first, Lyserg teams up w

name: Chocolove McDonell
native: チョコラブ・マクダネル
description:
Joco met his mentor, Orona, on a snowy night when he was young. Orona was among the crowd of people who circled around a victim who was being robbed. The police had the robber surrounded, but he threatened everyone by threatening to kill the victim. Orona stood out from the crowd and asked the police to give him a chance. Joco was watching him, and before he knew it, the robber was laughing his head off and was being carried off by the police.  

In the manga, the circumstances between Orona and Joco's first meeting are different. After killing a man on Christmas with his gang members from Sha

name: Yoh Asakura
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm  
__Birth Place:__ Izumo, Japan  
__Hobby:__ Listening to music and sleeping  
__Favorite Food:__ Udon Curry  
__Quotes:__ "Don't worry, it'll work out somehow."  

Yoh was born into the famous Shaman family, Asakura. He has a twin brother named [Hao](https://anilist.co/character/172/Asakura-Hao) who is a powerful reincarnation of the original HAO who keeps getting reborn. For this reason, Yoh is said to be the only one who can defeat his brother, and he himself is, as stated in the manga, a half of the original HAO, thus has many of the qualities of the reincarnation before

name: Johann Faust VIII
description: Faust is a descendant of the original Faustus, a man who made a pact with the devil. In Shaman King, Faust the eighth was a lonely boy who had only one friend, named [Eliza](https://anilist.co/character/18342/Eliza). But Eliza suffered from a deadly disease that no cure, so Faust devoted his life to find one and evetually did it. He became a doctor, saved Eliza's life and married her. They lived together in their clinic in Germany until one night a burglar broke in and shot Eliza dead.  Broken Faust turned to his ancestor's black arts, necromancy, and now fights in order to become the Shaman K

name: Anna Kyouyama
description:
Aggressive and decisive, Anna is a pragmatic person who appears cold and harsh. However, she has shown that she genuinely cares for those important to her. She is extremely dedicated to being "The Ultimate Shaman Queen" and the wife to [Yoh](https://anilist.co/character/167/Asakura-Yoh), the first friend that she ever had. She firmly believes that Yoh is destined to become the Shaman King, and believes her duty (as an Itako - a spirit medium) is training him extensively for it.

She is almost always seen wearing a red bandana; the bandana is usually worn on her head, but she starts wearing the

name: Manta Oyamada
description: An intelligent but worrisome teen who always carries a "dictionary/encyclopedia/compendium of all human knowledge", and has a sixth sense, meaning he can see supernatural beings, even though he is not a Shaman. He is very expressive and a bit panicky. His rather abnormal height has gotten him into trouble numerous times, once having been mistaken for one of the shy nature spirits, and being cut open and used as a hostage of sorts during Yoh Asakura's match with Faust VIII. In the anime, during the final battle with Hao, he actually becomes a Shaman and is able to merge with a sp

name: Ryuunosuke Umemiya
description: Ryunosuke Umemiya, usually called "Wooden Sword" Ryu, is a character in the anime and manga Shaman King. In the English anime, his name is Rio. A direct translation of his nickname reads "Dragon of the Wooden Sword". He is a Capricorn. He usually wears exaggerated 1970s fashion: white suits and dark shirts with oversized collars, cuffs and lapels, plus pointy shoes. His battle outfit consists of a vest-styled shirt that exposes his stomach and pants that occasionally puff out above the ankles. His crowning glory is a foot-long pompadour, which keeps getting lopped off by Yoh Asakura and others

name: Ren Tao
description:
Len is a Shaman from China, one of the few remaining members of the Tao Family, who after their years of serving as the guardians of the Forbidden City, became outcasts and condemned as witches and devils. Those two centuries of suffering were the fuel of the hatred En bared for those outside of their clan and even more for those of the Tao family who associated themselves with outsiders like his brother or Len's father (in the Japanese version, En is Len's father, in the English version, is his uncle).

Len was taught to hate and see the worst in people, with the Tao family Crest magically ta

name: Horohoro
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Horohoro is an Ainu from Hokkaidō, a prefecture in Japan. In the English anime, he is described as from "the Northern Woods" instead of from Hokkaidō. He is the older brother of [Pirica](https://anilist.co/character/15558/Pirika-Usui) and his guardian ghost is [Kororo](https://anilist.co/character/20242/Kororo), a small nature spirit. Horohoro is a tall boy and he is most commonly seen wearing a white and blue skiing outfit, black shorts and skiing shoes that can be attached to his snowboard. He has long light turquoise blue hair that when tied together with his headband (t

description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Initial Persona:__  Arsène
__Ultimate Persona:__ Satanael

The protagonist of Persona 5. He is a transfer student at Shujin High School and is infamous due to his criminal record. He was transferred to Shujin on probation by the court due to the alleged assault filed against him. During his probation, he lives in the cellar of Cafe Leblanc owned by Sakura Sojiro, which is also his acting guardian. 

Ren has a strong sense of justice, as noted by his fellow friends and confidants. He also has a strong will for rebellion, as noted by his Persona, Arsene. It is due to

name: Futaba Sakura
description:

__Height:__ 152 cm
__Arcana:__ Hermit
__Initial Persona:__ Necronomicon
__Transforming Persona:__ Prometheus
__Fusion Persona:__ Al Azif

A genius 15-year-old​ girl with otherworldly calculation and programming skills. Her interpersonal communication is extremely poor though, so she lives life as a shut-in with limited to no human interaction.

name: Gorou Akechi
aliases: Second Advent of the Detective Prince
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Akechi is a high school student who conducts a detective business. His abilities as a detective have been widely acclaimed, since he not only has solved numerous cases but is also able to deal with people from the investigation agency smoothly. His handsome features draw public attention, and people comment on him as “The Second Advent of the Detective Prince.” He represents the Justice Arcana.

He works behind the scenes as the Black Mask responsible for many of the mental shutdown and psychotic breakdown incidents, acting as an assassin for [Shido](https://anilist

name: Ann Takamaki
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Arcana:__ Lovers
__Initial Persona:__ Carmen
__Transforming Persona:__ Hecate
__Fusion Persona:__ Célestine

Ann Takamaki is a playable character from Persona 5. She is a student at Shujin Academy who lives a double life as a Phantom Thief. After being ridden with guilt of not helping her best friend Shiho Suzui who would fall victim to Suguru Kamoshida and would lose ties with her in the process, she would support her friends while facing, overcoming, and promising not to make the same mistake again.

name: Ryuuji Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Arcana:__ Chariot
__Initial Persona:__ Captain Kidd
__Transforming Persona:__ Seiten Taisei
__Fusion Persona:__ William

Ryuuji is known as a disruptive "problem student" at school whose bad behavior causes all sorts of trouble for the teachers. His rebellious, mischievous, and disobedient nature are the perfect qualities to be a Phantom Thief. He is a bit short-tempered, easily taking offense from even the slightest of comments from others, and can sometimes even resort to violence.

name: Yuusuke Kitagawa
description:
__Height:__ 181.9 cm
__Arcana:__ Emperor
__Initial Persona:__ Goemon
__Transforming Persona:__  Kamu Susano-o
__Fusion Persona:__ Gorokichi

Yusuke is a very composed and collected individual, and upon further inspection, this extends to a sense of methodical intelligence and a highly observant nature. He acts with poise and elegance, displayed by his eloquent, poetic way of speaking. He is able to remain calm even in dire circumstances, but can also act dramatically at times; others have pointed him out as weird, and even Yusuke admits that he can be seen as eccentric.

name: Morgana
description:
__Height:__ 60 cm (Bipedal) - 50 cm (Cat, including tail)
__Initial Persona:__ Zorro
__Transforming Persona:__ Mercurius
__Fusion Persona:__ Diego

Morgana is an amnesiac that remembers almost nothing about his past or himself, believing that the cause is the distortions within Mementos. This causes him to lose his sense of self in the process and wishes to get it back. Despite his appearance of a mysterious cat-like creature, he believes himself to have been human. He theorizes the core of Mementos may have the answers, but access from most of it is blocked and he cannot go very deep. In orde

name: Makoto Niijima
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm 
__Arcana:__ Priestess
__Initial Persona:__ Johanna
__Transforming Persona:__ Anat
__Fusion Persona:__ Agnes

Makoto is a perfectionist who has a strong sense of responsibility. Like her previous Priestess counterparts, Makoto is intelligent, honest, and very hardworking. In truth, she is a very compassionate and understanding young lady who strives to ensure everyone is accounted for. She is Shujin Academy's student council president and lives a double life as a Phantom Thief.

name: Haru Okumura
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__Arcana:__ Empress
__Initial Persona:__ Milady
__Transforming Persona:__ Artarte
__Fusion Persona:__ Lucy

Haru has good communication and observational skills. She grew up with all the elegance and splendor. She finds it difficult to differentiate between those who truly value her as a friend and who merely want to use her for her family's status. After meeting and joining the Phantom Thieves, Haru becomes passionate and rebellious and eventually learns how to properly convey her mind and connect with others.

name: Yumiella Dolkness
native: ユミエラ・ドルクネス
description:
A girl who reincarnated as the hidden final boss of the RPG otome game _Light Magic and the Hero_. She originally planned to live a peaceful life, but her "gamer soul" became fired up after her first time using her newfound magical powers in a dungeon, and she quickly became obsessed with leveling up.

Yumiella is stoic, logical, and has a phlegmatic expression; she struggles with social interaction, including understanding and building relationships. This, combined with her jet black hair that is feared and discriminated against in the kingdom, often leads others to be scared and distance the
