Villainess Level 99: I May Be the Hidden Boss But I'm Not the Demon Lord

name: Patrick Ashbatten
native: パトリック・アッシュバトン
description:
Patrick is a student at the Royal Academy and [Yumiella](https://anilist.co/character/208534/Yumiella-Dolkness)'s closest friend. He is the second son of a margrave and is skilled at battle tactics and wind magic. In the original game, _Light Magic and the Hero_, he was just a background character.

Patrick is a sincere, kindhearted, and level-headed person who often acts as the straight-man for Yumiella's antics. description:
__Height:__ 153 cm  

A dispassionate, withdrawn assassin, Golden Darkness is hired by one of [Lala](https://anilist.co/character/5511)'s arranged suitors, [Lacospo](https://anilist.co/character/71391) to kill [Rito](https://anilist.co/character/5510), until she breaks the contract, noting the true nature behind her target. native: モモ・ベリア・デビルーク
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm

[Lala's](https://anilist.co/character/5511) younger sister and [Nana's](https://anilist.co/character/17363) twin; they are introduced when they have most of the characters in a virtual game world created by Lala that they subsequently modify. They claim they did this to determine the nature of their sister's friends and to test Rito's affection for Lala.

Momo has short hair and is generally sweeter than her twin, but develops a bad attitude whenever Nana takes credit for what she does; she shares a connection to plant life. She also has a strong attraction towards [Rito](h

name: Mea Kurosaki
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm

Mea Kurosaki is a character from To-Love-Ru Darkness. She is sent to Earth to bring back the "old" Golden Darkness. It is revealed that she is Yami's younger sister as she was created by the same organization as her. At first she is found alone starring out the window until she meets Nana and becomes friends with her. She now views others as friends. It appears (in chapter 7) that she has sexual feelings towards Rito.

She is described by Yami as a "second generation" transforming weapon, making her abilities more advanced than her sister's. She has displayed several abilit

name: Mikan Yuuki
description:
**Height:** 149 cm

[Rito Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/5510/Yuuki-Rito)'s independent and reliable 11-year-old sister, Mikan takes care of the housework while their parents are away on business.

In contrast to her brother, she is very mature and does not hesitate to tease him, going as far as stating they aren't blood related, just for a laugh. Mikan also seems to have a certain lack of respect for Rito because of this (she hardly ever addresses him by his honorific as an older brother), but does answer him "Onii-chan" as thanks for trying so hard to take care of her when she develops

name: Uta
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm
__Occupations:__ Singer

Uta is the most beloved singer in the world. Her voice, which she sings with while concealing her true identity, has been described as “otherworldly.”

In ONE PIECE FILM: RED, she is revealed to be [Shanks](https://anilist.co/character/727/Shanks)' adopted daughter.

Uta and [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Luffy-D-Monkey) met when they were children, and they seem to have been friends since then.

name: Shanks
description:
__Height:__ 199 cm (6'6½")
__Bounty:__ 4,048,900,000

Red-Haired Shanks is a legendary and powerful pirate in the Grand Line, being the captain of the Red-Haired Pirate Crew. Furthermore, he is [Monkey D. Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy)'s childhood hero. Overall, he is greatly respected by most of the characters, despite having a 'soft' and friendly nature and never appearing in actual combat until he started a fight with [Whitebeard](https://anilist.co/character/2751/Edward-Newgate). As a whole, he does not make many appearances in the series, although he appears in a m

name: Rein
description: He is a Beast Tamer who originally had no other combat skills except weak fire and healing spells, which leads him to be expelled from the hero's party. However, upon meeting Kanade and making a contract with her, Rein learns that he can also obtain other skills from members of strongest races, which makes him stronger with each new contract.

name: Kanade
description: Kanade is a talented and powerful fighter from the Cat Tribe, the rarest of the strongest races. She left her hometown in search for adventure. After she meets Rein Shroud, she asks him to tame her, and Rein does so, making her his first companion.

name: Tania
description: Tania is a red dragon, a member of Dragon Tribe, and is traveling the world challenging worthy fighters until Rein and Kanade defeat her. After befriending them, she joins the party, making her his second contractual.

name: Luna
description: Luna, a Dryad from the Spirit Tribe, was sacrificed to Shadow Knight in order to protect their village. At Sora's request, Rein helped her and her older twin sister by defeating Shadow Knight. Along with Sora, decided to join his party, making them his third and fourth contractual.

name: Sora
description: Sora, a dryad from the Spirit Tribe, was given the job of protecting the forest and safeguarding the Shield of Truths. She gave the shield to Rein and others after they told her it was needed to defeat the demon lord. Noticing that she is sad, Rein asks her to tell the reason. Sora told Rein and others that her younger twin sister was captured by Shadow Knight as an offering to protect their village. Rein helped her and her sister by defeating Shadow Knight. Then, Sora and Luna decided to join his party, making them his third and fourth contractual.

name: Utena Hiiragi
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm

Utena is a shy and introverted girl who longingly admires magical girls, collects their memorabilia, and talks passionately about them. Her obsession with Tres Magia even reached to the point where she wished to fight alongside them, but that ultimately led to her being tricked by [Venalita](https://anilist.co/character/301180). At times, she can be simple-minded.

name: Kiwi Araga
description:
__Height:__ 149 cm

She became a member of Enormeeta to beat up magical girls, because she hated that they got more attention than her on social media. Although Kiwi was initially hostile towards [Utena](https://anilist.co/character/175746), after undergoing shock training, she became docile and developed a crush on Utena. Now she is content with Utena's acknowledgement alone. Kiwi frequently fantasizes about going to a love hotel with Utena. Despite appearances she is decent enough academically to help Utena avoid her grades deteriorating.

She and [Magia Sulfur](https://anilist.co/character/

Korisu is a quiet and reserved girl, and the youngest member of Enormeeta. She has a large collection of old toys that are precious to her.

Her theme is Alice in Wonderland.

name: Matama Akoya
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm
__Favorite Food:__ Sweet Rolled Omelettes
__Least Favorite Food:__ Coriander
__Recent Ambition:__ To Have A Video Of Her Singing Go Viral On Social Media

Matama is a cheerful girl. However, she is also quite narcissistic and very sensitive to criticism. She fears both [Lord Enorme](https://anilist.co/character/288448) and [Magia Baiser Utena](https://anilist.co/character/175746), finding them both similar in that they use sexual harassment as punishment. Nemo is a snarky and crude girl. She is also quite arrogant, since she has a habit of taunting her opponents. She is also childhood friends with [Akoya Matama](https://anilist.co/character/255890). They have good teamwork when fighting together. However, they also argue often. In spite of this, they may have romantic feelings for each other.

name: Terminus Est
description: Est is Kamito's contracted spirit. She is a powerful sword spirit. In elemental waffe form she transforms into a sword known as Demon Slayer, Demon King Killing Sacred Sword, or The Sacred Sword of Severian.

native: エリス・ファーレンガルト
description: Ellis Fahrengart is a captain of the Sylphid Knights and a member Team Scarlet. She is the elementalist of the wind spirit Simorgh. Though she is armed with a sword, her main weapon is a lance which is an elemental waffe which her contract spirit transforms into.

description: The main character of this story, who suddenly sees Claire while she's washing herself. He eventually becomes her slave spirit.   He is actually Ren Ashbell, the strongest blade dancer.

native: リンスレット・ローレンフロスト
description: Rinslet Laurenfrost is Claire's childhood friend and self proclaimed rival. She is a Member of Team Scarlet and elementalist using the ice wolf spirit Fenrir.

native: フィアナ・レイ・オルデシア
description:
Fianna Ray Ordesia is a member of Team Scarlet and the so called the Lost Queen. She is the contractor of the light spirit Georgios.

She excels in ritual Kagura, which have many uses such as combat support, resealing, driving spirits mad, etc.

name: Claire Rouge
description: Claire Rouge is the leader of Team Scarlet and an elementalist using the flame spirit Scarlet.

name: Tron
description:
__Affiliation__ Village Bunnies, Demon Lord Kunai Hakuto, Satanists (former)
__Species__ Cambion (half demon)

A cute, melancholy-looking little girl dressed in black she and the image of a gothic lolita. Tron is very melancholic because of her stalking past that she suffered in the demonic kingdom and the human world, she once said that she had forgotten how to smile. After being saved by [Zero Kirisame](https://anilist.co/character/189442/Zero-Kirisame), she became more open and cheerful. Tron can fly freely, she also has superhuman strength due to her half demon blood. Her most remarkable a

description:
__Height:__ 153 cm

She is the youngest of the ‘Three Saints’. She has magical talent that is rare even among the saints. Because of that rare talent she grew up as if she were a rose among weeds. She is extraordinarily selfish.

description: Aku was cast out of her village as a sacrifice to the Devil King Greol; however, as she is being chased through the forest by Greol, she comes to a clearing where she encounters a mysterious man.   This man defeats the Devil King with a single knife, causing Aku to become frightened for her life.  The man assures her that she has nothing to worry, he introduces himself as Hakuto Kunai.  Aku repeatedly refers to Kunai as "Demon Lord", which he tries time and time again, to tell her that's not his name.  He eventually gives in and lets her call him the Demon Lord, as they begin their journey tog

description: Adachi Sakura is a high school student. She is found skipping class on the second floor of the gym by [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) one day. The two of them gradually became friends and began to spend a lot of time together. Adachi had an extremely introverted personality. Before meeting Shimamura, she never had someone whom she can call a friend. Adachi was said to be cold toward other people and didn't attempt to make friends with other people in the past. She also gets very jealous when Shimamura is together with her friends, and as a consequen

She met [Adachi](https://anilist.co/character/144717/Sakura-Adachi) while skipping class on the second floor of the gym in her school when Adachi accidentally walks in on her one day. The two instantly took a liking for each other and began to hang out together all the time. name: Fio Piccolo
description: Fio was in America, but went to Milan to help out her grandfather Piccolo. Her grandfather is the owner of Piccolo S.P.A., where they build seaplanes. Fio is very talented and skilled for her age, and most importantly, passionate about her work.  She greatly admires Porco Rosso. Her father was once a member of Captain Marco Paggot’s unit in the Italian Air Force, and she heard wonderful stories about him. Aside from helping Porco Rosso repair his plane, she also wants to help free him from his curse.  (Source: wingsee.com)

name: Donald Curtis
description: Donald Curtis, a confident ¼ Italian ¾ American pilot, is recruited in the Flying Pirates Alliance to take out their enemy Porco Rosso. His goal in life is to become a Hollywood star and become the President of the United States.

name: Porco Rosso
description: Born Marco Pagot, Porco was an ace fighter pilot for the Italian Air Force in World War I. A curse has since given him the appearance of a pig, leading to the nickname Porco Rosso (Italian for "Red Pig"). He now operates as a bounty hunter in the Adriatic Sea, fighting air pirates in his distinctive red sea plane.

name: Yogiri Takatou
description: A high school student who gets trapped in the alternate world with Tomochika Dannoura. He has a power that he has kept hidden most of his life, the power to force instant death.

name: Jin Seon
description: Jin is the main protagonist and the son of the murderous CEO Dongsoo Seon. Jin is a scrawny teenager with pale skin, brown hair, and a blue right eye. Because of the "accident" during his childhood, Jin's left eye was substituted with a reddish-brown glass eye, which he hides with his irregular bangs. Due to his brutal nature, while dealing with bullies and other opponents, Jin will occasionally appear bruised and cut from his fights. Even though Jin wants to be righteous and well-meaning, he has a sociopathic side that emerges in times of intense stress or anger. When this trait shows itself,

description: Kyun is known to be a sociable butterfly and friendly, she has a lot of morality as well as common sense. However there are times where she can be quite cold when the time calls for it.

name: Jae-Hyeok Kim
description: Manny Kim is the 'alpha' of his school, being quite popular with everyone. That changed when an accident took his legs. He comes from a rich family, gets good grades, and is quite good at fighting. He and Jin Seon have a very complicated relationship.

name: Matsu
description: A computer genius and hacker that lives in a secret room of Izumo Inn, and was once mistaken for a ghost by Kusano. She becomes Minato's third Sekirei. She also likes to shorten people's names and substitute tan for san.   Matsu uses a vast network of satellites and spying devices to gather large amounts of information and has even succeeded in hacking the MBI mainframe computer. She refers to herself as the 'Wisdom' Sekirei. However, despite her high intellect, she is very perverse - she uses her resources to peep on people and often tries to 'experiment' with Mi

__Weight:__48kg

__Personality:__ Musubi is very naive, positive and insightful, often says things she does not understand, and is probably the most 'childish' of Minato's Sekireis, even more so than Kusano. name: Minato Sahashi
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

19 year old student who's just found out he's failed his exam for the second time to get into college. He's currently lives in Tokyo with no close friends and he's down in the dumps, until he bumps into Musubi. Musubi changes his life when she decides that he is her ashikabi (patner) and becomes a winged sekirei. Not only that but he finds out that Musubi is a sekirei who must battle other sekireis within Tokyo. Now Minato must keep this a secret while he tries to handle a new life with Musubi.   __History__ Not much is known about Minato's past, except that Matsu states th

She has power over plants-to make them grow. She does not like fighting or quarrels and she can be seen stopping them when they start. she said that she wishes to be Minato's wife when she grows up.     (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Saito Houjou
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

[Akane Sakuramori](https://anilist.co/character/248384/Sakuramori-Akane)'s classmate and natural enemy. He has trouble getting along with Akane, always quarreling with her. He's smart and always places at the top of the class, but he lacks common sense in his daily life. Married Akane so he could succeed his grandfather to control the Houjou Group.

appearsIn.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class
I Got Married to the Girl I Hate Most in Class

name: Akane Sakuramori
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Saito's classmate and natural enemy. When she's not talking, she's a model-class beauty, but when she sees Saito, she's always fighting with him. She has a strong competitive spirit, is hardworking, and has a family-oriented side. She has a dream that she wants to fulfill even if she has to marry Saito.

appearsIn.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class
I Got Married to the Girl I Hate Most in Class

name: Ai Enma
description: The primary protagonist of the series. With long, flowing hair and red eyes, she is a spiritual entity with a tragic past, who lives in a world of eternal twilight with her grandmother, and is the one who receives and delivers vengeance on her clients' behalf. She normally wears a black seifuku, or sailor uniform (which is usually worn during winter months), but always wears a kimono with floral designs when delivering the vengeance of a client. Ai started her career as the Hell Girl by her own act of vengeance on the villagers who sentenced her to a sacrificial death. Her eyes turned red

name: Hone Onna
description: Assistant of Enma Ai, and appears to be a beautiful woman in a kimono with its obi tied in front--the trademark of a prostitute. She becomes the red straw doll when necessary by tossing her red obi strap over her neck. Hone Onna, along with Ichimoku Ren, researches the people who make a contract and the ones they have a grudge against. Hone Onna usually infiltrates human society in casual clothing to investigate cases, on these occasions she tends to use the psudonym "Sone Anna". On certain occasions, she uses throwing knives as weapons; Hone Onna is apparently extremely skilled with these wea

name: Ren Ichimoku
description: An assistant of Enma Ai who appears to be a handsome young man with one eye covered by hair. He can manifest a single, very large eye that can be directed anywhere, allowing him to see through walls. This manifests as an eye on a wall. The large eye can also be used as a weapon, by projecting intense flashes of light. When so required, Ichimoku Ren becomes a blue straw doll by kissing a pendant he wears around his neck. He is sometimes referred to as "Moku" or "Ichimoto Ren".    It is later revealed that Ichimoku Ren is a tsukumogami, an artifact which has gained sentience after a long time of

name: Hajime Shibata
description: A former journalist who now earns money by blackmailing celebrities with evidence of their scandals. He began to investigate Jigoku Tsuushin merely out of interest, but becomes more heavily involved once he realizes that it's more than just a rumor and people are actually being dragged into Hell. Furthermore, his daughter Tsugumi seems to have a mysterious connection with Enma Ai that allows her to see anything significant that Ai sees. (Wikipedia)

name: Tsugumi Shibata
description: Hajime's daughter who often refers to him as "Hajime-chan". She sees Ai one day and has had a mysterious connection with her ever since. At first, she reports everything she sees through Ai to Hajime, but as the series progresses, she becomes more reluctant to do so as she begins to disagree with her father on whether they should try to stop Ai or not.     She is briefly shown in the second season as a source of information for an investigator. At the same time, it seems that she has a similar relationship with Kikuri, which is revealed in the 24th episode of the second season.

name: Wanyuudou
description: Assistant of Enma Ai, who becomes the black straw doll with a red string around its neck, the string probably originating as the red scarf he wears in human form. He also frequently takes the form of a burning wheel on Ai's coach when she goes to the human world to claim a soul. The coach incidentally bears the same black flame-crest that appears on the chest of those people who contract with the Hell Girl. At all other times, Wanyuudou appears as an older man whose eyes remain mostly shut, wearing a fisherman's hat and fairly old-fashioned Japanese clothing. Despite appearing quite mild-manne

name: Godou Kusanagi
description: The main character of the series and one of only 7 Campione. Originally a retired middle school baseball player, after his grandfather asked him to return a stone tablet to a friend in Sardinia named Lucretia Zola a series of events take place in which he kills the god Verethragna, a Persian god of Victory. Due to a curse, any god killed by a mortal, that mortal shall obtain the abilities of the killed god. These are the people known as Campione.  Godou obtains the abilities of Verethragna's 10 forms: The Wind, Bull, White Stallion, Camel, Boar, The Youth, Raptor, Ram, Goat and The Warrior.  E

name: Yuri Mariya
description: A part of the Japanese Magician's Society (History Compilation Committee) in an elite group known as the Hime-Miko. A miko with a strong Spirit Vision which allows her to obtain visions from objects.  Originallly fearful of Godou due to her previous encounter with the Campione Marquis Voban. She later opens up to and falls for him, becoming one of his allies.  Touma, her guardian often calls her "Princess."

name: Erica Blandelli
native: エリカ・ブランデッリ
description: A member of 'Copper Black Cross' - a magician organization based in Milan.  Holding the rank of Great Knight and the title of Diavolo Rosso she is a magic swordsmen that through coincidence meets Godou and assists him while he is in Sardinia.  Using her weapon Cuore de Leone an enchanted weapon summoned by her known as the king of lions.  Originally wary of Godou however becomes attached to him. Her personality likes to keep herself in control of her own situation thus she can be very forceful in her affection however she truly cares for Godou. Even allowing for other women to love him on the

name: Liliana Kranjčar
native: リリアナ・クラニチャール
description: A member of "Bronze Black Cross," a magician organization based in Milan. Known as Erica's rival, she also holds the rank of Great Knight. Wielding her sword Il Maestro, her swordsmanship is on par with Erica; however, her true strength lies in Witchcraft.  She has fairy-like beauty and a strong sense of duty. She falls for Godou and swears as a knight she will serve him for eternity. She also like to write romance novels in secret (though Erica knows and constantly blackmails her with them).  Liliana was a member of the magical association descended from the Knights Templar called Bronze-Blac

name: Liao Diao He
description:
He Liao Diao is the last known descendent of the Kyuumei Mountain Tribe, which was destroyed in the war with Yang Duanhe, king of the Qin mountains. As a result of this, she moved to Kokuhi village, a place of outlaws in which she eventually encounters and befriends Ying Zheng and Li Xin.

She becomes an expert in blowing poisonous needles using a hollow bamboo stem acquired following the defeat of the assassin Muta by Xin.  It is initially assumed by Xin, Zheng and Bi that Diao is a boy, however it is revealed early on that she is a girl after she is wounded in a skirmish with their pursuers.

name: Xin Li
description: The hero of the story. A war orphan who aims to become the "World's Greatest General". He later meets Zheng Ying, the future first king that would rule all of China.

name: Zheng Ying
description: The young king of Qin who bears a striking resemblance to Piao. Later becomes Qin Shi Huang.

name: Lei Qiang
description: A member of a legendary assassin clan called "Chi You" that is exceptional in combat and uses the notorious Dance of Death. She fights with a sword named "Lu Seui".

name: Takenori Akagi
description:
__Year:__ 3rd Year 
__Height:__ 197 cm 
__Jersey Number:__ #4 
__Position:__ Center 

Takenori Akagi is the captain of the Shohoku basketball team and [Haruko](https://anilist.co/character/8485/Akagi-Haruko)'s older brother. Despite at first not thinking too much of [Sakuragi](https://anilist.co/character/310/Sakuragi-Hanamichi) (who addresses him as "Gori" for gorilla due to his immense physical presence), he actually realizes Sakuragi's potential as a basketball player. Serious and disciplined, Akagi's dream is to lead Shohoku to the national championship. His determination is shown in the m

name: Hisashi Mitsui
description:
__Year:__ 3rd Year 
__Height:__ 184 cm (6 ft ½ in) 
__Shoe Brand:__ Asics 
__Jersey Number:__ 14 
__Position:__ Shooting Guard 

Before joining Shohoku, Mitsui Hisashi was an MVP for Takeishi Junior High. Despite having opportunities to join more prestigious high schools like Ryonan, he choose to go to Shohoku because of [Coach Anzai](https://anilist.co/character/12862/Anzai-Mitsuyoshi); Anzai had given him the courage to win in the Junior High tournament by encouraging him during the last seconds of the match. However, an injury to his left knee in a training session interrupted his basketbal

name: Ryouta Miyagi
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6)
__Position:__ Point Guard (PG)

He joined the basketball team because of his love for the game in the first place. But soon it seems that he is also playing for the love of his life [Ayako](https://anilist.co/character/23827/Ayako), the team manager. Although Ryonan's coach asked him to join the Ryonan Basketball Team, Miyagi chose for Shohoku because of [Anzai](https://anilist.co/character/12862/Anzai-Mitsuyoshi). Miyagi is a problem kid, he gets into fights a lot and gets himself beaten up.

Miyagi is a smart but kinda rude person, who is only nice and sweet to Ayako

name: Kaede Rukawa
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'2")
__Position:__ Small Forward, SF

Kaede Rukawa is Sakuragi's rival as well as almost his opposite; he is attractive to girls, skilled at basketball, and very cold and unfeeling. The only traits they share are that they are not academically inclined and good fighters. He regards Sakuragi as an idiot and both normally fight. Actually, he knows Sakuragi can put his talents to a better use, but is ashamed to see the immaturity with which he deals with things. His hobby is sleeping, and is usually seen asleep whenever he's not on the court; he can even ride his bike while a

name: Hanamichi Sakuragi
description:
__Height:__ 189.2 cm
__Jersey Number:__ #10
__Position:__ Power Forward

At the beginning, Sakuragi was a slacker, always trying to ask girls out but getting constantly rejected (the 50th rejection occurring at the start of the series). He then met Akagi Haruko, with whom he fell in love immediately. This passion led to him joining the Shohoku basketball team. However, as a complete beginner, he was not able to keep up with the rest of the team at first despite his physical attributes (great height, athleticism, stamina, speed and leaping ability). He regards himself as a genius though, with s

name: Takao Kasuga
description:
A middle school student who has a huge love for literature and a crush on [Saeki](https://anilist.co/character/62797/Saeki-Nanako). It is because of his infatuation of Saeki that he steals her gym uniform. [Sawa Nakamura](https://anilist.co/character/62793/Nakamura-Sawa), an isolated loner in Kasuga's class witnesses him stealing the uniform. She then blackmails him into forming a contract, tying them together as "friends."

 Initially against his contract with Nakamura, he cautiously followed her requests and disliked their meetings. However, over time he begins to see that Nakamura is actual

name: Sawa Nakamura
description: A classmate of Kasuga who is portrayed as alone, isolated, and aloof. She has no friends. Nakamura witnesses Kasuga stealing Saeki's uniform and blackmails him to become her friend and form a contract. She displays hostile and rude behavior toward Kasuga, but can often be seen enjoying herself when with him. Though she maintains a usually sane and calm demeanor, Nakamura has occasionally had emotional outbursts when expressing herself to Kasuga. It is hinted that her desire to "escape" with Kasuga stems from a desire to no longer be alone. Nakamura earnestly believes that even if Kasuga choose

name: Nanako Saeki
description:
Saeki Nanako is a smart, popular girl admired by many, but especially by a boy named Kasuga Takao. She accidently leaves her gym clothes on the floor and they are stolen by a mysterious "pervert".  Despite this, she manages to keep on smiling and manages to date her lover Kasuga. However everything starts to go downhill because of Nakamura's constant interfering.

Saeki's biggest problem isn't Nakamura herself, though. Struggling with her own loneliness, lust and confusion, she does what she thinks is best.

name: Aya Tokiwa
description: A tall girl in the same grade but different class than Kasuga. She looks strikingly similar to Nakamura and likes to read. The other high school boys admire her for her looks.

name: Ito Manabu
description: Manabu Ito is a rich medical student who is well-versed in the matters of human psychology and physiology. However, his greatest concern is in performing a surgery known as trepanation. To do this, he seeks the ideal patient, Nakoshi, who lives a life of balance. Nakoshi accepts to be his experimental guinea pig for money. Ito claims that the procedure involves drilling a small hole into the skull, and allows for a sixth sense to develop, though later maintains that his goal was to expose the idea as suggestive development (the placebo effect).

name: Susumu Nakoshi
description:
Susumu Nakoshi is a middle-aged man living in his car. Spending his time between a park full of homeless people and upper-class complex hotel, he is chosen by [Ito Manabu](https://anilist.co/character/8279/Manabu-Ito) to be an experimental guinea pig because he is neither an egocentric wealthy guy, nor a pitiful homeless man. He is "just between".

After the Trepanation, he is able to see the "monster" in each human being, things that frighten or obsess people. By studying the human nature and facing the other's fear, he'll try to understand his own person thanks to this strange and worrying 6

name: Buntarou Mori
description: A transfer student, who after being talked into climbing the school building, discovered a sense of fulfillment upon reaching the top. After which he became interested in rock-climbing. He is a loner who says he doesn't need friends, and seems to have gone through something in the past. He would rather climb a mountain alone than with a partner.

name: Shion Izumi
description: He was a psychotic yet powerful teenager who participated in the game and won his freedom before the series's events. He desired to return to the game and used a SMG and a pistol to rampage through Shinjuku, killing Hiroto Sakurai, Kenzo Sakata, and Daizaemon Kaze, and either injuring or killing 387 bystanders in broad daylight. He thus not only brought Gantz new participants but also himself because he was killed by Kurono in a standoff. He is an incredible swordsman and was the first to use the Gantz Saber, a katana with a retractable blade that was hidden in one of the apartment's rooms. He

name: Masaru Katou
description:
__Height:__ 192 cm

Masaru Katou has a good personality; he loves to help people and easily cares for everyone. His parents are dead so he is responsible for his younger brother who he is fiercely protective of. Katou usually takes the position of being a leader because he has good authority, but is unable to hurt others which hinders his performance in the game of Gantz.

Masaru Katou was [Kei Kurono](https://anilist.co/character/2867/Kurono-Kei)'s childhood friend. They meet each other again the day they die because Katou was trying to help a drunk off of the train line, with Kurono reluctan

name: Daizaemon Kaze
description: A tall and incredibly powerful martial artist who came from the countryside to Tokyo looking for a good fight. One of his signature moves is the "back attack", in which he thrusts his back against his enemies with incredible force, often sending them flying. He died against [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/5518/Izumi-Shion) in the Shinjuku massacre. He seems to care about [Takeshi](https://anilist.co/character/15451/Koumoto-Takeshi), a young child who recently joined the game and admires Kaze as his "Muscle Rider" savior. On [Kurono](https://anilist.co/character/2867/Kurono-Kei)'s request,

name: Tae Kojima
description:
She is [Kurono](https://anilist.co/character/2867/Kurono-Kei)'s first actual girlfriend, first dated on a dare. He actually falls in love with her, and they build a real relationship, Kurono appearing to be very protective of her.

After taking pictures of the Game's participants during their mission, she immediately becomes the next target (considering Gantz wants to remain unknown to outsiders). To end the mission and preserve his points, [Shion Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/5518/Izumi-Shion) takes the pleasure of murdering Tae (while [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/2953/Kishimoto-K

name: Kei Kurono
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Kei is a 10th grader summoned by Gantz, along with [Kato](https://anilist.co/character/3111/Masaru-Katou), after being hit by a subway train in an effort to help a hobo passed out on the tracks. 
Initially Gantz refers to Kurono as "Bitch" and "Loser", though he settles on "Kurono" as the series progresses.

name: Joichiro Nishi
description: Joichiro Nishi is a middle-school veteran of the Gantz world, having arrived there over a year before the beginning of the series. While running away from police officers after shoplifting, he fled onto an apartment building roof where he fell to his death.    Much like how Kurono started out, he is also selfish and has a Social Darwinist approach to life. Nishi is reluctant to reveal anything about the Gantz or himself, but he runs a web site where he posts information about it (carefully avoiding Gantz's rule about informing outsiders, which would in turn prove fatal). Gantz calls him &

name: Hiroto Sakurai
description: He is a psychic who receives instructions on how to unlock his latent powers from [Sakata](https://anilist.co/character/5522/Sakata-Kenzo) after attempting suicide. He is then encouraged by Sakata to kill his bullies who sexually abused him with the use of his powers, which he does. However, he later regrets it, realizing how it feels to be a murderer. When he and Sakata witness [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/5518/Izumi-Shion)'s Shinjuku massacre, he insists in trying to stop Izumi and convinces Sakata to join him, arguing that it is a good opportunity to redeem themselves for the murder

name: Reika Shimohira
description:
She is a beautiful, young and popular idol. Like almost everyone else, she is caught in the line of fire during [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/5518/Izumi-Shion)'s killing spree in Shinjuku. She develops a crush on [Kurono](https://anilist.co/character/2867/Kurono-Kei) after seeing him in action during her first night as a participant in the game. Surprisingly enough, she proves to be a formidable opponent against the Aliens.   

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Chihiro Rokuhira
description:
__Height:__ 170-175 cm

Son and apprentice of the master swordsmith [Kunishige Rokuhira](https://anilist.co/character/314803).

Wielder of the Enchanted Blade Enten, and a user of the Iai White Purity Style.

He possesses the "Rokuhira Eyes" which are able to see through extremely fast "invisible swordsmanship" and the eyes allow him to learn sword techniques by just seeing them once.

name: Hakuri Sazanami
description:
Hakuri is a young man that was disowned from the Sazanami clan due to being perceived as weak. He witnessed [Chihiro](https://anilist.co/character/314801) and [Sojo](https://anilist.co/character/317244)'s battle in the streets of Tokyo from a nearby restaurant and was touched by the sight of Chihiro's bravery, regarding him as a samurai. 

He possesses the extremely rare distinction of having 2 sorceries, Shockwave Manipulation and The Storehouse.

name: Sakurako Busujima
description:
She is a student at Oumi Women's University and the coworker of Iori Kitahara and Naomi Otoya. She has a crush on Otoya Naomi.
She was cheered up by Iori after Naomi rejected her confession. Soon after that, she has developed romantic feelings for Iori, of which he is unaware. She lip-locked him in front of Chisa and Aina during their second trip to Okinawa islands.

name: Lloyd Frontera
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

A drunkard whose family is in a mountain of debt. Su-Ho Kim, a civil engineer, is transmigrated into his body.

name: Javier Asrahan
description: The protagonist of the fantasy novel Iron Blooded Knight, who rises to the level of a sword grandmaster after several years of adventure. Javier Asrahan is a loyal knight of the Frontera family. He currently acts as the personal guard of [Lloyd Frontera](https://anilist.co/character/269308/Frontera-Lloyd) and accompanies him on nearly every occasion.

name: Alicia Magentano
aliases: 艾利西亞·特爾米納·瑪真塔諾

name: Gong-Ja Kim
description:
Gong-Ja Kim is an aspiring hunter who is jealous of the #1 ranker: the [Flame Emperor](https://anilist.co/character/211825/Yu-SoHa). 

Before entering the tower, Gong-Ja lived his life as an orphan. Even after entering, he was a below-average hunter who adored and worshipped higher rankers. This admiration later turned into envy though, and Soo-Ha Yoo became the main subject of Gong-Ja's jealousy. This below-average hunter's life changed when he received an S-Rank Skill Card for the toxic envy he developed. His gifted S-Rank Skill Card allowed him to receive the power of those who killed him.

name: Helen
description: Number 22 in Clare's generation, Helen's specialty is attacking her enemies with her stretching arms, giving her a surprisingly long range of attack, as well as the ability to constrict the enemy. Hot tempered and aggressive, Helen mocked Clare because of her rank when she joined the hunting party, but she eventually grew to respect her later on.

name: Deneve
description:
Deneve is a defensive type Claymore, and thus sports powerful regenerative abilities.

She has a rather calm and empathetic personality, and is quite different from her friend [Helen](https://anilist.co/character/2732/Helen). She was part of the awakened-hunting squad led by [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/2702/Miria), along with Helen and [Clare](https://anilist.co/character/2188/Clare). Deneve is number 15 of the 78th generation

name: Seiichi Osabe
description: He is a shy and insecure school student.

name: Seiko Osabe
description: She is Seiichi's mother. She is very overprotective with her son and will do anything for him. She is very manipulative.

name: Killy
description:
Killy is the main character who is on the unenviable task to find a human with the Net Terminal Gene within the Megastructure to access the Netsphere. He is equipped with a Gravitational Beam Emitter (GBE), a petite but awesome weapon capable of creating holes miles long in the Megastructure. He is soon joined by [Cibo](https://anilist.co/character/3763/Cibo) in his quest.

Looking to be in his early to mid-20's (Once saying that his "growth period is over."), he is a glum looking person, never smiling (except madly when shooting on occasion) and has a slight slouch in his normal standing posi

name: Cibo
description: Cibo is a main character in the manga BLAME! by Tsutomu Nihei. She is the head scientist of the Electronic Corporation in the Capitol and joins Killy on his quest for the Net Terminal Gene.    Killy 's first encounter with Cibo is in the lower levels of the Corporation in The Capitol, where she has been imprisoned for attempting to access the Net Sphere with an artificially created version of Net Terminal Genes. Her failed attempt to access the Net Sphere led to the appearance of the Safeguard, which destroyed the entire lab facility that Cibo was conducting the experiment in. The death and de

name: Geu Sonyeon
description: The boy who lost their parents live with one hope: that he can walk with the [girl](https://anilist.co/character/197692/Geu-Sonyeo) forever...until they come across adults who are trying to take that hope away.

name: Geu Sonyeo
description:
The girl who lost her father due to an infectious disease, contracted from someone on the bus who they ventured with.
Meets the boy unexpectedly on the bus, and together they walk on the path for as long as they can.

name: Yotsuba Koiwai
description:
__Height__: 107 cm

She has a carefree and energetic personality, taking delight in simple matters even as she learns about all manner of things in her daily life. In Japanese, Yotsuba's dialogue is written without kanji, making it seem simpler and more child-like, and in a typeface that gives the impression of speaking with high intensity. Her energy is noted by other characters, especially members of the neighboring Ayase family. Her father says of her carefree nature, "She can find happiness in anything. Nothing in this world can get her down." However, when deeply frightened or upset, she

name: Yousuke Koiwai
description: Koiwai is [Yotsuba](https://anilist.co/character/3568/Koiwai-Yotsuba)'s adoptive father. The circumstances of her adoption are obscure; he tells [Fuuka](https://anilist.co/character/7742/Ayase-Fuuka) that without intending to, he found himself taking care of her while somewhere overseas, but gives no other details. Though he acknowledges Yotsuba is a bit odd, he can be offbeat himself. He is depicted as something of a slacker; he habitually wears an undershirt and boxer shorts when working at home during the summer, and apologizes more than once for being irresponsible. He works from home as a

name: Takashi Takeda
description:
A friend of Koiwai and Yotsuba, having known Koiwai since they were childhood classmates. Standing 2m10 (6 ft 11 in) tall, he dwarfs the other characters, especially Yotsuba.
He is always called by the nickname "Jumbo," and when Fuka learns his real name she calls it "common." He works at his father's flower shop, as Yotsuba discovers when she meets him there. He helps the Koiwais move in and frequently visits their house, where he is more or less treated as a member of the family by Yotsuba.

__Personality__: Jumbo has a dry sense of humor and is prone to deadpan quip

name: Fuuka Ayase
description: The middle Ayase sister, Fuuka is in her second year at a local high school. She is the most responsible of the sisters, and during Yotsuba's first visit to her school, one student calls her "vice-president." She finds herself frequently helping the Koiwais, even though she does not intend to and is more flustered by their eccentricities than anyone else. Fuuka is often teased by the other characters, especially about her fashion sense and sense of humor. She is fond of making bad puns, which irritates Asagi, and wearing shirts with odd or interesting graphics (such as Chiyo&#03

name: Ena Ayase
description: The youngest Ayase sister, Ena is a few years older than Yotsuba and her most frequent playmate. She is sensible for her age and tries to be responsible by recycling and limiting her use of air conditioning. Her attempts to spare Yotsuba's feelings sometimes lead her to make little white lies, such as praising Yotsuba's childish sketches or letting her believe that Miura's cardboard costume is a real robot named Cardbo (in ADV's translation) or Danbo (in Yen's translation) (ダンボー, Danbō), with consequences that rebound on herself and Miura. Ena likes drawing, something

name: Asagi Ayase
description: The eldest of the three Ayase sisters, Asagi lives at home while attending a nearby university. She is depicted as an attractive young woman who enjoys teasing people, especially her parents; her friend Torako describes her as a horrible person for teasing Ena. She is the best of her family at managing Yotsuba, and her mother claims she was much like Yotsuba when she was young. Asagi's irreverence may have come from her mother's teasing when she was a child—for example, when Asagi found a four-leaf clover, Mrs. Ayase asked for a five-leaf clover instead, which Asagi could not f

name: Kou Nakano
description:
Kou Nakano is an Ajin. 
Nakano is very considerate of others; stating he wanted to help Kei with taking down Satō, and later helping Kei escape even after he locked him in a wrecked truck. He was also concerned for Izumi, saying she shouldn't put herself in danger. He is also a bit clumsy compared with other characters and often doesn't know what's going on. As seen in the recent chapters, he is not good with coming up with plans and prefers to improvise instead. This results in him relying on Kei a lot with strategic plans, much to Kei's annoyance. 

it is revealed that Kō had first died when

name: Toto-sama
description: The main antagonist of Noragami, as well as Yato's and Nora's parents. What lies underneath his mysterious appearance is a deep hatred for the gods and by extension, the humans who worship them after a tragic death of a loved one. He is a skilled manipulator and is very vocal about the heaven's injustice.

name: Jousuke Higashikata
description:
Seemingly a sailor who is amnesiac about all details of his personal life.  For some reason, he has 4 testicles.

The real identity of this character is unknown. The second chapter stated that the Jojolion protagonist's name could be Yoshikage Kira, however, it is later revealed that he is merely a doppelganger for the real [Kira](https://anilist.co/character/54055/Kira-Yoshikage). He was later given the name Jousuke by the Higashikata family, who took him in. However, DNA testing implies that they are nearly the same person.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Joubin Higashikata
description:
__Nationality__: Japanese

Jobin Higashikata is an antagonist featured in the eighth part of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, JoJolion. 

Jobin is the eccentric eldest son of the Higashikata Family. He is married with Mitsuba Higashikata and has a son, Tsurugi. Beyond his job at the Higashikata Fruit Company, Jobin was formerly one of the members of the Rock Humans' Locacaca Organization. 

In his room, he keeps a large shelving unit full of display cases for exotic beetles. It is hinted that his fondness for beetles is the way they symbolize strength. He breeds beetles to make them fight and conside

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Yasuho Hirose
description:
__Height__: 166 cm (5'5")
__Occupation__: University Student
__Stand__: Paisley Park

A young girl who lives in the town of Morioh in the new timeline of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. After the events of the March 11th earthquake she finds a mysterious naked man lying under rubble and decides to save him.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Tsurugi Higashikata
description: Tsurugi Higashikata, the youngest member of the Higashikata family, is the son of Jobin and Mitsuba Higashikata. Tsurugi's stand, Paper Moon King, allows him to transform objects into origami and create illusions.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Rai Mamezuku
description:
Rai Mamezuku is a reclusive plant appraiser secretly employed by the Higashikata Fruit Company. Rai is an eccentric, blunt, quick-witted, and analytical man who often comes across as cold-hearted. He is extremely antisocial, going to great lengths in order to stay isolated. His stand, Doggy Style, allows him to unravel his body into band-like cords.

He is struck by calamity after trying to attack Wonder of U, and as a result, is killed by Josuke's bubbles.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: JoJolion

name: Reiji Kurose
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Due to his family situation and feeling tied down to his hometown by his responsibilities to support them, he gradually spiraled into depression. Occasionally, contemplating suicide.

name: Nagi Aoe
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

Nagi Aoe is an idol that recently moved into [Kurose](https://anilist.co/character/170177/Kurose-Reiji)'s town, where she worked as a convenience store clerk. She has recently stepped down from her work as an idol. 

Married to [Nozoe Esemori](https://anilist.co/character/215475/Esemori-Kousaku).

name: Alice
description:
__Name:__ Alice/ B-Rabbit  
__Height:__ 150 cm  
__Affiliation:__ Pandora's Member  
__Base of Operations:__ Vessalius Mansion, Rainsworth Mansion, Pandora Headquarters  
__Occupation:__ Chain  
__Contractor:__ [Oz Vessalius](https://anilist.co/character/13835/Vessalius-Oz) 

The heroine of the story. Alice first appears as a chain that persuades Oz to form a contract with her in the Abyss. In fact, she is actually the infamous B-Rabbit (Bloodstained Black Rabbit), the strongest chain in the Abyss. 

Alice's goal is to find her lost memories, which play a major role in the story. She has a hug

name: Xerxes Break
native: ザークシーズ・ブレイク
description:
__Height:__ 177.5 cm (5'10")  

Commonly known as Break, he is a member of Pandora and a servant of the Rainsworth household. Break's appearance does not change from the ten year gap between Oz entering and leaving the Abyss. He has a legal contract with the Mad Hatter. Break is often seen with a doll on his shoulder, which he calls Emily. He adores sweets and cakes. From the outside, Break seems like a carefree character, never serious and always smiling. When needs be, however, Break shows his dangerous and evil side. Reim tells Oz that Break has not always been the way he is now. Before, af

name: Gilbert Nightray
native: ギルバート・ナイトレイ
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Oz's best friend and loyal servant. To him, Oz is his most precious person, and he is willing to sacrifice anything for him. He was taken into the Vessalius family after being discovered in an injured state 15 years ago. He was invited by Oz to attend the coming of age ceremony as his friend. During the ceremony, he was controlled by a chain in the Baskerville's possession and forced to attack Oz. After regaining consciousness, Gilbert manages to see the face of one of the hooded people and for some reason jumps in the way of Oz's attack to protect him.

name: Sharon Rainsworth
native: シャロン・レインズワース
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")

The Lady of the Rainsworth household. Sharon is a member of Pandora and looks like a thirteen year old girl, although she is chronologically 23 years old. Her appearance does not change from her first meeting with Oz to after he came out of the Abyss because she has a legal contract with a chain, the black unicorn Eques.   Sharon and Break have a close relationship. It is she who discovers Break after he was found in front of the Rainsworth household's gate to the abyss. When she was young, she used to call Break 'Brother Xerx', as he was like a big brother to her. S

name: Oz Vessalius
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'4")
__Age:__ 25 (Legal Age)

A 15-year-old boy with blond hair and green eyes from the prestigious Vessalius family, whose father is the reigning lord. His mother was killed by the Nightray family, but despite this, he retains a bright, optimistic, and energetic personality. The story of Pandora Hearts starts when Oz turns fifteen. During the ceremony to celebrate this reaching of adulthood, he was dragged into the Abyss for the sin of 'existing'. There he meets the chain named [Alice](https://anilist.co/character/13836/Alice) and makes a contract with her.

name: I-Jin Yu
description: As the only survivor of a plane crash, Ijin became a mercenary in order to survive. 10 years later, he returned to his home country where his family was. As a former mercenary, he attends school and is currently a senior.

name: Hyun-Su Cha
description:
The main character of the story. An isolated, lonely teenager who is forced to move when his family dies in a traffic accident. He is eighteen years old and stopped going to high school due to unknown reasons. He spends his time trolling and tricking on internet, as well as playing various RPGs. He sold his old house and moved into Green Home apartments (room 1410) because the money left by his deceased family was insufficient for him to survive as an isolated person. He then proceeds to chose October 25th as a date to commit suicide.

Hyun is a human infected with the monsterization, but figh

name: Eun-Hyuk Lee
description:
Eighteen year old Hyuk Lee is the leader of the Green Roof Apartments Survivors and Eun Lee's older brother. He is also one of the deuteragonists of the series with the others being some of the Green Roof Apartment survivors.

Hyuk is an intelligent and level-headed young man with an affinity for leadership. He often plans the many missions the survivors need to undertake. He is unafraid to take risks and is pragmatic, such as accepting an infected human into their ranks, if it helps boost their success rates. He also was prepared to take underhanded measures to tip the odds in his favor. Howe

name: Ji-Su Yun
description: A girl who recently moved into Green Home apartments (room 1510) the same day as Hyun.

name: Sang-Uk Pyeon
description:
Thirty two year old Wook Pyeon, also called Mr. Mobster by some of the other residents, is a former police detective and a resident of Green Roof Apartments. He is fierce-looking and he appears to have a gangster manner. However, he calls himself a "good fella". He got fired for putting the son of an important person in hospital. 

Due to his background, he is more aggressive than others. He still uses physical force to keep others in line, such as Hyun Cha. Despite this, he means well and will selflessly put his life on the line to save others. He appears confident in his ability to live and

name: Ayame Moriya
description: Younger sister of Karen and the new team manager for the Eimei High badminton team.

name: Meiko Inoue
description: Meiko graduated from university two years ago and lives in an apartment in Tokyo with her boyfriend [Taneda](https://anilist.co/character/18351/Taneda-Naruo). She has no real goals or direction in life and stepped into society as a rather clueless person. She worked as an office lady, but soon grew unhappy and decided to quit her job. Having broken her routine, Meiko enjoys a sense of freedom, but her uncertainty soon returns and she, along with her boyfriend, must learn to embrace their unpredictable future.

name: Naruo Taneda
description: Taneda is Meiko's boyfriend and lives in an apartment with her in Tokyo. They support themselves through their jobs (Taneda is an illustrator in a press company), but both up and quit when they realise they just aren't happy. Taneda has a great passion for music and is a guitarist and vocalist in a band with his friends. After quitting his job he decides to try and make it in the music industry by going pro.

name: Aya Oosawa
description: Part of the popular crowd, her grades aren't great but she has good communication skills and has a lot of friends. Popular with the guys at school but she takes no interest in them.

appearsIn.title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All

name: Mitsuki Koga
description: Has a quiet and reserved personality, her classmates mistake her for an anime otaku. She can be a little airheaded in certain circumstances.

appearsIn.title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All

name: Jin-Hyeok Kang
description:
Kang Jin-Hyeok is the protagonist of [I’m the Max-Level Newbie](https://anilist.co/manga/137280/Na-Honja-Mallep-Newbie/).

__Unique Ability:__
Fusion

__Skills:__

- The Eye of Truth 
- Fire Element 
- Commune 
- Stigma of Soul 
- Shallow Breathing 
- Cold Heart 
- Monopolize

name: Tomomi Nomiya
description: Nomiya was once the captain of his institute’s basketball team before he left school. Some time ago, he was involved in a motorbike accident while giving a girl a ride, leaving her severely injured. Burdened by guilt, he now visits her often. Determined to change his life for the better, Nomiya dedicates himself to helping others and does whatever he can to support a wheelchair basketball team.

name: Hisanobu Takahashi
description: At the start of the manga, Takahashi is a typical high school alpha male-- captain of the basketball team, popular with girls, effortlessly smart, and a bully to other "inferior" students. In an effort to give his girlfriend a ride home after school, he steals a bicycle, is chased into traffic, and is hit by a garbage truck, rendering him paralyzed from the chest down. Realizing that his popular days are over, Takahashi feels that he has nothing to live for, and that he has dropped from an "A" class person to lower than an "E" class (Takahashi is obsessed with ran

name: Kiyoharu Togawa
description: Forced to spend all of his free time after school practicing the piano, Togawa was something of an outcast to the rest of his junior high classmates. During the last PE class of the first semester, Togawa agrees to race the 100M dash against the fastest boy in his class and nearly beats him, earning an invitation to the school's track team. Togawa soon dedicates his life to becoming the fastest sprinter in the nation, but just as his goal seems in reach, he is diagnosed with osteosarcoma and loses his right leg below the knee. Togawa spends much of his time after the amputation in isolation, f

name: Desir Herrman
aliases: Desir Arman (デジール・アルマン)
description:
__Magic Circle Rank:__ Tier 3 (Analysis Magic)

Desir Herrman is the central protagonist of A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special. After his return to the past upon the failure of clearing the Shadow World, he resolves to strengthen his allies so that the future doesn’t get repeated. In Hebrion Academy, commoners are frowned upon and put into the Beta class whilst the nobles are designated the alpha class, Desir is one of the commoners who hates the class system and wants things to change. As a result he and his friends set out to close the gap by showing the teachers and aristocrats that commo

appearsIn.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

name: Pram Schneider
aliases: プラム・シュナイザー
description:
__Circle Tier Level:__ 3 (Swordmage)

Pram is a member of Desir Arman's alpha party made of commoners.

 Pram’s weapon of choice was a rapier made of Blankšum, left by his noble father (The super light rapier). The sword was originally in a rusted hilt and was sold to a pawn shop for little money. Later on, Desir Arman and Pram go back to take the sword back, and after a disagreement, Desir is forced to fight the merchant's bodyguard and take the sword back to its rightful owner

appearsIn.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

name: Romantica Eru
description:
__Circle Tier Level:__ 3 (Wind Mage)

When Desir Arman first meets Romantica after returning from the Shadow Labyrinth she exhibits a superiority complex due to her position as a noble which slowly decreases as the story progresses and she gets to know Desir Arman. 

 Later on in the it is discovered that Romantica is the illegitimate child of a baron and the only reason that she has the title of a noble is that her mother traded her life so that Romantica wouldn't have to live the impoverished "commoner's" life. As the story progresses Desir offers her a chance to join the beta class and beca

appearsIn.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

name: Azest Kingscrown
aliases: アゼスト・キングスクラウン
description:
__Circle Level Tier:__ 4 (Swordmage)

Azest Jedgar F. Roguepalace was the firstborn of Gilltian Jedgar F. Roguepalace, the current emperor of the Hebrion Empire and thus the heir to the Hebrion throne. Initially Azest was a cold person and she tends to be uninterested about other people unless they consist of her close friends in the Desir group.
 Azest was one of the six survivors of the Shadow Labyrinth who defeated Brohmier Napolitan along with Desir Arman. She was the core figure of their attack force and their swordmage. She dealt the final blow to kill the boss of the shadow world.

appearsIn.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special

name: Tokio Kurohara
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

The protagonist of Choujin X. Tokio is a second-year student at Tsuru High, and is a good friend of [Azuma Higashi](https://anilist.co/character/224490/Azuma-Higashi)'s. Following the events of the first chapter, Tokio became a Bestial Choujin.

As a small child, he and his classmates went on a field trip to a zoo, where they had to draw an animal that represented them. After Azuma got compared to a lion, Tokio's peers decided to mock him by comparing him to a vulture, an animal that has negative undertones associated with it. They continued to bully him until he broke down

name: Azuma Higashi
description:
__Height:__ 158cm

Deuteragonist of Choujin X. He is [Tokio Kurohara](https://anilist.co/character/224464/Tokio-Kurohara)'s best friend. Azuma is a short yet very athletic young man who is described as possessing rather attractive features. He has short white hair in a bowl cut, yellow eyes and can usually be seen wearing glasses.

Azuma has a very straightforward and heroic personality. Due to his father being an accomplished police officer, Azuma was raised with the mentality to always be ready to help people in need, no matter who they are.
Azuma and Tokio have been friends since childhood.

name: Ely Otta
description:
__Height:__ 135 cm

She is upbeat, kind, determined, yet stubborn. She tries to help as many people as she can, but has been shown to be quite unforgiving in regards to people who've wronged her or anyone else. She also has a mature side, being rational and level-headed when talking about the reasoning behind her clearly set goals or dreams.
Ely is terrified of ending up just like her mother, so from a very young age she imposed several moral codes upon herself. She strongly believes that "All life comes from the soil" and "All that is borrowed must be returned". However, her mother's actions

name: Kakeru Kurosawa
description: Quiet and introverted, Kakeru keeps to himself - especially as he has a dark secret. Spending each afternoon in the girls bathroom masturbating, he loves being able to picture doing perverted things with females who wouldn't normally look at him twice. With much to learn about life, Kakeru finds that friendship and romance are much more important than painting the inside of a toilet stall.    Kurosawa spends time at the school library everyday, reading. He reads many books. He is also camera-shy and does not socialize with others, preferring to be a loner.

name: Yeo-Un Cheon
description:
He was a member of the Cheon Family and was the son of a female servant who worked at the Lord’s chamber and was not from the Six Clans. Although considered as an illegitimate son of the Lord due to a servant mother, he was still part of the Cheon family and he had the right to the throne but had an extremely low chance without support. 

He doesn't learn any martial arts in his early 15 years due to his oath with the Lord's wives from Six Clans. After entering the Demonic Academy, only then did he learn Martial Arts and have an unimaginable growth rate due to Nano Machine'a support.

name: Akira
description: Codename #28 in the Japanese government's secret ESP project. An estimately 8 year old boy around whom the story revolves. Akira's power was so immense that he inadvertantly caused the destruction of Tokyo in 1988 and was secretly sealed afterwards in a cryogenic chamber underneath the destruction site.  *Manga Spoilers*    Unlike in the animated feature, Akira makes an actual appearance in the manga. After his awakening by Tetsuo, he loses control of his power again as he witnesses his friend Takashi being murdered, and the destruction of Neo-Tokyo ensues.  Though he is known as the figurehea

name: Keiji Kiriya
description: A new recruit in the United Defense Force. He finds himself caught in a time loop where he wakes up one day in the past after having been killed on the battlefield. Through the training and battles he experiences in these loops he comes into his own as a soldier.

name: Rita Vrataski
description:
A U.S. special forces soldier. Highly decorated and peerless in battle, she is seen as a hero by the entire world.
 In reality, she was caught in a time loop just like Keiji.

name: Junichirou Tanizaki
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8.5")
__Ability:__ Light Snow

He is a member of the Armed Detective Agency and the older brother of [Naomi](https://anilist.co/character/89209/Tanizaki-Naomi).

name: Sensei
description:
He is a cursed being who was a doctor in the past. He found [Shiva](https://anilist.co/character/123988/Shiva) and took care of her while hiding from her that she was abandoned.

He has a good heart and does everything for his little protégé, not hesitating to risk his life.

appearsIn.title: The Girl From the Other Side: Siúil, a Rún

name: Shiva
description:
She is a little girl who does not seem to be touched by the curse.
She was picked up by sensei, but unaware that she was abandoned, she believes that her auntie will come back one day to look for her and she looks forward to her return.
She is a naive child; sweet and innocent, she is not aware of the danger that surrounds her.

appearsIn.title: The Girl From the Other Side: Siúil, a Rún

name: Mu-Won Jin
description: The last descendant of the 4th generation leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect, Kwan-Ho Jin. With his supposed death 10 years ago, he reappears as the 5th generation leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect and given the title "The Northern Blade".

appearsIn.title: The Legend of the Northern Blade

name: Ji-U Seo
description:
He is a very bright and kind person who will go out of his way to help the people around him. His main ability is super speed. 

In the past, Ji-U had no friends because he was afraid that people would discover his powers and those they discovered would treat him like a freak. The first friend he made was a stray cat, which led to his adoration for cats today.

His mentor is Kayden Break, who started to live with him. He is friends with Ji-Seok Yu, U-In, and Su-Bin Lee.

name: Kayden Break
description: Kayden is a secret agent on the run, who finds himself stuck in the body of a fat old fluffy cat. The strongest unaffiliated person in the world, capable to crush even those trained by the groups, which had accumulated vast amounts of data in their systems over the years. He is teaching Jiwoo about the awakened world as his teacher and coach.

name: Hyung-Suk Park
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4’11”) (Old Body), 178.5 cm (5’10”½) (New Body)
__Relatives:__ His mother, David, Dylan, and Sarah (cousins)

Hyung-Suk is a student in the fashion department of J High School. He has a unique ability in which he can transfer his consciousness in and out at will between two completely different bodies. He is a very kind and friendly person at heart, preferring to avoid unnecessary conflicts if he can, but will help those in need even in dangerous situations.

(Source: Lookism Wikia)

name: Shintarou Jagasaki
description: Jagasaki works as a night patrol in a town called Buppa. Although he has the authority due to his job, he seems to have lack of perseverance even towards some street thugs. His catchphrase is "shoot 'em up", while pretending his right hand is a gun.

name: Clarabelle Kawamoto
description: Jagasaki workmate.

name: Chiharu Matsuyamachi
description: He is the main antagonist of the Jagaaaaaan manga and one of the most powerful fractured human warriors seen thus far. He was infected with a frenzied tadpole and became the fractured human warrior "Hidarikki" and got the ability to grow and manipulate wood on his body and met his partner, The Hawk of Paradise Naraku.

name: Cale  Henituse
description:
__Relatives:__
- Deruth Henituse (father)
- Drew Thames (deceased mother)
- Violan Henituse (stepmother)
- Basen Henituse (younger step-brother)
- Lily Henituse (younger half-sister)
- Albert Crossman (sworn brother)

__Occupation:__ 
Supreme Commander of the Allied Armies (formerly)
__Affiliations:__ Henituse Family, Roan Kingdom

 Cale‘s original personality was that of a spoiled brat. His mother died when he was very young and his father remarried and created a family he didn't like. He used to be a 'good boy', but he began acting 'trash'-y at the tender age of 8 and started drinking when h

name: Choi  Han
description:
__Occupation:__ Swordmaster, Dragon Slayer
__Abilities:__ Black Yong, Ancient Powers, Sword of Disasters, Dominating Aura, Abandoning Life

name: Raon Mir
description:
A 6 year old black dragon (he was 4 years old at the beginning of the story) who started following [Cale](https://anilist.co/character/187471/Henituse-Cale) after he was saved by him from [Venion Sten](https://anilist.co/character/277605/Sten-Venion). He was imprisioned and tortured by Venion for the span of four years. 

Cale gave the Dragon the name Raon Miru, pure Korean for "Joyful Dragon" after the black dragon asked him to do so.

He possesses destructive impulses but looks out for his newfound family. 

Raon would give tear-soaked apple pie slices to Cale whenever Cale overused his powe

name: Vikir van Baskerville
description: The Hound of the Baskerville Clan who regressed after being cut down by the blade of the guillotine.

name: Yeon-U Cha
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm 

Yeon-woo is the main protagonist of the Korean web Novel, Second Life Ranker. Prior to entering the tower, he served in the army and later on went to take on the revenge for his younger twin brother. Yeon-woo later reawakened as a 'Dragon Human' becoming a 'player' after receiving the powers from the pocket watch of [Jeon-woo](https://anilist.co/character/165469/JeongWoo-Cha). He continues to climb the tower taking revenge on those who betrayed his brother and killed him.

He is a hard-working and determined person who greatly cherishes his family. Yeon-Woo was different f

name: Cheong-Myeong
description: Cheong-Myeong usually has a carefree nature and enjoys fooling around. However, when he has a goal, he sets his mind to it. Cheong-Myeong is intelligent, but often uses that to his advantage (but sometimes end up offending others). He enjoys drinking and indulges himself with food. Cheong-Myeong is sadistic and likes playing around with his seniors. He has confidence and doesn't waver in every situation and knows when he should retreat or run away.

name: Yslat Han
description: He was a master of the game 'Pick Me Up' who went by the nickname of Loki and was ranked 5th in it. One day, he gets brought into the world of Taoneer as Han Yslat, a 1-star playable character.

name: Jenna Shirai
description: 1-star hero, who was summoned at the same time as [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546). She learned archery from her father, who was a hunter.

name: Jae-Hwan
description: Jaehwan is a young, South Korean male who was summoned to the Tower of Nightmares, a large construct consisting of 100 floors brimming with perilous monsters. Jaehwan's sole mission is climbing the Tower and saving humanity, which suffers from "Tower Impacts".

name: Yu
description:
Yu is the main character of The Boxer. He becomes a professional boxer under the tutelage of the legendary [K](https://anilist.co/character/208937/K).

Yu has a very dark and melancholic appearance, with unstyled jet-black hair that drapes down loosely on his head, distinctively coal-black eyes with even darker pupils and a wholly disinterested facial expression painted on his face with an equally 'dead' look in his eyes. He has a very skinny body which belies his deceptively athletic abilities.

Yu has a startlingly emotionless and disinterested persona, taking little to no interest in anythi

name: K
description: K is one the supporting characters in The Boxer. He is a legendary boxing trainer, having raised 5 boxing world champions. He is currently training Yu.

name: Alma
description:
Alma works as a Troubleshooter on Troubleshooters' Office on the surface with [Tao](https://anilist.co/character/185726/Tao), where they get paid for any work a client wants to be done, making their other work where they kill off calamities appear to be a secret job for him and [Tao](https://anilist.co/character/185726/Tao). 
Alma is a child born of a demon and a man, a half-calamity.

name: Tao Saotome
description: Tao is one of the main protagonists in Gokurakugai manga series. On the surface, she works as a Troubleshooter, where they are paid by clients who need any type of job done, making her and [Alma's](https://anilist.co/character/185725) other profession where they kill off calamities like a secret job.

name: Jin Runcandel
description: The youngest son of Runcandel family.

name: Makoto Okazaki
description: Makoto Okazaki is your run of the mill high-schooler, a perfect bullying target and a closet pervert. One night, on his way to return a DVD to a friend, he notices a person on a nearby rooftop. The person lunges at him and bites his neck, drinking his blood. The attacker, a beautiful girl, then asks him: "Do you want to die or become like me?" He decides to live...

name: Yukiko Gosho
description: Makoto's friend. She is antisocial and withdrawn from the rest of the group, she likes to eat lunch alone in a secluded place outside the classroom.

name: Do-Heun  Chang
description: One of the members of the gang. He is known for his muscular physique but meek demeanor. Ken recruited Chang in a fight by using a variety of tactics to take him down. He loves his car and his hobby taking care of it.    He apparently dies in Chapter 84 falling from a building under construction, but survives the fall thanks to his car.

name: Kae-Lyn Kim
description: The sexy weapon instructor during the mountain training.   She is the female member of the gang and also the "cleaner" of the Sun-Ken Group. She is a weapons specialist, mainly knife, and is obsessed with Ken.

name: Ken Kitano
description:
A high-school delinquent and the primary protagonist who drops out of school and leaves Japan in pursuit of his love, [Yumin](https://anilist.co/character/31889/Yoshizawa-Yumi). While in Korea he lives his life as a shut-in for an entire year being unable to find an actual job. After saving an old man from being killed by loan sharks, he was scouted and invited to join a local gang(gondal) to work under [Tae-soo](https://anilist.co/character/13825/Park-Tae-Soo) as one of his underlings.

After fighting against Tae-soo, he was offered the position of boss instead. He initially declined since he

name: San-ki Lee
description: The first member of Tae-Soo's gang after the death of Tae-Soo's father long before the story begins and one of Ken's henchmen. He is loyal to both Tae-Soo and Ken. An Ex Korean soldier, he often fights dual-handed with wrenches.

name: Tae-Soo Park
description: A Korean gangster and the true mastermind behind most of the gang's more underhanded actions. Originally the boss of the gang, he passed leadership over to Ken as he realized his potential and charisma. He serves as Ken's right-hand​ man, and has numerous underground connections and is in charge of handling the day-to-day business of the gang. He can be seen as the real evil behind the gang and is often doing dirty works for the gang, but his loyalty to Ken is unquestionable. He took over the gang after his father was killed. He was later put into a coma by Ban-Phuong's men.  (Source: Wikipedi

name: San-dae Yang
description: One of the original members of Tae-Soo's gang and one of Ken's henchman. He dislikes Ken and often While his loyalty is sometimes questionable, he is highly competitive and does not back down from a fight. He left his village when he was 16 after he had sex with a farmer's wife. Later on San-dae finds his hometown turned into a US Army Base and realizes that he can never go back to his previous life. His nickname comes from the fact that he uses an actual pickaxe in combat.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yumi Yoshizawa
description:
Ken's love interest, a girl that left Japan to become a cop in the department in charge of organized crime. Her true name is Yumi and she is actually Japanese.

She hates gangsters, later it is discovered that she is the daughter of a Japanese Yakuza Boss that killed Ken's parents. Her hatred of gangs is due to her mother and sister being killed by other Yakuza when she was young. As the daughter of a Yakuza boss, she has mastered some martial arts and is a very capable fighter. She also has feelings for Ken while not knowing he is an underworld boss. Later she was kidnapped by Kim Ban-Phuong'

name: Derrick Eckhart
description: __Height:__ 185cm

name: Penelope Eckhart
description:
Penelope is the adoptive daughter of the Eckhart family.

The protagonist, Siyeon Cha, transmigrates into Penelope's body after struggling with the Hard Mode of the game Daughter of the Duke - Love Project! and falling asleep. After years of abuse, the protagonist has become a cold-hearted and independent person. She can also be very sarcastic.

name: Callisto Regulus
description:
__Height:__ 188cm

The crown prince of the Empire of Eorka, Callisto Regulus is a cruel tyrant who treats humans like dirt. It is hinted that there may be an ill-fated reason for his disposition.

name: Hiromi Hayakari
description:
Hiromi is a teenage girl from an all-girl school who meets [Hideo](https://anilist.co/character/37610) in the 'Sea of Trees' at the base of Mount Fuji. As first, she mistakes him for someone contemplating suicide and comforts him, after which the two become close friends.

She has a boyfriend who she simply acknowledges as Shinji, though she hasn't seen him since the outbreak.

Later, she is infected by a zombie baby but still retains most of her personality. However, at times she starts to see the world as some sort of child-like vision, viewing people as off-putting stuffed animals. After be

name: Tsugumi Oda
description:
A girl who befriends [Hideo](https://anilist.co/character/37610) and [Hiromi](https://anilist.co/character/78073) during their refuge at the Outlet Mall. Before the outbreak, she was a nurse.

After discovering she's pregnant, Oda attempts to leave Hideo and Hiromi so as to not inconvenience them. They catch up with her, but Oda is eventually infected after being bitten by a zombie baby. In her last moments of human consciousness, she jumps into the back of a garbage truck along with the baby and manages to persuade Hiromi to push the button that operates the trucks mechanism, crushing her and

name: Hideo Suzuki
description: Hideo is a down-on-his-luck mangaka who found work as an assistant after his own series was cancelled due to poor sales. He comes across as fairly timid and insecure, but often has spurs of confidence. He suffers from delusions and is very anxious, especially when in the dark. Despite Japan's strict laws on firearms, he owns a shotgun to which he has a license. This makes him a very desirable person to hang around with following the outbreak, but Hideo is very serious when it comes to the law and won't allow anyone else to even touch his gun.

name: Ja-Hyeon Jo
description:
__Place of Birth:__ Incheon, South Korea
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew 
__Height:__ 178cm 

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ja_hyuni/)

Ja-Hyeon is a member and ace of the Hummingbird Crew and a junior at Sunny High School.

He usually assumes a serious and emotionless expression. He appears cold hearted, but very much so cares about the friends he has and his little brother. His minimal expression of emotion doesn't allow him to articulate his feelings very well, but sometimes his few words mean a lot.
