Ja-Hyeon is a well rounded cyclist. Throughout the competition, he is acknowled

name: Min-U Yun
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

Minu is quite a simple and good guy. He is loyal to his words and his friends and seems to be a rather pure guy. When people provoke him he most likely falls for it since he is very emotional and impulsive. Furthermore he is really tough and can endure some pain. He is quick to anger when someone he cherishes is threatened.

He gets run over by a car from a member of Team Scorpion while trying to protect [Jay](https://anilist.co/character/137282/Jo-JaHyeon). He remains crippled in a wheelchair from this accident.

name: Yu-Bin Hong
description:
Vinny Hong is a student at Gunn High and the current leader of the Sabbath Crew. He was previously a member of the Zephyrus Crew along with [Minu](https://anilist.co/character/140298/Yun-Min-U) and [June](https://anilist.co/character/233793/Lee-Jun-Su), the Hummingbird Crew, and the Ghost Crew..

He cares deeply about his mom and does not tolerate anyone who disrespects his mother, not even her self-deprecation. His childhood sweetness does make an appearance once in a while. He displays a great deal of empathy, even while displaying it through hardened words.

Yu-Bin has a condition called Wa

name: Shelly
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Place of birth:__ Manchester, England
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/shelly_______x/)

Shelly has a crush on [Jay](https://anilist.co/character/137282/Jo-JaHyeon). She is the only female member of the Humming Bird Crew.

Because she stayed at England before coming to Korea her personality is perceived as very headstrong. She does not like it when people talk badly about her friends, especially Jay. Described as someone who can confidently express her thoughts and feelings. Although her words are harsh, it is because she never suga

name: Han-Nam Kang
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/hannam_x_jordan/)

Dom is a Junior at Sunny High School. He is the son of a gang leader. He is interested in making music in the future and works part-time as a DJ at his father's club, WD Club. He is quite the sneakerhead and spends his money on his collection.
Dom is caring towards his friends and others and does his best to get involved.

Dom is very good at sprinting and riding on straight distances. He is also good at hand-to-hand combat and wrestling

name: Tomie
description:
Tomie enjoys the effect her beauty has on men, and seeks to seduce them, but feels no emotional attachment to any of her lovers. Once she no longer has an immediate use for a man, she'll discard him, a pattern that has led to several of her deaths. She's also jealous when attention is given to other women, and works to break up established couples if presented an opening. Extremely self-centered, she thinks nothing of manipulating others for her pleasure.    

Little is known of Tomie's true background, not even her family name. It is not known how she gained her powers, or even if she was awa

name: Ryouhei Arisu
description:
__Specialty:__ Psychological (Heart)

The protagonist of Alice in Borderland. His alias is a reference to the main character "Alice" in Alice in Wonderland.
A 3rd year high school student with the hidden potential to be one hell of an analyzer; he looks at things from afar and checks every detail he can find. He keeps track of everything he learns so that he can find a way to put an end to this twisted game.

name: Yuzuha Usagi
description:
__Specialty:__ Physical (Spade)

The heroine of Alice in Borderland. Her alias which means "rabbit" in Japanese refers the White Rabbit in Alice in Wonderland.

She is a skilled mountaineer thanks to her father.

She lost hope when her father committed suicide.

She later gets married to [Ryouhei Arisu](https://anilist.co/character/129005/Arisu-Ryouhei) and becomes Yuzuha Arisu.

name: Ouran Nakagawa
description:
A girl in her third year of high school. She is [Kadode](https://anilist.co/character/88566/Koyama-Kadode)'s best friend.

She has long black hair, which she often wears in twintails, secured by skull-shaped hairties. Ouran has an older brother, [Hiroshi](https://anilist.co/character/89578/Nakagawa-Hiroshi) who is a NEET. She likes to play video games along with Kadode.

Ouran is a very flamboyant character. She often rambles on about her goal to enslave mankind or lead the human race to destruction. However, despite her seemingly flamboyant and sociable personality, Ouran tends to only show h

name: Kadode Koyama
description:
A girl in her third year of high school. She loves the iconic manga character [Isobeyan](https://anilist.co/character/208124/Isobeyan). She also has a crush on [her teacher](https://anilist.co/character/89581/Watarase-Naoki).

[Her dad](https://anilist.co/character/208125/Koyama-Nobuo) went missing during the initial appearance of the alien mothership over Japan. She appears to have a rocky relationship with [her mother](https://anilist.co/character/89585/Koyama-Manami), who's constantly worried about her own health and the A-Rays that were released when the aliens invaded.

name: Keita Ooba
description:
He was a member of an idol group and also acted in some movies. He disappeared during the event of 8/31. When she was younger, Kadode was obsessed with him.

His body was taken over by an invader child during the 8/31 event and ever since he has been living as an invader in the human body.

name: Futaba Kuze
description: An impossibly naive girl who fell for Touma. She ends up befriending Ichinose in an attempt to learn more about him, but they end up becoming close friends with each other and Touma as well. She is very sweet and tries her hardest, but her natural clumsiness and naivete make it hard for her to befriends others in her class.

name: Masumi Itachi
description: Kuze's best friend. She is a dark and mysterious girl who is very protective of her smaller best friend. She is in a separate class but is often seen hanging around with the rest of the main characters. She intends to become a veterinarian.

name: Touma Mita
description: Ichinose's childhood friend and the most popular boy in their school, loved by everyone for his niceness, looks and being the school's baseball team's ace and captain. He gets close to Ichinose and Kuze once they end up in the same class. He is very kind-hearted and loud and cares deeply for his new found friends. His dream is of playing in the grounds of Koushien Stadium and become a professional baseball player.

name: Taichi Ichinose
description: An ordinary high school student. Ichinose used to be Mita's best friend, but they drifted apart during high school. They get closer again when they end up in the same classroom. He is usually shy and meek, but is known for being extremely nice.

name: Zephyr
description:
Protagonist of the story "Doom Breaker".
Zephyr is the last human fighting evil in a world abandoned by the gods. When he is killed in battle by Tartarus, the god of destruction, all hope for humanity seems lost. But Zephyr’s fate is not sealed - the gods who find his battles entertaining have gifted him a second chance at life, as he is sent ten years into the past, back to when he was a slave instead of the most powerful human alive.

name: Athanasia de Alger Obelia
description:
Athanasia de Alger Obelia is the main protagonist of the manhwa "Who Made Me a Princess" as well as the first princess and only heir to the Obelian Empire. After reading a book named "The Lovely Princess" on a shunned princess named Athanasia, the protagonist falls asleep with sleeping pills and finds herself in the infant body of Athanasia from the book.

Athanasia, also known as "Athy", is the daughter of the emperor [Claude de Alger Obelia](https://anilist.co/character/136776/de-Alger-Obelia-Claude) and [Diana](https://anilist.co/character/143634/Diana), a dancer he deflowered after meeting

name: Claude de Alger Obelia
aliases: クロード・デイ・エルジェア・オベリア
description:
Claude de Alger Obelia is the current reigning emperor of the Empire of Obelia, and the father of the main protagonist in the popular manhwa "Who Made Me a Princess". He is a book character in "The Lovely Princess", and kills his oldest blood-related daughter, the original Athanasia de Alger Obelia. Claude has been shown to be ruthless and cruel, yet also warm and affectionate later on in the story. 

In the book "The Lovely Princess", Claude gains the throne by usurping and murdering his older brother, Anastacius de Alger Obelia. His name, Claude, refers to his illegitimacy to become heir, as

name: Lucas
description: A royal magician working at the black tower and Athanasia de Alger Obelia's chosen playmate.

name: Ijekiel Alpheus
description:
Ijekiel Alpheus is the oldest son of the House of Alpheus. He is the male lead in _The Lovely Princess_, ending up as [Jennette](https://anilist.co/character/143630/Jennette-Margarita)'s fiance at the end of the original story. He is disliked by [Claude de Alger Obelia](https://anilist.co/character/136776/Claude-de-Alger-Obelia) and refers to [Athanasia de Obelia](https://anilist.co/character/143632/Athanasia-de-Alger-Obelia) as "Lady Angel" due to the circumstances of their first and second encounters.

(Source: Who Made Me Princess Wikia)

name: Jennette Margarita
aliases: ジェニット・マグリタ
description:
Jennette was the original protagonist of the book "The Lovely Princess" from the manhwa "Who Made Me a Princess", until the main protagonist of the series transmigrates into the body of Athanasia de Alger Obelia. She is a side character and views Athanasia with admiration.

(Source: Who Made Me Princess Wikia)

name: Chun-U Han
description: Teacher who has mastered 9 styles of martial arts. With a mysterious past who seems to hold a grudge for the martial artists federation relating to the death of his master.  At the beginning of the story he seems to be a perverted middle aged man who came to the school going undercover as a teacher. After Shioon discovering his martial art skills, shioon bribes him with a video clip. Continuing Chun woo discovers Shioon's hidden potential and teaches foot and arm techiniques.As the story progresses, he shows more of his past and growing relationship with his new disciple.

name: Shi-Ho Lee
description: A very attractive woman who uses her sex appeal to make people do as she wishes. She can be very manipulative when she wants, making the likes of Alex carry out jobs which she would prefer not to do. Chun-Woo once claimed that there has never been a person that she has targeted that hadn't been taken in by her. She was a member of the Chun-Nyu-Moon (Heavenly Maiden Skill) and is very skilled at administering drugs, and has a in-depth knowledge of the human body and Ki system. With this knowledge, she has the ability to transfer Ki from one person to another. She drives a Mini Cooper S as her p

name: Shi-Woon Yi
description: A weak cowardly boy who is constantly being bullied until he encounters his new teacher using martial arts to defend himself. Shi-Woon begs him to teach him. After several instances where the cowardly boy shows he has heart and will fight with all his might, he becomes Chun-Woo's pupil.   He was given the Illwallsidan (One Moon Divine Dan) by Shi-Ho that forcefully increases Ki, and, had it not been for Goo-Moon-Ryong's help, would have died due to large of amount of Ki his body could not contain. Due to ingesting the pill, Shi-Woon now possess quick healing abilities, greater stamina and phys

name: Un-Wol
description: He was the master of Chun-Woo Han and Ryuji. After achieving the Black Origin Threshold the Martial Arts Alliance banished him to a life of meditation and solitude in a cave while he tried to figure out a way to solve the problem of this technique. He was always calm and composed, and did not hold a grudge against the elders that exiled him. Despite almost never showing emotions, he is very caring as he expelled Ryuji as a disciple and killed himself to protect both Ryuji and Chun-Woo Han respectively. He is also very moral, as he told off Chun-Woo Han when his student made the wrong choices i

name: Billy Bat
description: Ostensibly, a talking anthropomorphic bat that is the star of several detective comic book series throughout the 20th Century. His true nature and purpose comprise the central mystery of the plot. Francis Xavier himself once mentioned the Bat, himself unsure if the entity was an angel or demon or perhaps both. Zōfū, on the other hands, claims there are two bats, one white and the other black. When The White Bat appears, it always says confusing things, and when The Black Bat appears, it manipulates people to do bad things.

name: Kevin Goodman
native: ケヴィン・グッドマン
description:
[Tony](https://anilist.co/character/82483/Tony-Goodman) and [Diane](https://anilist.co/character/82481/Diane-Goodman)'s son.

His life was saved by [Kevin Yamagata](https://anilist.co/character/23635/Kevin-Yamagata) during the JFK assassination. 

 He is the "successor" of Kevin Yamagata, and the "true protagonist" of Billy Bat.

name: Jackie Momochi
description:
A nisei Japanese-American University girl in New York who was unwillingly influenced by Billy Bat. She is a descendant of the Momochi Clan of Iga-ryuu. Later on, she goes to Japan to investigate Father Xavier's first disciple, Yajirou.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kevin Yamagata
description: Kevin Yamagata in 1949 is a nisei Japanese-American comic book artist drawing the popular detective series "Billy Bat." When he learns he may have unconsciously copied the character from an image he saw while serving in occupied Japan, he returns to Japan to get permission to use Billy Bat from its original creator.   Kevin's comics mostly feature anthropomorphicized animal characters, such as dogs or mice. Later on, his Billy Bat comic become a kind of prophecy, its various plotlines precisely predicting future world events.   Kevin's Japanese name is Kinji Yamagata (山縣金持). He is said by othe

name: Kurumi Haraga
description:
__Type:__ Hangry
__Occupation:__ Third-Year Middle School Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 24

**Girlfriend No. 007**

Kurumi absolutely loves food and possesses an extremely high metabolism. As such, she's almost constantly hungry, and she grows extremely cranky if she isn't eating the certain food that she happens to be craving for at the moment. Kurumi has a strong word-association when it comes to food. Almost anything can remind her of food, at which point she has to eat that food or else she will become irritable.

appearsIn.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You

name: Jing Sun
description: Sun Jing is the main protagonist of Tamen de Gushi. She's a freshman, seventh class at Second High School. She's completely and utterly in love with Qiu Tong.

name: Tong Qiu
description: Qiu Tong is a main protagonist of Tamen de Gushi. She is a second year in class 3 of South High. Qiu Tong is pretty popular at her school, but despite that has only a few friends. She is the love interest of Sun Jing.

name: Geon Lee
description: The 13th awakened person, not selected by a god. He was betrayed by the 12 Saints and left to die.

appearsIn.title: The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero

name: Lukas Trowman
description: Lukas was captured in the abyss for 4000 years, than he saw Frey Blake who has poisoned himself and died. Lukas took over the body of Frey and thus escaped the abyss.

name: Yeong-U Sin
description:
__Country:__ South Korea

Sin Yeong-U is the name of the main character in real life, while Greed is the in-game name.

He was an unlucky loser in life. He entered into debt to buy the gaming capsule needed to play the game Satisfy. He experienced a hard life and was forced into manual labor jobs to pay off the enormous debt, but he still played the game despite not being good at it.

His in-game character called Greed found unusual luck in a legendary class change item (Pagma's Rare Book) during an S-class quest. But hidden beneath that luck was his level dropping to -1. This was due to the l

name: Kars
description: Cars is the leader of the Pillar Men. He is intelligent, ruthless, and single-minded in his dedication to obtaining the Red Stone of Aja. Strangely, despite his apathy towards humans and willingness to kill them, he has been shown to be more compassionate for other living beings. In Switzerland, he sliced a car that was about to hit a puppy in half, and later on maneuvered himself during a long fall to miss a patch of flowers near the bottom of the cliff. Cars' power is that of light; he is able to produce bladed appendages from his arms and use these to reflect blinding light toward his enemi

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 2: Battle Tendency

name: Lisa Lisa
description:
__Birthday:__ Dec, 1888
__Age:__ 50
__Height:__ 175 cm 

A mysterious Ripple user whom Joseph Joestar meets in Venice, Lisa Lisa reveals herself to be his friend Caesar Zeppeli's mentor. She trains Joseph in the ways of the Ripple and joins in the fight against the Pillar Men, as a powerful Ripple user in her own right.   

It is eventually revealed that she is Joseph's long-lost mother, despite her youthful appearance. Her real name is Elisabeth Joestar and she is the infant Jonathan Joestar saved at the end of Phantom Blood and gave to his widow Erina to raise. She was subsequently adopted b

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 2: Battle Tendency

name: Wamuu
description: Wamuu is introduced as a servant to both Esidisi and Kars. He is a very strong and honorable warrior who possess the power of the wind, and also reflexively attacks anyone who steps on his shadow. If he goes blind, he can grow a horn on his forehead and sense sound waves with it. He can also draw air into his body and blast it through the tip of the horn, creating a highly-destructive "wind scalpel". He is also extremely honorable, stopping himself from defeating a defenseless Joseph Joestar when he said that with a month to train he could beat Wham.    Later on, he engaged in battle with Caes

appearsIn.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 2: Battle Tendency

name: Tasuku  Kaname
description: Tasuku Kaname is a high school student at Shimanami High, who is troubled by his sexual orientation and his affection for his schoolmate Touma Tsubaki.

appearsIn.title: Our Dreams at Dusk: Shimanami Tasogare

name: Touma Tsubaki
description: Touma Tsubaki is a character from the manga Shimanami Tasogare, the ace of the Shimanami High volleyball club and Tasuku Kaname's crush. He and Tasuku are on the Health Committee together.

appearsIn.title: Our Dreams at Dusk: Shimanami Tasogare

name: Kabi Nagata
description: [Staff Profile]( https://anilist.co/staff/120310/Kabi-Nagata)

name: Alpha Hatsuseno
description: Alpha is the main character of the series. As an A7-M2 model robot, one of the few production prototypes, she is one of the first of the A7 series and was named "Alpha". She has an unusual affinity with machines and people. Unlike most characters with cheerful personalities, Alpha is sweet without being saccharine. Her pleasant disposition has won her several friends and loyal customers yet she is also capable of making deep insights and displays an unusual level of maturity during her more private moments. As the story progresses, she interacts more with her surroundings and the peo

name: Ju-Heon Seo
description:
__Age:__ 38 (Before Regression), 23 (After Regression)

After getting betrayed by his own boss who feared his rising power and sent to a death mission, he gets help from a strange relic which sends him 15 years back in time, when tombs just started appearing.

name: Chloe Laurent
description: Chloe is a medic skilled at healing the injured and suppressing risks caused by relics. She can store relic risks inside bottles and use them.

name: Irene  Holton
aliases: アイリーン・ ホルトン
description: Irene Holton is the only daughter of the Holton Family. She was known as the Monarch of Destitution. Irene is an innocent girl that is at first reluctant to do anything. During the fight against the relic Hand of Midas, with the help of Seo Joo-Heon, she gained confidence and dominated the relic and seized complete control over it. After this event, she would gain more confidence and start to help Seo Joo-Heon in his every task.

name: Ilya Volgof
description:
Ilya Volgof was a member of TKBM's Team 13 under the command of Seo Joo-Heon.

He is the most skilled of the Aftermath Clean-up Crew which specializes in modifying memories and disbanding tomb raiding teams.

He is currently working for Kwon Hyuk Soo after quitting his job as a talented Russian exorcism priest at the Vatican in Italy and losing his girlfriend Galina to find a way to revive her without realizing that the Vatican executed her and used her as a sacrifice for Un-Known.

After he regained his memories, he betrayed Kwon Hyuk Soo but refused to rejoin the team which resulted in him b

name: Seol-A Lee
description:
Lee Seol-Ah was a member of the TKBM Tomb raiding team under the command of Seo Ju-Heon.She was a scout skilled at finding people and relics. She is currently working for the Chinese raiding group of Red Flowers. She attempted to thwart Seo Joo-Heon plan of selling the fake Nero's Relic which was presumed to be the relic of Julius Ceaser by destroying it with a B ranked dagger.

(Source: Tomb Raider King Wiki)

name: Jae-Ha Yu
description:
Before the time rewind, he was (and still is) a specialist in relic restoration. He became known as the Fraud King, something which Chairman Kwon eventually became aware of. Jae-Ha met Joo-Heon through being on the same raiding team.

When Joo-Heon tries to seek him out in order to repair his relics, Irene informs him that he is 'dead'. She then recounts that he had sold her brother, George Hilton, a false painting. He was caught for the fraud and was presumed dead after his car fell down a cliff.He's later discovered to be alive when Edward called him on behalf of Chairman Kwon. Since he'd da

name: Julian Miller
description: Jullian Miller was framed by Seo Joo-Heon as the culprit and blackmailer attempting to steal the Julius Caesar relic.

name: Han-Bin Ryu
description: Ryu Han-Bin was a normal person who just had been discharged from his mandatory military service, when he was transported to another world

appearsIn.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

name: Leonhart
description: Leonhart is a powerful warrior from Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King, initially part of the Heresy Inquisitors. Over time, he shifts his allegiance and becomes an ally to Ryu Hanbin. His strength and divine abilities make him a key character in the story.

appearsIn.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King
Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

name: Atisse Bennister
description: Atisse Bennister is a dragon with the ability of transform himself into a human and back to dragon. Among the dragons Atisse is considered very young due to the fact that dragons can live several thousand years as stated by Atisse. He is currently friends with Ryu Han-Bin and Ephyr.

appearsIn.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

name: Kivye
description: Kivye is the envoy of the Goddess of Darkness Kivryelle. She was sent to Rathnia to search for Ryu Han-Bin in order to ask for his help in finding one of the four heroes, Barolt, for the sake of saving the world of Rathnia from Ormphlaus and defeating Zenovia and Garhan.

appearsIn.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

name: Manabu Itagaki
description: The most recent addition to the roster, the charming Manabu has a prodigy's talent and was the captain of his high school's boxing team. Cheerful and a lover of bad puns, Manabu is a fierce outboxer with extremely high speed and reflexes and whose fighting style is uncanny in its resemblance to Miyata's. His most powerful technique is a furious hail of mid-power blows known as the Hedgehog or Porcupine, which was employed in an East Japan Rookie Kings showdown with his longtime nemesis, Kyosuke Imai. Outside of boxing, Manabu is employed as an assistant at the Makounouchi family's fishing busi

name: Charles-Henri Sanson
native: シャルル＝アンリ・サンソン
description:
Charles-Henri Sanson is one of the main characters and protagonist of Innocent series. Born in 1739 to Charles Jean-Baptiste Sanson and his first wife Madeleine Tronson, he was the fourth in a six-generation family dynasty of executioners.

Charles is described as a beautiful young man with straight long dark hair. Older Charles has longer and wavy hair that is usually always shown to be slicked back. He resembles his father more with large shoulders and rib cage, but still has soft facial features and hands. His complexion, hair reflexions and eye color is odd and changing from volume to volu

name: Marie-Joseph Sanson
native: マリー＝ジョセフ・サンソン
description:
Marie-Josèphe Sanson is the younger half-sister of [Charles-Henri Sanson](https://anilist.co/character/89944/Sanson-CharlesHenri) and one of the two main characters of the series. Born in 1751 to [Charles Jean-Baptiste Sanson](https://anilist.co/character/131350/Sanson-CharlesJeanBaptiste) and Jeanne-Gabrielle Berger Sanson.

Her looks are considered to be too unladylike as she tends to style her sun-blond hair in buzzcut and undercut styles. Usually shaving left side of her head or both sides. She even completely shaved her hair once. Despite her tomboyish appearance Marie is considered as a

name: Eugene Lionhart
description: Eugene Lionheart is the titular protagonist of the web novel Damn Reincarnation. In his previous life, he was known as Hamel Dynas, and was one of the Five Great Heroes who vanquished three of the five Demon Kings of the Devildom of Helmuth long ago. After dying in the castle of the Demon King of Incarceration, he found himself reborn 300 years later as a distant relative of his comrade, Vermouth Lionheart. Reborn into a collateral branch family of the Lionheart Family, the son of Gerhard Lionheart, he swore to finish the task his comrades could not: Kill all the Demon Kings.

name: Emanon
description: A mysterious girl who holds a 3-billion-year old memory, dating back to the moment life first appeared on Earth.

name: Narrator
description: A young student who likes sci-fi literature. In 1967 he met Emanon on the ship heading for his home in Kyushu.

name: Ruri Aoki
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")
__Relatives:__ [Umi Aoki](https://anilist.co/character/328042/Umi-Aoki) (Mother), [Ruri no Chichi](https://anilist.co/character/328049/Ruri-no-Chichi) (Father), [Ruri no Sobo](https://anilist.co/character/328045/Ruri-no-Sobo) (Grandmother)

A first-year in high school who awoke one morning to find horns growing out of her head and learned that she was, in fact, half dragon. In the days and weeks since, Ruri has dealt with fire breath and other emerging dragon traits, all of which threaten to disrupt her life as an otherwise ordinary teen.

name: Nene Odagiri
description: Nene is one of the seven witches and Vice president of the Student Council.   Nene's abilities is captured. When she kisses, that person will fall in love with her and she can make them do whatever she wants.   There is a limitation though, if the person she kissed is already under the effects of another witch's power then the Captured won't happen.   Odagiri gained that power by the desire to become popular.

name: Kouta Ooyama
description: Ooyama is a second-year high school student who lives alone, but has to deal with Akutsu since she is constantly hanging out in his room after school and sometimes even stays the night. While he does want Akutsu to go home, he becomes flustered when he is around her. He is also concerned that she might stay at some other guy's place if she leaves

name: Riko Akutsu
description:
Akutsu is Ooyama's delinquent classmate who constantly hangs out in his room to read manga, play video games, and eat snacks.

While she likes to tease Ooyama, she slowly develops romantic feelings towards him, especially after Ooyama makes statements like pleading her to stay and not wanting her to go off with any other guys.

name: Nao Kanzaki
description:
Nao is a stupidly honest girl who sees herself trapped in the Liar Game after finding 100 million yen in a box along with a card. Now, she has to take care of the money for 30 days and try to steal another 100 million from his rival.   Nao's father is in the hospital and none of her friends believe her so she contacts Akiyama Shinichi to help her.   

 As the story goes on she becomes more mature and even gives Akiyama a hand in the game sometimes. She believes that Liar Game is about how much a person can remain honest and plays the games with honesty. She is always concerned about her teamma

name: Shinichi Akiyama
description: Formerly a graduate student majoring in psychology, he is a "genius swindler" who took down a giant MLM scam named Shuuei to avenge his mother. He helps Nao when he sees the honest nature she had, just like his mother. Although he is not invited into the Liar Game, he enters by substituting for another player in Round II. By Round III he is respected (and feared) enough by the LGT players to become unofficial leader of the Southern Country, though he tries to keep things equal in the group. Yokoya, however, knows Akiyama had been manipulating his team mates and mocks him for it.

name: Airen Farreira
description: A boy who sleeps to run away from reality. People mocked him, calling him a deadbeat, but he had no wish to change. Until one day, he dreamt of a swordsman... It was a dream about a talentless man who had been training by swinging his sword for decades.

appearsIn.title: The Lazy Lord Masters the Sword

name: Marco
description:
Marco has the mental age of a kid, but possesses a monstrous strength that is far beyond any ordinary human being. 

Due to his ruthless and savage upraising by his father, Marco was conditioned to turn into his bloodthirsty Rodem persona whenever he was stabbed with a needle, turning him into a being that would mercilessly kill everyone in his path.However, since Marco joined Madarame Baku's side, he has avoided his intent to kill, even when reverting to his Rodem persona.

name: Baku Madarame
description:
Baku is known as a genius gambler, he is a legend in the underworld.

During gambles, there are many instances where he intimidates and tosses around his opponents as if he is eating them. And even outside of gambling, he is prone to danger and likes to take risks in everything. His true feelings towards people are unknown and a mystery. However, he seems to treat people based on what he sees through his judgments. He shows his disgust towards people like [Kaji](https://anilist.co/character/134946/Takaomi-Kaji)'s mother who selfishly trample on others, but on the other hand, he shows kindness

name: Kaji Takaomi
description:
Kaji Takaomi was originally a very ordinary man before he met Madarame Baku with a typically trusting personality. But as he went through and experienced many life-threatening situations, his mentality strengthened. He grows and becomes more courageous against dealing with people like yakuza and Kakerou.

Kaji hates the idea of killing his opponent in a gamble.

name: Hikoichi Yakou
description:
Hikoichi is an older gentleman with grey hair, a well-kept mustache, with his most distinguishing feature being his eyebrows which curl at the outer sides. Like a gentleman, he uses honorifics and is polite to anyone. However, he shows his savage side to satisfy his curiosity or during battles.

He has a twin brother called Yakou Jouichi.

name: Kyara
description:
Kyara was an intimidating-looking individual, with a notably muscular frame, a mop of wild black hair and a generally menacing facial expression. He has chemical burn scarring around his left eye from chemicals being accidentally splashed on him during one of Usogui's Kakerou games.

_Terrorist of the Abandoned Mine Arc:_
Kyara appeared as a bodyguard for Karl Belmont. He fought both Leo and Marco to keep them away from Karl's missile launcher during the Hangman Game.

_Bull's Womb Arc:_
Kyara and Kaji gamble to see who can make the best coffee. Kaji cheats by putting something in Kyara's coff

name: Souichi Kiruma
description:
Kiruma Souichi  is the current Royal Leader  of Kakerou and one of the most important characters of Usogui. 

Souichi has the view that due to "God's will" or "destiny", he will keep on winning gambles. Though his behavior often fluctuates, and he is capricious enough to not know what to do at times, he often resorts to childish behavior, making jokes or refusing to take orders from others.

Souichi feels immensely pressured by his duties and thus feels a need to be "perfect." 
In order to deal with the pressure, he developed a coping method where he loses stretches of his memories after makin

name: Su-Ho Seong
description:
Sung Suho displays little interest in things that bore him and don't get his blood pumping, especially his education. He also likes to get physical against any bullies who are stupid enough to pick on him and has an intense desire to surpass his father, who always easily defeats him in their sparring matches. 

Sung Suho is the son of [Jin-U Seong](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung) and [Hae-In Cha](https://anilist.co/character/138789/HaeIn-Cha).

name: Manji
description:
Manji is the protagonist of the Japanese manga series Blade of the Immortal. In the story, he's known infamously both as the "Hundred Man Killer" for the number of men he's killed by the beginning of the series, and "Mister Twelve Blades" for the number of weapons he carries. He is most easily identified by the manji symbol he wears from which he derives his name and the scars across his face, and as the title of the manga implies, he's been given immortality by the means of the Kessen-chu, which prevent him (for the most part) from dying.

Little is known about Manji's background except that

name: Taito Magatsu
description: Among the Ittō-ryū's finest swordsmen. Of peasant origin, he became a swordsman to avenge his sister, who was killed as a child by a samurai. Taito is one of the few swordsmen who has fought Manji and survived. He has also fought by Manji's side as well. He can be considered a kenshi, a swordsman who is not from the samurai class. His lover of sorts, a prostitute named O-ren was killed by Shira. He quit the Ittō-ryū, although he is still friends with Anotsu. He ends up following Manji around due to the fact he knows Shira is after Manji. Although they argue a lot, Manji and Taito hav

name: Kagehisa Anotsu
description: He is the leader of the Itto-ryu and an equal of Manji. This emotionally cold young man has prodigious skill with the sword, and leads the Itto-ryu. He runs Itto-ryu in order to form a dojo dedicated not to form and rules, but to the simple test of superior lethality. He was brought up by his abusive grandfather (a swordsman disgraced by the Asano dojo -the dojo of Rin‘s family). Anotsu is as pragmatic and shrewd as he is deadly, although he isn't as inhuman as originally believed. He even allows Rin to live after she attacks him. He has two weapons. The first, his main weapon, is a Nepalese-b

name: Makie Otono-Tachibana
description: Master swordswoman and in love with Anotsu. Said to be Anotsu's match and saved his life with her deadly abilities when they were children. Born into a samurai family, Makie and her mother were disowned and cast away from the family by her father, Harukawa, when Makie's older brother committed seppuku after Makie was revealed to have inherited the family's famed talent and he was unable to defeat her in combat. She initially chose the path of the sword to avenge her mother's disgrace, but ended up becoming a geisha when Anotsu bought her freedom because she neither had the nerve to become a pr

name: Rin Asano
description: The sole survivor of an Ittō-ryū massacre at Anotsu's hand and heir to her father's sword school, the "Mutenichi-ryū". She has mediocre swordsmanship skills but an intense desire to avenge the brutal death of her family. To aid in this quest, she hires Manji as a bodyguard. It is worth noting that she kisses a sleeping Manji in the fourteenth volume and has shown on numerous occasions that she develops feelings towards him. They are as of now largely unreciprocated.   At the beginning of the series she is portrayed as somebody who is trying to act mature, but is still very childish - as the se

name: Hyakurin
description: A female assassin and a lieutenant in the Mugai-ryū. Hyakurin was the wife of an abusive samurai, Hayakawa Kakōsai Genkei, who was obsessed with trying to gain fame by training Matsuhiko, their sickly son, to become a strong swordsman. She later kills her husband to avenge the death of her son by his father's hand and is then arrested and sentenced to death. Her case came to the attention of Kagimura who subsequently recruited her into Mugai-ryū. Hyakurin's most unusual physical trait is her blonde hair (concealed frequently under a wig), which she maintains by bleaching it with a strong chemi

name: Masaki Izawa
description: An experienced boxer who hangs around the streets as a delinquent, called the 'Charisma of the streets'. He supports Yuu in his development as a fighter. He uses his own customized version of Boxing and Karate for street fights.

name: Yuu Kamishiro
description: Yuu is a very nervous boy, who was bullied severely, eventually cutting school and becoming a hikkimori. Eventually, he tries to grow stronger by practicing boxing from a book, and by repetition develops a powerful one-two. Beginning to get into fights with delinquents, Yuu finds a sense of place and satisfaction on the streets, but must defend himself against stronger opponents to survive.

name: Shougo Midorikawa
description: A delinquent skilled in karate (he deliberately avoids gaining a blackbelt to escape the notice of police). He challenges Yuu, but is beaten, and hunted by his previous gang. He tries to team up with Yuu to fight them, but ends up becoming his friend, and teaching Yuu about kicks and body rotation.

name: Kang-U O
description: __Height:__ 178 cm

name: Li Nie
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Soul Realm:__ Red

After dying at the hands of the Sage Emperor, Nie Li wakes up back in his thirteen year old body. Given a second chance to save his loved ones, he is determined to stop Sacred Family from betraying Glory City, and causing the attack that not only destroyed his home but killed all his friends and family.

Nie Li is a member of the Heavenly Marks Family, a declining and weak aristocratic family. His initial talent is considered by others to be poor and is lacking in culture and social position. However, he retains all the knowledge he gathered while roaming t

name: Mari Yoshizaki
description: An "angel-like" beautiful high school girl with a certain secret she has been hiding from everyone.

name: Yori Kakiguchi
description:
A classmate of Mari, she seems to have some kind of relation with her.

It is revealed that Yori was stalking Mari and she is very strict with how "Isao" acts while inside of Mari's body as to not ruin her in any way. The two slowly become genuine friends and eventually begin to date before it is revealed that the "Isao" within Mari was not the real him and just a projection of him Mari conjured in her mind and assumed as her own persona due to family trauma and wishing to escape from it. At the end of the manga once Mari returns to being herself it is unclear if Yori and her are dating but th

name: Eiji Urashima
description:
__Height__: 5'6"

Urashima Eiji is a normal university student at first glance. However, it turns out his biological father was a serial killer. One day he realizes that he sometimes has blanks in his memory of a few days.

It turns out Eiji has a double personality.

appearsIn.title: My Dearest Self With Malice Aforethought

name: Kyouka Yukimura
description:
Eiji's Girlfriend.

She was adopted by her parents when she was 7.

appearsIn.title: My Dearest Self With Malice Aforethought

name: Vlad
description: An orphan living in Schoarra's slums. Despite his lowly birth, his appearance bears resemblance to nobility.

name: Minoru Tanaka
description:
A middle schooler who chooses to use the Death Note for a different, unique purpose.

Unlike Light Yagami, Minoru does not seem to have a strong sense of justice. Although he is morally opposed to using the Death Note himself, he has no issue with making it available to anyone who is willing to pay for it, regardless of how they plan to use it once he has sold it to them. In fact, when the USA and China promise, while bidding for the notebook, that they will use it for altruistic purposes, he makes a point of announcing that he does not care why they want it, he just wants to know how much the

appearsIn.title: The Max Level Hero Strikes Back!

name: Gally
description: Found in the scrapyard below the floating city Tiphares by the Hunter Warrior [Daisuke Ido](https://anilist.co/character/6545/Daisuke-Ido), Gally soon becomes a Hunter Warrior herself, hunting for bounties throughout the scrapyard city. Having no recollection of her past, Gally's only link to her memories is her "Panzer Kunst" a martial art style for cyborgs that she somehow remembers. While trying to live her life and protect those dear to her, she is eventually caught up in the struggle between the utopian society of Tiphares and the suppressed surface dwellers.

name: Yuu
description: An orphan who killed three people - mother, kid and a man. He is in prison (death row) waiting for his death to the point that he attempted suicide numerous times.     His abusive father caused Yuu's three-year younger brother to go blind. Their mother could not handle the abuse so she abandoned her children, and so Yuu and his brother were sent to an orphanage. Since the brother would get teased a lot, they ran away and lived on the streets together. For his brother's sake Yuu shoplifted and even worked as a prostitute. But his younger brother jumped in front of traffic and was kill

name: Juri Mutou
description: The daughter of a very famous pianist who had to stop playing after giving birth to her. She believed she had no hope in the future due to a dark past - until she met Yuu.   When she was 16 years old, her piano teacher raped her. She told about it her mother, but she didn't believe her. Taking her daughter for granted and hating her for losing her dream - piano - caused Juri's hatred for her.

name: Fable
description:
A mysterious man labelled as the "Genius of Killing". With his favourite gun, Night Hawk, in his hands, he's a hitman that can take down any enemy in a single shot. His origins and real name are both unknown.

Seems to very much love watching the comedian, Jackal Tomioka.

name: Ed Rothstaylor
description:
He was originally the successor to the Rothstaylor family, a ducal family, but was excommunicated from the family after insulting the princess and lost his surname. 

Due to his past life experience, he has a very serious and cautious personality. Compared to other characters, he acts cold, does not easily give affection to others, does not easily share his worries, and does not easily trust others.

name: Janica Faylover
description:
She is the top student in her second year and is a spirit master who handles spirits.

A girl who seems to be the embodiment of kindness and innocence. She also wants to live up to the expectations of those around her.

name: Lucy Mayreel
description:
She is lazy and only does things she wants to do. Supposedly she became lazy because she was too strong before even arriving to the academy.

The greatest genius at her job and a powerful mage who has reached the pinnacle of the strongest bloodline in the world. She was born with remarkable magical talent that caught the attention of the great magician Glockt from an early age.

name: Lortelle Kecheln
description:
The heroine of the game "Sylvania's Failed Sword Saint". The adopted daughter of the owner of the Elte Trading Company, also known as the Golden Daughter. She is one of the 6 main characters in the original story of the game.

In the original game, she was directly related to most of the bad endings, and was said to have been a nuisance character who angered many users, calling her the "bad ending maker".

name: Karluk Eihon
description: He is a calm person with lots of patience - doing what his wife Amira asks him to so as not to make her worry. He adores her very much.

name: Amir Halgal
description: Amir comes to be the bride for Karluk. She is very capable of hunting and managing house chores. She is nice and calm person, and overprotective to Karluk

name: Yang Yu
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Second-year Art major. Came out as gay in junior high.

name: Huan Li
description:
__Height:__ 196cm

College freshman majoring in Design.

name: Takeru Minakata
description: A charming gambler who joins Akira & Co in Volume 9.

appearsIn.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

name: Izuna Tokage
description: Izuna was a student in High School before the outbreak. When the outbreak started she was bitten on the thigh, but didn't turn into a zombie. She started travelling with a scientist, Tsuru, who was trying to develop a vaccine, and was acting as her guardian. In the end she decided to travel with Akira's group but they plan on returning to the lab where Tsuru is.

appearsIn.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

name: Wrath
description:
Wrath, formerly known as Sasajima Kyouya, is one of the students that reincarnated. After reincarnation, he found himself reborn as a Goblin in a Goblin Village with the special skill to create weapons.

He is the commander of the Demon Lord's eighth army.

appearsIn.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?
So I'm a Spider, So What?

name: Anna Anjou
description:
A high school student and a gyaru in the same class as Seto, whom she teases and flirts with constantly.

Outside of school, she hangs out with Seto or helps out with her mom at the hair salon. Her dream is to become a stylist and she has a surprising talent when it comes to hairdressing.

name: Himari Kino
description:
Himari is a very joyous, cheerful girl and often likened to a puppy by other characters. 

She is able to instantly befriend anyone, even hard to approach characters like [Shiho](https://anilist.co/character/215602/Izumi-Shiho). Himari is always wanting the best for her friends and cheering them on in whatever they pursue.

name: Yori Asanagi
description: A third year high school student who sings while playing guitar at the school rooftops and loves collecting cat merchandise. She is also a part of the "SS Girls" band in which she is positioned as the guitarist and vocalist.

name: Jodio Joestar
native: ジョディオ・ジョースタ
description:
__Stand:__ November Rain

Jodio is a small-time gangster living in Hawaii with his big brother [Dragona](https://anilist.co/character/298896) and his mother [Barbara Ann Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/298906). He is a Stand user that wields November Rain, allowing him to create localized drops of rain that can crush his opponents.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Dragona Joestar
native: ドラゴナ・ジョースター
description:
__Stand:__ Smooth Operators

Dragona is [Jodio Joestar's](https://anilist.co/character/298895) older sibling and works alongside him as a gangster in Hawaii. They are a Stand User that wields Smooth Operators, a colony Stand that can displace anything.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Paco Laburantes
description:
__Stand:__ The Hustle

Paco is a gangster working in the same gang as Jodio and Dragona Joestar. They are assigned to the same team in order to steal a diamond. Paco is a Stand User possessing The Hustle, an integrated Stand that allows him to grab objects with his muscles anywhere on his body.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Usagi Alohaoe
description: __Stand:__ The Matte Kudasai

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Charming Man
description:
__Stand:__ Bigmouth Strikes Again

He is introduced as an antagonist who stalks Jodio Joestar and his allies to try retrieving the Lava Rock. His Stand lets him disguise with his surroundings and confuse his enemies' perceptions.
It is revealed that he was searching for the Lava Rock believing it was connected to the disappearance of his brother Mauka.

appearsIn.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands

name: Ichi
description: Ichi is the first known male witch and the contractor of the legendary Majik King Uroro.

name: Desscaras
description: Desscaras is a powerful magic user in this world where Majik, a living force, grants power through difficult trials. She is confident and skilled, often taking charge of dangerous missions like confronting [King Uroro](https://anilist.co/character/344557/Uroro), a destructive Majik. Despite her serious nature, Desscaras sometimes dismisses caution, preferring to handle matters on her own.

name: Kumugi Harvest
native: クムギ・ハーヴェスト

name: Gokuraku Kagami
aliases: Kagyaku no Gokuraku (苛虐のゴクラク)
description:
Infamously known as Gokuraku the Brutalizer, he is one of the main members of Team Desscaras as their Special Adjunct. Gokuraku is an augmented human and a notorious criminal in the land of Kagami for repeatedly attempting to kill slumbering Majik Bakugami.

He is officially listed as a dangerous individual by the Mantinel Witches Association due to his relentless and violent attempts to acquire Majiks. He wishes to become a witch to acquire Bakugami, and so he challenges and beats up any Majik he encounters. True to his title, he brutally beat up the Majik he encountered repeatedly to clear t

name: Danpei Tange
description: Danpei is Joe's serious, cautious and responsible mentor who gets him started in his boxing career. He is fond of sake, being overly cheerful when drunk which contrasts with his strict everyday self. He is also very polite when talking to people who hold higher ranks than himself, something that annoys Joe, who doesn't care for such things. Before meeting Joe, it is stated that Danpei used to be a boxer himself. However, after the loss of one of his eyes, we learn that he was forced to give up on his own boxing career, aiming to become a coach instead. But due to his violent, strict, passionat

appearsIn.title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow

name: Tooru Rikiishi
description:
__Gym:__ Shiraki
__Weight Class:__ Welterweight
__Style(s):__ Hybrid, Brawling Style
__Stance(s):__ Orthodox Stance, Brawling Stance
__Trainer:__ [Shiraki Youko](https://anilist.co/character/46051/Shiraki-Youko) (minimal)

Rikiishi and [Joe](https://anilist.co/character/11804/Yabuki-Joe) first meet in the juvenile detention center, where Rikiishi was introduced as a boxer who was sentenced to the juvenile detention center because he had punched an member of the audience half to death after they had claimed that the match was rigged in Rikiishi's favor, enraging him.

On their first encounter J

appearsIn.title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow

name: Joe Yabuki
description:
The protagonist of the story. He is known for his long bangs and for always wearing a worn out beige coat and a red flat cap.

Not long after birth he found himself in many orphanages and facilities. However, he quickly grew tired of the boring life and frequently escaped, eventually finding his way to the Doya Town the story takes place in. Joe is rude and quick to fight, but he can also be very frivolous at times. Because of his rough upbringing he is a delinquent who likes his solitude, but he later grows to appreciate his new friends and rivals. He is not very good at understanding women,

appearsIn.title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow

name: Youko Shiraki
description:
Yoko Shiraki is a young woman born to the Shirakis, a very wealthy family who is known for their activities in the boxing field. She is the main female protagonist in Ashita no Joe.

She is very polite, graceful and kind to other people, always acting exactly as expected from a daughter born to a family with a higher rank, donating to charities from time to time. As so, she clashes in both appearance and personality with most of the other characters who know nothing but poverty and hardship.

One of those characters is Joe who is the first to remark that her so called 'kindness' is completely

appearsIn.title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow

name: Raeliana McMillan
aliases: レリアナ・マクミラン
description: Reincarnated as only a side character dying in the hands of her fiancée, Raeliana Mcmillan is the badass main female character who is determined to live her life and not die as she was destined to do so. In a moment of desperation, she goes to Noah Wyknight and offers him a contract for an arrange marriage, to avoid her doom by canon fate.

appearsIn.title: The Reason Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion

name: Noah Wynknight
aliases: ノアボルスティア・ウィンナイト
description: The famous Duke of Wynknight and the main male protagonist of the story. In the original timeline, he ends up with Beatrice but due to Raeliana changing the original timeline to avoid her fate, he fell for Raeliana instead. He's Siatrich's younger brother.

appearsIn.title: The Reason Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion

name: Ho-Bin Yu
description: Ho-Bin is a boy from a poor family who gets bullied at school - until a lucky incident that leads him to become famous on NewTube.

name: Ji-Hyeok U
description: Cameraman and classmate of Hobin Yoo. He used to be Pakgo's cameraman before the fight during his gaming stream was released to the public.

name: Ga-Eul
description: Video editor of Ho-Bin Yoo. She is one year younger than Ho-Bin and Ji-Hyeok.

name: Yu-Won Kim
description:
Yuwon Kim is the protagonist and main character of Leveling with the Gods.
After losing the war against the Outer Gods, Chronos uses his power to send Yuwon back to the past to change the result of the war. After his regression, his only goal was to get stronger and gather his past allies to annihilate the Outer Gods.

name: Onii-san
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

"Onii-san" is one of the main characters of the story. His birth name is unknown. He never formally introduces himself to Sachi, so she just calls him "Onii-san". He has light colored hair and always wears a face mask.

In chapter 43, he revealed that his name is Haru.

name: Sachi
description: "Sachi" is a high school student. In the beginning of the story, her real name is unknown, as she is only referred to as "XXX-San" on television and by two former classmates who recognize her on the street. "Onii-san", her kidnapper, gives her the name "Sachi", which comes from the word happiness in Japanese, in replace of the name she had during her old life.

name: Takane Takamine
description:
__Occupation:__ Student Council President

She is a perfectionist and wants to be the best at everything. She has an ability called "The still untouched, unknowing maiden. (The eternal aisle)". Every time she takes off a piece of underwear she can make what was done into something it wasn't.

name: Koushi Shirota
description: Once he is introduced to Takane Takamine, he is soon told that he will become her "closet", in which he has to replace her underwear once she has used her ability.

name: O
description: A mysterious being introduced in the series as the one who distributes boxes. Always refered as they. They love playing with the protagonist Kazuki Hoshino.

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Kazuki Hoshino
description: A completely ordinary high school student who loves idle chatter with his friends and Umaibōs, a Japanese snack. One day, he somehow suddenly antagonizes Aya Otonashi — even though he has never met her before. She threatens to “break” him.

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Daiya Oomine
description:
A self-centered and arrogant student who dyes his hair silver and wears three piercings in his right ear. He is also the class president and a shrewd friend of Kazuki’s.

Daiya used Kamiuchi and his box in order to learn how to master his own. He tricked Hoshino into believing that he was the real owner. He kills Kamiuchi which terminates the box.
(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Maria Otonashi
description:
An antisocial beauty with a resolute personality. She transfers into [Kazuki Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/87513/Hoshino-Kazuki)'s class on March 2nd—right before the end of the school year. Immediately upon her arrival, she announces her intent to “break” Kazuki.

Her life first intertwines with Kazuki when she sneaks into Mogi's box that created the recurring classroom. Being a box herself, she is able to keep her memories each recurrence. She spends years searching for the one who has the box and created the recurring classroom. During this time she also spent lots of time obtaining

appearsIn.title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria

name: Ji-A Han
description: A 32 year old freelancer who still doesn’t have a full-time job.

name: Min-Cheol Jin
description: A programmer and childhood friend of [Ji-A Han](https://anilist.co/character/266483).

name: Alexander Anderson
native: アレクサンド・アンデルセン神父
description:
Alexander Anderson is the trump card of Iscariot - section XIII, the secret organization of the Catholic church created to fight the undead.

Little is known about his background, other than his many nicknames and victories, and his biotech regeneration. Anderson first meets [Alucard](https://anilist.co/character/601/Alucard) on a mission in Northern Ireland, and their paths cross many times afterwards. Anderson is seemingly possessed by the thought of defeating Alucard... How far is he willing to go in order to defeat his foe?

name: Kei Yonagi
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Affiliation:__ Studio Daikokuten

A high school girl who's all alone to raise her twin siblings, [Rui](https://anilist.co/character/158800/Yonagi-Rui) and [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/158921/Yonagi-Rei), ever since their mother died and their father left home. Her greatest talent is acting; however, her very immersive approach, based on her own intimate memories, leads her to often get lost in character and blur the line between fiction and reality.

name: Chiyoko Momoshiro
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__Affiliation:__ Stars Agency

She is recognized as the hottest young actress of her generation. She is nicknamed "Angel of Stars" because of her beautiful image both in film and in real life. Her type of acting is to create a 'mask' of herself that the audience wishes to see. She doesn't delve into emotion to fit her role, because for her the important thing is her look to others. She said that her acting is the complete opposite of Kei Yonagi's acting.

(Source: Act-Age Wiki)

name: Akira Hoshi
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm
__Affiliation:__ Stars Agency

- __Favorite Food:__ soba (this isn't publicized because it doesn't fit his image as an actor)
- __Dislikes:__ junk food, violence, and dirty jokes.
- __Favorite Movies:__ Spiderman 2, The Dark Knight, and Captain America: The Winter Soldier.

Akira is famous for his many roles, including Ultra Masked Man, the hero of a popular Sunday morning cartoon. Although he is the son of Arisa Hoshi, a former famous actress, he is not considered by her to have inherited his mother's talent. Conscious of his perception by many as "not a worthy successor to

name: Sumiji Kuroyama
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Affiliation:__ Studio Daikokuten

He works as a director and is the founder of Studio Daikokuten.

Although he had won various film festival awards overseas, Sumiji was not famous in Japan as a director. He founded Studio Daikokuten for the purpose of making a single film in the future. After discovering [Kei Yonagi](https://anilist.co/character/126858/Kei-Yonagi)'s talent from an audition, he invites her to his studio and guides her to become an actress who will leave an imprint on the history of acting.

name: Araya Myoujin
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Affiliation:__ Tenkyu Theatrical Company

He is recognized as the "monster of the theatre world". He is nicknamed "The Chameleon" because he can take on many faces for his roles. Sumiji said that he has the complete version of Kei's acting. He can delve into a character deeply then conscientiously convey his role through his emotion and body language. Although he admitted that he can't delve into character as fast as Kei can. He is an eccentric weird person with a unique world view and behavior.

name: Yifan Zhuo
description:
Zhuo Yifan was the Magic Emperor or can also be called a Demonic Emperor. Because he had the (Nine Serenities) Ancient Emperor's book the Book of Nine Secrets, he was targeted by all the attending experts and was even betrayed and killed by his student Zhao Cheng.

Then his soul enters and comes back to life in a family servant boy named Zhuo Fan. Because the Magic of the Heart (Heart Demon) of the previous owner was holding him back, he must unite the child's memories and cannot ignore the family and the mistress he serves.

name: Ian Paige
description: A powerful mage in his past and current life, Ian has a mature mindset befitting his true age in the forties-fifties, as well as an inner ruthlessness concealed by his courteous behavior.

appearsIn.title: The Return of the 8th Class Mage

name: Ouma Tokita
description:
Having grown up in the lawless territory known as The Inside, the young Ohma was found and adopted by [Tokita Niko](https://anilist.co/character/189945/Niko-Tokita), who taught him his style of martial arts; the Niko Style. Ohma is a man of above-average height and has an extremely athletic build. His most notable trait is his mop of messy, dark hair that has been compared to seaweed. In addition, Ohma possesses a narrow gaze that exudes both confidence and general indifference.

Ohma is a rough, yet well-meaning individual. He was initially rather arrogant, which often surfaced whenever he fo

name: Kazuo Yamashita
description: He is the CEO of the Yamashita coop.. He is a weak old man, however he is never scared to say his opinion out loud. He is also known as The Kengan

name: Zaha Sanko
description: A 14-year-old hunted by the entire universe for possessing the bones that grant any wish.

name: Avakian
description: The Package of Darkness that Sanko bears. Somewhat different from your usual luggage.

name: Shimada Death
description:
Shimada Death is an ominous living phantom that consumes death, a mysterious creature born from the world of Darkness, known as the God of Death. Shimada met Zaha as a child and understood there will be a lot of death happening around him due to his curse, which means free meals for him. Since he was uninterested in Zaha's bones, he left a positive impression on him and they became friends. When Zaha's spaceship was ready, they started traveling together.

Shimada is usually wearing a large, tattered coat with a red mask.

name: Ja-Ha Lee
description: Ja-Ha dreamt of becoming a Martial God but fell off a cliff while running from the Demonic Cult after stealing and swallowing the Jade of Heaven. He then awakens and finds himself back in his 20s. He becomes a powerful and extremely deadly master martial artist infamous for his unpredictable and benevolent mindset, ruthlessness, and utter insanity.

name: Koutarou Natori
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Natori is a member of the product development team at Lilia Drop, a company that manufactures makeup and bath products that are tremendously popular with women. He is the project planner for all the soaps the company makes.

Natori-sans' sense of smell isn't inborn (like perfect pitch, etc.) He got better through practice, so he's a bit less sensitive when he's dozing or too tired to concentrate. He likes animals but sometimes has a hard time at zoos.

name: Asako Yaeshima
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'4")

Asako is an office lady who has a complex about her excessive sweating. She works in the accounting department at Lilia Drop, a company that manufactures makeup and bath products that are tremendously popular with women.

As a child, she was called "Aseko." (Ase means sweat.)

Asako likes looking at cute outfits in fashion magazines and has a weakness for cute furnishings and knick-knacks.

name: Melissa Podebrat
description:
After dying in a car accident, Han Da Young finds herself in the body of the villainess from a popular novel called "All the Men that Loved Her". She is determined to live as a jobless rich girl and making sure that the heroine of the novel does not get taken advantage of by the useless male leads.

Melissa has a very unique personality. Rather than repent for the deeds of her body's previous owner or fulfill the role of a villainess, Melissa initially sets out to live out the rest of her days as a pampered daughter of a duke—this is due to the constant studying and work she had to endure duri

name: Yuri Elizabeth
description: Yuri Elizabeth is the protagonist of the novel “The Brats I Love”. She was adopted into the Elizabeth family because of her magical ability. She is forced to live through the novel's plot again and again.

name: Nine Forton
description: Nine is Melissa's shy butler and a werewolf. He was rescued from the streets by Melissa, making him really loyal to her.

name: Jun-Ho Seo
description: Famously known as "Specter", he is one of the Five Heroes and also cleared the 1st Floor. He fought against the Frozen Queen and successfully killed her, but was then frozen for 25 years in order to absorb the nucleus.

name: Enkrid
description: Enkrid is the protagonist of The Knight Only Lives Today. He possesses a curse which turns him back in time every time he dies to a “wall”.

name: Shou Naruse
description:
Shou Naruse is very straightforward and arrogant. He doesn't care what other people think of him. He is very tall and he has piercings on both of his ears. He is the ace player of the Ryuhoku High's basketball team and has been a basketball player since he was 6 years old. He was tall since he was a kid so he was considered as the "most important player" in their team even though he plays the game with little effort. 

He likes his manager, [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/88601/Machida-Yuki). When he first met Yuki, a girl pushed him which caused his hand to land on Yuki's breasts, and sai

name: Yuki Machida
description:
Yuki Machida is the manager of the Ryuhoku High basketball team. She has always been mature ever since she was a little kid and also has a crush on the captain of the team, [Kido](https://anilist.co/character/88861/Kido). Yuki thinks of him as her "first love". He was the reason why Yuki joined as the manager of the basketball club in the first place. Her interest on him later faded away when she found out that Kido was going out with someone else which also results her to gradually develop feelings for [Shou](https://anilist.co/character/88600/Naruse-Shou).

Yuki is a serious and stern girl.

name: Hachirota Hoshino
description: Everyone simply calls him "Hachi" (Japanese for "eight" or "eighth") or "Hachimaki"; because he wears one during his EVAs). His dream has always been to own his own spaceship, but between the cost of purchasing one and his low-paying, seemingly dead-end job, Hachi struggles with even deciding whether or not to pursue his dream. Hachi's father is a renowned engineer, a source of much ambivalence to Hachimaki. Much of Hachi's drive is summed up in "bigger, faster, and further". However, this drive makes him conflicted about his own relationship with space. Loud and brash, Hac

name: Ai Tanabe
description: She is the newest member of the Debris Section. She is the adopted daughter of a death metal band leader turned engineer and an elementary school teacher. Tanabe did not speak until she was three years old. She is bright and earnest, but mostly unsure of herself. As a newcomer to space, the Debris Section and to extra-vehicular activity all at the same time, she has to slowly learn the ropes from everyone else. She believes that love, or "ai" (possibly a pun intended on her name being the Japanese word for love) is the solution to every problem. Kind and sweet, she is willing to do a

name: Fee Carmichael
description: Fee Carmichael is the American pilot of the "Toy Box", the debris-collecting ship used by the main characters of PlanetES. She was born in Richmond, Virginia, and the daughter of a prominent lawyer. Even more loud and brash than Hachi, Fee often becomes violent at others' actions and inaction, but she always means well. Being a heavy (and slightly ashamed) smoker, she has difficulty finding places to indulge her habit in space, as smoking is a strain on life support systems and is thereby restricted to designated smoking rooms. This often makes her quite irritable, especially af

name: Yi Jian
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Jian Yi is a loud, boisterous individual who is constantly adding light and humour to situations, despite his not-so-happy background. Yi has been friends with [Zhan Zheng Xi](https://anilist.co/character/121621/Zhengxi-Zhan) since childhood and continues to be close with him.

Jian Yi grew up in a terrible childhood; his father had abandoned him and his mother when he was just a baby for reasons that are still unknown. As a result, his mother had to try and take care of him by herself; however, she did not provide him with the attention a typical child would need from a pa

name: Medaka Kuroiwa
description:
The male protagonist of the show, Kuroiwa is a monk-in-training that enlisted to a Tokyo public school in an attempt to "steel his heart" and get himself rid of all worldly desires, in line with his religion. This attempt is later conflicted by Kawai Mona, however, as she continually shows him affection in order to make him fall for her.

Typically stoic, he ripostes to Mona's usual charms with a cold scowl, not to give in to desire, but his struggles and true emotions are often revealed as he blushes and reacts love-struck away from Mona's view.

Because of his time as a monk, he gets easily

appearsIn.title: Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms

name: Mona Kawai
description: Mona, in her own words, has got the looks, the personality and is the "complete package". She is like the queen bee of the school and is idolised by the entire student body - except for Medaka who is totally indifferent towards her. This annoys her and she decides to make Medaka fall for her through her charms.

appearsIn.title: Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms
Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms

name: Tadashi
description: Main character of the Gyo manga. In the beginning of the manga, it shows that he loves scuba. He has a girlfriend named Kaori and an uncle named Koyanagi. He noticed something was funny when Kaori said he had bad breath, although he brushes his teeth twice a day.

name: Kaori Sawahara
description:
Tadashi's girlfriend. She has an extremely sensitive nose and becomes very jealous when Tadashi is near other women. Due to her overly sensitive nose, she seems to be able to sense when the creatures are coming. 

In the anime, she is the main character rather than Tadashi.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Oowaki
description: Owaki is the main character of The Enigma of Amigara Fault. He comes to search the Amigara Fault after witnessing the display on television and meets another hiker on the way, Yoshida. He quickly becomes attached to Yoshida and wants to keep her safe and out of danger.

name: Ha-Yan Park
description:
**Height:** 160 cm (5'3")

A girl who conceals her identity as one of the strongest pureblood vampires in order to live normally as a college student. However, she cannot ignore injustice caused by others of her kind. She is infamously known as the 'White-Haired Vampire' by other vampires.

name: Eun-Tae Hwang
description: A handsome, talented and extremely perceptive police detective who is nicknamed the vampire-hunting 'Ghost' due to his excellent record of arresting vampires. He is currently investigating about a certain pureblood vampire.

name: Haegolbyeongsa
description:
He is a skeleton who has the ability to return to a specific point in time every time he dies.

Skeleton was just a regular Skeleton Soldier minion placed under the Demon Lord Baal.
His past as a human remains unknown. His grave where his remains are buried had no clues about his past. The tombstone of his grave had been scratched so bad that they can't even see his name on it.

appearsIn.title: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon

name: Kai Yang
description:
__Species:__ Human (Former) 

Yang Kai was a trial disciple in High Heaven Pavilion and the ninth Young Master of the Yang Family which was of the Eight Great Families of Nine Continents. 

One day, he stumbled upon a Black Book,   which turned out to be the Great Demon God's legacy. This fixed his genetic defect and allowed him to finally practice Martial Arts.

appearsIn.title: 66,666 Years: Advent of the Dark Mage

name: Hyeon-U Kim
description: Hyeon-U Kim is more powerful than just about any human or monster on Earth. Now that he’s free, he’s determined to find out who was behind his imprisonment, even if that means he has to kill hordes of monsters.

appearsIn.title: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

name: Akane Ousaki
description:
__Relatives:__ [Shinta](https://anilist.co/character/264106/Shinta-Arakawa) (Father), [Masaki](https://anilist.co/character/264105/Masaki-Ousaki) (Mother), [Arakawa Shiguma](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Arakawa-Shiguma) (Rakugo Master)
__Affiliation:__ Arakawa School
__Occupation:__ Rakugoka (Zenza)
__Height:__ 158cm (5'2")

She is the protagonist of Akane-Banashi series. She is an apprentice of [Shiguma Arakawa](https://anilist.co/character/264107/Shiguma-Arakawa).

She is usually unconcerned about her studies preferring to use that time to improve her skills, she is determined to achi

name: Natsuru Nanao
description:
An 11-year-old sixth-grader, Natsuru is the ace player of the school's soccer team. He lives alone with his mother. He doesn't get along well with the new soccer coach and decided to skip the summer camp. He instead stayed at the Suzumura's house and went to the Bon festival with them.

 He later dug up the corpse of the Suzumura's grandfather and, having doubts about keeping the secret, decided to run away from home. When he came back to school, he beat up those who spread rumors about Rio and earned a bad reputation.

name: Rio Suzumura
description:
An 11-year-old sixth grader, Rio is the tallest girl in Natsuru's class. She secretly lives alone with her little brother, Yuuta, in a rundown house. She is amazingly responsible and has gone through unbelievable things. She let Natsuru stay over at her house when he decided not to attend his summer camp and later went to the Bon festival with him.


 It is later revealed that she buried her grandfather's remains in their backyard to avoid generating rumors against her father.

name: Shizuku Hoshikawa
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

Shy girl who avoids speaking with others, she's constantly haunted by her past of having bullied a friend. In secret, she wrote a novel expressing her innermost feelings she has never shared with anyone. Although she had planned to erase herself along with her novel when she finished writing, it didn't work out that way because her classmate [Kaori](https://anilist.co/character/204142) borrowed her novel after noticing it by chance. Having read it, Kaori asks when her next novel will be. Everything changes from then on, as they agree to go out until summer ends.

name: Kaori Asaka
description:
__Height:__ 149cm

Cheery and energetic, she accidentally stumbled upon her classmate Shizuku's novel when she approached her. After borrowing the novel in order to read it, she has started take an admiration towards Shizuku and asks when her next novel will be. Distraught to know she wasn't planning to write another one, Kaori asks to go out together so she can be inspired to write a new story. Unbeknown to Shizuku, she knew her from elementary school. There's also something she's hiding from her...

name: Mikoto Kujou
description: She is a poor, low-class girl but she is smarter and stronger than both boys and girls. Yanagi refers to her as a rival cause he always is second in anything while Kujou is first. She is quite dense in several things like the fact that she does not know Yanagi's feelings for her even though he followed her from primary school to university and even joined the astronomy club to make sure no guys approach her.

name: Naoto Yanagi
description: The son of a rich and influential family and excels in Sports.    Girls seek him because of his good looks and skills, however he doesn't acknowledge them because they only chase him for his looks and wealth, which according to him is given to him by his parents and isn't self-earned (which Kujou told him in their first conversation). He has attended the same primary, middle, high school and university as Kujou, chasing her everywhere so he doesn't lose contact with her. Despite being blessed in all things, he is quite naive and a poor guy when it comes to romance.

name: Mao Motomiya
description:
Childhood friends with the Nakamuras' and has a lonely childhood that consisted of an empty house, an unloyal mother, and a emotionally scarred father. Her parents are divorced. She lives with [Hiro Nakamura](https://anilist.co/character/67527/Nakamura-Hiro) and [Daiki Nakamura](https://anilist.co/character/81071/Nakamura-Daiki) because of an unloving atmosphere with her father and his new wife and daughter.

Is in love with Hiro and he with her.

name: Hiro Nakamura
description:
__Occupation:__ Entry Level Programmer

Hiro is always a caring person and always helps people when they are in trouble. He is the one who does most of the chores at home and is quite skilled at housework, being described as motherly by [Mao](https://anilist.co/character/59053/Motomiya-Mao). He doesn't want his family to be apart nor make his family worried. He is rather polite, gentle, cheerful and sometimes dense (according to Mao). Hiro hopes that he can live together with his family despite the death of their parents and tries his best to bring his siblings back home.

At the end of the se

name: Daiki Nakamura
description:
Hiro's younger brother. Likes playing video games even if he's not that good at them. Has similar tastes to Mao in the sort of things he likes.
It is revealed that Daiki likes Mao, but Mao is oblivious. His brother, Hiro, knows. Later in the chapters, Daiki finally confesses to Mao that he likes her. Mao thinks he's lying though and she runs away to her parents house to get away.

name: Perez Durelli
description: Perez is an illegitimate son of the emperor, born from a concubine, which puts him in a precarious position within the imperial family. Due to his status, he initially lives a harsh and secluded life, facing neglect and contempt from those around him. However, as the story progresses, Perez becomes a significant figure in the plot, particularly in his relationship with the protagonist, Firentia Lombardi.

name: Najimi Ajimu
