aliases: The Non-Human Who Is Just Impartial
description: Najimi Ajimu, or Anshin'in as she prefers to be called, has existed for over 3 trillion years before the universe was even created, and 3,402,193,822,311 years by the time of the series. Unlike Pluses like [Kurokami Medaka](https://anilist.co/character/21794/Kurokami-Medaka) who see themselves above normals, or Minuses like [Misogi Kumagawa](https://anilist.co/character/36753/Kumagawa-Misogi) who see themselves below normals, Anshin'in belongs to an ideology she calls "Not Equals". Anshin'in and the other Not Equal, [Hanten Shiranui](https://anilist.co/character/51681/Shiranui-Hanten), do not

name: Zenkichi Hitoyoshi
description: The male protagonist, childhood friend of Medaka, and the Student Council General Affairs Manager, reluctantly joining for the sake of protecting Medaka; in the pilot chapter, Medaka assigns him to become the Vice President. Zenkichi always shows enthusiasm toward Medaka’s cause for helping others and will punish anyone who opposes that cause. It is later revealed that he is the one who reformed Medaka into her current personality. It is implied he has feelings for her. Little is known about Zenkichi's past except that he has been with Medaka since they were two years old. The relationship bet

name: Mogana Kikaijima
description: Mogana Kikaijima is a freshman and later junior of Class 11. She is a member of the Swimming Club, and is later hired as the treasurer for [Medaka Kurokami](https://anilist.co/character/21794/Medaka-Kurokami)'s Student Council.

name: Misogi Kumagawa
description:
__Academic Status:__ 3rd year, class -13
__Schoo:l__ Previously is Hakobune School and Suisou Academy. Currently Hakoniwa Academy. 
__Affiliation:__ Previously Kumagawa's Student Council of Hakobune School, Kumagawa's Student Council of Suisou Academy, Kumagawa's Student Council of Hakoniwa Academy, Medaka's Student Council, Naked Apron Alliance and Tsurubami Team/All Jokers
__Position:__ Previously President, General Affairs Manager, Vice-President
__Mentality:__ Minus 
__Abilities:__ All Fiction, Book Maker, Hundred Gauntlets, Unskilled 

Kumagawa Misogi, commonly referred to as simply Kumag

name: Medaka Kurokami
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'4")

Medaka is an incredibly beautiful and talented first year student. She became Hakoniwa Academy's Student President as she managed to get 98% of the student body's support. One of her pledges during her campaign was to set up a suggestion box (which later became known as the Medaka Box), along with her childhood friend [Zenkichi](https://anilist.co/character/21795/Hitoyoshi-Zenkichi), goes out to solve any and all problems that comes through.

She is very confident and isn't ashamed of any part of her body at all. She is extremely intelligent and can understand all he

name: Youka Naze
description: The researcher for class 13 and current supervisor of the Flask Plan. While attractive and possessing a strong resemblance to Medaka, she favors concealing her face behind bandages and embeds a knife in her forehead since she dislikes the attention her face attracts.

name: Hansode Shiranui
description: Hansode Shiranui is a freshman and later junior of Class -13, originally of Class 1, and Zenkichi Hitoyoshi's best friend

name: Natsu Momoya
description:
__Height:__ 177cm

Natsu Momoya is a 1st year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club. In his free time, he goes drumming or dates girls.

Momoya came from the same junior high school as Kudo, and as such knew of his violent history.

name: Atsumu Yoshinaga
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

Atsumu Yoshinaga is a 1st year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club. He is a quiet, awkward and timid boy and hasn't dealt with people all that much in his life, so he doesn't quite understand personal space. He clings to people he likes and is shown to be a crybaby.

He was very close to his grandfather when he was a little boy and was bullied by other boys because of him playing koto.

name: Lanuvel
description: Lanuvel is an archeologist and sorcerer that chases after ancient legends in the world of Fantasia. She's the guide of the heroes in the script of Fantasia Education Center and a secret associate of the director of the school.

name: Taiyou Asano
description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family, Asano Family
__Occupation:__ Student, Spy
__Blooming:__  Hardening

Taiyou is the main protagonist of the series. He is a Spy and member of the Yozakura Family. Taiyou married into the Yozakura Family for the sake of wanting to protect Mutsumi Yozakura and also find out the truth of what happened the day of the car accident which took his parents' and younger brother's lives.

Taiyou was a cheerful person before he went through the experience of his entire family's death in a car accident. It was after that day that his personality and made him afraid of formi

name: Mutsumi Yozakura
description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Student, Spy, Head of Yozakura Family

Mutsumi is one of the main protagonists of the series. She is the wife of [Taiyo Asano](https://anilist.co/character/162723/Taiyou-Asano) and the current head of the Yozakura Family.

Mutsumi is a kind and caring girl who can be willing to do anything to help her friends and family. Additionally, she is responsible as a sister and as the Head of the Yozakura Family, taking after her late mother, the previous head of the family. Since being married to Taiyo Asano, she's seen assisting in Taiyo's missions, le

name: Kyouichirou Yozakura
description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy, Vice-Principal of a School, Principal of Teiou Academy
__Blooming:__  Void


Kyoichiro is the oldest son and most powerful spy in the Yozakura Family. After a certain mission, where his younger sister and head of the Yozakura Family, [Mutsumi Yozakura](https://anilist.co/character/162724/) was badly injured, Kyoichiro swore to protect from there on out, no matter the cost.

Kyoichiro is a sister-loving freak. Practically a stalker and would do anything to protect his little sister, Mutsumi. He is very over-protective of her, and won't let a

name: Futaba Yozakura
description:
__Age:__ 21
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy
__Blooming:__  Magnanimity

The responsible second child of the Yozakura family. Her diminutive stature belies her incredible strength and skill in hand-to-hand combat.

Futaba may seem like the non-gentle kind but is actually pretty kind and helpful. At times she can be strict but truly wants the best for her family. Unlike the oldest son [Kyoichiro](https://anilist.co/character/165308/Kyouichirou-Yozakura), Futaba is calmer and protects her family from a distance. She is almost always the one that can easily put Kyoichiro back

name: Shinzo Yozakura
description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy (Gold Rank)
__Blooming:__  Destroy

The constantly jittery third child of the family, specialized in firearms. He often hides in a trash can.

Shinzo is a scaredy-cat, and he also has a rather low self-esteem despite his strength when serious. Shinzo always has one of his guns on him, even when he was a child. Without his weapons of choice, Shinzo seems useless and cowards in fear and distress. He gives off a different, more serious vibe as if he is focused on something important when armed. However, despite these weaknesses, Shinzo wants to

name: Shion Yozakura
description:
__Afiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy, Hacker
__Blooming:__  Analyzation

A fiercely competitive Gamer Girl and the fourth child of the family, she's a hypercompetent hacker.

name: Kengo Yozakura
description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Spy
__Blooming:__  Assimilate
The cheerfully mischievous fifth child of the family, who can craft hyperrealistic disguises.

name: Nanao Yozakura
description:
__Affiliation:__ Yozakura Family
__Occupation:__ Student, Spy
__Blooming:__  Adaptation


Nanao is one of the main supporting characters and younger son in the Yozakura Family.

He is the sweet and gentle (but enormous) youngest brother, adept at creating drugs and medicine of all kinds. Hides his face with a bucket.

 It is later revealed that he uses medicine to shrink his body so he can look like a normal student and go to school to try and live a normal life.

name: Alpha Yozakura
description:
__Blooming:__  Precognition

The son of Taiyo and Mutsumi Yozakura and the younger twin of Hifumi Yozakura.

name: Hifumi Yozakura
description:
__Blooming:__  Infinity

The daughter of Taiyo and Mutsumi Yozakura and the older twin of Alpha Yozakura.

name: Mamoru Aikawa
description: Mamoru Aikawa is a God Candidate and a major antagonist of Tenkuu Shinpan. As he witnessed his father's suicide as a young child, for which his father wrote a note to "those who betrayed him" on his business and social ventures, Mamoru grew to despise those who were betrayed, believing them to be a cancer to society and worthy of suicide. He explains this belief to Rika and anyone who will listen, with his doctrine explained as: those who earn betrayal earn death.

name: Shizuka Doumeki
description: Shizuka Dômeki is Kimihiro Watanuki's classmate and considered a rival by Watanuki. He is part of the school's kyūdō club and often participates (and tops) school competitions. Also because of his cool and calm composure he is very popular with the girls. He has a cool, calm and often sarcastic demeanor. He barely speaks unless explaining folklore or asking Watanuki for impossible bento lunches (such as asking for food that is out of season or hard to find). He also has a deadpan sense of humor that is often dark and somewhat fatalistic. Much to the annoyance of Watanuki he seems to pop up eve

name: Yuuko Ichihara
description:
Being one extremely experienced in her industry, Yuuko is not foolish enough to give away her real name like [Watanuki](https://anilist.co/character/235). That aside, Yuuko has served as a major catalyst for Watanuki's transformation, acting somewhat as his mentor. She loves to drink and eat Watanuki's wonderful cooking and dragging Watanuki on crazy outings at the drop of a hat.

Despite this immature and free-spirited attitude, Yuuko has been known to be sage-like and serious when the time calls for it. Yuuko seems to know the true hitsuzen that Watanuki will follow, and has often offered cr

name: Himawari Kunogi
description: Watanuki's main love interest. He has been infatuated with Himawari ever since the beginning of the series and even some cryptic remarks from Yūko like "are you sure she's good luck?" haven't deterred him.  Himawari is caring and kind towards Watanuki, but she has her own reasons in avoiding him becoming closer to her.  For some reason she was born with the power to cause serious misfortune (although unintended) to those around her, an issue that even brought death to her grandmother and sometimes brought trouble to her friends.

name: Kimihiro Watanuki
description:
Watanuki (a name meaning "April 1" in kanji) is known for having both a volatile and caring personality. Depending upon the person he talks to, his emotions tend to be overly exaggerated. He lives alone because his parents died when he was young, but harder than these conditions is the fact that his everyday life is plagued with strange spirits that only he can see, and they are drawn to him. Apparently this was inherited- it is noted that his blood smells good to spirits.

One average day, while Watanuki is being chased by a legion of spirits, he comes across a strange house which the spirits

name: Sakura
description:
Kind and upbeat, Sakura is the princess of the Kingdom of Clow and Syaoran's childhood friend. She had her memories spread in the form of feathers across multiple worlds and dimensions.

Moments before her death in Nihon Country, Sakura reveals to Syaoran that she's not "his Sakura" and that she is only a clone of the original Sakura.

name: Fai D. Flourite
native: ファイ・D・フローライト
description: Fai's introduction is in chapter two of the manga, in which he is shown sealing away King Ashura of Celes country at the bottom of a pool. He transforms his creation Chii (originally from Chobits) into a net-like shield, instructing her to alert him if King Ashura should awake. He then uses his magic to transport himself through dimensions, to the shop of the Space-Time Witch, Yuuko Ichihara.  Out of his travel companions, Fai’s motives for joining the group are the least clear. He was the only one to arrive at Yuuko's shop purposefully, by use of his own means. His wish was to never return to

name: Elijah Ballard
description: The son of the famous drug lord Enoa Ballard, Elijah and the rest of his family is soon swept along on waves of trouble due to their father's antagonism towards Propater. Only nearly eluding capture by Propater agents, Elijah starts his journey being on the run from his father's enemies, but soon return to rescue his mother and sister from their captors. Starting out as a naive child, Elijah soon experience the harshness of the world first hand, and if the world is cruel, then he too, must be.

name: Tae-Gyeong Jin
description: Jin Tae-Kyung is a low-rank hunter who picks up a VR machine and accidentally logs into the game, which is set in the world of Martial Arts. After many ups and downs, Tae-Kyung is able to escape this world.

name: Emma
description:
Emma is a blind woman who always has her eyes closed and originally uses a cane. She ran away from home and went looking for a job. She meets [Aleksander](https://anilist.co/character/259597/Aleksander) by accident by hitting him with her cane and he eventually becomes her lover.

She loves croissants, the smell of perfume, and fluffy clothes. She also likes wines and spirits, and herbal tea. She has three older sisters, two younger sisters, and a dog.

name: Aleksander
description:
A police officer in Sashenka's police station who by chance meets [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/200756/Emma), who accidentally hits him with her cane. It's implied he's Russian.

The two eventually become lovers.

He is not a morning person. He likes reading, Assam tea and smokes Chesterfield. He has a half sister that works at a cabaret.

name: Giselle Perdium
description:
Born into the noble Perdium family, Ghislain Perdium harbored a deep resentment toward his household. Consumed by feelings of inferiority, he lashed out in defiance, pushing away those around him. As his reckless behavior worsened, the once proud Perdium estate grew distant, and isolation became his only companion. Unable to endure the growing scorn, he abandoned his home, leaving his past behind.

Years of hardship forged him into something new. As a mercenary, he fought, bled, and survived, sharpening his skills until he stood among the strongest warriors on the continent. He became known as

appearsIn.title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan
The Reborn Young Lord is an Assassin

name: Naoko Kirino
aliases: Pumpkin Night (パンプキンナイト)
description:
Naoko is a cheerful, childish and intelligent girl, she has a passion for Halloween and was shown to be very excited when she was crowned the "The Pumpkin Queen", she also has a strong personality and isn't willing to give in to anyone, she'll do what it takes to have her way.
Because of the trauma, Naoko has become a psychopathic, sadistic and ruthless girl, killing mercilessly her bullies and innocent people.
She also mispronounces other people's names on purpose (e.g Chaki, Kachuya, Nyaruto, etc).

(Source: Pumpkin Night Wiki)

name: Sakurako Amamiya
description:
She is a childhood friend of [Ageha Yoshina](https://anilist.co/character/10478/Ageha-Yoshina). Although she used to have a kind and cheerful personality, she is now known in class as the "Ice Queen"—super cool and anarchic. While Ageha’s internal monologue refers to her as an "untouchable girl," she is actually being bullied by the other girls in the class.

She primarily fights using weapons like swords and *kusarigama* (sickle-and-chain), enhancing her physical abilities with "Rise" in combat. When facing ordinary humans, she may use blunt weapons (such as tonfas) to avoid killing them.

Wh

name: Asaga Hiryuu
description:
__Height:__ 187cm

He is a first-year male student at Chikyuwa High School, distinguished by his largeframe and spiky brown hair. He possesses physical strength to match his imposing build.

He has a thoughtful and calm personality.

After his junior, [Tatsuo Mana](https://anilist.co/character/13810/Tatsuo-Mana), went missing following an involvement with "Psyren," he became a "Psyren Drifter" himself in order to search for him. His PSI ability excels in "Burst" (physical force); he manifests and manipulates dragon-like tails and wings.

name: Kabuto Kirisaki
description:
He has a cheerful, carefree personality and dislikes both trouble and violence; his specialty is running away. He also possesses keen eyesight and a sharp eye for reading people.

He is a feminist who treats men and women very differently. He looks up to his uncle, the journalist Toji Kirisaki, affectionately calling him "Ojiki" (Boss/Uncle).

He became a "Silent Drift" after picking up a red telephone card, though initially, he could not bring himself to accept this new reality. His PSI ability is "Menace"—a form of precognitive vision that allows him to foresee future dangers. Since he skips

name: Oboro Mochizuki
description:
A male actor. He becomes affiliated with Psyren after finding a red telephone card.

While he markets himself as having a calm demeanor for his work, in reality, he is curious and self-centered. He detests boredom and prioritizes having fun above all else.

He possesses a talent for handling PSI and is a user of the rare healing ability known as "CURE." However, his performance with CURE is relatively low-level compared to other users.

Later, when facing a life-threatening situation, he awakens a unique ability called "Harmonious" (Life Fusion). This ability allows him to absorb, fuse with, a

name: Ageha Yoshina
description:
__Height:__ 168cm

He is short-tempered, impulsive, and a bit of a goofball. At the same time, however, he possesses good situational judgment, insight, and self-control; he also has a cold-blooded side that allows him to calmly and unhesitatingly carry out a decision—even if it involves murder—once his mind is made up.

Restless and frustrated with his life, he sought an outlet by taking on requests from acquaintances for a fee of 10,000 yen, resolving their issues primarily through violent means.

After obtaining a red Psyren telephone card—and learning that his childhood friend and classmat

name: Alice
description:
Alice is a young, carefree girl who is the 431st guest of the manor. She expresses that she despises lies and carries herself in a nonchalant way through a journey said to be "tantamount to suicide"

At the end of the manga, Alice is revealed to be more of an anti-hero. She was a princess bedridden from illness that held nothing but the desire to truly experience the world. She becomes greatly invested in literature, using it as a proxy to experience the world that has been cut off from her. She then grows the desire to create the ultimate book, a book containing infinite knowledge. Her book c

name: Yuuka Okkotsu
description: Granddaughter of [Yuta Okkotsu](https://anilist.co/character/129571/Okkotsu-Yuuta) and [Maki Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/134167/Zenin-Maki). A Jujutsu Sorcerer in training, Yuuka wishes to show that she deserves the favor of her household.

name: Tsurugi Okkotsu
description: Grandson of Yuta Okkotsu and Maki Zenin. A Jujutsu Sorcerer in training, Tsurugi aims to show that he does not need the favor of his household.

name: Marulu Yelvori
native: マルル・ヴァル・ヴル・イェルヴリ
description: An extraterrestrial belonging to the Simurian race, Marulu is a representative of his people - who are planning to emigrate to Earth as refugees. His most notable feature is the third eye in the middle of his forehead (covered with a patch when he needs to blend among humans), and powers that are similar to Jujutsu Sorcerers.

name: Cross Yelvori
native: クロス・ヴァル・ヴル・イェルヴリ
description: A dispatch officer of the Simurian refugees who have come seeking a home at Earth, Cross is the younger twin brother of [Marulu.](https://anilist.co/character/374243/Marulu-Val-Vol-Yelvori) Unlike his older brother, who believes that they can coexist with humanity, Cross believes the only way their people will be safe is by going to war with Japan.

name: Satsuki Shishio
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm

Yukichi's friend and Suzume's teacher. He gave the nickname "Chun-Chun" to Suzume. He is a bit of an oddball because outside of his profession as a teacher his appearance changes to accommodate the fact; his hair is messy, he wears big glasses and his clothes and manner of speech are more suited to that of a cheerful, somewhat weird teenager. He retains some of his nature while in his role as a teacher and discards anything that is considered unprofessional, claiming he knows the line between work and outside, but that line begins to blur once he starts spending time with S

name: Suzume Yosano
description: Suzume grew up in the countryside most of her life until her father's work made him and Suzume's mother leave the country. They leave her in the care of her uncle who lives in Tokyo and owns a restaurant. She meets Shishio randomly at the bus stop and discovers that he is her uncle's friend and her teacher. She is obsessed with an occurrence that happened when she was in elementary school, in which after getting lost on the way home, she saw a shooting star in the middle of the day. She has bad grades and frequently skips class due to her obsession with once again seeing that star.

name: Daiki Mamura
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm 


His exterior is cool and aloof but he is actually extremely shy when girls make any physical contact and blushes profusely. When Suzume discovers this, she "blackmails" him by threatening to tell other people his secret. Despite his frustration and annoyance at her, he agrees and thus makes his first female friend. He finds it hard to talk to girls because in his house there are only men; Suzume teases him for being simple when he tells her. Eventually, it becomes slightly easier for him to talk to them thanks to Suzume's not-so-subtle prompting.  Mamura is normally very

name: Yuyuka Nekota
description:
**Height:** 156 cm 

Suzume's friend and classmate. She has an unrequited love for Mamura. Initially, she believes Suzume likes Mamura so Yuyuka tries to get close to him using Suzume, but her plan falls through when Suzume confronts and reprimands her for her actions; shortly after they become friends.  Yuyuka's true personality is very blunt and unforgiving which she believes would cause friction with people, which is why she hides behind a "cute" exterior that is friendly and outgoing in order to make friends. Suzume is the first friend she makes who knows her true personality.

name: Maruo Kaido
description: Maruo dreams of becoming a manga protagonist as he punches his way into the monstrous world of the Ayashimon Yakuza.

name: Urara
description: Urara is the deuteragonist of Ayashimon. She is an oni Ayashimon who is the founder and kumicho of the Urara Family, which consists of only her and Maruo Kaido. She is also secretly the illegitimate child of the late first chairman of the Enma Syndicate, Kio.

name: Woo-Jin Kim
description: The main protagonist of _Kill The Hero_.

name: Jin-A Lee
description: Phoenix Guild's player, O Se-Chan's friend.

name: Ludger Cherish
description: A fake professor at Ceoren Academy.

name: Jae-Gu Song
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10)

Song Jae-Gu is the main protagonist of the series. He is a first year at Wild's High and also the first male student to be enrolled into the former girls-only school after its conversion to a co-ed institution. He is currently not ranked. While he uses no materials, he's being taught boxing.

name: In-Gwi Yun
description: Known primarily as Queen, In-Gwi is the heroine in the series, an S-Class ranked second-year student and the current Wild's League champion. She is a mixed martial artist, proficient in nearly every form of martial arts, where she helps spar with each of the school clubs. Her initial encounter with Jae-Gu leads to misunderstanding, due to a bad experience with a boy in her childhood. She nevertheless quickly develops feelings for Jae-Gu, who does not fawn over her like everyone else.

name: Mun-Yeong Lee
description: Lee Mun-Yeong is an S-class Wild's High School second year student, where she is the president of the boxing club and Queen's best friend and confidante. She is loud, rambunctious, and outgoing, as opposed to the reserved personality that Queen shows. However, when she is fighting seriously, she becomes a very powerful and frightening opponent, well-deserving of being Queen's best friend. She has a friendly rivalry with Choi Dal-Dal over martial arts and the attention of the series' protagonist, Song Jae-Gu.

name: Dal-Dal Choi
description: Choi Dal-Dal is a cute and bubbly young woman. She is the president of the Taekwondo club in Wild's High and has a friendly rivalry with Lee Mun-Yeong over martial arts and the attention of the series' protagonist, Song Jae-Gu.

name: Sera Kang
description: She is a member of the Mil-Yang Clan and is currently the clan's head. She had initially gained a grudge against Shi-Woon Yi because Goomoonryong had killed her grandfather until today, where the two are friends-in-arms, and love interest of Shi-Woon Yi  She is a young, slender girl with ears that stick out of her long, black, straight hair. She is often wearing formal attire. Other clothing she had worn would be general clothing, whether it'd be a long or short-sleaved shirt with shorts or skirts. In her initial introduction with her meeting with Shi-Woon, the latter had remarked his first im

name: Jin-le Kwon
description: A redheaded girl (inherited from her father) born to an American father and a Korean mother. During her early life, she lived with her mother in America. However, following a plane crash which resulted in her mother's death, her maternal grandfather took her in. She was trained in the Sun-Woo Clan's martial arts, and is said to be amongst the top five for her skills.  At the start of New Waves, she is guarding Shi-Woon from other Schools that want to exact revenge on him for actions committed by the Nine Arts Dragon. After Shi-Woon is introduced to the four elders of the Sun-Moon Clan, she is

name: Mamori Anezaki
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5' 4")

Sena's overprotective and motherly childhood friend. Mamori's mother met Sena's mother in a cooking class, and Mamori and Sena have been friends ever since. Her mother is half-Japanese, half-American which makes Mamori 25% American and 75% Japanese. Mamori has been protecting Sena from bullies since primary school, to the point that Sena has grown up never having to stand up for himself. Mamori joined the American Football club to watch over Sena and prevent any bullying by the other members (particularly Hiruma). Despite her joining the American Football club just

name: Youichi Hiruma
description: Hiruma usually acts in a vulgar, bizarre, threatening manner so as to intimidate or disturb those around him into getting what he wants. He has a cunning, goal-oriented mind and does not seem to care what means he uses to accomplish those goals. His sense of morals is lax at best, but he is quick to find the moral flaws of others, which he keeps recorded in his "Book of Threats" or "Devil's Handbook", and uses this information to blackmail everyone from students to figures of authority into placing him in a position of power. He has little respect for authority and has in fact usurped authorit

name: Sena Kobayakawa
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5' 1")
 
The main character of Eyeshield 21. Initially a bullied gopher, his speed was discovered by Hiruma as he was literally forced into joining the football team at Deimon. However, he soon grows to love the game he plays as he masters both the Speed of Light Pace and further techniques as he gains the confidence to become a successful player. At different times throughout the anime and the manga he will often, through emotions, tap into the "Speed of Light Pace", but the problem with this is every time he does that he will often overextend himself causing himself to fa

name: Ryokan Kurita
description: Position: Center / Defensive Tackle / Long snapper  Jersey: 77  40 yard dash: 6.5 seconds  Bench Press: 160 kg (352 lb)  Height: 195 cm (6' 4")  Weight: 145 kg (319 lb)  Graduated From: Mao 13th Middle School  2nd Year Student (Grade 11)    The largest and strongest player in the Deimon American Football club. Kurita lives in a temple with his father, who is the director of a Buddhist sect. His father believed that to grow up big and strong, a young boy had to eat a lot, but unfortunately it seems he has overfed his son. Kurita, as his name would suggest, has a head shaped like a chestnut. He

name: Tarou Raimon
description:
**Position:** Wide Receiver Split end / Cornerback  
**Jersey:** 80  
**40 yard dash:** 5.0 (as of the start of the Kantou tournament)  

Monta is the wide receiver of the Deimon Devil Bats American football team. He resembles an ape, particularly a chimpanzee, in many ways; indeed, his simian similarity is the character's running joke throughout the manga. Although he is as short as Sena, his large hands, arms (that are noticeably longer than his legs), acrobatic moves, and leaping ability make him a very effective receiver; he can even catch Hiruma's bullet passes with one hand. He has a hab

name: Gen Takekura
description:
__Position:__ Kicker/Linebacker  
__Jersey:__ 11  
__40 yard dash:__ 5.6 seconds  
__Bench Press:__ 90 kgs  
__Height:__ 177 cm (5' 9")  

The place kicker for the Devil Bats and one of the original three members of the team (along with Hiruma and Kurita). He is often mistaken for an older person (even though he is only 17), since he initially has a bit of stubble and has a buzz-cut. He leaves the team during the spring season of his freshman year, due to the fact that his father had become seriously ill. As a result, he was forced to drop out of school and take over as the construction forema

name: Aria Roscent
description: After Aria’s mother Carin Roscente married Count Roscente, Aria became the stepsister of Cain Roscente and Mielle Roscente. Having received a second chance in life, she begins to develop various schemes to get ahead of Mielle, as well as humiliate her and destroy her reputation in ways that parallel Aria’s downfall in the original line of events. Having been quite frank and spoiled after her initial rise in social standing (among other things, refusing to eat vegetables, deeming them commoner food she had more than enough of), Aria now learns to put on a mask and behave in more efficacious way

name: Asterope Franz
description:
Asterope is the Crown Prince of the empire. He goes by "Asher" to avoid telling Aria he's part of the royal family. He first meets Aria when he's in town investigating the casino case and she's retrieving her repaired hourglass.

Asher is described as an exceptionally tall young man with short black hair and highly handsome facial features. He has an angled face, pale skin, and ears that redden when embarrassed. Although Asher’s build is rather slender overall, he has very wide shoulders. Most prominently, his eyes have a distinct blue color which is commonly remarked upon in the novel.

name: Mielle Roscent
description: Mielle Roscent is the half sister of [Aria Roscent](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent).

name: Yukari Hayasaka
description: Yukari is the heroine of the story, a high school student who is tired of the meaningless and repetitive life that has been forced upon her by her uptight mother. She eventually models for Paradise Kiss after being "kidnapped" by Isabella and whisked away to Paradise Kiss' "atelier". She is often referred to, inexplicably, as "Caroline" by Miwako.  Yukari begins the series as a pretty faced, yet rather unattractive in personality, high school senior that studies dutifully for university entrance exams. When she meets the ParaKiss crew, she begins to discover new depth to her personality and li

name: George Koizumi
description:
George (real name Johji) is an eccentric, handsome, and extremely charismatic student of Yazagaku who has extraordinary talent with a gift for fashion design, haute couture in particular. Despite his cold demeanor, he has extravagant ideas on everything, most of which are not accepted by the general public. He wants Yukari to become an independent woman, as well as a girl that will take responsibility for her own mistakes. 

His appearance is loosely based on Brian Slade of Velvet Goldmine, and several references to the film are made by him in the manga. He has distinctive blue hair and eyes,

name: Arashi Nagase
description:
Miwako's boyfriend and a student of Yazagaku who also works with George to run Paradise Kiss. He is the son of a musician and a guitarist in a punk band. He tends to act rough, but can be very caring. He also has quite an assortment of facial piercings. Son of Kanzaki Risa, who is a good friend of Mikako Kouda, also from Gokinjo Monogatari.    

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Miwako Sakurada
description: A student of Yazagaku who works with George to run their own brand, Paradise Kiss. She is the younger sister of the creator of the Happy Berry brand, Mikako Kouda, who was the protagonist of Gokinjo Monogatari. She is very sweet and cute, and tends to act in a rather childlike manner.

name: Isabella Yamamoto
description: Isabella is the mother figure to the members of ParaKiss. This tall Yazagaku student is the epitome of high class and femininity. Isabella inspired George's very first dress during childhood and often had the habit of taking every piece of clothing that he finished. Isabella encourages Yukari when she needs it the most, whether it be regarding George or her abandoned studies.

name: Taiga Hirasawa
description:
A highschooler and member of the drama club who wants to become japans top actor. As a child, he was a big fan of superheroes and wanted to become a hero that protects girls. 

Due to events that occurred in his childhood, he began to only see people as what they were on the surface and ran away from his thoughts as a means to avoid getting hurt.

name: Yuu Arima
description:
A freshman in highschool and member of the drama club as a dancer.  

As a child, he was dressed as a girl by his mother due to her desire to have a daughter. He had to learn how to act like a proper girl, and through the constant practice refining his movements, learning how to dance, sing and play instruments, and act, he begun to feel that by playing the role as a girl it’d be the only way he would be accepted, and the only way he knew how to live.

He was raped as a child by a teacher of his, and was saved by a man whom he eventually forgot the face of, but was later revealed to be Taiga’s

name: Psyche Polly
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5' 1")

__Background:__
Psyche grew up in the wealthy House of Callista as the only daughter of the count and countess. Since birth, Psyche possessed the divine power to heal. She was capable of healing minor to relatively major wounds on her own body, and on those of others within a certain vicinity. Because she had no voluntary control over this ability, Psyche was confined to the basement of the count's manor, forbidden to enter the outside world. Her mother, Countess Callista, wished to protect Psyche and her divine power from being discovered by greedy nobles. Psyche w

name: Medea Belial
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5' 6")

As a reputable, high-ranking noble, Medea possesses a certain level of haughtiness. Though she exhibits proper grace and savoir-faire in public as the duke's daughter, she is also known to have an unpleasant temper. Medea often treats those of lower class, typically ordinary civilians and servants, with contempt and condescension. Many find it difficult to associate with her, believing that her terrible personality will cause her trouble in finding a suitor. Since childhood, Medea is disciplined and diligent in her aspirations to become an individual worthy of being

name: Yoi Takiguchi
description:
__Height:__ 169.5 cm

A first year student in high school. Known as the female prince of the school. She works at her family's ramen shop.

name: Kohaku Ichimura
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Yoi Takiguchi's senpai. The male prince of the school.

name: Shiki Ichinose
description: Shiki is an oni whose powers manifest after an attack by the Momotarou results in the death of his adoptive father. Biologically, he is one of the eight children of Kishin and inherits the Fire elemental attribute. His Blood Eclipse Release manifests as various guns, a reflection of his past interest in them. The tremendous output of his power generates severe aftereffects, such as causing blood to rain from the sky.

appearsIn.title: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood

name: Naito Mudano
description: The teacher of Shiki's class. A taciturn, strict man, he is a highly-skilled fighter respected as such by both the oni and the Momotarou. He often travels on roller skates instead of walking. His Blood Eclipse Release manifests as an umbrella.

appearsIn.title: Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood

name: Shou Hazama
description:
The protagonist of the series.

Apparently an easygoing, reckless and somehow comical high-school student known only due to his incapability to arrive on time for classes, he is in fact the result of an experiment made years before by a powerful crime syndicate lord.  The man, dying of old age, tried to use medical knowledge and advanced technology to revive himself as a youth, and thus create a cloning facility where he experimented with cloning humans and transferring memories and experience from a mind to another, so as to be reborn as an ultimate being. His plans failed however, as he died

name: Min Ryu
description:
He lost his parents when he was young and was living with his younger brother, Ryu Won, working part-time as the head of a boy. However, he suffered from school violence and was exploited by his part-time job boss. 

Then, with the start of the Death Game, his life changes completely. Afterwards, through his 99 regressions,He reaches the final round of 20, but fails because he is the only player left and the requirement for round 20 is 5 people. He eventually decides to aim for a perfect strategy based on the information from his regression as he enters the 100th time.

appearsIn.title: The 100th Regression of the Max-Level Player

name: Ji-Han Han
description: Han Jee-Han (한지한, Hanjihan) also known as "The Gamer" is the main protagonist of the manhwa The Gamer. Jee-Han has recently discovered that he has a Natural Ability called The Gamer. This ability makes him experience his life in a game-like setting which was derived from his gaming addiction.

name: Julian
description: He is a runaway slave who has chosen to use his freedom to raise his adoptive sister Diana.

name: Diana
description: Diana is the daughter of Mira and the adoptive sister of Julian.

name: Onigiri
description: Team: Kogarasumaru  Road: Smell Road    One of Ikki's childhood friends, Onigiri (オニギリ, Onigiri?) is also part of Kogarasumaru. His head is in the shape of an onigiri. Onigiri is a pervert and characterized as a pig. He has an unusual way of using his perspiration, usually during overall perverted moments, to create illusions. He also has a strange way of using his AT by sitting upside down on it (to the chagrin of his female schoolmates whose skirts he tends to look up while doing this). This way of riding proved to be very dangerous, for both Onigiri and his opponent, as he flails his l

name: Issha Mihotoke
description: Team: Kogarasumaru  Former Team: Night King   Known as Buccha to his friends and teammates, Issa Mihotoke (御仏 一茶, Mihotoke Issa) is a level E AT user who uses his immense strength as his weapon. Before he became part of Kogarasumaru, he was the leader of the team Night King (夜王 Yaou) which was broken up after Buccha lost a Parts War with Ikki. Buccha is often characterized as a tank. He attends Higachu Junior High School. He appears to be obese, but his body is only ten percent fat. His size is actually caused by a large amount of blood pooling in his gut from overeating. He also has the abili

name: Kazuma Mikura
description: Team- Kogarasumaru  Status- Flame King  Road- Flame Road   known as Kazu to his friends, is a childhood friend of Ikki who becomes influenced to take up AT and join Kogarasumaru. He is originally bullied by Ikki as a child, and he often feels like others are more important than himself, especially compared to Ikki's natural talent. In the manga, Kazu owns a dog named Chiwa. He takes up running at a later point, which eventually leads to him being an exceptionally fast AT rider. As he shows signs of following the Flame Road, Spitfire takes an interest in him and eventually proclaims Kazu to be

name: Itsuki Minami
description:
__Height:__ 167cm
__Team:__ Kogarasumaru
__Road:__ Wing
__Road Status:__ Sky King candidate, After Sora's betrayal: Road: Hurricane road; Status: Storm King 
 
Known as Ikki (イッキ?) by his friends, and also known as Babyface, is a free spirited AT rider that has a natural affiliation for being in the sky. He is introduced to ATs by Noyamano family, whom he lives with due to his parents' deaths. He eventually forms Kogarasumaru, and takes on the Trophaeum. Ikki is often characterized as a crow due to a small crow, Kū, using his hair as a nest.  Ikki is able to see the Wing Road, and his peers of

name: Ringo Noyamano
description: Team- Sleeping Forest Status- Thorn Queen Road- Sonia Road  Ringo looks like your everyday junior high school girl. However, she is actually the successor of the legendary Storm Riders team, Sleeping Forest . She is also the current Thorn King (Queen) of the eight 'Kings' in the AT world. Ringo is in love with Ikki but does not dare to tell him. She helps Kogarasumaru in times of trouble under the guise of Croissant Mask (Croissiant Kamen). Ringo is a King Class AT user. Ringo is determined to show Ikki the "fear" of flying through the air, because she doesn't want to see him suffer the same f

name: Kururu Sumeragi
description: Kururu Sumeragi is the leader of the current Tool Toul To and Pledge Queen. She has very messy hair, and uses pins in attempt to keep it kempt. She always carries tools around in her clothing. She is Ikki's Tunner and wants to get to know him better personally and in order to tune him better. Although shy around Ikki at first, she becomes devoted to him after witnessing his anger over Simca's attack. She does not wear ATs, but as the leader of Tool Toul To, she is a true genius in repair, construction, and maintenance of ATs. In Ikki's battle with Ringo, Kururu identified the so

name: Agito Wanijima
description: Akito Wanijima and Agito Wanijima are two personalities that make up the Fang King, of the Bloody Road. They are originally part of the Wind SWAT team, in which they are treated like a tool by their older brother, Kaito. Ikki eventually saves them, and they join Kogarasumaru. They switch who is in control by using an eye patch. Akito is innocent and non-violent. He becomes attracted to Ikki, much to Ikki's discontent, and often tries to kiss, bathe, and sleep next to or with Ikki. He states he was the original Fang King until he became disgusted with himself and became unable to use AT. Agito

name: Jihan Seong
description: He possesses a rare "nameless" talent, which made him get another chance at beating the "Battle Net" game when humanity was about to be wiped out. Regressing back to when he was addicted to gambling and drinking, he now tries to make things different.

appearsIn.title: The Martial God Who Regressed Back to Level 2

name: Hatsu  Takagi
description: A girl suffering from 'Kokuhaku disease', having only a limited number of heartbeats before she dies. She refrains from activity, and keeps to herself. She learns to enjoy her time alive as a result of meeting Hato.

name: Hato  Iijima
description:
A boy who is inspired to show Hatsu the joys of life despite her 'Kokuhaku disease', spends time taking her places and giving her new experiences. 

Also suffers from 'Kokuhaku disease'.

name: Rinko Yoshitaka
description:
__Birthday:__ April 1st
__Occupation:__ Teacher

name: Ryou Arase
description: Rinko's student and something more

name: Hao Asakura
description:
Asakura Hao is the main antagonist in Shaman King and the most powerful shaman in the entirety of the series.

He was born Asaha Douji in Japan during the Heian era. During his third life he becomes the twin brother of his descendant Asakura Yoh. During his first life, he was constantly surrounded by the horrors of war and thus saw the world as a grim and dark place, until he met the small demon Ohachiyo, who taught him all the positive aspects of life. As he grew into an adult Hao became a relatively peaceful man who sought to help the people around him, and thanks to him the Asakura Family p

name: Jin Kyung
description: Jink-Yung was a fan of the idol Group, "Oh My Lady". After he calls himself a Pedophile on live TV by mistaking the word, he receives huge backlash from the viewers. His public life was effectively ruined and he spends his time inside his own room unable to leave the house because of his deep rooted fears, when suddenly one day he is summoned by an Apprentice Summoner - Maina Haze - to defeat a monster.

name: Benny
description: A young slave who served Elleyra, however decided to stop that and follow Ai and Jinkyung on their adventure.

name: Ai Haze
description: A rookie summoner who by chance invokes Jinkyung, who thanks to his incredible power, recruits her to stop the demons of the North.

name: Satoko Kirigaya
description:
Satoko is a noblewoman from a wealthy family. As she comes of age, she is expected to find a husband. However, she has a serious heart condition that makes it difficult to find a suitable match. Because of this, she tells every potential suitor about her illness so she does not deceive them, but many proposals are rejected because of it. 

One day, while out in town, she is kidnapped by men who intend to kill her. Then [Shinpei Gotou](https://anilist.co/character/298762/Shinpei-Gotou) appears. In order to save her life, she proposes marriage to him.

name: Elise De Clorance
aliases: エリーゼ・ド・クロレンス
description: Elise De Clorance is the princess to which Dr. Song, the youngest female professor at the leading College of Medicine in Korea was  reincarnated into after meeting an untimely death over the ocean. Enlightened with the medical knowledge of a master surgeon, is this her chance to mend her past relationships and heal an ailing empire, or is fate sealed to repeat itself?

appearsIn.title: Doctor Elise: The Royal Lady with the Lamp

name: Linden De Romanoff
aliases: リンデン・ド・ロマノフ

appearsIn.title: Doctor Elise: The Royal Lady with the Lamp

name: Amahiko Suzuki
description: Suzuki Amahiko is a cynical boy who gets depressed easily, mostly thanks to his uncaring foster parents and being alienated in school.

name: Kyoko Sakaki
description:
A one-eyed teacher in Suzuki's class. She got her injury when she tried to save Kimura Arie from a rapist at Nijigahara field. Since then, she stopped trying to get involved with children's problems at all. She married a teacher named Hatori from the same school.

(Source: MAL)

name: Maki Arakawa
description:
Arakawa Maki is a girl that studies at the art school and works part-time in Prism cafe. Komatsuzaki Kouta is her first love since childhood. However,​ she couldn't make him fall for her, because he is obsessed with Kimura Arie and can't love anyone else.

(Source: MAL)

name: Kanna
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

[Koharu](https://anilist.co/character/342735/Koharu)'s mentor. She's known to be laid-back and often runs away from fights between cupids. However, she will do anything to let Koharu succeed.

name: Ena
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

A cautious, yet strong-willed cupid. Having a fair amount of experience, Ena is determined to make sure the job of matchmaking is done well.

name: Chiyo
description:
__Height:__ 149 cm

A reckless cupid who loves fighting other cupids more than anything. Her energetic nature seems to land her in trouble a lot.

name: Koharu
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

A shy, inexperienced cupid, mentored by [Kanna](https://anilist.co/character/342734). Despite being new to the job, her insight gives her amazing matchmaking abilities.

name: Yuu Aikawa
description: Honest, straightforward, and friendly. His childhood friend is Mitsuki, whom he cares a great deal for, and he takes it upon himself to protect her at all costs. Mitsuki is also the only person that Yuu completely trusts within the group. Yuu found himself inside the hospital after receiving a blow to the head from a wrench inside the bathroom at the karaoke bar. He also seems to be the only person who has caught a glimpse of the wolf. He's the only one who doesn't have a bar code tattooed on his skin which, the group discovers, are the keys to unlocking the network of doors keeping them trapp

name: Haruka Akechi
description: This happy, fun-loving, and flirtatious girl turns into a scared, obsessive, and paranoid participant of the game. As the "Rabbit Doubt" advances, she seems to descend to madness, flinging accusations out left and right. She is the one to note that Yuu doesn’t have a bar code and believes him and Mitsuki to be the wolf after she learns Mitsuki's information is on file, when she should have only been an accidental participant. She ties Yuu up after attacking Mitsuki and locking her in the bathroom, then she disappears after claiming she can't trust Hajime either. When the others

name: Rei Hazama
description: The youngest of the players. She was involved on a hypnotism TV show, but after it was reported to be a scam by relentless reporters, she tried to commit suicide by walking out in front of a vehicle. She then had a change of mind at the last moment and wound up paralyzed instead of dead, so she is confined to a wheelchair. It’s because of her past that Rei is shy and tends to be nervous around others. She is harassed by Eiji at first, but when Yuu comes to her rescue, she is grateful and reveals the truth to him. Eiji overhears and reports it to the rest of the group who is shocked, but

name: Eiji Hoshi
description: This 18 years old boy is aggressive, abrasive, and sometimes violent. He has a smoking and drinking habit for which he is chastised by Mitsuki, a cop's daughter, who refuses to let him indulge in either vice while under the age of 20.  He flirted with Rei, but after hearing her talk to Yuu about her past as a famous hypnotist, he immediately exposed her in front of everyone. After the tension in the group has eased, Eiji disappears to the bathroom and is not to be seen again until the group reawakens in the mental hospital. Once the real life or death game of "Rabbit Doubt" begins, h

name: Mitsuki Houyama
description: She was not one of the original players and only tagged along to be with Yuu, whom she seems to have a crush on. She gets jealous when other girls are friendly with him. As the horror that develops, she is constantly seeking reassurance and protection from Yuu. She is the daughter of a cop, which contributes to her strong sense of morality, and her mother died when she was young. Yuu found her crying and promised to protect her, and they have been close since. She is the most emotional of all with a weak constitution, screaming or fainting at the first sign of danger or injury. Mitsuki wants t

name: Hajime Komaba
description: A medical student attending university, he is the last of the players to be presented. He didn’t meet with the others because he was lured by a false text message to a different meeting place at a different where he was abducted separate from the group. He reveals to Yuu that the text message apparently came from his phone, which Yuu denies having any knowledge of. Cool and collected, he is the most level-headed of the players and appears to have the best understanding of what is going on. He stumbles across most of the clues and comes up with most of the deductions, which causes him to

name: Chii Nishikata
description: Daughter of Nishikata and (née) Takagi. She hates green peppers, but loves to tickle her father. At the beginning of the story, she goes to kindergarten.

name: Hikikomori Seijin
description: The make-believe characters working in the NHK (Nihon Hikkikomori Kyokai) in Satou Tatushiro's fantasy during his anti-social years. In Satou's imagination, this group of blue goblins with pink sleeping caps are part of a conspiracy that tries to ruin his life.

name: Shougo Kawada
description: Boy #5 Shougo Kawada, portrayed as a loner within the class ranks, is a transfer student. He is put in Class B about two months before the program takes place. He is the winner of a previous program, some three years prior.

name: Kazuo Kiriyama
description: The manga's primary antagonist, Kazuo Kiriyama is a ruthless killer, who is also a savant with no feelings of remorse. He also possesses a genius level I.Q., mastering things such as playing the violin in minutes, and has an uncanny ability to adapt to situations quickly.  His starting weapon is a Ingram MAC-10 Uzi.   Kazuo has AB-type blood.  The characters in Kazuo's given name mean "peace" and "male," respectively. The characters in his family name mean "mist" and "mountain."  In the novel and manga, it's implied that he is an illegitimately born child due to maternal infidelity. After kill

name: Shinji Mimura
description: Boy #19 Shinji Mimura uses his intellect to invent an escape plan.    His first plan is to hack into the government's computer and disable their collars, and then bomb the school. He is unsuccessful at hacking into the computer, since he discusses his plan with a fellow student, and the conversation is transmitted through his collar back to the teacher, who puts a stop to that plan. Shinji then attempts to bomb the building where the Program's staff is bunkered in, a plan which fails after a slight disruption that results in Shinji's Death.

name: Noriko Nakagawa
description: Girl #15 Noriko Nakagawa is the story's primary female character and Shuuya's first companion. She is a quiet, reserved girl. She is shot in the lower leg by Yonemi for attempting to help Nobu, and also gets ill. Although she does not realize it, she manages to keep Shuuya sane.

name: Shuuya Nanahara
description: Boy #15 Shuuya Nanahara is the primary protagonist. He has witnessed a good deal of troubling events throughout his life. His father was killed by the government for struggling against the regime, and his mother died when he was in third grade. When the rest of his family rejected him, Shuuya was put in an orphanage. He is willing to trust others, not wanting to take part in the Battle Royale program. He tries several times to rally fellow students in an attempt to escape, but fails. Consequently, he narrowly escapes death at the hands of his classmates, on several occasions. Shuuya is a self-

name: Mitsuko Souma
description: Girl #11, Mitsuko Souma (相馬光子 Sōma Mitsuko?) is beautiful and seductive on the outside yet inside, she's a hollow shell, having been left damaged after suffering years of physical and sexual abuse from her stepfather. She is said to be the most beautiful girl in school with her angelic face, shapely body, and seductive smile which is referred to in the novel as her "fallen angel's smile." She uses her sexuality to her advantage throughout the series. Similar to Kazuo Kiriyama, Mitsuko suffers from childhood trauma, and she is the leader of her own gang, which consists of Hirono Shimizu and Yos

name: Yoshio Akamatsu
description: Boy #1 Yoshio Akamatsu is the first student to leave the school where they are briefed in all versions of the series.  The novel describes Yoshio, the largest student in Class 3-B, as "the timid type." Prior to the game, many students targeted Yoshio with pranks and insults.   He runs away, but later comes back and climbs onto the roof of the school, in an attempt to assassinate others. He is the first student to kill someone - Mayumi Tendo. In the novel and manga he shoots her back from behind, killing her. In the film he shoots Mayumi in the neck. He later attempts to kill Shuya Nanahara, bu

name: Hae-In Sin
description: A musician and self-proclaimed fan of Long Afternoon's.

appearsIn.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train

name: Yeo-Un Lee
description: A college student and big fan of the indie band Long Afternoon.

appearsIn.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train

name: Chiyo
aliases: The All-Mother Black Goat with a Thousand Young
description:
**Height:** 168 cm

A mysterious, kind and cheerful girl that Yuu accidentally summoned. She grants Yuu the wish of becoming his elder sister.

As Chiyo herself states she has been revered as a goddess, demon and monster during her existence but only Yuu has mistaken her for an angel.

name: Yuu Hasunuma
description: A young boy who has been forced to live among close and distant relatives ever since his parents died in an accident when he was young. He lived his entire life detached from the loving embrace of a family, thus prompting his wish to have Chiyo as his sister.

name: Kenshirou
description:
Kenshirou is the 64th successor of the "Hokuto Shin Ken" style. He has seven scars on his chest in the shape of the "Hokuto Shichisei ", or Big Dipper, that were put there by [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/16419/Shin).

A strong and mostly stoic character, Kenshiro is compelled to punish evil-doers and can perform feats not possible for most people. His mastery of the ancient martial art Hokuto Shinken allows him to kill or cripple with a mere touch. The results tend to be very messy -it usually causes parts of the victim to explode- but the art also includes several other means of killin

name: Du-Jun Kang
description: The son of a rich family and the CEO of a company. He is always cool and calm and has a plan, but when it comes to Hui-Won's business, he goes out of his way without hesitation.

name: Hui-Won Jang
description: The female protagonist of the story. Irritated by the bragging of a long-time crush and friend, she ends up getting pregnant after a one-night stand at an upscale bar.

name: Leon Dragonia Lionheart
description:
Owner of the sacred lion's heart and guardian of the Holy Grail.

He acts as the king of the world he lives in. On the surface, he has created a new guild called Pantheon.

name: Tomoka Kase
description: A popular and handsome girl in the class next door to [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/125397)'s. She's the ace of the track and field club.

name: Yui Yamada
description: A quiet girl who is in charge of greenification. She's poor at sports and singing.

name: Chibiusa
description:
Chibiusa's real name is actually Usagi, but she is nicknamed Chibiusa to distinguish her from [Usagi](https://anilist.co/character/2030/Tsukino-Usagi). She is usually very upbeat, extroverted and outgoing. Though she started out socially awkward, she quickly became popular with her classmates in the 20th-century.

Chibiusa's dream is to one day become a real lady, to have her own prince, and to be friends with everyone she knows. Meanwhile, she is a fairly ordinary little girl; she likes pink and red, pudding, pancakes, and rabbits. Her favorite school subject is drawing, while her least favor

name: Haruka Tenou
description:
Haruka is a stubborn, protective individual, but is also strong-willed, capable, charming, and occasionally even doting. She is formally introduced in the third story arc, although she appears in silhouette alongside [Sailor Neptune](https://anilist.co/character/2829/Kaiou-Michiru) in the final episode of [Sailor Moon R](https://anilist.co/anime/740/-R/). When transformed, she is known as Sailor Uranus, and is part of the group known in Fanon as the Outer Senshi.

Haruka is a racecar driver, even though she is barely sixteen years old when she appears. However, the timing of her birthday to th

name: Hotaru Tomoe
description: With people who do not know or understand her well, Hotaru is extremely shy and socially awkward, due to her powers and intelligence, but only at first. With her close friends and family, she is a sweet, gentle, young woman with great warmth and spirit. She tends to be independent, having been alone and taking care of herself for quite some time. Hotaru grew up very much alone, sick, and an outcast, shunned by her classmates who were frightened of her. It was not until she met [Chibi-Usa](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) that she, at last, had a true friend.

name: Michiru Kaiou
description: Introduced in the third story arc, Michiru fights alongside her partner and lover Haruka in defending the Solar System from outside threats. In both versions of the story, she is elegant, sophisticated, capable of sharp anger, and sometimes cold. She is fully dedicated to her duty as a Senshi. Her Senshi alter-ego is Sailor Neptune, one of the "four soldiers of the outer solar system". As Sailor Neptune, her element of influence is the sea(not with water in general as Sailor Mercury's powers are); as with many of the other Senshi, this element is closely associated with her planet, which is na

name: Setsuna Meiou
description:
Sailor Pluto is the soldier who guards the gates of time and acts as [Chibiusa's](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) guardian. 

After the events of the second story arc, she leaves the gates of time to temporarily live as a human being, joins the rest of the Outer Senshi, and becomes a university student studying physics. Even in her civilian form, Setsuna is the oldest of the Sailor Team, around her late teens or older. Her personality has been described as distant and somewhat lonely, however, she does consistently display warmth and affection toward Chibiusa. When she reincarnates

name: Youko Shiragami
description: Youko is a classmate of [Asahi](https://anilist.co/character/89084/Kuromine-Asahi) and the daughter of a human and a vampire. Though she has long canine teeth, many other typical vampyric characteristics are downplayed, such as only getting tanned in sunlight or feeling guilty when entering a room uninvited. She has a Kansai accent, but speaks in honorifics so as not to expose her teeth. While initially coming across as haughty, her true personality is bubbly and absent minded. Her dream is to become a cool beauty, but has yet to accomplish this goal. Though initially friendly with Asahi, she

appearsIn.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…
They Are Still Being Shaken This Morning

name: Akane Koumoto
description:
Koumoto Akane is the principal of the school [Kuromine](https://anilist.co/character/89084/Kuromine-Asahi) attends. Though young in appearance she is actually thousands of years old. Despite her age and power she actually behaves very immaturely and is obsessed with snacks.

She is a devil; however, the only indication of this are the two large horns that grow out of her head which she has passed off as a fashion accessory that can be removed at any time, but in reality she uses an illusion to make it look like she can remove the horns.

appearsIn.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…

name: Nagisa Aizawa
description: Nagisa is a classmate of [Asahi](https://anilist.co/character/89084/Kuromine-Asahi) and [Yōko](https://anilist.co/character/89018/Shiragami-Youko), and is also a small alien in a robotic exoskeleton. Initially the love interest of Asahi before the series began, she turned him down believing that her secret would be discovered if she started a relationship with him.

appearsIn.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…

name: Asahi Kuromine
description:
He is a second-year high school student who has trouble keeping secrets, earning him the nickname of "ana no aita zaru" (A bag full of holes), or "anazaru" for short.

One day, he discovers that his crush, [Youko Shiragami](https://anilist.co/character/89018/Shiragami-Youko), is secretly a vampire and, as a result, must try to keep her secret to avoid her having to leave school.

appearsIn.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…
They Are Still Being Shaken This Morning

name: Mikan Akemi
description: She is a childhood friend of [Asahi Kuromine](https://anilist.co/character/89084/Kuromine-Asahi) and constantly bullies him.

appearsIn.title: My Monster Secret: Actually, I Am…

name: Vermilio
description:
__Height:__ 152cm (5')
__Power level:__ 78

One of the Four Heavenly Kings of the Empire. Has a hair-trigger temper, but is big-hearted underneath. The serious one of the group, she usually gets caught up in Helck and Piwi's shenanigans.

She can use fire and summoning magic and excells at fighting several enemies simultaneously.

name: Helck
description:
__Height:__ 200cm (6'7")
__Power level:__ 99

The titular human hero Helck. He is the older brother of the hero Cless. Immensely strong, reliable, and capable, Helck seeks to become the champion of demons and destroy the humans.

name: Piwi
description:
Piwi is a round pure green fluffy bird like creature.

Piwi is raucous and very ignorant. Yet, he has been described with a "cute" personality. He is very carefree, sometimes even oblivious to the violence that occurs around him.

name: Cheong-Ryeong
description: A blue-rank spirit bound to Mok Gyeong-Un as his familiar spirit. Unwilling to give him her name, Mok Gyeong-Un gave her the name Cheong-Ryeong, meaning blue spirit.

name: Un-Seong Hyeok
description: Un-Seong Hyeok is the sole disciple of Nok Yu On - the world's strongest spearman and the master of the Spear Master Sect. Under his mentorship, he reaches Transcendence Level and attains great mastership of the spear.

name: Mariko Higuchi
description: A Proxy scout for the firm. She knows much more about Kano than he does, and they are linked through an event that happened years before the beginning of the manga. She is also in charge of securing contracts and gathers the paperwork needed to satisfy the association.

name: Hiroshi Kano
description: Hiroshi Kano is special.  Unfortunately its a schizophrenic kind of special. Kano-san talks to a woman no one else can see, and complains about a phone that no one else can hear.  Despite these idiosyncrasies, he has been able to survive in a future war torn Japan, with the help of his "sixth sense".  This ability allows Kano-san to usually avoid danger.  Recently the Japanese government has passed the Vengeance Act.  A law which allows vengeful victims to try and kill the felons that wronged them.  If the victim does not want to do this personally, a proxy can be hired to do the job

name: Masaki Mizoguchi
description: He is a proxy working at the same firm as Kano, although he has been there much longer than his coworkers. He is constantly trying to hunt his coworkers, most notably Kano, who weirds him out due to his bizarre abilities. To him it's important that he hunts the zebras that represent everybody who isn't him. He is either married or has a girlfriend that he abuses regularly who has lost touch with reality.

name: Ichiro Yamada
description: One of the proxies hired by the proxy firm along with Kano. It took him three tries to pass the exam required to become an enforcer, done by memorizing the entire book, whereas everybody else got a list with answers on it from various scouts. Initially optimistic, he grows jaded when he realizes the truth behind the enforcements.

name: Itto Ogami
description: Ogami Itto seemed to have a very cushy life during Edo-Era Japan, for he had been the Shogun's official executioner (Kogi Kaishakunin). A position so powerful, the term "Second" meant that Itto was only second to the Shogun as far as metering out death to unloyal feudal lords throughout the 60 regions of Shogunate controlled Japan. In fact, the Shogun's symbol of the Hollyhock crest was a noticable part of Ogami's court attire, thus deeming his stature as indeed being the Shogun's final say over his people. The Kogi Kaishakunin was highest of the three positions given to certain clans of samur

name: Daigoro Ogami
description: The son of Ittō and Azami, Daigorō becomes a stronger warrior as the story progresses.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Teru Kurebayashi
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Teru is left all alone when her brother died with only the cell phone her brother gave her to keep her company. It is with this cell phone that she discovers the friend her brother left her in the one that calls himself DAISY. Teru's feelings for DAISY become that of a brothers as he is always there in the shadows, protecting and encouraging her through messages and sometimes physical acts (i.e. throwing tennis balls at bullies from afar, hacking the school computer system at her request), however their relationship has never gone beyond the bounds of Instant Messaging. At

name: Tasuku Kurosaki
description:
__Height:__ 181cm
__Favorite food:__ Potato salad with ham and corn. (No apple or mandarin! nothing too sweet or sour; hates tomatoes)

Kurosaki works as the school janitor. He is also a computer hacker.
He is a drinker, smokes a lot, is violent, dangerous, scary and calls Teru his servant. He is quite good-looking as well. He does not display his emotions normally but when he gets angry, he can be very terrifying. He swears at times, and likes to eat. He is an excellent cook, but usually commands Teru to cook. However, he can be protective of Teru when she is in danger. And yes, he is in love

name: Seol-Jin Heo

description: Maria is Rosa's daughter, and is the youngest of the cousins. She has a habit of uttering 'uu-uu' at times, which frustrates Rosa greatly. Maria is also rather stubborn, and believes things easily, which isn't uncommon for someone her age. She has an interest in the occult, like her grandfather. She carries around a bag which is filled with occult items, such as a scorpion charm which wards off evil. She idolizes witches, and believes that they are there to bring people joy and happiness. In Maria's notebooks there are sketches of witches, and the witches are beautiful

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 1: Legend of the Golden Witch
Umineko When They Cry Episode 2: Turn of the Golden Witch

name: Mako Wakamiya
description: Mako Wakamiya is the main female protagonist in the story, and she's known for being considered as very mature and is looked up to by her fellow classmates. She's an eager member of the Public Morals Committee, and her personality is quite timid despite her energetic behavior that is shown through the story.

name: Shinichi Honda
description: Shinichi Honda is the main male protagonist in the story, and he's known for being overly energetic and straightforward with other people, having truthfully rejected several love confessions from potential love interests. He's also a member in the school's Kendo team.

name: Dong-Tae
description:
__Rank:__ A-Rank

Dongtae is the main protagonist of DICE. He starts off as a timid kid with bottom of the barrel rankings on every aspect of his life. Whether it be looks, intelligence, height, it was like Dongtae rolled "ones" for all of his attributes. Constantly bullied and incapable of approaching his crush Eunju, Dongtae is rescued from a spiral of despair by becoming a Dicer. His main goal is to get the final dice and make a world fair for all.

name: Eun-Ju
description: Eunju is a female protagonist of the series and Dongtae's love interest. In terms of dice points, she would be a full "six". Initially depicted by Dongtae and everyone that she is the prettiest girl in the whole school, it is often overlooked that Eun-Ju never saw herself as someone special. Having seen dicers lose their humanity, compassion and sensibility for the sake of getting their desires fulfilled and, ultimately, for X's entertainment, she possesses only one single powerful desire to eliminate dice from the world.

name: X
description:
X is the main antagonist of the series. He is a supernatural entity who controls the production and distribution of Dice and sets the quests Dicers must complete in order to gather them. He also sets and changes the rules of the game as a whole.

(Source: Dice Wiki)

name: Tae-Bin
description: Tae-Bin is the love interest of Eun-Ju. A transfer student to Dong-Tae's school and classroom, and sitting next to him, Tae-Bin is a Dicer and was initially Dong-Tae's polar opposite. He quickly became one of the most popular students in the school.

name: Mio
description:
Mio is one of Dongtae's classmates that became a Dicer in the chaos that occurs at their school.

Mio later becomes Dongtae's girlfriend.

name: Mu-Yeong
description: Mu-Yeong is a Dicer and was Taebin's former mentor, and the person who gave him his first Dice. He seems to currently be the most powerful A-Ranker

name: Choe-Hyeon
description: Choe-Hyeon is a student in the protagonists' school, though one grade lower than him. He keeps his A-Ranker skill hidden until the final battle royal, though he has shown a co-operative stance towards Dong-Tae.

name: Ji-Eun
description: Ji-Eun had something embarrassing that happened to her, because of this she seeks the ultimate dice to change her past. She also hides her face with a mask due to the events of her past.

name: Kuranosuke Koibuchi
description: Kuranosuke is the son of a rich political family. He uses the alias "Kurako" in front of the other Amars to hide his gender. He enjoys cross-dressing, to the chagrin of his family.   Unlike the rest of his family, he does not find politics interesting at all and desires to get into fashion. He is constantly looking for the address of his mother, who gave birth to him after having an affair with his father, hoping to see at least once more the wardrobe she kept with so much passion.   After meeting Tsukimi, helping her rescue Clara, he constantly starts paying her visits, finding her more inter

name: Tsukimi Kurashita
description: Tsukimi is an otaku girl who lives in Tokyo and wants to be an illustrator. Influenced by her late mother, she has a love for all kinds of jellyfish and is quite knowledgeable about them. She is the only resident of Amamizukan who knows Kuranosuke's true gender. Like the other Amars, she has a fear of stylish people and will usually petrify in their presence. Tsukimi has a pet spotted jellyfish named Clara.   Whenever she gets a make-over from Kuranosuke she becomes beautiful and Shū falls for her. She reciprocates Shū's feelings but she is led to think that he is in love with another person.

name: Kotoka Hatsushima
description: **Fetish:** Backs

description: **Fetish:** Hair, Washing Hair

description: Second-year high school girl with a smells fetish.

description: Fetish: Short Height
