description: Fetish: Hair

name: Ihwa
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm 
__Affiliation:__ Nameless

Ihwa is the main protagonist and tritagonist of the aptly named webcomic series, Hero Killer. 
After her sister Yeon was killed by corrupt heroes, Ihwa sets out to avenge her by killing as many heroes as possible. She would join the villain organization known as the Nameless and works with [Engen](https://anilist.co/character/252729/Engen), the Smiling Man and legendary villain as they work together to destroy the Hero Clan.

Ihwa's gift is the ability to steal, borrow, and absorb the Gift of another Gift user. She has two categories of her powers

name: Engen
description:
__Height:__ 189 cm 
__Affiliation:__ Nameless

Engen, also known as the Smiling Man, is the deuteragonist of Hero Killer.

He is the leader of the villain organization known as the Nameless who was once a central figure of the major conflicts from the previous era that fought in both the War of Inheritance as an heir to the throne of Nera and as its second king during the Great War, afterward he went into hiding and somewhere along the way saved [Rachel Sinclair](https://anilist.co/character/308061/Rachel-Sinclair) and organized the survivors of the war. While not all of his motives are clear,

name: Kanade Toramaru
description: The top delinquent in the school, who's also in love with protagonist, Unoki.

appearsIn.title: I Belong to the Baddest Girl at School
I Belong to the Baddest Girl at School

name: Red
description:
Red is very much the quintessential hero; brave, kind, and outgoing. He is capable of feats of agility, and is always willing to help others, with or without the help of his Pokémon.

Red is an exceptional Pokémon battler, able to utilize his Pokémon's moves and natural talents in unique ways.

Red is sometimes slow to pick up on sensitive matters. He is the last of the original seven Pokédex holders to learn of Yellow's true gender identity.

Red's special skill, as described by [Dr. Yukinari Okido](https://anilist.co/character/17783/Ookido-Yukinari), is Pokémon battling, earning the title of

name: Green Okido
description:
Green has a serious, calm, and focused personality in everything he does. Although Red and Green were once bothered by each other because their personalities are so opposite, they ended up resolving their differences.

Green and his Strike were trained by Shijima of Tanba City when he was a child. Thus, Green has some cursory knowledge of martial arts, and his Strike knew Generation II techniques.

Green's special skill, as described by Dr. Yukinari Okido, is Pokémon training—that is, leveling them up and making them strong, and as such is referred to as the "Trainer".

name: Blue
description:
__Current Team:__ Blastoise, Wigglytuff, Clefable, Ditto, Granbull, Nidoqueen

Blue is a sneaky, cunning, intelligent, but also very kind trainer. She often uses her looks to her advantage, but is also a very skilled battler. At the start of her journey, she stole a Squirtle from Professor Oak, and encounters Red and Green many times as she travels Kanto in the RGB chapter.   

At the age of five, Blue was kidnapped by Ho-Oh, who was under the command of the Mask of Ice. She was brought to his lair along with other children whom he was going to train to be his faithful servants. Here she met a

name: Yellow
description: Yellow was first introduced into the series in chapter 42 where she begins her role as the main character until chapter 90 when Gold takes the spotlight.  Yellow was born in Viridian Forest and her birthday is on the March 3. When first introduced in the series, she was 14 years old.  Yellow has a carefree personality and doesn't like to battle since she doesn't like to hurt other Pokemon. She chooses not to evolve her Pokemon, which are Rattata, Caterpie, Doduo, Omanyte, and Graveler. She also partners up with Pikachu for most of the time she is the main character.  Yellow, being born in the

name: Gold
description:
Gold grew up in a home full of baby Pokémon. His neighbors in Wakaba Town refer to his family as the "Poké House". He usually wears a pair of goggles and travels on a scooter. Instead of throwing/kicking his Poké Balls, he uses a billiard cue to shoot them out, allowing for tactical maneuvers and deployments of his Pokémon. Gold's hobbies include gambling, skateboarding, and trying foods from different cities. His favorite idol/DJ is [Kurumi](https://anilist.co/character/34132/Kurumi) from the Kogane Radio Station.

[Dr. Yukinari Okido](https://anilist.co/character/17783/Ookido-Yukinari) noted

name: Silver
description:
As a child, Silver was kidnapped by the Masked Man along with several other children. There, he met and befriended a young girl named Blue. After spending several years being trained by the Masked Man, Blue led an operation for her and Silver to escape the Masked Man when his guard was down. After successfully managing to run away, the two began to work together to put an end to the Masked Man's ambitions.

Silver's special skill, as described by Dr. Yukinari Okido, is Pokémon trading (taught to him when he was with the Masked Man), and he is known as the "Exchanger".

name: Crystal
description:
Crystal is an expert in capturing Pokémon, a skill she developed when she was young. After an accident during her childhood that left her arms broken, Crystal learned to kick Poké Balls with her feet. Although by now her arms have been completely healed, Crystal has retained the habit of kicking her Poké Balls instead of throwing them.

Crystal is very dedicated to her task of completing the Pokédex and has faith in her Pokémon and their ability to help her. Though she can be insecure about herself when she fails, with encouragement she is able to pick herself back up and restore her confidenc

name: Ruby
description:
Ruby has a great passion for Pokémon Contests. While he's an excellent battler, he only fights when necessary or when no one takes notice. He believes that Pokémon battles are barbaric, and get his Pokémon dirty — something that he does not like.

Ruby is skilled at sewing and knitting. He makes clothes for all his Pokémon to wear, and even made [Sapphire](https://anilist.co/character/12530/Odamaki-Sapphire) the clothes she wears for much of her adventures. He is nearsighted, and he has a pair of glasses to correct this, though he was originally too vain when it came to wearing them often. His

name: Sapphire Odamaki
native: オダマキ・サファイア
description: Sapphire is a Pokémon Trainer and the daughter of Dr. Odamaki. She often assists her father with his fieldwork and years of doing so have given her various skills such as heightened physical strength and senses. Due to constantly being surrounded by nature, she has come to dislike the idea of beautifying Pokémon instead of leaving them in their natural state.

name: Emerald
description:
Emerald is a Pokémon Trainer born somewhere in the Hoenn region. Due to the loss of his parents at a young age, he was moved between his family members and was constantly bullied by his cousins due to his short height and tendency to rely on the help of Pokémon to get objects from high places. These events led to Emerald developing a complex about his height and a dislike of Pokémon. To get over his height issues, he used hair gel to style his hair upwards and wore various gadgets and clothing to make himself look taller than he actually is.

The constant moving from family member to family me

name: Un-Hwi So
description: He is the third son of Ikyang Soga.

name: Hwa-Jin Na
description: He works in the Ministry of Education.

name: Han-Rim Im
description:
Han-Rim works in the Ministry of Education. She is of relatively short stature, with dyed red hair, and is extremely skilled at martial arts. 

She is an Ex-Special Forces soldier from the Military

name: Youzou Ooba
description: Plagued by a maddening anxiety, the terrible disconnect between his own concept of happiness and the joy of the rest of the world, Yozo Oba plays the clown in his dissolute life, holding up a mask for those around him as he spirals ever downward, locked arm-in-arm with death.

name: Jirou Azuma
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

A peculiar high school student that has basic training as a ninja and the unfound ability to speak to animals. Jirou Azuma, the grandson of [Toshimasa Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/146845/Azuma-Toshimasa), is a cocky kid with a heart for animals. Should Jirou find an animal being bothered or in need of help, he will rush over and fight the people causing trouble. Eventually, he meets a wounded [Ragou](https://anilist.co/character/137545/Ragou) and brings him in to help him recover. The two butt heads a bit though Jirou does care for him. Upon a near death experience,

name: Ragou
description:
__Height:__ 32 cm

The Black Sun, a legendary mononoke that has lived for over a millennia, renowned for raw power beyond any other: Ragou. Taking the form of an adorable pure black cat, Ragou may seem to not be much, though he very much is. Contained within that ball of fluff is power that exceeds any other mononoke could ever dream of having. Mononoke chase after Ragou to have his power or to join forces with him, though he wants no part of it. After being randomly set free from a sealing stone, Ragou ran away and ended up being found by [Jirou Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/137304/Azum

name: Reiji Kirihara
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

The youngest son of the once well renowned Kirihara Family: Reiji Kirihara. Once training to be a swordsman with his twin brother, Shinji, under their father's teachings. Now, among a family in ruin, Reiji stands out on top, working as an Onmitsu for the Bureau.

Compared to other members of the Black Torch elite squad, Reiji presents himself to be much more calm and collected, rarely letting other emotions get the best of him. Similar to Ichika Kishimojin, Reiji has a distaste for Ragou and Jirou Azuma at first, though they get closer over time. Though Reiji seems to be so

name: Ichika Kishimojin
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

A promising shinobi from a peculiar bloodline known as the Kishimojin Family: Ichika Kishimojin. Having a heart of justice and a burning aggression towards mononoke, Ichika is a perfect member for the Bureau.    Though she can act as a spy for the Bureau, she is more than capable of combating against a mononoke. 

Initially, Ichika may come off as cold and harsh to others, especially mononoke, though she will warm up to others overtime. When she first meets [Jirou Azuma](https://anilist.co/character/137304/Azuma-Jirou), she doesn't like him for his fused mononoke state with

name: Rita
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Rita is a former assassin who currently works at the Kindergarten Noir under [Erina](https://anilist.co/character/293693/Winkler-Erina)'s orders. She is the teacher of the dandelion class along with [Doug](https://anilist.co/character/289106/Doug) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/293694/Hana-Bradley).

Rita is known for her friendly and approachable nature, especially when it comes to interacting with the children at the Kindergarten Noir. She is physically strong, which allows her to easily participate in any play activities the kids want to engage in, making her ad

name: Doug
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Doug is a former swindler and a known womanizer. He spent his life scamming people until he was hired by [Erina](https://anilist.co/character/293693/Winkler-Erina) to work at Kindergarten Noir. He is the teacher of the dandelion class along with [Rita](https://anilist.co/character/289105/Rita) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/293694/Bradley-Hana).

Doug grew up alone and abandoned, having to fend for himself and live through tough times. As a result, he developed a strong defense mechanism that made him self-reliant and determined to do whatever it takes to survive w

name: Koinzell
description: Koinzell is a new name taken by one of the falsely-labeled Lances of Betrayal, Ascheriit. Back in his youth he was an orphan who was accepted as a student in Ms. Gleaa's school of swordsmanship, where he accomplished such feats, especially the learning of the infamous Black Wing sword technique, that made him the new heir of the title of Blade Master, an ancient honour for those deemed true master swordsmen. He then became one of the fourteen youths chosen to carry the Emperor's spears and end the war with Wischtech, and was also one of the four to accomplish their mission, only to b

name: Ato Kusharundo
native: アト・クシャールンド
description: Ato is the third princess of the Kusharundo clan. She looks up to her brother, Kurato, and by dressing up as a boy, she could fight alongside him. After she witness Koinzell kill her brother, she couldn't accept the fact that he died and sought revenge for Kurato. She wore "The Black Dress of Vengeance" to seek revenge and tried to kill Koinzell, but eventually, she realized that Koinzell helped put Kurato out of his suffering and joined him on his quest.   Koinzell saves Ato's life by giving her his blood, giving her some power like his.  Her arsenal of weapons include a long Dual Bladed swor

name: Kayena Hill
description:
Kayena Hill is the first princess of the Eldyme Empire. She is the most beautiful woman in the Eldyme Empire, and is often praised for her beauty. Her beauty is such that it puts famous paintings to shame.

In her first life, Kayena was a foolish, wicked, and arrogant woman who couldn't even realize she was being used and manipulated. She loved to receive praise, and it took only a few compliments to melt her heart and manipulate her. Even after Regef's betrayal, she couldn't grasp her powerless position and dark fate until she herself witnessed the consequences of her evil deeds. She was also

name: Raffaello Kidrey
description:
Raffaello Kidrey is the heir of the Kidrey Dukedom. He is one of the most handsome men and highly sought after bachelor in the Eldyme Empire along with Regef. 

At first glance, Raffaello can come off as a cold, powerful, and stern knight which adds up to his masculine charm, but deep down he's a warm and kind person who cares about others. Since he was a powerful military warrior ever since his youth, he's skilled at swordsmanship, combat, and strategic thinking. Since he survived in the battlefield for many years and came out victorious, he's presumed to be a great tactician with high intell

name: Nanoka Koyanagi
description: Nanoka is an eccentric girl that always says the truth with a very direct way of talking. She is also smarter than other kids her age. She has a different way of looking at various things in the world because of her love for reading books.

appearsIn.title: I Had That Same Dream Again

name: Hiroto Ikuta
description: A freeter. He works part-time at a fishing place. He has no girlfriend, but old ladies seem to really like him.

name: Natsumi Kobayashi
description: An art student at a university in Tokyo. She lives with her cousin [Hiroto](https://anilist.co/character/253838/).

name: Taichi Sagawa
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Specialty:__ Part-time work

Taichi is one of the main protagonists of the I Hear the Sunspot series. He agrees to take notes for [Kouhei Sugihara](https://anilist.co/character/161621/Sugihara-Kouhei) on the condition that Kouhei brings him lunch every day.

His friends describe him as loud, emotional, and constantly hungry. Moreover, he's very comfortable in social situations. He has the affinity for understanding people.

name: Kouhei Sugihara
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Specialty:__ Lip-reading

Kouhei is the main protagonist of the I Hear the Sunspot series. He's a college student who is often seen by himself and misunderstood due to his hearing disability. Due to the strange and hostile treatment from the other students has made Kohei reserved and lonely.

Due to his hearing impairment, he's become distant and reserved. While he's hearing has deteriorated over the years he still can hear and finds people with high-pitch voices, fast talkers and gossipers annoying.

appearsIn.title: Mr. Paper Bag is in Love
Mr. Paper Bag is in Love

description:
__Level:__ 55 (at start of series)
__Class:__ Demon Hunter
__Background:__ Successor of a great family
__Affiliation:__ Mage's Tower

The last surviving Demon Hunter in the world after the Arkshan Base was destroyed.

Lee Ho-Yeol awakens as his Arcana character "Granfel Claudi Arpheus Romeo" who he created at the height of his cringelord phase in the second year of middle school. After assimilating with his character, he struggles to control Grandfel's aristocratic personality and behavior. Because of this, Ho-Yeol's true self is sometimes depicted as a separate entity attached to his physical

name: Shoutarou Fuwa
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

His real name is Shoutarou. He keeps it hidden because he finds it as a very old and traditional name. His natural hair color is brown but he later bleached it blonde. He is a typical stuck-up star and is also very ruthless. Shō had no qualms about tricking Kyoko into going with him to Tokyo so she could be a free servant for him. He also had even fewer qualms about being extremely cruel to her when she discovered this. Shō eventually figured out that Kyoko was in L.M.E., and was surprised to see her transformation. It is also revealed that he has more feelings for her than

name: Kyouko Mogami
description:
__Height__: 163 cm
__Company__: LME
__Affiliations__: Dark Moon, Box "R", Lotus in the Mud

Kyouko's life has always known only one aim-- to please others. Be it her mother who didn't care much for her, or Sho's family, who took her in after she was abandoned.
Suddenly, childhood friend Sho asks country bumpkin Kyouko if she wants to go to the city with him. He aims to be a big star and wishes for her support. When he commits an unthinkable crime to Kyouko's frail self-esteem, he awakens another side in her.  She changes from being an innocent girl to a woman full of the desire of revenge

name: Ren Tsuruga
description:
**Height:** 190 cm

Ren is, in outward appearances, an extremely nice and polite star. However, he shows his true self whenever he deals with Kyoko. Although at times teasing, he harbors an unrequited love for Kyoko. As the story progresses, flashbacks reveal a past with Kyoko when she was smaller, however, Kyoko is still unaware of this. She cannot reconcile the sweet "fairy-prince Corn" with Ren's current personality. Interestingly, at the age of twenty, Ren has lived a large portion of his life in America. In fact, he began his acting career in the US albeit disastrously. Although he gained

name: Su-Hyeon Kim
description: Su-Hyeon Kim is currently a high school student in West Gangbuk-Seo High and the Top Dog of West Gangbuk. Every day he faced relentless bullying from his classmates, leading him to wish his life was more like RPG quest game he plays. Suhyeon's wish is granted when a quest prompt pops up in real life with an easy quest and an enticing reward.

name: Ji-Hu Seol
description: At the start of the story, Seol is a gambling addict, deep in debt and scorned by his family and ex-girlfriend. However, due to an opportunity granted to him by his past life, he obtained a second chance to set things right.

name: Aya Asagiri
description: At school she gets tacks put in her shoes, glue put on her desk, her head shoved in a toilet, and even worse than that. At home, her older brother who is stressed from trying to live up to their father's expectations ties her up, strips her, and beats her to relieve his stress. All Aya thinks about every day amidst the hell that is her life is dying. But one day a strange website called "Mahou Shoujo Site" pops up on her computer. The next day, the bullies at her school push her past the limit once again, but this time things go a little differently.

name: Tsuyuno Yatsumura
description:
__Height:__ 5'0"

She is a magical girl with the power to stop time. She tells Aya information about the magical girls and allies with her so they can be safer together. Unlike Aya, she does not have a problem using her power to injure or kill people who she dislikes.

She was born in a city called Kanagawa, her hobbies are sleeping, gaming, and swimming, her advantages are that she's friendly, fit and takes the initiative. Tsuyuno doesn't like meat or waking up in the morning, but does like vegetables, games on her phone, honey, yogurts, cute things and advertising mascots.

name: Kayo Komura
description: is a protagonist of Mahou Shoujo Site. She is the daughter of Detective Keiji Komura and Sachiko Komura and the older sister of Airi Komura. Thanks to her compact-shaped staff obtained by an Administrator, she can copy the staffs of the Magical Girls when she touches their hands or touches any part of their bodies and use their abilities, although she has a limitation, that is that she can only use alone once the ability of each copied staff, Best friend of Sakura

name: Fukumoto Tsukune
description: Childhood friend of Kogami Kii   __10 years ago arc__  When Kogami enters her room, he finds disgusting looking drawings of these mahou shoujos in this box she kept, which therefore proves that she has something to do with this whole thing.

name: Brad Burns
description: Around 14 years ago, Brad and his little brother Luke were left by their father. They eventually found themselves in New York City, in the biggest slum in the world, The Five Points. There they met Gene McDowell, the founder of the Grave Diggers, a gang, who helped them. Now Brad is working for the Grave Diggers as their hitman known as "Grim Reaper" using a gunknife, while Luke don't know about his job and is searching information for his father Edward King.

name: Lionia Voreoti
description: The adopted daughter of Duke Voreoti.

appearsIn.title: The Male Lead's Little Lion Daughter
The Male Lead's Little Lion Daughter

description: A maid at the Voynich Hotel.

name: Beluna

A maid working at the hotel and Elena's servant. She is also agent number 7 of the Sleuth Brigade and her code name is "maid".

Lives together with Elena in room no. 101.

name: Taizou Kuzuki
description: A resident of the hotel occupying room no. 805, and ex-gangster who is on the run from mobsters in Japan.

name: Tougo Sakuradaimon
description: Tougo Sakuradaimon is a member of the public morals committee.

description: A 28 year old historical-fiction writer who hires [Fumi Oono](https://anilist.co/character/148501/Ohno-Fumi) to be his housekeeper.

name: Fumi Ohno
description: A 2nd-year high school student who is in a mountain of debt thanks to her father and will go to any lengths to pay it off. She is often worried because her employer is difficult to understand.

name: Ryou Narushima
description: The protagonist of Shamo. As a child he was considered a genius, until one day he snapped and stabbed his parents to death. After being sent to juvenile prison, he learns karate to defend himself.    Ryo Narushima is consistently depicted as being unrepentant for the murder of his parents and is shown repeatedly committing morally repugnant crimes such as assault and rape. Though capable of redemption (as evidenced by his care-taking of his sister and various small charitable acts shown throughout the manga) ultimately Narushima is depicted as a Byronic hero spiraling into darkness, his chance

name: Ju-Gyeong Lim
description:
__Height:__ 169cm (5'6) 
Ju-Gyeong is the main protagonist of the story True Beauty. Through YouTube, she masters the art of makeup, changing her look completely. 
At school, she mains her "pretty girl" image by faking her personality, such as lying about her music preferences and eating small portions during lunch. At home, she sheds her image and revertts to her "geeky" self, spending her time reading comics, listening to rock music, and eating fatty foods like fried chicken. Later in the series, she persues her dream of working in the beauty industry, and becomes a popular influencer online

name: Su-Ho Lee
description:
__Height:__ 6'1 
Suho is very studious in academics, unlike Ju-Gyeong and Seojun, and spends most of his free time studying. He is a talented cook and generally stays away from social media. He was best friends with Seojun in middle school.
Later in the series, he leaves to care for his father in japan for around 3 years - leaving the relationship he had built with Ju-Gyeong behind. They later meet again and proceed to officially start dating - getting engaged later in the series.

name: Seo-Jun Han
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'1)

Seojun Han is at first a bad-tempered reserved former K-pop trainee. He has a sister, who befriends Ju-Gyeong, which leads him to become best friends with Suho and Ju-Gyeong. He has great piano skills and is known as a great singer, prompting many idol companies to scout him.

He is shown to have an interest in Jugyeong, later becoming her boyfriend in the series. After Suho returns, they eventually break up due to Seo-Jun's busy idol schedule. He is shown to never properly get over their breakup.

name: Sora Ko
description: She was saved by HCLW once and when she sees him being beaten down she helps him out. She holds him in high regards even though he's a complete jerk.

name: Dark
description: Heart hitter's boss, Dark. His Grandfather owns a World scale corporation "Giga" and he is looking for him. He decided to hire HCLW to Power Level him.

name: Yeollepjeonsa
description: Former top ranked player of Lucid Adventure.

name: Won-Ho Gong
description: The player who controls Hardcore Leveling Warrior.

name: Sunao Akiyoshi
description: Sunao Akiyoshi is a University student who happens to one day run into his ex-girlfriend from middle school who dumped him. To his surprise, he wakes up the following morning to discover he and his ex-girlfriend Lemon have swapped bodies.

name: Lemon Nishikawa
description: Lemon is Sunao Akiyoshi's childhood friend and ex-girlfriend. After bumping into [Sunao](https://anilist.co/character/317238) years later, she wakes up in his body the day after.

name: Mizuki Suzushiro
description: The main character of the series. Mizuki is a really girly-looking guy who is greatly annoyed by how everyone keeps mistaking him for a girl all the time. One day, the trickster goddess decides to mess with him because she's bored and Mizuki wakes up with breasts and a missing part of his anatomy.

name: Loki Asgard
description: The Norse goddess of trickery. Loki has decided to turn her eye to the mortal world for a new form of entertainment. She decides to have some fun by turning the girly-looking guy Mizuki into an actual girl. She is 700 Years Old.

name: Takeru Ichimonji
description: Mizuki's best friend who has known him since they were kids. Takeru is the only one who treats Mizuki as a guy, but after his friend turns into a girl, things begin to get confusing for him as he finds himself more and more attracted to Mizuki.

name: Yumeko Fujiwara
description: A ditzy but kind girl who Mizuki has a crush on, but she has a crush on Mizuki's childhood friend, Takeru.

name: Tetsu  Misato
description: He is a third-year in high school, who begins working part-time under his father's housekeeping agency to save up money due to personal circumstances. He is assigned to work at the Karasawa Estate, where he soon becomes friends with and the personal housekeeper for the daughter of Tetsu's employers, [Shizu](https://anilist.co/character/156990).

name: Shizu Karasawa
description: She is the only child of [Tetsu](https://anilist.co/character/136088)'s wealthy employers who lives on an estate on the hill and is secreted away, where she is forbidden from leaving her house. This is because she is claimed to have dissociative identity disorder.

appearsIn.title: Legend of an Asura - The Poison Dragon

name: Remina
description: A mysterious living planet from another dimension that devours worlds and stars.

name: Akira Momose
description: A beautiful girl who has returned to the countryside with careful plans to be united with her crush Hajime. She excels academically, but is not good at sports. Super clumsy and spineless.

name: Hajime Kugayama
description: A boy living in the countryside. He respects Akira as a 'concept'. Fairly athletic. Super dull & headstrong.

name: Sachiyuki Tokinaga
description: Tokinaga is a young male veterinarian who belongs to the Anti-God Science Institute, Anti-God Weapon Development Department, Biotechnology Section.

name: Waka Kamikura
description: Kamikura Waka is a high school girl who has the eyes of a "God". Waka is originally from Saga prefecture, and came to Tokyo in the hopes of meeting a god. When she was in her third year of middle school, she suddenly received the eyes of a god for reasons unknown to her.

name: Yi Bei
description: The titular Demon Queen. At the start of the story she was betrayed by one of her servants, lost her powers and was quickly defeated. She is forced to pose as a human and Xiang Ye's wife, "Yi Bei".

appearsIn.title: My Wife is the Demon Queen

name: Xiang Ye
description: The protagonist. He is a normal teenager living alone when he is accidentally summoned into another dimension to aid the deposed Demon Queen Isabella Osa. He pretends to be Isabella's husband for her protection. Although he is initially viewed as worthless and feeble by everyone, Xiang Ye quickly proves himself in unique ways.

appearsIn.title: My Wife is the Demon Queen

name: Kanan Zebul
description:
Kanan Takakiyo, at first glance, is an ordinary teenage girl who is president of her high school's public morals committee. However, this is all a facade - her true identity is Kanan Zebel, a thousand-year-old demon who is the daughter of [Beelzebub](https://anilist.co/character/321160/), the Great Demon of Gluttony. Eager to consume human souls, she descended to the human world and used hypnotism to convince an ordinary family that she was their firstborn - all so that she could find a student to consume. 

Her search brought her to [Youji Kyougi](https://anilist.co/character/282075/), her ko

name: Youji Kyougi
description: A high school boy one year Kanan's junior. Kanan has chosen him as a target to devour his soul, but he mistakenly believes that she's confessing to him and becomes her boyfriend. Aggressively in love with Kanan.

name: Saki Hananoi
description: Saki Hananoi is a popular highschool student and Hinase Hotaru's boyfriend.

name: Krystal Nokanatika
native: クリストル・ノバティ・ノカナティカ

name: Nephrites Lomka
native: ネフリティス・ロムカ
description: The shut-in elf princess bearer of the Rings of Wind.

name: Saphir Maasa
description:
Saphir is one of the twin princesses of the water country of Maasa. She takes on the roll of becoming Ring Princess and gives Satou the Ring of Water to help save her country from Empire influence and so her sister Saphira can be with Marse. She becomes his 4th wife.

She has strong magic powers but has a lazy personality.

name: Granart Needakitta
native: グラナート・ニーダキッタ
description: The current princess and the strongest of the cat people bearer of the Rings of Fire.

name: Amber Idonokan
native: アンベル・イダノカン
description: The Princess of the Earth Ring.

name: Morion Nokanatika
native: モーリオン・ノバティ・ノカナティカ
description: Hime's younger sister.

name: Yuva
description: Yuva is a young man sent to the Dragon's Tower to help rescue the Princess.

name: Lilicen
description: Lilicen is a fire mage who was saved by [Yuva](https://anilist.co/character/333217/Yuva) inside the "Dragon Tower" and has now joined him on the quest to save the princess.

name: Eriquo
description: A soldier of the Kingdom's Royal Guard and good friend of [Lilicen](https://anilist.co/character/336647/Lilicen). Originally part of Vice Captain [Rudeum](https://anilist.co/character/368306/Rudeum)'s squadron to save the princess, now the leader of the newly formed Royal Guard Battalion 7th Squad. Considered to be the best archer in the Kingdom.

name: Changge Gu
description: Gu Changge is the main character of the I Am The Fated Villain series.

name: Sheena Totsuki
description: Because of her class number, she is in the same room with [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and is partnered with her. She hates war and anyone getting hurt, and has doubts about her mission as a weapon. Her magical power is low, and she can only use magic to move a book by floating it in the air...

appearsIn.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day

name: Mimi Kagari
description:
__Height:__ 143 cm

A mysterious girl who came to [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena).

She is said to be the school's immortal secret weapon. She possesses unimaginable power despite her young appearance and innocent words and actions, and she has no reservations about killing her enemies. She has the ability to revive herself even after being injured to the point of losing her original human form.

appearsIn.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day

name: Min-Su Kim
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior → Independent
__Epithet:__ Sword Warrior
__Abilities:__ Exceptional swordsmanship and superhuman physical abilities
__Blessing:__ Goddess Seraphine's blessing
__Holy Relics:__ Durandal sword, armor
__Family:__ Kim Sung-chul (father), Lee Hyun-jung (mother)


Pre-Fallen Hero: Kim is a young-boy that is empathic, deterministic, strong-willed, kind, and helpful. The other world's heros noted that Minsu was humble and very soft-spoken. Minsu was determined to see the other world's salvation and was very selfless in this regard.
Post-Fal

name: Jeong-Su Park
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Affiliation:__ Resistance Forces
__Epithet:__ The Spear Warrior, The Warrior of Revolt, The Warrior of Warriors
__Ability:__ Grants excellent spearmanship and superhuman physical abilities
__Holy Relics:__ The World of Creativity, the Spear, Magic Armor, Didantium, the Transformation Belt, Martial Arts, Chronos, and many other sacred relics
__Family:__ Park Da-bin (younger sister)
__Appearance:__ Episode 2

Jeong-Su Park was once a normal boy who lived a good life, with a good family. However, it takes a big turn when the world is now being taken over by the Sword Hero. Hi

name: Akemitsu Akagami
description: He is the main protagonist of TenPuru.

appearsIn.title: TenPuru -No One Can Live on Loneliness-

name: Yuzuki Aoba
description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She is the 1st daughter of the Mikazuki Temple and oldest of the Aoba sisters. The two other Aoba sisters are Tsukuyo Aoba and Kurage Aoba.

appearsIn.title: TenPuru -No One Can Live on Loneliness-

name: Kurage Aoba
description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She is the 3rd daughter of the Mikazuki Temple and the youngest of the Aoba sisters. The two other Aoba sisters are Yuzuki Aoba and Tsukuyo Aoba.

appearsIn.title: TenPuru -No One Can Live on Loneliness-

name: Mia Christoph
description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She came to Japan with Kagura Baldwin, they have been best friends since childhood.

appearsIn.title: TenPuru -No One Can Live on Loneliness-

name: Kiki
description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She is the stand-in priestess of the Mikazuki Temple.

appearsIn.title: TenPuru -No One Can Live on Loneliness-

name: Tsukuyo Aoba
description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She is the 2nd daughter of the Mikazuki Temple and the middle child of the Aoba sisters. The two other Aoba sisters are Yuzuki Aoba and Kurage Aoba.

appearsIn.title: TenPuru -No One Can Live on Loneliness-

name: Kagura Baldwin
native: カグラ・ボールドウィン
description: She is one of the main female characters of TenPuru. She came to Japan with Mia Christoph, they have been best friends since childhood.

appearsIn.title: TenPuru -No One Can Live on Loneliness-

name: Yugo Hachiken
description: The main character of Silver Spoon, he enrolls in Yezo High, an agricultural school, to get away from his parents. He is hard-working and intelligent, but he struggles in competing in grades with some individuals who have grown up in agricultural backgrounds, which affects his pride. He joins the equestrian (horses) club to become closer to Mikage Aki, who he has a crush on. Seeing those around him striving towards their goals, he acknowledges his own lack of a goal and tries to find one.

name: Aki Mikage
description: A member of the equestrian club, she loves horses and grew up on a farm. She is expected to eventually take over the family farm, however she remains uncertain if that is what she herself wishes to do.

name: Yui Mitsuya
description: A coworker who started working at the same time as Tateishi. She works in the planning department. She has an unyielding spirit and a sharp tongue... at least it seems that way, but in truth she loves Tateishi way too much.

appearsIn.title: I Have a Crush at Work

name: Masugu Tateishi
description: An employee of the accounting departmenf of Tsuda sweets. He's methodical, industrious, and a bit of a pushover. He loves Mitsuya way too much.

appearsIn.title: I Have a Crush at Work

name: Yue Ayase
description:
__Seat Number:__ 4

Yue is Nodoka's best friend, and is often seen around both her and Haruna. She's short and at times has a blunt way of speaking to people, but is generally a friendly person. She likes to read but (ironically) doesn't like to study, and is one of the Baka Rangers (a name for the 5 worst students in Negi's class). When she finds out that Negi is a mage she gets excited about learning magic herself.  At first she shows no romantic interest in Negi, but as time goes by she finds herself developing a crush on him. However she doesn't want to hurt Nodoka, so she tries to keep it

name: Negi Springfield
native: ネギ・スプリングフィールド
description: Negi Springfield is the teacher of Mahora Girls' Jr High School class 3-A (formley 2-A) with formely 31 students,now reduced to 30. Negi Springfield is the son of master mage Nagi Springfield, famously known as the legendary "Thousand Master" and princess Akira of the Ostian Empire in the magic world. At present, Negi has formed 11 temporarily pactio with his students(Asuna, Nodoka, Setuna, Konoka, Yue, Haruna, Chisame, Kazumi, Kaede,Ku Fei,and Chachamaru) and 1 temporarily pactio with Theo, which gives him the artifact that allow him to use any of his partner's artifact.     Negi specialize i

name: Albert Chamomile
native: アルベール・カモミール
description: A perverted lingerie stealing (once again a throw back to the typical manga male stock character archetype), chain-smoking, talking ermine, (though he has a long, and prehensile tail), that Negi freed from a trap when he was five years old. Since then, Chamo has been going to Negi whenever he ran into trouble.  Chamo cares strongly for Negi and will fight to protect him, but he is not above using him to try to make a fast buck. Chief among those methods is attempting to make probationary contracts between Negi and as many of his students as possible, since the act nets him 50,000 Ermine Dollar

name: Sister Shakti
native: シスターシャークティ
description: Sister Shakti is a mage teacher, who heads the Mahora nun patrol squad. She seems particularly skilled in combat and uses floating crosses in battle. Both Misora and Cocone are under her guidance at the church on Mahora's campus.    Source: Wikipedia

name: Chisame Hasegawa
description:
__Seat Number:__ 25

Chisame Hasegawa is the grumpy, unsocial computer hacker of the class, intentionally isolating herself due to her dislike of freaks and weirdos. However, Chisame secretly lives a double life as the famous web idol Chiu, where she can be popular without putting up with the local idiots.

She likes small, powerful devices, such as sub-notepad PCs, but dislikes useless people and unexpected events.

name: Asuna Kagurazaka
description:
__Affiliations:__ Art Club  

As one of the main characters of the series, Asuna has been known to have quite a short temper and frequently her actions are a bit rash, but at the same time, has some aspects that display her maturity, especially when it comes to doing the right thing. Although at first she really detests Negi, over time she becomes like a big sister role model to him, as she does resemble Negi's cousin, Nekane, in a way.

name: Konoka Konoe
description: __Affiliations:__ Fortune-Telling Club, Library Exploration Club

name: Evangeline Athanasia Katherine McDowell
native: エヴァンジェリン・A.K.・マクダウェル
description:
__Seat Number:__ 26
__Clubs:__ Go Club, Tea Ceremony Club
__Height:__ 130 cm (4'3")

Evangeline is a centuries-old true blood vampire, cursed to remain at the school by [Nagi Springfield](https://anilist.co/character/4912/Springfield-Nagi). Initially an antagonist for [Negi](https://anilist.co/character/146/Springfield-Negi) due to his father's actions, she eventually becomes an important teacher and guide for the young mage and his allies. However, Eva remains a cruel, powerful mage in her own right, yet with the sensitivities of her former human life. Evangeline, having the reputation of a c

name: Nodoka Miyazaki
description:
__Seat Number:__ 27

Class 2/3-A's resident bookworm, Nodoka is of the quiet but kind variety, harboring romantic feelings for her homeroom teacher, Negi Springfield. She has since confessed her feelings to him, but not much progress in their relationship has been made; they still remain friends. Nodoka is the second person to establish a probationary contract with Negi and gain a pactio card (it occured during the field trip to Kyoto). Her artifact is a book that can show one's thoughts in picture diary format.

name: Setsuna Sakurazaki
description: Setsuna is a Shinmeiryu swordswoman from Kyoto who was taken in by Eishun Konoe, Konoka's father and the leader of the Kyoto Mage Association. She is childhood friends with Konoka and her protector.  Setsuna spends the beginning of the series being relatively cold to Konoka, wishing to protect her from the shadows due to not forgiving herself for being unable to save Konoka when she almost drowned when they were kids. She does eventually open up to Konoka after the Kyoto arc and begins calling her "Oujo-sama" and "Kono-chan".  Setsuna's pactio, Sica Shishikushiro is a wakizashi which she can s

name: Shinpu
description:
Father-kun was sent by God to protect the innocent, his main mission is to protect [Imuri Atsuki](https://anilist.co/character/284738/Imuri-Atsuki) from different demons sent by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/305829/Satan) himself.

He is a boy who is quite calm in general, he likes peace, baking, and cute things.

appearsIn.title: Make the Exorcist Fall in Love

name: Imuri Atsuki
description:
A young girl who loves painting and drawing, she likes very much the works that represent themes related to religion.

She works for Satan in order to trap the Priest, but it seems that may not happen as planned, love feelings could disturb it.

appearsIn.title: Make the Exorcist Fall in Love

name: Mizuki Aikawa
description:
Mizuki is a quiet girl, who has lived a privileged life. She feels extremely pressured by her mother to be something she doesn't want to be, and seeks refuge in the kindness of her best friend [Mako](https://anilist.co/character/296924/Igarashi-Mako).

Her brother committed suicide due to the pressures received from their parents. As a result they turned their focus onto Mizuki to follow into her father's steps as a diet member.

name: Mako Igarashi
description: Mako is a happy-go-lucky girl who lost her mother when she was 10 due to a car accident, and her father became an disabled through the same accident. As a result, she has to work hard during her part-time job to pay for her father's debts and medical bills.

name: Souta Aoki
description: Aoki is a high school student with a pure heart. He possesses an extremely kind personality and a naive nature. He is secretly in love with Hashimoto at first. However, due to certain misunderstandings he begins to get closer to Ida, his new friend.

name: Kousuke Ida
description: Ida is a high school student who belongs to the volleyball club. He has an orderly and direct personality, often saying what he thinks. He is unfamiliar with love and doesn't understand the "feeling of falling in love with someone". However, for reasons unknown to himself, he begins to arouse feelings for Aoki.

name: Mio Hashimoto
description: Hashimoto is a high school student and Aoki's classmate. She possesses a gentle personality and charming smile, but is also shy and withdrawn. Hashimoto accidentally lent Aoki an eraser that had "Ida-kun ♡" written on it, creating a romantic mix-up between Aoki and Ida.

name: Hayato Aida
description: Aida is Aoki's best friend. He possesses a flirtatious and kind nature, as well as being very self-assured. He doesn't have a very close relationship with Ida, but after exchanging a few words, he discovers that he is a good person. He initially tries to romantically set Ida up with Hashimoto. However, Aida subsequently begins to develop a great friendship with Hashimoto.

name: Hopachai Apachai
native: アパチャイ・ホパチャイ
description:
A 28-year-old master of Muay Thai and is known as the "Death God" of the Muay Thai underworld fighting circuit.

Apachai has been fighting life or death battles in underground Muay Thai fights since he was a teenager. Later, he was an enforcer for a cruel pirate who accidentally fed Apachai while he was starving in a harbor in Thailand. He served this man faithfully until [Hayato Fūrinji](https://anilist.co/character/3079/Fuurinji-Hayato) brought his misdeeds to Apachai's attention. The two of them then defeated the pirates, and Apachai has been at the dojo ever since.

name: Miu Fuurinji
description:
__Martial Arts:__ Furinji Style Martial Arts

The granddaughter of Hayato Furinji and the daughter of Saiga Furinji, the leaders respectively of Ryozanpaku and Yami's One Shadow Nine Fists. Miu came into Hayato's care when his son murdered several of his friends and his wife, sparing Miu by accident. Thereafter Miu learned martial arts from her grandfather.

Although attractive, smart, athletic, and kind, Miu is often clumsy among her fellows.

name: Hayato Fuurinji
description: Miu's grandfather and the undefeated elder of the Ryouzanpaku Dojo, who is said to have beaten 500 Shaolin masters to near death. His kicks have speeds that are still a blur even when viewing a replay of it at 1/1000 of the normal speed. If necessary, he is able to intimidate the other masters in order to maintain peace. Even using just 0.0002% of his power, he can easily overwhelm both Ken'ichi and Miu at the same time and rip a tree in half.

name: Akisame Koetsuji
description:
__Height:__ 180cm 

Koetsuji Akisame is the philosophical Jujitsu master and doctor of Ryozanpaku who was an old friend of Miu's father, Fuurinji Saiga. He was also the the first master willing to train Kenichi (though he is the least considerate to Kenichi's feelings). Despite his seemingly small physique, he is actually known for having his muscles built to perfection. He also has very good insight on people, often knowing if they are troubled or hiding something; he sometimes even knows what a person is thinking, which scares Kenichi. He has no trouble using his friends as guinea pigs to co

name: Shigure Kosaka
aliases: The Prodigy of Swords and Weapons
description:
__Height:__ 159cm
__Martial Arts:__ Kosaka Style (All Weapons)

Shigure is a mysterious person and a slow talker. She is also a master of all types of weapons and believes that weaponry should be seen as an extension of the body: simply relying on the weapons strength alone will not make you a master of it. She was initially viewed as a loner, often avoiding interaction with the other residents of the dojo, besides Apachai. However, later in the series, she begins to open up to Kenichi and the others, and even partakes in certain daily rituals (e.g. dinner) with them. She teaches Kenichi how t

name: Kensei Ma
aliases: The Master of All Chinese Kenpo
description:
__Height:__ 158cm 

Kensei is the lecherous master of all Chinese Kenpo, who prefers to fight using soft forms and currently the second oldest of the six masters of Ryozanpaku.  He is short, balding, and always tries to take revealing pictures of beautiful women (including Shigure and Miu), which often earns him the wrath of the pair, though it does not stop him. Despite his present attitude, he was actually a charming and handsome young man in his youth, and was very popular with women.   Kensei and Kenichi develop a very close relationship, though Kensei mistreats Kenichi comically like ever

name: Shio Sakaki
description:
__First appearance:__ Battle 7
__Height:__ 192cm 
__Type:__ Dou
__Type:__ Katsujin Ken
__Martial Arts:__ Karate (specializes in Mutenkendoku-style)

A 30-year-old master of karate who claims to hold 100 dan. Little is known about Sakaki's past; but he has mentioned that he used to travel the world and fight, and he also at one point belonged to a group that consisted of himself, a French martial arts master named Christopher Eclair, and an Englishman named Mycroft; but left them when their activities brought harm to the innocent, and later buried them alive.

name: Kenichi Shirahama
description: A first year high school student, who likes botany and reading How to... books. He was initially viewed as a weakling by the rest of his school, and was ranked as the weakest student. In order to become strong enough to protect others, he becomes a disciple of the Ryouzanpaku Doujo, and eventually lives there, so he can fully embrace his masters' teachings.

name: Koyuki Honami
description: She's the president of Nanahama High School's Aquarium Club. Her peers see her as out of reach, and by behaving in line with that impression others have of her, she feels a little smothered and lonely.

appearsIn.title: A Tropical Fish Yearns for Snow

name: Konatsu Amano
description: She's a high school first-year student who transfered into Nanahama High School. While she was having trouble blending in with those around her, she met Koyuki, the sole member of the Aquarium Club and later joined the club.

appearsIn.title: A Tropical Fish Yearns for Snow

name: Dora-chan
description: A pixie dragon that Mukouda took as his third familiar. Despite his very small stature, he is very strong when it comes to combat. Dora can use all kinds of elemental magic, such as fire, wind, water, earth and thunder.

appearsIn.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

name: Ranma Saotome
description: Training with [Genma](https://anilist.co/character/9913) at Jusenkyou in China, Ranma was thrown into a spring called Nyanniichuan. He emerged as a young girl, according with the spring's curse. When splashed with hot water, he changes back to a boy, but when splashed with cold to room temperature water, he turns into a girl again. As for our well-built 16-year-old hero/heroine, the martial arts is his life. He also possesses a rather large and easily wounded ego, believing his physical strength to be his only virtue. Whenever his pride is damaged, Ranma feels the need to rectify the situation

name: Akane Tendou
description:
**Occupation**: Material arts student, sports
**Weapon**: Large, wooden mallet.

Akane Tendo is the youngest of [Soun Tendo](https://anilist.co/character/9215/Soun-Tendo)'s three daughters and one of the heirs to the Anything Goes School of Martial Arts.

While Akane is generally shown as compassionate and helpful towards anyone in trouble, she's also a vulnerable, stubborn, relentless, and very short-tempered girl. She frequently becomes angry and jealous, and is apt to hit Ranma, often a reaction to Ranma's own bad traits like his smart mouth and insensitivity, but also due to rampant parano

name: Chikan Otoko
description: The protagonist of Chikan Otoko. Molester man is a pet otaku with no friends. One night on his way back home, he is mistaken as a stalker of Miss Understanding.

name: Kanchigai
description: Mistakes Molester Man as a stalker. However, she later comes to understand the circumstances, and becomes friends with him.

name: Kansai
description: Kansai is friends with Miss Understanding and Yamaoka, and best friends with Loli. She cares deeply for her friends and goes out of her way to help them.   She falls in love with Molester Man, and eventually starts dating him after being confessed to.

name: Loli Kyonyuu
description: Friends with Miss Understanding, Yamaoka, and best friends with Kansai. Works at the same family restaurant as them.  Named as such by Molester Man due to her short stature and large bust size.   Falls in love with Molester Man and confesses to him.

name: Marik Ishtar
native: マリク・イシュタール
description: The holder of the Millennium Rod. Marik's family has guarded the tomb of the pharaoh for generations. He attempts to obtain the three God Cards through his secret organization, GHOULS, and become Pharaoh himself. Marik seeks to send the Pharaoh's soul into the darkness in which he had to spend his childhood.

name: Kouga Amagi
description: Konoha's older brother, and grandson of Mitsugai Amagi. Both academically and sports-inclined, especially soccer. However, although he is popular with girls, he doesn't really know how to act around them, and Jin says he is "so honest, it hurts." Due to his attraction to an anime 'Ginga Choujin Alphasz', Kouga has developed a strong sense of justice since young. Urged by his encounter with Jin during a fire accident (caused by a Player) to become a hero of justice.    He had been depending on a trio of researchers since middle school for gadgets which could assist him in his escapades. He lost

name: Konoha Amagi
description: A girl who has known Jin since they were children and harbors feelings for him. As daughter to Amagi Corp's president (Kouga's sister), she is unaware of the fact that Jin is Zet. They originally met when she and her mother were secretly giving out food to the homeless. Since then, due to many complicated events, they are now relatively close friends.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Jin Kanzaki
description: The main protagonist. A mysterious young man bearing a circular lump on the back of his left hand, Jin was a result of the Z.E.T. Project by the Amagi Corporation to create the perfect being to fight and destroy the escaped Players. Jin is able to transform a creature known as "ZET", a mutant possessing superhuman abilities, but often mistaken for another Player. The transformation is slow, though it may be accelerated due to extreme rage and conditions.The source of his strength appears to be the mysterious lump on his hand.   (Source: ytv ENGLISH)

name: Hanako Tanaka
description: A tomboyish teenage girl. She has had constant headaches since she was born, leading her to go to the nurse's office quite often as a result. Because of this, students thought she was just slacking off, and was bullied by them, leaving her traumatized and unwilling to go to high school. After this, her parents started becoming apathetic to her, forcing her to run away. She met Jin as he was living in the slum she ran away to.   When Jin saved her from the homicidal Crab Player, she was offered to live with him and become a family with him. She then quickly developed romantic feelings for him.

name: Theo Fumis
description: Young halfblood boy who loves books and wants to see the world.

name: Hodaka Saotome
description:
