name: Yutaka Tachibana
description: A tsundere high school girl that becomes less tsun as each day goes by.

appearsIn.title: Ichinichi Goto ni Dere ga Fueteku Tsuntsuntsuntsuntsundere-chan

name: Keita Takahashi
description:
Tachibana's classmate and the second main character.
Keita Takahashi and Yutaka Tachibana eventually start going out.

appearsIn.title: Ichinichi Goto ni Dere ga Fueteku Tsuntsuntsuntsuntsundere-chan

name: Raven Balt
description: A former noble that fell to ruin after his household was accused of treason. He joined the Devil's Army as an ultimatum, where he survived a decade on the battlefield of demonic monsters. Driven solely by the goal of obtaining freedom and restoring his household to its former glory.

appearsIn.title: Duke Pendragon: Master of the White Dragon

name: Allen Pendragon
native: エレン・ペンドラゴン
description: The current heir of House Pendragon. Because of his failure to form a pact with [Soldrake](https://anilist.co/character/261207/Soldrake), he entered a prolonged coma for three years. He was timid around people, preferring to keep himself shut in his room. He lacked talent with the sword and other martial arts, and was considered a laughingstock for these reasons, bringing decline to the Pendragon name. For reasons unknown, [Raven](https://anilist.co/character/261210/Raven-Balt) woke up as him one day.

appearsIn.title: Duke Pendragon: Master of the White Dragon

name: Hiro Momose
description:
A first-year student in Class C at Narukino High School and a member of the Support Club.

During middle school, her clumsy and timid nature led her to be taken advantage of by delinquents; she was bullied and treated as a so-called “shuttle.” Because of that experience, she strongly dislikes delinquents. Upon entering high school, she resolved to put her past behind her and lead a normal, peaceful school life. After joining the Support Club, she becomes entangled with Ichikura when she discovers his secret—that he was once a delinquent himself—despite being a perfect model student who excels

appearsIn.title: Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent

name: Dan Ichikura
description:
A first-year student in Class C at Narukino High School and the president of the Support Club.

Diligent and quiet, Ichikura’s a model student in the same class as Momose. With his black curly hair and glasses, he has a neat appearance and is seen by those around him as the typical straight-A student. However, during his middle school years, he made a name for himself as a notorious silver-haired delinquent. At the time, he was famous for his fighting skills and was treated as a problem child. 

Striving to keep the promise he made to Momose—“I won’t fight anymore”—he appears somewhat intimida

appearsIn.title: Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent

name: Happy Girl
description: A girl that wishes that time would stop, so she could preserve her happy moments.

name: Shinigami Dog
description: A shinigami that takes on the form of dog.

name: Horita Tomotsugu
description: Horita is a boy who is quick to lose interest in things. He proposed to his college friend Yuriko to quit her indie band and go pro with him. She declined his offer at first, but after some incidents happened, she agreed. However, he didn't stay in the band for long and became an office worker through his father's connections later.

name: Yokoyama
description: Horita's friend. He becomes a manga assistant. His girlfriend breaks up with him, because she will be working in another prefecture and they won't be able to keep up the long-distance relationship.

name: Seo-Cheon Ju
description: Seo-Cheon is the main protagonist of the story. In his past life he was an elder of the Mount Hua Sect that survived the "Age of War".

name: Chiyome
description:
She looks like a ninja, a beast race with animal ears and a tail. A descendant of the Jinshin clan. She has infiltrated various places to release the oppressed beastmen, gathered information to rescue them. She met [Arc](https://anilist.co/character/161637/Arc) and others when she was looking for information in a place elven were hold captive. She's looking for the whereabouts of her brother, Sasuke.

"Chiyome" is not her real name, but one of the names inherited by excellent ninjas from generation to generation. Her real name is Mia.

name: Akiko Hayashi
description: At the start of the series, Hayashi Akiko is a third-year high school student whose dream is to become a shoujo mangaka.

appearsIn.title: Blank Canvas: My So-Called Artist's Journey

name: Kenzou Hidaka
description: The teacher of the extramural art class which Akiko attends, known for his rough, pragmatic teaching style. He treats all of his students the same, whacking them with a bamboo sword when they mess up and making them repeat sketches until they get them right, in some cases for years. He is usually referred to as "sensei."

appearsIn.title: Blank Canvas: My So-Called Artist's Journey

name: Ha-Neul Yeon
description:
__Height__: 173 cm (5' 8.5")

Has been part of the photography club since his first year in high school. His hobby is taking pictures of his crush, Chan-Il.

name: Hyeon-Un Baek
description:
__Height__: 182 cm (6')

Chan-Il’s friend and the one who discovered Ha-Neul’s collection of photos.

name: Chan-Il Seong
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1)

Has been part of the photography club since his first year in high school, and is currently receiving lessons from [Ha-Neul](https://anilist.co/character/215421/Yeon-Ha-Neul).

name: Fiona
description:
The final boss in the original novel. Being the illegitimate child of Count Green, she was subjected to a miserable childhood. However, unbeknownst to anyone, she carried a great talent for magic, which would earn her renown as a great mage. For unknown reasons, the author one day wakes up as her. 

Following events in the capital, she officially became Abel Heylon's adopted daughter and heir, becoming Fiona Heylon.

name: Abel Heylon
description: Duke of the North. He's Siegren's mentor and Fiona's benefactor. Though cold to outsiders, he shows a much warmer side of him to his allies, and especially Fiona, whom he regards as his daughter, even insisting on her calling him "father". During the events in the capital, he gains Fiona's consent in adopting her as his heir, thus giving the Heylon name to her

name: Siegren
description: The bastard child of the emperor, born to a commoner mother. He is Abel Heylon´s disciple.

name: Toshiya Misumi
description: At first Toshi is a mentally fragile weak little boy who can't stand up for himself. He cries for everything and nothing. After he meets Mon, who shows him without mercy how a man could be if he fights for everything he wants, Toshi starts to transform. He becomes a devil with a fanatical thirst for destruction.

name: Mon
description: At first Mon is a violent killer faithful only to his own eruptive desires.  He meets Toshi, the exact opposite of himself. After they spend a long time together and Toshi becomes more and more like Mon and even more evil, he collapses and is no longer able to kill. Almost at the same time he meets Maria and starts to grow strong feelings for her. Because of Maria, Toshi starts to distrust him but even in his weakened condition  Toshi is no match for Mon.

name: Hinako Uno
description: She's a kind and extroverted office lady who can be clumsy sometimes, and has a bit of low-self-esteem.

name: Asahi Sato
description: A dependable, reserved, and introverted office woman. Her coworkers are scared of her cold and intense stare. She's five years older than Hinako.

name: Hayato Kasukabe
description: A Tokyo U student who returned to his Grandmother's café following her passing; now interim manager.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Ouka Makuzawa
description: Vocational student, studying fashion design.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Riho Tsukishima
description: A second year college student, and the oldest of the main cast. She's a former child actress who was once regarded as a child genius, but her popularity gradually declined as she grew up. Riho is the most calculating and devious of the girls, putting more thought into managing the cafe than the owner, [Hayato](https://anilist.co/character/208525/Kasukabe-Hayato), himself.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Akane Hououji
description: Part-time worker for the café. Writes music for her band.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Shiragiku Ono
description: A second year who attends the same college as Riho, and is the oldest of the main cast along with her. She is a talented cook who specializes in Japanese cuisine. Has a smell fetish. She is revealed to be a childhood acquaintance of Hayato

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Ami Tsuruga
description: An energetic third-year high school student in the karate club, she works part-time at the Café. Her fighting style consists of moves from the Street Fighter series and other popular works.

appearsIn.title: The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses

name: Motoko Aoyama
description:
__Height__: 175cm (5'9")

Motoko Aoyama is a 15-year-old high school girl who is very formal and into kendo, to the point that her room resembles that of a samurai's (complete with a suit of armor). She claims lineage to a school of demonslaying swordsmen and also displays a prodigious competence with her katana. She can often wreak great damage to boulders or other objects using nothing more than her wooden practice sword. Motoko is very terrified of her sister, Tsuruko, whose skill far exceeds her own, and has a phobia of turtles that is left unexplained for the majority of the series. She d

name: Mitsune Konno
description: She is a scheming freelance writer (and is conspicuous in her lack of writing). A model example of a parasite single, Kitsune lives to enjoy the easy life, and frequently scams others by any means possible. She is frequently drunk, and bottles can be found hidden all over her room. Her greatest joy seems to be teasing Keitaro, even though she clearly cares for him. She is a school friend of Naru and tries her best (or worst) to make Keitaro and Naru get married. In order to maintain her finances, she often bets on horse races. In the anime, Kitsune speaks with an Osaka accent, which seems to i

name: Shinobu Maehara
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

Shinobu Maehara is an extremely shy young girl, though she does develop more confidence as the story progresses. She is aged 12 at the start of the story, and has short black hair, with one strand of hair subtly sticking out. In the Anime she first appears in episode 1. She is later introduced in episode 2 where we learn that her parents are divorcing and she is expected to leave town with one of them, but she prefers to become a resident at the Hinata apartments. In the manga she is already a resident at the apartments when Keitaro arrives there.  She is in seventh

name: Naru Narusegawa
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

Naru Narusegawa is a 17-year-old student and resident of the Hinata Inn that can be described as "one fuse short of a cannon" because of her extremely fiery temper and tendency to be very physical, mainly with Keitaro whenever she feels he's acting perverted. Of all the girls in the Hinata House, she is victimized the most by Keitaro's clumsiness which often results in her being naked, exposed in some fashion, or lying in very suggestive positions. Throughout most of high school she studied hard and became Tops in the nation on the college practice exams in order to

name: Kaolla Suu
description: An immigrant who resides in the Hinata house in the town of Hinata hot springs. She is a very energetic and innovative youth that is always doing something and can manufacture the most amazing things at a whim. Let's not mention her room, it's a jungle in there!!

name: Keitarou Urashima
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")  

Keitarō Urashima is a 20-year-old cram-school student who is desperately trying to get into Tokyo University in order to fulfill a childhood promise he made to a girl 15 years ago. This proves to be very difficult since he has terrible luck, bad studying habits, and can't grasp the material as well as others leading him to fail the exam three times making him a third-year ronin. His grandmother later grants him ownership of the Hinata Inn, a girl's dorimatory. His clumsiness lands him into deep trouble with the girls at the Hinata Inn as he is prone to accidentally

name: Umagon
description: Umagon (Ponygon in English dub) is a mamodo who resembles a small horse, donkey or a sheep according to Kiyomaro's friends. Umagon can only speak "Meru meru mee". Umagon's real name is "Schneider," as it is revealed in the flashbacks that his mother calls him so. Umagon is seen many times throughout the series following Gash Bell around, but he was not officially introduced until episode 23.   His human partner is Kafka Sunbeam.  In the manga, Umagon discovers Gash at the end of his trip in England, but the anime introduced Umagon in Japan earlier to show him off while following him and Kiyoma

name: Parco Folgore
description:
Parco Folgore is a superstar and film hero from Milan, Italy. 

He normally spends his time touring the world, giving concerts, and meeting his fans - especially the ladies, who love him. However, he and [Kanchomé](https://anilist.co/character/16871/Kanchom) have come to Japan for a special purpose - to defeat [Zatch Bell](https://anilist.co/character/3893/Bell-Gash) and [Kiyo Takamine](https://anilist.co/character/3894/Takamine-Kiyomaro). 

They are defeated rather easily and leave, but Zatch and Kiyo meet them again in England, where Kiyo discovers Folgore singing for a group of sick childre

name: Brago
description: Brago is a teenaged mamono with a rough, antisocial attitude. Not much is revealed about his life or personality, other than he resents weakness and especially requiring a human's help to win the demon kingship. He is extremely strong, often defeating other mamono teams without even requiring the use of spells.  His personality softens a bit after meeting with Sherry; Brago is even seen helping a human child. He continues to look down on weaker opponents, however, doing whatever it takes to defeat them. He has a rabid appetite, like most other mamono, once seen eating an entire alligator whole

name: Megumi Ooumi
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

Megumi Ooumi is an old pop star and The Keeper Of The Book to a 6-year-old mamodo, [Tio](https://anilist.co/character/8315/Tio).

She is often seen in video games or doing concerts but despite all this remains a normal girl. Megumi first met Tio when she found her injured on the docks. At first, Tio had kept harshly to herself when they'd first met, saying that Megumi would only get hurt helping her fight off mamodo. They eventually started to get along and Tia came to trust Megumi.

name: Kiyomaro Takamine
description:
__Height:__ 5'11"

Kiyomaro is a genius junior high student (Middle school student in Japan) who doesn't have any friends because people around jealous of him being too smart. He is soon given Gash to care for by his father. Gash makes Kiyomaro believe in himself and together they fight other mamonos to become the King of Mamonos.

name: Kanchomé
description: 1 of the 100 mamono king candidates. He is Folgore's partner, who seems weaker than Gash, but only because his spells are more based around deception and transformation of form. He is dubbed "crybaby" by those around him. He is extremely loyal to Folgore and sings Folgore's songs all day. He has an "endless pocket" filled with all kinds of candy, but despite that he will always try to take candy that is nearby, which has caused him problems.

name: Tio
description:
__Power:__ Strong Shields and Healing.

1 of 100 mamono children chosen for the battle to decide the next king. Tio's power respond towards how her heart feels.

name: Gash Bell
description:
__Race:__ Mamodo
__Spellbook Color:__ Red 
__Spellbook Power:__ Lightning Spells 

Gash is Kiyomaro's partner. He was discovered by Kiyomaro's father wounded and unconscious in a forest in England. Gash had no recollection of who he was or where he had come from. 

Gash is overly cheerful, possessing a strong sense of justice but he is clueless about most the world around him and often gets in trouble when not being supervised by someone. He is also initially unaware of the fact that he can shoot lightning out of his mouth through the use of his spellbook.

name: Sherry Bellmont
native: シェリー・ベルモンド
description:
Sherry is Brago's partner, Is a young Swiss woman she comes from a prosperous family and lives in a mansion with her butler, Albert (Jii in Japan), but is frequently seen travelling abroad to fight other mamodo teams. Initially, she states she has no interest in the kingship or in the battle, and that she is only fighting to free her onetime best friend, Koko, from the influence of an evil mamodo named Zofis.

Her mother was overbearing and proud and expected Sherry to be perfect as a child, constantly expressing disappointment and disgust with her when she failed. As a result, Sherry grew up

name: Ryang Seo
description:
Cheon Ha-Jin was an assassin of Divine Justice Alliance and is one of the Ten Great Masters. He was known as Dam Sa-Yeong's faithful hunting dog. He was later killed by Gwak So-Gyo, the Queen of Soaring Beauty.

After dying, Cheon Ha-Jin reincarnates to the body of Seo Ryang, the third prince of the Heavenly Demon Cult and a student of the Demon Lord, who fell victim to qi reflux and spent six months in a coma.

name: Chiaki Asami
description: A freshman politician determined to oust the elder statesmen currently in power.

name: Akira Houjou
description: An ambitious young man working his way up through the ranks of the Yakuza. His goal: to radically reform Japan from the bottom up.

name: Mariko Kumakura
description:
**Height:** 155cm (5'1") 

Initially just a reserved girl, Mari comes into her own when she suddenly is swept up into a whirlwind friendship with a popular classmate, Akko.   She gets her hair cut off, and from that moment, it seems Mari begins to shed her closed up and shy personality.   Despite being dowdy, Mari comes to enjoy things like shopping for cute clothes and dressing up, though mostly this is because of Akko's encouragement.    Mari has a good family life in contrast to Akko, having both her parents there for her (probably more than she'd like) and a younger brother who she gets al

name: Akiko Oohashi
description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2") 

Akko is not far away from being the image of the "typical teenage girl". She loves shopping, goes to mixers, and enjoys hanging out with her friends immensely. She is a little on the wild side (as compared to quiet girls like [Mariko](https://anilist.co/character/15456/Kumakura-Mariko)), though she mostly just enjoys having a good time.

She develops a strange fascination with Mari and eventually befriends the quieter girl, much to Mari's surprise. Her charisma and honest, forthright nature captivates those around her, and she easily makes friends, as Mari observes.

name: Roland Wimbledon
description: Roland Wimbledon is the King of the Kingdom of Graycastle and the leader of the Witch Union. His true identity is Cheng Yan, an engineer from modern day China, who somehow wakes up in the body of the original Roland after both of them died. After realizing this was real, he decided to live in this new world according to his morals and ideals.

name: Anna Wimbledon
description: Anna Wimbledon is a witch from Border Town, and the first witch Roland meets.

name: Leslie Salvatore
description: Leslie Shuya Salvator formerly Sperado is the main protagonist. She is known as the Black Saint and is the only daughter and lady of the Salvator family. She is the former second daughter of the Sperado family, and was born to be a sacrifice for her older sister, Ellie de arne Sperado.

name: Acela Salvatore
description:
Acela Benkan Salvatore is known as the Monster Duchess as well as a powerful swordsman and magician. She quickly adopts Leslie after seeing the power of the Black Saint.
She is Sairaine's wife.

name: Konrad Altera
description: Eldest son of Duke Altera and Ruenti's friend. He is a paladin knight of the Tesentraha temple. Konrad entered the temple when he was around seven years old.

name: Sunny
description:
Sunny (Sani) is one of the "Four Heavenly Kings" (四天王, shitennou), he is first shown as having great strength, like Toriko, shown carrying a Regal Mammoth with one arm, although this is just a clever trick due to the fact that he was actually using his monstrously strong hair, each of his strings being strong enough to lift nearly 50 pounds. He is Rin's older brother. 

He is a quiet, pretty boy who judges the "beauty" of people's actions and speaks in an elegant, almost flirtatious manner. He has a way of "hitting" without even touching the target, mainly related to his "sensor" talent that a

name: Coco
description: The "Gentleman" of the "Four Heavenly Kings" ((四天王, shitennou), he is good friends with Toriko. While Toriko mostly relies on his brute strength, Coco prefers using stealthy techniques and cunning strategy to subdue aggressors. He is also strong defensively; he is immune to five hundred different kinds of poison. He earns most of his living by working as a fortuneteller, and his fortunes have a 97% accuracy rating, this has also made him extremely popular with women and results in him being mobbed by costumers when he is in public.  He also has the ability to see non-visible spectrum's of ligh

name: Komatsu
description: A five-star chef who works for Hotel Gourmet, part of the prestigious IGO (International Gourmet Organization). Komatsu is 25 years old, the same age as Toriko.  He is timid but greatly interested by what he finds in his travels with Toriko. As a result, he tries to overcome his fear and does his best to help. It is shown that he is a highly skilled and competent chief capable on carrying out delicate procedures such as the removal of a puffer-whale's poison sack. He is also able to create delicious plates from any food giving to him and he has such a large knowledge of foods that he knows whi

name: Zebra
description: One of the "Four Heavenly Kings" he is in jail for an as of now unknown crime. He is said to be the best at disrupting IGO's food order. Although not officially seen, he is described as the most savage of the Four Heavenly Kings, as proof of this he single handily caused all the scars on Match's body. It was later revealed the person who captured Zebra is Yosaku the Saiseiya, along with Teppei's assistance. He, and the other Four Heavenly Kings, were trained by Ichiryuu, the President of the IGO.   He is later charged from prison and go with Toriko and Komatsu to the Gourmet Piramid to find an

name: Toriko
description:
__Height:__ 220 cm
__Hors-D'oeuvre:__ BB Corn
__Soup:__ Century Soup (Komatsu's Version)
__Fish Dish:__ Ougai
__Meat Dish:__ End Mammoth
__Main:__ GOD (Has yet to acquire it) Acquired in the end
__Salad:__ AIR
__Dessert:__ Fruit of Rainbow
__Drink:__ Billion Bird Egg

A Bishoku-ya with an abnormally large appetite (a food serving for 500 people could only get him 1/10 full). Toriko is 25 years old, the same age as [Komatsu](https://anilist.co/character/19942/Komatsu). He is known as one of the "Four Heavenly Kings", and his nickname is "The Glutton". Despite having a huge appetite and massive

name: Jirou
description: FULL COURSE MENU Hors-D'oeuvre: Hundred Leaf Clover  Soup: Magma Consomme  Fish Dish: Royal Land Shark  Meat Dish: Ashurasaurus  Main: E.T. Rice  Salad: Grana Lettuce  Dessert: Oasis Melon  Drink: Doham Spring Sake   A retired bishokuya who's always drunk. He was Setsuno's partner in old days and he was one of Acacia's students (with the others being Ichiryuu and Bishoku-kai boss). He's also Teppei's grandfather.

name: Yae Saotome
description: Saotome Yae is a local female High-School boxing-talent considered to be the next promise in Japanese boxing.

name: Digimortal
description: Digimortal is an otherwise unnamed assassin who does work for a resistance/terrorist organization seeking to undermine and ultimately destroy the Inquisition Branch of the Church of Transfiguration. He has apparently undergone extensive cybernetic modification which grants him extreme physical quickness and strength. In Digimortal, he has been hired to assassinate Lord Halogen Übler of the Inquisition and both of the High Inquisitor's bodyguards, the sisters Tolaris and Lataris. Contrary to his rather somber appearance, Digimortal's helmet displays a wicked grin to anything standing before his

name: Denji Kudou
description: Former member/test subject of Kegen Hall. Fused with an organism known as the gauna.

name: Touta Konoe
description:
Number 7 of UQ Holder's immortal squad, Numbers. Touta is a cheerful and optimistic 14 year old boy with many dreams. He was raised by Yukihime after his parents died. After being mortally wounded while protecting Yukihime, he drinks her blood and is transformed into an immortal vampire. His weapon is the Gravity Blade, a sword that can have its weight increased or decreased thousands of timesfold according to the will of its user (actually a adjustable dial). His grandfather was Negi Springfield, a legendary magician and Negima's protagonist.

(Source: Wikipedia, edited)

name: Kuroumaru Tokisaka
description: Number 11 of UQ Holder's immortal squad, Numbers. A 14 year old who comes from a tribe of demi-humans (Yatagarasu) where children are born genderless, but can choose to become male or female during a ceremony on their 16th birthday. Kuroumaru currently wants to become male, and thus identifies as and presents himself as a boy. He has romantic feelings for Touta, but denies it to everyone who points it out, claiming he only wants "male friendship" with Touta. He is a practitioner of the Shinmeiryuu, a sword style also seen in Ken Akamatsu's previous series.

name: Youta Toono
description: __Height:__ 167cm

appearsIn.title: Osoraku Kanojo wa Ore no Aniki wo Neratteru

name: Izumi Houjou
description: __Height:__ 167cm

appearsIn.title: Osoraku Kanojo wa Ore no Aniki wo Neratteru

name: Kazuki Itou
description: Itou Kazuki is a normal highschooler with an untidy nature who relies very much on his younger sister to keep his cleaning in check. As a result, when his younger sister is threatened, he stands up for her. When the strange lolita begins to stalk him and his sister, Kazuki shows himself to be brave and determined character but she soon begins to get under his skin...

name: Remina Kanbe
description: The strange lolita girl who has been stalking the protagonist.      She is not actually the real Remina Kanbe, and instead has taken the identity of the real Remina Kanbe. By the end of the series, she has taken the identity of Hikari Itou.

name: Nemesis
description: Nemesis is a sadistic, demanding girl who is responsible in giving orders to Mea. She uses Mea as her spy to look after Yami's changes and recent life. In addition, Nemesis is the one behind the plans to make Yami return to her emotionless-assassin's life again. Claiming that she knows that one day, Yami will return to her real path naturally, she decided to live in the human world and tries to be friends with everyone; in refusal of Momo and Rito. Like the other girls, she also seems to have sexual feelings towards Rito and plans to train him as her 'pet'.

name: Se-Jun Park
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Class:__ Farmer

Park Se-Jun is the protagonist of The Top Dungeon Farmer who had been dreaming of going into the dungeon. He was transported to the 99th Floor of the Black Dungeon after forcibly jumping into the Vanishing Phenomenon and was regarded by the administrator as a mistake. There he earned the class of Farmer.

name: Jack Valantier
description: The third child of the Valantier family, Jack Valantier. The protagonist of the story.

name: Hana Agaya
description: An illustrator and Machi's junior, she's a lesbian who tried dating in her school days. She was the one to propose the fake marriage with Machi.

appearsIn.title: I Married My Best Friend to Shut My Parents Up

name: Machi Morimoto
description: An office lady who lives under her parents' expectations. In order to escape her parents' nagging, she fakes a marriage with Hana.

appearsIn.title: I Married My Best Friend to Shut My Parents Up

name: Tsubasa Ichinose
description: The main character of Ichinose Family's Deadly Sins. Before the accident, he used to be part of the soccer club.

name: Inori Yuitsuka
description: A 5th grade elementary student who loves figure skating so much she used to practice it in secret. Though she greatly lacks academic skill, when she's in the rink she's like a different person.

name: Tsukasa Akeuraji
description: He is a former figure skater and now the coach of [Inori Yuitsuka](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka).

name: Mayuka Korenaga
description: Mayuka is Daiki's older sister. Her existence is also kept low profile until a certain point where it is found that she is actually the girlfriend of the unobtainable Ren Ichinose. She has a job which is in the modelling business which she pursued for what she thought was Ren's sake and she is currently studying for extrance exams to university. After chapter 7, she has her own story arc entitled Strobe Edge: Another Light which is set when her parents are separated and where she meets Ren for the first time. As the series progresses, she becomes wary of Ninako's relationship with Ren but rema

name: Ritsuka Hara
description: Landlord of the apartment [Koduka](https://anilist.co/character/143660) lives in. She is good at cooking.

appearsIn.title: I Can't Believe I Slept With You!

name: Chiyo Koduka
description:
__Likes:__ Alcohol and games.

Currently unemployed, previously worked at a game company.

appearsIn.title: I Can't Believe I Slept With You!

name: Saki Kasukabe
description:
She is Kousaka's girlfriend. Fashionable, violent, confident, occasional smoker, and not at all attracted by the sexual charms of anime characters, Saki is not an otaku in any sense of the word. 

She follows Kousaka into Genshiken, and is eventually blackmailed by the first Genshiken chairman into joining the club. Surprisingly, Saki actually saves Genshiken from being shut down on two separate occasions, though her motives have more to do with revenge and guilt than becoming more of an otaku.

name: Makoto Kousaka
description:
Unusually handsome and cute, Kousaka is actually one of the most hardcore otaku in Genshiken. He loves hentai games and is undefeatable when it comes to video games, particularly the fighting genre. As Saki's boyfriend, Kousaka is largely responsible for Saki learning to be patient when it comes to dating an otaku.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Harunobu Madarame
description:
The second president of Genshiken, Madarame is personally chosen by the first Genshiken president to be his successor, though Madarame shows the most leadership and initiative even before formally appointed as president. He is a Gundam fan and arguably the most hardcore otaku out of all of Genshiken.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Chika Ogiue
description: Ogiue is a blunt, self-hating fujoshi and amateur artist whose inner turmoil is the focus of much of the second half of Genshiken.  Ogiue hails from the Tohoku region of Japan in the northeast, and as such frequently tries to hide her accent while she attends college in the Tokyo area.  When put under pressure though her accent tends to slip through.  Her eyesight is incredibly bad, and requires the use of contact lenses or glasses.    Ogiue is a fan of yaoi and boys' love, and her taste in doujinshi stems from a preference for shounen series.  Among the series she likes are Scram Dunk (Slam D

name: Kanako Oono
description: Raised in the United States since the third grade, she graduated from an American high school, joining the Genshiken at the beginning of the Fall term. Normally soft-spoken and easily embarrassed, Oono is surprisingly upfront when it comes to one of her two main passions: cosplay. With a nice figure and large bosom, Oono and her cosplaying (using costumes sewn personally by [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/2510/Tanaka-Souichiro), whom she begins dating) quickly become Genshiken's main attraction at student fairs. Oono's other main passion is yaoi involving muscular, middle-aged, exceeding

name: Kanji Sasahara
description: The third president of Genshiken. At first in denial about his otaku nature, Sasahara eventually accepts and embraces it. He loves hentai PC games despite not owning a computer until volume 3. When Sasahara assumes the title of Genshiken president from Madarame, his first decision is to push the club's initiative, and establish their own booth at Comic-Fest. While Sasahara is pretty much the "normal" otaku, his unwavering loyalty to a single character (Kujibiki Unbalance character Ritsuko Kübel Kettenkrad aka "The Chairman") makes him stand out from the others. Even the dōjinshi created by Gen

name: Rion Akagami
description: Rion is a pretty, athletic girl who is considered the school's number one idol and the ace of the Gymnastics Club. She is Akira's childhood friend and had a crush on him.

name: Miina Isurugi
description:
__Height:__ 132 cm 

The fake Miina Isurugi, real name Heijirou, is a young actor who, prior to the plane crash, was hired to dress up as the real Miina Isurugi. He is one of the very few children on the plane and worked as a child actor before the plane crash.

name: Shirou Mariya
description:
**Height:** 146 cm  Weight: 38 kg
**Class:** 3rd Year, Class 4   
**Family:** Father , 3 Older Sisters, 1 Little Brother

he first person Sengoku met after waking on the island. Mariya is (was?) one of the best students from their school. He's not very sociable, nor is he strong physically, but with his vast knowledge he's proven himself to be really reliable and useful. He never parts with his laptop (after fans made it into infinite-battery one, it was finally revealed it's charged with a foot-pump charger) the main use of which is identifying animals with an "extinct ani

name: Kanako Oomori
description:
**Height:** 165 cm 

She is a plucky young flight attendant who survives the crash. She acts as the group's medic. Even though, at first, she is seen as not very smart (she failed her flight attendant test 16 times before passing as the storyline begins) she is actually quite intelligent, knowing all the chemicals that could be used for first aid and more serious wounds. Being with Akira gives her the courage to survive and protect the others to the best of her ability.

name: Akira Sengoku
description:
__Height:__ 151 cm 

The main character of the series, a Japanese schoolboy. He seems to be a bystander who reacts to events rather than choosing his own destiny. He is regarded by his fellow students as a lazy good-for-nothing. He is not much of a reliable guy but in times of peril he springs courageously into action that helps the group survival, and eventually making him the leader of the group. He also seems to have a crush on Rion but can't express his feelings to her since they are childhood friends.    (Wikipedia)

name: Kouichi Yarai
description: 3rd year, class 4, is a tough kid from Akira's school who appears to dominate the other boys. He has some of the qualities of a natural leader. While the others are panicked from these new surroundings, Yarai finds this world as "living a life without boredom."   The son of a wealthy business man with many mistress's and is therefore  ignored by his father, never having actually met him. His mother died when he was a young child, and he was sent to his Aunt, who also later died. He is devoloping a mother/son? relationship with sensei.

name: Seong-Min Lee
description: __Age:__ 18 2100+ (Post-Consciousness World)

appearsIn.title: Backstabbed in a Backwater Dungeon: My Party Tried to Kill Me, But Thanks to an Infinite Gacha I Got LVL 9999 Friends and Am Out For Revenge

name: Pereshati Lapileon
aliases: 佩雷莎提 拉菲雷昂
description: Pereshati Zahardt is a countess. She was murdered by her familly due her father's fortune and ended up travelling back in time. She signed marriage contract with the Grand Duke Lapileon in effort to stay alive.

appearsIn.title: My In-Laws are Obsessed with Me
My In-Laws are Obsessed with Me

name: Su-Hhyeon Kim
description:
__Height__: 181 cm (5'11")

After losing his brother and beloved ones, he decides to climb to the zenith of the hall plains to obtain "zero code" which will grant him any wish.

name: Mugi Nekozane
description: A strange girl that is very fond of cats. Appears somewhat apathetic and expressionless towards her peers, often keeping to herself, but after meeting [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/328502/Seno-Minato) she begins to open herself up more.

appearsIn.title: Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate

name: Minato Seno
description: A fairly timid boy that sits next to Nekozane in class. Due to Nekozane usually sleeping in class Minato doesn't initiate contact with her at first, but after interacting with her for the first time and seeing a different side to her he tries to get to know her better.

appearsIn.title: Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate

name: Ga-Jang No
description: No Ga-Jang is the main protagonist of Peerless Dad. He is the adopted son and disciple of Mo Wei and the successor of the Trillion Blows Art.

name: Seo-Hyeon No
description: She is the youngest children of Noh Gajang. She is extremely intelligent and has a great talent for martial arts, surpassing her older siblings and apparently any child of her age.

name: Satsuki Tachibana
description: Childhood friend of [Watari](https://anilist.co/character/209143/Watari-Suzushiro) and [Naoto](https://anilist.co/character/209142/Watari-Naoto), "Suzu"shiro. She has come back into their lives after six years.

name: Naoto Watari
description: Naoto Watari's life has revolved around his little sister. He forgoes club activities for the sake of spending time with her, leading many of his peers to label him a siscon. But as long as his sister's happy, Nao is willing to shut out any unwelcome comments about himself.

name: Suzushiro Watari
description: Nao's little sister

name: Takuya Seo
description: A socially awkward, unassuming otaku high school boy who loves the girls' anime “Kiramon.” Nicknamed “Otaku-kun.” He tends to speak rapidly when talking about Kiramon. He's good at drawing but struggles with academics and communication. He has an aversion to gals. Through a series of unexpected events, he becomes involved with his classmates, the gals [Kei Amane](https://anilist.co/character/322471/Kei-Amane) and [Kotoko Ijichi](https://anilist.co/character/322472/Kotoko-Ijichi).

appearsIn.title: Gals Can’t Be Kind to Otaku!?

name: Kei Amane
description: The cool gal in [Takuya's](https://anilist.co/character/322478/Takuya-Seo) class. One of the top beauties in her grade. Has strong likes and dislikes, especially dislikes vegetables. Tall and skilled at basketball, but not part of any club activities. Despite her intelligent looks, she's not particularly good at studying. As for Kiramon, she insists she only likes it for her little sister-like friend [Sayu](https://anilist.co/character/392458/Amamiya-Sayu) and isn't an otaku... but...?

appearsIn.title: Gals Can’t Be Kind to Otaku!?

name: Kotoko Ijichi
description: A cheerful gal who is [Takuya's](https://anilist.co/character/322478/Takuya-Seo) classmate. She has excellent communication skills and is good at studying, but not so good at sports. She tends to get close when talking. She is the third of five siblings, with two older brothers and two younger brothers. Because she has so many siblings, she often acts as a mother figure and takes care of her younger brothers.

appearsIn.title: Gals Can’t Be Kind to Otaku!?

name: Kazuya Nachi
description: An upperclassman of Fuuka and Yuu. He originally wanted Fuuka to join the school's track team, which he was the captain of, but he was later persuaded to join Fuuka's band instead. He plays the drums.

name: Yuu Haruna
description: Yuu Haruna moved to Tokyo and started high school there because his parents were moved to America for business. He lives with his 3 sisters [Hibiki](https://anilist.co/character/120933/Haruna-Hibiki), [Mayu](https://anilist.co/character/120932/Haruna-Mayu), and [Chitose](https://anilist.co/character/120929/Haruna-Chitose). He uses Twitter often and posts about his life whenever he gets the opportunity. On his first day he meets [Fuuka](https://anilist.co/character/120752/Akitsuki-Fuuka) on the street where she bumps into him and falls over, with the way Yuu was standing with his phone in his h

name: Sara Iwami
description: A senpai at the same school as Yuu and Fuuka, she is the younger sister of Hisashi.

name: Fuuka Aoi
description: She is first seen after the Hedgehogs' concert playing one of their songs on the street. We later find out that she is in a band and is going to play at the Denkou Rebellion as well.

name: Makoto Mikasa
description:
A friend and classmate of Fuuka and Yuu. He has both British and German heritage in addition to Japanese. Mikasa is popular and well liked by everyone in class and considered to be very good looking. He appears to be particularly close to Fuuka, but not in a romantic way, as he is openly homosexual.
In the 163rd chapter, he confesses his feelings to his former teacher Tomomi.

name: Suzuka Asahina
description: A talented female high jumper from Yokohama that was scouted by many famous high schools because of her skill. While in Tokyo, she lives in Ayano’s dormitory, next door to Yamato. She is a serious athlete that puts a lot of pressure on herself to perform so she does not disappoint others.    At first, she has a cold attitude toward Yamato, but according to her sister, Suzuka only shows her arrogant and somewhat moody attitude to someone she likes. Because of her past with Kazuki, she was reluctant to express her feelings toward Yamato and ended up trying to push him away. After a while, she fi

name: Marnak
description: Though he usually seems like a good priest, he shows a radical side that mercilessly kills wrongdoers and enemies.

name: Fujiwara no Sai
description:
A spirit from the Heian era of Japan and mentor of [Hikaru Shindou](https://anilist.co/character/90/).

Once the Go instructor to the Emperor, Sai continually plays Go, his goal being to one day play the divine move. Sai's ghost had previously possessed the real-life figure, Honninbou Shuusaku, who became a renowned Go player. He is an extremely emotional person, who often acts childish and has great mood swings. While playing Go however, his behaviour changes completely as he controls himself and his emotions to play to the best of his ability.

Sai has a high sense of honor, abhorring cheati

name: Hikaru Shindou
description: Hikaru is a sixth grader in elementary school. An important factor in the development of Hikaru's passion for Go was an encounter early on where Hikaru becomes the rival of Akira Toya. At first, he thinks that Go is just for oldsters and he is annoyed at Sai's demand to play, but little by little his passion for Go increases as he plays more and more. From being a member of a school Go club to being an insei and finally becoming a professional Go player (at 14 years old) a year after Akira, Hikaru matures throughout the course of the series. Throughout the series, Hikaru gradually gets taller

name: Akira Touya
description: Hikaru's biggest rival and Kaio Middle School student. The son of Koyo Toya, Akira is already a very strong Go player when Hikaru first begins playing and is amazed by Hikaru's seemingly impossible strength. Since his first game with Hikaru, Akira has been obsessed with discovering the secret behind his strength. Akira has faced Hikaru again and won, but still sees a lot of strength within him. As the series progresses, they continue to play each other, but it always ends in an argument.

name: Gennosuke Fujiki
description: Fujiki Gennosuke is a one armed samurai from the Kogan school. Fujiki is very loyal to his master, he is also rumored to be the strongest disciple in Kogan's dojo.

name: Seigen Irako
description: Irako Seigen is introduced as Fujiki's opponent. He is a blind samurai with a very strange and terrifying sword technique.

name: Yuna Ichihara
description: __Height:__ 154cm

name: Tatsuya Iguchi
description: Tatsuya is the top chief of Kamaekite, the school to which Hiroshi transferred to during the 2 school semester. Tatsuya is know by various names: The Inhumain, the idol, etc... He is one crazy madman who enjoys using his authority over the school students. He put Hiroshi to the test once he arrived at school. He is usually accompanied by 3 of the schools most dangerous guys.

name: Atsushi Tanzawa
description:
The 7th Gen. Head of the biker gang Kilihito.

Has the face and body structure of a female. Incredibly competent fighter.

Known for his playful, carefree attitude and being brought to tears easily, but will seldom forgive anyone who may hurt his friends or anyone in Kilihito - his punishment will be swift and merciless.

name: Kaname Abe
description: Kaname is the vice head of Kilihito

name: Kogami Kii
description: A normal high school freshman, doesn't want to get involved in anything bothersome or build up unneeded stress.

name: Kaede Sayano
description: In the same year as Kii. Along with Ootsuki, she cruelly bullied Tsukune.   She confesses to Kii that she has always loved him since elementary school.

name: Wataru Himeji
description: Himeji is a deaf classmate of Kogami.

name: Shirogane Shinobu
description: Shinobu is the son of Sou Shirogane, the president of the Wahre Liebe Pharmaceutical Company.

name: Hanzawa Yoruka
description: Sophomore student

name: Hanakai Mikano
description: Mikano is a high school student. She has a brash manner of speaking and doesn't bow to bullying. She has been friends with Shinobu since they were kids.

name: Rintarou Akuta
description: Rintarou Akuta was a police officer before the magical girl attack where his sanity had slipped by the time he met the survivors from the high school, who sought refuge in the mall where he was apparently working.

name: Makoto Nasuno
description: Gender: Male

name: Ryou Watari
description: A closeted trans man who can only express himself through his clothing. He's creative and artistic, but has trouble expressing it. Jin encourages him to be his partner on the creation of an apparel brand.

name: Rinn
description: Rinn is a girl from a rural Niederland village, after her village is attacked, she happens upon the sword Gram containing the spirit of prince Siegfried.

name: Siegfried
description: Siegfried, sometimes referred to simply as Sieg, is the recently deceased prince of Niederland. His spirit inhabits his sword Gram, now wielded by Lynn and accompanies her on their journey.

name: Dietrich von Bern
native: ディートリヒ・フォン・ベルン
description: Dietrich von Bern is the prince of Bern.

name: Lyngheid
description: Lyngheid also known simply as Lyng is a dragon and twin sister of Lofn.

name: Lofnheid
description: Lofnheid or known simply as Lofn is a dragon and twin sister of Lyng.

name: Kuroko Koumori
description:
An ex-serial killer, now national executioner. Koumori Kuroko loves cute girls, sex, and annihilating her targets. Even though she is now a hired assassin by the Japanese police force, she has a record of murdering 715 people in the past since her childhood.

She has a girlfriend but actively flirts and sleeps with other women. She occasionally goes on dating sites to find said women.

name: Hinako Tozakura
description: A lighthearted and innocent yet bold girl who owns and drives her Murcielago like a psychopath. She is Kuroko's partner.

name: Ayako Nakano
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

A third-year high-schooler who has had telepathic powers since she was 5. She's quiet and reclusive as a result and doesn't have any friends initially, because she's afraid of what people would think of her if they knew. She is grossed out by Hayato's constant thoughts regarding her.

name: Akira Yashima
description:
Height: 184 cm
Hobbies: cycling, gaming, reading manga
Talent: can hold his breath for a long time
Favorite subject: English, art, and history
Least favorite subject: none
Future dream: traveller

One of Hayato's closest friends. He has a girlfriend whom he cycles with. He enjoys playing the "word chain" game.

name: Manami Azuma
description:
Height: 148 cm
Talent: handstands
Favorite subject: music, mathematics, biology, PE
Least favorite subject: English and history
Dislikes: being called croissant
Future dream: School teacher

A cute and fashionable third-year student. She's in love with her childhood friend, Hayato, and is fiercely protective of him, causing her to have no female friends. Her inner thoughts are often far more rude and sinister than her outward attitude and actions.

name: Hayato Toda
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

A popular and handsome third-year student who is madly in love with [Ayako](https://anilist.co/character/126460/Nakano-Ayako). Spends all day imagining lewd things about her, which annoys Ayako greatly. 

He is the star of his school's soccer team. Is childhood friends with [Manami](https://anilist.co/character/126465/Azuma-Manami), but doesn't see her anything more than just a friend.

name: Riku Azami
description: Riku Azami lived with an abusive father and a drug addicted mother. He was taken to the orphanage when his father committed suicide. He soon sought after boxing to learn how to protect the ones he loves.

name: Toshihide
description: A half-human-half-mermaid that likes playing underwater piano.

name: Shiju
description: A mermaid that wants to learn piano.

name: Toshihide
description: A boy who suddenly woke up as a girl.

name: Rie
description: [Toshihide's](https://anilist.co/character/374495/) girlfriend.

name: Kenji
description: [Nayuta's](https://anilist.co/character/290547) older brother and protector.

name: Nayuta
description: A girl born with horns and strong magic powers.

name: Mitsuko Ehara
description: A high school student attending an art school and [Anzu's](https://anilist.co/character/374513/) older sister. After Anzu wins first place for a nude portrait of Mitsuko that is displayed at the school entrance for the entire year—much to Mitsuko’s embarrassment—Mitsuko spends the rest of the school year trying to get back at her sister by creating an equally humiliating nude portrait of her.But after realizing she is unable to, she ends up drawing a self-portrait to show her sister how to correctly draw her nude, which wins first place and in turn replaces her sister's painting of her on the

name: Anzu Ehara
description:
[Mitsuko's](https://anilist.co/character/374511) younger sister who she always strives to be like. Her painting of Mitsuko nude *(drawn from imagination)* won the school art competition and was hung at the school entrance all year.

*Note: The manga translates her name as "Anzu", the anime translates her name as "Kyoko"*

name: Kakihara Masao
description: A sadistic and insane man from the pits of hell with one thing on his mind "who is Ichi" and "where can I find him?"

name: Jijii
description: Jijii is a very short, old man and the leader of a small band of exiles bent on destroying the notorious Anjou gang and making as much money as possible. To do this, he has taken a young man under his wing, whom he calls Ichi. Jijii has implanted false memories in Ichi's mind, which cause him to go psychotic. Jijii, in a sense, had made this cowardly young man into the ultimate killer.    In reality, not much is known about Jijii. What we do know is that, despite his old appearance, he is only 35. Plastic surgery and heavy steroid use caused him to look the way he does. His plans are much grea

name: Shiroishi Hajime
description: On the surface, Shiroishi is just a simple-minded guy who works at a metal shop and enjoys stopping by the red light district. At night Shiroishi becomes Ichi the Killer. When pushed to the brink emotionally, Ichi becomes a sadistic monster capable of ripping men to shreds. At first Ichi only kills when his guardian, Jijii, pushes him to. After awhile, fueled by an insatiable violent perversion, Ichi begins to grow in ways Jijii hadn't dared to hope.

name: Gou Iwakura
description:
__Sentence:__ 3 years

A man of few words, he possesses both strength and an extraordinary aura of intimidation. With his youth seemingly contradictory to his prowess in combat, as well as the gunshot wound on his back, he hails from a mysterious background.

name: Yoshiaki Maeda
description:
__Sentence:__ Indefinite  

An ordinary boy who wouldn't look out of place anywhere, he was imprisoned on false charges. Although cowardly, with no stomach for fighting, he appears to have a sense of justice.

name: Mitsuru Yamanoi
description:
__Sentence:__ 2 Years 6 Months 

Always with a calm and collected demeanor, he passes judgment with a precision bordering on cruelty. With his high intellect, he tends to look down on those around him. He also goes by the nickname "Noiman."

name: Masafumi Yoshioka
description:
__Sentence:__ 2 years 3 months

Although seemingly aloof and condescending, he is a sly fox who is always hiding a knife somewhere. Contrary to his dignified appearance, he is always ready for a fight.

name: Chae-Rin Eun
description:
A woman who appeared in the world of a novel after dying. She became the main character - Chaerin Eun, a "drop-dead gorgeous" girl who was only liked by her admirers. She lives a comfortable life inside the novel, until the day on which Jeha was supposed to confess to her comes.

She tries every way to live a normal life again. After living and dying around 400 times, she meets a mysterious extra who dies in front of her afterward. After reviving, she promises herself to find her helper and dedicates her time, life, and resources to help the classmates.

name: Yuu Ayase
description:
Yuu is a 17-year-old boy with a short stature. He possesses striking red hair and red eyes. Despite being described as average, his most notable feature is his handsome and beautiful face, which he inherited from his mother, Subaru Ayase.

Yuu is a naturally kind and caring boy, always willing to help the Mikadono Sisters and those in need, even if it means butting into their business. He approaches life with extreme positivity and proactivity, often going above and beyond to lend a hand. However, the sisters sometimes see his kindness as a weakness and tease and scold him for it, yet still fi

appearsIn.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze

name: Kazuki Mikadono
description: Kazuki is the eldest of the Mikadono Sisters. She possesses outstanding acting and singing skills, capable of flawlessly portraying roles that are deemed impossible by others, and she also has incredible ticket-selling power, as every performance she appears in is sold out. Despite being part of an all-female theater group, she specializes in male roles due to her deep voice and polished appearance, which makes her extremely popular among women as a prince figure. However, she internally feels a compulsion to lead and help others without relying on anyone, in order to live up to her image as e

appearsIn.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze

name: Niko Mikadono
description: Niko is the second eldest of the Mikadono Sisters. Despite her small stature of 150cm, Niko is a karate athlete who overwhelms her opponents with immense strength, winning numerous medals. She has exceptional physical abilities since childhood, dominating various martial arts competitions, and her robust and charismatic personality reflects her strict attitude towards herself and others. However, she also has a shy side and has a tendency to enjoy cute and bright things.

appearsIn.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze

name: Miwa Mikadono
description:
Miwa is the youngest of the Mikadono Sisters. She is a high school girl with a unique two-tone short cut, with the top of her head being blonde and the rest of her hair being green. Like her sisters, she also has golden eyes.

Miwa is a genius shogi player with an IQ exceeding 180, occasionally winning in shogi and chess competitions and leading her team to victory in international mathematics competitions as the youngest female representative. However, her outstanding genius often isolates her from others, as she lacks interest in mundane conversations and people tend to keep their distance f

appearsIn.title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze

name: Guideau
description:
A feral, violent girl with long fangs and the eyes of a beast. A witch's curse can be seen in the form of a rose tattoo on her collarbones.

Guideau currently works for the Order of Magical Resonance, a group that works by magic, for magic and of magic. Her partner is Ashaf.
Guideau's true form is locked inside Ashaf's coffin. She is originally a man who's extremely powerful, considered to be a witch's "one true natural enemy". Her current appearance is the result of a witch's curse.

name: Ashaf
description:
A soft-spoken man with delicate features, a coffin strapped to his back, and an entourage of crows.

Ashaf currently works for the Order of Magical Resonance, a group that works by magic, for magic and of magic. His partner is Guideau.

They are currently both looking for the traces of a specific witch in order to remove the curse on Guideau.

name: Izana Shinatose
description: Shinatose is a Guardian pilot and quickly becomes [Nagate's](https://anilist.co/character/22249/Tanikaze-Nagate) best friend, constantly following Nagate and teaching him about the life inside Sidonia. Izana is a new third gender that originated during the hundred of years of human emigration into space.

name: Nagate Tanikaze
description: The series main protagonist who was created by his grandfather deep inside Sidonia, thus he did not undergo the special genetic treatment to develop the ability to perform photosynthesis and must eat on a daily basis like a regular human for nutrition. Despite having a hard time adapting to Sidonia's way of life and getting in trouble constantly while being rejected by the other humans due to not being aware of the laws and attributes of the new culture, he eventually becomes the spaceship's ace pilot after saving the day on several missions.

name: Tsumugi Shiraui
description:
A gauna/human hybrid created by Kunato Developments for fighting against the Gauna. Similar in size and appearance to a guardian, but having a gauna-like appearance, her prowess in combat is rivaled only by Nagate's. She becomes friends with Nagate and Izana, usually interacting with them at their house by a tentacle she sneaks by the vent system while her main body stays at her hangar. Later it is revealed that Tsumugi was created from a sample of a Gauna with Hoshijiro's DNA.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Shizuka Hoshijiro
description: She is a Guardian Pilot who is ranked number 2 among the trainees. She is the first Sidionian who [Tanikaze](https://anilist.co/character/22249/Tanikaze-Nagate) became friends with. She is also his classmate and fellow squadron team mate.

appearsIn.title: I Get Stronger the More I Eat

name: Ruwanda Bailey
description: Ruwanda is the son of Miranda, a murderer. He was a lonely child raised in captivity. Sometimes, his behavior turns into that of a killer but with the mind of a child.

name: Ivan
description: A boy born and raised in the slums. Ivan was sold off by his father due to his crippling debt. Ivan soon became obsessed with money, believing his family could become whole once more if he simply had enough money. Due to his father’s poor habit of drinking till he passed out, Ivan happened to pick up the same drinking problem.

name: Macaro
description: Macalo grew up in a wealthy family, a result of one of her parents being a doctor. She doesn't feel guilty when killing animals as she hunts.

name: Midwinter
description: Midwinter is the boss of an organization who asks Ruwanda to do jobs for him. He conducts himself in a gentlemanly manner.

name: Takumi Aterazawa
description: A forthright twenty-year-old university student who is childhood friends with Miu, Takumi fell in love with Ayako after witnessing her declaration to adopt Miu ten years ago. Living next-door, he frequently visits the Katsuragi family and also acts as Miu's tutor at Ayako's request. After ten years of diligently keeping his love secret, he finally confesses to Ayako.

appearsIn.title: You Like Me, Not My Daughter?!

name: Ayako Katsuragi
description: A kind and somewhat dense thirty-four-year-old housewife who works from home, Ayako is a successful editor and frequent intermediary between clients and creators at LightShip. Following the tragic accidental death of her sister, she takes responsibility for Miu's upbringing by adopting her and has been a devoted mother since. Between raising Miu and her career, Ayako has never been free to pursue a romantic relationship.

appearsIn.title: You Like Me, Not My Daughter?!

name: Miu Katsuragi
description: A mischievous fifteen-year-old in her first year of high school, Miu is Ayako's adopted daughter. Having long been aware of Takumi's feelings and wishing for her mother's happiness, she encourages Ayako to date him.

appearsIn.title: You Like Me, Not My Daughter?!
Can You Just Die, My Darling?

name: Mika Hanazono
description:
Hanazono Mika, is Kamishiro's childhood friend and high school classmate.

She is a young girl of medium height, slender body, brown eyes and light brown hair. Many kids at her school consider her attractive. She is usually dressed in school uniform.

She is a very kind young woman who generally cares for others, a gesture she acquired as a child. After the collapse of the school building she acquired partial amnesia and became somewhat distracted.

appearsIn.title: Can You Just Die, My Darling?

name: Toshirou Kamiya
description: Toshirou, a young man suffering from poverty, discovers a glimmer of hope through Transfloration. After undergoing the surgery, he can now hear the voices of spirit blossoms.

name: Yomiko Hourai
description: An employee of the government- run Transflora Medical facility and a childhood friend of [Toshiro](https://anilist.co/character/305110/Toshirou-Kamiya)'s. She loves eating more than anything.

name: Ii
description: The Nonsense User, a boy that drastically plays down his abilities, yet inevitably solves any mystery he encounters. Ii is an abnormal person. A "defective product." Unable to express much emotion, he is often seen with a neutral expression; however, Ii is able to express some emotion in some circumstances. At the beginning of his second year in junior high, he joined the ER3 System and went to Houston in America for 5 years and later returns to Japan at the age of 19. Upon return, he begins to attend Rokumeikan University in Kyoto. Ii is "friends" with [Tomo Kunagisa](https://anilist.co/chara

name: Tomo Kunagisa
description:
The technological genius Blue Savant and heiress of the Kunagisa household. Tomo is a young girl who is well versed in computer engineering, capable of crafting computers that are much more powerful that anything on the market. Most known for being the leader of Team, a collection of genius hackers. Due to Tomo's renowned computer genius, she is invited to Wet Crow's Feather Island by Iria Akagami. Tomo brings Ii with her, to help her get around. 

Tomo stands out like no other, having blue hair and eyes due to recessive genes. Her hair may get even darker if she refuses to wash it, becoming u

name: Ki-Bong Kim
description: He was trapped in the Awakening Test for 3000 years.

name: Kira Aso
description: Kira Aso is only interested in painting. She doesn't have many friends and she is extremely shy. She lives with her mother, because her father died. One day she meets Rei Kashino, a well known womanizing slacker. Kira is entranced by Rei's beauty and expressions, and decides to paint him.

name: Rei Kashino
description: An extroverted playboy, Rei rides motorcycles in a professional circuit. He only entered high school because he made a deal with his father that if he did he could move out of the house. He and his father do not get along. He had a twin brother, Sei, who committed suicide the day before their birthday.

name: Gorilla
description:
The protagonist featured in _1-nichi Go ni Shinu Gorilla_, who is shown to be a gorilla, and has stated he will die the next day.
He then unfortunately perishes as had been stated in the first chapter.

name: Zheng Luo
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Eye Color:__ Gold
__Age:__ Unknown

Luo Zheng is a faithful and loyal friend and family member who treats others with as much compassion as is shown towards himself. Reacts vengefully and aggressively towards those who would mistreat his friends, family, or himself. Takes pride in his accomplishments in a way that is borth humble and visible, he would also go through any lengths for his little sister Luo Yan .

He was the young master of the previous head of the Luo Clan, After the death of his father the Zheng branch of the Luo Clan became mistreated by the rest of the clan

appearsIn.title: Principles of Heavens: Zen’s Cultivation of Immortality

name: Suzu Kanade
description: An Ayakashi Maiden who is the childhood friend of [Matsuri Kazamaki](https://anilist.co/character/175063/). She is one of few who can see ayakashi, and is often very friendly to them. However, her maiden status makes her a target for ayakashi with ill intentions.

name: Matsuri Kazamaki
description: A young boy who, along with his childhood friend [Suzu Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/174838/), can see ayakashi (a type of spirit). After he learned about Suzu's status as an Ayakashi Maiden from his grandfather, he became an exorcist ninja in order to protect her from harm.

name: Shirogane
description: A powerful ayakashi and the king of the ayakashi. He is after Suzu Kanade, wanting to consume her to increase his power.

name: Koemushi
description: A weird creature who calls itself "Dung Beetle" (Coemushi) and becomes the children's tutor after Kokopelli's disappearance. It is able to communicate verbally, and is usually very sarcastic. It responds to the children's call, which includes Kana even though she didn't sign the contract. It is able to teleport the children, as well as others from the outside world to the cockpit, and vice-versa. However, it cannot teleport directly between two places, and must go through the cockpit beforehand. Between battles, it can be seen conversing with an unknown entity.    In the anime, is revealed tha

name: Kunihiko Moji
description: A boy whose great intuition helped some of the previous pilots to defeat their enemies. Moji was kind and insightful, often ready to give advice and wisdom to his comrades when they needed it. The other children often came to him for advice. He had two childhood friends: a girl named Tsubasa, and a boy named Nagi, who had a heart disease. Upon checking, Moji found out that his heart was a perfect match for Nagi. After his victory, Moji has Dung Beetle transport him to a hospital where Nagi could receive his heart. His chair was a plastic chair with a metal frame back that curved around into a

name: Daiichi Yamura
description: Daiichi was a hard-working and responsible boy despite his gruff "no-nonsense" exterior. He dedicatedly took care of his three younger siblings: Yoshi, Futaba, and Santa. He accepted this task because their mother had died much earlier, and their father abandoned them for unknown reasons three years ago. Their uncle on their father's side made up for his brothers disappearance by renting a home for the four siblings to live in, and paying for all expenses. Daiichi earned his keep by working as a mail and newspaper boy, and for his uncles landscaping business on his days off. He chose to live s

name: Maki Ano
description: The adopted daughter of an anime otaku, she was expecting a baby brother. Her battle begins the night after her mother enters labour. During the battle, she discovers that the robots that they have been fighting are in fact piloted by humans of Alternate Universes, and that the battles are the method for choosing which ones survive, and which ones don't. With every victory, 10 billion people from another universe die. As she finishes her battle, she uses Zearth's powers to see the birth of her baby brother. In the manga her chair is a baby cot, but is changed to a rocking chair in the anime ve

name: Mako Nakarai
description: Nakama was a girl who focused all or her energy on living honestly and being an active benefit to the community in hopes that others would see her as a responsible and dependable person. Despite this, the well-known fact that her mother is a prostitute and her humorless, over-responsible attitude left her no friends. Ever since elementary school any kind of hatred or dishonesty tortured her, so much that she couldn't even raise a clenched fist at all of the kids who bullied her, constantly having to keep to her duty and not protest in the slightest. Regardless, she looked up to her mother, and

name: Kanji Yoshikawa
description: Jun's schoolmate and friend. Before his fight begins, he reveals to Jun that despite seeing him hurting Kana, he did not intervene because his sister asked him not to. He also reveals to him a secret that makes Jun start to change his point of view about her, and asks him to watch out for Machi. Kanji's opponent is by far one of the strangest who appeared in the manga as it first launches itself into the sky then lands in a very far away place - Hawaii to be exact, then starts to fire powerful shots to a cannon orbiting the Earth which redirect them at Zearth. After Japan attempts to defeat th

name: Chizuru Honda
description: After killing Kako Isao, she completed his battle. Chizu was relatively calm and a bit quiet, yet particularly disgusted by the one-track minds of her male classmates. Her chair was black and fancy, carefully designed, shapely, and looked very old. While at school Chizu was in love with her teacher, but was being deceived. He lured her into a date and then blackmailed her to being gang-raped by his friends. For this reason she began to carry a knife with her at all times. During the combat she revealed she was pregnant and used Zearth's power to kill all of the men who assaulted her except the

name: Masamitsu Seki
description: Masamitsu Seki is one of the officers who befriended the children and assumed one of the empty places in Zearth's group. He joined the military thanks to his fascination with Idol Defense Force Hummingbird.    During Kanji's battle, Seki sacrifices himself in order for Kanji to defeat the enemy robot, creating another empty seat in the group.  In the anime, Seki threatened Koemushi with a gun and gets his right arm cut off by him, when he teleported his whole body, except for the hand which was holding the weapon to another place. By the time he signed the contract along Tanaka, it was already

name: Kako Isao
description: Kako was a spoiled and self-centered coward with a severe inferiority complex. He acted as an errand boy for a group of bullies to avoid being the subject of their abuse, and his parents would let him get away with just about anything, much to his older sister's chagrin. Kako’s only "friend" was Kirie who also went to his school. Kako would constantly boss Kirie around since it made him feel less like a loser especially since Kirie would take this abuse without complaint. Kako in fact made Kirie accompany him to the nature school for this very reason. It was here that Kako developed a strong c

name: Waku Takashi
description: Waku was an energetic and confident young boy who acted like a stereotypical shōnen main character. He was previously a talented soccer player and is considered popular. He wanted to become a professional player and his friends thought he had the talent for it. However, he found out that his salary-man father was a soccer player just like him in his youth and even played at the national level. The fact that someone just like him didn't make it shook Waku's resolve and he stopped playing soccer. If he had not quit the team he wouldn't have been at the summer class and become a pilot. He was cho

name: Ran Uruma
description:
Ran is a young and willful girl with too much power and too little wisdom.

She is a big fan of Mr. Pudding, a five-minute anime that airs on weekday evenings. She likes oden, morning glories, her family, her friends, knitting, her Mr. Pudding doll and her science class. Meritocracy is valued by the sorcerers, and as a child Ran was picked on for being unable to control her own powers.

name: Yuzuru Shino
description: __Voiced by__: Jun Fukuyama (Drama CD)    A third-year high school student who entered Houka Academy though an archery scholarship. Despite his good looks and stoic air when he draws a bow during archery, his personality is careless and casual. Due to this, girls who ask him out become disappointed and dump him after realizing that he is not the person they thought he was.

name: Touji Seryou
description: __Voiced by:__ Nakamura Yuuichi (Drama CD)    A first-year high school student who is part of the archery club though he does not attend practice very often. On Mondays, he will go out with the first person who confesses to him. However, at the end of the week, he will say: "I couldn't fall in love with you. Let's break up." Although he abruptly ends relationships like that, he retains his popularity because he will earnestly devote himself to his partner of the week.

name: Mitsuki Haruno

description: He's the ace of Hojo High's basketball team and [Mitsuki's](https://anilist.co/character/145889/Haruno-Mitsuki) childhood friend whom she thought was a girl but is actually a guy.

name: Mavis Vermillion
native: メイビス・ヴァーミリオン
description:
Mavis has very long, wavy, pastel yellow-blonde hair that reaches down to her feet with a small ahoge; large green eyes with no pupils; peachy skin and a slight child-like build. As a consequence of using an incomplete version of a grand Magic when she was thirteen to save [Yuri Dreyar](https://anilist.co/character/126471/Dreyar-Yuri), her body was no longer able to grow or mature from that point onwards. By the time [Precht](https://anilist.co/character/38961/Gaebolg-Precht) encased her body in a Lacrima, though, Mavis was biologically twenty-four.

Regarding her usual clothing, Mavis wears a

description:
Zera was a young girl who was the daughter of Zeeself, the Guild Master of Red Lizard. She died in X679 during Blue Skull's raid on Tenrou Island, but was used as Mavis Vermillion's illusionary friend until X686.

(Source: Fairy Tail Wiki)

name: Bianca De Arno
description: The eldest daughter of Gustave De Blanchefort of the prestigious Count Blanchefort family. Born in a noble status, firm and strict, educated and strong under a father who strictly observes the dignity and etiquette of a nobleman, she is a typical aristocratic girl with a keen personality.

name: Zachary De Arno
aliases: The Count of Blood and Iron
description: Lord Zachary is the count of Arno and madame Bianca's husband. He's known as the Count of Blood and Iron due to the way his silver hair glistens like a well-forged sword when soaked with the blood of his enemies on the battlefield.

name: Takeru Amaya
description: Amaya is one of the deuteragonists of Kamisama no Iutoori. He is violent, sadistic, brutal, blood-lusting, savage, and tyrannical individual who actively takes pleasure in the destruction of everything around him to an extreme extent.

name: Shun Takahata
description: The main character of the story. Finds life to be boring.

name: Akira
description: He was a boy who lives in a slum in the eastern city of Kugamayama. He is an orphan boy, and little is known about his childhood apart from the fact that he lived on the streets, and had to fend for himself for most of his childhood.

name: Alpha
description: Alpha is the first character to be introduced after series Protagonist Akira. She is a holographic AI, and is shown to have lime green hair, with blue eyes and a white/black dress. She can change her appearance at will, since she does not have a real body and is a hologram.

name: Roroa Amidonia
description:
__Race:__ Human

Roroa Amidonia is one of the female protagonist of Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki series. She is the daughter of Gaius Amidonia and the younger sister of Julius Amidonia.

(Source: Genjitsu Shugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki Wiki)

appearsIn.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom

name: Makio Koudai
description: A 35-year-old novelist who lives alone. She is deeply introverted, and has not communicated with her relatives for a long time due to arguments with her [mother](https://anilist.co/character/387235) and [sister](https://anilist.co/character/363293). Took in her sister's orphaned daughter, [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/189957).

name: Asa Takumi
description: After the passing away of her parents, she was adopted by her [Aunt Makio](https://anilist.co/character/171138). She now faces the hardship of adapting to a new environment, while sorting the emotions within herself.

name: Airi Sezaki
description:
She places heavy importance on her social standing, and puts lots of effort into maintaining popularity and a clean image around her classmates. However, most of this behavior is an act, as in private with Hinako she reveals her true self, putting Hinako through varying degrees of suffering for her own amusement, being an perverted, sadistic and manipulative person,
 Later on, she sinks into a deep depression and becomes highly dependent on Hinako. She then ends up running away with Hinako and trying to commit suicide with her.

name: Shiori Honda
description:
A high school English teacher. She was once an aspiring guitarist who was very passionate about starting a band; however, the one that originally sparked her interest, her brother, left her family in debt after taking a 20,000,000 Yen loan. His disappearance caused Shiori Honda to lose interest for the music industry and become a more recluse, timid, and plain individual. After being haunted by the ghost of Jimi Hendrix who noticed her musical talents, she is slowly re-discovering her passion for music.

After forming a contract with Jimi Hendrix, if Shiori doesn't become a guitar legend by th

name: Atou
description: The hero unit that [Takuto](https://anilist.co/character/183606/Ira-Takuto) used in "Eternal Nations". Determined to build a country again with Takuto.
