Natsuki is a shy boy with a good heart and dreaming nature. He's energetic, delusional, and like a girl when it comes to affairs of the heart. On the day his heart gets broken, he meets a mysterious girl who he can't stop thinking of.

name: Keiichi Katakura
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Class:__ 1-3

Keiichi is an boy who knows what he wants. And what he wants is the ultimate masochist girlfriend who he can realize his sadistic fantasies with. Will he ever find her? Or will he have to raise one from scratch? His older brother is a teacher in their school.

name: Tomoya Matsunaga
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm
__Class:__ 1-3

Tomoya is not only popular among girls, but he's also a player. A narcissistic guy who flirts and constantly and steals the hearts of many girls in his school. But what if there is one who doesn't fall for his good looks? He's a bit overprotective of his younger sister.

He falls in love with Mari and confesses to her in chapter 20. Before that he often tried to flirt with her already which she coldly rejected as his games but in his confession he tells her that he's serious and she also believes him.

name: Tsuyoshi Naoe
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm
__Class:__ 1-3

An otaku and unpredictable guy. Tsuyoshi looks like he's only interested in otaku stuff, so how come he's the only one of his group of friends with an actual, stable relationship?

name: Darcia
description:
Darcia is the Dark Elf mother of the protagonist, [Vandalieu](https://anilist.co/character/274306/Vandalieu). She worked as a D-class adventurer, before being assassinated. Thanks to her son, she is able to stay in the world of the living through one of her bone fragments.

Darcia has a soft and mellow personality, and acts my pace based on what thought is currently in her mind.

name: Vandalieu
description:
Vandalieu (formerly Amamiya Hiroto, D-01) is a person who attracts misfortune his entire life.

Vandalieu is described as having a soft personality. "He tends to prioritize his emotions and makes decisions without paying any regard to the benefits or losses to himself."

name: Satoshi Ideguchi
description: He is the catcher of the Saikyou Saitama Lycaons and he also notices Toua talents as he catches Toua's pitches.

name: Hiromichi Kojima
description: Kojima is the cleanup batter in the professional baseball team, Saikyou Saitama Lycaons. He is defeated by Toua during his time at the training camp as he challenged Toua to avenge his relief pitcher, Nakane. After his defeat, he goes into the forest to train himself mentally against Toua but as he is training he injures his wrist. Even with the injury he challenges Toua to a rematch with the bet that if he wins, he takes Toua's hand. He wins the match as he gets hit by the pitch making it a deadball, Toua admits defeat and Kojima makes Toua join the Lycaons. (source: wikipedia & mang

name: Toua Tokuchi
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (5’11")

Toua is a successful gambler, and a pitcher in the game One Outs. After losing a game of One Outs for the first time , he joins the Lycaons with an odd contract, the One Outs contract, that decides Toua's pay based on his performance. As the Lycaons' famed star pitcher, he can pitch entire games without giving up a single hit.

name: Emi Sawatari
description: A model student with perfect grades and impeccable social standing.

name: Chiharu Saeki
description:
Chiharu is a high-schooler who loves movies. He has good grades and looks and is very popular with girls.

 Since he was 7 that his mom liked him to dress him up as girl, much to his distress. When Wataru was ten he got separated from his family in the park, fell down and got hurt while dressed up as a girl. Wataru offered to help him out and told him he shouldn't do things he didn't want to do. Chiharu has been in love with him ever since.

name: Wataru Toda
description: Wataru is a high schooler who loves movies. He met Chiharu, a school colleague, in a movie related store, and both shared their love for "Black Flash", an underground production. From there, he started hanging out with Chiharu and going to the movie theater two or three times a month.

name: Megumi Saitou
description: A girl that moves in with Yokoi after having been inspired by his work as a mangaka.

name: Hijiri Sanagi
description: She has scopophobia, an excessive fear of being stared at.

name: Kengo Kousaka
description: A man whose compulsive tendencies make it impossible for him to keep a job.

name: Richard
description:
With a birth of great pain, Richard was born intersex (a general term used for various conditions in which a person is born with reproductive or sexual anatomy that doesn't seem to fit the typical definitions of female or male). Richard has heterochromia iridium, making his left eye yellow and right eye purple.


Richard's mother saw him as a monster and despised him. Leaving him to be loved by his father, who was oblivious to his wife's hatred. Richard himself is a tormented child, fearing abandonment and suffering from strange visions of Joan of Arc, who tells him that he is a demon to be fe

name: Henry VI
description:
Henry VI is the head of the House of Lancaster. A devout Christian who hates war and killing. He yearns to be a shepherd and meets Richard III in the forest, and they are drawn to each other without knowing each other's true identities. Henry VI is married to Margaret, and he is the father of Edward of Lancaster. Henry is most well-known as a cowardly man. However, this cowardice is mistaken as he hates war and therefore will not lead his armies, which leads his wife, Margaret, to do so for him.

He is also shown to be relatively weak in strength, and he often runs away from the castle in disg

name: Kurosawa
description: A run-of-the-mill guy stuck at his dead-end job. At the very least, he wants people to look up to him. Has pride in his physical strength from his long years doing manual labor.

Ryuki Gaoh is a mysterious individual who suddenly appeared wanting to enter the Kengan matches.

name: Nozomi Aizawa
description: A high school second-year. Aizawa works up the courage to confess to [Azuma-kun](https://anilist.co/character/132829/Azuma-Shirou), the guy she has had a crush on for so long, but things do not work out as planned. She is a somewhat optimistic girl with stalker-like tendencies.

name: Shirou Azuma
description: An argumentative boy who looks like a class representative, making his poor grades and hatred of studying shocking. He is ruled by logic and has four aunts, whose behavior left him with harsh opinions of women. He loves to read novels and even tries to write them himself.

name: Velou
description: Velou is a starry eyed young boy whose dream is to become a talented huntsman. Even though he isn't particularly good at hunting, he still tries his best to achieve his dream. He finally gets an opportunity to see how the real world of hunting is when the mysterious huntress Grimm comes to Kasoka Village to help exterminate the werewolf hiding nearby.

name: Grimm
description: Grimm is a huntress capable of transforming between an adult and a child version of herself, who works for the Hunters Guild.

name: Kai Miura
description: He is a boy who stands out due to his lemon colored hair and pierced ears, and he became the center of a group of popular people. He acts coldly to almost everyone, but for some reason he cares about [Uka.](https://anilist.co/character/182176/Uka-Ishimori)

name: Uka Ishimori
description: In middle school she was given the nickname "stone" and afterwards she became a withdrawn girl who had forgotten how to cry or laugh. By coincidence, she met [Kai](https://anilist.co/character/162041/Kai-Miura) after enrolling at Hachimitsu High School.

name: Haruko Hirukoma
description: Liliko is about twenty and has accomplished a lot in the world of beauty. She is a model, singer and actress but can´t handle a thing without her assistant Hada. Though almost everybody envies her she is nothing more than a visual lie.

description:
Isidor is a highly skilled swordsman and heir to the Bisconti family, one of the most prestigious ducal families in the Asteia Empire. He is described as one, if not the most handsome man of his time by both women and men. He has complete confidence in himself and his abilities. According to Deborah, he does not appear in the novel she knows.

Isidor is the main male protagonist. Besides being a skilled swordsman, he is a great mage and also the master of Blanche, an information guild. He doesn't appear in the original work under the name of Isidore but rather under his second identity, the Ma

description: Natsuo Ishidou is the series' main protagonist. She is naturally talented at everything she does. Having lived with this ability her whole life, she cannot understand why other people cannot do things which she can do. This has given her a condescending attitude against her opponents, who she goads and teases during their match and after Natsuo's inevitable victory. She is also ruthless when fighting, whether or not the fight is a serious one.  Natsuo has come to the realization that people with the ability to be the best without even trying have the hardest time, since they don't have anyone

name: Yuzuko Mawatari
description: Yuzuko is Natsuo’s main rival throughout the story. Born in Japan, she moved with her parents to Brazil. While there she became an exceptional MMA fighter under the training of Mario Cordeiro. She is the captain of the budding MMA club at the Natsuo’s high school and is close friends with Mario Cordeiro daughter, Ringi. It is two early fights with Yuzuko that drive Natsuo to become an MMA fighter. Yuzuko has no talent, but makes up for this limitation with pure tenacity and a single-minded focus on moving forward. As a result, Yuzuko often comes off as "creepy" by others, who are disturbed by

description: Fran Madaraki is an artificial creation and one of the most advanced, made by the greatest surgeon in the world, Dr. Madaraki Naomitsu. She's not human, but instead a creature akin to Frankenstein's Monster, and her body is able to add or lose pieces, like up to six arms or cut the lower half of her body without pain or danger. Fran has a fraction of the Dr's ability, but it's still able to raise the dead (If they have been dead less than 24 hours), create genetically altered creatures, rebuild complete human bodies in a matter of minutes and other medical miracles. She says that her abilities

name: Veronica Madaraki
description: Assassin bioweapon created by Dr. Madaraki for his own protection. In addition to her naturally high combat ability, she is trained in the handling of explosives and the setting of traps in the field. A large, X-shaped stitch marks her face. Because she was created after Fran, Veronica calls her “elder sister”.    She wields a huge guillotine blade in her right arm and a sharp sword in her left. She also has sharpened daggers sticking out of the pommel. She follows her own battle etiquette: “To murder while causing as little suffering as possible”. In opposition to Fran

name: Shou Iketani
description:
__ Height:__ 153 cm  

Shou Iketani is the tennis club captain and one year older than Utsumi and Yuki. Shou is the reason Utsumi joins the tennis club in the serial manga because he has a crush on her. In the one-shot version,​ he merely observes her playing tennis.

name: Yuki Kurokawa
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm  

Kurokawa Yuki is on the tennis team and the one who caught Utsumi watching them secretly. After being confronted by Utsumi, Yuki reversed the accusations right back at him, demanding a pure reason for his sneaky actions. Utsumi gives in to Yuki that he has a crush on the tennis club captain Shou. Knowing the situation, Yuki wanted to help... by tricking him into joining the tennis team.

name: Seiji Utsumi
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm  

Utsumi has a crush on Shou Iketani, the tennis club captain. He's content with just looking at his beloved senpai from afar until one day he is caught by Yuki, who then "forces" him to join the tennis club to impress Shou and help him win over her heart.

name: Manim
description:
Madam is the new wife of the village minister. She is initially seen as a beautiful bride, but then is suspected to be a fox when her husband falls sick and the Indangsu river  does not allow pass of ships. She is found and saved by Cheong in the river when she falls off a boat that her brother uses to catch 'the golden turtle' which they gift to the minister instead of a dowry. She invites Cheong to the mansion to help care for the minister, and the two begin to share a deep bond, becoming romantic over time. 

The minister's son and his subordinates blamed her for bringing 'the golden turtle

name: Sim-Cheong
description: Sim-Cheong is a beggar girl. She lost her mother when she was only 7 days old, and lives with her blind father, who she provides food for through her begging.

name: Makoto Ariga
description:
Makoto, known as Mako for short, is a trans girl who first appears when the cast is in sixth grade. She is Shuuichi's closest friend, and is an only child whose parents run a bakery.

Mako is unusually mature for her age. She's a calm and rational thinker with good listening skills, which helps her to give good advice to her friends, and to get along well with her peers. She is also a romantic who dreams about being in a relationship with a cool, adult man.

name: Saori Chiba
description: Saori, nicknamed Saorin, is a girl who is a fifth grader in Shūichi's class at the beginning of Hōrō Musuko. From early on, she takes an interest in encouraging Shūichi to cross-dress, even going so far as to buy him an expensive dress for his birthday which he later returns, much to her displeasure. Saori finds it difficult to associate well with most others, and as such has very few friends, though she becomes close friends with Shūichi. She tends to tell others what is on her mind, disregarding how others may take what she says. As Saori grows up, she gradually becomes more standoffish and

name: Shuuichi Nitori
description:
Shuuichi is a young trans girl who is one of two main protagonists. She is a fifth grader at the beginning of the series. As she grows up and hits puberty, she becomes increasingly concerned about the way her body is changing.

Shuuichi has an honest and dutiful personality that generally makes it easy for her get along well with others, though she can also be quite sensitive at times. She is often described as cute, and is able to pass as a girl due to her feminine appearance and physical build; she enjoys wearing cute clothes, which her friends encourage. Shuuichi later becomes interested in

name: Yoshino Takatsuki
description: Yoshino, the other protagonist, is a tall, masculine child who at the beginning of Wandering Son is a fifth grader in Shuichi's class. Otherwise known as Takatsuki-kun by their classmates, with an honorific used mainly with boys, Yoshino wishes to be a boy. Yoshino usually refrains from dressing in traditionally feminine clothes, such as skirts or dresses. Despite this, Yoshino's mother insists on buying such clothes for them. Shortly after becoming friends with Shuichi, Yoshino gets a boyish haircut, taking on the appearance of a boy their age, especially when Yoshino is dressed in a male sch

name: Keiichiro Katsuragi
description:
Keiichiro Katsuragi is a man of tradition, who is from a super elite family whose grandfather and father are both former Prime Ministers.
 What's more, the Katsuragi family has a "tradition" 
  In which boys are not allowed to have any sexual contact with girls until they turn 18!?

name: Yuuri Hasegawa
description: Yuuri is a sophomore at St. Margaret High School for Girls. She is a Gyaru who follows new fashion trends, but she falls in love with [Keiichiro](https://anilist.co/character/212825/Katsuragi-Keiichiro), who lives in a completely different world to hers.

description:

name: Beatrice
description:
The Golden Witch and Endless Witch. She is affectionately referred to as "Beato" (ベアト). A witch who has lived for over a thousand years, she is said to appear as a cloud of golden butterflies, and has the power to summon higher demons among the seventy-two pillars to serve her. It is said that humans can summon her to have their wishes granted in exchange for compensation, though she often acts whimsically. She is the one rumored to have given [Kinzo](https://anilist.co/character/14041/Ushiromiya-Kinzou) ten tons of gold and served under him as the alchemic advisor to the Ushiromiya family.

description: Kinzo's second child. Under normal circumstances, she would have lost her place in the Ushiromiya family when she married, though she managed to retain her name on the family register when she had her husband Hideyoshi adopted into the family and gave birth to Kinzo's first grandchild, George.  Eva is cheerful and mischievous, but also sinister and greedy. She is hostile towards her older brother Krauss, and rallies the other siblings against him in their fight for the family inheritance. She also looks down on Krauss's wife Natsuhi for not being related to the Ushiromiya family

description:
A high school senior of Haruna's who is a year older than her. He knows the ways to impress men from a girl's point of view. Thus, he becomes Haruna's coach to make her more popular among guys.

Despite being known as a hottie and being popular among girls, he does not acknowledge this fact. He is quite embarrassed about his popularity. He gets shy easily especially when he is praised.

During his childhood days, he was a difficult child. He never smiled in photographs. He does not like to be the centre of attention. Apart from that, he is cold and does not talk much. However, he is actually a

name: Haruna Nagashima
description: Shortly after entering high school, Haruna becomes determined to find a boyfriend under the influence of all the shoujo manga she reads. She accidentally meets Yoh after a failed attempt at being "picked up" by guys and asks him to coach her on how to be more attractive. After some prodding, Yoh finally accepts to teach her under two conditions; one: she mustn’t cry, and two: she cannot fall in love with him. She eagerly accepts, and the two start training. Yoh helps her on a day to day basis, giving her advice on what to wear every day and how to act around guys.   Haruna is a tomboy and star

name: Renako Amaori
description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")

At school, Renako acts bright and sociable. However, while she enjoys talking with her classmates, this is only a front, and her "true self" is gloomy and negative.

In middle school, Renako declined an invitation to go out with her classmates, causing them to reject her. Renako spent the rest of middle school as a hikikomori as a result of this. Because of what happened to her in the past, she has trouble declining invitations and requests from her classmates.

name: Mai Ouzuka
description:
**Height:** 167 cm (5'6")

Mai is gifted academically and athletically, and [Renako](https://anilist.co/character/196166/Amaori-Renako) describes her as the pinnacle of beauty. Mai is arrogant and forthright, owing to her status as the school's Madonna. Though she is polite in general, when she is alone with Renako, she is very open and persistent with her desires. She has a tendency to act on a whim. 

The day after meeting Mai, she confesses to Renako. Renako declines, but Mai persists. They both agree that when Mai wears her hair down, they are in "lovers mode," and when she ties it up, the

description:
**Height:** 165 cm (5'5")

Satsuki is a blunt, serious, and headstrong person. Despite her beautiful appearance, she has a cold personality and an unapproachable aura that makes it difficult to connect with her.

Satsuki lives in a run-down apartment and works part-time to support her single mother.

appearsIn.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...

name: Ajisai Sena
description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2")

She is sometimes referred to as an "angel" because of her easygoing personality.  Sena's parents frequently leave her home to care for her two younger brothers, Kou-kun and Kii-kun. Although she loves her brothers, she grows resentful of the restrictions it places on her freedom as she is left to look after them on a more regular basis.

appearsIn.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...

name: Kaho Koyanagi
description:
**Height:** 153 cm (5'0")

As the group's mascot, Kaho has a playful and fun personality. She enjoys making jokes and has the ability to control the mood of the group. She is referred to as "everyone's little sister" because of her childish personality.

Renako is later revealed to be Kaho's childhood friend. Renako was unable to remember who she was because her surname had been changed from Minaguchi to Koyanagi.

appearsIn.title: There's No Freaking Way I'll be Your Lover! Unless...

name: Ryang-ha Son
description: He is a hitman wanted by at least 20 organizations for singlehandedly taking down the Hong Kong triads. Since meeting [Chateau](https://anilist.co/character/157017), he stalks and brokers her information in exchange for spending time with her.

name: Chateau Dankworth
native: シャトー・ダンクワース
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Chateau is a newly recruited bounty hunter working for Ritzland Support. She is reluctant to trust [Ryang-Ha](https://anilist.co/character/157016/) and constantly rejects his romantic advances.

name: Nagyunn
description: Nagyunn is the main character in The Ember Knight. After his twin brother Najin is murdered he vows to avenge him and to do this he assuming Najin’s identity.

description: A girl from the Tang Dynasty.

**Height:** Roly-Poly
**Favorite Food:** Super Miracle Chrunchies

A kitty who loves his daddy. He follows his daddy everywhere... even into the bathroom, naturally. Fukumaru is a 1-year-old cat that, because of his appearance, is never adopted from a pet store and grows lonely until he gets adopted by [Kanda-san](https://anilist.co/character/129634/Kanda-Fuyuki).

(Source: Character Profiles, Vol 3)

name: Fuyuki Kanda
description:
**Height:** 180 cm
**Profession:** Music Teacher

A middle-aged cat fancier. He has long, narrow eyes, so when he is being quiet, he looks scary. He's had a complex about it since he was a boy. Kanda-san is the elderly man that adopted Fukumaru despite most people calling him Ugly. He likes soba noodles and fish.

Kanda-san adopted Fukumaru after presumably having lost his wife, who wanted to raise a cat since she was a young child.

name: Nanoha Aoba
description: She is secretly dating her best friend, [Chidori Fujimiya](https://anilist.co/character/210152/Fujimiya-Chidori).

name: Chidori Fujimiya
description: She is secretly dating her best friend, [Nanoha Aoba](https://anilist.co/character/210151/Aoba-Nanoha).

name: Eon Green
description: Eon Green is an immortal and has adapted herself to the N5S virus. She is parentless and lives with [Kozlov Grebnev](https://anilist.co/character/3973/Kozlov-L-Grebnev) in her grandfathers house in the MSCF in south district 17 of J9O. She has a super-regenerative healing factor. She is taken in to custody of the Public Health Department by a patrol officer. She carries some sort of spore in her that can turn all drones back to normal humans.

name: Zouichi Kanoe
description: Zouichi is a synthetic human created by the Toha Heavy Industries and is on a mission to find people that have adapted to the N5S virus. He meets [Eon Green](https://anilist.co/character/3974/Eon-Green) in the MSCF, Mass Security Containment Facility, in south district 17 of 9JO, where he has been dispatched. His weapon is similar to the Gravitational Beam Emitter in Blame!. He rides a 4000XLA Toha Industries Motorcycle. It comes equipped with a large rifle, possibly a coilgun, and an axe for close combat. His A.I. is [Fuyu Kanoe.](https://anilist.co/character/3969/Fuyu-Kanoe)

name: Kozlov L Grebnev
native: コズロフ・Л（レーフヴィチ）・グレブネフ
description: Kozlov is a bear that walks like a human and talks. He lived with [Eon Green](https://anilist.co/character/3974/Eon-Green) and tried to protect her when the patrol officer came to get her. He befriends both [Zouichi](https://anilist.co/character/3968/Zouichi-Kanoe) and [Nishu](https://anilist.co/character/3970/Nishu-Mizunoe) after a short unfriendly start with both. He saves the A.I. [Taira Hinoto](https://anilist.co/character/3972/Taira-Hinoto) from falling in to the hands of DRF. He loses parts of his body through the manga.

name: Nishu Mizunoe
description: Nishu is a female synthetic human that makes contact with [Kozlov Loewic Grebnev](https://anilist.co/character/3973/Kozlov-L-Grebnev) in former Izhits Co. and is on a mission to find Loew Grigorievic Grebnev, one of original founders of the DRF, Data Recovery Foundation. She has similar weapons and vehicle to [Zouichi.](https://anilist.co/character/3968) Her A.I. is [Shin Mizunoe.](https://anilist.co/character/3971/Shin-Mizunoe)

name: Jun-U Choi
description: Appearing at the start of the series as a timid, gloomy and lonely guy, Jun-U thinks of himself as an 'outsider' and rarely ever felt that he fit in with the others at school. During the progression of the series, he is described as a selfless person, as he always goes out of his way to help the ones dearest to him.

name: Ha-Min Park
description: Ha-Min usually an intimidating demeanor but shows empathy for those that are close to her. She is extremely intelligent and is the top-scoring student in the school due to the fact that she spends lots of time at cram school. Ha-Min is also quite popular but she usually ignores anyone that tries to talk or befriend her because she doesn't care about expectations of her. It also makes her uncomfortable to interact with strangers. She is very observant as well, solving mysteries using her quick wit and intellect.

name: Tae-Yang Lee
description: Tae-Yang is reckless and hot-tempered, but also will swallow his pride if he thinks he has made a mistake. He is shown to trigger at the slightest irritation, and won't hesitate to beat someone up, even when he's outnumbered. He is called "reliable" by Joowoon because of his dedication to help his friends. Even though he is always ready for a fight, he won't start fight for no reason.

name: Yu-Ri Lee
description: Jun-U's friend from middle school

name: Ro-Sa Park
description: __Superpower:__ Superhuman-strength and Teleportation.

name: Do-Ryeong Han
description:
__Superpower:__ Telekinesis and Self-regeneration

Member of the SP police.

name: Ma-Ri Baek
description:
Ma-Ri Baek is the main female protagonist in the webtoon. She is a vampire but regularly attends school without any of her schoolmates knowing her true identity. Ma-Ri is shown to be very quiet and lacking in emotion. She also turned down multiple boys without hesitation, thus earning her the nickname "Ice Princess".

She seems to have had friends in the past, but whenever her true identity as a vampire was revealed, no one wanted to stay with her since they feared they'd be bitten. This resulted into Ma-Ri being regarded as a monster, which is probably why she keeps her real identity to herse

name: Jae-Min Jeong
description: Jae-Min Jeong is the main male protagonist. He is a handsome teenager who is known to be the school's most popular student. Jae-Min seems to have a hatred for women and acts very cold towards them. At one time, he even yelled at them just because they touched him.

name: Itsuki Ayukawa
description: Ayukawa is a 26-year-old architect who has been in wheelchair since a traffic accident during his 3rd year at the university.

name: Tsugumi Kawana
description: Kawana is an employee at the interior design company "Cranberries." She is a kind, shy and affectionate young woman who was in love with Ayukawa in high school but never confessed.

name: Dae-Gun Kwon
description:
Dae-Gun Kwon is a high school dropout who used to work in a convenience store.

After beating up some miscreants during his shift at the convenience store it is revealed that he was the leader of Incheon area which was said to be in the age of blood, was wiped in just a week by him alone. 

He is then later selected as the lead of a project called 'Iljin in charge of Iljin' where he was going to be used to tackle and stop the problem of bullying in Geumryong High School.

name: Fan Mo
description:
__Race:__ Human

Mo Fan is a 16-year-old high school student. In his first awakening, he awakened two elements which was a rare occurrence yet no one saw.
Originally Mo Fan was a genius high school student that came from a world where magic does not exist. 
After he received an old black pendant from an old man that was guarding the rear gate of his school and took a nap in the mountain behind the school, at that moment Mo Fan travelled to another world where the magic existed. All the people he knew including his classmates, his teachers, even his family did not change, but there is one thing

name: Luca
description: He was raised by a band of mercenaries, where he served as their bugler. After being saved by the Pontiff, he agrees to become the leader of the Papal States' branch-hexed, in exchange for help in achieving his dream of becoming a maestro. His power allows him to turn sound into light, which he uses in battle to command troops.

appearsIn.title: The Bugle Call: Song of War

name: Zoe
description: A branch-hexed under Luca's command and the Papal States' trump card. She has a mutual affection for Luca. She believes the Pontiff is her mother. Her power allows her to obtain her future self's strength, but she falls asleep afterwards as a consequence. She is 27-years-old but has the mind of a 9-year-old due to overuse of her power.

appearsIn.title: The Bugle Call: Song of War

name: Touka
description: The Pontiff is the head of the Spire Church and ruler of Termi, the Holy Capital. He rallies and manages the Branch-hexed, including Luca. His goal is to protect their Spire, defeat the Erin Empire, and kill a Branch-hexed named The Garland.

appearsIn.title: The Bugle Call: Song of War

name: Clyde Barrow
description: A smooth and intelligent thief who RJ meets after setting out on his own. The two meet after Clyde hears what he describes as an eerie sound from RJ's guitar. Clyde picks RJ up, bringing him along to use as distraction in order to rob an old man during a party. Clyde is based on the real Clyde Barrow, a famous gangster in American history who acted along with his lover, Bonnie, during the Depression era.

appearsIn.title: Me and the Devil Blues: The Unreal Life of Robert Johnson

name: Robert Johnson
description: He always dreamt to be a talented blues-man, instead of working on plantations. And one day his dreams came true. But what was his price?

appearsIn.title: Me and the Devil Blues: The Unreal Life of Robert Johnson

name: Niina Miyamoto
description: [Uehara](https://anilist.co/character/324905/Yuuki-Uehara)'s classmate who enters into a fake relationship with him so they can write better manga.

name: Yuuki Uehara
description: A high school student that dreams of becoming a mangaka.

name: Plue
description:
The strange creature that [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/3749) discovered, Plue is the Rave Bearer, and is able to sense the presence of the other Rave Stones. Plue's nose also has the ability to destroy dark brings. Plue is quite fond of sweets - especially lollipops. Plue hates pudding. He has the ability to utilize the rave of conflict which powers him and Haru up.

Plue has since shown up in Fairy Tail as one of [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186)'s stellar spirits (Nicola, Canis Minor) and quickly named Plue and has been noted to only agree to be summoned on Tuesdays, Wednesday

name: Hamrio Musica
description: Musica is the leader of a band of infamous thieves known as the Silver Rhythm gang that reside in Punk Street. He owns and pilots a flying ship called the Advent. He has long brown hair (in the beginning of the series, but later wears it in a shorter, black, spiky style), has three distinctive piercings above his left eyebrow, and is always wearing a skull necklace that he uses as a weapon in conjunction with his silverclaiming abilities. He first meets Haru Glory and Elie in Punk Street when Haru is there looking for Musica the Blacksmith to fix his broken sword. Elie mistakes him for Musica

name: Elie
description: Elie is one very lively, bubbly, optimistic girl whose usual outfit is a tight fitting midriff top and a mini skirt. She has a hot temper, as shown when she destroyed a casino for a bet loss. She first met Haru Glory at the casino when she was about to win roulette but Plue jogged the table and moved the ball. She ends up joining them after Haru saves her. When she revealed to Haru that she was actually looking for her memories and is in search of someone who can tell her what her name is, when her birthday is, or who her parents are, Haru promised her that they will find it together. Elie has

name: Bony The Starfish
description: Bony is a rather small starfish that has been serving loyally under Flemia for many years. Bony is generally seen as your average starfish, but with a mustache and two small curly hairs on each side of his head. During the beginning of the Star Song Festival, Bony would be the one to introduce the Queen of Mildesta, Flemia; this would also be the first time Bony was shown in the series. Throughout the Star Song Festival, Bony would generally be seen resisting death while Plue continuously tried to eat him. After Haru and the others effectively say their final farewells to the people of Mildest

name: Ruby
description: Ruby is a pink penguin (sentinoid, penguin-type) who owns a massive floating casino. Ruby likes to use his wealth to buy rare treasures. When he learns Drew is using his cash for evil ends, he is almost killed by Drew, but Haru saves him, and he decides to join his side. He is the only person to know who would be the third Rave Master if Haru dies. Ruby also has a tendency to blab out plans that the Rave Warriors have decided on during battle, making them entirely useless. He recently learned how to use "Wind" magic from the bell given to him by his father. The bell was actually name

name: Belnika
description: Belnika is a kind girl and has a personality very similar to Elie only much more shy. She was experimented on so that she could have magical powers.

name: Haru Glory
description: Haru is a teenage boy who grew up on a small island called Garage Island. His father left him with his mother and sister to find Rave when he was young. Soon after, his mother died and he was left alone with his sister.  His destiny takes a turn when Shiba gives him the Rave stone, passing on the powers of the Rave Master.  He first fished Plue the Rave bearer out of the ocean, and soon met Shiba, the Rave Master. Haru was chosen as the second generation Rave Master by Rave. When he realizes the true threat that Demon Card are to the world, he then promised Shiba that he will complete the coll

name: Griffon Kato
description: Called Griff by his friends, he mostly praises Plue and calls him 'Master Plue'. He looks like a strange blue blob, with eyes and arms. He is close to Plue in size but with the ability to speak. Griff has limited shape-shifting abilities; such as inflating portions of his body and elongating his limbs. He is also a voyeuristic character, and in a couple of episodes he is seen spying on Elie. He is the cartographer of the group. He has been described as a pervert.

name: Java Let Dahaka
native: ジャヴァ・レット・ダハーカ
description: Let is a Dragonrace, a race of dragon people who reside in the Mystic Realm. When Let was first introduced, he was an evil warrior who worked for Demon Card as a guardian for King. He only wanted to fight until Haru defeated him and showed him the path of justice. His initial appearance in the story is of a human with a lizard like face. In the fight against Jegan he performs Dragon trial and takes the appearance of a human. Soon, he joined Haru in hope of bringing peace to the world.

name: Julia Line Dragoon
native: ジュリア・ライン・ドラグーン
description: Julia is Let's girlfriend, somewhat of a feisty blond who's loud, rowdy, and not above beating people up to get her way, which is a polar opposite to the cool and calm Let. She can be usually found at a bar and can turn into a dragon the same as Let. a A sisterly figure to Haru's party.  Julia in her dragon form was under the control of Jegan back then. As Jegan loves her and witness her failed the dragon ritual, he put a dark bring on her to keep her by his side.

name: Seiji Sanada
description: A 27-Year-Old office worker who finds himself in his younger self back in his second year of high school. He gets a second chance to confess his feelings towards his World History Teacher Hiiragi Sensei.

appearsIn.title: I Time-Traveled and Confessed to My Teacher Crush

name: Haruka Hiiragi
description: Haruka was Seiji's World History Teacher back in High School. He had a crush on her but never confessed at the time. After being given a second chance to confess, she reciprocates his feelings.

appearsIn.title: I Time-Traveled and Confessed to My Teacher Crush

name: Kazuhiko Amamiya
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm

A police detective known to his colleagues as Yousuke Kobayashi; an inoffensive family man tracking down a serial killer who mutilates his victims by severing their limbs. When the killer sees Yousuke on television he claims to recognize something in the detective and mutilates Yousuke's girlfriend. Yousuke eventually tracks down the killer at which point a new personality called Shinji Nishizono, an arrogant and callous psychopath, emerges and shoots the killer.

From this point onward, the personality of Yousuke is replaced by Kazuhiko Amamiya, a cool-headed, serious crim

name: Miwa Isono
description: Miwa is the younger sister of Machi. She is initially introduced as a schoolgirl with a forceful personality who occasionally helps Machi and Amamiya in their cases. As the series progresses, she becomes more important as revelations about her role in the conspiracy that runs through the book are revealed.     She is later revealed as a new generation bar-coder who carries a crucial alternate personality for the formation of Lucy Monostone. Her last seemingly important role was to transfer the personality of Kazuhiko Amamiya to Nishizono Tetora.

name: Machi Isono
description: An intelligent female criminologist who runs a private consultancy firm. She employs Kazuhiko Amamiya upon his release from prison and invites him to live in the large apartment which serves as home to herself and her sister as well as the headquarters of her business.

name: Tetora Nishizono
description: In appearance, a young teenaged version of Kazuhiko Amamiya, Tetora Nishizono also carries the psychopathic personality of Shinji Nishizono, although the personality of Shinji is far more dominant in Tetora.

name: Jeong-Min Choi
description: A viciously bullied, and depressed high school student from a poor and abusive family. She has a good heart but when at her wit's end, she can take desperate and dangerous actions.

name: Si-Yun Baek
description: A mysterious man who enters Jeongmin's lucid dreams.

name: Yun-Jae Kim
description: He is kind to his comrades and friends, but he is cruel and merciless to enemies. He is calm and quick to adjust to situations and also won't hesitate to kill people that try kill other "innocent" players.

name: Ikebe Kyoto
description: A former member of the baseball team who had once made it to Koshien. Though he seemed uptight and strict at first, often lecturing Kawato over the smallest details, he later warms up to Kawato. When the team starts playing again, Ikebe becomes their coach, lending his expertise.

name: Tomochika Wakana
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm
__Position:__ Catcher
__Throw:__ Righty / Righty
__Throwing record:__ 97 m

A foul-mouthed first-year, who drifts through his life without passion. From baseball, he gets a newfound passion to live his life and chase a dream with his friends.

name: Murayama Yoshio
description: former captain of the baseball team from 43 years ago, when the team went to Koshien. He harbors a resentment for the current baseball team as he views them as tarnishing the legacy he left behind, and is willing to do anything to get them all expelled. However, after witnessing their first game against Yoga Daiichi, he starts to regard the baseball team more positively. When Yoga Daiichi's coach threatens to press charges of assault against Kawato for hitting him during their game, Murayama takes the blame for Kawato and resigns.

name: Tetsuro Yufune
description:
__Height:__ 186 cm
__Position:__ First Baseman
__Throw:__ Righty / Righty
__Throwing Record:__ 100m

Member of the baseball team.

description:

__Position:__ Right Fielder
__Throw:__ Lefty / Lefty
__Throwing record:__ 115 m

A skilled player who was also well-known in middle school and dreamed of being able to compete in Major League Baseball. At first, he seemed arrogant, claiming he only needed high school to learn English and refusing to join the baseball team as he viewed them beneath him. However, he was practicing with a university team in secret, something Yagi and Aniya accidentally found out. When he was convinced to join the team, he discovered they were all as or even more talented than he was, leading hi

name: Kouichi Kawato
description: Kouichi Kawato is a 24 year old single and an enthusiastic modern Japanese teaching teacher. He is accepted at the Futagotamagawa Gakuen High School and is assigned to class 1-B. Little did he know that all of the members of the baseball club reside in this class and that they gained delinquent status after the school and tournament expulsion.

name: Toru Mikoshiba
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm
__Position:__ Second Baseman
__Throw:__ Righty / Righty
__Throwing record:__ 83 m

The team's captain. Though non-violent and intelligent, he is often affected by nervousness and insecurity. He is often emotional and cares deeply for his teammates and their coach.

name: Minoru Soramoto
description: Minoru is a high school boy with light brown hair and purple eyes, he is a simple and normal person, but sensible and realistic. Because his parents abandoned him and leaving him with all their debts, he now lives with the next door neighbour, who paid all his debts and invited Minoru to live with her in her apartment. Now she spoils him by filling him with luxuries, much to his annoyance, because he is afraid of being turned into a good-for-nothing who always has to depend on her. He is in the basketball club of his Institute, although he does not stand out too much. Sometime after he starts

appearsIn.title: She's Adopted a High School Boy!

name: Shiori
description:
**Height:** 160 cm**Age:** 26**Occupation:** Mystery writer under the pen name **Michiko Nariose**.

At first, Shiori is [Minoru](https://anilist.co/character/147620/Soramoto-Minoru)'s neighbor, who decides to take him in her apartment after he was abandoned by his parents, in addition to paying off the debts left to him. She feels an obsessive but at the same time innocent love for Minoru, to the point where she cannot touch him or get very close to him, since according to her, she is happy enough breathing the same air that he breathes. Onee-san always spoils Minoru, granting him a dream lif

appearsIn.title: She's Adopted a High School Boy!

name: Tamahiko Shima
description: A young man born into a wealthy family in Meiji 38. A year before the manga starts, he was in a car accident that resulted in his mother dying and the loss of complete use of his right arm. He was given his family's mansion in Chiba, and a bride was purchased to assist him for ¥200,000.

name: Yuzuki Tachibana
description: Tamahiko's bride. She was purchased for ¥200,000 by Tamahiko's father.

name: Soichiro Arima
description:
Smart, attractive, athletic, and talented like Yukino, Soichiro Arima becomes Yukino's rival at school. Very handsome and popular, Soichiro excels at kendo and becomes a national champion. He is at first smitten by Yukino, unaware that she secretly hated him and constantly tried to compete with him. After unwittingly discovering that Yukino is not the model student everyone thinks she is, Soichiro blackmails her into doing his school work so he can spend more time with her. After resolving the issue and becoming each other's first true friend, they eventually fall in love.

Arima has alot of i

appearsIn.title: Kare Kano: His and Her Circumstances

name: Yukino Miyazawa
description:
Smart, attractive, athletic and talented, Yukino Miyazawa appears to be the model student. Both her male and female peers express their admiration for her, often asking her for help and commenting about her model features and characteristics. 

However, her "perfect" exterior hides the fact that everything she does is done solely to receive praise from others. She has been this way since she was a little girl - a self-professed "queen of vanity", Yukino once practiced playing her recorder until she vomited blood. With all this praise, however, she never realized that she never had a real frien

appearsIn.title: Kare Kano: His and Her Circumstances

name: Yuuma Mukai
description:
**Height:** 170 cm (5'6")

Mukai Yuuma is the main protagonist of Real Account Part II.

name: Marble
description: The organiser of the death games and mascot for Re-Aca.

name: Ataru Kashiwagi
description:
The protagonist of the first part.
It is later revealed that he is actually Kashiwagi Yuuma, the older brother of Kashiwagi Yuri and Ataru's twin brother, and had swapped places with him during the accident.

name: Koyori Kanda
description: A third year middle school student that loves cats.

name: Ayame Kamijou
description:
**Height:** 161 cm

The female protagonist of the second part.
