description:
__Height:__ 188cm (6'2")

Kartazen Empire's Second Prince. Befitting the prestige of one granted the Golden Blessing, he has everything from looks, to wealth, to outstanding swordsmanship.

name: Rosentine Arzen
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4'')

Daughter of the duke of Argent with the ability to see ghosts. In her past life, she was able to see ghosts as well and got bullied severely because of it.

name: Touka Scott
description: Touka is the main character in the Yuusha ga Shinda! manga. He's a farmer from Cheza village, the same as his childhood friend, Yuna Yunis. Touka has a thigh fetish and loves putting kneesocks on vegetables he harvests to engage his fantasies. Touka's simple life changes when a demon attacks his village. Touka digs a pitfall trap and baits it with cooked bacon in order to kill the demon and protect the village. However, the demon dislikes bacon so it continues to destroy the village until the Hero arrives and defeats it. The hungry Hero is lured into the pitfall trap by Touka's bacon and falls

name: Sion Breydan
description: A famous hero who saved the world from monsters. He is accidentally killed at the start of the series.

name: Anri Haysworth
native: アンリ・ヘイズワース
description: Anri is one of the companions of the Hero. She is a necromancer. After the Hero's death, Anri transfers Touka's consciousness into the Hero's body so Touka can continue the Hero's work.

name: Yuna Yunis
description: Yuna Eunice is from Cheza Village and she is Touka's childhood friend. She has a crush on the Hero and she considers Touka a pervert.

name: Kyle Ozment
description: Kyle is one of the companions of the hero. After the hero's death he attempts to take his place as hero.

name: Esel Borgnine
native: エセル　ボーグナイン
description:
Ethel's first appearance is in front of Hell's Gate in chapter 1. She's an infamous bandit and master trap maker. She's 29 years old.

Ethel "trained" Touka in the art of trap making and survival tactics following the end of the war between the Allard Kingdon and Farom when demons terrorized the Northern continent (3 1/2 years prior to the main story line). As a result, Touka refers to her as his teacher or master.

Ethel aligns herself with the necromancers seemingly aiming for a similar goal, though she still helps Touka's group when possible.

She seems to be attached to Touka and often won

name: Shuri
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

The youngest son of the Emperor, he rules over Saikoku (western Japan) which includes Chugoku, Shikoku and Kyuushuu. In the early parts of the story Shuri stands out as brutally cruel to those who do not obey him, because he is responsible for the destruction of Byakko Village and the murder of [Tatara](https://anilist.co/character/17180/Tatara). Later he meets [Sarasa](https://anilist.co/character/4330/Sarasa), unaware that they are enemies, and falls in love with her.

Though he is merciless to his enemies, Shuri is a capable ruler and very proud of his realm. He has a bi

name: Sarasa
description: The protagonist of this series. She takes the name of her murdered twin bother Tatara, who was known as the child of fate. As Tatara, she wields the sword of Byakko and leads the survivors of Byakko Village. Even among her allies few people know she is a girl.  Sarasa hopes to create a land that is fertile, full of flora, and free of strife. Though she is quick to cry and psychologically weak in some respects, over the course of the story she develops undeniable skills in leadership and swordplay, and becomes the central figure of the Tatara Army.  Because of visiting hot springs she has met a

name: Jin Haiba
description: He's a high school physics teacher. His students tease him about being lazy and smelling of nicotine.

name: Mikoto Ochiai
description: Top of the class. When she wants to jump off the school roof, her physics teacher [Jin Haiba](https://anilist.co/character/172764/Haiba-Jin) hurries to her rescue and asks her: "Love me before you die." Her feelings for the sloppy teacher begin to rise.

name: Cub
description: A small-time peddler and heavy addict. Used to any kind of hallucinogenic trip, he is able to feel the happiness through the ecstasy of the drug, while at the same time hypocritically hating who gave birth to that society that has forced him to live this way.

name: Ango
description: A specialist in fire and water classes, and the main character of the chapters about Summer group A. He was the top student of the project, and a Ryou's rival. He and Ryou reluctantly respect each other. Ango is attracted to Ayu and friends with Koruri, Mayu, Nobara, and Shigeru.

name: Arashi Aota
description: A 17-year-old male who is Hana's (a member of Spring group) boyfriend. He was the first person who was kind to Natsu, and in general, he's a very nice guy. He loves to swim. "Arashi" means "tempest" and "Aota" means "green paddy".

name: Takahiro Aramaki
description:
The main character of the Winter group. Takahiro was a high-school baseball player, described as the best pitcher for 50 years, who led his team to victory at Kōshien. He is attracted to Mitsuru, but when he realizes she prefers Fubuki, he helps the two get together. Taka means "hawk"

After Fubuki and Mitsuru's deaths, Takahiro survives on his own for 15 years with two wolves named after them, which he raised from puppies, until he meets Arashi, Natsu, and Semimaru of Summer group B in the ruins of Tokyo. Later, he meets Hana of Spring group, who invites him to join them.

name: Natsu Iwashimizu
description: A shy, awkward, and withdrawn 16-year-old girl. Natsu has difficulty expressing herself and was always put down at home and bullied in school. She becomes essential to the team's survival by observing and writing down what they discover, such as which foods are edible. She has conflicting feelings for Arashi, knowing that he has a girlfriend. She is picked on or rather, teased by Semimaru frequently. Natsu means summer and iwashimizu means water trickling from rocks.

name: Hana Suguruno
description: Hana Suguruno is a 17-year-old female and the girlfriend of Arashi Aota. Overwhelmed with sadness when she woke up and thinking that she would never meet Arashi again, she almost let herself get killed in the harsh days. That is, until she found out that Arashi was possibly one of the survivors, and once again struggles to meet the love of her life. She is very beautiful, strong-willed and tomboyish, and learned everything about wilderness survival from her father. "Hana" means "flower" and "Suguruno" means "burning of fields to make way for new crops".  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kouji Kagami
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

A former weak villager who has reached the "highest level" that no one has ever reached before. Due to a past incident, he believes that demons and humans are the same, and currently spends his days earnestly saving money for a certain purpose.

name: Alice
description:
__Height:__ 144 cm

A demon girl born into the demon race who wishes to coexist with humans. Inheriting the ideas of her father, the Demon King, she begins to work towards realizing her ideals after meeting [Kagami](https://anilist.co/character/373000/Koji-Kagami), who does not hate demons.

name: Emma
description: Emma is quite an anomaly for her time; her glasses -- something a person of her station would never have afforded -- is symbolic of her character traits as well.  She can read, is educated somewhat, is reserved and even naturally refined, though this is often misread as "quiet" or "shy".  She is shy as well however, and speaks little of herself or indeed at all.    Orphaned, she started life on her own as a flower girl -- someone who sells flowers that they could find underfoot near the flower seller's stalls.  No living was remotely possible on what even a successful flower girl could make an

name: William Jones
native: ウィリアム・ジョーンズ
description:
The male protagonist of the story.

 He is the eldest son of the "House of Jones", a very wealthy merchant middle class family that is attempting to rise into the gentry. As his father's heir, he is under tremendous stress to not only take over the family business but also marry a girl from another wealthy family, preferably into the peerage. 

He developed feelings for Emma after their first meeting. He often intercepts her coming from Covent Garden on Regent Street. In the manga, William had told his father about Emma but his father had never seen Emma (different with the anime).      After

name: Alice Douglas
description: A noblewoman who takes Hanako on as her personal maid after finding out that she is trying to find Victor Franks. Alice fears that rumors surrounding her once having an affair with her governess will cause disgrace to her family.

name: Hanako Kujo
description: An aspiring novelist who travels to England in hopes of meeting her favorite author, Victor Franks. She instead finds herself as a personal maid to the noblewoman Alice Douglas.

appearsIn.title: My Life as an Internet Novel
My Life as an Internet Novel

name: Dan-I Ham
description:
Ham Dan-I is the main character of My Life as an Internet Novel. On the first day of her middle school life, she finds herself in the world of a web novel, where she is the plain childhood best friend and neighbor of beautiful Ban Yeo-Ryeong. Despite her persisting disbelief, she follows Yeo-Ryeong to Ji Jon Middle School, where she meets the Four Heavenly Kings of Ji Jon. Over time, she becomes actual friends with Ban Yeo-Ryeong and the Four Heavenly Kings.

Due to also believing that her friends are main characters in a web novel while she is a supporting role, Dan-I often sees herself as an

appearsIn.title: My Life as an Internet Novel
My Life as an Internet Novel

name: Chun-Yeong Yu
description: One of the four male leads of the web novel that Dan-I was transported to. He is quiet and seems difficult to get along with, but is caring in his own way.

appearsIn.title: My Life as an Internet Novel

name: Eun-Hyeong Kwon
description:
Kwon Eun-Hyeong is one of the Four Heavenly Kings of Ji Jon Middle School. He is the kind class president of Class 1-4. He is a model student, well-loved by teachers and students.
When Eun-Hyeong was five years old, his mother and Yoo Cheon-Yeong's mother got into a car accident on a rainy day. Cheon-Yeong's mother was driving and was unharmed, but the garbage truck that hit them demolished the passenger seat where Eun-Hyeong's mother was. This incident gave him trauma and created an intense dislike for rainy days.
His father works for Cheon-Yeong's father's company as a reporter.
Eun-Hyeong i

appearsIn.title: My Life as an Internet Novel

name: Akane Matsunaga
description: Akane is Aoi's twin sister and Seiji's niece. She is energetic and active. Has a cute smile and keeps looking forward. She can be told apart from her brother because her bangs look shorter than Aoi's.

name: Aoi Matsunaga
description: Aoi is Akane's twin brother and Seiji's nephew. He has great concentration skills, like an adult, yet he acts like a spoiled child. Aoi can be told apart from Akane because he seems to have longer bangs then her.

name: Seiji Matsunaga
description: Aoi and Akane's uncle and legal guardian. He's a television announcer. When the twins' mother died, their father(his brother) abandoned the twins in his care and ran away.

name: Shiharu Nakamura
description: Aoi and Akane's babysitter. She dreams to one day open a nursery. After her mother's death when she was five, she was taken care of by the child welfare establishment.

name: Camute de Volphric
description: He's the next emperor, who still needs to awaken his power as a Wolf descendant to ascend the throne.

name: Seo-Won Jin
description: Mr. Jin is a Maths Teacher at Garam Highschool. He has a fear of dogs.

appearsIn.title: A Good Day to be a Dog

name: Hae-Na Han
description: Miss Haena is a Literature Teacher at Garam Highschool. She has a family curse that turns her into a dog at midnight, this is triggered when she drunkenly kisses Mr. Jin after mistaking him for Mr. Lee

appearsIn.title: A Good Day to be a Dog

name: Jouji Habu
description:
A mountaineer with a natural talent for rock wall climbing who has conquered many difficult spots in Japan, including Mount Tanigawa's Ichinokurasawa demon slab.  However, because of his lack of recognition he was unable to travel abroad due of financial difficulties. He is uncooperative and very passionate and stubborn about mountain climbing, so his climbing partners wouldn't last long with him.

In 1979, he slipped and was injured while attempting to climb the Grand Jorasses alone in winter, but survived owing to his tremendous mental and physical strength. In 1984, he participated in the E

name: Makoto Fukamachi
description:
A 40 year old Japanese mountaineering photographer and climber. In 1993, he lost one of his companions in an Everest expedition and considered quitting mountain climbing. Shortly after, in a shop in Kathmandu, he finds a Pocket Autographic Kodak camera who supposedly belonged to George Mallory, an English mountaineer who went missing on Mount Everest during an expedition in 1924. 

While searching for the origin of the camera, he encounters a mysterious mountain climber who the nepalese call Bikha Sanp, who Fukamachi realizes may very well be [Jouji Habu](https://anilist.co/character/140187/),

name: Adolf Kamil
description: A Jewish-German boy who considers himself Japanese. Lives and works in his family's bakery in Kobe. As a child he accidentally learns the secret behind Adolf Hitler's ancestry after over hearing a secret meeting between  his father and other Jews. Later he is tasked with keeping the secret documents containing Hitler's Birth certificate.

name: Adolf Kaufmann
native: アドルフ・カウフマン
description:
A half-Japanese, half-German boy living in Kobe. His best friend Adolf Kamil is an Ashkenazi Jew living in Japan. 

Though he opposes the Nazis at first, he develops a hatred for the Jews during his stay in Germany and persecutes them fervently, only renouncing these views at the end of his life. He later joins the Sicherheitsdienst, then Gestapo, then the PLO.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Acetylene Lamp
description: First Appearance: 1948 – Jungle Kingdom  Acetylene Lamp is widely known for the running-gag candle that appears in the dent in the back of his head. This came about from the image of one of Tezuka’s childhood friends who has similarities that the character shares. Acetylene Lamp is one of Tezuka’s more used villains. He generally plays more important roles such as Inspector Tomobiki, a role in Black Jack and the widely best role, Acetylene Lampe from Adolf and Drake Lamp from the 2003 Astro Boy. He also shares lesser important roles such as the conductor of the Marine Express in Undersea Super

name: Sohei Toge
description: A Japanese reporter sent to Germany to cover the 1936 Olympics only to find his younger brother murdered. He then proceeds to investigate who killed his brother and why, leading him into a dangerous web of espionage during World War II. He was born and raised in Niihari, Ibaraki (now Tsuchiura).

name: Kuklo Mansel
description: Kuklo is the main protagonist of the Attack on Titan prequel Before the Fall. He is the son of Heath and Elena Mansel and miraculously survived when his heavily pregnant mother was swallowed whole by a Titan.

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall

name: Sharle Inocencio
native: シャルル・イノセンシオ
description: Sharle Inocencio is the daughter of the late merchant, Dario Inocencio, and the younger sister of Xavi.

appearsIn.title: Attack on Titan: Before the Fall

name: Jung-Woo Ha
description: The Main Protagonist of the Manhwa, _Reverse Villain_

name: Warumono-san
description: Leader of an evil organization set out to destroy Earth. On his days off, however, he indulges in plenty of Earth pleasantries, ranging from food to looking at his favorite animal, pandas.

name: Keiji
description:
A battle-hardened rooster who who travels from place to place, never wanting to be tied down (since he is a self-proclaimed "migratory species"). With exceptional strength and a mighty voice, he seeks to defeat any Kijū that he can find. 

He is bothered when women are brought to tears because of his actions, and has disdain for children. 
In the past, his sister was eaten by a ferocious Kijū. Ever since that day, he roams the land, searching for the Kijū that took her life so that he can exact vengeance.

name: Shiage Hamazura
description: Level 0 and former Skill-Out with his best friends [Komaba Ritoku](/character/40145) and [Hattori Hanzou](/character/39988). A former lackey, grunt, chauffeur, and informant of ITEM, he delved into Academy City's darkness and turned into an anomaly that disrupts Aleister Crowley's plans and calculations time and time again.

name: Eumenes
description:
An intelligent young boy from Cardia who has been troubled with a bad dream of a woman killing soldiers since childhood.

Much of his past is revealed during the series: he is, in truth, a Scythian, but is adopted by Hieronymus when his own family is massacred in a Greek slave raid. After a relatively happy childhood in Cardia, the events following Thrax's escape resulted in Hieronymus' death and the revelation of Eumenes' Scythian heritage, making him a slave. He is sold and shipped off Cardia, but soon after the slaves on the ship he is in mutinied before being sunk in a storm. Shipwrecked,

name: Philip 2-sei
description:
The king of Macedonia. Introduced in the story claiming to be Antigonus,a merchant from Perinthus, coming to Cardia to look for Hieronymus (the Younger). First meets Eumenes outside the gates of Cardia. Impressed by the latter's performance in gaining entrance to the city, he impetuously asks Eumenes to come and work for him. 

Philip is killed by Pausanias to Alexandre be the new king.

name: Ron Kamonohashi
description:
A talented detective and the student with the highest grades in Detective Training Academy BLUE's history. As his detective license was revoked after an incident five years ago, he has partnered up with [Totomaru Isshiki](https://anilist.co/character/193587/) to still be able to solve cases.

Later, it is confirmed that Ron Kamonohashi isn't the true culprit behind the Bloody Field Trip, but "Shachi". It was to ruin his detective life.

name: Totomaru Isshiki
description: Totomaru Isshiki, frequently shortened to Toto, is a police detective of the Metropolitan Police Department. He helps [Ron Kamonohashi](https://anilist.co/character/191539/) investigate cases by pretending to be the one who solves them.

name: Douki-chan
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm
__Special Skill:__ Delusions

Works at a Tokyo company. Does her job with diligence; the company's rising star. However, she's quite inexperienced in love. She worries daily about how to approach Douki-kun, her love interest.

name: Douki-kun
description: The coworker of Douki-chan, Kouhai-chan, and Senpai-san, all of whom has romantic interest in him.

name: Jung-Woo Hwang
description: Hwang Jung-Woo is the young lord of the Hwang Family and a powerful young martial artist, who in his previous life was renowned but feared as a martial god of the dark arts.

name: Komichi Akebi
description:
Class 1-3, student number 1.

A girl who has a strong yearning for sailor uniforms due to a certain reason. She has a bright and straightforward personality, and is really looking forward to school life. She is very good at sports.

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

name: Makio Fujiyama
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

Makio is the ace player for her school's volleyball team.

name: Yuki
description: Yuki is a former elite assassin who abandons her violent past and asks to be employed as a maid by high school student [Hitoyoshi Yokoya](https://anilist.co/character/321802/Hitoyoshi-Yokoya). Having been raised solely to kill, she possesses overwhelming combat ability—particularly with knives—but lacks basic experience in ordinary daily life. As she adjusts to her new role, she gradually learns about trust, warmth, and what it means to live peacefully.

name: Luca
description:
He's an Imperial Guard trainee.
For his military accomplishments, he gets adopted by Heilas Kustoria and introduced to the other members of the Kustoria family as Lukaus Kustoria.

name: Azami
description:
First appeared in Shinigami Record. Presumed to be Shion's mother and Mary's grandmother. She is Medusa and her hair grows as snakes. Each of the snakes possesses a unique ability.   

Because she herself has an immortal body, she thinks of humans as, “dull creatures that die easily.” However, at one time, she fell in love with a young man who was the first human to not fear her, and created a family with him. Humans’ life spans are short, so fearing that she’d be alone again, Azami used the powers of the snakes to create a never-ending world.

name: Hiyori Asahina
description: First appeared in Heat-Haze Days. A girl that visits the city to take summer courses with Hibiya. For this reason, she came to stay at her sister’s house, and fell in love with Konoha in one day, who happened to be staying there as well. On August 15, she becomes involved in a certain incident with Hibiya. Her favorite animal is a cat.   (Source: Vocaloid Wikia)

name: Oscar François de Jarjayes
native: オスカル・フランソワ・ド・ジャルジェ
description:
Born the last of five daughters to the Commander of the Royal Guards, [General François Augustin Regnier de Jarjayes](https://anilist.co/character/8150/de-Jarjeyes-Regnier), she is raised by her father as if she were a boy in order to take his place and command the Royal Guards serving at Court after he retires. At the age of fourteen, as soon as her training in the basic military skills is complete, Oscar is given the task to protect the [Dauphine Marie Antoinette](https://anilist.co/character/1701/Antoinette-Marie) when she arrives at the French Court.

Despite being raised as if she were a

name: André Grandier
native: アンドレ・グランディエ
description: The friend of Oscar and the grandson of her nanny, André and Oscar learned the arts of fencing and horsemanship together when they were children. As they grew up, Oscar became the Dauphine's guard and the class gap between them widened.   He has been described as a "true working-class hero" by Helen McCarthy.   André is secretly in love with Oscar, but he never tells her until both of them decide to help the insurgents when the French Revolution begins. Oscar initially refuses him and asks him to leave her but he stubbornly remains by her side until later on she admits to loving him back.  Lat

name: Marie Antoinette
native: マリー・アントワネット
description:
Marie Antoinette married the Dauphin to seal the alliance between his grandfather Louis XV and her mother, Empress Maria Theresa of Austria, when she was 14. After her marriage, she realizes that Madame du Barry, King Louis XV's mistress, is against her. The princess, horrified by what she had heard about du Barry, decides to never speak to her. Meanwhile, she meets Count von Fersen, who becomes her lover.    

Madame du Barry, always plotting against Marie Antoinette and Oscar, fulfils her desire to be greeted by her. After the death of Louis XV, Madame du Barry is condemned to die. Mari

name: Hans Axel von Fersen
native: ハンス・アクセル・フォン・フェルゼン
description: A handsome Swedish aristocrat who comes to the court of Versailles and becomes involved in a forbidden romance with queen Marie Antoinette.  He was Oscar's best friend. It is revealed in the series that Oscar also has strong feelings for Fersen.

name: Rosalie Lamorliere
native: ロザリー・ラモリエール
description: Rosalie is the adoptive daughter of a commoner named Nicole Lamorlière. She is described as "a stereotypical good girl, sweet, obedient and timid". Her biological mother is the Duchess de Polignac, referred to as Martine Gabrielle. Nicole tells Rosalie the truth when she is dying after being hit by a carriage. Rosalie swears that she will kill the person in the carriage that killed her mother. She tries to kill Oscar's mother, Lady Jarjayes, because she thought Lady Jarjayes was in the carriage, but Oscar stops Rosalie. Oscar decides to help her, and she teaches Rosalie the art of fencing, man

name: Bocchi Hitori
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")

Hitori Bocchi (meaning "all alone"), is shy and has extreme social anxiety. A kind person and clumsy at times. She cries frequently, her legs cramp when she gets nervous, and she faints from happiness and excitement. It's challenging for her to talk with new people. Bocchi, however, wants to be able to have fun interacting with friends. She does everyday things in quirky ways, doing things like making scripts for daily conversations, only for it to fail. Her favorite food is rice with natto (finely crushed).

name: Nako Sunao
description: The first friend Bocchi makes upon entering middle school. She has a tough appearance but is actually kind and supportive of Bocchi. Her name is derived from sunao na ko (素直な子, "honest child").

name: Kako Kurai
description: The public morals officer in Bocchi's school. Her name is derived from kurai kako (暗い過去, "dark past").(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Aru Honshou
description: The vice representative in [Bocchi](https://anilist.co/character/128986)'s class. She often puts on an appearance to hide the fact that she is actually somewhat of a loser. Her name is derived from honshou aru (本性ある, "having a true nature").

name: Sotoka Rakita
description: [Bocchi's](https://anilist.co/character/128986/Hitori-Bocchi) classmate who comes from another country and considers herself to be a ninja. Her name is derived from soto kara kita ("came from outside").

name: Beatrice Redden
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

A classic Yandere, therefore she is stronger and more skilled than most girls. Bibi exhibits psychopathic traits, is bubbly and clingy and considers most people to be beneath her.
She is now married to [Amy Lee](https://anilist.co/character/295481/Amy-Lee) and has adopted two children with her, Jerry and Alice.

name: Amelia Park Lee
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

A student with a timid personality.

name: Nanami Takahashi
description:
__Height:__ 155cm

Also known as Nana-chan is a girl who confesses her love too easily, pretty clumsy, and looks very cute. She takes a while to sort out her feelings, and is confused by what her heart tells her and what she knows to do. At the beginning of the anime, she decides that she will not become a lovestruck idiot over Yano like two thirds of the school, and fails as she becomes more and more curious of him.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Masafumi Takeuchi
description:
__Height:__ 178cm

One of Yano's close friends. Unlike Yano, he's kind and considerate, and tends to offer advice to Nana when she's having problems with Yano. Take slowly relives his unmistakable feelings for he once loved Yano's girlfriend, and begins to do so with Nana as well.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Motoharu Yano
description:
**Height:** 174 cm  

A popular boy at his school, and most girls have a crush on him. He is an extreme flirt, and he mainly thinks about perverted things.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Astraea
description:
__Height__: 159cm 
__Species__: Angeloid  

Introduced as the "Delta Angeloid: Close Combat Type". She is something of an airhead and has limited intelligence, due to having low processing power to be able to have high combat abilities and emotions. She weighs 48 kilograms, stands at 159cm, and her wing type is stated to be "Not Variable" and "Super Acceleration".  She is sent by Synapse to dispose of Tomoki after he violates one of their rules.  However, when she is ordered to eliminate Nymph, she breaks off her chain and betrays Synapse, engaging in combat with Chaos.  Astraea has been descr

name: Remilia Graupner
native: レミリア・ローゼ・グラウプナー
description:
The villainess's body has two souls: *Emi Kobayashi* & *Remilia Rose Graupner*. Because of Emi Kobayashi's knowledge of the game world of 「The Star Maiden And The Knight of Salvation」she changes the course of Remilia's life and establishes wonderful reputation for her as the duke's daughter.

The true Remilia was perfectly content to watch Emi live a happy life for the sake of both of them. However, when [Pina](https://anilist.co/character/306778/Blanche-Pina) undoes all of Emi's work, Remilia's soul reclaims control of her body in order to exact revenge.

name: Hiiro Okamura
description:
Height: 180 cm (5'11")
Race: Humas (Human)
Hiiro is one of the 5 people from Earth who were transported to Edea by the First Princess Lilith.

He is extremely smart and logical, but he only cares for himself, and only does things if offered a reward, or if it would benefit him in some way, even when an innocent person's life is on the line. Hiiro doesn't care about the different races, and is one of the few people (if not the only person) who doesn't discriminate between them. He also has a great love of books, as well as the food that is in Edea.


Hiiro grew up in an orphanage. His parents d

appearsIn.title: Konjiki no Word Master: Yuusha Yonin ni Makikomareta Unique Cheat

name: Tarou Jimi
description: The homeroom teacher of Class 1-A. A man completely dedicated to being a teacher and fulfilling a teacher's duties, nothing more.

name: Nagisa Ootsuki
description:
Mashiro, who sits next to her, bothers her in a number of ways, and in order to improve herself, she pushes herself to confront Mashiro and "like" her.

She had previously been unable to make it in time for her preferred school's entrance exam after helping a girl (Mashiro) who had collapsed, so she took an exam for a nearby private high school instead and enrolled there. When she reached high school, she changed her hairstyle and switched from glasses to contact lenses. 
Her family consists of her parents, younger brother, and two younger sisters.

name: Mashiro Komiyama
description:
Her personality is bright and friendly, yet she is a frail person who needs to rest in the infirmary whenever she feels ill. She isn't particularly good at studying. 
She knows that people are worried about her health and she does her best to handle things on her own despite having a weak body. Her parents are her only family members.

appearsIn.title: Little Rabbit and the Big Bad Leopard
Little Rabbit and the Big Bad Leopard

name: Shizuka Kusunoki
description:
__Height:__ 153cm

A classmate who attended the same junior high school as Shizuki. Although she was a quiet, unassuming girl back then, she successfully reinvented her image upon entering high school and now attracts attention as the most beautiful girl in her grade. 

In reality, she struggles with conversation and making friends, but she is trying to change and adopt a more positive outlook.

appearsIn.title: Kusunoki’s Flunking Her High School Glow-Up

name: Keisuke Shizuki
description:
__Height:__ 170cm 

A high school boy who worked on improving himself after a heartbreak in junior high and successfully reinvented his image upon entering high school. 

Although he aims for a peaceful school life, his inability to ignore people in need often lands him in troublesome situations. Due to the trauma of his past heartbreak, he feels physically unwell whenever he makes eye contact with a beautiful girl.

appearsIn.title: Kusunoki’s Flunking Her High School Glow-Up

name: Cárcel Escalante de Esposa
aliases: 卡賽爾・埃斯卡蘭特・德・艾斯波沙
description:
__Height:__ 192 cm (6'3")

- Spends the next decade and a half avoiding the marriage at all costs!
- Thinks that [Inés](https://anilist.co/character/289711/Valeztena-de-Perez-Ins) is in love with him

appearsIn.title: The Broken Ring: This Marriage Will Fail Anyway

name: Inés Valeztena de Perez
aliases: 伊尼絲．瓦萊斯特納．德．貝雷茲
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

- Belongs to one of the highest-ranking families in the "Grandes de Ortega."
- She settled for the heir to [Duke Escalante](https://anilist.co/character/289710/Escalante-de-Esposa-Crcel) solely because he was the most handsome
- Always has a bored, uninterested look on her face

appearsIn.title: The Broken Ring: This Marriage Will Fail Anyway

name: Lilith
description:
One day, a suspicious maid suddenly appeared in front of Yuuri. Characterized by her jet-black hair, tan skin, and piercing purple eyes. She is very suspicious to Yuuri because she doesn't like to talk about herself very much and she tends to keep things secret.

(Source: Official Site)

appearsIn.title: The Maid I Hired Recently is Mysterious
The Maid I Hired Recently is Mysterious

name: Satoru Furuya
description: Furuya is a right-handed power pitcher who throws a fastball and forkball. His main objective is to improve his stamina and control. [Eijun Sawamura](https://anilist.co/character/22998/Sawamura-Eijun) is his rival.

name: Haruichi Kominato
description: A first-year second baseman of the team, Haruichi is a naturally talented, all-rounder baseball player. Despite his small stature and frail appearance, he has pinpoint precision while batting the ball, able to hit it as wide and as far as he pleases, and control where the ball lands. He also is extremely talented at defense, able to catch a ball in the air and throw it while still floating. He is often noted to have amazing baseball sense, able to decide in a split second where to hit the ball, what to watch for, and when to steal. His ability in baseball exceeds his older brother’s, Ryousuke

name: Kazuya Miyuki
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")
__Position:__ Catcher
__Bats:__ Left
__Throws:__ Right

Miyuki Kazuya is a second year student of Seidou High School and the best catcher of the baseball team. He was already a noted catcher on his first year and nationally known for his skills. Miyuki was scouted by [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/89415/Takashima-Rei) when he was still a first year on his Junior High.

name: Eijun Sawamura
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9'')

Eijun Sawamura comes from the prefecture of Nagano where he played baseball at Akagi Junior High. After their last match, he was scouted by [Takashima Rei](https://anilist.co/character/89415/Takashima-Rei) that decided his new journey being a first-year high school student of Seidou High School in Tokyo. He is a left-handed southpaw relief pitcher who throws with his feelings and is never ashamed to show everyone what is on his mind. For his teammates, he is known for being hotheaded and loudmouthed person that usually comes off as obnoxious, but they often get insp

name: Miko Sonoda
description:
__Height__: 159cm (5'2.6")

Sonoda Miko is a high school student who, due to unknown reasons, moves in with her uncle, not knowing that he runs a boarding house. Miko appears to be a girly-girl who also has cooking skills, though she makes curry almost every day.

name: Jun Matsunaga
description:
__Height__: 180cm (5'10.9")

Matsunaga is a designer who is a resident of a boarding house that is owned by Miko's uncle. Matsunaga appears to have anger management issues as he takes out his anger toward other people and objects a lot. Despite his hotheadedness,​ he is shown to be tender and caring toward the people he cares about, especially toward Miko.

name: Harumichi Bouya
description: In essence, Harumichi Bouya is a lone wolf that is shy; however, he will always help his friends, and through the many battles he wins, he gains even more. His non-brawling days consist of him chasing girls, dreaming of girls while sleeping, or having fun with his friends. Harumichi attended Suzuran High School, a school notorious for its' amount of delinquents. At Suzuran, Harumichi Bouya once stood at the top of the food chain and is known as one of the The Four Kings of his generation for his fighting prowess.

name: Yasuo Yasuda
description: A pretty average kid who some how ended up at Suzuran even though he doesn't like fighting and often gets picked on.  He ended up becoming Bouya first underling and friend after Bouya saves his skin, because he became enamoured with a picture of Yasu's sister.

name: Satsuki Kitaouji
description: Athletic and energetic, she loves to be seen with Manaka and is the most confident in her love for him. Completely open with her feelings and not afraid to show her thoughts (or her body for that matter), Kitaouji stands out because of her alluring body. She is a G-cup (the running joke is that her breasts are so big, they weigh her down) and her blouses occasionally pop open when she is emotional. Manaka and Kitaouji have a lot in common (including their tastes in TV shows and manga and their academic records) to the point that Manaka even said that if she were a guy, she would be the boss an

name: Junpei Manaka
description: The main character in the story. An overall nice guy attending middle (and later high) school who gets caught up in many embarrassing but endearing romantic situations. Although his thoughts on girls can get quite perverted on occasion, his gentleness and kindness, as well as his selflessness at times, is what attracts girls to him. His dream is to make films as a director. While not academically gifted, he has great talent with cinematography that gradually develops as the story progresses.

name: Yui Minamito
description: A neighbor and childhood friend of Manaka until she moved away to the countryside. Only one year younger than Manaka, she is very much like a younger sister to him. She has a very strict father. She is fond of chocolates and cake, and has a bad habit of sleeping naked. As a fellow student of Oumi Academy, she looks up to Nishino as a role model, and is infatuated with Okusa. In her second year of high school, after an argument with her father over her living with Manaka and his family, she decides to live in an apartment on her own even though she still has trouble cooking for herself. She sti

name: Tsukasa Nishino
description: Her idol-caliber face, fair hair, and straightforward personality make her very popular at school. With her looks, she attracts literally dozens of admirers but turns down each and every one. Flighty and hot-tempered at the start of the manga, she develops a far more mature attitude after entering Oumi Academy.

name: Aya Toujou
description: Reserved and timid almost to a fault, Toujou is the mystery girl Manaka has been seeking out (the girl with the strawberry panties). She excels in studies but is not very noticed at her middle school because of her large glasses and unattractive hairstyle. Her beauty was only brought out after she started wearing contact lenses and letting her hair down. Her career goal is to become a novelist. A gifted writer, she manages to win several prestigious awards for her compositions despite her youth. She is also the script writer for the movies of the Film Studies Club, and was the first person Man

name: Amachi
description: A true ladies' man, Amachi is the perfect gentleman, with a face to match. He is Manaka's rival for Tojo's affections, although he does not pose too much of a threat (It's apparent that she prefers Manaka). Like Okusa, Amachi has herds of girls flocking to him, and he seems to have a compulsive necessity in helping women in need. After meeting staunch resistance to his approaches on Tojo, Amachi gives up his horde of girls as a sign of devotion to Tojo, but later returns to them after news breaks out that Tojo is not going with Manaka or him to the final school festival. Amachi once challenged

name: Toki Ninomae
description:
__Height:__ 183cm (6')

Toki Ninomae is the vice president of the class committee. He is well-liked by his classmates and is considered very handsome.
Like Otogi, he is a delinquent and hides his personality at school.

appearsIn.title: Fall in Love, You False Angels

name: Otogi Katsura
description:
Otogi Katsura is the president of the class committee and is known as the school's "perfect beauty."
At school, she hides her delinquent personality to maintain her image. She has a crush on the vice president, Toki Ninomae.

appearsIn.title: Fall in Love, You False Angels

name: Libertia Rham Triel
description: Princess Libertia is part of the Vance family. She is the daughter of the notorious villainess, Lisian Vance. She suffers from an incurable illness called "Raphaelis", an illness that directly affects the soul.

appearsIn.title: When the Villainess is in Love
When the Villainess is in Love
When the Villainess is in Love
When the Villainess is in Love
When the Villainess is in Love

name: Yuu Kamegawa
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Birthplace:__ Saitama Prefecture

A straightforward and refreshing newcomer to the PR department. His natural friendliness brings out the awkward kindness in his supervisor, Kannawa. A hobby of his is collecting Plastic Figure models.

name: Azusa Kannawa
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Birthplace:__ Ooita Prefecture

Azusa is cool and competent but clumsy. She is easily misunderstood, but is actually sensitive and compassionate, and is sincere in her approach to both her work and her junior staff. A hobby of hers is gaming.

appearsIn.title: The First Night With the Duke
The First Night With the Duke

name: Yunifer Magnolia
description: A woman who suddenly found herself in the body of Yunifer, the villainess of the original novel. She's a water mage who works at a clinic.

name: Ishid Lucrenze
description: Captain of the Order of the White Night and Archduke of Lucrenze. He owns the heavenly sword Ciergo and is one of the five fire mages currently alive. He is also known as the Knight of the Crimson Flame.

name: Junpei Takeda
description:
Takeda Junpei is a high school student that lives his days being bullied by Shouta Kido and saved by his childhood friend Tatsumiya Noriko. But one day, they’re all summoned by “God,” who cruelly claims that he’s going to relieve his boredom by sending them to a dangerous world of fantasy.

Each of them is given a “job” and stats, and while Kido’s are amazing, Junpei is but a jobless weakling. With that, they begin new lives, but Junpei is soon betrayed and sacrificed to a labyrinth full of abnormal monsters. Now seething with anger, he fights tooth and nail to escape the labyrinth for revenge

name: Sera Himeura
description: She is an otaku with no friends who enjoys anime and manga as well as being a hero, trying to save the world.

name: Kokage Fujinami
description: She is a tsundere street kid. She sells drugs for free.

name: Yume Furusuna
description:
__Occupation:__ Student (former)
__Height:__ 153 cm
__Weight:__ 48 kg
__Affiliation:__Asami Elementary School
__Hobbies:__ Stalking, going to the library

Yume Furusuna is the instant bullet of "Time", and one of the main characters of Instant Bullet.

A master of faking smiles. She carries a gun, and has the means to have herself instantly admitted to a high-level university. Because Kuro, Moroki and Kokage gave her the "reason for existing" that she had lacked since she was a child, she harbors feelings of affection for them. Everything she does is for Kuro Fukase's sake, but the strain in h

name: Kuro Fukase
description: He is a very pessimistic person with no friends who wishes the world would just be destroyed.

name: Ochiai-san
description:
Ochiai-san is a woman in her late 20s, a few years older than Sawatari-kun. She is a divorced woman who has suffered from psychological abuse in her previous marriage, which has left her with trust issues and a shy, crying nature. Despite her past trauma, Ochiai-san is an excellent cook, but she never takes pride in her culinary skills. She has long hair that she is unable to change, her hair color to come back quickly. 

She works at local supermarket.

As a neighbor of Sawatari-kun, Ochiai-san had never received compliments or praise until she met him. She found it hard to believe that someo

name: Sawatari-kun
description:
A kind person who lives next door to Ochiai-san.

In Chapter 26 of the manga, Sawatari-kun and Ochiai-san enter a romantic relationship with each other.

name: Asa Asada
description: Asa, a little girl living in the Port of Nagoya alongside her parents and her eleven siblings (with a twelfth about to come) is commonly forgotten by her own family, mistaken with her sisters by neighbours, and feels like she doesn't have an identity of her own. She blames it to her name being the dullest of the family, since the only reason for it was being born early in the morning. Yamato is clumsy and has a carefree attitude, which often gets him into comprising situations. When the need arises, he can become focused and determined. He is good friends with Ikegaki and Otomo, and later becomes good friends with Sakiko, Gamo, and the other officials. She's also the caretaker of Hina Hongou because she's the only one who has at least a bit control over her.

__Weapons:__ Hockey Sticks (Valkyrie, Cyclone, Kunpuumaru)

Himeko is the violent "yankee"-girl with a soft spot for cute things. She is the fighter/brawn and tsukkomi to the Sket Dan. In her past she was called "Legendary Yankee Onihime (鬼姫)" which became a symbol of "power and fear". Himeko seems to now have "calmed down" from her days of being the Onihime and has become the second-chief to the Sket Dan.

name: Reika Inukai
description:
Haruma's friend and crush since their high school days. He's long suppressed his feelings for her once she started going out with Shuuji, but has continued to keep in touch with the couple long into adulthood. After Shuuji's death, she moved in with Haruma so the latter could support her through her pregnancy. 

It is revealed that Shuuji is not the father of the baby Reika is carrying, but in fact Haruma, who in a moment of weakness slept with Reika the night after attending Shuuji's funeral, upon her invitation. However, due to his amnesia, Haruma himself can't seem to remember these events

name: Haruma Sakuraba
description: An average salaryman who leads a dull life.  He holds a big inferiority complex due to being compared to his former next door neighbor, Shuuji, his whole life.

__Hair Color:__: Brown

300 years ago, Qing entered the fairy world where he became a sword expert cultivator. As he was nearing the realm of eternity, he went through the hall of time and space and returned to Earth at the age of 17. However, it isn't the world he knew but a world where the gender roles we're reversed both in a mental and physical aspect, because of this fact he became angered and is trying to make his way back home to the world he knows.

 Later on in the story he guises hi

__Eye Color:__ Pink

Tang Ziyan is the girlfriend and to be fiancee of Chu Qing after the events with the Li family. Ziyan has a serious competitive attitude but will respect the people who can be considered better than her. She is the next in line to become the Tang family patriarch.

name: Huahua Chen
description:
__Species:__ Human

Huahua is an information broker. She helps out Chu Qing if he needs any type of info on a person. This leads to them both becoming emotionally invested in one another to the point where she becomes Chu Qing's girlfriend. Huahua is now the technical directer at Chu Qing's mothers company.

appearsIn.title: Sword King In A Women's World

name: Chenxi Ye
description:
__Age:__ Unknown
__Species:__ Human
__Hair Color:__ Black
__Eye Color:__ Orange/Yellow

Chenxi is born as the second daughter to Qingmei in the Ye family and is next in line to become the patriarch to the Ye family. (One of the big three families). She is one of Chu Qing's girlfriends and hold him close to her heart. 
 She is the one to help Chu Qing persuade her mother to open the Ye Pharmaceutical company to be able to have the funds to repair the financial struggles of the Ye family and to be able to attack the other 2 large families of Jinmen so Chu Qing won't get targeted anymore.

appearsIn.title: Sword King In A Women's World

name: Meng Zui
description:
Zui is the Founder and Owner of Drunken Dreams. She's one of the 10 Great Experts in Jinmen City.
Later on, by signing a marriage certificate, Zui becomes Chu Qing's wife. They might be expecting a child soon. She had Qing's family brought to live in her company.

appearsIn.title: Sword King In A Women's World

name: Ephtal
description:
This is the current Ephtal, who has been reincarnated twice. He has set his sights on the path of magic and is aiming to enroll in a magic academy.

He retains the memories and magical prowess from his previous life 400 years ago as the Sage and Thunder God Emperor Ephtal; his power is so extraordinary that it would be called a “miracle” by modern standards. However, just as in his past life, he lacks a natural aptitude for magic. Yet he possesses a passion more single-minded than anyone else’s, striving to overcome this handicap through hard work and determination.

While kind to others, he d

appearsIn.title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage

name: Anastasia
description: A young girl who was rescued by Ephtal while being subjected to unjust treatment as a slave, and who ends up joining him on his journey. She is reserved but strong-willed, and refers to Ephtal—who saved her—as “Lord Ephtal,” placing deep trust in him. She possesses a talent for magic that even he acknowledges, but due to her background and circumstances, she harbors a secret she cannot reveal. She quietly matures as she watches Ephtal’s back.

appearsIn.title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage

name: Merlin
description:
After the Demon King was defeated, she was found by Ephtal in the Demon King’s castle—which was on the verge of collapse—and raised by him from infancy. As her background suggests, she is a descendant of the Demon King’s clan. She possesses exceptional aptitude for water and wind magic, and is both hardworking and highly ambitious. As his top disciple, she deeply admires Ephtal and often takes reckless actions out of concern for his safety.

As a faculty member at the Magic Academy, she instructs her students rigorously, yet she understands her master’s ideals and resolve better than anyone el

appearsIn.title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage

Kishou Arima is a famed Special Class Ghoul Investigator known as the CCG's Reaper. He is undefeated as a Ghoul Investigator and at some point was formerly partnered with [Take Hirako](https://anilist.co/character/136023/Hirako-Take).

(Jack), 32 (Tokyo Ghoul:re)

Aki is the childhood friend of Taishi and Ryou's girlfriend.

name: Uruka Minami
description: Minami Uruka is a second-year student at Seishin Senior High School. She is a classmate of Kishou Arima and Taishi Fura.

name: Nimura
description: Part of a military helicopter crew. He and his crew were separated from their group while heading out for a mission. While searching for supplies and fuel in an abandoned town, they come across Teru and Ako.

name: Iwada
description: Part of a military helicopter crew. He is the pilot of the helicopter. He and his crew were separated from their group while heading out for a mission. While searching for supplies and fuel in an abandoned town, they come across Teru and Ako.

name: Teru Aoki
description: After watching a bright light in the horizon, the train where he and the rest of his classmates are riding, has a terrible accident.  Only three survive!  Teru desperatly clings to hope that someone will come to save them , but when help doesn't arrive, he decides to search for his own way out, having to deal with the ever-growing insane Nobou and the injured Ako.

name: Ako Seto
description:
One of the three survivors form the train crash. She is injured from the crash, and Teru is the one to take care of her. 
She is kidnapped by Nobuo, painting her body with the blood of one of the dead professors. He then proceeds to try to sacrifice her.

name: Chinatsu  Miura
description: The youngest of the three Miura brothers. An elementary school student. His joy and childish innocence brings the brothers together and lifts their spirits. Despite his happy exterior, the family's financial situation still troubles Chinatsu, but he tries to hide his sadness from his brothers.

name: Chiaki Miura
description:
The eldest of the three Miura brothers and the protagonist. He takes on the responsibility of taking care of his siblings following their father's death. After several failed attempts to find employment, fate seems to be on Chiaki's side when he receives a job offer from a mysterious man on his way to an interview. Unbeknownst to Chiaki, this job would take him on the strangest adventure of his life. 
He cares deeply for his brothers and will do absolutely anything to make sure they are happy.

name: Chiharu Miura
description: The second oldest brother of the Miura family. A serious middle school student who speaks his mind freely. He is frustrated with the poverty he and his brothers live in and with Chiaki's inability to find a job. According to Chiaki, he worries much more than a middle schooler should.

name: Yuning Xia
description:
__Eye Color:__ Blue
__Hair Color:__ Silver
__Martial Arts:__ Dragon Martial Arts
She is the daughter of the Northern Guardian Lord. Her title of "Princess" was stripped from her after partaking in dishonourable behaviour with  Xinghe during the fighting tournament. As such she has now become a part of the Azure feather family in Blue Carp Town.

She is the fiancee (to be) to Ye Xinghe

name: Itsuki Akiba
description: Loud, reckless, and shameless, and seems to be a complete opposite of Iori, including her affinity towards wearing boyish clothing and having a short haircut.

name: Izumi Isozaki
description: Izumi Isozaki is two years younger than the other characters and is very much like Itsuki Akiba. However, she isn't as shy in expressing her emotions, especially her love for Ichitaka Seto. In fact, she announces her love to pretty much everyone she knows. Also, she's more daring and is quite superstitious when it comes to love. She constantly tails Seto, and on more than one occasion, had tried to seduce Seto to go to bed with her in order to prove her love. Izumi persists in attempting to obtain Seto's love and says that she will try whatever it takes to get him to be with her. She is introd

name: Ichitaka Seto
description: Seto has a shy nature. Due to past experiences with girls he is afraid to tell the one true girl he loves how he feels. As the years go by, Iori and himself become better friends but nothing more. With the help of his good friend Teratani, Seto hopes to one day change that and win Iori over forever.

name: Iori Yoshizuki
description: Iori is prim, proper, and friendly, not to mention gorgeous. She's a young lady who's easy to like and get along with.

name: Chiemi Honda
description:
Nobuaki's girlfriend who helps him on several occasions.

She later dies in Nobuaki's arms making him the only survivor

name: Nobuaki Kanazawa
description: Nobuaki acts always trying to help others, was the first to try to end the game finding Ousama, always doing everything to help his best friend and his girlfriend.    Nobuaki's the only survivor and he later ends up participating in more Ousama Games to avenge his friends and catch the person who made the game.

name: Yuki  Ichihara
description: Yuki is a college student. She acts, behaves and dresses as a boy which is why she is usually mistaken for a boy.

name: Rina Okamoto
description: Rina Okamoto is a talkative first-year high school student and the youngest among the game participants. She seems to recognize [Shinomiya's](https://anilist.co/character/42138/Ryuhei-Shinomiya) face, though the reason is unclear.

name: Hiroyuki Sakurai
description: Hiroyuki Sakurai is the being of "Envy", represented by the rabbit. Due to a series of events, a lie from two years ago leads him to accidentally kill his own brother, something he deeply regrets. He is then drawn into the game of Judge, where he struggles to find a way for everyone to survive. Despite his sin, Hiroyuki has a strong sense of justice and tends to face problems head-on without much thought.

name: Ryuhei Shinomiya
description:
Ryuhei Shinomiya is a short-tempered and violent freeter who constantly maintains an intimidating attitude.

He is a freelancer. In the game, he wears a horse mask.

name: Hayato Takizawa
description: Hayato Takizawa is always calm and composed, analyzing situations carefully. He is a university student enrolled in the law faculty and is critical of [Hiroyuki’s](https://anilist.co/character/52123/Hiroyuki-Sakurai) actions.

name: Kim Bu-Jang
description: Kim Bujang, also known as Code 66, is a retired military man and a father to Minji Kim.

name: Min-Ji Kim
description: The daughter of Kim Bu-Jang.

description: Chiaki is the Ace of the Archery club, where she also is the upperclassman of [Kana Kashiwagi](https://anilist.co/character/136406/Kashiwagi-Kana) in the Archery Club. She has a small chest and likes to grope boobs. She met [Harumi](https://anilist.co/character/136405/Harumi-Hana) on a rainy day when she lent her an umbrella.

appearsIn.title: Breasts Are My Favorite Things in the World!

name: Hana Harumi
description: A girl with big boobs. She met [Chiaki](https://anilist.co/character/136404/Ichihara-Chiaki) on a rainy day, when Chiaki gave her an umbrella. In return Chiaki asked her if she can grope her boobs.

appearsIn.title: Breasts Are My Favorite Things in the World!

name: Happy
description: Happy is an Akita dog and the narrator of the first part of the story. As a puppy, he is left in a box on the side of the road and picked up by Miku, who names him "Happy" and pleads with her parents to keep him. After several years of living with the family, the father sets out on a roadtrip and takes Happy with him. Happy enjoys the times when he and father go out on walks and father talks to him.

name: Soujirou Yui
description: He is a skilled swordsman and talented at whatever he sets his mind to. But he lacks self-confidence and has a low self esteem .

name: Chiyo
description: She has a dignified face but when she is facing Soujirou her face slips up . Moreover, she has good athletic abilities .

name: Makoto Koga
description: A high school student who confesses his feelings to Meguro-san . He is senior to Meguro-san by a year

She's in love with her sister-in-law.

(Source: MAL)

name: Kaoru
description: Reiichi's wife and Uta's crush.

name: Mogari Shishikuno
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm

While unable to see ghosts, Mogari has the ability to forcibly exorcise them by consuming them. By touching or being touched by another person with spiritual powers, like [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/328366/Kanzaki-Kaoru) or [Koutarou](https://anilist.co/character/328365/Tamon-Koutarou), he can temporarily borrow their own spiritual abilities and share that gift among those who are spiritually sensitive. Hailing from a lineage of spiritual mediums, he had to choose between training in the Akita Mountains or enhancing his skills by exorcising spirits in Kamakura. Opt

name: Eugene Korekishi
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Since childhood, Eugene was hailed as a prodigy by those around him. He deeply admires his grandmother, who treated him as the only normal child among them. However, because of his grandmother's promise to return to him as a ghost to meet him after her death remains unfulfilled, Eugene has firmly decided not to believe in ghosts.

name: Kaoru Kanzaki
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm

Since childhood, Kaoru has had a natural ability to see spirits, leading to distressing encounters as these spirits latch onto him upon realizing his gift. To ward them off, he deliberately changes his appearance by dyeing his hair and adopting a flashy style. He's an otaku at heart, with 'Slam Dunk' holding the status of a life bible for him.

name: Koutarou Tamon
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Tamon possesses the unique ability to solely hear spirits' voices. His spiritual gift has led to discomfort among regular humans, making it difficult for him to maintain eye contact and causing physical unease. Conversely, he can hold ordinary conversations with unseen spirits whose voices he hears. He opts for peaceful exorcism by conversing with spirits he can communicate with.

name: Hiroshi Nakahara
description: An ordinary middle schooler who later becomes busy salary man.

name: Elsa Dorothy
description:
**Height:** 158cm
**Good at:** Anything related to magic.
**Bad at:** Physical activity.

The heroine of the otome game that Yvonne was reincarnated into.

name: Yvonne Smollett
description:
**Height:** 167cm

Yvonne was reincarnated into an otome game as the rich villainess. According to the game's plot, she is loathed by everyone and has the role of bullying the heroine, in order to push her towards the various love interests' romantic routes.

name: Nobunaga Oda
aliases: Demon King of the Sixth Heaven
description:
__Height:__ 152cm

Demon Archer is the Archer-class Servant in the Strange Tales of the Imperial Holy Grail of Koha Ace. She is one of the Servants of the Protagonist of the Grand Order conflicts of Fate/Grand Order.

Haughty and self-confident, she possesses a flexible way of thinking that loves new things and is not bound by conservatism and common sense.

name: Souji Okita
description:
__Height:__ 158cm

Sakura Saber is the Saber-class Servant of Kohaku in the Imperial Capital Holy Grail Strange Story of Fate/KOHA-ACE. She is one of the Servants of the Protagonist of the Grand Order conflicts of Fate/Grand Order.

Okita has both the facet of a cool-headed manslayer, as well as a cheerful side that is fond of children. Although she is essentially a cool-headed manslayer, towards those who pardoned that mentality, Okita borders on being openly friendly as if they were members of the same organization. During her lifetime, since she had nearly no relationships in regards to lov

name: Akagi Kanata
description: Kanata is from a declining magus family. His grandmother possessed Magecraft but kept to herself and eventually died when he was six. His father did not have Magic Circuits, so Kanata was raised as a regular boy, is untrained in magecraft, and does not know much about it.

name: Fujimiya Tsukumo
description: Tsukumo Fujimiya is a magus participating in the Imperial Capital Holy Grail Strange Story of Fate/type Redline. She is the grandmother of Kanata Akagi. She is originally Saber's Master in the original timeline instead of Kanata.

name: Ikuto Tsumura
description:
Ikuto has aspired to be a fashion designer and self-taught himself since he was at least seven years old, but is forced to put his dream on halt due to his financially struggling family. As the oldest child and only son, Ikuto helps his mother take care of his sisters and handles most of the housework and initially refuses to go college in lieu of full-time employment to support his sisters. After befriending Chiyuki and getting a part-time job at Yanagida's studio, Ikuto begins working towards his dream of being a fashion designer, though his financial situation causes him some setbacks.

Des

name: Chiyuki Fujito
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

A model for her father's company "Mille Neige". While praised to be blessed with good looks, the proper body proportions, and her father's connections and wealth, Chiyuki lacks the minimum height requirement to be a runway model. Despite this, she dreams of being in the Paris Fashion Week as the representative of her father's company and aims to be a top model, regardless of her short height and what other people think of her.

Chiyuki is an energetic, charming, and strong-willed girl who speaks her mind and has a strong competitive spirit, especially when trying to

name: Sara
description:
Sara is the girlfriend of Furuya. She is considered the most beautiful girl of the school.
She later became a spirit to "hang out" with Furuya, while she was actually haunting him. It was later revealed that she wanted to curse Furuya, so she acted like a normal girl to make him guilty enough to commit suicide, all so she could touch and control him again.

appearsIn.title: Machigatteita no wa Ore Dattan da.

name: Furuya
description:
Furuya is a high school boy who accidentally killed his girlfriend Sara. 
At first he is relieved, but spending time with Sara's ghost makes him believe he was wrong and he decides to take his own life due to the guilt.

appearsIn.title: Machigatteita no wa Ore Dattan da.

name: Dr. Saruta
description: Like Dr. Ochanomizu, Saruta is visually identifiable by his large nose, though in his case it is grotesquely spotted. Where Ochanomizu generally appears in light and uplifting roles, Saruta is quite the opposite. His two main roles in Tezuka manga are both in extremely important series: Black Jack and Phoenix. In Phoenix, he is arguably an over-arching protagonist for the series as a whole, alongside its title character. He appears in every story, sometimes in a main role, sometimes in a peripheral one, sometimes with a new name and barely recognizable in his character, but always present and

name: Gaou
description: One-eyed and one-armed young man Gao, an ancestor of Saruta, turns into a murderous bandit when he is rejected by his village.

name: Elymas Edvan
description: A reincarnated person who was reborn into the world of a game they used to play in their previous life.

appearsIn.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System

name: Norimizu Ameya
description: Jaibo is a member of the Litchi Hikari Club. He is obsessively in love with Zera, the leader of the club, and stops at nothing to be with him.  He is classified as a Yandere-type character.   After he reveals to be the cause of the destruction of the Litchi Hikari Club due to Zera becoming infatuated with Kanon rather than him, he confesses his true feelings to Zera before having Litchi crush his head, killing him.

name: Litchi
description: A machine with artificial intelligence developed by the Hikari Club.

name: Kanon
description: A young girl captured by Litchi, declared as a goddess of beauty of the Hikari Club.

name: Hiroshi Tamiya
description: Tamiya was the original leader of the Litchi Hikari Club, which he founded with his two best friends, Kaneda and Dafu. The club was later overtaken by Zera, who Tamiya dissaproves of for his cruel means of ruling. Tamiya is level-headed and thinks of others before himself. He also has a little sister, named Tamako. His character is named after Jirou Tamiya, a Japanese actor and television host.    Tamiya was killed by Jaibo (wielding Tamiya's slingshot) after confronting Zera about a traitor being in the club.

name: Hiroyuki Tsunekawa
description: Zera is the 14-year-old  leader of the Litchi Hikari Club, a group composed of middle school boys attempting to create the ultimate AI. He has a very charismatic personality and is also an expert player at the board game chess.  His character was based off the Roman Emperor Elagabulus, who was infamous for his lewd and ungoverned acts of rule.   After Jaibo reveals to be the cause of the destruction of the Litchi Hikari Club, Zera goes insane. He is then killed by Nico, who bludgeons him through the stomach with a urinal.

name: Raizou Ichihashi
description: Raizou is a member of the Litchi Hikari Club. He is extremely effeminate, and uses a speech pattern fitting that of a Gyaru.  According to the LHC 4-Koma series, Raizou enjoys reading books (such as Anne of Green Gables) and also wears Fundoshi - traditional Japanese men's underwear.   Raizou is killed by Litchi when it goes on a rampage and rips his face off. He is the fourth member of the Litchi Hikari Club to be killed.

name: Ayumi Yurino
description:
Ayumi is Yuuki Hisamizu's underclassman who likes to tease and flirt with him, but can get easily flustered when the tables are turned on her. She shows her playful side exclusively to him whereas other boys in the school are given the cold shoulder when they approached her.
It is revealed during a flashback that she started having feelings for Yuuki since they became acquainted as study partners in junior high school. Ayumi started dating with Yuuki after she accepted his confession on Christmas Eve.

name: Yuuki Hisamizu
description: Ayumi's senpai, and is in love with her. His brother is Youta. Fairly casual and prefers to stay out of trouble.

name: Wilhelmina Murray
native: ウィルヘルミナ・マリー
description: A girl from Lancashire. She is Whitby School's first female student, and a skilled wrestler who is handy with a typewriter.

name: Luke Westenra
native: ルーク・ウェステンラ
description: The child of a wealthy family. A student at Whitby School who enjoys drawing and painting.

name: Naoki Satou
description: [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/323205/Shun-Satou)'s senpai. She's cheerful, carefree and more than a little eccentric, being the president of her own "Hyper Go-Home Club", which she immediately recruits Shun for on their first day of high school. Despite her quirks and detour-loving personality she is kind, attentive and gets along well with everyone at school, quickly becoming close with Shun and capturing his interest.

name: Shun Satou
description: [Naoki](https://anilist.co/character/323204/Naoki-Satou)'s kouhai, and a former well-known soccer player. Shun is a first-year that joins Naoki's "Hyper Go-Home Club" on the first day of high school after turning down sports club requests due to his recent leg injury. Despite his initial reluctance to joining Naoki's bizarre club, he quickly begins to look forward to their detours together.

name: Hiroki Aoyama
description:
He has a crush on the class representative of his class: Daigo. His mother suspecting him being gay, but he tries to hide it.
He has a younger brother called Yuuri.

appearsIn.title: I Think Our Son Is Gay

name: Tomoko Aoyama
description: Mother of two sons. She suspects her son Hiroki being gay, but is willing to support his feelings. She knows that her husband isn't aware of the family circumstances since he's seldom at home.

appearsIn.title: I Think Our Son Is Gay

name: Ryuuji Danma
description: The other member of the Onibaku duo, Ryuuji is taller and maybe slightly more restrained than his partner, although get in his bad books and you're in for big trouble. He has more luck with women, having had a relationship with his teacher Ayumi, and later Nagisa (seen in GTO). Ryuuji's family are nice, normal people, who appear quite wealthy, who totally disapprove of his 'bad behavior', however his elder sister Yoko allows him to stay at her home when he needs to. His younger brother is called Yoshitaka. Ryuuji rides a Honda CBX-400F, as seen in Bad Company.

appearsIn.title: GTO: The Early Years - Shonan Junai Gumi
Survival in Another World with My Mistress!

name: Yukiko Akaza
description: Suffers from amblyopia and enrolls at the High School for the Blind.

name: Arslan
description:
Prince of Pars. 14 years old. Arslan is frequently misinterpreted by those around him as being a weakling, because of his effete appearance, naivete, compassion, and optimism. While these are true to a point, Arslan is also philosophical, intelligent, and charismatic, able to rally even the most apathetic of people to his cause. He is dedicated to his friends, especially Daryun, at one time threatening to kill an ally who had got Daryun into a particularly nasty situation.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hilmes
description: In the beginning, all that is known about Silvermask is his obsessive desire to torture and kill both Andragoras and Arislan. He is serving as the leader of the Lusitanian forces but is in fact a Palsian himself and soon commands a regiment of collaborators. He is so named because of the ornate silver helm he wears; it has large silver bull-horns attached to it, and completely obscures his face. He later reveals his face to Andragoras, now his prisoner, who recognises him as Hermes, the son of King Osiris, Andragoras' brother and predecessor. Hermes' face is partly burnt by a fire he

name: Daryun
description: Formerly a high-ranking military officer, Daryun is demoted from his position in the opening of the anime. His new mission is to protect and serve Arslan. Daryun and Arslan become close friends. In the style of samurai, Daryun is loyal to a fault, and at point tells Arslan that whatever his true origins may be, Daryun regards him as his prince. His fighting skills are so legendary that, at one point, Prince Rajendra praises him as the greatest warrior in both Pars and Shindra.

name: Gieve
description: Gieve is the only player who does not make a strong allegiance to any side in the various battles that take place. While he self-identifies as a musician, it would be more apt to say that Gieve is a rogue-of-all-trades. He is the most versatile fighter in the series, capable of using a sword, a bow, or a lance, and also claims that he can play any instrument in the world.  In the OVA, Gieve is also known for breaking the fourth wall: when he is alone, he will address the audience and narrate his thoughts on what is going on in the story (though it could be said that he is merely talking becaus

name: Elam
description:
A youth whom Narsus bought out of slavery, Elam intends to serve his 'master' until he is old enough to live on his own. Cunning in his own way, he acts as spy to gather useful information through various disguises. He faces something of a struggle with Afurido for the affection of his master Narsus.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Narsus
description: Narsus was once a chief adviser and tactician under Andragoras, but because he spoke out against the king's continuing practice of slavery, he was removed from his office. He appears fonder of animals than humans and displays a love of the natural world. He usually appears calm and soft-spoken. He enjoys drinking tea and has a special fondness for confectionery.

A strange elementary school student who kidnaps I for witnessing her true nature. Her real name is undisclosed, as I wishes to protect her privacy. 

U appears normal to outsiders, being quiet, introverted and polite. However, her true nature is that of an abnormal individual that lacks an understanding on social norms. 
Her parents were extremely negligent towards her; failing to assist her with understanding the world. Instead, her parents gave numerous rules that led to her being very unstable by the time she met I. As a result of this, U has a twisted view on social norms and etiquette.

name: I

An aspiring author in college. Though he aspires to be an author, he is continually rejected, causing him to be depressed. After meeting U U and witnessing her abnormality, I is kidnapped by her.

I is quiet, calm, and a shy individual. He's often depressed, rarely smiling, and is likely lacking self-confidence. Though he is relatively normal as an adult, he was considered abnormal as a kid, similar to U U.

Once I got involved with U U, he decided to help her through her worries about her abnormalities and her past. In turn, his time with U U helps with his novels as well.

When he does help others, his methods almost always involve excessive bloodshed, lying, torture, and other questionable acts. After Munsu frees her, she decides to become his bodyguard in memory of her dead lover, and takes the title "Sando" as her new name. He believes that angyo onshi should be virtuous and heroic, which is why Munsu's behavior often shocks him.

She was initially assigned to Tamon's house to cover the absence of her co-worker before officially hired as his housekeeper.
