name: Donny
description: Donny is a member of the Katz Street Troupe. Donny is a tall teenager, with long red hair and is a bit burly. Donny wears a white button-down shirt, which leaves part of his chest uncovered, and black pants with some kind of pockets on the sides, and a pair of light-colored boots. Donny used to train as a Holy Knight apprentice under his uncle Howzer alongside his friend Edlin. However, seeing that he lacked the strength to become a Holy Knight, Donny dropped out of training and joined the Katz Street Troupe alongside Katz and Elva.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse

name: Nasiens
description: Nasiens is a mysterious person Percival meets at Echo Gorge. Nasiens is a young person with short light brown hair and yellow eyes. Nasiens has a great interest in plants, wanting to be a herbalist like his adoptive grandfather Ordo was. He gets very excited when making new discoveries, liking to experiment with everything around him.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse

name: Anghalhad
description: Anghalhad is a girl Percival meets at Sistana. Anghalhad is a young girl with long, fluffed pale cyan hair and turquoise eyes. She wears a white frilly dress with a magenta blouse along with socks and heels. She carries a dotted umbrella which hides a rapier in the center.

appearsIn.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse

name: Cao Cao
description: Cao Cao is by far  one of the greatest leaders in the Three Kingdoms Era. One might question his methods or call him "cruel", but even so his cold tactics allow him to fully utilize his armies and accomplish his objectives.

name: Yu Xun
description: Courtesy name Wenruo. Xun Yu is the second member of the Eight Enigma, genius military advisors handpicked by renowned veteran strategist Sima Hui 'Shujing'. Although as well-versed in warfare as any of the Enigmas, Xun Yu's true strength is diplomacy. From the beginning days of Cao Cao's faction, his benevolent ministry, as opposed to Guo Jia's 'Darkness Ideology' in military affairs, has helped fortify Cao Cao's rule. Thus stems his nickname, 'Zhang Liang', a homage to a famous advisor who aided Liu Bang in the construction of the Han dynasty

name: Yu Guan
description: Courtesy name Yunchang. Guan Yu is an oath brother to Liu Bei and Zhang Fei, him being the second oldest. He is one of the most powerful warriors of his era, rivaling the likes of Lü Bu and Sun Ce. When he was temporarily serving under Cao Cao, Guan Yu played a vital role as his bodyguard and also briefly tipped the balance of power on the battlefield.  Guan Yu is a man of honor and righteousness, as well as a devoted follower of his oath brother Liu Bei. He will punish a man for his wrong, but also respects him for his right. Unfortunately this idealism makes him vulnerable to manipulation, e

name: Fei Zhang
description: Courtesy name Yide. Zhang Fei is an oath brother to Liu Bei and Guan Yu, him being the youngest of the three. He is among the most powerful warriors of his era, and is more sneaky than people would assume. When not overshadowed by the Eight Geniuses, he takes on the role of a capable military advisor.  Zhang Fei is more Machiavellian than his second oath brother Guan Yu. He's not afraid to play the fool, make deals under the table, injure or manipulate his oath brothers if it means accomplishing the goal, which is to help Liu Bei rise to power.  (Source: ravagesoftime.wikispaces.com)

name: Jia Guo
description: Guo Jia is the fourth member of the Eight Enima, genius military advisors handpicked by the renowned veteran strategist Sima Hui 'Shujing' from his students. He's praised as the 'King of strategic decisions', a nod to his ability to account for virtually every scenarios possible in his plans. Like his close friend, the Third Enigma Jia Xu, Guo Jia is also a proponent of the 'Darkness ideology', which hails actions of utmost cruelty, rather than of benevolence, as the ultimate mean to pave way for peace and prosperity. This, while perpetuates his fame as Cao C

name: Yu Zhou
description: Zhou Yu is the fifth member of the Eight Enigma, genius military advisors handpicked by renowned veteran strategist Sima Hui 'Shujing' from his students. Of all the Enigma to have made an appearance, Zhou Yu's goal strays the furthest from their common ideal: rather than striving to bring peace to the land, he pledges loyalty to his sworn brother, Sun Ce, and dedicates his genius to the resurrection of the fallen Sun clan, which implies his intentions to found the future Wu kingdom independent of Imperial Han. For this, he's greatly disliked by the Seventh Enigma Zhuge Lian

name: Xu Jia
description: Courtesy name Wenhe. Jia Xu is the third member of the Eight Enigma, genius military advisors handpicked by renowned veteran strategist Sima Hui 'Shujing' from his students. He's also arguably the most notorious among the Eight Enigma, due to his favorite sacrifical strategy, which twice has killed his lords for the sake of eliminating the common enemy (Lu Bu). As best friend of the Fourth Enigma Guo Jia, Jia Xu is a fervent believer in the 'Darkness ideology', the belief hailing actions of utmost cruelty, rather than of benevolence, as the ultimate mean to pave way fo

name: Liang Zhuge
description: Courtesy name Kongming. Zhuge Liang is the seventh member of the Eight Enigma, genius military advisors handpicked by veteran strategist Sima Hui 'Shujing' from his students. As the recipient of the title 'Crouching Dragon' (臥龍;  _Wòlóng _), one of the two titles conferred on the best of the Enigmas only (the other being 'Fledgeling Phoenix', conferred on the Sixth Enigma Pang Tong), Zhuge Liang's ability to predict the outcomes of battle is praised by his master as godly. It's noted that he's also proficient in the art of shamanism.

name: The Eighth Genius
description: The last of the Eight Genius. There has been much debate over who is the last Genius, and theory abounds.

name: Huo Liaoyuan
description: Courtesy name Zilong, adopted at the same time he took on the name Zhao Yun. Liaoyuan Huo is the leader of the Sima clan's notorious assassin squad, the Crippled Legion, and is best friend with the clan's young head, Sima Yi. Besides prodigious fighting skills, he has the unique handicap of inability to feel pain, making him one of the strongest warriors in the story. Unlike the amoral Sima Yi, Liaoyuan Huo is regarded to be a very righteous man who values justice, and, despite their strong friendship, hates Sima Yi's indifference to the world's chaotic state. He's als

name: Chae-A Han
description: After serving a 7 year prison sentence for an attempted murder, Chae Ah works as a taxi driver.

name: Yun-Su Park
description: Yoonsoo Park is a cold-hearted vampire who also attends church every Sunday. He lives with a small child, [Geurim](https://anilist.co/character/305760/Geu-Rim).

name: Shinsuke Hyoudou
description: Shinsuke was just a traveling ronin when he met Jinka and Tama. He was fascinated with their abilities and offered information to be able to follow them.

name: Tama Youko
description: A very ambitious and sassy several hundred year old fox katawara. Alongside her human brother, [Jinka](https://anilist.co/character/27221/Jinka-Yamato), she travels the lands in order to try and rid the world of humans and katawara committing evil deeds and spread peace and kindness.

name: Senya
description:
Senya is a demon hunter with his father Jinun.

Senya was experimented on and given 1000 demons inside of his body by the Dangaishu

In the second half of the manga, he later becomes the main character of the series. With Tama, Tsukiko, and Nau, they try to free Jinka.

name: Tsukiko
description:
Senya's partner. Tsukiko is a timid and reserved girl who harbors deep feelings for Senya. Often trying to help Senya she feels that she causes more trouble than actually stopping it.

(Source: MAL)

name: Akira  Shiroyanagi
description:
__Ability__: Possesses whichever ability the other person thinks he has.

Akira Shiroyanagi is a high schooler who loves games and Konpeito. He is bored with his everyday life and hence tries out many games hoping to find something to challenge him. This changes when he suddenly is dragged into a battlefield by a mysterious girl who calls herself Mion. The participants are told that they were "erased from the family register, involved in an experiment, and gained certain powers." They then have to compete against each other in varying matches.

As it turns out, he actually played and completed

name: Yuuri Amagake
description:
__Ability__: Quintuple her physical abilities

She is a second year high school student.

name: Yukina Himuro
description: Yukina Himuro has always been feared by other students in her classes because of her sharp eyes and cold skin temperature. She is secretly a cell phone novelist by the name of "Yupina", whose cell phone novel made it very popular, that is until Yukina hears from two other girls that her novels are getting boring due to the lack of "romance". Worried about her novel, Yukina doesn't know what to do until, the famous student council president Shigure Kitami comes along and accidentally drops his student handbook. Yukina picks it up to give back to him, but when she sees what is inside, she finds

name: Shigure Kitami
description: Shigure Kitami is the student body president and the most popular guy in school. His father is the director of a big hospital. He owns a student notebook that lists every girl in his 9th grade class and puts checks next to each girl that confesses their love to him and also writes the method they used to confess to him and he turns them down each and every time. One day he drops this notebook and Yukina Himuro, the heroine of the story, finds it, and uses it to blackmail him into teaching her about love to help her write her cell phone novel. In the novel, he is the Count. Yukina uses Shigure

name: Mami Mizuno
description: Mami Mizuno is Shigure Kitami's childhood friend and seems to be quite possessive about him as she seems to get angry whenever she sees his shy expressions when Yukina Himuro's around. She seems to know about Shigure's secret of carrying a student notebook which includes names of the girls in his class and which he uses to keep track of how many girls have confessed to him and what methods have been used by them. Mami doesn't seem to like Yukina much as she is able to bring about real feelings of like and love from Shigure, which again indicates that Mami likes Shigure.   When she sees Shigure

name: Akira Shimotsuki
description: Akira Shimotsuki is Himuro Yukina's cousin. His parents died in a fatal accident when he was still a young child. He seemes to have a strong devotion towards his cousin Yukina because his life was saved by Yukina when he almost got hit by a car right after he heard his parents were no longer coming home. Akira is one of the only people who knows that Yukina is disguised as a cellphone novelist, Yupina. Akira is almost always seen eating food besides Yukina, such as melon bread.  Being Yukina's cousin doesn't stop him from being in love with her. He's never been apart from her since they were c

name: Aria Pokoteng
description:
Amongst the undine companies, it's a tradition to keep a blue-eyed cat (breed is not a problem here) as mascot for good luck.

President Aria is the Aria Company's mascot, a male Aqua breed feline (common trait are bigger than Earth breed and human-level intelligence). He is smart enough to understand human speech. President Aria was a stray cat before being taken in by Grandma twenty years ago and has been the company's mascot ever since.

He really loves to eat - coupled with [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/379/Florence-Alicia) and [Akari](https://anilist.co/character/378/Mizunashi-Aka

name: Aileen Dautriche
native: アイリーン・ローレン・ドートリシュ
description: A villainess who remembered her past life. However, her incomplete memories are making it very hard for her to avoid doom.

appearsIn.title: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss

name: Claude Elmir
native: クロード・ジャンヌ・エルメイア
description: The demon king and oldest prince of Imperial Ellmeyer. The source of Aileen's death flags.

appearsIn.title: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss

name: Hagumi Hanamoto
description:
__Height__: 142 cm (4'6")

A supremely gifted artist, Hagu's immense talents are esteemed by all who witness her works, catching the eye of numerous professional artists who insistently urge her to submit her work to exhibitions to heighten her publicity (which she seems to find daunting). She is 18 years of age at the beginning of the series and her appearance is that of a child, and she conveniently behaves as one. Raised in a largely sheltered and obscure home by her irritable grandmother, her sociability is below average. It is whilst living in that home that Hagu develops her skill in dra

name: Takumi Mayama
description:
__Height__: 183 cm (6")

Takumi is a 4th year student at the start of the series and is from Kanazawa, Ishikawa-ken and an architecture student at the art institute. He lives in the same complex as Takemoto and Morita. He occupies room 101, sharing the floor with an unknown individual and formerly Lohmeyer-senpai. He acts as a senior to Takemoto and tries to help Morita get up for early morning classes. At one point, Takemoto and Morita are seen sleeping alongside him in his futon. Morita also borrows Mayama's shirts from time to time because it's more comfortable. Mayama also hates being left

name: Shinobu Morita
description:
__Height__: 175 cm (5'8")
__Specialty__: Sculptures


A 6th year student in the beginning of the series, Morita occupies room 203, his floormates being Takemoto and Hasegawa. Morita is unable to graduate, as he can never wake up on time to go to classes. This is mainly due to the work that he does, which forces him to go missing for periods of time. What he does for work though remains a mystery. When Morita comes back from his mysterious job, he immediately falls asleep for at least 48 hours, due to the amount of work he does. He also returns with a large sum of money in his back-pocket and b

name: Yuuta Takemoto
description:
__Height__: 170 cm (5'7")

Yuuta Takemoto is a second-year student at the art college. He is from Annaka city, Gunma-ken. He lives in the same apartment complex as Mayama and Morita in room 202. His floormates are Morita and Hasegawa. Takemoto studies architecture, but has little certainty as to what he wishes to do upon graduating; his decision to attend art college was because he liked to build things with his hands, like he had with his father.  Takemoto is one of the more mellow characters in the series. He falls in love with Hagu immediately after being introduced by his professor and kee

name: Ayumi Yamada
description:
__Height__: 165 cm (5'5")

Yamada is well known by her peers at the art college. Due to her good looks, she also catches the attention of her male friends/coworkers at the shopping district she works with.  She and Hagu seem to be very close, like siblings. While Hagu addresses the three young men by their last names, she calls Yamada by her first name. Yamada really cares for Hagu like a younger sister. She offers to stay with her while Shuji is gone. Although not shown as much as her relationship with Hagu, she is close friends with Takemoto and Morita.
Yamada is deeply in love with one of h

name: Seiichi Aramiya
description:
__Eye color:__ Black
__Hair color:__ Black
__Occupation:__ Student
__Debut:__ Chapter 1 (Manga) / Volume 1 (Light Novel)

Seiichi Aramiya is the main male protagonist of [Real no Heroine wa Irimasen!](https://anilist.co/manga/99461/). 

_Appearance:_ Seiichi is a high school boy with black hair and light blue eyes.

name: Helvi
description: A is a demon summoned by Theo Asper. She joins his team and is infatuated with him. In the first chapter, the main character wants her to marry him.

name: Aoi Asada
description: A 2nd year and the Vice-president of the Newspaper Club. She was Fujimaru's father's apprentice in karate. She seems to have a slight crush on Fujimaru.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Otoya Kujou
description: A 3rd year and the President of the Newspaper Club. He is Fujimaru's childhood friend. He is also, Fujimaru's "back up." He was the only one that knew about Fujimaru's supreme hacking skills, and was the one that told the Newspaper Club (with Fujimaru's permission) about the Takagis' work. Lately, it was revealed that he likes Fujimaru's younger sister, Haruka.    (source: Wikipedia)

name: Maya Orihara
description: She purchased a virus in Russia. She is currently undercover as Maya Orihara, a biology teacher in Mishiro Academy High School. Under her facade she shows others she is a cold and calculating killer who doesn't care who has to die to achieve her objective and even plans to kill Fujimaru's friends at the first chance she gets.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Fujimaru Takagi
description: A 2nd year high school student and a member of the Newspaper Club. Unknown to everyone (but his father, the PSIA, and the Newspaper Club), he is also Falcon, a hacker prodigy who hacks into corrupt people's computers and brings their crimes to light. When he goes into "Falcon Mode" his pupils become slits. It appears to be inherited, as his father also does this when fighting.    Source: wikipedia    In the live-action drama he is portrayed by Miura Haruma in both seasons.

name: Shuuko Yakumo
description: A 28-year-old widow who, after her husband died, kept accidentally making too much food. She then begins sharing the leftovers with her neighbor, the highschooler Yamato Shouhei.

name: Yamato Shouhei
description:
A highschooler who is part of his school's baseball team. He lives next-door to Shuuko Yakumo and starts eating meals with her after she began offering him her leftovers.
He has very healthy appetite.

name: Hana Nonomura
description:
Hana Nonomura is a normal sixteen-year old high school girl from an average income family. Hana's sister boycotted an unavoidable marriage meeting with Takane Saibara, so Hana was forced attend the meeting in her place.

Hana likes practical things.

name: Takane Saibara
description:
A scion and the grandson of the Takaba company's president. He has an arrogant personality and dislikes the commoner's lifestyle. Despite his personality, he is surprisingly an intelligent and capable office worker.

He loves home-cooked or top-quality dishes and dislikes pre-packaged food. Takane enjoys being on high places, such as tall buildings.

name: Angela
description:
As a child, she was a runaway slave, and after being liberated she lived in a rural village. Because she knew how to read and write, she used to help the village residents. 

She secretly wrote a fanfic about the first prince 'The Prince Among the Roses' which became a huge hit. Self proclaimed No. 1 Rayburn fan.

name: Rayburn Espelindo
description: A falsely accused prince with a tarnished image. Rumor has it that he loves bloodshed and is always craving for action. In reality, he's a calm person who was roped into royal family politics.

appearsIn.title: The Holy Power of Modern Medicine

name: Touya Senji
description: A student at the First High School affiliated with a certain national university. He is an extremely hard worker, studying and training until late at night, and always placing in the top 100 in national mock exams. Having grown up being compared to his genius older brother, he craves "talent" and feels intense jealousy towards "those who possess talent."

name: Albert Einstein
native: アルバート アインシュタイン
aliases: A. Einstein (A・アインシュタイン)
description:
__Talent:__ The ability to teleport by swapping spaces. However, there is a restriction that teleportation is only possible within the range of coordinates registered by the user.

One of the original members of the Forest of Great Men. She is mainly in charge of combat and movement, and is considered one of the "two strongest" along with [Newton](https://anilist.co/character/214621/Newton). She intensely dislikes men, even objecting to other women interacting with them.

name: Haito Le Buffett
description:
__Talent:__ A talent enabling the wielding of swordsmanship reaching beyond human limits. Two blades—the “Kubi-gari” and the “Hara sogi”—materialize, awakening superhuman strength and dynamic visual acuity.

She is [Touya's](https://anilist.co/character/214623/Touya-Senji) classmate, but doesn't attend school often. She was invited to join the Kendo club as a scholarship student, and is a master swordsman feared by those around her. She has a bright and combative personality, and sometimes enjoys fighting.

name: John V. Neumann
description:
__Talent:__ A talent for quantifying all information and predicting the future. This awakens incredible calculation and thinking abilities, resulting in accuracy so high that it is said to be able to predict the future.

A girl who always sits in a wheelchair. She is the leader of the Forest of Great Men, a group of people who aim for "world peace," and one of its original members. In contrast to her young appearance, she is always calm, collected, and rational, and is the sole leader of the chain of command for her companions.

name: Hikari Wanda
description:
First-year member of the dance club. Hikari loves dancing. Not very muscular, but has excellent physical intuition. 

The artist that inspired her into dancing was Michael Jackson and she wants to become a dancer like him.

name: Kaboku Kotani
description: First-year member of the dance club. Has trouble talking in front of people because of his stutter. It was Wanda who drew him into the dance club.

name: Konata
description:
Konata is a mysterious high school girl who confined a mangaka in his (The mangaka's) own room.

The reason she held him captive is so he can draw manga for her.

Despite wearing a school uniform, Konata didn't really go to school. She bought foods and daily needs with the Mangaka's bank account.

During the confinement, Konata learned how to cook so she can feed the Mangaka more proper and healthy food. Over time, she started to let her guard down and even reveal her face and name to the Mangaka.

appearsIn.title: Mishiranu Joshikousei ni Kankinsareta Mangaka no Hanashi

name: Shuusei Kugayama
description: Shuusei is the prince of the school. Due to an accident, he starts living together with Aoi. Throughout the series he continuously teases her.

name: Aoi Nishimori
description: At first Aoi finds Shuusei annoying and arrogant, though throughout the course of the story, she starts warming up to him. She is very good at cooking and often cooks the meals at the house.  In chapter 22, when Shuusei is leaving, Aoi is running after him in the rain, she hugs him from behind and confesses to him. He then tells her that he doesn't hold the same feelings as she does, and walks away..     In chapter  29 Shuusei kisses Aoi after a misunderstanding about him and Satsuki and as of chapter 30 they are dating.

name: Loki
description:
Loki is Nakaba's servant. He is half animal and half human. He hates Caesar, and is plotting to assassinate him. He asks Nakaba to go along with it, but she is unsure. He frequently rescues Nakaba from Caesar and cares for her a great deal. He is her personal servant and took care of her since she was young.

It is revealed later that Loki is Nakaba's older brother. He also possesses the arcana of time and has been using it from the beginning of the story.

Later in the series, Loki demands that Nakaba gives him Senan. Neither Caesar or Nakaba are willing to fight him, so Loki gets his wishes.

name: Nakaba
description: Nakaba, is the now married to Caesar the prince of Belquat, in a marriage of convenience to keep her family and his, from feuding on the single island in which they live. She is disgusted by him, but cannot find the heart to kill him and is torn between assassinating him and letting him live. Her personal servant is Loki. She is frowned upon because of her red hair. Royals, have distinguished black hair. Caesar frequently reminds her of her place in his castle and as his wife, by means of lust, control and commands, that she cannot refuse.

name: Caesar
description:
Caesar is the prince of Belquat. He has an odd relationship with Nakaba, and frequently uses lust against her, to show her position as a subordinate. He puts on an act toward his people as a kind person who tolerates her, despite the colour of her hair and her sub-human and half animal servant, Loki.

All the royals, have black hair, and Caesar thinks that since he is a prince and has black hair, that he is above them. He is commanding, arrogant and likes to be in control. Later on though, he develops real feelings towards Nakaba.

name: Ririto Ibusuki
description: The first love of [Tarou](https://anilist.co/character/174329/Kurume-Tarou), from when they were in the same English class ten years ago. When Ibusuki left to go overseas Tarou forgot about their time together, until Tarou is hit in the head with a baseball. Three days later, out of the blue Ibusuki is a new transfer student in Tarou's class, looking a bit different to how he remembered.

name: Tarou Kurume
description: Wakasanomiya class 1-2. Childhood friends with Ebino Mei and Yatsuhiro Ryuu. Tarou believes in "energy-saving" and initially has no interest in love-related matters.

name: Mei Ebino
description: Tarou's childhood friend and neighbor. She attends the same school as him and is responsible for the injury that causes him to see the First Love Zombies.

name: Eve
description:
Kurume Tarou's first love zombie based off his expectations of what Ririsu Ibusuki would look like at 15 years old. Unlike most other zombies, Eve is self-aware and able to interact with her owner.

She often appears floating above Tarou's head wearing sparkly flowing pink hair with a hair accessory, and a white sailor uniform.

name: Delice Kaleid
description: Archduke of the Delpais Empire. Called the 'Reincarnation of Evil'.

appearsIn.title: I Was Tricked into this Fake Marriage!
I Was Tricked into this Fake Marriage!
Happy Harem Making with the Mightiest Orc!
Happy Harem Making with the Mightiest Orc!
Happy Harem Making with the Mightiest Orc!

name: Nomamoto
description: A 17-year-old girl who works at a factory run by an alien, who she hates. In fact, she hates all of the aliens that are now living in Japan.

name: Seiran Kitami
description: Nomamoto's co-worker. Kitami has a massive grudge against the alien race for killing his family in a car accident that the perpetrator got away with. He and Nomamoto join forces in an alien-killing journey.

name: Allen
description: Allen lives in a small, nameless pioneer village. His status is serf. Although he is ostensibly without talent, he actually has the world's only "Summoner" class. In fact, he was an enthusiastic gamer in his previous life, and with his experience and enthusiasm of clearing unreasonably high-difficulty games, he challenges the "hell mode" of another world.

appearsIn.title: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates Another World with Garbage Balancing - Summoner of the Beginning

name: Cecil Glo Alphasta
native: セシル・グロー・アルファスタ

appearsIn.title: An Observation Log of My Fiancée Who Calls Herself a Villainess

name: Bertia Ibil Noches
native: バーティア・イビル・ノーチェス

appearsIn.title: An Observation Log of My Fiancée Who Calls Herself a Villainess

name: Fuuma Monou
description:
The primary antagonist and Kamui's dear friend. Fuuma is initially kind and gentle. He helps his father dutifully and dotes upon his younger sister Kotori, and excels at high-school sports. After Nataku attacks Kyogo and steals the first Shinken, Fuuma's dying father tells him that he is Kamui's twin star. Accordingly, when Kamui chooses the Dragons of Heaven, Fuuma is forced to become a Dragon of Earth, immediately attacking Kamui. He proceeds to grant wishes to the characters with whom he interacts, in ways that often lead to their death or that of a loved one.

In __Tsubasa: Reservoir Chron

name: Kamui Shirou
description:
__Powers:__ Powerful psychic, demonstrating telekinetic ability, the proverbial "power (authority) of God"
__Kekkai (barrier field):__ Perfect sphere (anime only)
__Relatives:__ Shirou Tooru / Magami Tooru (mother; deceased), Magami Tokiko
__Romantic Interests:__ Monou Kotori
__Closer Friends:__ Monou Fuma

When the audience is first introduced to Kamui at the very beginning of X, he appears to be nothing more than a brooding and somewhat cocky fifteen year old from Okinawa who is gifted with extraordinary telekinetic powers. He has returned to the place where he spent his early childhood, Tok

appearsIn.title: Boroboro no Elf-san wo Shiawase ni Suru Kusuriuri-san
Boroboro no Elf-san wo Shiawase ni Suru Kusuriuri-san

name: Eizo
description: A man who loves cats and working with his hands. Formerly a corporate drone.

appearsIn.title: My Quiet Blacksmith Life in Another World

name: Samya
description: A half-tiger girl who's one of the beastfolk. She came to live with Eizo after he rescued her from the brink of death.

appearsIn.title: My Quiet Blacksmith Life in Another World

name: Rike
description: A dwarf who begged her way into an apprenticeship with Eizo after being captivated by his skills.

appearsIn.title: My Quiet Blacksmith Life in Another World

name: Credos
description:
Level 666

A college student, who transmigrated into the final boss of the game "Paladin of Blood". Thinking if he lived like this, he would be killed by the warriors he raised, Kim Jang-Cheol, a graduate student and slave to the agricultural department, uses his knowledge of agriculture to survive the starving demon invasion.

appearsIn.title: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!
It Takes More than a Pretty Face to Fall in Love
It Takes More than a Pretty Face to Fall in Love
The Isekai Returnee is Too OP for the Modern World

name: Nanase Kuga
description: Birthday: March 24 Sign: Aries   Likes: Gratin Dislikes: Wasabi  Classmate of Toru (2-6) whose Iris lets her see people emotions based on a color their "wings" have (for example "anxious" purple). She's a quiet girl with kinda sleepy expression on her face. She's a childhood friend of Tokita Harumi and is in love with a boy called Houjou.  She encourages Sasamori Koyuki's love for Toru, though her own feelings for Houjou become a catalyst for a lot of troublesome situations - even life-threatening ones...

name: Toru Mizushima
description: Mizushima Toru (class 2-3) is one of the few people born with no Iris, an Iris Zero. Because of that, he was bullied in childhood and is desperately trying not to stand out in any way. His motto is "Minimal Exposure" but after Sasamori Koyuki, one of the most popular girls in school (and therefore his natural enemy), takes interest in him, it starts to become more and more difficult for him to not being noticed.  Toru's best friend is Shinozuka Hijiri (class 2-6) and he's known Yuki Asahi (also 2-6) from childhood, though for a long time they were far from what could be called "friendship".  H

name: Koyuki Sasamori
description: Because of her Iris that allows her to see people "qualified" (O above the person's head) or "unqualified"(X above the head) to any task she thinks of at the moment, she is chosen to find a new Student Council President. After it becomes more difficult than she thought, she turns to Mizushima Toru, a person "qualified" to help her. Because of her popularity in school, he's far from being delighted with her, but in the end he helps her...  It turns out the person qualified to become a new Student Council President is the only person she couldn't have looked at - herself.  Very grateful, she tri

name: Hijiri Shinozuka
description: Being an Iris Zero, Toru isn't too popular, but Hijiri doesn't care about that and is his best friend. He always seems carefree and easy-going - the sleeves of his uniform seem to be longer than necessary - but there is more to him than meets the eye. Very few people know about his Iris - as he is keeping that secret - and it was only Toru that was able to see through him...   Even since he was a kid he's been able to see black butterflies no one else saw. Later he realised it was his Iris allowing him to see upcoming death of living beings. Knowing about inevitable dead he saw no sense in lif

name: Harumi Tokita
description:
Sign: Taurus
Likes: Spicy Foods
Dislikes: Milk

Toru's classmate, a bespectacled and kinda mysterious guy. Childhood friend of Koga Nanase. He seems to be a cold, scheming type, who doesn't care for others and plans something behind the curtains... Even though in volumes' omakes he's pictured as a pervert type.   His Iris allows him to see people's love affections for each other - he can see an arrow pointing from a person to their loved one.

name: Asahi Yuki
description: Asahi was Toru's friend in childhood, one of a few who knew about him being an Iris Zero. When they got into a fight she revealed his secret, causing him to become a victim of bullying - that made them more of "childhood enemies" than "childhood friends". Asahi is now Sasamori Koyuki's best friend, together with her in class 2-6. When Asahi slaps her homeroom teacher, Fujimura-sensei, Koyuki runs to Toru (who's "qualified" to help) and makes him resolve the problem - thus causing Toru and Asahi to eventually make up.  With her Iris's power, Asahi can see a devil's tail growing out of people wh

name: San  Tang
description:
Tang San was a former young prodigy of the renowned Tang Sect who was ostracized and not permitted to learn Tangmen's core skills despite the fact that none of the Tangmen core disciples were able to master the core skills. Following his death he was reborn while maintaining his past memories as the son of the Tang Hao.

His descendants are Wutong Tang/Dong Wang, Wulin Tang, Xuanyu Tang 

Soul Land 5
After the events of Soul Land 4 Tang San chose to reincarnate with his wife Xiao Wu on the Falan Planet where humans are slaves and also known as a lower race. Armed with the knowledge of both of

name: Rongrong  Ning
description: At her Spirit Awakening she received a rank of 9, and was considered an exceptionally talented Spirit Master. She was spoiled by all the members of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan, with her being their little princess.

name: Chenxiang Bai
description:
After she becomes part of Tang Sect and learns of Ma Hongjun's proposal and that her grandfather accepted she immediately becomes discontent. She confronts Hongjun and tells him to break it off and seeks assistance from Tang San. Tang San tells that she wouldn't have to marry him if their feelings are mutual.

Chenxiang then integrates herself with the Shrek Seven Devils. She is rather discontent when Grandmaster doesn't allow her to train together with them against Chen Xin but becomes shocked after witnessing the power difference between her and them.

name: Mubai Dai
description:
Dai Mubai is a short tempered person who is often impulsive. He is well aware of his strength and limits. He is a loyal person who cares much for his friends.

Dai Mubai is the second prince of the royal household in the Star Luo Empire. The heir to the throne is by tradition the strongest in the royal family, so he and his older brother are rivals. Dai Mubai since the birth of Zhu Zhuqing was promised in marriage to her as per agreement of their families. Dai Mubai left home in order to become stronger and never lose to anyone. He is the senior at the Shrek Academy and he broke the record for

name: Hongjun  Ma
description: Ma Hongjun was found by Flender for his unique spirit and was recruited by him to the Shrek Academy at the age of 11. Ma Hongjun thus became Flender's disciple.

name: Zhuqing Zhu
description: She and Dai Mubai have been promised to each other in marriage since a very young age. Following Dai Mubai's departure to Heaven Dou Empire, she follows him and enrolls in Shrek Academy to be by his side.

name: Xiaowu
description:
She is a beautiful girl with a rosy face. She has a fair and soft appearance that resembles a completely ripe honey peach. She has beautiful long legs. Her brown long hair is combed into a scorpion braid hanging past her buttocks. She possesses a pair of bright and intelligent eyes. 

She is a spirit beast who transformed into a human on reaching 100,000 years of cultivation. 

Soul Land 5
After the events of Soul Land 4 Xiao Wu reincarnated on the Falan Planet where humans are slaves and a lower race with no memories of her past.

name: Oscar
description: Oscar is the only known person to be an Auxiliary Food System Spirit Master with Innate Full Spirit Power. There is a variant nature of his tool spirit, and therefore he was recruited into the Shrek Academy for his uniqueness.

name: Sese
description:
Sese is the first ghost Gwangnam meets in the Underworld. She is not very strong, but is very smart, having been in Hell for twenty years and possessing many books. Due to dying while still unborn, it appears that as long as she does not touch them, the dead cannot sense her.

Sese came to the Underworld as a unborn child when her mother committed suicide while pregnant with her. Initially, their relationship was antagonistic and Sese's mother wanted nothing to do with her. They stayed in Hell for a significant amount of time, working to save money to buy the informational books on Hell. Sense

name: Gwang-nam Jang
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm

The protagonist of the Korean webtoon series 'Hellper.' Gwangnam, whom is the leader of Killerboros; a gang that helps individuals in need and designs clothes, is killed off by an unknown individual in a truck at the start of the series.

Being the leader of a 'gang' as big as Killerboros, Gwangnam is an individual adored by many, and for good reason, given his selfless attitude. Through the course of the series Hellper, Gwangnam embarks on a quest to collect 100 black tickets from other condemned souls and become reincarnated as to return to his friends and family.

name: Kengo Fujimoto
description: Fujimoto works for the National Welfdelivers ikigami, or death notices, to their recipients. While his job is for the "good of the country" he has doubts about the morality of it all and second guesses whether what he's doing is right or not.  His girlfriend broke up with him because of how his work affects his mood and personality, which he explains with how he has to basically deliver death to people and he can't possibly be open or cheerful about such a thing. He receives a new batch of ikigami to deliver each month.

name: Henrietta
description: She was left for dead after the brutal murder of all members of her family, Henrietta is the newest addition to the Agency. She was assaulted repeatedly next to the dead bodies all night, which had inflicted psychological trauma to her, making her suicidal. Her struggle is the most developed of all the girls as she adjusts to her new life. Henrietta's favorite activity is to spend time with her handler, Jose. Whenever Jose seems to turn his attention to other women (including the other cyborgs of the SWA), Henrietta becomes slightly jealous. This is due to Henrietta's strong romantic feelings

name: Triela
description:
She was former victim of a Mafia child smuggling group based in Amsterdam, Triela was one among many who regularly suffered abuse in the form of drugs, torture, rape and mutilation. She was rescued by a pair of Europol detectives, one of whom was her future handler, [Hilshire](https://anilist.co/character/2026/Hilshire). After being mortally wounded in a gunfight, Hilshire's partner bravely used the last of her strength to perform CPR on Triela, enabling Hilshire to save the child's life.

Triela has a sarcastic wit and prefers to wear masculine clothing. She serves as a sort of mentor/Mother

name: Rico
description: She was born with severe birth defects confining her to a hospital since birth, Rico's parents signed her over to the SWA on her eleventh birthday, where she was given a new lease on life due to her cybernetic operation. Rico loves her new body and life at the SWA, viewing each day as a blessing. She maintains a happy disposition, despite her treatment as a machine by her handler, Jean. Rico is only one who clearly remembers her past: that she was in a hospital, that her parents fought, and where her father works.

name: Claes
description: Once known as Fleda Claes Johansson, this girl has undefined origins. In the beginning, Claes is confined to the Agency, unable to participate in missions with the other girls because her handler, Raballo, had died, which caused her to snap. She is used as a test subject by the cyborg engineers, who utilize controlled situations and equipment to monitor the usefulness of her implants. Claes wears glasses from her life before her cybernetic operation as a visual reminder of the promise she once made to Raballo and is knowledgeable and mature for her age.

name: Jose Croce
description: An agent of Section 2. Henrietta's handler and Jean's younger brother. Unlike the other fratello (sibling), José truly lives up to the name, caring for Henrietta like a protective brother and showing a good deal of interest and concern for her welfare. As such, he attempts to minimize Henrietta's conditioning as much as possible. Years ago, José had a younger sister who adored him and wished to join the Carabinieri when she was older, in order to protect him. She resembled Henrietta somewhat and died in a terrorist attack which possibly caused her to drown. Due to his sister's death, José gain

name: Venti
description:
__Origin:__ Mondstadt
__Constellation:__ Carmen Dei

A bard that seems to have arrived on some unknown wind — sometimes sing songs as old as the hills, and other times sing poems fresh and new. Likes apples and lively places, but is not a fan of cheese or anything sticky. When using his Anemo power to control the wind, it often appears as feathers, as he's fond of that which appears light and breezy.

Venti's true persona is that of Barbatos, the Anemo God, one of the seven Archons of Teyvat. He has a rather mischievous attitude and a liking to rhyming in his speech.

name: Diluc Ragnvindr
description:
__Origin:__ Mondstadt
__Constellation:__ Noctua

Born into the affluent Ragnvindr Clan, Diluc is the current owner of the Dawn Winery and a nobleman of high esteem in Mondstadt society. While a past incident caused him to split ways with the Knights of Favonius, he continues to protect Mondstadt in his own way.

Diluc was once an ideal young man, dedicated to his work with Knights of Favonius, and a man who adored his father. However. after his father's untimely demise, along with Inspector Eroch ordering Diluc to cover up the incident, his faith in the Knights shattered and he started supress

name: Jean Gunnhildr
description:
__Origin:__ Mondstadt
__Constellation:__ Leo Minor

As the Acting Grandmaster of the Knights, Jean has always been devoted to her duties and maintaining peace in Mondstadt. She had taken precautions long before the onset of Stormterror's assault, and she will guard Mondstadt with her life as always. Barbara is her younger sister.

name: Amber
description:
__Origin:__ Mondstadt
__Constellation:__ Lepus

A perky, straightforward girl, who is also the only Outrider of the Knights of Favonius. Her amazing mastery of the glider has made her a three-time winner of the Gliding Champion in Mondstadt. As a rising star within the Knights of Favonius, Amber is always ready for any challenging tasks.

name: Lisa Minci
description:
__Origin:__ Mondstadt
__Constellation:__ Tempus Fugit

She is an intellectual witch who can never get enough naps. As the Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, Lisa is smart in that she always knows exactly what to do with whatever troubles her. As much as she loves her sleep, she still manages to keep everything under control in a calm, composed manner.

name: Kaeya  Alberich
description:
__Origin:__ Mondstadt
__Constellation:__ Pavo Ocellus

Kaeya is an adopted son to the Ragnvindr Family, the renowned tycoon in winery. It has been a long time since he last called Diluc Ragnvindr "brother". Kaeya currently serves as the Cavalry Captain of the Knights of Favonius, trusted by Jean. Kaeya is often the one cleaning or wrapping things up in every incident that occurred in the vicinity of Mondstadt.

name: Collei
description:
__Origin:__ Sumeru
__Constellation:__ Leptailurus Cervarius

Originally a victim of Fatui human experimentation, Collei wandered the world as a vagrant until she met [Amber](https://anilist.co/character/190866) in Mondstadt. Since then, Collei has turned her life around, and currently serves as a trainee Forest Ranger in the Avidya Forest.

A Trainee Forest Ranger who is under the tutelage of Tighnari. She started her academic career a little later than her peers, so she is currently working hard to catch up. She hides the other side of her personality deep under the surface of optimism and ki

name: Byakuya Ishigami
description:
Byakuya Ishigami was a Japanese astronaut who was residing on the International Space Station when the Petrification on Earth's surface occurred. He was a kind, playful, and mischievous man who always found a way to amuse himself and keep things lighthearted, no matter the stakes.

He was [Senku Ishigami](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Senkuu-Ishigami)'s adoptive father.

name: REI
description:
REI is a robot made by Byakuya using 60 smartphone chips. 
It contains data from Space Engineering, Earth Science to Astronomy, but it does not have any common knowledge, such as human life spans.

name: Souta Oshio
description: A second-year student at Sakuraba High School. He's in charge of social media at his father's cafe, "cafe tutuji", and is skilled at taking stylish photos. Through an encounter at the cafe, he begins to learn the true nature of Sato-san.

appearsIn.title: The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me
The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me

name: Hae-Jun Go
description:
A second-year high school student who can see ghosts. He recently transferred to a new school, and due to his mother's obsession with the supernatural, he's desperate to leave home and stay in the school dorms. After a tragic accident, he finally gets his wish, but ends up in a run-down old house which is supposedly haunted. 

Hae-Jun's new life isn't as easy as he'd hoped, as he's constantly fighting with his dormmate, silently enduring his classmates' bullying, and pretending not to notice the ghosts, all while struggling with his recent trauma.

name: Eun-Yeong Baek
description:
A first-year high school student who lives in the supposedly-haunted old dorm house. He's constantly butting heads with [Hae-Jun](https://anilist.co/character/273310/Go-Hae-Jun), his new dormmate, due to his selfish behaviour and messy nature. He's always surrounded by friends, to whom he seems bright and fun, but to Hae-Jun he's cold and snarky. 

Although the two get on each others' nerves, they realise that they both have nowhere else to go, and must live together in the run-down old dorm.

name: Ju-Wan Park
description:
A second-year high school student at Hansol High, who is desperate to move into dorms. He has kept diaries since he was young, which his mother would read then laugh about with her friends. Exhausted with his lack of privacy, he eventually moves in with Hae-Jun and Eun-Yeong in the old dorm building. 

Unfortunately, his troubles seem to have followed him to his new home. His talkative nature rubs his dormmates the wrong way, unintentionally offending them, and his personal belonging start to go missing, leading him to accuse Eun-Yeong of stealing.

Although his dorm life gets off to a rocky s

name: Marie Kim
description:
A second-year high school student and president of the journalism club. Her parents divorced when she was young, and her mother left and started a new family. Even though she was just a child, Marie was burdened with the housework, cooking and cleaning for her father and older brother. Although she was happy to help when she was young, all the responsibility is too much for her, and she dreams of moving into the school dorms. 

As well as taking care of the home, Marie has to put up with her older brother's temper. They often have fun and play games together, but if he gets angry, he often hit

name: Akane Maekawa
description:
__Height__: 152cm

Works in the Administration Department.

name: Makoto Shimizu
description:
__Height__: 168cm

Works in R&D software design department.

name: Jae-Ha Kim
description: The childhood friend of Se-I Yun.

name: Se-I Yun
description: The childhood friend of Jae-Ha Kim.

name: Neko Kuroha
description:
Being a magician Kuroha has the power to destroy any inanimate object, as well as transferring power when in direct contact with organic beings. Her power is so strong that while being in the lab, she had to undergo multiple extensive tests. As a result, Kuroha has almost completely forgotten her childhood memories, with only a few bits of emotion lingering.

Although usually gentle and caring, she can be short-tempered when embarrassed. She easily gets jealous when Murakami is "too close" to other girls (especially when Kazumi is seducing Murakami) and she would use her magic to destroy thi

name: Ryouta Murakami
description: The main character with high intellect and a photographic memory. He wants to be an astronomer who works at NASA due to a promise he made with his childhood friend Kuroneko. After meeting the magic users, he decides to provide shelter to them at an abandoned observatory despite knowing that their pursuers have orders to kill whoever comes in contact with them, usually coming with plans to have their location concealed while looking for ways to provide the medicine they need to keep living while helping them to live their lives as normal as possible.

name: Kana Tachibana
description: Kana is a magician who escaped the laboratory with Kuroha and is her roommate. Kana is paralyzed and cannot talk without her keyboard and has good intentions though she can be quite mouthy and rude. She has the ability to predict how and when people are going to die.

name: Nanami Tokou
description: Nanami is an unique AA+ rank magic user and a minor antagonist. She is soft-spoken, and has a taste in sugar. Her research number is 5210. Her ability is scanning, modifying and erasing people's memories up to a certain point if they look directly at her eyes.

name: Kazumi Schlierenzauer
native: カズミシュリーレンツァウアー
description:
Kazumi is a half-Austrian magician who speaks Japanese with a Kansai accent. Her power is hacking computer systems.

She, also has feelings for Ryouta that she would try to seduce him and even go naked in front of him.

name: Hatsuna Wakabayashi
description: Hatsuna is a magician who escaped the laboratory. She has the ability to resurrect herself so cannot be killed by any physical harm. However, she will still die if she stops consuming pills.

name: Kotori Takatori
description:
Kotori has the ability to switch with other people and things as well as allowing others to come with her when she uses her powers. However she can only use her powers once which then causes her to hang up. Despite this handicap, her ability has often come into place in vital situations. She is not familiar with other magicians when still lived in the lab.

Kotori is a clumsy but soft-hearted girl. She gets nervous easily, and when that happens, she will start to stutter. She likes all kinds of desserts and does eat a lot of food.

name: Aika Hiiragi
description: Aika is a young girl attending Seinagi Private High School and is thus a mage in training. She has a unique trait in that she is able to laugh at nearly anything, which always ends up being loud and unrestrained. Her father is one of the magic teachers at her school. Aika has a naturally kind and forgiving personality and it takes a lot for her to not forgive someone for anything they have done to wrong her. She also has a natural clumsiness, which often makes it difficult for her to recite magic spells.        During her elementary and junior high school years, she attended all-girl schools,

name: Taiga Kuzumi
description: Taiga is the protagonist of the story who is a normal guy who fails at first to get into the high school of his choice, but is soon after taken onto the school grounds against his will when he is mistaken for a truant student. He tends to have a very strong-willed personality and never wants to back down from anything. His personality is only matched by his physical strength, as he can hold his own in hand-to-hand combat. At his preliminary interview into the school of magic he now attends, he briefly met a cute girl named Aika Hiiragi who he instantly has feelings towards. During his first ti

name: Shinichi Nagakawa
description: A painter, he dies at the beginning and is presented an ultimatum.

name: King
description: Role:CrewmateFate:He loses when ends up doubting and voting Megane out.

name: Tamago
description: Role:ImpostorFate:They end up winning the game when King ejects Megane for doubting him.

name: Yankee
description: Role:CrewmateFate:Ends up breaking off his pompadour by rubbing it too much when they couldn't take standing still anymore, for this he ends up losing his reason to live and commits suicide.

name: Megane
description: Role:CrewmateFate:They correctly guess who was the imposter, but ends up getting kicked out in the end for being sus.

name: Cap
description: Role:CrewmateFate:Gets killed off first by Tamago for talking stuff about the fried egg on their head.

description: Haru is a lonely mangaka.

appearsIn.title: Before Dawn and the End of the World
Before Dawn and the End of the World

name: Tae
description: Main character of chapter 8.

appearsIn.title: Before Dawn and the End of the World

name: Esono
description: An old man who has lost his wife, job and meaning in life. One day he leaves home in search for himself...

appearsIn.title: Before Dawn and the End of the World

name: Oozawa
description: A high school girl who was dumped by her boyfriend and doesn't get along with her parents. She met Esono while they were both wandering in quest of purpose.

appearsIn.title: Before Dawn and the End of the World

name: Tamura Masatoshi
description: Tamura is a high school boy who is uncertain about his future.

appearsIn.title: Before Dawn and the End of the World

name: Eiko Tajima
description: A young girl with a charming smile who works part-time at the kiosk of a train station.

appearsIn.title: Before Dawn and the End of the World

name: Wakana Esono
description: Esono Wakana is a high school girl who is busy with her exams. She likes Horikawa Yuusuke.

appearsIn.title: Before Dawn and the End of the World

name: Sugisaki
description: Sugisaki is a high school boy. He is worried about his mother who is involved with a shady cult.

appearsIn.title: Before Dawn and the End of the World

name: Lachiel Magentano
aliases: 拉基爾．亞得里亞．瑪珍塔諾
description:
He is the main protagonist of The Apothecary Prince. 
He is the descendant of Lloyd Frontera and Alicia Termina Magentano

name: Meika
description:
She works as a maid for Kota. She is infatuated with him, but she cannot show her feelings. 

In later chapters, she confesses her love to him and they become a couple.

name: Kouta
description: Kouta is a first year high school student. He is Meika's Master, classmate and love interest

name: Aria
description: A vampire that Ichika meets during a visit.

name: Eva-Beatrice
native: エヴァ・ベアトリーチェ
description: A witch who resides within Eva's heart. She represents all of Eva's dark desires from her childhood, including her greed for the Ushiromiya family inheritance; as such, she has the appearance of Eva as a young girl.   She first appears in Banquet of the Golden Witch, where she helps Eva solve the riddle of Beatrice's epitaph, leading to her discovery of Kinzo's hidden gold and her inheritance of the Ushiromiya family. As stipulated in the epitaph, Eva inherits the name "Beatrice" and is granted the titles of Golden and Endless Witch, with Lambdadelta as her guardian. Eva-Beatrice is described

appearsIn.title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 3: Banquet of the Golden Witch

name: Irushia
description:
The hero of the story, who reincarnated as a dragon. They have vague memories of their past life, and hopes of making friends with the humans of this world. Their goal is to level up and evolve into a powerful dragon, both to allow them to communicate with humans, and more than that, to allow them to survive.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Myria Milleania
description:
A cheerful, peaceful, and somewhat quiet girl. Lives in a forest village. One of the few healing mages in her village, she spends her days curing the wounded, patrolling the surrounding area, and helping with battles against monsters. Her strong sense of responsibility leads to her getting caught up in the incidents surrounding the baby dragon she encountered in the forest.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Miharu Suzukaze
description: An assassin.

appearsIn.title: Hachigatsu Kokonoka Boku wa Kimi ni Kuwareru.

name: Cecile
aliases: 瑟西爾·弗朗比耶·納比坦

name: Nagato Sunohara
description: A calligrapher who moved from Nagoya to Tokyo for personal reasons. Got married to Haruhi and does chores for her in exchange for living at her house.

appearsIn.title: Black Sesame Salt and Custard Pudding

name: Haruhi Fukunaga
description: 22-year-old girl who loves her job in Tokyo as a heavy machine operator. Has a crush on her co-worker.

appearsIn.title: Black Sesame Salt and Custard Pudding

name: Fang Yuan Gu Yue
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm (5'11")

Fang Yuan is formerly a Scholar from Earth, he mysteriously transmigrated into the Gu World where he lived his first life for 500 years. He started as a common clan member before growing into a Gu Immortal and Sect Master of the Demonic Path. At the very end of this 500 Year Life, Fang Yuan was cornered by his foes and forced to use the power of his newly refined Spring Autumn Cicada to travel back in time to the days of his youth.

In the Five Regions And Two Heavens, Fang Yuan became infamous for being one of the strongest demonic overlords of his time. He is some

name: Tsubaki Kuchinashi
description:
Tsubaki, beloved by all female students, has a hatred towards men and utilizes her position as the granddaughter of the school's principal to expel anyone she wishes on moments notice.

While trying to expel a male student, she soon discovers her fondness for the opposite gender.

name: Tadashi Kiritsu
description:
Kiritsu, the head of the Public Morals Committee.
His upstanding behaviour and dislike towards Kuchinashi's grip on the school poses as threat to Kuchinashi.

name: Noel Stollen
native: ノエル・シュトーレン
description:
__Job:__ Talker
__Cluster:__ The Blue Beyond

__Job:__ Tactician
__Cluster:__ Wild Tempest


Following in the footsteps of his heroic grandfather, he aims to be the "Strongest Seeker". However, his job is "Talker" which is regarded as the weakest. Knowing that, Noel worked hard persistently to fulfil his ambition. Despite the merciless methods he employed for the sake of his ambition, which is considered "evil". Noel’s distinct talent attracted many powerful people and they began to gather under him.

appearsIn.title: The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan

name: Koga Tsukishima
description:
__Job:__ Blademan
__Cluster:__ The Blue Beyond

__Job:__ Samurai
__Cluster:__ Wild Tempest 

The undefeated Swordman from an island nation in the Far East. His swordsmanship is outstanding, and his slashing skills are top-notch. However, he is bound by a slave contract and cannot disobey his master's orders.

appearsIn.title: The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan

name: Alma Judikhali
native: アルマ・イウディカーレ
description:
__Job:__ Scout
__Cluster:__ The Blue Beyond

__Job:__ Assassin
__Cluster:__ Wild Tempest 

She is the granddaughter of the legendary paid killer, "Assassin." She has been training as an assassin since childhood and has outstanding abilities.

appearsIn.title: The Most Notorious "Talker" Runs the World's Greatest Clan
Kurokiya-san Wants to Lead Him Around by the Nose
Kurokiya-san Wants to Lead Him Around by the Nose

name: Eriko Ichimura
description: A plain-looking high school girl who spends her free time posting fantasies of handsome men on her Twitter. Goes by "Lovesick Ellie" as her handle.

name: Akira Ohmi
description: The most popular, "dream boy" at school, who is friendly to everyone. He is also the subject of Ellie's fantasies.

name: Kuroe Akaishi
description: Kuroe has been suffering from a mysterious illness for at least sixteen years that causes abnormal body growth and disfigurement. This has led Kuroe to become an outcast feeling that nobody could accept someone like her. She has a pet dog named "Jumbo King".

name: Manatsu Tomosato
description: Kaijuu Fan Girl No.1

He pretends to be a powerful sorcerer, which allows people to dismiss his social aloofness. 

Naska likes Candy Floss and fried chicken.

His primary position is attack (DPS) but he plays best as a sniper.

He sneaks away in the middle of school to play it in the computer lab, and notices another mysterious student doing the same thing. This kid is a far lower level than he is, so Su-Ho believes that he will easily beat the new kids in a few rounds. When he loses 0 to 10, he begins to realize that there is something special about this kid. That kid, is Do-Yoon Lee.

He recently tried to attack Vera and Earth Beast. It is revealed in volume 8 that the person that killed Lighting Tiger, was Yuri Linus.    In volume 9 Fire Dragon attacks Madoka and Hayato, after they protest of the training (lethal) given to Kombengi; R

He was, at one point, the third-strongest student at the school. In addition, he is a shrewd tactician who developed many techniques, some of which were specifically designed to counter the fighting style of Reunion such as "Half-step", he also helped Rud learn "Sharpened Sword force". It has been stated that if Rud didn't help him in the past, Shinra would have stolen his art. Understanding bodily principles is his specialty. She also provides him with information on the Feline Claws fighting style, which he pursues despite its inherent weakness. He develops a strong grudge against Guhoo after he kills Anichella in battle, and uses this motivation to rise to the top of the school.
